##### `HostSafeSlice`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries an immutable body-free subset of host facts selected for a safe public view.
pub struct HostSafeSlice {
    /// Project-scoped execution subject represented by this safe slice.
    pub project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Identity anchor corresponding to the project-scoped execution subject.
    pub global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Referenced logical host when a current or selected host is available to the safe read path.
    pub host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
    /// Immutable host generation when the selected safe facts are generation-bound.
    pub generation: Option<HostGeneration>,
    /// Field families actually present in this body-free slice.
    pub visible_fields: Vec<HostSafeField>,
    /// Public local host lifecycle summary when the identity field family is present.
    pub lifecycle_summary: Option<HostSafeLifecycleSummary>,
    /// Public local readiness summary when the qualification field family is present.
    pub readiness_summary: Option<HostSafeReadinessSummary>,
    /// Public local registration and session summary when that field family is present.
    pub session_summary: Option<HostSafeSessionSummary>,
    /// Public local health and recovery summary when that field family is present.
    pub health_summary: Option<HostSafeHealthSummary>,
    /// Public local closure and reconciliation summary when that field family is present.
    pub closure_summary: Option<HostSafeClosureSummary>,
    /// Public local handoff and publication summary when that field family is present.
    pub handoff_summary: Option<HostSafeHandoffSummary>,
    /// Body-free references to known local gaps affecting this slice.
    pub gap_refs: Vec<HostSafeGapRef>,
}

impl HostSafeSlice {
    /// Creates a safe slice from fields that were already selected and redacted by the application read assembler.
    pub fn from_projection_fields(
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
        generation: Option<HostGeneration>,
        visible_fields: Vec<HostSafeField>,
        lifecycle_summary: Option<HostSafeLifecycleSummary>,
        readiness_summary: Option<HostSafeReadinessSummary>,
        session_summary: Option<HostSafeSessionSummary>,
        health_summary: Option<HostSafeHealthSummary>,
        closure_summary: Option<HostSafeClosureSummary>,
        handoff_summary: Option<HostSafeHandoffSummary>,
        gap_refs: Vec<HostSafeGapRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether the selected slice contains a given public field family.
    pub fn contains(&self, field: HostSafeField) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether no public fact family is present in the slice.
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
}
```

`HostSafeLifecycleSummary`、`HostSafeReadinessSummary`、`HostSafeSessionSummary`、`HostSafeHealthSummary`、`HostSafeClosureSummary`、`HostSafeHandoffSummary` 与 `HostSafeGapRef` 是 planned `contracts/src/refs.rs` 的 body-free secondary carrier family。本节以下对象卡已经关闭它们的 exact public schema；它们只承载对应 local state / reason classification 和 public gap index，不承载 domain object、external snapshot body 或 fallback default。全体 summary 的 basis 必须是 application mapper 已经选中的 committed local facts / safe projection fields，且其产生时点不得晚于 future `SafeHostView.source_revision`。若 Step 8 protocol 需要一个此前未定义的 summary field，必须回到本 Step 增补其 exact carrier，不得在 DTO 中临时使用 map / JSON。

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_member_ref` | `ProjectMemberRef` | 当前安全 slice 的唯一执行主语 | 来自 query explicit selector、resolved view subject 或 application resolver output；`GlobalMemberRef` 不能替代该字段。 |
| `global_member_ref` | `GlobalMemberRef` | 与项目执行主语一致的身份锚 | 来自 approved subject anchor / existing safe view；不保存 Identity body。 |
| `host_ref` | `Option<HostRef>` | 已选 host 的 local typed ref | 仅当 application read path 可安全返回 selected/current host 时存在；`None` 不得被 client / query 层补造。 |
| `generation` | `Option<HostGeneration>` | 被 slice 代表的 immutable generation | 只随 `host_ref` / generation-bound facts 输出；不是 current guard、repository version、cursor 或 external generation。 |
| `visible_fields` | `Vec<HostSafeField>` | 该 slice 实际可公开的字段族 | application 依据 `VisibilityContext.selected_fields` 和 redaction result 形成；ordered unique 且非空，不得由 caller 自行补充。若没有可返回 field，不能构造 slice 或 `SafeHostView`。 |
| `*_summary` | `Option<HostSafe*Summary>` | 分字段族的 body-free local state / reason summary | 只有相应 `HostSafeField` 被选择时可存在；summary 的 exact fields 只能来自已提交 local facts / safe projection，不能带 forbidden body。 |
| `gap_refs` | `Vec<HostSafeGapRef>` | 影响当前 slice 的已知本地 gap 引用 | projection / source / contract gap 的 body-free ref；不保存 adapter error body，不把 gap 映射成 ready / complete。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projection_fields(...)` | 形成 immutable public-safe slice | 所有参数均为 application 已选择 / 已裁剪的 local typed fields | `Result<HostSafeSlice, ContractError>` | 做结构一致性校验：`visible_fields` 非空且 ordered unique；summary 必须对应 `visible_fields`；`generation.is_some()` 时 `host_ref` 必须存在；不查询 source、不判断 visibility、不写 projection。 |
| `contains(&self, HostSafeField)` | 判断字段族是否在 slice 中 | target public field family | `bool` | 纯字段检查；不作 authorization 或 refresh。 |
| `is_empty(&self)` | 判断 slice 是否不含公开字段族 | 无 | `bool` | 只反映 `visible_fields`；不能用来推断 query 成功、subject existence 或 projection health。 |

| 工厂 / 静态函数 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 使用场景 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projection_fields(...)` | 由 application read assembler 创建安全 view payload | 已选 field family、body-free summary、local typed ref、gap ref | `Result<HostSafeSlice, ContractError>` | `SafeHostView` compose 前；完整 read path 和 source / projection choice 留 Step 9。若没有任何可返回 field，Step 8 必须使用 no-body response / disposition，而不是构造 empty slice。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 不是 source truth | slice 不得进入 command、decision、generation fence、registration / session uniqueness、health evaluation、closure、outbox 或 handoff write path。 |
| 不能越过 domain private types | struct 字段不得是 `MemberExecutionHost`、`HostProjectionState`、`HostSession`、`HostHealthAssessment`、`HostClosure`、repository record 或任何 domain-only enum。 |
| 不补默认值 | 缺失、blocked、stale、unknown、unavailable 或 visibility-denied 必须用 marker / gap / optional absence 表示；不得构造 `Ready`、`Active`、`Healthy` 或 `Completed` 默认 summary。 |
| 不输出 forbidden body | raw endpoint、credential、image / manifest、Member / Runtime / Sandbox / backend / Bus / observability body 均不可进入任何 summary 或 gap ref。 |
| empty slice 不承载拒绝 | `HostSafeSlice` 不表示 `NotVisible`、无结果、source unavailable 或空白默认值；这些情况分别由 future Step 8 no-body response、`HostUnavailableMarker` 或明确 gap / marker 表达。 |

##### `HostSafeSummaryReason`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries a non-sensitive local reason code attached to a body-free host summary.
pub struct HostSafeSummaryReason(HostRedactedCode);

impl HostSafeSummaryReason {
    /// Wraps a projected local reason code that has already passed the host redaction boundary.
    pub fn from_projected_code(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a previously stored public reason code after persisted-safe-code validation.
    pub fn from_persisted_code(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the opaque public reason code for safe response mapping.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `HostRedactedCode` | 公开 summary 可携带的非敏感 local reason code | `from_projected_code` 只接收 `HostRedactedCode`；`from_persisted_code` 只接收已保存 public projection code。application mapper 从已提交 local reason / classification 映射；不接受 raw adapter error、endpoint、credential、external identifier、policy / approval body 或 free-text report。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projected_code(HostRedactedCode)` | 包装已做公开裁剪的本地 reason code | `value` 是 `redaction.rs` 已验证的 non-empty public code | `HostSafeSummaryReason` | move 该 opaque code 进入 wrapper；不读取 source truth、不评价 reason 是否足以改变 domain state；不能再次接受 raw `String`。 |
| `from_persisted_code(HostRedactedCode)` | 重建已保存的 public reason | `value` 是 `HostRedactedCode::from_persisted_public_code(...)` 已验证的 local public projection code | `HostSafeSummaryReason` | move 该 opaque code 进入 wrapper；不刷新 projection、不反推原始 reason 或 external error；不得以未验证 `String` 直接 rehydrate。 |
| `as_code(&self)` | 提供安全响应映射所需的 opaque code | 无 | `&str` | 不得将 code 解析为 error body、resource identity 或 authorization conclusion。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| code 不是 domain reason truth | 它只说明当前已公开 summary 的局部状态，不替代 intent / decision / readiness / session / assessment / closure / handoff owner 的 reason field。 |
| 不泄露 protected existence | code 不得暴露某个外部资源、Runtime run、Sandbox binding、Member request 或其他 actor 可见对象是否存在。 |

##### `HostSafeLifecycleSummary`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Summarizes the local lifecycle of one logical host without exposing host truth internals.
pub struct HostSafeLifecycleSummary {
    /// Public lifecycle classification projected from the local host lifecycle state.
    pub state: HostSafeLifecycleState,
    /// Optional body-free local reason for a held, quiescing, terminated, or superseded surface.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl HostSafeLifecycleSummary {
    /// Creates a public lifecycle summary from an already selected local lifecycle classification.
    pub fn from_projected_state(
        state: HostSafeLifecycleState,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether this summary can represent a current local host surface.
    pub fn is_current_candidate(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies a projected local host lifecycle without merging other host state axes.
pub enum HostSafeLifecycleState {
    /// The logical host identity has been committed but is not yet locally active.
    Established,
    /// One or more local lifecycle actions are progressing for this host generation.
    Progressing,
    /// The local host lifecycle is active without implying readiness, health, or session activity.
    Active,
    /// Local progression is held by a conflict, unknown effect, or explicit gap.
    Held,
    /// A committed local decision is driving quiescing or closure preparation.
    Quiescing,
    /// The local host lifecycle has terminated while cleanup may still be pending.
    Terminated,
    /// A newer host generation has superseded this local lifecycle surface.
    Superseded,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `HostSafeLifecycleState` | 已投影的本地宿主生命周期摘要 | application mapper 仅从 matching `MemberExecutionHost.lifecycle_status` 或安全 projection 映射；不得由 external association、registration、heartbeat、Runtime 或 container state 推断。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | held / quiescing / terminal 公开原因 | 从对应 committed local reason 映射；`None` 不表示没有内部原因，只表示当前公开 surface 未携带 reason。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projected_state(HostSafeLifecycleState, Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>)` | 形成 lifecycle public summary | state 和已裁剪 reason 均来自 application mapping | `HostSafeLifecycleSummary` | 纯构造；不验证 current pointer、不创建 host、不变更 lifecycle。 |
| `is_current_candidate(&self)` | 判断摘要是否仍可作为 current-host 候选 surface | 无 | `bool` | 仅 `Established`、`Progressing`、`Active` 或 `Held` 可返回 true；不证明该 host 是 current、visible、ready 或 healthy。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Established` | `The logical host identity has been committed but is not yet locally active.` | 本地 identity 已建立 | committed host lifecycle projection | `HostSafeSlice.lifecycle_summary` |
| `Progressing` | `One or more local lifecycle actions are progressing for this host generation.` | 本地动作推进中 | committed host lifecycle projection | `HostSafeSlice.lifecycle_summary` |
| `Active` | `The local host lifecycle is active without implying readiness, health, or session activity.` | 本地生命周期 active | committed host lifecycle projection | `HostSafeSlice.lifecycle_summary` |
| `Held` | `Local progression is held by a conflict, unknown effect, or explicit gap.` | 本地 hold | committed host lifecycle projection | `HostSafeSlice.lifecycle_summary`、gap surface |
| `Quiescing` | `A committed local decision is driving quiescing or closure preparation.` | 本地收束准备 | committed host lifecycle projection | `HostSafeSlice.lifecycle_summary` |
| `Terminated` | `The local host lifecycle has terminated while cleanup may still be pending.` | 本地生命周期终结 | committed host lifecycle projection | `HostSafeSlice.lifecycle_summary` |
| `Superseded` | `A newer host generation has superseded this local lifecycle surface.` | 新世代取代旧 host | committed host lifecycle projection | history / selected host safe view |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 不压平状态轴 | `Active` 不等于 readiness ready、Host Session active、四轴 healthy、closure closed 或 external carrier ready。 |
| 不暴露 backend truth | 不携带 container / pod / registry / carrier resource 或 Sandbox binding body。 |

##### `HostSafeReadinessSummary`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Summarizes a generation-bound local readiness conclusion without qualification or assembly bodies.
pub struct HostSafeReadinessSummary {
    /// Public readiness classification projected from the local readiness decision.
    pub state: HostSafeReadinessState,
    /// Optional body-free reason for a non-ready conclusion.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl HostSafeReadinessSummary {
    /// Creates a public readiness summary from an already selected local readiness classification.
    pub fn from_projected_state(
        state: HostSafeReadinessState,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether the public summary expresses only local readiness for its matching generation.
    pub fn is_locally_ready(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies a projected readiness decision without merging lifecycle, session, or health status.
pub enum HostSafeReadinessState {
    /// All required local qualification and assembly conditions are satisfied for the selected generation.
    Ready,
    /// A required contract, owner, or forbidden boundary blocks the local readiness path.
    Blocked,
    /// An allowed prerequisite is still pending for the selected generation.
    Waiting,
    /// A required local qualification or assembly condition has failed.
    Failed,
    /// Freshness, source, or external-effect certainty is insufficient for a readiness conclusion.
    Unknown,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `HostSafeReadinessState` | generation-bound 本地 readiness 摘要 | application mapper 仅从 matching committed `HostReadinessDecision.readiness_status` 映射；不得由 process alive、registration、endpoint、session、health 或 fake 直接构造。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | 非 ready 结论的公开原因 | 从 `ReadinessGapRefSet` 或 local decision reason 的安全分类映射；`MSVC-UP-001~008` 造成的正向缺口必须保持 `Blocked` / `Waiting` / `Unknown`，不得省略成 `Ready`。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projected_state(HostSafeReadinessState, Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>)` | 形成 readiness public summary | 已映射 state 和 safe reason | `HostSafeReadinessSummary` | 纯构造；不评估 qualification、不加载 assembly、不写 readiness truth。 |
| `is_locally_ready(&self)` | 判断摘要是否表达 matching generation 的本地 ready | 无 | `bool` | 仅 `Ready` 返回 true；不证明 host active、session active、Runtime ready、health healthy 或 external resource established。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Ready` | `All required local qualification and assembly conditions are satisfied for the selected generation.` | 本地 readiness ready | matching committed readiness decision | `HostSafeSlice.readiness_summary` |
| `Blocked` | `A required contract, owner, or forbidden boundary blocks the local readiness path.` | 正式 blocker / owner gap | matching committed readiness decision | `HostSafeSlice.readiness_summary`、gap surface |
| `Waiting` | `An allowed prerequisite is still pending for the selected generation.` | 合法待到达 prerequisite | matching committed readiness decision | `HostSafeSlice.readiness_summary` |
| `Failed` | `A required local qualification or assembly condition has failed.` | 本地 required condition failed | matching committed readiness decision | `HostSafeSlice.readiness_summary` |
| `Unknown` | `Freshness, source, or external-effect certainty is insufficient for a readiness conclusion.` | 时点或结果不可判定 | matching committed readiness decision | `HostSafeSlice.readiness_summary`、gap surface |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 不替代 host truth | summary 不可驱动 `MemberExecutionHost::mark_active`、action prepare 或任何 external call。 |
| no-fallback | `Blocked`、`Waiting`、`Failed`、`Unknown` 均不得在 mapper、query、projection 或 fake 中降格 / 默认填充为 `Ready`。 |

##### `HostSafeSessionSummary`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Summarizes local registration, endpoint redaction, and host-session state without session bodies.
pub struct HostSafeSessionSummary {
    /// Public registration classification when a local registration is selected.
    pub registration_state: Option<HostSafeRegistrationState>,
    /// Public endpoint-presence classification without an endpoint value.
    pub endpoint_state: HostSafeEndpointState,
    /// Public local host-session classification when a session shell is selected.
    pub session_state: Option<HostSafeSessionState>,
    /// Optional body-free reason for a blocked, stale, closed, or unknown surface.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl HostSafeSessionSummary {
    /// Creates a public registration and host-session summary from already selected local classifications.
    pub fn from_projected_states(
        registration_state: Option<HostSafeRegistrationState>,
        endpoint_state: HostSafeEndpointState,
        session_state: Option<HostSafeSessionState>,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether the summary contains a local active host-session classification.
    pub fn has_active_local_session(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies a projected local registration record without exposing registration input.
pub enum HostSafeRegistrationState {
    /// A registration input was received but has not reached a public accepted or rejected conclusion.
    Received,
    /// A registration has been accepted by local registration rules.
    Accepted,
    /// A registration has been rejected by local registration rules.
    Rejected,
    /// A later registration has replaced this registration surface.
    Replaced,
    /// A host replacement or closure invalidated this registration surface.
    Invalidated,
}

/// Classifies endpoint availability without exposing an endpoint or transport detail.
pub enum HostSafeEndpointState {
    /// No endpoint presence may be exposed by the selected safe slice.
    Omitted,
    /// A local endpoint association is present but is not currently active.
    Candidate,
    /// A redacted local endpoint association is active for the selected generation.
    ActiveRedacted,
    /// The local endpoint association is stale and must not be used as a current endpoint.
    Stale,
    /// A later endpoint association replaced the selected endpoint surface.
    Replaced,
    /// The selected endpoint association is locally invalid.
    Invalid,
}

/// Classifies the local host-session shell without representing a Runtime session or run.
pub enum HostSafeSessionState {
    /// Local prerequisites are collected while the host-session association remains pending.
    Pending,
    /// A local host-session shell is active without implying a Runtime run is active.
    Active,
    /// A local prerequisite or unresolved boundary blocks host-session progression.
    Blocked,
    /// A registration, endpoint, or association basis is locally stale.
    Stale,
    /// A later host session replaced the selected local session shell.
    Replaced,
    /// A closure or invalidation closed the local session shell.
    Closed,
    /// The association result or current local session status is not determinable.
    Unknown,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `registration_state` | `Option<HostSafeRegistrationState>` | 选中 registration 的本地公开状态 | application mapper 从 matching `HostRegistration.registration_status` 映射；无 selected / visible registration 时为 `None`，不从 heartbeat 推断。 |
| `endpoint_state` | `HostSafeEndpointState` | 不暴露 endpoint value 的关联状态 | mapper 从 selected `HostEndpoint.endpoint_status` 映射；无可公开 endpoint 使用 `Omitted`，不表示 host / endpoint 不存在。 |
| `session_state` | `Option<HostSafeSessionState>` | 本地 Host Session 壳的公开状态 | mapper 从 matching `HostSession.session_status` 映射；未选 / 不可见 session 为 `None`，不从 Runtime body 创建。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | blocked / stale / closed / unknown 公开原因 | 从 selected local registration / endpoint / session reason 映射；不带 credential、Member registration body、endpoint 或 Runtime association body。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projected_states(...)` | 形成 registration/session public summary | 输入均已被 application 选择及脱敏 | `HostSafeSessionSummary` | 纯构造；不接受 / 替代 registration、不激活 endpoint / session、不读取 external owner。 |
| `has_active_local_session(&self)` | 判断是否公开了 local session active 分类 | 无 | `bool` | 仅 `session_state == Some(Active)` 返回 true；不证明 Member registered、Runtime session / run active、endpoint reachable 或 host healthy。 |

| 枚举 | 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostSafeRegistrationState` | `Received` | `A registration input was received but has not reached a public accepted or rejected conclusion.` | matching committed registration | `HostSafeSessionSummary.registration_state` |
| `HostSafeRegistrationState` | `Accepted` | `A registration has been accepted by local registration rules.` | matching committed registration | `HostSafeSessionSummary.registration_state` |
| `HostSafeRegistrationState` | `Rejected` | `A registration has been rejected by local registration rules.` | matching committed registration | `HostSafeSessionSummary.registration_state` |
| `HostSafeRegistrationState` | `Replaced` | `A later registration has replaced this registration surface.` | matching committed registration | `HostSafeSessionSummary.registration_state` |
| `HostSafeRegistrationState` | `Invalidated` | `A host replacement or closure invalidated this registration surface.` | matching committed registration | `HostSafeSessionSummary.registration_state` |
| `HostSafeEndpointState` | `Omitted` | `No endpoint presence may be exposed by the selected safe slice.` | application redaction / no selected endpoint | `HostSafeSessionSummary.endpoint_state` |
| `HostSafeEndpointState` | `Candidate` | `A local endpoint association is present but is not currently active.` | selected local endpoint | `HostSafeSessionSummary.endpoint_state` |
| `HostSafeEndpointState` | `ActiveRedacted` | `A redacted local endpoint association is active for the selected generation.` | selected local endpoint | `HostSafeSessionSummary.endpoint_state` |
| `HostSafeEndpointState` | `Stale` | `The local endpoint association is stale and must not be used as a current endpoint.` | selected local endpoint | `HostSafeSessionSummary.endpoint_state` |
| `HostSafeEndpointState` | `Replaced` | `A later endpoint association replaced the selected endpoint surface.` | selected local endpoint | `HostSafeSessionSummary.endpoint_state` |
| `HostSafeEndpointState` | `Invalid` | `The selected endpoint association is locally invalid.` | selected local endpoint | `HostSafeSessionSummary.endpoint_state` |
| `HostSafeSessionState` | `Pending` | `Local prerequisites are collected while the host-session association remains pending.` | matching committed Host Session | `HostSafeSessionSummary.session_state` |
| `HostSafeSessionState` | `Active` | `A local host-session shell is active without implying a Runtime run is active.` | matching committed Host Session | `HostSafeSessionSummary.session_state` |
| `HostSafeSessionState` | `Blocked` | `A local prerequisite or unresolved boundary blocks host-session progression.` | matching committed Host Session | `HostSafeSessionSummary.session_state` |
| `HostSafeSessionState` | `Stale` | `A registration, endpoint, or association basis is locally stale.` | matching committed Host Session | `HostSafeSessionSummary.session_state` |
| `HostSafeSessionState` | `Replaced` | `A later host session replaced the selected local session shell.` | matching committed Host Session | `HostSafeSessionSummary.session_state` |
| `HostSafeSessionState` | `Closed` | `A closure or invalidation closed the local session shell.` | matching committed Host Session | `HostSafeSessionSummary.session_state` |
| `HostSafeSessionState` | `Unknown` | `The association result or current local session status is not determinable.` | matching committed Host Session | `HostSafeSessionSummary.session_state` |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| endpoint 永远脱敏 | `ActiveRedacted` 只表达 local association 可用，绝不携带 URL、port、credential、transport 或 Member body。 |
| Host Session 不等于 Runtime session | `Active` 不表示 Runtime run、LLM loop、checkpoint、tool execution 或任何 Runtime owned truth。 |
| 并列而不折叠 | registration、endpoint、Host Session 三项必须保留独立字段；不得压成一个 `connected` / `online` / `ready` boolean。 |

##### `HostSafeHealthSummary`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Summarizes local health, failure, and recovery classifications without signal or external-owner bodies.
pub struct HostSafeHealthSummary {
    /// Public classification of the logical-host health axis.
    pub host_axis: HostSafeHealthAxisState,
    /// Public classification of the local host-session health axis.
    pub session_axis: HostSafeHealthAxisState,
    /// Public classification of the backend-association health axis.
    pub backend_axis: HostSafeHealthAxisState,
    /// Public classification of evidence certainty for the selected local assessment.
    pub uncertainty_state: HostSafeHealthUncertaintyState,
    /// Public status of a selected local failure classification when one is visible.
    pub failure_state: Option<HostSafeFailureState>,
    /// Public status of a selected local recovery decision when one is visible.
    pub recovery_state: Option<HostSafeRecoveryDecisionState>,
    /// Public recovery action only when a selected recovery decision is visible.
    pub recovery_action: Option<HostSafeRecoveryAction>,
    /// Optional body-free reason for uncertainty, failure, or recovery disposition.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl HostSafeHealthSummary {
    /// Creates a public health summary from already selected local health, failure, and recovery classifications.
    pub fn from_projected_states(
        host_axis: HostSafeHealthAxisState,
        session_axis: HostSafeHealthAxisState,
        backend_axis: HostSafeHealthAxisState,
        uncertainty_state: HostSafeHealthUncertaintyState,
        failure_state: Option<HostSafeFailureState>,
        recovery_state: Option<HostSafeRecoveryDecisionState>,
        recovery_action: Option<HostSafeRecoveryAction>,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether the selected assessment exposes an evidence uncertainty classification.
    pub fn has_uncertainty(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies one projected health axis without collapsing the other health axes.
pub enum HostSafeHealthAxisState {
    /// The selected local assessment classifies this axis as healthy.
    Healthy,
    /// The selected local assessment classifies this axis as degraded.
    Degraded,
    /// The selected local assessment classifies this axis as unhealthy.
    Unhealthy,
    /// The selected local assessment cannot determine this axis reliably.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies certainty of the selected local health assessment without asserting external truth completeness.
pub enum HostSafeHealthUncertaintyState {
    /// The selected local assessment records no known uncertainty for its own basis.
    NoKnownUncertainty,
    /// Required local evidence is incomplete for the selected assessment.
    Incomplete,
    /// The selected assessment basis is stale for the applied local policy.
    Stale,
    /// Available local evidence conflicts and cannot be safely collapsed.
    Conflicting,
    /// The selected assessment cannot determine certainty for its basis.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies the visible record status of a local failure classification.
pub enum HostSafeFailureState {
    /// A local failure classification is a candidate and is not yet confirmed.
    Candidate,
    /// A local failure classification is confirmed by its allowed local basis.
    Confirmed,
    /// A newer failure classification superseded the selected classification.
    Superseded,
    /// A newer local health assessment withdrew the selected classification.
    Withdrawn,
    /// The selected failure layer or classification is not determinable.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies the visible record status of a local recovery decision.
pub enum HostSafeRecoveryDecisionState {
    /// A local recovery disposition has been proposed but is not committed.
    Proposed,
    /// A local recovery disposition is committed without proving any external action completed.
    Committed,
    /// A newer local recovery decision superseded the selected decision.
    Superseded,
    /// The selected recovery decision was voided by local guards or prerequisites.
    Voided,
}

/// Classifies the action selected by a visible local recovery decision without authorizing execution.
pub enum HostSafeRecoveryAction {
    /// The local decision requests a recovery action for the selected host generation.
    Recover,
    /// The local decision requests a new-generation restart path.
    Restart,
    /// The local decision requests a local stop path.
    Stop,
    /// The local decision requests local termination and subsequent closure handling.
    Terminate,
    /// The local decision explicitly holds progression because prerequisites are unresolved.
    Hold,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host_axis` | `HostSafeHealthAxisState` | logical host 层的公开健康摘要 | application mapper 仅从 selected / matching `HostHealthAssessment.host_axis` 映射；不从 lifecycle、process alive、container 或 runtime run 推断。 |
| `session_axis` | `HostSafeHealthAxisState` | 本地 Host Session 层的公开健康摘要 | 仅从 `HostHealthAssessment.session_axis` 映射；不等于 Member / Runtime / external session truth。 |
| `backend_axis` | `HostSafeHealthAxisState` | carrier / binding association 的本地健康判断摘要 | 仅从 `HostHealthAssessment.backend_axis` 的允许安全判断映射；不拥有或公开 backend state。 |
| `uncertainty_state` | `HostSafeHealthUncertaintyState` | assessment basis 的时点 / 证据确定性 | 仅从 `HostHealthAssessment.uncertainty_axis` 映射；`NoKnownUncertainty` 仅说明该本地 assessment 无已知 uncertainty，不声明全局完整。 |
| `failure_state` | `Option<HostSafeFailureState>` | 可见 failure classification 的 record 状态 | 仅从 matching selected `HostFailureClassification.classification_status` 映射；不暴露 failure layer、category、impact、evidence 或日志 body。 |
| `recovery_state` | `Option<HostSafeRecoveryDecisionState>` | 可见 recovery decision 的本地 record 状态 | 仅从 matching selected `HostRecoveryDecision.decision_status` 映射；不表示 action 已发起、accepted 或完成。 |
| `recovery_action` | `Option<HostSafeRecoveryAction>` | 已公开 decision 的动作类别 | 仅随 selected recovery decision 映射；不得被 query / client 用作 action command、authorization 或 retry input。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | uncertainty / failure / recovery 的 body-free public reason | mapper 从已裁剪 local classification / decision reason 映射；不带 raw signal、Runtime body、Sandbox / backend policy、external evidence 或 error text。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projected_states(...)` | 形成保持四轴和 recovery 分层的 health public summary | 全部输入均为 application mapper 选定的本地 public classification | `Result<HostSafeHealthSummary, ContractError>` | 仅验证 `recovery_state` 与 `recovery_action` 同时出现或同时缺失；不加载 signal、不评估 health、不创建 failure / recovery decision。 |
| `has_uncertainty(&self)` | 判断 summary 是否表达非无已知不确定性 | 无 | `bool` | 当 `uncertainty_state != NoKnownUncertainty` 时返回 true；不触发 hold、repair、refresh 或任何 action。 |

| 枚举 | 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostSafeHealthAxisState` | `Healthy` | `The selected local assessment classifies this axis as healthy.` | matching committed health assessment | `HostSafeHealthSummary` 的对应 axis 字段 |
| `HostSafeHealthAxisState` | `Degraded` | `The selected local assessment classifies this axis as degraded.` | matching committed health assessment | `HostSafeHealthSummary` 的对应 axis 字段 |
| `HostSafeHealthAxisState` | `Unhealthy` | `The selected local assessment classifies this axis as unhealthy.` | matching committed health assessment | `HostSafeHealthSummary` 的对应 axis 字段 |
| `HostSafeHealthAxisState` | `Unknown` | `The selected local assessment cannot determine this axis reliably.` | matching committed health assessment | `HostSafeHealthSummary` 的对应 axis 字段、gap surface |
| `HostSafeHealthUncertaintyState` | `NoKnownUncertainty` | `The selected local assessment records no known uncertainty for its own basis.` | matching committed health assessment | `HostSafeHealthSummary.uncertainty_state` |
| `HostSafeHealthUncertaintyState` | `Incomplete` | `Required local evidence is incomplete for the selected assessment.` | matching committed health assessment | `HostSafeHealthSummary.uncertainty_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeHealthUncertaintyState` | `Stale` | `The selected assessment basis is stale for the applied local policy.` | matching committed health assessment | `HostSafeHealthSummary.uncertainty_state`、future freshness surface |
| `HostSafeHealthUncertaintyState` | `Conflicting` | `Available local evidence conflicts and cannot be safely collapsed.` | matching committed health assessment | `HostSafeHealthSummary.uncertainty_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeHealthUncertaintyState` | `Unknown` | `The selected assessment cannot determine certainty for its basis.` | matching committed health assessment | `HostSafeHealthSummary.uncertainty_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeFailureState` | `Candidate` | `A local failure classification is a candidate and is not yet confirmed.` | selected local failure classification | `HostSafeHealthSummary.failure_state` |
| `HostSafeFailureState` | `Confirmed` | `A local failure classification is confirmed by its allowed local basis.` | selected local failure classification | `HostSafeHealthSummary.failure_state` |
| `HostSafeFailureState` | `Superseded` | `A newer failure classification superseded the selected classification.` | selected local failure classification | history / selected health surface |
| `HostSafeFailureState` | `Withdrawn` | `A newer local health assessment withdrew the selected classification.` | selected local failure classification | history / selected health surface |
| `HostSafeFailureState` | `Unknown` | `The selected failure layer or classification is not determinable.` | selected local failure classification | `HostSafeHealthSummary.failure_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeRecoveryDecisionState` | `Proposed` | `A local recovery disposition has been proposed but is not committed.` | selected local recovery decision | `HostSafeHealthSummary.recovery_state` |
| `HostSafeRecoveryDecisionState` | `Committed` | `A local recovery disposition is committed without proving any external action completed.` | selected local recovery decision | `HostSafeHealthSummary.recovery_state` |
| `HostSafeRecoveryDecisionState` | `Superseded` | `A newer local recovery decision superseded the selected decision.` | selected local recovery decision | history / selected health surface |
| `HostSafeRecoveryDecisionState` | `Voided` | `The selected recovery decision was voided by local guards or prerequisites.` | selected local recovery decision | `HostSafeHealthSummary.recovery_state` |
| `HostSafeRecoveryAction` | `Recover` | `The local decision requests a recovery action for the selected host generation.` | selected local recovery decision | `HostSafeHealthSummary.recovery_action` |
| `HostSafeRecoveryAction` | `Restart` | `The local decision requests a new-generation restart path.` | selected local recovery decision | `HostSafeHealthSummary.recovery_action` |
| `HostSafeRecoveryAction` | `Stop` | `The local decision requests a local stop path.` | selected local recovery decision | `HostSafeHealthSummary.recovery_action` |

| `HostSafeRecoveryAction` | `Hold` | `The local decision explicitly holds progression because prerequisites are unresolved.` | selected local recovery decision | `HostSafeHealthSummary.recovery_action` |

|---|---|
| 四轴不可压缩 | 三个 health axis 与 uncertainty 必须分别输出；不得合并成 `healthy` boolean 或以 host axis 替代 session / backend axis。 |

##### `HostSafeClosureSummary`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Summarizes local closure and reconciliation state without cleanup or external-resource bodies.
pub struct HostSafeClosureSummary {
    /// Public local closure classification when a closure is selected.
    pub closure_state: Option<HostSafeClosureState>,
    /// Public residual-finding classification when a selected finding is visible.
    pub residual_state: Option<HostSafeResidualState>,
    /// Public reconciliation-case classification when a selected case is visible.
    pub reconciliation_state: Option<HostSafeReconciliationState>,
    /// Optional body-free reason for an incomplete, blocked, residual, or unknown closure surface.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl HostSafeClosureSummary {
    /// Creates a public closure summary from already selected local closure and reconciliation classifications.
    pub fn from_projected_states(
        closure_state: Option<HostSafeClosureState>,
        residual_state: Option<HostSafeResidualState>,
        reconciliation_state: Option<HostSafeReconciliationState>,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether the summary contains a local closure that has reached local completion.
    pub fn is_locally_closed(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies the selected local closure record without asserting external cleanup completion.
pub enum HostSafeClosureState {
    /// A local closure scope is open and has not completed local invalidation.
    Open,
    /// Local registration, endpoint, session, or association invalidation is progressing.
    Invalidating,
    /// Local invalidation has progressed while cleanup or release attempts remain pending.
    CleanupPending,
    /// Required local closure records are complete without asserting external cleanup completed.
    LocallyClosed,
    /// One or more local residual findings remain associated with the closure.
    Residual,
    /// A required boundary, owner, or prerequisite blocks local closure progression.
    Blocked,
    /// A local cleanup effect or closure result cannot be determined safely.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies the selected local residual finding without exposing its affected external resource.
pub enum HostSafeResidualState {
    /// A local residual finding is open and has no final local disposition.
    Open,
    /// The selected local finding is confirmed by its allowed basis.
    Confirmed,
    /// The selected local finding has conflicting basis and is disputed.
    Disputed,
    /// A reconciliation case has locally resolved the selected finding.
    Resolved,
    /// A newer finding superseded the selected finding.
    Superseded,
    /// The selected residual finding cannot be determined safely.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies the selected local reconciliation case without claiming an external owner accepted a request.
pub enum HostSafeReconciliationState {
    /// Local findings are grouped but no final local disposition exists.
    Open,
    /// A local repair or cleanup request has been recorded.
    ActionRequested,
    /// A local hold prevents automatic progression.
    Holding,
    /// A local escalation was recorded without proving downstream acceptance.
    Escalated,
    /// A local reconciliation case has an explicit local resolution basis.
    Resolved,
    /// The selected case disposition or external-effect result is not determinable.
    Unknown,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `closure_state` | `Option<HostSafeClosureState>` | selected local closure 的公开状态 | application mapper 从 selected `HostClosure.closure_status` 映射；无可见 closure 为 `None`，不得从 host terminated 推断 `LocallyClosed`。 |
| `residual_state` | `Option<HostSafeResidualState>` | selected residual finding 的公开状态 | 从 selected `ResidualFinding.finding_status` 映射；不携带 affected ref、external summary、evidence、resource name 或 finding body。 |
| `reconciliation_state` | `Option<HostSafeReconciliationState>` | selected reconciliation case 的公开状态 | 从 selected `ReconciliationCase.case_status` 映射；不公开 action / operator / target / external acceptance body。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | 公开的 incomplete / blocked / unknown 原因 | 从 closure gap、residual reason 或 case holding reason 的安全分类映射；不泄露 cleanup target、Sandbox / carrier backend or route。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projected_states(...)` | 形成 closure/reconciliation public summary | 所有分类和 reason 已由 application mapper 选择 | `HostSafeClosureSummary` | 纯构造；不创建 closure、cleanup attempt、finding 或 reconciliation case。 |
| `is_locally_closed(&self)` | 判断公开 summary 是否表达本地 closure 已关闭 | 无 | `bool` | 仅 `closure_state == Some(LocallyClosed)` 返回 true；绝不表示 cleanup / release 已由外部 owner 完成。 |

| 枚举 | 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostSafeClosureState` | `Open` | `A local closure scope is open and has not completed local invalidation.` | selected committed closure | `HostSafeClosureSummary.closure_state` |
| `HostSafeClosureState` | `Invalidating` | `Local registration, endpoint, session, or association invalidation is progressing.` | selected committed closure | `HostSafeClosureSummary.closure_state` |
| `HostSafeClosureState` | `CleanupPending` | `Local invalidation has progressed while cleanup or release attempts remain pending.` | selected committed closure | `HostSafeClosureSummary.closure_state` |
| `HostSafeClosureState` | `LocallyClosed` | `Required local closure records are complete without asserting external cleanup completed.` | selected committed closure | `HostSafeClosureSummary.closure_state` |
| `HostSafeClosureState` | `Residual` | `One or more local residual findings remain associated with the closure.` | selected committed closure | `HostSafeClosureSummary.closure_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeClosureState` | `Blocked` | `A required boundary, owner, or prerequisite blocks local closure progression.` | selected committed closure | `HostSafeClosureSummary.closure_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeClosureState` | `Unknown` | `A local cleanup effect or closure result cannot be determined safely.` | selected committed closure | `HostSafeClosureSummary.closure_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeResidualState` | `Open` | `A local residual finding is open and has no final local disposition.` | selected committed residual finding | `HostSafeClosureSummary.residual_state` |
| `HostSafeResidualState` | `Confirmed` | `The selected local finding is confirmed by its allowed basis.` | selected committed residual finding | `HostSafeClosureSummary.residual_state` |
| `HostSafeResidualState` | `Disputed` | `The selected local finding has conflicting basis and is disputed.` | selected committed residual finding | `HostSafeClosureSummary.residual_state` |
| `HostSafeResidualState` | `Resolved` | `A reconciliation case has locally resolved the selected finding.` | selected committed residual finding | `HostSafeClosureSummary.residual_state` |
| `HostSafeResidualState` | `Superseded` | `A newer finding superseded the selected finding.` | selected committed residual finding | history / selected closure surface |
| `HostSafeResidualState` | `Unknown` | `The selected residual finding cannot be determined safely.` | selected committed residual finding | `HostSafeClosureSummary.residual_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeReconciliationState` | `Open` | `Local findings are grouped but no final local disposition exists.` | selected committed reconciliation case | `HostSafeClosureSummary.reconciliation_state` |
| `HostSafeReconciliationState` | `ActionRequested` | `A local repair or cleanup request has been recorded.` | selected committed reconciliation case | `HostSafeClosureSummary.reconciliation_state` |
| `HostSafeReconciliationState` | `Holding` | `A local hold prevents automatic progression.` | selected committed reconciliation case | `HostSafeClosureSummary.reconciliation_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeReconciliationState` | `Escalated` | `A local escalation was recorded without proving downstream acceptance.` | selected committed reconciliation case | `HostSafeClosureSummary.reconciliation_state` |
| `HostSafeReconciliationState` | `Resolved` | `A local reconciliation case has an explicit local resolution basis.` | selected committed reconciliation case | `HostSafeClosureSummary.reconciliation_state` |
| `HostSafeReconciliationState` | `Unknown` | `The selected case disposition or external-effect result is not determinable.` | selected committed reconciliation case | `HostSafeClosureSummary.reconciliation_state`、gap surface |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| local completion 不等于 external completion | `LocallyClosed`、`Resolved`、`ActionRequested` 或 `Escalated` 均不可写成 Sandbox / carrier cleanup、delivery 或 downstream acceptance completed。 |
| no implicit repair | public summary / helper 不得启动 cleanup、release、repair、reconcile 或重放 unknown effect。 |
| 不泄露对账正文 | 不输出 finding affected ref、external resource、operator、evidence、report、adapter error 或 external summary body。 |

##### `HostSafeHandoffSummary`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Summarizes local material publication and handoff progress without route, receipt, or consumer bodies.
pub struct HostSafeHandoffSummary {
    /// Public local outbox classification when a selected publication record is visible.
    pub publication_state: Option<HostSafePublicationState>,
    /// Public local handoff classification when a selected material-target record is visible.
    pub handoff_state: Option<HostSafeHandoffState>,
    /// Public presence classification of delivery feedback without delivery body.
    pub delivery_feedback: HostSafeExternalFeedbackState,
    /// Public presence classification of observation feedback without observation body.
    pub observation_feedback: HostSafeExternalFeedbackState,
    /// Public presence classification of acceptance feedback without acceptance body.
    pub acceptance_feedback: HostSafeExternalFeedbackState,
    /// Optional body-free reason for a gap, unknown, or locally closed handoff surface.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl HostSafeHandoffSummary {
    /// Creates a public handoff summary from already selected local publication and feedback classifications.
    pub fn from_projected_states(
        publication_state: Option<HostSafePublicationState>,
        handoff_state: Option<HostSafeHandoffState>,
        delivery_feedback: HostSafeExternalFeedbackState,
        observation_feedback: HostSafeExternalFeedbackState,
        acceptance_feedback: HostSafeExternalFeedbackState,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether any feedback layer is linked without treating linkage as successful delivery or acceptance.
    pub fn has_linked_feedback(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies the selected local outbox record without asserting broker delivery.
pub enum HostSafePublicationState {
    /// A local publication record is pending and has no recorded attempt.
    Pending,
    /// At least one local publication attempt is recorded.
    Attempted,
    /// A local submission was recorded without proving delivery, observation, or acceptance.
    Submitted,
    /// A route, contract, publisher, or feedback gap affects local publication progression.
    Gap,
    /// The local publication result is not determinable safely.
    Unknown,
    /// Local policy closed further publication progression without asserting downstream acceptance.
    Closed,
}

/// Classifies the selected local handoff record without flattening external outcome layers.
pub enum HostSafeHandoffState {
    /// A material-target handoff record exists without a local attempt.
    Pending,
    /// One or more local handoff attempts are recorded.
    Attempted,
    /// A local route, contract, publisher, or feedback gap is recorded.
    Gap,
    /// At least one external-owner feedback layer is linked to the local handoff record.
    FeedbackLinked,
    /// Local policy closed further handoff progression without asserting downstream acceptance.
    Closed,
    /// The local handoff attempt or feedback result is not determinable safely.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies whether one external-owner feedback layer is absent, linked, or unavailable without carrying its body.
pub enum HostSafeExternalFeedbackState {
    /// No body-free feedback summary is linked for this layer.
    NotLinked,
    /// A body-free external-owner feedback summary is linked for this layer.
    Linked,
    /// This feedback layer is unavailable or blocked by a declared contract or source gap.
    Unavailable,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `publication_state` | `Option<HostSafePublicationState>` | selected `HostOutboxRecord` 的本地传播状态 | application mapper 从 selected `HostOutboxRecord.outbox_status` 映射；无 selected / visible record 时为 `None`，`Submitted` 不表示 broker delivery。 |
| `handoff_state` | `Option<HostSafeHandoffState>` | selected `HostHandoffRecord` 的本地交接状态 | 从 selected `HostHandoffRecord.local_status` 映射；不得由 event receipt、timeout 或 callback body推断。 |
| `delivery_feedback` | `HostSafeExternalFeedbackState` | delivery layer 的公开链接存在性 | 仅从 selected handoff 的 `delivery_summary` / known gap 映射；`Linked` 不等于 accepted。 |
| `observation_feedback` | `HostSafeExternalFeedbackState` | observation layer 的公开链接存在性 | 仅从 `observation_summary` / known gap 映射；不保存 observability backend truth。 |
| `acceptance_feedback` | `HostSafeExternalFeedbackState` | consumer acceptance layer 的公开链接存在性 | 仅从 `acceptance_summary` / known gap 映射；`Linked` 仅表示允许的 external-owner summary 已关联。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | gap / unknown / closed 的安全原因 | 从 selected local handoff / outbox reason 或 gap classification 映射；不泄露 Bus route、receipt、consumer body、observability body。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projected_states(...)` | 形成 publication/handoff public summary | 所有状态由 application mapper 选择 | `HostSafeHandoffSummary` | 纯构造；不 publish、不重试、不链接 feedback、不写 handoff / outbox truth。 |
| `has_linked_feedback(&self)` | 判断至少一层已有允许的 linked feedback surface | 无 | `bool` | 任一 feedback 为 `Linked` 返回 true；不推断 delivery、observation、acceptance 三层相互成立。 |

| 枚举 | 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostSafePublicationState` | `Pending` | `A local publication record is pending and has no recorded attempt.` | selected local outbox record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.publication_state` |
| `HostSafePublicationState` | `Attempted` | `At least one local publication attempt is recorded.` | selected local outbox record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.publication_state` |
| `HostSafePublicationState` | `Submitted` | `A local submission was recorded without proving delivery, observation, or acceptance.` | selected local outbox record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.publication_state` |
| `HostSafePublicationState` | `Gap` | `A route, contract, publisher, or feedback gap affects local publication progression.` | selected local outbox record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.publication_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafePublicationState` | `Unknown` | `The local publication result is not determinable safely.` | selected local outbox record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.publication_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafePublicationState` | `Closed` | `Local policy closed further publication progression without asserting downstream acceptance.` | selected local outbox record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.publication_state` |
| `HostSafeHandoffState` | `Pending` | `A material-target handoff record exists without a local attempt.` | selected local handoff record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.handoff_state` |
| `HostSafeHandoffState` | `Attempted` | `One or more local handoff attempts are recorded.` | selected local handoff record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.handoff_state` |
| `HostSafeHandoffState` | `Gap` | `A local route, contract, publisher, or feedback gap is recorded.` | selected local handoff record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.handoff_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeHandoffState` | `FeedbackLinked` | `At least one external-owner feedback layer is linked to the local handoff record.` | selected local handoff record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.handoff_state` |
| `HostSafeHandoffState` | `Closed` | `Local policy closed further handoff progression without asserting downstream acceptance.` | selected local handoff record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.handoff_state` |
| `HostSafeHandoffState` | `Unknown` | `The local handoff attempt or feedback result is not determinable safely.` | selected local handoff record | `HostSafeHandoffSummary.handoff_state`、gap surface |
| `HostSafeExternalFeedbackState` | `NotLinked` | `No body-free feedback summary is linked for this layer.` | absent selected local safe summary | `HostSafeHandoffSummary` feedback fields |
| `HostSafeExternalFeedbackState` | `Linked` | `A body-free external-owner feedback summary is linked for this layer.` | selected local safe external summary | `HostSafeHandoffSummary` feedback fields |
| `HostSafeExternalFeedbackState` | `Unavailable` | `This feedback layer is unavailable or blocked by a declared contract or source gap.` | selected local gap / blocker classification | `HostSafeHandoffSummary` feedback fields、gap surface |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| outcome layers 正交 | delivery、observation、acceptance 必须各自表达；不得以 `Linked`、`Submitted` 或 timeout 推断任一其他层。 |
| 不替代 external truth | summary 不拥有 Bus route / receipt、consumer acceptance、observability 或 downstream system truth。 |
| 不触发传播 | public view helper 不能 publish、replay、retry、repair outbox 或 callback。 |

##### `HostSafeGapRef`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// References one body-free local gap that affects a safe host read surface.
pub struct HostSafeGapRef {
    /// Finite public classification of the local gap.
    pub kind: HostSafeGapKind,
    /// Public field family affected by the gap when one is known.
    pub affected_field: Option<HostSafeField>,
    /// Optional non-sensitive local reason for the gap.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl HostSafeGapRef {
    /// Creates a public gap reference from an already redacted local gap classification.
    pub fn from_projected_gap(
        kind: HostSafeGapKind,
        affected_field: Option<HostSafeField>,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether this gap affects one requested public field family.
    pub fn affects(&self, field: HostSafeField) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies a public local gap without exposing an external contract or resource body.
pub enum HostSafeGapKind {
    /// A required local source fact is missing from the selected safe projection basis.
    SourceMissing,
    /// A selected source fact is stale for its applicable local freshness rule.
    SourceStale,
    /// A declared cross-boundary contract is unavailable or not yet closed.
    ContractPending,
    /// A required local prerequisite is blocked by an owner or no-fallback boundary.
    PrerequisiteBlocked,
    /// A relevant local or external-effect result cannot be determined safely.
    ResultUnknown,
    /// A projection mapping or selected safe slice is incomplete.
    ProjectionIncomplete,
    /// The local projection or safe-read source is unavailable.
    ProjectionUnavailable,
    /// The selected public field was deliberately redacted by the resolved visibility path.
    VisibilityRedacted,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `HostSafeGapKind` | 公开、有限的 local gap 分类 | application mapper 从 committed local gap / blocked / unknown / projection classification 映射；不得从 raw adapter error、HTTP status、route、runtime event、broker receipt 或 guessed sibling contract推导。 |
| `affected_field` | `Option<HostSafeField>` | 被 gap 影响的公开 field family | 仅当 resolver / mapper 可在不泄露 protected existence 的前提下明确归属时填写；`None` 表示 public surface 不公开归属，不等于没有影响。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | gap 的非敏感本地原因 | 已裁剪 local reason；不得包含 credential、endpoint、manifest、Runtime / Sandbox / Member body 或 policy detail。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projected_gap(...)` | 形成 safe gap ref | kind、可选公开 field、已裁剪 reason | `HostSafeGapRef` | 纯构造；不创建 / 修复 gap，不刷新 source / projection，不触发 cross-boundary call。 |
| `affects(&self, HostSafeField)` | 判断 gap 是否公开影响指定 field family | target field | `bool` | 仅当 `affected_field == Some(target)` 返回 true；`None` 不能推断无影响。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SourceMissing` | `A required local source fact is missing from the selected safe projection basis.` | safe projection 的 required local fact 缺失 | committed local gap / mapper classification | `HostSafeSlice.gap_refs` |
| `SourceStale` | `A selected source fact is stale for its applicable local freshness rule.` | 已选 local fact 时点不满足 | committed freshness / mapper classification | `HostSafeSlice.gap_refs`、future freshness surface |
| `ContractPending` | `A declared cross-boundary contract is unavailable or not yet closed.` | 上游未闭合 seam | explicit `MSVC-UP-*` classification / local gap | `HostSafeSlice.gap_refs` |
| `PrerequisiteBlocked` | `A required local prerequisite is blocked by an owner or no-fallback boundary.` | local policy / prerequisite blocked | committed local readiness/session/closure classification | `HostSafeSlice.gap_refs` |
| `ResultUnknown` | `A relevant local or external-effect result cannot be determined safely.` | local unknown fence | committed local attempt / assessment / closure / handoff classification | `HostSafeSlice.gap_refs` |
| `ProjectionIncomplete` | `A projection mapping or selected safe slice is incomplete.` | projection mapping 有缺项 | projection state / application mapper classification | `HostSafeSlice.gap_refs` |
| `ProjectionUnavailable` | `The local projection or safe-read source is unavailable.` | projection store / safe source unavailable | infra availability translated by application | `HostSafeSlice.gap_refs`、future unavailable surface |
| `VisibilityRedacted` | `The selected public field was deliberately redacted by the resolved visibility path.` | 已解析 visibility 的 redaction | `VisibilityContext` / application mapper | `HostSafeSlice.gap_refs`；不得替代 not-visible response |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| gap 非 error body | gap ref 是 public classification，不是 `ContractError`、adapter error、trace、report 或 observability evidence。 |
| gap 不重写事实 | 记录 / 输出 gap 不改变 Host Truth、projection cursor、outbox、handoff 或 sibling truth。 |
| pending 保真 | `ContractPending` 必须保留 `MSVC-UP-001~008` 的 pending / blocked 语义；不得借由 local ref / fake / timeout 宣称 ready。 |

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// References the project-scoped execution subject used for a host read visibility decision.
pub struct HostReadSubjectRef {
    /// The only supported execution subject for the current member-service scope.
    pub project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
}

impl HostReadSubjectRef {
    /// Creates a read subject from the explicit project-scoped execution subject.
    pub fn from_project_member(project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef) -> Self;

    /// Returns the project-scoped execution subject without resolving its external body.
    pub fn project_member_ref(&self) -> &ProjectMemberRef;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_member_ref` | `ProjectMemberRef` | visibility judgment 的唯一执行主语 | 从 query explicit selector、`SafeHostView` 已闭合 subject field 或 future resolver output 获得；不得从 host id、endpoint、GlobalMemberRef、route 或 external body 反推。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_project_member(ProjectMemberRef)` | 构造 read subject carrier | 当前支持的项目型执行主语 | `HostReadSubjectRef` | 不查询 Work、不验证 assignment、不做 authorization。 |
| `project_member_ref(&self)` | 只读取得 typed subject | 无 | `&ProjectMemberRef` | 不解析 L1 body。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 项目型-only | `GlobalMemberRef` 仅可作为 `VisibilityContext` / `HostSafeSlice` identity anchor，绝不能替代本 subject；非项目主语 fail closed。 |
| ref 不等于 visible | read subject 存在或可解析不等于 actor 有权读取，也不等于有 host / view。 |

##### `VisibilityContext`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries the resolved input required to assemble a host read visibility surface.
pub struct VisibilityContext {
    /// Trusted actor context supplied by the public read entry.
    pub actor: ActorContext,
    /// Project-scoped execution subject selected for this read.
    pub read_subject: HostReadSubjectRef,
    /// Identity anchor associated with the selected execution subject.
    pub global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Opaque scope reference resolved before safe-view assembly.
    pub scope_ref: VisibilityScopeRef,
    /// Public field families selected by the resolved visibility path.
    pub selected_fields: Vec<HostSafeField>,
    /// Body-free trace of the resolver or authoritative safe source.
    pub resolution_source_ref: VisibilityResolutionSourceRef,
}

impl VisibilityContext {
    /// Creates a resolved context that the application visibility path has already structurally validated.
    pub fn from_resolved(
        actor: ActorContext,
        read_subject: HostReadSubjectRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        scope_ref: VisibilityScopeRef,
        selected_fields: Vec<HostSafeField>,
        resolution_source_ref: VisibilityResolutionSourceRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the selected body-free field families without evaluating authorization.
    pub fn selected_fields(&self) -> &[HostSafeField];

    /// Returns whether the resolved context selected one public field family.
    pub fn permits_field(&self, field: HostSafeField) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor` | `ActorContext` | 本次 safe read 的 trusted actor carrier | public query entry 传入的 Core contract actor；本仓不认证、不重生成 actor、不保存 actor profile body。 |
| `read_subject` | `HostReadSubjectRef` | 需保护的项目型执行主语 | request explicit field、view subject or resolver output；不得由 loaded host / endpoint / GlobalMember ref 推导。 |
| `global_member_ref` | `GlobalMemberRef` | 与 read subject 一致的 identity anchor | application visibility resolver / validated subject mapping；不替代 `ProjectMemberRef`。 |
| `scope_ref` | `VisibilityScopeRef` | 解析后 scope carrier | resolver / formal safe source output；未解析不得用 guessed local scope。 |
| `selected_fields` | `Vec<HostSafeField>` | 解析路径允许 application 尝试组装的 field family | resolver / policy result的 body-free selection；ordered unique；空集合法并表示不输出事实字段。 |
| `resolution_source_ref` | `VisibilityResolutionSourceRef` | 可见性输入的 body-free trace | resolver / authoritative safe source summary；不携带 authorization truth body。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_resolved(...)` | 构造 resolver-first visibility context | actor、subject、identity anchor、opaque scope、field selection、source trace | `Result<VisibilityContext, ContractError>` | 只做 structural checks：selected fields ordered unique、actor / subject non-empty、source / scope non-empty；不访问 repository、不调用 Governance / Identity、不判 actor 权限。 |
| `selected_fields(&self)` | 只读取得 field selection | 无 | `&[HostSafeField]` | 不产生 view、不改 selected fields。 |
| `permits_field(&self, HostSafeField)` | 判断解析结果是否包含一个 field family | target field family | `bool` | 只检查已解析 selection；名称不等于 domain policy decision，不得作为 authorization bypass。 |

| 工厂 / 静态函数 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 使用场景 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_resolved(...)` | 接收 application resolver 已完成的 structured output | resolver output 的 six pieces | `Result<VisibilityContext, ContractError>` | `application::read` 在加载 source facts 前 / 后的 visibility-guard flow；port signature 留 Step 7，调用顺序留 Step 9。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| resolver-first | Query handler、read service、projection store、domain object 或 fake 不得根据 request route、host id、generation、view type 或 loaded facts临时构造 `VisibilityContext`。缺 `scope_ref` / `resolution_source_ref` 时必须 fail closed / return not-visible or unavailable surface，由 Step 8 / 12 收口。 |
| context 不做 authorization | `VisibilityContext` 不拥有 principal、scope、allow / deny、Governance approval 或 identity truth；它只能传递已解析的 body-free inputs。 |
| context 不做 read side effect | 构造、`selected_fields` 与 `permits_field` 均不得 refresh、rebuild、repair、publish、append history 或 reserve idempotency。 |
| no hidden subject expansion | 仅支持 `ProjectMemberRef` execution subject；不得以 `GlobalMemberRef`、Workspace、runtime session、endpoint、container / backend resource 成为 read subject。 |

##### `HostVisibilityReason`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Explains a not-visible or redacted host read result without exposing protected details.
pub struct HostVisibilityReason(HostRedactedCode);

impl HostVisibilityReason {
    /// Wraps a body-free reason produced by a policy or resolved visibility path after host redaction.
    pub fn from_policy_result(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a stored public visibility reason after persisted-safe-code validation.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the opaque public reason for response mapping.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `HostRedactedCode` | denied / redacted read surface 的 body-free reason | `from_policy_result` 只接收 `HostRedactedCode`；`from_persisted` 只接收 stored public result code。不得来自 raw error body、protected object label、endpoint、credential、Runtime / Sandbox body。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_policy_result(HostRedactedCode)` | 包装 policy / resolver 已裁剪的 public reason | `value` 是 `redaction.rs` 形成的 non-sensitive opaque public code | `HostVisibilityReason` | move 该 opaque code 进入 wrapper；不判断 visibility；不能以 raw `String`、policy body 或 protected label 构造。 |
| `from_persisted(HostRedactedCode)` | 重建已保存的 public reason | `value` 是 `HostRedactedCode::from_persisted_public_code(...)` 已验证的 public-result code | `HostVisibilityReason` | move 该 opaque code 进入 wrapper；不重新读取 policy 或 protected fact；不得以未验证 `String` 恢复。 |
| `as_str(&self)` | 供 response mapping 使用 | 无 | `&str` | 不允许调用方拼接 protected object existence / content。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| denied 不泄露存在性 | reason 不得说明不存在 / 存在某 host、session、Runtime run、Sandbox binding 或 external resource，也不得泄露其他 actor 的 visibility。 |
| marker 不替代 error taxonomy | 具体 API error / status 和 unavailable priority 由 Step 8 / 12 决定；本对象只提供安全 reason carrier。 |

#### 8.5.4 `6.1-b-1` corrective closure 对象组停审记录

| 审查项 | 结论 | 缺口 / 修正 |
|---|---|---|
| safe read capability 有对象承接 | pass_after_correction | `HostSafeField`、`HostSafeSlice`、`HostSafe*Summary` family、`HostSafeGapRef`、`HostReadSubjectRef`、`VisibilityScopeRef`、`VisibilityResolutionSourceRef`、`VisibilityContext` 与 `HostVisibilityReason` 均有唯一 contracts schema owner。 |

| view / projection / read 分层 | pass | public slice / summary 位于 contracts；`SafeHostView` 留 views；projection state 属 domain；visibility / assembly 归 application；physical store 属 infra。 |
| visibility 不是 Query 临时推导 | pass | `VisibilityContext` 强制使用 actor、ProjectMember subject、scope、field selection 和 resolution source；没有 resolver output 不允许 fabricate。 |
| body-free / owner boundary | pass_with_upstream_blockers | field taxonomy 明确排除 L1、Member、Runtime、Images、Sandbox、Bus、Observability 与 backend body；其 exact contracts仍由 `MSVC-UP-001~008` 挂起。 |
| no hidden status collapse | pass | health 保留三 axis + uncertainty；registration / endpoint / Host Session、closure / residual / case、publication / handoff / feedback layers 各自保持正交，未创建 `HostStatus` 或默认 ready / healthy / completed。 |
| public carrier 与 29 object 分母 | pass | 所有新增卡均为 `SafeHostView` support carrier，不是 Host Truth 业务主语，不改变 29 个对象或 CMP 的分母。 |
| 后续闭口 | pending_by_step | `SafeHostView`、public marker / page、protocol DTO 和 flow / error mapping仍待 `6.1-b-2` 及 Step 7~12；不得以本停审结论进入 domain。 |

`6.1-b-1` corrective closure 停审结论：`completed / pass_with_upstream_blockers`。允许继续 `contracts` 的 `6.1-b-2`（`SafeHostView` public surface、visibility / freshness / degraded / unavailable marker、page / cursor helper）；不允许进入 `domain` 或创建 Step 7。

### 8.6 `6.1-b-2`：`SafeHostView` public surface、read marker 与 page / cursor helper

#### 8.6.1 本对象组写入边界

| 项 | 本批结论 |
|---|---|
| unique owner | `SafeHostView`、`SafeHostViewId`、`HostTruthRevision`、`HostVisibilityMarker`、`ViewFreshnessMarker`、`HostDegradedMarker`、`HostUnavailableMarker`、`HostPageCursor`、`HostPageRequest`、`HostPageInfo` 的唯一 schema owner 是 planned `crates/contracts/src/views.rs`。`HostSafeSlice` / `VisibilityContext` 仍留 `contracts/src/refs.rs`；`HostProjectionState` 仍只属于 `domain/src/projection.rs`。 |
| capability source | 承接 `CMP-MS-07 / CAP-MS-27~28`、`IB-MS-003/006/009/011/015` 以及 02 的 `QuerySafeHostFacts` / `QueryHostHistory` no-write read boundary：对已解析可见性和已选择 source / projection field 形成 immutable safe view / page public surface。 |
| view construction division | application `use_cases/read.rs` 是唯一 assembly owner：它解析 visibility、选择 committed source / projection field、映射 `HostSafeSlice`、生成 view id，并调用本批 factory。contracts factory 只验证 public surface 的结构一致性；它不读取 repository、不选择 source、不过滤 raw body、不认证授权、不 refresh / rebuild / repair。 |
| source / projection division | `HostTruthRevision` 是本地 committed source 的 immutable revision anchor；projection progress 仅由 future `HostProjectionState` / infra projection store 持有。正式 02 使用 `HostChangeCursor`，02 Step 6 承接材料使用 `CommittedChangeCursor`，二者尚未收敛为同一个本仓 Rust 类型；因此本批只称“domain-owned committed projection cursor”，不定义、别名、转换或公开它。`HostPageCursor` 是 opaque pagination continuation。三类概念不可转换、不可互用，均不是 repository optimistic version 或 external source version。 |
| public-data ceiling | 可返回的 full view 只能含已获 visibility 许可的 `HostSafeSlice`、body-free source revision、visibility / freshness / degraded / unavailable marker和 assembly timestamp；不携带 domain truth、projection state、repository record、endpoint、credential、manifest、Runtime / Member / Sandbox / Bus / Observability body。`NotVisible` 不是 `SafeHostView`，只能由未来 Step 8 的 no-body response / disposition 表达。 |
| unresolved external seam | `MSVC-UP-001~008` 未关闭时，public surface 只能显示 `Blocked` / `Waiting` / `Unknown` / `Degraded` / `Unavailable` / gap，不能将 placeholder、fake、local receipt、timeout 或 ref 转写为 ready、active、delivered、accepted 或 external completion。 |

#### 8.6.3-a `SafeHostView` marker 组合矩阵

本矩阵只约束已经通过 application resolver-first 路径的 public read assembly；不定义 Step 8 transport status、error code 或 no-body response schema。

| public surface | `HostVisibilityMarker` | `HostUnavailableMarker` | `safe_slice` / `source_revision` | `ViewFreshnessMarker` / `HostDegradedMarker` | 是否构造 `SafeHostView` | 禁止解释 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| fully visible | `Visible` | `Available` | 均为 `Some`；slice 非空，revision 与 freshness anchor 一致 | 任一合法 freshness；degraded 可独立为 not-degraded / degraded | 是，使用 `compose(...)` | `Fresh` 不等于 host ready、healthy、external contract ready 或 external completion。 |
| redacted visible | `Redacted` | `Available` | 均为 `Some`；slice 非空且仅含 resolved selection；revision 与 freshness anchor 一致 | 任一合法 freshness；degraded 可独立为 not-degraded / degraded | 是，使用 `compose(...)` | redaction 不是 unavailable，也不能通过 omitted field 推断 protected body。 |
| authorized unavailable | `Visible` 或 `Redacted` | `Unavailable` | 均为 `None` | 可保留安全的 freshness / degraded marker；不得将其升级为 fresh 或 complete | 是，使用 `unavailable_for_authorized_subject(...)` | unavailable 不表示 host / session / external resource 不存在、deleted 或 failed。 |
| not visible | `NotVisible` | 不适用；不得用 availability 覆盖 visibility | 不适用；不得创建 slice / revision | 不适用；不得返回任一 view marker | 否；future Step 8 仅给 no-body response / disposition | 不得返回 view id、subject anchor、cursor、freshness、degraded、unavailable、reason 以外的可关联字段。 |

本批只固定结构组合，不允许 implementation 因现有 `Timestamp`、source revision、cursor、cache hit、store availability 或 fake path 自动选择其中任何一行；选择责任仍属于 future application read assembly / Step 7 resolver and read port / Step 9 flow。

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Identifies one immutable body-free safe host view without identifying host truth.

impl SafeHostViewId {
    /// Wraps a locally generated opaque public-view identity.
    pub fn from_generated(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted opaque public-view identity.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Returns the opaque view identity for typed mapping only.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `String` | immutable safe view 的 local identity | application id generator output 或 local public view store rehydrate；不得从 `HostId`、`ProjectMemberRef`、source revision、page cursor、timestamp、external ref 或 route 拼接。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_generated(String)` | 包装新生成 view identity | `value` 来自 application id generation result | `Option<SafeHostViewId>` | 空值拒绝；不创建 host truth、projection state 或 visibility result。 |
| `from_persisted(String)` | 重建已保存 view identity | `value` 是 local public view store value | `Option<SafeHostViewId>` | 不刷新 / rebuild view，不验证 view freshness。 |
| `as_str(&self)` | 用于 typed mapping / persistence | 无 | `&str` | 不解析内部结构，不用作 cursor / revision / expected version。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| view id 不等于 host id | 一个 logical host 可有多个 visibility / revision / page context下的 view；view identity 不可取代 `HostRef`。 |
| id 不证明 view ready | id 的存在不表示 visible、fresh、available、host current 或 source committed。 |
