##### `HostVisibilityMarker`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries the resolved public visibility result for one safe host view.
pub struct HostVisibilityMarker {
    /// Public visibility classification for the assembled view.
    pub state: HostVisibilityState,
    /// Optional body-free reason when the view is not visible or has been redacted.
    pub reason: Option<HostVisibilityReason>,
}

impl HostVisibilityMarker {
    /// Creates the marker for a fully visible public safe slice.
    pub fn visible() -> Self;

    /// Creates the marker for a not-visible result without exposing protected existence.
    pub fn not_visible(reason: HostVisibilityReason) -> Self;

    /// Creates the marker for a partially redacted but otherwise visible result.
    pub fn redacted(reason: HostVisibilityReason) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether the public view body may be returned to the caller.
    pub fn is_visible(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns the body-free visibility reason when one is present.
    pub fn reason(&self) -> Option<&HostVisibilityReason>;
}

/// Classifies the public visibility surface without replacing authorization truth.
pub enum HostVisibilityState {
    /// The resolved visibility path permits the selected safe slice to be returned.
    Visible,
    /// The resolved visibility path does not permit a safe slice to be returned.
    NotVisible,
    /// The resolved visibility path permits only a redacted safe slice to be returned.
    Redacted,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `HostVisibilityState` | read response 的公开可见性分类 | 仅由 application visibility resolver + read assembler 的已解析结果创建；Query entry、repository、projection store、domain、infra fake 不得自己判断。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostVisibilityReason>` | not-visible / redacted 的 body-free reason | 从 resolver / policy 的已裁剪 public output获取；`Visible` 必须为 `None`，不得携带 authorization / identity / Work / governance body。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `visible()` | 构造 full visible public marker | 无 | `HostVisibilityMarker` | 返回 `Visible + None`；不验证 caller、subject或 field selection。 |
| `not_visible(HostVisibilityReason)` | 构造不可见 surface | public reason | `HostVisibilityMarker` | 返回 `NotVisible + Some(reason)`；不表明 host / view / session / external resource 是否存在。 |
| `redacted(HostVisibilityReason)` | 构造部分公开 surface | public reason | `HostVisibilityMarker` | 返回 `Redacted + Some(reason)`；实际 field selection 在 `HostSafeSlice.visible_fields`，不得由 marker 扩张。 |
| `is_visible(&self)` | 判断 public view body 是否可返回 | 无 | `bool` | `Visible` / `Redacted` 返回 true；不重新做 authorization。 |
| `reason(&self)` | 读取安全原因 | 无 | `Option<&HostVisibilityReason>` | 只读；不得将 reason 拓展为 protected existence。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Visible` | `The resolved visibility path permits the selected safe slice to be returned.` | 可返回已选 slice | application resolved visibility output | `SafeHostView.visibility` |
| `NotVisible` | `The resolved visibility path does not permit a safe slice to be returned.` | 不可返回 body | application resolved visibility output | Step 8 no-body response / disposition；不得进入 `SafeHostView` |
| `Redacted` | `The resolved visibility path permits only a redacted safe slice to be returned.` | 可返回更窄 slice | application resolved visibility output | `SafeHostView.visibility` |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `NotVisible` 必须无 view | `NotVisible` 不得进入任一 `SafeHostView` factory；future Step 8 仅返回 no-body response / disposition，且不得以 view id、subject anchor、empty slice、revision、page cursor 或 marker 暗示 host 是否存在。 |
| marker 不是 authorization truth | 它只携带 resolved public result，不能被当作 policy decision、permit token、actor context 或 command permission。 |
| redaction 不等于 unavailable | `Redacted` 只说明可见性裁剪；projection / source不可用必须通过 freshness / degraded / unavailable marker 表达。 |

##### `ViewFreshnessMarker`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries freshness observed for a safe host view without triggering a refresh or rebuild.
pub struct ViewFreshnessMarker {
    /// Public freshness classification for the selected source and projection surface.
    pub state: ViewFreshnessState,
    /// Source revision associated with the freshness surface when one is safely known.
    pub source_revision: Option<HostTruthRevision>,
    /// Optional body-free local reason for a non-fresh surface.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl ViewFreshnessMarker {
    /// Creates a freshness marker from an already selected public classification.
    pub fn from_projected_state(
        state: ViewFreshnessState,
        source_revision: Option<HostTruthRevision>,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether the selected public surface is fresh for its stated source revision.
    pub fn is_fresh(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies safe-view freshness without replacing projection progress or source truth.
pub enum ViewFreshnessState {
    /// The selected safe surface is fresh for its stated local source revision.
    Fresh,
    /// The selected safe surface is behind a known local source revision or has a stale basis.
    Stale,
    /// A projection rebuild is in progress and no fresh claim may be made.
    Rebuilding,
    /// The source or projection basis cannot be classified reliably.
    Unknown,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `ViewFreshnessState` | selected safe view 的时点分类 | application mapper 从 safe projection / selected committed source classification 得到；不从 cache hit、client timestamp或 repository connection status猜测。 |
| `source_revision` | `Option<HostTruthRevision>` | marker 对应的 source anchor | `Fresh` / `Stale` 只能随已安全确定的 revision 给出；`Rebuilding` / `Unknown` 可为 `None`，不得伪造 current revision。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | stale / rebuilding / unknown 的公开原因 | mapper 从 local projection / source classification安全映射；`Fresh` 必须为 `None`。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_projected_state(...)` | 构造已映射 freshness marker | state、optional source revision、safe reason | `Result<ViewFreshnessMarker, ContractError>` | 验证 `Fresh` 需要 revision 且无 reason；`Stale` 需要 revision；`Rebuilding` / `Unknown` 不能伪造 reason-free fresh claim；不 refresh / rebuild。 |
| `is_fresh(&self)` | 判断是否公开为 fresh | 无 | `bool` | 仅 `Fresh` 返回 true；不说明 visibility、availability、domain truth current或 external freshness。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Fresh` | `The selected safe surface is fresh for its stated local source revision.` | safe surface 跟上其已知 local source revision | application projection / source mapping | `ViewFreshnessMarker.state` |
| `Stale` | `The selected safe surface is behind a known local source revision or has a stale basis.` | local source / projection 时点不满足 | application projection / source mapping | `ViewFreshnessMarker.state`、degraded surface |
| `Rebuilding` | `A projection rebuild is in progress and no fresh claim may be made.` | 本地 projection rebuilding classification | application projection mapping | `ViewFreshnessMarker.state`、degraded / unavailable surface |
| `Unknown` | `The source or projection basis cannot be classified reliably.` | source / projection classification不确定 | application projection mapping | `ViewFreshnessMarker.state`、degraded / unavailable surface |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| freshness 不替代 cursor | marker 不能存放 / 比较 domain-owned committed projection cursor、broker offset、repository version 或 page cursor；projection progress 仍由 domain / infra owner管理。 |
| Query no-write | 读取 `Stale` / `Rebuilding` / `Unknown` 不得自动 refresh、rebuild、repair、publish或写 history。 |
| fresh 不代表完整成功 | `Fresh` 只约束 selected safe surface的 local source revision；不保证 all field families visible、external contracts ready、host ready / healthy或任何 external outcome。 |

##### `HostDegradedMarker`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries whether a visible safe host view is partially degraded without repairing it.
pub struct HostDegradedMarker {
    /// Public degradation classification for the assembled view.
    pub state: HostDegradedState,
    /// Optional body-free local reason when the view is degraded.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl HostDegradedMarker {
    /// Creates a marker for a view with no known public degradation.
    pub fn not_degraded() -> Self;

    /// Creates a marker for a partially degraded public view.
    pub fn degraded(reason: HostSafeSummaryReason) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether the assembled public view is degraded.
    pub fn is_degraded(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies whether a visible public safe view has a known partial degradation.
pub enum HostDegradedState {
    /// The assembled public view has no known degradation in its selected safe surface.
    NotDegraded,
    /// The assembled public view is partial or degraded and must expose its safe reason or gap.
    Degraded,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `HostDegradedState` | view 是否已知部分降级 | application mapper 由 safe gaps、projection classification或 selected field availability创建；不得把 all fields absent、not-visible或 local policy block一律等同 degradation。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | degraded 的公开原因 | `Degraded` 必须有 reason；`NotDegraded` 必须无 reason。reason 只来自已裁剪 local gap / projection classification。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `not_degraded()` | 构造无已知降级 marker | 无 | `HostDegradedMarker` | 返回 `NotDegraded + None`；不证明 fresh / available / all fields present。 |
| `degraded(HostSafeSummaryReason)` | 构造部分降级 marker | safe reason | `HostDegradedMarker` | 返回 `Degraded + Some(reason)`；不刷新 / repair public view。 |
| `is_degraded(&self)` | 判断公开 surface 是否部分降级 | 无 | `bool` | 仅 `Degraded` 返回 true；不触发 any side effect。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `NotDegraded` | `The assembled public view has no known degradation in its selected safe surface.` | 已选 surface 无已知降级 | application mapper | `HostDegradedMarker.state` |
| `Degraded` | `The assembled public view is partial or degraded and must expose its safe reason or gap.` | 安全 surface 部分不可用 / 不完整 | application mapper from gap / projection classification | `HostDegradedMarker.state` |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| degraded 不等于 unavailable | `Degraded` 仍可能带 visible body；完全不可依赖 public source 才由 `HostUnavailableMarker` 表达。 |
| 不吞掉 gap | 若 degraded 可公开影响某 field，则 future view/slice 必须保留对应 `HostSafeGapRef`；reason 不得代替 gap index。 |

##### `HostUnavailableMarker`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries whether a safe host view cannot be provided reliably for its selected public surface.
pub struct HostUnavailableMarker {
    /// Public availability classification for the assembled view.
    pub state: HostAvailabilityState,
    /// Optional body-free local reason when the view is unavailable.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl HostUnavailableMarker {
    /// Creates a marker for a safely available public view surface.
    pub fn available() -> Self;

    /// Creates a marker for an unavailable public view surface.
    pub fn unavailable(reason: HostSafeSummaryReason) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether the public view body must be withheld because its source is unavailable.
    pub fn is_unavailable(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies public view availability without declaring a domain or external-owner failure.
pub enum HostAvailabilityState {
    /// A selected public surface can be returned, subject to its visibility and freshness markers.
    Available,
    /// The selected public surface cannot be returned reliably and must remain body-free.
    Unavailable,
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | `HostAvailabilityState` | view public surface 的可靠可用性 | application mapper 从 safe source / projection availability分类得到；不是 domain lifecycle、host health、Runtime availability、adapter health或 external owner result。 |
| `reason` | `Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>` | unavailable 的非敏感原因 | `Unavailable` 必须有 reason；`Available` 必须无 reason；只来自 public-safe local source / projection condition。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `available()` | 构造可返回 public surface marker | 无 | `HostUnavailableMarker` | 返回 `Available + None`；不证明 fresh、visible、all field family present、host ready或 external seam ready。 |
| `unavailable(HostSafeSummaryReason)` | 构造不可可靠读取 surface | safe reason | `HostUnavailableMarker` | 返回 `Unavailable + Some(reason)`；不改 source truth、不开始 repair / rebuild。 |
| `is_unavailable(&self)` | 判断 public body 是否必须 withheld | 无 | `bool` | 仅 `Unavailable` 返回 true；不说明 host、project member或 source truth不存在。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Available` | `A selected public surface can be returned, subject to its visibility and freshness markers.` | selected public surface 可返回 | application safe-read mapper | `HostUnavailableMarker.state` |
| `Unavailable` | `The selected public surface cannot be returned reliably and must remain body-free.` | public safe source不可可靠提供 | application safe-read mapper | `HostUnavailableMarker.state`、Step 8 unavailable response |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| unavailable 不泄露存在性 | `Unavailable` 不得表示 host / session / Runtime / Sandbox resource 是否存在、是否 deleted或 failed。 |
| unavailable 优先级 | future `SafeHostView` 若为 unavailable，必须不携带 `HostSafeSlice` body；visibility reason、freshness / degraded marker可保留仅限安全 marker。 |
| 不等于 service health | 该 marker只描述本次 selected safe read surface，不代表 API、worker、adapter或整个 member-service process可用性。 |

##### `SafeHostView`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Represents one immutable body-free safe host read snapshot that may be returned after visibility resolution.
pub struct SafeHostView {
    /// Stable identity of this immutable public view.
    pub view_id: SafeHostViewId,
    /// Project-scoped execution subject represented by the view.
    pub project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Identity anchor corresponding to the project-scoped execution subject.
    pub global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Body-free fields selected and assembled for this public view.
    pub safe_slice: Option<HostSafeSlice>,
    /// Immutable local committed source revision used for the selected view surface.
    pub source_revision: Option<HostTruthRevision>,
    /// Resolved public visibility surface for the current actor and subject.
    pub visibility: HostVisibilityMarker,
    /// Freshness surface observed for the selected source and projection basis.
    pub freshness: ViewFreshnessMarker,
    /// Partial-degradation surface for an otherwise returnable view.
    pub degraded: HostDegradedMarker,
    /// Availability surface that can withhold the safe slice body.
    pub unavailable: HostUnavailableMarker,
    /// Local time at which the application assembled this immutable public surface.
    pub assembled_at: Timestamp,
}

impl SafeHostView {
    /// Composes an immutable visible or redacted safe host view from application-selected public fields.
    pub fn compose(
        view_id: SafeHostViewId,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        safe_slice: HostSafeSlice,
        source_revision: HostTruthRevision,
        visibility: HostVisibilityMarker,
        freshness: ViewFreshnessMarker,
        degraded: HostDegradedMarker,
        unavailable: HostUnavailableMarker,
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Composes a body-free unavailable surface for an already visibility-authorized subject.
    pub fn unavailable_for_authorized_subject(
        view_id: SafeHostViewId,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        visibility: HostVisibilityMarker,
        freshness: ViewFreshnessMarker,
        degraded: HostDegradedMarker,
        unavailable: HostUnavailableMarker,
        assembled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether this view may expose a safe slice body.
    pub fn is_visible(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether the selected view surface is fresh.
    pub fn is_fresh(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether the selected view surface is unavailable.
    pub fn is_unavailable(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this view references a specified local source revision.
    pub fn references_revision(&self, revision: &HostTruthRevision) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `view_id` | `SafeHostViewId` | immutable public view identity | application read assembler 使用 id-generation result 或 persisted view identity；不替代 host identity。 |
| `project_member_ref` | `ProjectMemberRef` | view 的唯一项目型执行主语 | 从 `VisibilityContext.read_subject` / selected `HostSafeSlice` 的已解析 anchor复制；非项目型 subject fail closed。 |
| `global_member_ref` | `GlobalMemberRef` | 与项目主语一致的 identity anchor | application validated subject mapping；不保存 Identity body、不替代 `ProjectMemberRef`。 |
| `safe_slice` | `Option<HostSafeSlice>` | visible / redacted 时的 body-free fields | `SafeHostView` 只能来自 `Visible` / `Redacted` 语境：available 时必须为 `Some(non-empty slice)`；unavailable 时必须为 `None`。`NotVisible` 根本不构造 view；不得由 query entry / repository / fake临时构造。 |
| `source_revision` | `Option<HostTruthRevision>` | 已选 safe slice 的 local committed revision | available view 的 `safe_slice.is_some()` 时必须为 `Some` 且匹配 freshness可公开 anchor；已授权 unavailable view 必须为 `None`。`NotVisible` 没有此字段，故不得伪造 revision。 |
| `visibility` | `HostVisibilityMarker` | resolved public visibility result | application resolver-first output；不重新认证授权。 |
| `freshness` | `ViewFreshnessMarker` | 时点 / rebuild / unknown public surface | application mapper 根据 selected local source / projection classification构造；不以 client timestamp推断。 |
| `degraded` | `HostDegradedMarker` | partial result public surface | application mapper；view只公开，不能修复。 |
| `unavailable` | `HostUnavailableMarker` | body withholding public surface | application mapper；仅在已确认 `Visible` / `Redacted` 的语境中与此 DTO 一同出现；unavailable 是本次 read surface而非 domain / process state。 |
| `assembled_at` | `Timestamp` | application 形成此 immutable public surface 的本地时点 | 只来自 future application `ClockPort` 的 read-assembly output；不是 source observation time、freshness policy、projection cursor、repository version或 client supplied time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `compose(...)` | 组装可见 / redacted immutable safe view | all input 已由 application resolver / mapper selected | `Result<SafeHostView, ContractError>` | 验证：visibility只能为 `Visible` / `Redacted`；unavailable必须为 `Available`；slice双锚必须与 view anchors一致；slice非空、source revision与 freshness revision一致；不读 / 写 source或 projection。 |
| `unavailable_for_authorized_subject(...)` | 组装无法可靠提供 body 的安全 surface | 已确认可公开 subject anchors、marker family、assembly time | `Result<SafeHostView, ContractError>` | 验证 visibility只能为 `Visible` / `Redacted`、unavailable为 `Unavailable`、safe slice / source revision为 `None`；不 retry / refresh / rebuild。`NotVisible` 必须走 Step 8 no-body response，不能调用本 factory。 |
| `is_visible(&self)` | 判断是否可以返回 body | 无 | `bool` | `visibility.is_visible() && !unavailable.is_unavailable()`；不重新做 visibility检查。 |
| `is_fresh(&self)` | 判断 public surface是否 fresh | 无 | `bool` | 仅 `freshness.is_fresh()`；不代表 domain truth current或 external condition fresh。 |
| `is_unavailable(&self)` | 判断 body 是否被 withheld | 无 | `bool` | 代理 unavailable marker；不说明 entity existence。 |
| `references_revision(&self, &HostTruthRevision)` | 判断是否锚定某个 source revision | candidate revision | `bool` | 纯比较；`None` revision 返回 false，不加载 source。 |

| 工厂 / 静态函数 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 使用场景 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `compose(...)` | 从 selected safe slice / marker family构成可读 view | public id、双锚、slice、revision、markers、assembly time | `Result<SafeHostView, ContractError>` | application `read.rs` 的 visible / redacted query assembly；Step 8 只消费该 DTO。 |
| `unavailable_for_authorized_subject(...)` | 在 source / projection不可可靠时构成 no-body surface | public id、已确认可公开的双锚、markers、assembly time | `Result<SafeHostView, ContractError>` | application `read.rs` unavailable branch；不重试 / repair。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| immutable / no-write | view 不得进入 command、decision、attempt、registration、health、closure、outbox或 handoff write path；Query不得 refresh / repair / publish / reconcile。 |
| visibility优先 | `NotVisible` 不构成 `SafeHostView`，仅能返回 future Step 8 no-body surface；因此不得携带 view id、subject anchor、safe slice、source revision、freshness、degraded、unavailable或 assembly timestamp。`Unavailable` 只可在已确认 `Visible` / `Redacted` 的查询语境下形成 no-body view，且不得携带 safe slice / source revision。 |
| no empty-slice substitute | `compose(...)` 不接受 empty `HostSafeSlice`；未定义 empty-slice factory。没有可返回 field 时只能走 future Step 8 no-body response / disposition，不能借空切片包装 `Visible` / `Redacted` view 或暗示 host / subject存在。 |
| marker不互相替代 | freshness、degraded、unavailable、visibility必须同时保持独立字段；不得以 `Fresh` 替代 available、以 `Visible` 替代 fresh或以 degraded替代 gap。 |
| forbidden body | raw endpoint、credential、image / manifest、Member / Runtime / Sandbox / external resource / Bus receipt / Observability body均不得进入 view。 |
| no projection owner leak | `SafeHostView` 不能持有 `HostProjectionState`、domain-owned committed projection cursor、repository version、external source version或 domain object。 |

##### `HostPageCursor`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries an opaque continuation token for one safe host query page.
pub struct HostPageCursor(String);

impl HostPageCursor {
    /// Wraps an opaque cursor returned by a local safe-read repository or projection path.
    pub fn from_returned_cursor(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Rehydrates an opaque cursor supplied by a prior public page response.
    pub fn from_request_cursor(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Returns the opaque cursor for typed request or response mapping only.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `String` | safe query continuation token | future application read repository / projection path 返回的 opaque cursor，或上一页 public response回传；不得由 id、timestamp、source revision、projection cursor、repository version、broker offset、external version或 route拼接 / 解析。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_returned_cursor(String)` | 包装 read path返回的 continuation | `value` 是 opaque local page cursor | `Option<HostPageCursor>` | 空值拒绝；不读取下一页、不验证数据 / visibility。 |
| `from_request_cursor(String)` | 包装 client回传的上一页 cursor | `value` 是 previous response opaque cursor | `Option<HostPageCursor>` | 空值拒绝；不 decode / parse / reconstruct sort state。 |
| `as_str(&self)` | 供 typed page mapping使用 | 无 | `&str` | 不得将内部值用于 source / projection / CAS comparison。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| cursor 不是 source revision | `HostPageCursor` 只延续一个 read ordering，绝不表示 `HostTruthRevision`、Host generation、projection progress或 freshness。 |
| cursor 不是 authorization token | 它不能绕过 resolver-first visibility；每页都必须重新受 future read flow 的 visibility / public-surface guard约束。 |
| opaque 不等于可伪造 | application / infra须在 Step 7/8定义验证 / decode seam；contracts不定义编码、签名、排序、offset或storage算法。 |

##### `HostPageRequest`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries bounded pagination input for a safe host query without selecting visibility or source truth.
pub struct HostPageRequest {
    /// Opaque continuation cursor returned by a prior page when present.
    pub cursor: Option<HostPageCursor>,
    /// Maximum number of public items requested before application-side limits are applied.
    pub limit: u32,
}

impl HostPageRequest {
    /// Creates a first-page request with a requested positive item limit.
    pub fn first_page(limit: u32) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Creates a continuation-page request with a prior opaque cursor and requested positive item limit.
    pub fn new(cursor: HostPageCursor, limit: u32) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether this request continues from a prior public page.
    pub fn has_cursor(&self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | `Option<HostPageCursor>` | prior public page 的可选 continuation | API / query entry把已验证 string映射为 typed cursor；`None` 表示 first page，不表示 source从头重建。 |
| `limit` | `u32` | 请求的最大公开 item 数 | query entry输入；必须大于 0，application future page policy / configuration还会施加上限。contracts不固化具体 max value。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `first_page(u32)` | 构造首屏 page request | requested positive limit | `Result<HostPageRequest, ContractError>` | 拒绝 `0`；不读取任何 view / history、不选择排序。 |
| `new(HostPageCursor, u32)` | 构造续页 request | previous cursor、requested positive limit | `Result<HostPageRequest, ContractError>` | 拒绝 `0`；不解析 cursor、不验证访问权限。 |
| `has_cursor(&self)` | 判断是否为续页 | 无 | `bool` | 仅检查字段 presence；不说明 cursor有效、visible或 fresh。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| limit不定义配置 | 本类型仅拒绝零值；最大 page size、limit clamp和恶意 cursor策略在 Step 14 / Step 7 / Step 8闭合，不能在 contracts私定数值。 |
| request不选择 truth | page input 不含 actor、subject、visibility、sort、source revision、repository version或 projection cursor；这些归 Query DTO / application read flow。 |

##### `HostPageInfo`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries body-free continuation information returned with one safe host query page.
pub struct HostPageInfo {
    /// Opaque continuation cursor for the next page when more public items are available.
    pub next_cursor: Option<HostPageCursor>,
    /// Whether another public page may be requested through the returned cursor.
    pub has_more: bool,
}

impl HostPageInfo {
    /// Creates page information from a local safe-read result that already determined continuation.
    pub fn from_read_result(next_cursor: Option<HostPageCursor>, has_more: bool) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether this response provides a continuation cursor.
    pub fn has_next_cursor(&self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `next_cursor` | `Option<HostPageCursor>` | 后续页的 opaque continuation | future repository / projection safe-read result由 application mapper复制；只在 `has_more` 时存在。 |
| `has_more` | `bool` | 是否可继续请求下一页 | future read result 的局部 pagination outcome；不表示有更多 hidden、unavailable、external或 unqualified item。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_read_result(Option<HostPageCursor>, bool)` | 构造 page response helper | read path 已决定的 cursor presence与 has-more | `Result<HostPageInfo, ContractError>` | 验证 `has_more == next_cursor.is_some()`；不读取下一页、不生成 cursor、不改变 ordering。 |
| `has_next_cursor(&self)` | 判断 response 是否带 continuation | 无 | `bool` | 仅检查 `next_cursor`；与 `has_more` 结构一致。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| continuation 不泄露隐藏项 | `has_more` 只针对当前已授权、可返回 public surface的分页结果，不能暗示 not-visible host、external resource或 protected history存在。 |
| page info 不是 projection progress | next cursor / has-more不等于 domain-owned committed projection cursor、source revision、storage offset或rebuild completion。 |

#### 8.6.4 `6.1-b-2` 对象组停审记录

| 审查项 | 结论 | 缺口 / 修正 |
|---|---|---|
| full public view schema owner | pass | `SafeHostView` 及 id / revision / marker / page helper均在 `contracts/src/views.rs`；`HostSafeSlice`在 refs、`HostProjectionState`在 domain、read assembly在 application、physical store在 infra，未混同。 |
| visibility / public body guard | pass_after_correction | `NotVisible` 不构成 `SafeHostView`，只能走 Step 8 no-body response；已授权 unavailable view 也强制 no body；`Redacted`只允许 application已选的非空更窄 slice；marker不充当 authorization truth。 |
| freshness / degraded / unavailable分层 | pass | freshness、partial degradation、source unavailable是独立 marker；任何 marker均不替代 host lifecycle、health、external owner completion或 projection state。 |
| page / cursor分层 | pass_after_correction | page cursor、source revision、domain-owned committed projection cursor、repository optimistic version和 external source version均有不同 owner和禁止互转规则；正式 02 的 `HostChangeCursor` 与 02 Step 6 承接材料的 `CommittedChangeCursor` 名称差异已登记为 domain 前置待收敛项。 |
| view no-write | pass | factory/helper都不读repo、不refresh、不rebuild、不repair、不publish、不reconcile、不写 history；future query flow只能 assembly。 |
| public body ceiling | pass_with_upstream_blockers | view只可输出 `HostSafeSlice` / safe marker；`MSVC-UP-001~008` exact body、route、receipt、credential、manifest、callback继续 pending。 |
| capability object coverage | pass | `CMP-MS-07` safe consumption / projection read surface和 02 query flow需要的 id、source revision、view、marker、page carrier均有独立对象卡。 |
| contracts module completion | not_yet | metadata、reason / shared state、receipt / disposition等 contracts对象组仍未展开；只能继续 `contracts`后续对象组，不得进入domain或Step 7。 |

`6.1-b-2` corrective closure 停审结论：`completed / pass_with_upstream_blockers`。允许继续 `contracts` 的下一对象组（`6.1-c` metadata / operation carrier），不允许进入 `domain` 或创建 Step 7。

### 8.7 `6.1-c`：Core metadata consumption 与 consumer / job replay-input placeholder

#### 8.7.1 本对象组写入边界

| 项 | 本批结论 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 owner | `HostCommandMetadata`、`HostQueryMetadata`、`HostCommandReplayInput`、inbound consumer identity / time / replay carrier 与 operations-job placeholder 的唯一 schema owner 是 planned `crates/contracts/src/metadata.rs`。`IdempotencyKey`、`CorrelationId` 仍由 `contracts/src/refs.rs` 拥有；application `OperationContext`、digest、reservation 与 stored result 仍不属于本文件。 |
| Core 消费上限 | `ActorContext`、`CommandMetadata`、`QueryMetadata` 与 `Timestamp` 只作为已存在的 Core shared category 被直接字段引用；本仓不复制其内部字段，不定义 `HostRequestMetadata`、`HostTraceContext`、`HostActor` 或 Core metadata 的本地序列化 shadow schema。当前 `MSVC-UP-007` 仍阻塞准确 import/export、member-service event family 和 envelope 细节。 |
| 本批责任 | 为 command / query 保留可信 actor 与 Core metadata 的消费边界；为 inbound consumer / operations job 固定 opaque identity、time、correlation 和已映射的 local replay input，使 worker、jobs、application 和 fake 不得自行拼消息或作业 metadata。 |
| placeholder 上限 | `HostInbound*Placeholder` 与 `HostOperationsJob*Placeholder` 只保存已验证 boundary 交给本仓的 opaque carrier；它们不是 external envelope、Bus receipt、route、topic、schema registry entry、runtime request、sandbox callback、credential 或 sibling truth。exact contract 未闭合时无法构造相应 placeholder 必须在 entry 处 fail-closed / hold，不得用 raw body、route、offset、adapter error 或 fake map 补齐。 |
| 时间与关联 | consumer 必须同时保留 source-provided `source_time`（带 captured / observed 类别）和 local `accepted_at`；二者不互相 fallback，也不因 clock skew 互相推出先后。job 只记录 runner 交付时的 `accepted_at`，不把它解释为 scheduler trigger、实际执行完成、external observed time 或 Host Truth 时间。Core request metadata 内含的 request time 仍只留在 Core carrier 中，不能替代 consumer / job time anchor。所有 causal chain 仅通过既有 `CorrelationId` 关联。 |
| replay 与幂等上限 | `HostCommandReplayInput`、`HostInboundReplayInput`、`HostOperationsJobReplayInput` 只携带已验证的 `IdempotencyKey` / stable identity / correlation；它们不 canonicalize payload、不计算 digest、不 reserve、不读取 stored result、不判定 duplicate，也不生成新 key。command 的 Core `CommandMetadata` 已是本地 key 的唯一合法 source category；consumer / job 的 exact key mapping 仍随正式 envelope / runner contract pending。上述 application-owned 行为只可在 Step 7 / 13 闭合。 |
| 不在本批定义 | 不定义 command/query/event/job 完整 DTO、entry disposition、consumer receipt、job report、error taxonomy、port、worker/job entry、outbound event metadata、trace body、external envelope body、schema version、route、delivery receipt 或 retry policy。 |

#### 8.7.3-a 构造资格与缺失输入处置矩阵

本矩阵只约束 `metadata.rs` 的对象 factory 可接受什么已验证输入；它不定义 API / worker / jobs entry 的 protocol、receipt、error code、retry、UoW 或 application duplicate 判定。`rejected / held / gap` 仅是 future entry 的 fail-closed 处置类别，不是本批新增 disposition enum。

| carrier | 可接受的 factory 输入 | 不能构造时的 future entry 处置 | 明确禁止的替代输入 | 后续闭口 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostCommandMetadata` | trusted command entry 已完成 structural validation 的 Core `ActorContext` 与 `CommandMetadata` | rejected；不得进入 application command mapping | route、request body、local actor profile、system actor、query metadata | Step 8 command schema；Step 9 command flow |
| `HostCommandReplayInput` | 已验证 `CommandMetadata` 内的正式 Core idempotency authority；继承 / validated `CorrelationId` | rejected；不得用另一 local key 补齐 | request / trace id、subject、generation、timestamp、payload hash、route | Step 7 idempotency port；Step 13 reservation / duplicate |
| `HostQueryMetadata` | trusted query entry 已完成 structural validation 的 Core `ActorContext` 与 `QueryMetadata` | rejected；不得改写为 command 或在 query 内生成 write carrier | command metadata、idempotency key、job run id、history / view infer | Step 8 query schema；Step 9 no-write flow |
| inbound placeholder group | formal consumer mapper 已验证的 source / message opaque identity、safe time metadata、local clock output、mapped local key、correlation | rejected / held / gap；不得更新 snapshot、attempt、association、health或 handoff | raw payload、topic、offset、adapter error、fake counter、request id、receipt | Step 8 consumer protocol；Step 9 consumer flow；Step 13 dedup |
| operations-job placeholder group | validated runner input 的 actor、run identity、mapped local key、correlation 与 local clock output | rejected / held；不得扫描、lease、dispatch、形成 report或新 decision | schedule name、binary name、config、worker identity、scheduler offset、clock-generated key | Step 8 job schema；Step 9 job flow；Step 13 replay |

构造资格不等于业务授权：`HostCommandMetadata`、consumer placeholder 或 job placeholder 创建成功，只说明 metadata carrier 的结构输入已在其边界通过验证；是否允许对应 command、consumer effect 或 persisted work progression，仍只能由 future application / domain guard 结合 operation、generation、visibility、decision / attempt / closure 当前事实判断。

##### `HostCommandMetadata`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries trusted Core command metadata without reproducing the Core metadata schema.
pub struct HostCommandMetadata {
    /// Trusted actor context supplied by the command entry.
    pub actor: ActorContext,
    /// Core command metadata retained as the authoritative metadata carrier.
    pub metadata: CommandMetadata,
}

impl HostCommandMetadata {
    /// Preserves Core command metadata after the entry has completed structural validation.
    pub fn from_validated_core(actor: ActorContext, metadata: CommandMetadata) -> Self;

    /// Returns the trusted actor context without evaluating authorization.
    pub fn actor(&self) -> &ActorContext;

    /// Returns the authoritative Core command metadata without unpacking it into local fields.
    pub fn metadata(&self) -> &CommandMetadata;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor` | Core `ActorContext` | command 的可信主体语境 | 只由 API 或已授权 internal command entry 传入；本仓不认证、不生成 system actor、不保存 actor profile / role body。 |
| `metadata` | Core `CommandMetadata` | command 的 request / trace / idempotency authority | 保持 Core 类型原样；entry 必须先按 Core formal contract 验证，local contracts 不读取或复制其 private / nested field。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_validated_core(ActorContext, CommandMetadata)` | 形成 command metadata carrier | 两个参数均来自可信 entry 的已验证 Core carrier | `HostCommandMetadata` | 纯构造；不从 route、request body 或 domain fact推 actor / metadata，不 reserve idempotency。 |
| `actor()` / `metadata()` | 提供 opaque Core carrier | 无 | borrowed Core carrier | 不做 authorization、trace extraction、key conversion 或 data mutation。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| Core schema 唯一 | 不得新增 `request_id`、`trace_id`、`requested_at`、reason、external ref 或 idempotency 字段的本地镜像。 |
| metadata 不等于业务输入 | `HostCommandMetadata` 不包含 subject、generation、decision、action、external ref 或 requested body；完整 command DTO 留 Step 8。 |
| command key 另行映射 | local `IdempotencyKey` 只可由 `HostCommandReplayInput::from_validated_core_metadata(...)` 从已验证 Core `CommandMetadata` 的正式 idempotency authority 显式形成；不能将 metadata object、request id、trace id、route 或 timestamp 当本地 replay key。 |

##### `HostCommandReplayInput`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries local command replay inputs without calculating a request digest or reserving a result.
pub struct HostCommandReplayInput {
    /// Stable local key mapped from validated command metadata.
    pub idempotency_key: IdempotencyKey,
    /// Causal correlation retained across local command records.
    pub correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

impl HostCommandReplayInput {
    /// Creates replay inputs from validated Core command metadata and inherited correlation context.
    pub fn from_validated_core_metadata(
        metadata: &CommandMetadata,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `idempotency_key` | `IdempotencyKey` | command local replay anchor | 只从已验证 Core `CommandMetadata` 中的正式 idempotency authority 显式映射；不能由 request id、trace id、subject、generation、route、clock 或 raw command body替代。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 关联 command、decision、attempt、history和 material 的因果链 | 由 validated / inherited command context 提供；不能替代 idempotency key、expected version或外部 effect key。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_validated_core_metadata(&CommandMetadata, CorrelationId)` | 从既有 Core command metadata 提取并转换本仓 local replay anchor | `metadata` 必须已由 command entry 按 Core formal contract 验证；`correlation_id` 来自已验证 / 继承 command context | `Result<HostCommandReplayInput, ContractError>` | 当 Core metadata 不提供可转换的 idempotency authority 时返回 body-free contract error；不从其他字段生成 key，不计算 digest、不 reserve、不读取 stored result。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| no digest / no reservation | 本对象不含 digest、operation name、scope、stored result ref或 reservation state；application 才能定义 canonicalization、lookup、reserve / complete 与 duplicate result。 |
| Core command source only | command replay key 必须可回指 `CommandMetadata` 的正式 idempotency authority；不得接受 `IdempotencyKey` 裸参数、拼接字符串、hash payload、使用 random / clock，或在 fake 内临时生成。 |

##### `HostInboundSourceRefPlaceholder` 与 `HostInboundMessageIdPlaceholder`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// References an inbound source through a validated opaque placeholder until the formal source contract closes.
pub struct HostInboundSourceRefPlaceholder(String);

/// Identifies one inbound message through a validated opaque placeholder until the formal envelope closes.
pub struct HostInboundMessageIdPlaceholder(String);

impl HostInboundSourceRefPlaceholder {
    /// Wraps a non-empty source identity supplied by a validated adapter mapping.
    pub fn from_validated_adapter(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Rehydrates a stored opaque source identity without contacting its owner.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Returns the opaque identity only for typed local matching or persistence.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}

impl HostInboundMessageIdPlaceholder {
    /// Wraps a non-empty message identity supplied by a validated adapter mapping.
    pub fn from_validated_adapter(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Rehydrates a stored opaque message identity without replaying the source message.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Returns the opaque identity only for typed local matching or persistence.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 对象 | 来源 | 允许用途 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HostInboundSourceRefPlaceholder` | future Member / Runtime / Images / Sandbox / carrier / Bus adapter 在验证其正式 source contract 后提供，或 local record rehydrate | local source matching、gap / stale / late diagnostic linkage | 不解析为 endpoint、route、owner body、credential、member identity、runtime run、Sandbox resource或 external truth。 |
| `HostInboundMessageIdPlaceholder` | future formal envelope mapper 的 message identity，或 local record rehydrate | duplicate / late / conflict matching input | 不等于 broker offset、external effect key、publication key、receipt、delivery或 acceptance；不得据此宣称 external message accepted。 |

| 共同不变量 / blocker | 说明 |
|---|---|
| explicit placeholder ceiling | `MSVC-UP-001/002/003/004/007` 未闭口时，这两个类型只表示本仓已收到一个可安全保存的 opaque identity；并不证明具体 producer、schema、route或 payload已可用。 |
| no raw fallback | source 或 message identity 缺失、为空、无法被 formal mapper验证时，consumer 不构造 placeholder；future worker entry 必须 rejected / held / gap，不得用 payload digest、topic、offset、error text或 fake counter补位。 |

##### `HostInboundSourceTimeKind` 与 `HostInboundTimeAnchor`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Classifies the semantic source of an inbound timestamp without inferring event ordering.
pub enum HostInboundSourceTimeKind {
    /// The source captured a body-free signal or feedback summary at this time.
    Captured,
    /// The source observed a body-free signal or feedback summary at this time.
    Observed,
}

/// Preserves the source time and local acceptance time for one inbound consumer item.
pub struct HostInboundTimeAnchor {
    /// Source-provided time retained after validated boundary mapping.
    pub source_time: Timestamp,
    /// Meaning of the source-provided time.
    pub source_time_kind: HostInboundSourceTimeKind,
    /// Local time when the worker accepted the mapped item for processing.
    pub accepted_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostInboundTimeAnchor {
    /// Creates a time anchor from validated source metadata and a runner-provided local clock value.
    pub fn from_validated_input(
        source_time: Timestamp,
        source_time_kind: HostInboundSourceTimeKind,
        accepted_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Self;
}
```

| 字段 / variant | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| `Captured` | 标识 source time 是 source capture time | 只由正式 mapper 的已验证 metadata 映射；不是 application / worker 当前 clock。 |
| `Observed` | 标识 source time 是 source observation time | 只由正式 mapper 的已验证 metadata 映射；不是 backend state、receipt time或 query time。 |
| `source_time` | 保留外部安全摘要的 source time | 必须来自外部 source 的已验证 metadata；缺失时不得用 `accepted_at`、retry time、adapter response time或 persistence time替代。 |
| `accepted_at` | 标识本地 worker 接纳 mapping 的时点 | 未来 worker / operations context 通过 ClockPort / runner context 传入；不等于 source time、job time、Host Truth commit time或 external completion time。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| time is not order proof | 不允许仅比较 `source_time` 与 `accepted_at` 推断 message late / current / duplicate；generation、message identity、source、expected local facts与 future policy共同决定分类。 |
| no clock fallback | `Timestamp` 不由 contracts 读取、生成或修正；factory 只保存调用者已提供的 typed values。 |

##### `HostInboundReplayInput` 与 `HostInboundConsumerMetadataPlaceholder`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries stable, body-free inputs for inbound replay matching without reserving idempotency.
pub struct HostInboundReplayInput {
    /// Opaque external source identity after validated boundary mapping.
    pub source_ref: HostInboundSourceRefPlaceholder,
    /// Opaque source message identity after validated boundary mapping.
    pub message_id: HostInboundMessageIdPlaceholder,
    /// Stable local key mapped by the validated consumer entry.
    pub idempotency_key: IdempotencyKey,
    /// Causal correlation retained for matching local records.
    pub correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

/// Groups inbound replay input and time anchors without becoming an external envelope.
pub struct HostInboundConsumerMetadataPlaceholder {
    /// Stable matching inputs for the inbound item.
    pub replay_input: HostInboundReplayInput,
    /// Separate source and local acceptance timestamps.
    pub time_anchor: HostInboundTimeAnchor,
}

impl HostInboundReplayInput {
    /// Creates stable replay inputs after entry validation has mapped every required carrier.
    pub fn from_validated_input(
        source_ref: HostInboundSourceRefPlaceholder,
        message_id: HostInboundMessageIdPlaceholder,
        idempotency_key: IdempotencyKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Self;
}

impl HostInboundConsumerMetadataPlaceholder {
    /// Combines already validated replay and time carriers without parsing an external envelope.
    pub fn compose(replay_input: HostInboundReplayInput, time_anchor: HostInboundTimeAnchor) -> Self;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_ref` / `message_id` | inbound opaque placeholder family | 将 source 与 message binding 保持为一组 replay input | 均须经 formal consumer mapper验证；不可由 `IdempotencyKey`、correlation、offset或 local fact反推。 |
| `idempotency_key` | `IdempotencyKey` | 供 future application dedup / stored-result boundary 使用的本地稳定键 | 仅由 validated entry mapping 显式提供；不在 contracts 中派生算法。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 将 matching snapshot / attempt / handoff / history chain 关联起来 | 不代替 message identity、dedup key、generation或 external effect key。 |
| `time_anchor` | `HostInboundTimeAnchor` | 保留 source / local time 分层 | 仅合并已验证 typed carrier；不比较时间、不刷新、不写 snapshot。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| placeholder is not envelope | 不包含 payload、schema version、route、headers、trace body、receipt、target、generation、safe summary或 external outcome；这些均留 Step 8 / cross-owner contract。 |
| no consumer side effect | `compose(...)` 不做 dedup、late classification、store write、gap write、association update、health assessment或 recovery decision。 |

/// Carries stable replay inputs for an operations job without selecting or executing work.
