```rust
    /// Opaque job run identity supplied by the validated runner.
    pub run_id: HostJobRunIdPlaceholder,
    /// Stable local idempotency key supplied by the validated runner.
    pub idempotency_key: IdempotencyKey,
    /// Causal correlation for local attempts, material, history, or reports.
    pub correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

/// Groups runner-provided actor, replay input, and local acceptance time for an operations job.
pub struct HostOperationsJobMetadataPlaceholder {
    /// Trusted system or operator actor supplied by the job runner.
    pub actor: ActorContext,
    /// Stable replay inputs for this job run.
    pub replay_input: HostOperationsJobReplayInput,
    /// Local time when the runner accepted the job input.
    pub accepted_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostJobRunIdPlaceholder {
    /// Wraps a non-empty job run identity supplied by a validated runner.
    pub fn from_validated_runner(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Rehydrates a stored opaque job run identity without rescheduling work.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Returns the opaque run identity only for typed local matching or persistence.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}

impl HostOperationsJobReplayInput {
    /// Creates replay inputs that a validated runner has already supplied.
    pub fn from_validated_runner(
        run_id: HostJobRunIdPlaceholder,
        idempotency_key: IdempotencyKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Self;
}

impl HostOperationsJobMetadataPlaceholder {
    /// Combines runner-provided metadata without granting new job authority.
    pub fn from_validated_runner(
        actor: ActorContext,
        replay_input: HostOperationsJobReplayInput,
        accepted_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Self;
}
```

| 字段 / 对象 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| `HostJobRunIdPlaceholder` | 表示一次 runner-provided job run identity | 当前为 `MSVC-UP-007` 下 opaque placeholder；不等于 application result id、scheduler offset、lease、work selector、report id或 external operation id。 |
| `HostOperationsJobReplayInput` | 绑定 run / local key / correlation | 三者均由 validated runner / context mapping 提供；不生成 key、digest、selector或 schedule。 |
| `actor` | 保留 system / operator Core actor context | job runner 必须提供可信 actor；本仓不从 schedule、config、binary name或 worker identity推 actor。 |
| `accepted_at` | 记录 runner 接纳 job input 的本地时点 | 由 runner context / future clock boundary传入；不是 cron trigger、lease acquired、job completion、effect dispatch或 external observed time。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| no implicit authorization | metadata presence、system actor、run id或 idempotency key 都不能授权 `DispatchPendingHostActionsJob`、cleanup、publication、projection或 reconciliation 形成新 decision；future job flow只能推进已提交 work。 |
| no report / disposition | 本对象不包含 job kind、work selector、page、lease、batch、retry、result、report或 entry state；这些分别留 jobs / application / Step 8~14。 |
| no exact job protocol claim | placeholder 不代表 Core job DTO、CLI、scheduler或 Server self-test 已可用；`MSVC-UP-007/008` 继续 pending。 |

#### 8.7.4 `6.1-c` 对象组停审记录

| 审查项 | 结论 | 缺口 / 修正 |
|---|---|---|
| Core metadata owner | pass | `ActorContext`、`CommandMetadata`、`QueryMetadata`、`Timestamp` 仅作 Core typed consumption；没有复制任何 Core field、local trace wrapper或 metadata shadow schema。 |
| command / query read-write boundary | pass | command 有独立 local replay input；query carrier 明确 no-write，不能构造 local idempotency / operation / digest carrier。 |
| consumer time / identity / replay | pass_with_upstream_blockers | source/message placeholder、source/local time和 local replay input均有 schema；exact Member / Runtime / Sandbox / Bus envelope、source type和 mapping继续由 `MSVC-UP-001/002/004/007` 阻塞。 |
| job authority boundary | pass_with_upstream_blockers | runner actor、run identity、local replay input和 accepted time已闭口为 placeholder；job selector、lease、schedule、report、exact DTO / SDK target仍 pending。 |
| application ownership preserved | pass | 没有定义 `HostOperationContext`、operation name、canonical digest、idempotency record、stored result、UoW、port或 duplicate outcome。 |
| external protocol / completion boundary | pass | 没有定义 envelope body、route、receipt、trace body、schema version、delivery / observation / acceptance，placeholder / fake 未被升级为 ready。 |
| contracts module completion | not_yet | reason / shared state、receipt / disposition、external safe ref 与 protocol DTO仍未展开；只能继续 `contracts` 的下一对象组，不得进入 domain 或创建 Step 7。 |

`6.1-c` 对象组停审结论：`completed / pass_with_upstream_blockers`。允许继续 `contracts` 的 `6.1-d`（public local receipt / disposition carrier）；不允许进入 `domain` 或创建 Step 7。

### 8.8 6.1-d：public local receipt / replay / disposition carrier

#### 8.8.1 本对象组写入边界

| 项 | 本批结论 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 owner | HostReceiptChannel、HostLocalReceiptDisposition、HostReceiptReplayKind、HostReceiptReason 与 HostLocalReceipt 的唯一 schema owner 是 planned crates/contracts/src/receipts.rs。它们是可被 public protocol 和本仓 entry mapper 复用的 body-free secondary carrier，不是 application result store、domain record、worker state 或 job report。 |
| 本批责任 | 固定 Command、Consumer、Job 三类 write-side / operation-side entry 都可复用的 local-result 分类、fresh/replayed 标记与安全原因。它只描述本仓当前 local boundary 已返回什么结果，绝不描述外部 owner 已完成什么结果。 |
| entry owner 不前移 | API command/query handler 的 handler disposition 仍只属于 api；consumer item / loop disposition 仍只属于 worker；job entry / run disposition 和 report 仍只属于 jobs。receipts.rs 不定义 route、entry id、source envelope、job kind、lease、batch、page、retry、validation issue 或 entry lifecycle。 |
| application owner 不前移 | operation name、canonical digest、idempotency reservation、duplicate determination、stored result identity、stored public surface、save/get/missing behavior 与 UoW 仍只属于 application / its future ports。HostLocalReceipt 可以被 application 形成或 rehydrate，但不能取代这些 application object。 |
| public-data ceiling | receipt 只能含有限 channel、local disposition、fresh/replayed classification 和 body-free local reason。它不含 request / payload / endpoint / credential / image manifest / Runtime or Sandbox body / Bus route or receipt / adapter error / trace body / observability truth / target feedback body。 |
| result-layer ceiling | Accepted 只表示本地边界已产生允许返回的 local result；它不等于 Host ready / active / healthy / closed，也不等于 external action dispatched / accepted / completed、cleanup completed、publication delivered、observation linked 或 downstream acceptance。 |
| query red line | Query 没有 receipt channel，也不得构造、persist、replay 或返回 HostLocalReceipt 作为 write result。Query 的 visible / not-visible / degraded / unavailable surface 仍由 views.rs、api query entry 和后续 protocol / flow 收口。 |
| upstream blocker | Runtime、Member、Images、Sandbox、Core / Bus 与 SDK 的 exact result / callback / receipt schema 继续由 MSVC-UP-001~008 挂起。本批不以 local receipt、timeout、fake、observed signal 或 adapter availability 升级任何外部合同。 |

#### 8.8.2 本对象组 capability 到对象映射

| 功能 / capability | 输入 | 输出 | 状态 / 副作用 | 所属对象 | 后续 Step 承接 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 标明一个 local result 适用的 operation channel | 已由 future entry / application 选择的 Command、Consumer 或 Job 类别 | finite channel classification | 无 operation dispatch、无 truth write | HostReceiptChannel | Step 8 protocol DTO；api / worker / jobs entry card |
| 标明 local result 当前的安全 disposition | 已完成的 entry/application outcome mapping | Accepted / Rejected / Conflict / Waiting / Blocked / Gap / Failed / Unknown | 无 state transition；不替代 domain state | HostLocalReceiptDisposition | Step 8 result DTO；Step 9 mapping；Step 12 error mapping |
| 保持 fresh 与 duplicate stored replay 分层 | application 已判定 fresh result，或已取得同一 public receipt surface 的 actual-duplicate replay input | Fresh / DuplicateReplayed marker | 无 duplicate lookup、reserve、store read 或 result save | HostReceiptReplayKind | Step 7 result port；Step 13 idempotency / replay |
| 安全说明非 positive local result | entry/application 已裁剪的 local classification | opaque public reason code | 无 error construction、无 external body extraction | HostReceiptReason | Step 8 public error/result；Step 12 taxonomy |
| 把四个 shared carrier 作为一份无 body local receipt 输出 | selected channel、mapped disposition、replay status、safe reason | HostLocalReceipt | immutable carrier only；不写 Host Truth、history、outbox、projection、attempt 或 report | HostLocalReceipt | api / worker / jobs concrete result object；application stored-result mapper |

#### 8.8.3 本对象组对象能力到字段 / 函数 / state 映射

| 对象 | 对象能力 | 必需字段 | factory / 构造入口 | 成员函数 | state / classification | 字段来源 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HostReceiptChannel | 区分 receipt 的 operation-side channel | no payload | enum literal selected by future mapper | is_write_side | Command / Consumer / Job | future entry / application operation mapping；不能由 route、topic、job binary 名推断 |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition | 分类 local result 的安全结论 | no payload | enum literal selected by future mapper | requires_reason / is_locally_accepted | eight finite variants | validated entry/application outcome mapping；不由 external callback / timeout / fake 推断 |
| HostReceiptReplayKind | 区分 fresh 与 duplicate stored replay surface | no payload | fresh literal / replay factory | is_duplicate_replay | Fresh / DuplicateReplayed | application result creation or application-confirmed duplicate stored public receipt rehydrate |
| HostReceiptReason | 传递非敏感 local reason | private opaque code | from_local_code / from_persisted_code | as_code | no lifecycle | redacted entry/application classification or stored public receipt surface |
| HostLocalReceipt | 组合 local result、duplicate replay 和安全原因 | channel、disposition、replay、optional reason | from_local_outcome / duplicate_replay_of | is_duplicate_replay / is_locally_accepted | immutable receipt, not a state machine | future API / worker / jobs mapper or application stored-surface rehydrate |

#### 8.8.4 Shared enum and reason contracts

~~~rust
/// Classifies the operation-side channel that produced a local host receipt.
pub enum HostReceiptChannel {
    /// A command entry or internal command use case produced the receipt.
    Command,
    /// An inbound consumer produced the receipt.
    Consumer,
    /// An operations job produced the receipt.
    Job,
}

impl HostReceiptChannel {
    /// Returns whether this channel may enter a local write-side operation path.
    pub fn is_write_side(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies the safe local disposition without asserting any external completion.
pub enum HostLocalReceiptDisposition {
    /// The local boundary accepted the operation and produced an allowed local result.
    Accepted,
    /// The local boundary rejected the input before an allowed operation result was produced.
    Rejected,
    /// The local boundary detected an explicit local conflict.
    Conflict,
    /// The operation is valid but waits for a declared later local or owner-controlled condition.
    Waiting,
    /// A required condition or declared boundary blocks the operation fail-closed.
    Blocked,
    /// A local or cross-boundary contract gap prevents safe progression.
    Gap,
    /// The local operation failed without safely determining an external completion.
    Failed,
    /// The local result cannot be determined safely.
    Unknown,
}

impl HostLocalReceiptDisposition {
    /// Returns whether this disposition requires a body-free local reason.
    pub fn requires_reason(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this is an accepted local result rather than a non-positive disposition.
    pub fn is_locally_accepted(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Distinguishes a newly produced public receipt from a duplicate stored-receipt replay.
pub enum HostReceiptReplayKind {
    /// The local receipt was produced for the current operation execution.
    Fresh,
    /// The duplicate operation re-exposed an application-confirmed stored public surface.
    DuplicateReplayed,
}

impl HostReceiptReplayKind {
    /// Returns whether this receipt is a duplicate stored-receipt replay.
    pub fn is_duplicate_replay(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Carries a non-sensitive reason code for a non-positive local receipt.
pub struct HostReceiptReason(HostRedactedCode);

impl HostReceiptReason {
    /// Wraps a local reason code that has already passed the host redaction boundary.
    pub fn from_local_code(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a previously stored public receipt reason after persisted-safe-code validation.
    pub fn from_persisted_code(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the opaque public reason code for receipt mapping.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}
~~~

| 类型 / variant | Rustdoc 语义 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 | 明确不表示 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HostReceiptChannel::Command | command entry 或已继承 command authority 的 internal use case 形成 receipt | future API command mapper / application command result mapper | HostLocalReceipt.channel；Step 8 command result DTO | Query、HTTP route、Runtime action 或 external command accepted |
| HostReceiptChannel::Consumer | inbound consumer item 形成 receipt | future worker consumer mapper | HostLocalReceipt.channel；Step 8 consumer result DTO | source message delivered、source fact current、external feedback accepted |
| HostReceiptChannel::Job | persisted operations work run 形成 receipt | future jobs mapper | HostLocalReceipt.channel；Step 8 job result DTO | job run state、scheduler acceptance、lease acquired、job report completed |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::Accepted | local boundary returned an allowed local result | completed entry/application outcome mapping | HostLocalReceipt.disposition | Host Truth state、external effect, delivery, observation or acceptance |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::Rejected | input did not pass the local boundary | structural / policy / metadata result later mapped by owning entry | HostLocalReceipt.disposition；future entry response | external owner rejected, authorization truth, or protected object existence |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::Conflict | explicit local current-fact, generation, expected-version, or key-reuse conflict | application / entry conflict mapping | HostLocalReceipt.disposition | a new duplicate decision, external conflict, or automatic retry authority |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::Waiting | valid local operation is held for a declared later condition | application outcome mapping | HostLocalReceipt.disposition | external action dispatched, schedule registered, or eventual completion |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::Blocked | fail-closed prerequisite or boundary prevents progression | required-source / contract / availability mapping | HostLocalReceipt.disposition | source absence as object non-existence, fallback permission, or ready |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::Gap | a known local or cross-boundary contract / mapping / feedback gap prevents safe progression | application / entry gap mapping | HostLocalReceipt.disposition | a retry authorization, inferred external receipt, delivery, observation, acceptance, or silent fallback |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::Failed | local operation did not produce its intended local result | redacted entry/application failure mapping | HostLocalReceipt.disposition | Runtime / Member / Sandbox / carrier failure truth or external completed failure |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::Unknown | no safe local conclusion is currently available | unknown-effect / unavailable-result mapping | HostLocalReceipt.disposition | success, retry authorization, replacement key, or external unknown proof |
| HostReceiptReplayKind::Fresh | current local execution formed this public receipt | application result mapper | HostLocalReceipt.replay | unique request, no duplicate, persisted result, or external side effect |
| HostReceiptReplayKind::DuplicateReplayed | application supplied a prior stored public receipt after an actual duplicate determination | application stored-result read after duplicate decision | HostLocalReceipt.replay | a new domain transition, action dispatch, consumer write, job scan, delivery or acceptance |
| HostReceiptReason | body-free reason for a non-positive receipt | `HostRedactedCode` from redacted local mapping / stored public receipt rehydrate | HostLocalReceipt.reason；future public protocol mapping | raw request/event/job body, adapter error, endpoint, credential, external identifier, trace body or report |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HostReceiptChannel::is_write_side() | 声明该 shared channel 均属于非 Query 的 operation-side 分类 | 无 | bool | 三个 variant 都返回 true；不授权写入、不启动 operation。 |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::requires_reason() | 检查是否需要显式安全原因 | 无 | bool | 除 Accepted 外均返回 true；Gap 与 Unknown 不得以空原因被压平。 |
| HostLocalReceiptDisposition::is_locally_accepted() | 检查 disposition 是否是 local accepted | 无 | bool | 仅 Accepted 返回 true；不推断任何 specific truth mutation 或 external result。 |
| HostReceiptReplayKind::is_duplicate_replay() | 检查 public surface 是否来自已经判定的 duplicate replay | 无 | bool | 仅 DuplicateReplayed 返回 true；不查询 idempotency store。 |
| HostReceiptReason::from_local_code(HostRedactedCode) | 封装已裁剪的 local reason code | value 为 `redaction.rs` 的 non-empty public code | HostReceiptReason | move 该 opaque code 进入 wrapper；不从 error text / route / body / timeout 推导 code，也不再接受 raw `String`。 |
| HostReceiptReason::from_persisted_code(HostRedactedCode) | 重建已保存的 public reason | value 为 `HostRedactedCode::from_persisted_public_code(...)` 已验证的 stored public receipt code | HostReceiptReason | move 该 opaque code 进入 wrapper；不读取 source truth、stored result body或 external boundary；不得以未验证 `String` 恢复。 |
| HostReceiptReason::as_code() | 供 future response mapper 使用 | 无 | &str | opaque only；不得解析为 status code、resource id 或 authorization conclusion。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 有限 channel，不含 Query | Query 的 read surface 与 write-side receipt 分离；不得通过新增 Query variant 让 read path 获得 idempotency / result-store 语义。 |
| local classification 不是 domain state | disposition 不取代 intent、decision、readiness、host lifecycle、attempt、session、health、closure、outbox、handoff 或 projection 的 state enum。 |
| replay 不等于 duplicate 计算 | DuplicateReplayed 只能由 application 已完成 duplicate / stored-surface lookup 后映射；contracts factory 不接受 idempotency key、digest、request body、message id、run id 或 store handle。 |
| reason 不是 error taxonomy | HostReceiptReason 只传递安全代码；protocol error、retry policy、dead-letter、transport mapping 和 error priority 留 Step 8 / 12 / 13。 |
| no external conclusion | local receipt / reason / replay 都不能表达 external dispatch receipt、execution completed、cleanup completed、delivery、observation、acceptance、Runtime run or Member report truth。 |

#### 8.8.5 HostLocalReceipt object contract

~~~rust
/// Carries one immutable body-free local operation result without external completion semantics.
pub struct HostLocalReceipt {
    /// Operation-side channel that produced this local receipt.
    pub channel: HostReceiptChannel,
    /// Safe local result classification.
    pub disposition: HostLocalReceiptDisposition,
    /// Whether this public receipt is fresh or replayed after duplicate stored-result lookup.
    pub replay: HostReceiptReplayKind,
    /// Required body-free reason for every non-positive disposition.
    pub reason: Option<HostReceiptReason>,
}

impl HostLocalReceipt {
    /// Creates a fresh local receipt from an already mapped operation outcome.
    pub fn from_local_outcome(
        channel: HostReceiptChannel,
        disposition: HostLocalReceiptDisposition,
        reason: Option<HostReceiptReason>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Re-exposes a prior valid public receipt after application-confirmed duplicate stored-result replay.
    pub fn duplicate_replay_of(prior: &HostLocalReceipt) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether this public receipt was replayed after duplicate determination.
    pub fn is_duplicate_replay(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether the local boundary accepted the operation result.
    pub fn is_locally_accepted(&self) -> bool;
}
~~~

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| channel | HostReceiptChannel | 区分 Command、Consumer、Job 的 shared result category | 由 future owning entry / application operation mapper 显式选择；不得从 route、topic、job binary、timer 或 adapter name猜测。 |
| disposition | HostLocalReceiptDisposition | 表达当前 local result 的有限分类 | 只来自已映射 entry/application outcome 或已验证 stored public receipt；不从 external receipt、timeout、signal、fake 或 adapter availability 推断。 |
| replay | HostReceiptReplayKind | 表明结果是 fresh 还是 duplicate-replayed public surface | fresh path 由 from_local_outcome 固定为 Fresh；duplicate replay path 只由 application-confirmed stored local surface 使用。 |
| reason | Option<HostReceiptReason> | 为 non-positive disposition 提供安全解释 | Accepted 必须为 None；Rejected / Conflict / Waiting / Blocked / Gap / Failed / Unknown 必须为 Some；只保存 redacted public code。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HostLocalReceipt::from_local_outcome(HostReceiptChannel, HostLocalReceiptDisposition, Option<HostReceiptReason>) | 构造 fresh local result carrier | channel、已映射 disposition、可选安全原因 | Result<HostLocalReceipt, ContractError> | 仅接受 Accepted + None 或 non-positive + Some reason；固定 replay 为 Fresh；不执行 command / consumer / job、不写任何 local record。 |
| HostLocalReceipt::duplicate_replay_of(&HostLocalReceipt) | 从已有 public receipt 形成 duplicate-replayed surface | prior 必须已经满足本类型字段不变量，且只能由 application duplicate / stored-result mapper 交给该 factory | Result<HostLocalReceipt, ContractError> | 复制 channel / disposition / reason 并固定 replay 为 DuplicateReplayed；不做 duplicate lookup、digest compare、result-store read、domain transition、outbox publish或 job scan。 |
| HostLocalReceipt::is_duplicate_replay() | 判断是否 duplicate-replayed public surface | 无 | bool | 委托 replay marker；不判断 duplicate key 或 stored-result availability。 |
| HostLocalReceipt::is_locally_accepted() | 判断 local result 是否为 Accepted | 无 | bool | 委托 disposition；不说明 host / action / external owner state。 |

| factory / 使用场景 | 允许输入来源 | 不可构造或必须 fail-closed 的情况 | 明确禁止的替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| from_local_outcome | API / worker / jobs future mapper 已得到的 redacted local outcome；application mapper 已返回的 local result | 缺 channel、disposition 与 required reason，或 Query 试图构造 receipt 时不得形成 carrier；Gap 与 Unknown 必须保持不同 disposition；entry-specific rejection / error mapping 留所属 entry crate | raw request/event/job body、route、topic、run id、request id、trace id、clock、timeout、fake counter、adapter error text、external receipt |
| duplicate_replay_of | application 已确认 actual duplicate / completed result 并读取到同一 body-free stored public receipt surface | duplicate decision没有 stored public receipt、stored surface wrong kind、原因被破坏或结果不完整时不得重跑 operation；后续必须由 Step 7 / 13 形成 missing-result error path | IdempotencyKey 裸输入、payload hash、new receipt id、重新调用 domain、重新 dispatch / publish / cleanup / scan |
| public protocol mapping | future Step 8 DTO 选择明确 operation-specific result fields后嵌入或并列本 carrier | exact DTO、error code、route、envelope、callback / receipt schema 未闭口时只能 pending / blocked / fail-closed | ad hoc JSON、entry-private map、domain object、external body、product response model |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| immutable result carrier | receipt 不拥有生成、保存、更新或删除；它不能写 Host Truth、history、material、outbox、projection、attempt、association、session、finding、case或 report。 |
| no result reference here | 本类型不含 operation name、request digest、idempotency key、reservation state、application result id/ref、stored surface ref、store handle或 expected version；这些仍必须由 application / port 在 Step 6后续模块、Step 7、11、13 关闭。 |
| no entry state here | 不含 API handler state / route、worker loop state / source envelope、job run state / run id / report；它们必须各自留给 api、worker、jobs，不能以 shared receipt 偷渡。 |
| no result escalation | Accepted、Fresh、DuplicateReplayed、reason presence 或 absence都不能推出 external action dispatch / acceptance / completion、cleanup completion、delivery、observation、acceptance、Runtime session/run、Member registration / report 或 Sandbox outcome。 |
| gap and unknown preserve different fences | Gap 表示已知的 contract / mapping / feedback gap；Unknown 表示当前不能安全判断结果。二者都不授权重放、换 key、replace generation、自动 retry、写 ready 或清除 local gap；后续 Step 12 / 13 / job flow 必须分别明确 hold / reconciliation。 |

#### 8.8.6 6.1-d 解释与构造资格审计

| 审计问题 | 结论 |
|---|---|
| public receipt 是否有唯一 crate / module / file owner？ | 是。五个 shared carrier 全部归 contracts/src/receipts.rs；views.rs 不承接 write-side result，metadata.rs 不承接 disposition，errors.rs 只在后续定义 error taxonomy。 |
| 是否把 API、worker、jobs 的 entry-private result 偷迁入 contracts？ | 否。shared channel 只保留三类分类；route、entry id、source envelope、worker loop、job run、report、lease、batch、retry、validation issue 都继续由相应 entry module拥有。 |
| 是否把 application stored-result / idempotency owner 偷迁入 contracts？ | 否。没有 operation name、digest、key、reservation、result ref、stored surface ref或 store API；DuplicateReplayed 只是 application 已完成 duplicate 判断后的公共表面标记。 |
| receipt 是否误写为 external completion？ | 否。Accepted / DuplicateReplayed / Gap / Failed / Unknown 全部只在 local-result layer；Runtime、Member、Images、Sandbox、Bus / downstream feedback 继续只能用正式 safe outcome / callback contract承接。 |
| Query no-write 是否保持？ | 是。HostReceiptChannel 不含 Query；query read surface继续使用 visibility / freshness / degraded / unavailable carrier。 |
| 字段来源是否闭合？ | 是，全部字段只能来自 future entry/application mapped local outcome 或 application-confirmed stored public receipt rehydrate；无法获得时必须 fail-closed或以 future entry non-positive path处置，不得临时拼值。 |
| Step 7~13 是否仍有明确承接？ | 是。Step 7 定义 result / idempotency port，Step 8 定义具体 protocol DTO，Step 9 定义 mapping flow，Step 12 定义 errors，Step 13 定义 duplicate / replay / unknown fence；本批没有越级定义。 |

#### 8.8.7 6.1-d 对象组停审记录

| 审查项 | 结论 | 缺口 / 修正 |
|---|---|---|
| unique schema owner | pass | HostReceiptChannel、HostLocalReceiptDisposition、HostReceiptReplayKind、HostReceiptReason 与 HostLocalReceipt 均只属于 planned contracts/src/receipts.rs。 |
| capability / object coverage | pass | command、consumer、job 的 shared local-result / fresh-replay / safe-reason需求均有 carrier；没有新增 Host Truth 主语或第 30 个业务对象。 |
| local versus external outcome layering | pass_with_upstream_blockers | receipt 只表达 local result；Runtime / Member / Images / Sandbox / Core / Bus exact receipt、callback、delivery / observation / acceptance 合同仍 pending。 |
| application ownership preserved | pass | duplicate determination、canonical digest、reservation、stored result identity / surface和 save/get/missing behavior仍不在 contracts。 |
| entry ownership preserved | pass | api、worker、jobs 的 concrete entry state / disposition / result仍延后到各模块；本批不定义 route、envelope、run、report或 loop state。 |
| replay safety | pass | DuplicateReplayed 只能由 application-confirmed actual duplicate stored public receipt形成；missing / wrong stored result 禁止重新执行 command、consumer write、external action、publish、cleanup或 job scan。 |
| query boundary | pass | no Query channel、no read-result reuse、no write metadata / idempotency carrier。 |
| body-free / blocker fidelity | pass_with_upstream_blockers | reason只允许 non-sensitive code；local receipt、fake、timeout、observed signal或 adapter availability未被当作 positive cross-owner evidence。 |
| contracts module completion | not_yet | external safe reference / redaction / shared error carrier和 Step 8 protocol DTO前置共享项仍待审计；只能继续 contracts 的后续对象组，不得进入 domain 或创建 Step 7。 |

6.1-d 对象组停审结论：completed / pass_with_upstream_blockers。允许在下一次经停审恢复后继续 contracts 的剩余 shared carrier 范围审计；不允许进入 domain 或创建 Step 7。

### 8.9 `6.1-e-a`：shared construction error、redaction 与 forbidden-body baseline

#### 8.9.1 本对象组写入边界

| 项 | 本批结论 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 owner | `ContractError` 的唯一 schema owner 是 planned `crates/contracts/src/errors.rs`；`HostRedactedCode`、`HostRedactionProfileRef`、`HostForbiddenBodyClass` 与 `HostForbiddenBodyClassSet` 的唯一 schema owner 是 planned `crates/contracts/src/redaction.rs`。`refs.rs` 只消费这些类型，不重新定义 code / profile / body-class 或 construction error。 |
| 问题修正 | 已有 `HostSafeSummaryReason`、`HostVisibilityReason`、`HostReceiptReason` 均是**位置语义不同的薄包装**，而非第二套 redaction 或 error taxonomy：它们唯一可接受的新增输入是 `HostRedactedCode`，存储 rehydrate 也必须先经同一 `HostRedactedCode` 验证。此前直接以 `String` 入参表达“已裁剪”会让 implementation 自行决定校验和 redaction，现已收回。 |
| `ContractError` 上限 | 只承接 shared carrier 的结构不变量失败：空 public code / ref、错误的 owner-role、重复或无序 set、无效 field-marker 组合、错误的 persisted-safe-code input。它不承接 domain transition / policy guard、application operation / idempotency、infra adapter、API / worker / jobs entry 或 public protocol error。 |
| redaction 上限 | `HostRedactedCode` 仅表示已经通过本仓 redaction mapping 的**非空 opaque public code**；不得包含 free text、raw cause、endpoint、credential、image / manifest、Member / Runtime / Sandbox / carrier / Bus / observability body，也不得被解析为 resource identity、authorization conclusion、operation name、transport status 或 retry policy。 |
| profile 与 baseline 分层 | `HostRedactionProfileRef` 只回指形成 material / history / public summary 时采用的已验证 profile；它不拥有 Governance policy truth，不能成为 allow / deny token，也不能携带 profile body。`HostForbiddenBodyClassSet::mandatory_baseline()` 是本仓不可配置移除的安全下限；04 可绑定 profile / adapter 参数，但不能删除或放宽该下限。 |
| 跨仓上限 | exact Member / Runtime / Images / Sandbox / Core / Bus schema 仍由 `MSVC-UP-001~008` 挂起。本批的 class 只表达“不得进入本仓 public / material body”的抽象类别，绝不将任何 sibling ref、route、envelope、receipt、body 或 error taxonomy伪造成 ready。 |
| 不在本批定义 | 不定义 public `HostProtocolError`、HTTP / RPC status、consumer dead-letter、retryability、entry error priority、trace / diagnostic body、external error converter、profile content、policy version、redaction algorithm 或 config key；分别留 Step 8、Step 12、Step 14 与 04。 |

#### 8.9.2 语义去重与构造边界审计

| 概念 | 唯一 owner / 类型 | 可表达 | 明确不可表达 | 与相邻类型的关系 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| shared construction failure | `errors.rs` / `ContractError` | 当前 factory / helper 的结构不变量为何未满足 | domain business rejection、authorization、external failure、public transport status、retryability | 所有 contracts factory 可返回；Step 8 / 12 以后才由 owning mapper 显式分类。 |
| redacted code | `redaction.rs` / `HostRedactedCode` | 一个已验证的 opaque public code | 原始 reason、error text、external identifier、resource body、policy body | 是三类 public reason 的唯一 fresh / persisted input carrier。 |
| safe-summary reason | `refs.rs` / `HostSafeSummaryReason` | 已公开 summary / gap / freshness / availability 的位置语义 | visibility denial 或 command / consumer / job receipt outcome | private wrapper over `HostRedactedCode` value；不是 `ContractError`。 |
| visibility reason | `refs.rs` / `HostVisibilityReason` | not-visible / redacted public read surface 的位置语义 | protected existence、authorization truth、summary degradation、write result | private wrapper over `HostRedactedCode` value；不是 `HostSafeSummaryReason` 或 protocol error。 |
| receipt reason | `receipts.rs` / `HostReceiptReason` | non-positive local command / consumer / job result 的位置语义 | duplicate calculation、stored-result identity、domain / external outcome | private wrapper over `HostRedactedCode` value；不是 entry-private disposition 或 `ContractError`。 |
| forbidden-body baseline | `redaction.rs` / `HostForbiddenBodyClassSet` | required body exclusion categories | redaction decision、profile content、external owner state | validates material/history/public-surface input; does not itself redact or persist truth. |

结论：`HostSafeSummaryReason`、`HostVisibilityReason` 与 `HostReceiptReason` 不应合并为一个泛化 `HostReason`，因为它们分别受 summary/view/receipt 的字段组合、泄露和 mapping 约束；但它们不再各自拥有 raw-string validation。`ContractError` 也不得吸收三类 reason，避免 factory failure 与可公开业务解释混同。

#### 8.9.3 本对象组 capability 到对象映射

| 功能 / capability | 输入 | 输出 | 状态 / 副作用 | 所属对象 | 后续 Step 承接 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 拒绝 malformed shared carrier | factory 输入的 static field role、closed enum、opaque text、set member | `ContractError` | 无 truth write、无 public response | `ContractError` | Step 7 port/fake validation；Step 8 / 12 explicit error mapper |
| 形成唯一 public-safe code | application redaction mapper 已给出 bounded safe code，或 local public persistence 已保存该 code | `HostRedactedCode` | 无 reason classification、无 policy evaluation | `HostRedactedCode` | `HostSafe*Reason`、`HostVisibilityReason`、`HostReceiptReason`；Step 7 redaction port |
| 回指已验证 redaction profile | application 已验证的 profile identity 或 local material/history rehydrate | `HostRedactionProfileRef` | 无 profile load / policy write | `HostRedactionProfileRef` | Step 6 domain material/history cards；Step 14 / 04 binding |
| 锁定不可放宽的 body exclusion | fixed mandatory classes；object-level caller can test membership | `HostForbiddenBodyClass(Set)` | no redaction execution、no truth write | class enum / set | Step 6 material/history cards；Step 7 validator port；Step 12 failure mapping |
| 将已裁剪 code 放入不同 public surface | validated `HostRedactedCode` | summary / visibility / receipt reason wrapper | 无 field selection / visibility / receipt decision | existing three reason wrappers | Step 8 DTO / Step 9 mapper; no direct raw string path |

#### 8.9.4 本对象组对象能力到字段 / 函数 / state 映射

| 对象 | 对象能力 | 必需字段 | factory / 构造入口 | 成员函数 | state / classification | 字段来源 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ContractError` | 返回 shared construction failure | closed variant payload only | factory return only | `field()` / `set_owner()` pure accessor | non-persisted error enum | contracts factory / validator local checks |
| `HostRedactedCode` | 承载 non-empty opaque public code | private canonical code | `from_redaction_boundary` / `from_persisted_public_code` | `as_code()` | no lifecycle | application redaction output or persisted public-safe field |
| `HostRedactionProfileRef` | 回指 applied profile identity | private opaque ref | `from_validated_profile_ref` / `from_persisted` | `as_str()` | no lifecycle | validated application profile binding or local material/history rehydrate |
| `HostForbiddenBodyClass` | 有限分类永不进入 public/material body 的类别 | no payload | enum literal | `is_mandatory()` | closed taxonomy | fixed member-service boundary red line |
| `HostForbiddenBodyClassSet` | 承载 deterministic mandatory exclusion set | ordered-unique classes | `mandatory_baseline` / `try_new` | `contains()` / `as_slice()` | no lifecycle | fixed complete baseline；新增类别必须回写本 Step 的 closed enum 与 baseline |
| existing reason wrappers | 给 specific public surface 赋予 already-redacted code | private `String` value | updated `from_*` / persisted factories | `as_code` / `as_str` | no lifecycle | only `HostRedactedCode`; no raw string fresh input |

##### `ContractError`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Reports a structural failure while constructing a member-service public contract carrier.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum ContractError {
    /// A required opaque public text value is empty after trimming.
    EmptyPublicText {
        /// Stable name of the affected contract field.
        field: &'static str,
    },
    /// A supplied external-safe reference has no opaque value after trimming.
    EmptyExternalSafeRef {
        /// Stable role of the affected external-safe reference.
        field: &'static str,
    },
    /// A role-specific external-safe wrapper received an incompatible closed reference role.
    ExternalSafeRefRoleMismatch {
        /// Stable name of the wrapper that rejected the reference.
        carrier: &'static str,
        /// Stable expected closed role name; never an external owner value.
        expected_role: &'static str,
        /// Stable actual closed role name; never an external owner value.
        actual_role: &'static str,
    },
    /// A persisted public code cannot be rehydrated as a safe opaque code.
    InvalidPersistedPublicCode {
        /// Stable name of the persisted public-code field.
        field: &'static str,
    },
    /// A closed carrier combination violates its stated structural invariant.
    InvalidCarrierCombination {
        /// Stable owner of the failed carrier combination.
        owner: &'static str,
    },
    /// An ordered contract set contains the same closed member more than once.
    DuplicateContractSetMember {
        /// Stable owner of the ordered-unique set.
        owner: &'static str,
    },
    /// An ordered contract set does not retain the canonical order required by its owner.
    NonCanonicalContractSetOrder {
        /// Stable owner of the ordered set.
        owner: &'static str,
    },
}

impl ContractError {
    /// Returns the static field name when this failure is tied to one contract field.
    pub fn field(&self) -> Option<&'static str>;

    /// Returns the static owner name when this failure is tied to one carrier or set invariant.
    pub fn set_owner(&self) -> Option<&'static str>;
}
```

| variant | Rustdoc 语义 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 | 明确不表示 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `EmptyPublicText` | `A required opaque public text value is empty after trimming.` | `HostRedactedCode`、profile ref、reason / cursor / opaque wrapper factory 的 local structural validation | factory return；future explicit mapper | raw input echo、public validation status、domain reject、external absence |
| `EmptyExternalSafeRef` | `A supplied external-safe reference has no opaque value after trimming.` | `6.1-e-b` external-safe ref factory local validation | factory return；future explicit mapper | external object missing、owner rejected、sibling contract unavailable |
| `ExternalSafeRefRoleMismatch` | `A role-specific external-safe wrapper received an incompatible closed reference role.` | `6.1-e-b` typed wrapper structural validation | factory return；future explicit mapper | external object absent、owner / adapter failure、contract ready、external completion |
| `InvalidPersistedPublicCode` | `A persisted public code cannot be rehydrated as a safe opaque code.` | public-safe persistence mapper / rehydrate factory | factory return；future data-integrity mapper | raw stored text、external error body、redaction success |
| `InvalidCarrierCombination` | `A closed carrier combination violates its stated structural invariant.` | `HostSafeSlice`、view marker、receipt、metadata or redaction set factory | factory return；future explicit mapper | domain transition failure、retry decision、public protocol category |
| `DuplicateContractSetMember` | `An ordered contract set contains the same closed member more than once.` | `HostForbiddenBodyClassSet::try_new` and future closed contract sets | factory return；Step 7 fake parity | automatic dedup, choice of one member, truth conflict |
| `NonCanonicalContractSetOrder` | `An ordered contract set does not retain the canonical order required by its owner.` | future ordered-unique carrier factory only | factory return；Step 7 fake parity | time/order of external events, repository order, broker offset |

`6.1-g` 复用上述 `ContractError` 的 structural validation surface；不新增 qualification-specific external error taxonomy。所有 ordered-unique set factory 都必须在调用方传入已声明的 canonical order 时执行 duplicate / order 检查；本批不定义排序算法或从 external arrival order 推导 canonical order。

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ContractError::field()` | 取得 field-scoped diagnostic identity | 无 | `Option<&'static str>` | 只返回 static contract field name；绝不返回 raw value、route、payload、secret、endpoint或 external ref。 |
| `ContractError::set_owner()` | 取得 carrier / set-scoped diagnostic identity | 无 | `Option<&'static str>` | 只返回 static owner name；不暴露 adapter、store、SDK、broker或 sibling implementation identity。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| not an error taxonomy | `ContractError` 不含 `message`、`raw_value`、`source_error`、`backtrace`、status code、retryable flag、external owner kind或 generic `Internal`。这些分别属于受控内部 diagnostics、Step 8 protocol、Step 12 recovery 和 owning layer。 |
| no wildcard public mapper | Step 8 / 12 若把某 variant 映射成 public result，必须按 protocol family 显式列穷尽映射；不得以 `_ => Failed`、`Internal` 或 `HostReceiptReason` 静默吞掉新 variant。`ExternalSafeRefRoleMismatch` 只说明本地 wrapper 组合错误，绝不转换为“对端不存在 / 完成 / ready”。 |
| no truth mutation | contracts factory failure 不创建 / 修改 Host Truth、history、outbox、stored result、idempotency reservation、attempt、session、cleanup 或 handoff。 |

##### `HostRedactedCode`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries one non-empty opaque public code after the member-service redaction boundary.
pub struct HostRedactedCode(String);

impl HostRedactedCode {
    /// Creates a safe public code from an already validated redaction-boundary output.
    pub fn from_redaction_boundary(value: String) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Rehydrates a public code that was previously stored only on a public-safe surface.
    pub fn from_persisted_public_code(value: String) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the opaque code for a position-specific public reason wrapper.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `String` | 唯一 canonical public-safe code representation | non-empty after trim；由 application redaction mapper 的 bounded code output 或已经只保存 public-safe code 的 local persistence rehydrate 形成；不接受 raw external / adapter / policy / error / report text。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_redaction_boundary(String)` | 接收 redaction mapper 已形成的 bounded public code | `value` 是 mapper output，不是 raw error / body | `Result<HostRedactedCode, ContractError>` | trim 后空值返回 `EmptyPublicText { field: "host_redacted_code" }`；不自行 redact、template、hash、parse或访问 profile body。 |
| `from_persisted_public_code(String)` | 重新验证已保存的 public code | `value` 只可来自本仓 public-safe projection / receipt / material/history safe field rehydrate | `Result<HostRedactedCode, ContractError>` | trim 后空值返回 `InvalidPersistedPublicCode { field: "host_redacted_code" }`；不从 raw source record、adapter log或 external body恢复。 |
| `as_code()` | 为 position-specific wrapper 提供 opaque code | 无 | `&str` | caller 不得解析为 status、resource ref、authorization conclusion、operation selector、retry hint或 external outcome。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| mapping before construction | `from_redaction_boundary` 的调用资格仅属于 future application redaction mapper 或已验证 mapper output 的 test fixture；contracts、domain、infra adapter、api/worker/jobs entry、repository和 fake 都不得以 raw `String` 直接假称经过 redaction。 |
| no profile execution | 该类型不加载 profile、不决定哪些 fields 可见、不删除字段、不覆盖 `HostForbiddenBodyClassSet`；它只是 mapper 已完成裁剪后的 code carrier。 |
| not a generic reason | 不直接进入 public DTO、domain object或 entry response。它必须被 `HostSafeSummaryReason`、`HostVisibilityReason`、`HostReceiptReason` 或后续 exact protocol-specific wrapper消耗，避免跨 surface 误用。 |

##### `HostRedactionProfileRef`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// References the already validated redaction profile applied to one member-service safe surface.
pub struct HostRedactionProfileRef(String);

impl HostRedactionProfileRef {
    /// Creates an opaque profile reference from a validated application binding.
    pub fn from_validated_profile_ref(value: String) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted opaque profile reference without loading the profile body.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the opaque profile reference only for typed mapping and audit correlation.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `String` | 已应用 redaction profile 的 opaque identity | application validated binding 或 local material/history rehydrate；non-empty；不保存 profile rule、policy body、approval、secret、endpoint或 external config。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_validated_profile_ref(String)` | 封装已验证 profile binding identity | `value` 是 application binding output | `Result<HostRedactionProfileRef, ContractError>` | empty -> `EmptyPublicText { field: "host_redaction_profile_ref" }`；不验证 profile effective / current / authorized。 |
| `from_persisted(String)` | 重建历史已应用 profile ref | `value` 是 material / history 已保存 opaque ref | `Result<HostRedactionProfileRef, ContractError>` | empty -> `EmptyPublicText { field: "host_redaction_profile_ref" }`；不加载 profile 或重放 redaction。 |
| `as_str()` | 提供 typed audit correlation value | 无 | `&str` | 不得用于 profile lookup、policy authorization、config selection或 public display。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| profile ref is not profile truth | profile content、owner、version、approval、effective rule 和 configuration binding 在本批不定义；profile ref 存在不表示 source is ready、policy permits、material is accepted 或 any external owner confirmed。 |
| no safety downgrade | 04 / future binding 只能选择经本仓设计允许的 profile mapping；不得因为 ref 缺失、adapter unavailable、fake、timeout 或 configuration 把 mandatory forbidden-body class 移除。缺 ref 时由 owning domain/application path fail closed / gap，不能发明 default profile。 |

##### `HostForbiddenBodyClass` 与 `HostForbiddenBodyClassSet`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Classifies one body category that must never enter a member-service public or material surface.
pub enum HostForbiddenBodyClass {
    /// Secret, credential, token, key, or equivalent authentication material.
    SecretOrCredential,
    /// Raw endpoint, transport address, connection detail, or backend locator.
    RawEndpointOrTransport,
    /// Image content, manifest, build, provenance, or variant body.
    ImageOrBuildBody,
    /// Member-owned launch, registration, heartbeat, status, or report body.
    MemberOwnedBody,
    /// Runtime-owned session, run, turn, goal, plan, memory, checkpoint, or outcome body.
    RuntimeOwnedBody,
    /// Sandbox-owned policy, backend, binding, capture, execution, or cleanup body.
    SandboxOwnedBody,
    /// Carrier, registry, container, orchestration-platform, or backend provider body.
    CarrierOrBackendBody,
    /// Bus route, envelope, receipt, feedback, or downstream acceptance body.
    BusOrDownstreamBody,
    /// Observability backend event, metric, trace, evidence, or report body.
    ObservabilityBody,
    /// Raw external error, provider response, diagnostic, stack, or free-text report body.
    RawExternalOrDiagnosticBody,
}

impl HostForbiddenBodyClass {
    /// Returns whether this class belongs to the mandatory member-service exclusion baseline.
    pub fn is_mandatory(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Carries a canonical ordered-unique set of forbidden body classes.
pub struct HostForbiddenBodyClassSet(Vec<HostForbiddenBodyClass>);

impl HostForbiddenBodyClassSet {
    /// Returns the non-empty mandatory baseline that no configuration or profile may weaken.
    pub fn mandatory_baseline() -> Self;

    /// Creates a canonical ordered-unique set that must contain every mandatory class.
    pub fn try_new(items: Vec<HostForbiddenBodyClass>) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether a body class is forbidden by this set.
    pub fn contains(&self, class: HostForbiddenBodyClass) -> bool;

    /// Returns the canonical ordered classes without allowing mutation of the set.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[HostForbiddenBodyClass];
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SecretOrCredential` | `Secret, credential, token, key, or equivalent authentication material.` | 禁止 secret / credential body | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |
| `RawEndpointOrTransport` | `Raw endpoint, transport address, connection detail, or backend locator.` | 禁止 endpoint / transport detail | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |
| `ImageOrBuildBody` | `Image content, manifest, build, provenance, or variant body.` | 禁止 Images truth body | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |
| `MemberOwnedBody` | `Member-owned launch, registration, heartbeat, status, or report body.` | 禁止 Member truth body | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |
| `RuntimeOwnedBody` | `Runtime-owned session, run, turn, goal, plan, memory, checkpoint, or outcome body.` | 禁止 Runtime truth body | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |
| `SandboxOwnedBody` | `Sandbox-owned policy, backend, binding, capture, execution, or cleanup body.` | 禁止 Sandbox truth body | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |
| `CarrierOrBackendBody` | `Carrier, registry, container, orchestration-platform, or backend provider body.` | 禁止 host backend truth body | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |
| `BusOrDownstreamBody` | `Bus route, envelope, receipt, feedback, or downstream acceptance body.` | 禁止 transport / downstream truth body | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |
| `ObservabilityBody` | `Observability backend event, metric, trace, evidence, or report body.` | 禁止 observability backend truth | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |
| `RawExternalOrDiagnosticBody` | `Raw external error, provider response, diagnostic, stack, or free-text report body.` | 禁止 raw provider / diagnostic body | fixed baseline | material/history/public-surface validator |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `is_mandatory()` | 查询 closed class 是否属于 mandatory baseline | 无 | `bool` | 所有当前 variant 均返回 true；不读取 configuration / profile。 |
| `mandatory_baseline()` | 形成 canonical baseline | 无 | `HostForbiddenBodyClassSet` | 返回全部十个 class，按 enum declaration order；不依赖 config、adapter、clock、feature flag 或 external response。 |
| `try_new(Vec<HostForbiddenBodyClass>)` | 验证一个 persisted 或明确传入的 complete baseline set | items | `Result<HostForbiddenBodyClassSet, ContractError>` | 当前 closed enum 的十个 variant 全部 mandatory；空集、缺任一 baseline class、duplicate 或非 declaration-order 输入均返回 `InvalidCarrierCombination` / `DuplicateContractSetMember` / `NonCanonicalContractSetOrder`；不自动补、去重、重排或接受未定义类别。 |
| `contains(HostForbiddenBodyClass)` | 查询 class 是否被拒绝 | class | `bool` | pure membership only；不检查实际 body、不过滤 payload。 |
| `as_slice()` | 只读取得 canonical classes | 无 | `&[HostForbiddenBodyClass]` | 调用方不得修改、append、delete 或按外部 taxonomy 重新解释。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| mandatory baseline | ten classes all belong to the baseline；配置、profile、adapter、fake、test fixture、local receipt、timeout 或 sibling readiness 都不得减少集合。需要新增类别时须回写本 Step、扩展 closed enum 与 mandatory baseline，不能以 string extension 添加。 |
| exact closed-set semantics | set 按 enum declaration order stable；禁止重复；在当前 closed enum 下只接受完整 baseline，implementation 不得私自声称“更严格”并加入不可表示的类别。不得 silently sort、dedup、union、intersect或 use `Vec<String>`。 |
| classification is not detection | class / set 不读取或扫描 actual body，也不替代 application redaction mapper、domain material/history validator、security policy或 observability scrubber。它只是这些 owner 必须遵守的 shared input boundary。 |

#### 8.9.5 既有 public reason 修正后的构造资格

| existing wrapper | fresh construction | persisted rehydrate | missing / invalid input | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostSafeSummaryReason` | `HostRedactedCode` from application redaction mapper | `HostRedactedCode::from_persisted_public_code` then `from_persisted_code` | `ContractError` returned before wrapper construction；future owning mapper uses explicit local non-positive surface | raw reason string、adapter error text、gap kind name、profile ref |
| `HostVisibilityReason` | `HostRedactedCode` from resolved visibility / policy mapper after redaction | `HostRedactedCode::from_persisted_public_code` then `from_persisted` | `ContractError` before wrapper construction；no fallback to `NotVisible` / `Redacted` marker without a valid reason | policy body、protected label、actor id、route、resource existence |
| `HostReceiptReason` | `HostRedactedCode` from entry/application local-outcome mapper | `HostRedactedCode::from_persisted_public_code` then `from_persisted_code` | `ContractError` before receipt factory; invalid reason cannot be silently replaced with `Failed` / `Unknown` or raw text | raw command / event / job body、timeout text、adapter error、stored-result body |

`HostLocalReceipt::from_local_outcome` 和 `duplicate_replay_of` 的既有 `Result<_, ContractError>` 因此可以穷尽承接 reason-wrapper construction failure；它们仍不得以 `ContractError` 判定 duplicate、写 result store、返回 external failure 或自行形成 entry disposition。

#### 8.9.6 `6.1-e-a` 对象组停审记录

| 审查项 | 结论 | 缺口 / 修正 |
|---|---|---|
| `ContractError` unique owner | pass | 所有当前 public carrier factory 的 shared structural failure 统一归 `contracts/src/errors.rs`；不再让各 carrier 的 `Result<_, ContractError>` 引用未定义 error。 |
| reason / error semantic de-duplication | pass_after_correction | summary / visibility / receipt wrappers 保留 location-specific semantics，但 fresh/persisted raw-string path 已改为唯一 `HostRedactedCode` boundary；不创建泛化 `HostReason`。 |
| redaction owner and safety baseline | pass | `HostRedactedCode`、profile ref、ten-class mandatory baseline和 ordered-set rules 均归 `contracts/src/redaction.rs`；04 不得削弱。 |
| external truth / body ceiling | pass_with_upstream_blockers | class 只表达 body exclusion，不引入 Member / Runtime / Images / Sandbox / Bus exact body或 schema；`MSVC-UP-001~008` 仍 pending。 |
| application / domain / entry owner preserved | pass | redaction mapping、profile validation、material/history validation和 protocol / error mapping未迁入 contracts；contracts只定义 carrier / local structural checks。 |
| future fake parity | pass | Step 7 fake 只可按 `ContractError` exact variant、redacted-code validation、baseline class order and set rules复现；不得以 raw string / private map / config bypass。 |
| next object group | completed_by_sequence | `6.1-e-b` 已完成并停审；下一动作仅为 contracts 模块最终审计，不得进入 domain 或创建 Step 7。 |

`6.1-e-a` 对象组停审结论：`completed / pass_with_upstream_blockers`。允许继续 `contracts` 的 `6.1-e-b` externally-owned safe-reference support；不允许进入 `domain` 或创建 Step 7。

### 8.10 `6.1-e-b`：externally-owned safe-reference、source-version 与 safe-summary support

#### 8.10.1 本对象组写入边界

| 项 | 本批结论 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 owner | 全部基础载体及角色薄包装的唯一 schema owner 是 planned `member-service-contracts` 的 `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`。`domain` 只在自己的 truth record 中使用强类型包装；`application` 只负责正式 mapper、选择、matching 与 fail-closed disposition；`infra` 只翻译 port / persistence / fake seam；api、worker、jobs 不得私造同义 `String` / JSON / product type。 |
| 本批责任 | 闭合本仓能够安全保存、回链和传递的 externally-owned reference、source-side version、source-side captured time、redacted safe summary 及其 role-specific wrapper。它们只表达“某个 owner-safe opaque carrier 已被本仓接受为引用或摘要输入”，不表达 owner 的对象存在、生命周期、权限、策略、传输、接收或完成事实。 |
| 必须覆盖的使用位置 | `HostQualificationContext` source entry；`HostActionAttempt` / `HostExternalAssociation` 的 target、association 与 outcome；`HostRegistration` credential / Member source；`HostEndpoint`、`HostSession` 的 Member / Runtime association；`HealthSignalSnapshot` source；`CleanupAttempt` / `ResidualFinding` 的 target / safe observation；`HostHandoffRecord` 的 target、delivery / observation / acceptance；`HostOutboxRecord` 的 submission-safe summary。具体 domain 字段、状态和行为仍在后续 `domain` object group 闭合。 |
| 仍不拥有 | 不定义 L1-identity / L1-work member or project truth；不定义 L2-member launch / register / heartbeat / status DTO；不定义 L2-runtime session / run / execution handoff；不定义 L2-member-images manifest / digest / verification；不定义 L4-sandbox policy / backend / bind / release / cleanup truth；不定义 Core / Bus route、envelope、receipt、event version 或 SDK target。 |
| 与 metadata placeholder 的边界 | `HostInboundSourceRefPlaceholder`、`HostInboundMessageIdPlaceholder`、`HostInboundTimeAnchor`、`HostInboundReplayInput` 与 `HostOperationsJobMetadataPlaceholder` 仍只属于 `metadata.rs` 的未闭口 entry input；本批不得把它们转换、别名或升级为正式 external ref / source version / summary。外部 envelope 正式闭口前，consumer 只能在 mapper 已给出本批 carrier 时保存本地 safe input，否则 held / gap / rejected。 |
| 与 redaction 的边界 | `HostExternalSafeSummary` 只能接收 `HostRedactedCode`，因而无法以 raw error / diagnostic / endpoint / credential / body 伪装摘要。redaction mapping、summary content selection、profile validation 与 material/history body validation仍不属于本批。 |
| blocker 保真 | `MSVC-UP-001~008` 不因本批的类型闭合而关闭。特别是 Images、Member、Runtime、Sandbox、Core / Bus 的 exact schema 仍是 pending / blocked；类型可构造只说明 local structural carrier 完整，绝不说明双方 contract ready。 |
| 不在本批定义 | 不定义外部 object body、foreign key storage representation、endpoint/credential value、source digest algorithm、external success enum、timeout / retry、protocol error、adapter result、route / topic、payload、receipt、manifest、local state migration、repository CAS 或 view projection。分别留 Step 6 后续模块、Step 7~14。 |

#### 8.10.2 语义去重与不可替代审计

| 概念 | 唯一类型 / owner | 可表达 | 明确不可替代 | 误用后的处置 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 外部安全引用 | `refs.rs` / `HostExternalSafeRef` 及其 role wrapper | 一个已在正式 mapper / safe persistence 边界裁剪过的 opaque external locator | 外部 body、endpoint、credential、local host id、source version、外部完成 | 无对应 role wrapper 或 raw body 输入时 fail-closed；不得退回 `String`。 |
| 外部来源版本 | `refs.rs` / `HostExternalSourceVersionRef` | source owner 声明的 opaque version / revision marker，可缺失 | repository expected version、domain revision、`HostTruthRevision`、projection cursor、generation、message sequence、request digest、timestamp | 缺失只保留 `None` / stale / blocked / unknown 的后续语义；不得由本地值补造。 |
| 外部安全摘要 | `refs.rs` / `HostExternalSafeSummary` + summary wrapper | 对一个已引用外部主体、可选 source version、可选 source captured-at 的已裁剪 classification | raw response / report、adapter availability、local receipt、timeout、source object lifecycle、delivery / observation / acceptance completion | summary kind 或 source role 不匹配时拒绝构造；存在摘要只允许后续 domain 显式 link。 |
| 本地 repository version | future application port + infra store | optimistic lock / compare-and-swap 的本地持久化版本 | source version、domain basis、cursor、generation、key | 留 Step 7 / 11；本批类型不得用于 CAS。 |
| Host Truth read anchor | `views.rs` / `HostTruthRevision` | immutable safe view 所选 committed local truth 的 read anchor | external version、repository version、projection cursor、page cursor | view assembler 不得从 external summary 生成或替换。 |
| projection progress | future `domain::projection` / `CommittedChangeCursor` naming pending | 本地 committed change 被投影消费的顺序位置 | source version、broker offset、generation、page cursor | 保持 02 名称差异 pending；本批不得统一或别名。 |
| instance generation | `refs.rs` / `HostGeneration` | 同一 `ProjectMemberRef` 下 local host instance 的不可变世代 | external resource version、source version、signal sequence、effect key | only generation fence / local rehydrate may form it. |
| local replay / effect / handoff identity | `refs.rs` / `IdempotencyKey`、`ExternalEffectKey`、`PublicationKey`、`HandoffKey` | local replay、one-effect、publication 或 per-target handoff 的稳定 identity | source version、external ref、receipt、cursor、timestamp | unknown / gap 保留原 key；不得换 key 掩盖不确定效果。 |
| query continuation | `views.rs` / `HostPageCursor` | local safe-read continuation | source version、projection progress、CAS、authorization token、external ref | page layer不得解析或改写本批 carrier。 |

结论：同一 opaque text 即使字面相同，也必须保留其 typed boundary；`as_opaque_value()` 只服务于 typed persistence / approved mapper，不授予重解释、拼接、日志展示或跨类型转换资格。任何需要把一个类型换成上表另一类型的实现，必须先取得对应正式 mapper / repository / state rule，而不是调用 `.to_string()`。

| 区分 locator 的用途而不解码它 | base ref + wrapper expected role | qualification / credential / association / endpoint / signal / target / handoff / publication wrapper | 无 owner truth 读取、无 role inference | role-specific ref wrapper | Step 6 domain cards；Step 7 typed port signature |

#### 8.10.4 本对象组对象能力到字段 / 函数 / state 映射

| 对象 | 对象能力 | 必需字段 | factory / 构造入口 | 成员函数 | state / classification | 字段来源 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostExternalSafeRefRole` | 限定 external locator 的 owner-safe category | no payload | enum literal | `as_static_name()` | closed role enum，非状态机 | 本仓已知 integration category；不从 ref text 推导 |
| `HostExternalSafeRef` | 保存 non-empty opaque locator 和 role | role、private opaque value | `from_mapped_opaque_value` / `from_persisted` | role / opaque accessor | no lifecycle | formal boundary mapper 或 local safe persistence |
| `HostExternalSourceVersionRef` | 保存 source-side version marker | private opaque value | `from_mapped_opaque_value` / `from_persisted` | opaque accessor | no lifecycle | formal mapper / safe persistence；可由 enclosing field 缺失 |

| `HostExternalSafeSummaryKind` | 限定 summary 的消费层 | no payload | enum literal | `as_static_name()` / compatibility check | closed classification，非外部状态 | wrapper / mapper 已知的 summary surface |
