本批所有 enum 都是 closed classification，不是外部 owner 的状态机。`resolved`、`accepted`、`succeeded`、`delivered`、`observed`、`accepted-by-downstream` 等词若在后续本仓对象出现，必须由该对象的 local state / explicitly linked safe summary 定义；它们不能由本节 ref 或 summary 的存在推导。

#### 8.10.5 `HostExternalSafeRefRole`

本枚举只选择 contracts 允许保存的 external-safe carrier 类别。每个变体均指向“可被 body-free mapper 表示的角色”，而不是对端 resource schema、route、credential format、SDK type 或 owner state。需要新类别时必须回写本 Step 的 closed enum、wrapper compatibility 和后续 domain field audit；不得以 string role 或 feature flag 扩展。

```rust
/// Classifies an external-safe reference role that this service may retain without carrying an external body or state.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum HostExternalSafeRefRole {
    /// An external-safe reference for an identity or project-member qualification source.
    QualificationSource,
    /// An external-safe reference for pinned image supply or its verification source.
    PinnedImageSupply,
    /// An instance-bound, revocable, non-reusable external-safe launch credential reference.
    LaunchCredential,
    /// An external-safe host-level Sandbox binding reference; it does not assert backend, policy, or cleanup completion.
    SandboxBinding,
    /// An external-safe carrier capability reference; it does not assert carrier or backend truth.
    CarrierCapability,
    /// An external-safe carrier, registry, asset, or backend-resource reference.
    CarrierOrBackendResource,
    /// An external-safe Member-owned registration-input reference.
    MemberRegistration,
    /// An external-safe Member association reference.
    MemberAssociation,
    /// An external-safe Runtime Host Session association reference.
    RuntimeAssociation,
    /// An external-safe redacted endpoint or transport-access locator reference.
    SafeEndpoint,
    /// An external-safe reference for an allowed Member, Runtime, carrier, or Sandbox health-signal source.
    HealthSignalSource,
    /// An external-safe host-side action-target reference produced by a formal target mapper.
    HostActionTarget,
    /// An external-safe release or cleanup-target reference produced by a formal target mapper.
    CleanupTarget,
    /// An external-safe formal target reference for material handoff.
    HandoffTarget,
    /// An external-safe target reference for local outbox publication; it is not a Bus route.
    PublicationTarget,
}

impl HostExternalSafeRefRole {
    /// Returns a stable static role label for contract-combination diagnostics and typed persistence mapping.
    pub fn as_static_name(&self) -> &'static str;
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `QualificationSource` | `身份或项目成员资格来源的安全引用。` | 表示 Identity / Work 等 qualification 类 source 的安全 locator | formal qualification mapper；safe persistence | `HostQualificationSourceRef` / qualification summary；不得作 credential / endpoint / action target |
| `PinnedImageSupply` | `已钉定镜像供给或其可验证性来源的安全引用。` | 表示 Images supply direction | formal Images mapper；safe persistence | qualification wrapper / summary；不表示 manifest / digest verification ready |
| `LaunchCredential` | `实例绑定、可撤销且不可复用的 launch credential 安全引用。` | 表示 credential ref 而非 secret | formal credential mapper；safe persistence | credential wrapper / qualification summary；不得转为 token / secret / authorization |
| `SandboxBinding` | `宿主级 Sandbox binding 的安全引用；不表示 backend、policy 或 cleanup 完成。` | 表示 host-level binding locator | formal Sandbox mapper；safe persistence | qualification / action / cleanup wrapper；不表示 tool execution or binding truth |
| `CarrierCapability` | `carrier capability 的安全引用；不表示 carrier/backend truth。` | 表示 capability class / supported contract input | formal carrier mapper；safe persistence | qualification wrapper / summary；不得作 resource identity |
| `CarrierOrBackendResource` | `carrier、registry、asset 或 backend resource 的安全引用。` | 表示 linked resource locator | formal carrier / registry mapper；safe persistence | association / action / cleanup wrapper and matching summary；不拥有 backend state |
| `MemberRegistration` | `Member 所拥有 registration 输入的安全引用。` | 表示 Member registration source | formal Member mapper；safe persistence | registration wrapper；不表示 Member registration truth or accepted state |
| `MemberAssociation` | `Member 侧关联的安全引用。` | 表示 host-side allowed Member association | formal Member mapper；safe persistence | member association wrapper；不表示 Member lifecycle / session truth |
| `RuntimeAssociation` | `Runtime 侧 Host Session association 的安全引用。` | 表示 Runtime association shell | formal Runtime mapper；safe persistence | runtime association wrapper；不表示 Runtime session/run/turn/outcome |
| `SafeEndpoint` | `已裁剪 endpoint / transport access locator 的安全引用。` | 表示 safe endpoint locator | formal endpoint mapper；safe persistence | endpoint wrapper；不得暴露 raw URL / transport / credential |
| `HealthSignalSource` | `Member、Runtime、carrier 或 Sandbox 允许 health signal 来源的安全引用。` | 表示 signal source locator | formal signal mapper；safe persistence | health signal source / health summary；不表示 envelope or signal body |
| `HostActionTarget` | `经正式 target mapper 表示的 host-side action target 安全引用。` | 表示 create/start/stop/bind 等 action target | formal action-target mapper；safe persistence | action target / outcome summary；不表示 dispatch / external success |
| `CleanupTarget` | `经正式 target mapper 表示的 release / cleanup target 安全引用。` | 表示 cleanup / release target | formal cleanup-target mapper；safe persistence | cleanup target / outcome summary；不表示 cleanup completion |
| `HandoffTarget` | `material handoff 的正式目标安全引用。` | 表示 authorized downstream / observation target | formal handoff target mapper；safe persistence | handoff target + delivery / observation / acceptance summaries；不表示 target receipt / acceptance |
| `PublicationTarget` | `local outbox publication 的目标安全引用；不等于 Bus route。` | 表示 publication destination category binding | formal publication mapper；safe persistence | publication target / submission summary；不表示 route / envelope / broker delivery |

#### 8.10.6 `HostExternalSafeRef`、`HostExternalSourceVersionRef` 与 `HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt`

三者是所有 role-specific wrapper 的唯一基础值对象。它们不提供 `From<String>`、`Display`、cross-role conversion 或 generic string accessor，以防 persistence、adapter、entry 或 log 把安全边界重新抹平。

##### `HostExternalSafeRef`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Stores an external-safe opaque reference with a closed role and without an external body, state, or transport detail.
pub struct HostExternalSafeRef {
    /// The closed role that limits how this service may consume the reference.
    role: HostExternalSafeRefRole,
    /// A non-empty opaque value available only to approved mapping and typed persistence.
    opaque_value: String,
}

impl HostExternalSafeRef {
    /// Creates a reference from redacted output of a formal external-safe mapper without querying or validating the external owner.
    pub fn from_mapped_opaque_value(
        role: HostExternalSafeRefRole,
        opaque_value: String,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Rehydrates a reference from a locally persisted safe-reference field without restoring an external body or state.
    pub fn from_persisted(
        role: HostExternalSafeRefRole,
        opaque_value: String,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the closed consumption role without inferring it from the opaque value.
    pub fn role(&self) -> HostExternalSafeRefRole;

    /// Returns the opaque value only for typed persistence or an approved mapper.
    pub fn as_opaque_value(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | `HostExternalSafeRefRole` | 限制本 ref 的可消费位置 | 由 formal boundary mapper / persisted row 的 typed role column 形成；不得从 opaque text、route、owner name 或 adapter type 推断。 |
| `opaque_value` | private `String` | 保存外部 owner 已裁剪 locator | trim 后非空；来自 mapper 或已保存 safe-ref 字段；禁止 raw endpoint、credential、manifest、payload、receipt、report、trace、URL 或 backend body。它不证明对端对象存在或可访问。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_mapped_opaque_value(HostExternalSafeRefRole, String)` | 将正式 mapper 的安全输出封装为 typed ref | `role` 是 closed role；`opaque_value` 是 mapper 已裁剪的 opaque locator | `Result<HostExternalSafeRef, ContractError>` | trim 后空值返回 `EmptyExternalSafeRef { field: role.as_static_name() }`；不 lookup、不测试可达性、不加载 owner truth、不做 redaction。 |
| `from_persisted(HostExternalSafeRefRole, String)` | 重建已经只存 safe-ref 的本地记录 | 参数只来自本地 safe persistence | `Result<HostExternalSafeRef, ContractError>` | 与 fresh factory 同一 non-empty guard；不把历史 ref 解释为 current / active / resolved。 |
| `role()` | 读取 wrapper compatibility 使用的 role | 无 | `HostExternalSafeRefRole` | pure accessor；不得由 caller switch 后自行转成其他 wrapper。 |
| `as_opaque_value()` | 提供 typed storage / approved mapper 使用的 opaque text | 无 | `&str` | 不用于日志、display、string parsing、route synthesis、owner dispatch或 cross-role conversion。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| role is not owner truth | `role` 只表达本仓允许的消费类别，不表示 L1/L2/L4 或 carrier/backend 对象的 owner、existence、authorization 或 lifecycle。 |
| no generic external ref | 不得另建 `ExternalRef(String)`、`ExternalOwnerRef(String)`、`ExternalResourceRef(String)` 或无 role 的 `SafeRef` 作为 domain / adapter / entry shortcut；概要阶段的这些抽象名称统一由本批 typed wrapper 替换。 |
| no raw endpoint / credential escape | `SafeEndpoint` 和 `LaunchCredential` role 仍只保存 opaque safe locator；`as_opaque_value()` 不赋予 endpoint display / connect 或 credential materialization 权力。 |
| no hidden source version | ref 不能携带、解析或生成 source version；需要版本时必须使用独立 `Option<HostExternalSourceVersionRef>`。 |

##### `HostExternalSourceVersionRef`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Stores a source-owner-declared external version marker that is not a local version, cursor, generation, or key.
pub struct HostExternalSourceVersionRef(String);

impl HostExternalSourceVersionRef {
    /// Creates a version reference from an opaque source-side version supplied by a formal source mapper.
    pub fn from_mapped_opaque_value(value: String) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Rehydrates a version reference from a locally persisted safe source-version field.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the source-side opaque version only for typed persistence or an approved mapper.
    pub fn as_opaque_value(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `String` | source owner 声明的 opaque version / revision marker | non-empty；只能来自 formal resolver / event / safe summary mapper 或 local safe persistence；来源未提供版本时 enclosing field 为 `None`，不得以 local time、message id、sequence、repository version、cursor、generation、hash 或 key 补齐。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_mapped_opaque_value(String)` | 形成 source-side version carrier | `value` 是 external mapper 输出 | `Result<HostExternalSourceVersionRef, ContractError>` | trim 后空值返回 `EmptyPublicText { field: "host_external_source_version_ref" }`；不比较版本、不判断 fresh/stale、不解析语义。 |
| `from_persisted(String)` | 重建已保存版本 carrier | `value` 是 public-safe / local safe summary field | `Result<HostExternalSourceVersionRef, ContractError>` | 不重新 resolver、不补版本、不把 retained historic version 声称为 current。 |
| `as_opaque_value()` | 返回 typed mapper / persistence 需要的 version text | 无 | `&str` | 不可作为 CAS、cursor、generation、idempotency digest、page token或 numeric ordering。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| source side only | 版本仅表示 source owner 给出的对应时点标记；即使它与本地 revision 字面相同也不得转换。 |
| optionality belongs to enclosing fact | type 本身不表示 `Unknown` / `Stale` / `Unavailable`；缺失、过期和 resolver outcome 由后续 qualification、signal、association、projection 或 port result owner 明确表达。 |
| no version-derived completion | 具有 source version 不表示外部 action、delivery、observation、acceptance、cleanup 或 Runtime / Member session 已完成。 |

##### `HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Stores the source-side time at which an external owner formed a safe summary; it does not replace local acceptance, submission, or projection time.
pub struct HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt(Timestamp);

impl HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt {
    /// Creates the carrier from source-side captured time supplied by a formal source mapper.
    pub fn from_source(value: Timestamp) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates source-side captured time from a persisted safe summary.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: Timestamp) -> Self;

    /// Returns source-side captured time only for typed comparison or persistence.
    pub fn as_timestamp(&self) -> Timestamp;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | `Timestamp` | source owner 形成 safe summary 的时点 | 只能来自 formal source mapper 或 persisted safe summary；不使用 API / worker / job local accepted-at、clock now、outbox submitted-at、view assembled-at、repository updated-at 或 timeout occurrence 代替。若对端未提供，此字段为 `None` 而非 synthetic time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_source(Timestamp)` | 包装 external mapper 已提供的 captured time | `value` 是 source-side captured time | `HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt` | pure carrier；不验证 source ordering、freshness、clock skew 或 event acceptance。 |
| `from_persisted(Timestamp)` | 重建历史 safe summary 的 source time | `value` 为已保存时点 | `HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt` | 不刷新、不与 current clock 对比、不升级为 fresh。 |
| `as_timestamp()` | 提供 typed time comparison / storage input | 无 | `Timestamp` | 调用方必须在 owning flow / policy 中定义 comparison；本类型不判 late / stale。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| time is not version or order proof | captured time 不替代 source version、signal sequence、message order、projection cursor、CAS version或 generation。 |
| no local-time substitution | source time 缺失时后续 owner 必须表达 unknown / blocked / degraded / unavailable；不得借本地 clock 生成“看似新鲜”的摘要。 |
| no external completion inference | captured time 只说明 owner 摘要声称的形成时点，不说明该 owner 接受 / 完成 / 清理 / 交付。 |

#### 8.10.7 `HostExternalSafeSummaryKind` 与 `HostExternalSafeSummary`

summary kind 只描述本仓的**消费面**，而不是 source owner 的远端状态。它把一条 redacted classification 约束到对应的 source role，防止以 action outcome 冒充 delivery 或以 local submitted 冒充 accepted。

##### `HostExternalSafeSummaryKind`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Classifies the closed semantic layer in which this service may consume an external-safe summary; it does not express external-owner state.
#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Eq, PartialEq)]
pub enum HostExternalSafeSummaryKind {
    /// A redacted item summary for a qualification source.
    Qualification,
    /// A redacted outcome summary for host-side action matching.
    ActionOutcome,
    /// A redacted signal summary for health-signal intake.
    HealthSignal,
    /// A redacted outcome summary for cleanup or release matching.
    CleanupOutcome,
    /// A redacted observation summary for residual or reconciliation comparison.
    ResidualObservation,
    /// A redacted submission summary for the local outbox submitted surface.
    PublicationSubmission,
    /// An external-owner-declared summary for the handoff delivery layer.
    HandoffDelivery,
    /// An external-owner-declared summary for the handoff observation layer.
    HandoffObservation,
    /// A downstream-owner-declared summary for the handoff acceptance layer.
    HandoffAcceptance,
}

impl HostExternalSafeSummaryKind {
    /// Returns a stable static summary-layer label for contract compatibility diagnostics.
    pub fn as_static_name(&self) -> &'static str;

    /// Determines whether a source role may provide this summary layer without reading external truth.
    pub fn accepts_source_role(&self, role: HostExternalSafeRefRole) -> bool;
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Qualification` | `用于资格来源的已裁剪分项摘要。` | 供 `HostQualificationContext` / required-item evaluation 使用 | `QualificationSource`、`PinnedImageSupply`、`LaunchCredential`、`SandboxBinding`、`CarrierCapability` role 的 formal mapper | `HostQualificationSafeSummary`；不得替代 readiness decision |
| `ActionOutcome` | `用于 host-side action matching 的已裁剪结果摘要。` | 供 action attempt / association 的 matching input 使用 | `HostActionTarget`、`SandboxBinding`、`CarrierOrBackendResource` role 的 formal mapper | `HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary`；不得表示 dispatch receipt 或 external lifecycle truth |
| `HealthSignal` | `用于 health signal intake 的已裁剪信号摘要。` | 供 health snapshot 形成输入 | `HealthSignalSource` role 的 formal mapper | `HostHealthSignalSafeSummary`；不得作 action / recovery result |
| `CleanupOutcome` | `用于 cleanup / release matching 的已裁剪结果摘要。` | 供 cleanup attempt / association release 的 matching input | `CleanupTarget`、`SandboxBinding`、`CarrierOrBackendResource` role 的 formal mapper | `HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary`；不得表示 closure complete |
| `ResidualObservation` | `用于 residual / reconciliation 对照的已裁剪观测摘要。` | 供 residual finding 的 external comparison input | `SandboxBinding`、`CarrierOrBackendResource`、`HealthSignalSource` role 的 formal mapper | `HostResidualObservationSafeSummary`；不得改写 affected external truth |
| `PublicationSubmission` | `用于 local outbox submitted surface 的已裁剪提交摘要。` | 记录 publisher boundary 的本地提交层 | `PublicationTarget` role 的 formal publisher mapper | `HostPublicationSubmissionSafeSummary`；不得表示 Bus delivery / downstream observation / acceptance |
| `HandoffDelivery` | `用于 handoff delivery layer 的外部 owner 声明摘要。` | 关联 delivery owner 声明 | `HandoffTarget` role 的 formal delivery mapper | `HostHandoffDeliverySafeSummary`；不得代表 observation / acceptance |
| `HandoffObservation` | `用于 handoff observation layer 的外部 owner 声明摘要。` | 关联 observation owner 声明 | `HandoffTarget` role 的 formal observation mapper | `HostHandoffObservationSafeSummary`；不得代表 delivery / acceptance |
| `HandoffAcceptance` | `用于 handoff acceptance layer 的下游 owner 声明摘要。` | 关联 downstream acceptance owner 声明 | `HandoffTarget` role 的 formal acceptance mapper | `HostHandoffAcceptanceSafeSummary`；不得代表 delivery / observation |

`accepts_source_role(...)` 的 exact compatibility matrix 是：

| summary kind | compatible source role(s) | 不兼容示例 |
|---|---|---|
| `Qualification` | `QualificationSource`、`PinnedImageSupply`、`LaunchCredential`、`SandboxBinding`、`CarrierCapability` | `SafeEndpoint`、`MemberRegistration`、`HandoffTarget`、`PublicationTarget` |
| `ActionOutcome` | `HostActionTarget`、`SandboxBinding`、`CarrierOrBackendResource` | `LaunchCredential`、`HealthSignalSource`、`HandoffTarget` |
| `HealthSignal` | `HealthSignalSource` | 其他全部 role |
| `CleanupOutcome` | `CleanupTarget`、`SandboxBinding`、`CarrierOrBackendResource` | `HostActionTarget`、`PublicationTarget`、`HandoffTarget` |
| `ResidualObservation` | `SandboxBinding`、`CarrierOrBackendResource`、`HealthSignalSource` | `LaunchCredential`、`SafeEndpoint`、`PublicationTarget` |
| `PublicationSubmission` | `PublicationTarget` | `HandoffTarget`、`HostActionTarget`、`CleanupTarget` |
| `HandoffDelivery` / `HandoffObservation` / `HandoffAcceptance` | `HandoffTarget` | `PublicationTarget`、`HealthSignalSource`、`MemberAssociation` |

不兼容组合必须由 `HostExternalSafeSummary::try_new` 返回 `ContractError::ExternalSafeRefRoleMismatch`，其 `carrier` 是 `"host_external_safe_summary"`，`expected_role` 使用 summary kind 所允许 role 的稳定集合名，`actual_role` 使用 `source_ref.role().as_static_name()`。该错误只表示本仓 carrier 拼装错误；不得将它解释为 external target absent、message invalid、owner rejection或 downstream completion failure。

##### `HostExternalSafeSummary`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Stores the smallest redacted summary traceable to an external-safe reference without an external body or completion fact.
pub struct HostExternalSafeSummary {
    /// The closed semantic layer in which this service may consume the summary.
    kind: HostExternalSafeSummaryKind,
    /// The role-bearing external-safe reference for the subject summarized.
    source_ref: HostExternalSafeRef,
    /// The source-owner-provided version marker when present; this service never synthesizes one when absent.
    source_version_ref: Option<HostExternalSourceVersionRef>,
    /// A non-sensitive classification code that has crossed the sole redaction boundary.
    summary_code: HostRedactedCode,
    /// The source-owner-provided summary time when present; it does not replace local time.
    captured_at: Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>,
}

impl HostExternalSafeSummary {
    /// Creates a body-free summary carrier from a compatible role, optional source version, and redacted code.
    pub fn try_new(
        kind: HostExternalSafeSummaryKind,
        source_ref: HostExternalSafeRef,
        source_version_ref: Option<HostExternalSourceVersionRef>,
        summary_code: HostRedactedCode,
        captured_at: Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted safe summary carrier without refreshing or reinterpreting external state.
    pub fn from_persisted(
        kind: HostExternalSafeSummaryKind,
        source_ref: HostExternalSafeRef,
        source_version_ref: Option<HostExternalSourceVersionRef>,
        summary_code: HostRedactedCode,
        captured_at: Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the summary consumption layer.
    pub fn kind(&self) -> HostExternalSafeSummaryKind;

    /// Returns the typed source reference associated with the summary.
    pub fn source_ref(&self) -> &HostExternalSafeRef;

    /// Returns the source-side version; absence does not allow a local value to substitute for it.
    pub fn source_version_ref(&self) -> Option<&HostExternalSourceVersionRef>;

    /// Returns the validated redacted classification code.
    pub fn summary_code(&self) -> &HostRedactedCode;

    /// Returns source-side captured time; absence does not imply that the summary is fresh or stale.
    pub fn captured_at(&self) -> Option<&HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | `HostExternalSafeSummaryKind` | 锁定摘要可进入的本地消费层 | formal mapper / persisted typed field；须与 `source_ref.role()` 通过 compatibility matrix；不是 remote state。 |
| `source_ref` | `HostExternalSafeRef` | 回链摘要的外部安全主体 | formal mapper 或 safe persistence；不得用 local host / decision / attempt / session ref、page cursor或 message id 替代。 |
| `source_version_ref` | `Option<HostExternalSourceVersionRef>` | 保留 source owner 已提供的版本 | 可缺失；不得由 repository revision、generation、cursor、clock、hash或 key 补造。版本存在不证明 summary verified / current。 |
| `summary_code` | `HostRedactedCode` | 保存唯一 redaction boundary 后的 classification | only `HostRedactedCode`；不得用 raw status/error/body、transport code、endpoint、credential、image digest、report、trace或 free-text。 |
| `captured_at` | `Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>` | 保留 source owner 摘要形成时点 | 可缺失；只能来自 source mapper / safe persistence；不使用 local accepted / updated / submitted / generated time 替代。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `try_new(HostExternalSafeSummaryKind, HostExternalSafeRef, Option<HostExternalSourceVersionRef>, HostRedactedCode, Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>)` | 建立 new external-safe summary carrier | 所有输入均为已经 typed / redacted 的 carrier | `Result<HostExternalSafeSummary, ContractError>` | 只验证 `kind` 与 `source_ref.role()` compatibility；不调用 owner、不判断 freshness、quality、delivery、acceptance或 local state。 |
| `from_persisted(...)` | 重建已保存的 safe summary | 参数只来自已保存 typed fields | `Result<HostExternalSafeSummary, ContractError>` | 重做 compatibility guard；不 refresh、不恢复 raw body、不把 historic summary 升格为 current / successful。 |
| accessors | 为 typed wrapper / domain object / approved mapper 提供成员 | 无 | typed borrowed value / optional borrowed value | pure access；不得转换、parse、log、dispatch、reserve key或写 local truth。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| summary is not external truth | `HostExternalSafeSummary` 不能证明 source exists、verified、active、healthy、bound、released、delivered、observed、accepted、cleaned up 或 executable。它只承载已被 mapper 允许进入本仓的一条 classification。 |
| summary is not local result | local receipt、adapter availability、timeout、fake result、local `submitted`、consumer acceptance或 domain state不能构造或替代本 summary。`PublicationSubmission` 也只记录本地 publisher boundary 的安全提交层，绝不升级到 delivery。 |
| no body / digest algorithm | 不保存 external DTO、route、envelope、receipt、response body、manifest、credential、endpoint、transport、log、trace、evidence、report或 digest algorithm。若 future source requires additional safe field，必须回到 Step 6 定义 exact type 与 redaction input，不能增 `Map<String, String>`。 |
| source version and captured time remain independent | source version 可存在而 captured time 缺失，反之亦然；二者均可缺失，且 neither 代替 repository version / cursor / generation / key。 |

#### 8.10.8 role-specific external-safe reference wrappers

下列 wrapper 是 `refs.rs` 的 private-inner newtype，不新增业务对象，不生成 sibling schema。它们使 domain field、port input 和 future DTO 无法把资格、credential、association、endpoint、signal、target、handoff、publication 等 role 混为一个 `HostExternalSafeRef`。每个 wrapper 都有 identical structural pattern，但不可由 generic macro / `type Alias` 替代；每一个 expected role 均在此处闭合。

```rust
/// References an owner-safe qualification source without carrying a qualification body.
pub struct HostQualificationSourceRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References an owner-safe pinned image supply without carrying manifest, digest, or verification body.
pub struct HostPinnedImageSupplyRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References an instance-bound launch credential without carrying secret material or issuance and revocation truth.
pub struct HostLaunchCredentialRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a host-level Sandbox binding without carrying Sandbox backend, policy, or execution truth.
pub struct HostSandboxBindingRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a carrier capability without carrying carrier or backend truth.
pub struct HostCarrierCapabilityRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a carrier, registry, asset, or backend resource without carrying its body.
pub struct HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a Member-owned registration input without carrying the Member registration body.
pub struct HostMemberRegistrationRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a Member association without carrying Member lifecycle or session truth.
pub struct HostMemberAssociationRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a Runtime Host Session association without carrying Runtime run, turn, or outcome.
pub struct HostRuntimeAssociationRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a redacted endpoint locator without carrying raw transport or credential material.
pub struct HostSafeEndpointRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References an allowed health-signal source without carrying an envelope or signal body.
pub struct HostHealthSignalSourceRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a host-side action target without carrying request, dispatch-receipt, or result body.
pub struct HostActionTargetRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a cleanup or release target without carrying cleanup truth.
pub struct HostCleanupTargetRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a material-handoff target without carrying downstream route, receipt, or acceptance truth.
pub struct HostHandoffTargetRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
/// References a local outbox-publication target without carrying Bus route, envelope, or delivery truth.
pub struct HostPublicationTargetRef(HostExternalSafeRef);
```

| wrapper | expected role | factory / accessor | 概要设计承接 | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostQualificationSourceRef` | `QualificationSource` | `try_from_safe_ref` / `as_safe_ref` | `ExternalRef source_ref` of qualification source entry | `ProjectMemberRef` / `GlobalMemberRef` / raw Identity or Work body |
| `HostPinnedImageSupplyRef` | `PinnedImageSupply` | same | Images pinned supply placeholder | image manifest / digest / variant / generic `ExternalRef` |
| `HostLaunchCredentialRef` | `LaunchCredential` | same | `OpaqueCredentialRef` / `LaunchCredentialRefPlaceholder` | token / secret / credential owner truth |
| `HostSandboxBindingRef` | `SandboxBinding` | same | Sandbox qualification / association / cleanup placeholder | Sandbox policy / backend / run / tool execution handle |
| `HostCarrierCapabilityRef` | `CarrierCapability` | same | carrier capability qualification input | backend resource id / carrier status body |
| `HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef` | `CarrierOrBackendResource` | same | `ExternalRef` / `ExternalResourceRef` used for association / residual | local `HostRef` / container body / opaque endpoint |
| `HostMemberRegistrationRef` | `MemberRegistration` | same | `MemberRegistrationRefPlaceholder` | registration request / report body / Member status |
| `HostMemberAssociationRef` | `MemberAssociation` | same | `MemberAssociationRefPlaceholder` | Member session / heartbeat / lifecycle truth |
| `HostRuntimeAssociationRef` | `RuntimeAssociation` | same | `RuntimeAssociationRefPlaceholder` | Runtime session / run / checkpoint / outcome |
| `HostSafeEndpointRef` | `SafeEndpoint` | same | `SafeHostEndpointRefPlaceholder` / `SafeEndpointRef` | raw URL, transport detail, connection or credential |
| `HostHealthSignalSourceRef` | `HealthSignalSource` | same | `SignalSourceRefPlaceholder` / `HealthSignalSourceRef` | envelope, message id, sequence or raw heartbeat |
| `HostActionTargetRef` | `HostActionTarget` | same | `ExternalActionTargetRef` | action request, dispatch receipt, effect key or outcome |
| `HostCleanupTargetRef` | `CleanupTarget` | same | `ExternalCleanupTargetRef` | cleanup receipt / released status / new action target |
| `HostHandoffTargetRef` | `HandoffTarget` | same | `HandoffTargetRef` | Bus route, Observability record, consumer acceptance / receipt |
| `HostPublicationTargetRef` | `PublicationTarget` | same | `PublicationTargetClass` typed target binding | `HandoffTarget`, topic, route or downstream result |

每个 wrapper 必须实现以下显式签名（以 `HostQualificationSourceRef` 为模式；其余 wrapper 只替换类型名和 expected role）：

```rust
impl HostQualificationSourceRef {
    /// Creates a qualification-source reference from a base safe reference with the matching role.
    pub fn try_from_safe_ref(value: HostExternalSafeRef) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the underlying typed safe reference without allowing conversion to another role wrapper.
    pub fn as_safe_ref(&self) -> &HostExternalSafeRef;
}
```

`try_from_safe_ref(...)` 必须验证 `value.role() == expected_role`；不匹配时返回 `ExternalSafeRefRoleMismatch { carrier: "<wrapper static name>", expected_role: "<expected role static name>", actual_role: value.role().as_static_name() }`。它不通过重新标注 role、复制 string、adapter fallback、fake map 或 configuration bypass 修复不匹配。wrapper 没有状态、没有 `from_raw`、没有 `into_inner`、没有 owner lookup，并且不能作为 source version、generation、cursor、idempotency key 或 local decision ref 使用。

##### `HostQualificationSourceRef`

```rust
/// References an owner-safe qualification source without carrying Identity or Work body.
pub struct HostQualificationSourceRef(HostExternalSafeRef);

impl HostQualificationSourceRef {
    /// Creates a qualification reference from a base reference whose role is `QualificationSource`.
    pub fn try_from_safe_ref(value: HostExternalSafeRef) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;
    /// Returns the underlying typed safe reference without changing its role.
    pub fn as_safe_ref(&self) -> &HostExternalSafeRef;
}
```

| 项 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|
| 字段 `0` | private `HostExternalSafeRef`；必须由 `HostExternalSafeRefRole::QualificationSource` 的 formal mapper / safe persistence 进入。 |
| factory / accessor | role mismatch 返回 `ExternalSafeRefRoleMismatch`；只读 accessor 不提供 `String` 转换。 |
| 不变量 | 仅用于 qualification source；不表示 source resolved、fresh、required satisfied 或 readiness ready。 |

#### 8.10.9 role-specific external-safe summary wrappers

以下 wrapper 锁定 summary 进入的本地消费层。它们全部以 private `HostExternalSafeSummary` 为唯一字段，并以 `kind`（而非 code text、source role、adapter type、target name 或 status word）验证兼容性。summary 存在只允许 domain / application 在对应 record 中**显式关联**；绝不自动推进 local state。

```rust
/// Carries a safe qualification-source summary without asserting qualification completion or readiness.
pub struct HostQualificationSafeSummary(HostExternalSafeSummary);
/// Carries a safe host-side action-matching outcome without asserting dispatch or external lifecycle completion.
pub struct HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary(HostExternalSafeSummary);
/// Carries a safe health-signal summary without asserting a healthy assessment or executed recovery action.
pub struct HostHealthSignalSafeSummary(HostExternalSafeSummary);
/// Carries a safe cleanup or release outcome without asserting host closure or external cleanup completion.
pub struct HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary(HostExternalSafeSummary);
/// Carries an external-safe residual or reconciliation observation without mutating affected external truth.
pub struct HostResidualObservationSafeSummary(HostExternalSafeSummary);
/// Carries a safe publisher-boundary submission summary without asserting Bus delivery.
pub struct HostPublicationSubmissionSafeSummary(HostExternalSafeSummary);
/// Carries a handoff-safe summary supplied by the delivery owner without asserting observation or acceptance.
pub struct HostHandoffDeliverySafeSummary(HostExternalSafeSummary);
/// Carries a handoff-safe summary supplied by the observation owner without asserting delivery or acceptance.
pub struct HostHandoffObservationSafeSummary(HostExternalSafeSummary);
/// Carries a handoff-acceptance safe summary supplied by the downstream owner without asserting delivery or observation.
pub struct HostHandoffAcceptanceSafeSummary(HostExternalSafeSummary);
```

| wrapper | expected summary kind | 主要消费位置 | 明确不表示 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HostQualificationSafeSummary` | `Qualification` | qualification source entry / required-item evaluation | source verified、context resolved、assembly complete、readiness ready |
| `HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary` | `ActionOutcome` | `HostActionAttempt` / `HostExternalAssociation` matching | local dispatch、host active、external owner lifecycle complete |
| `HostHealthSignalSafeSummary` | `HealthSignal` | `HealthSignalSnapshot` intake | message accepted、signal current、assessment healthy、recovery executed |
| `HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary` | `CleanupOutcome` | `CleanupAttempt` / association release matching | closure locally closed、resource released、cleanup complete |
| `HostResidualObservationSafeSummary` | `ResidualObservation` | `ResidualFinding` comparison / reconciliation basis | external truth mutation、finding resolved、case accepted |
| `HostPublicationSubmissionSafeSummary` | `PublicationSubmission` | `HostOutboxRecord.mark_submitted(...)` | Bus route configured、event delivered、observed、accepted |
| `HostHandoffDeliverySafeSummary` | `HandoffDelivery` | `HostHandoffRecord.link_delivery(...)` | observation or acceptance |
| `HostHandoffObservationSafeSummary` | `HandoffObservation` | `HostHandoffRecord.link_observation(...)` | delivery or acceptance |
| `HostHandoffAcceptanceSafeSummary` | `HandoffAcceptance` | `HostHandoffRecord.link_acceptance(...)` | delivery or observation |

每个 wrapper 必须实现以下显式签名（以 `HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary` 为模式；其余 wrapper 只替换类型名和 expected kind）：

```rust
impl HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary {
    /// Creates an action-outcome summary from a base safe summary with the matching semantic layer.
    pub fn try_from_safe_summary(value: HostExternalSafeSummary) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the underlying typed safe summary without allowing conversion to another consumption layer.
    pub fn as_safe_summary(&self) -> &HostExternalSafeSummary;
}
```

`try_from_safe_summary(...)` 必须验证 `value.kind() == expected_kind`；不匹配时返回 `ExternalSafeRefRoleMismatch`，其中 `carrier` 为 wrapper static name，`expected_role` 为 expected summary-kind static name，`actual_role` 为 `value.kind().as_static_name()`。该 enum variant 的字段名沿用 shared construction-error schema，二者均是 stable diagnostic label，**不是** actual external role / status / resource value。任何要为 summary-kind mismatch 新增专门 error variant 的需要，必须先回写 `errors.rs` owner，而不能在 adapter / domain / entry 私造错误。

#### 8.10.10 外部引用与摘要的使用矩阵

| 后续 domain 字段 / 方法语义 | 本批必须使用的 wrapper | 可选 source version / captured-at | 允许的 summary wrapper | 禁止替代 / 状态上限 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| qualification source entry | `HostQualificationSourceRef`、`HostPinnedImageSupplyRef`、`HostLaunchCredentialRef`、`HostSandboxBindingRef`、`HostCarrierCapabilityRef` | all optional; missing remains explicit gap / stale / unknown later | `HostQualificationSafeSummary` | 不以 source ref / summary 直接写 `resolved` 或 `ready`；Images / credential / Sandbox exact contract仍 pending。 |
| host action target / outcome | `HostActionTargetRef`；matching association 可用 `HostSandboxBindingRef` / `HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef` | outcome source optional | `HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary` | 不以 summary / ref 表示 dispatched、succeeded、association active 或 owner completion；这些由 later attempt/association rules决定。 |
| external association | `HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef` 或 `HostSandboxBindingRef` | optional | `HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary` / `HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary` | 不用 backend id 作 `HostId`，不把 association ref 当 external truth。 |
| Member registration | `HostMemberRegistrationRef`、`HostLaunchCredentialRef` | no inferred version/time | none unless a formal compatible mapper supplies it | accepted / rejected / replaced 仍是 local registration state；Member body / credential secret forbidden。 |
| endpoint / Host Session | `HostSafeEndpointRef`、`HostMemberAssociationRef`、optional `HostRuntimeAssociationRef` | no inferred version/time | none unless future formal mapper gives a defined compatible summary | endpoint active、session active / blocked / stale、Runtime run remain separate; Runtime exact contract pending。 |
| health signal snapshot | `HostHealthSignalSourceRef` | version optional; captured-at normally mapper-provided but may be missing | `HostHealthSignalSafeSummary` | summary/ref 不证明 message accepted、ordering valid、health assessment or recovery truth。 |
| cleanup / release | `HostCleanupTargetRef`、`HostSandboxBindingRef`、`HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef` | optional | `HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary` | local cleanup attempt / closure / release completion remain separate；unknown 不得换 key重试。 |
| residual / reconciliation | `HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef`、`HostSandboxBindingRef`、`HostHealthSignalSourceRef` | optional | `HostResidualObservationSafeSummary` | observation does not alter owner truth or resolve case. |
| outbox publication | `HostPublicationTargetRef` | source version/time not inferred from local submit | `HostPublicationSubmissionSafeSummary` | `submitted` does not imply Bus delivery, observation or acceptance；route/envelope pending。 |
| material handoff | `HostHandoffTargetRef` | delivery / observation / acceptance each retain its own optional external version/time inside its summary | `HostHandoffDeliverySafeSummary`、`HostHandoffObservationSafeSummary`、`HostHandoffAcceptanceSafeSummary` | 三层不能互推；local attempt、timeout、receipt、fake、signal 不得构造其中任一层。 |

上表只冻结类型选择和禁止替代，不提前改变概要设计中 domain 字段的 optionality、状态或 transition。未列出 summary 的字段默认没有可构造 summary；若 future port 只能返回 raw body 或无 compatible wrapper，application 必须停在 blocked / waiting / gap / unknown 的 owning surface，而不是退回通用 `ExternalRef`。

#### 8.10.10-a 概要占位名称到本批 contracts carrier 的替换表

本表只规定 03 以后实现契约中的引用类型替换，不回写或改写已停审 02 的概要叙述。`Placeholder` 仍表示 exact upstream schema 未关闭；替换为 typed carrier 不是把对端合同标记为 ready。

| 02 概要 / handoff 名称 | 03 `contracts/src/refs.rs` carrier | 保留的 pending / blocker | 不得误解为 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ExternalRef`（qualification source） | `HostQualificationSourceRef`、`HostPinnedImageSupplyRef`、`HostLaunchCredentialRef`、`HostSandboxBindingRef` 或 `HostCarrierCapabilityRef`，按 `QualificationSourceKind` 在 domain card 选择 | Images / credential / Sandbox exact source contract pending | generic interchangeable ref 或 resolved / ready |
| `ExternalRef` / `ExternalResourceRef`（association / residual） | `HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef` 或 `HostSandboxBindingRef`，按 `HostExternalAssociationKind` / finding kind 选择 | carrier/Sandbox exact resource and cleanup schema pending | backend truth、`HostId`、resource lifecycle或 release complete |

| `SafeExternalSummary`（qualification） | `HostQualificationSafeSummary` | source body / schema pending | verified / fresh / resolved / readiness ready |

| `SafeExternalOutcome`（cleanup / release） | `HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary` | cleanup feedback contract pending | release / cleanup complete |

| `ExternalDeliverySummary` | `HostHandoffDeliverySafeSummary` | delivery feedback schema pending | observation / acceptance |
| `ExternalObservationSummary` | `HostHandoffObservationSafeSummary` | observation owner contract pending | delivery / acceptance |
| `ExternalAcceptanceSummary` | `HostHandoffAcceptanceSafeSummary` | consumer acceptance contract pending | delivery / observation / global approval |
| `MemberRegistrationRefPlaceholder` | `HostMemberRegistrationRef` | Member exact register contract pending (`MSVC-UP-002`) | Member registration truth or local accepted |

`HostTruthOwnerRef`、`FormalChangeSourceRef`、`FormalControlSourceRef` 和本地 host / decision / history ref 都不属于 externally-owned safe-reference group；它们仍必须在对应 domain / application object group 另行闭合。`HostIntentSourceRef` 与 `HostControlScopeRef` 的 body-free consumption carrier 已在随后 `6.1-f` 的 `contracts/src/refs.rs` 闭合；这不把它们升级为 external truth，也不把 external-safe ref 用作 formal-control authority。

### 8.10.14 `6.1-f`：formal intent / control shared carrier corrective closure

#### 8.10.14.1 发现、范围与唯一 owner

在准备进入 `domain/src/control.rs` 的 `CMP-MS-01` 前，按 `02_hld_step_06_key_objects.md` §6、`02_hld_step_07_interface_skeleton.md` §4 和 `02_hld_step_08_processing_flows.md` §4 反查发现：`HostIntent` 的 public input、domain record、history 因果链与后续 decision object 同时需要 `HostIntentId/Ref`、formal source、双锚 project-member control scope、requested / decided action、acceptance status 和 local decision status；此前 `6.1-a~e-b` 只写了 `HostIntentKey` 与 orchestration decision id/ref，尚未给这些 carrier 指定 schema owner。若直接进入 `domain`，实现者只能在 domain、entry 或 adapter 私造同义类型，违反 `contracts -> domain` 依赖方向。

本 corrective closure 不增加第 30 个业务对象，也不定义 L1 Work / Identity、平台运维入口、Member、Runtime、Images、Sandbox、Core / Bus 的 exact DTO、route、envelope、authorization 或 readiness 合同。它只关闭本仓需要消费的 body-free local carrier shape。

| 项 | corrective closure 结论 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-contracts` 的 `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`。domain、application、infra、api、worker、jobs、adapter、fake 与 future protocol DTO 只能导入，禁止 shadow。 |
| 直接输入 | 正式 `00` 的 `BR-MS-001~007`、`FR-MS-001/002`、`D-MS-001~007`；正式 `01` 的 A1 / control-plane 与四语义层分离；正式 `02` `6.2、`7、`8、`9；以及 Step 5 的 seven-crate owner map。 |
| 本批闭合的 carrier | `HostIntentId/Ref`、`HostIntentSourceKind/Ref`、同时携带 `ProjectMemberRef` 与 `GlobalMemberRef` 的 `HostControlScopeRef`、requested / orchestration action family、intent / decision state、local reason 和 control-policy baseline carrier。`DecisionBasisRef(Set)` 仅在此固定 future domain owner，不进入 contracts。 |
| 本批不闭合的东西 | source resolver / authorization implementation、L1 exact object/event schema、运维 request DTO、command metadata body、repository / UoW、idempotency reservation、history schema、external action / carrier call、Runtime run、Member request、Sandbox backend or policy。 |
| exact-contract 上限 | `HostIntentSourceRef` 和 `HostControlScopeRef` 是本仓 consumption carrier，不表示 source current、actor authorized、scope permitted、source owner ready 或 L1 / operations contract closed。缺 formal mapper / source / scope 时，future entry/application 必须 fail closed 为 rejected / waiting / blocked，不能以 raw string、default scope、GlobalMemberRef、route 或 fake 补造。 |
