| 功能 / capability | 输入 | 输出 | 状态 / 副作用 | 承接 carrier | 后续 Step 承接 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 定位一条本地 intent truth | application id generation 或 local rehydrate | typed local id / ref | 无 intent 写入、不推断 acceptance | `HostIntentId`、`HostIntentRef` | domain `HostIntent`；Step 7 intent repository；Step 8 command / result |
| 保留 formal intent 来源类别与 opaque 定位锚 | future formal source mapper 的 category + body-free opaque reference，或 local persisted safe record | typed source ref | 无 source fetch、authorization 或 external truth write | `HostIntentSourceKind`、`HostIntentSourceRef` | domain policy input；Step 7 source mapper; Step 8 `IB-MS-001` |
| 保留已映射的项目成员控制范围与身份锚 | typed `ProjectMemberRef` + typed `GlobalMemberRef` + mapped opaque scope anchor | dual-anchor-bound scope ref | 无 scope evaluation、owner lookup 或 L1 relation inference | `HostControlScopeRef` | domain `HostControlPolicy`；Step 7 formal scope / anchor mapper；Step 8 `IB-MS-001` |
| 表达 external requested lifecycle category | formal intent mapper 的 requested local category | finite requested action | 无 host progression、carrier call或 action completion | `HostLifecycleAction` / set | domain intent / policy；Step 8 command |
| 表达本仓 explicit orchestration conclusion | loaded accepted intent + current facts 的 domain choice | finite local decision action | 无 decision commit、attempt、dispatch 或 external completion | `HostOrchestrationAction` | domain decision; Step 9 `IB-MS-002` flow |
| 固定 intent / decision 状态与原因分类 | domain transition / policy guard already selected local conclusion | finite status / body-free code | immutable carrier itself has no transition | intent / decision state and reason family | domain state; Step 8 result mapping; Step 10 state matrix |
| 保留已提交 decision 的本地因果 basis | accepted intent + selected local current facts / prior decision ref | ordered typed basis set | no fact lookup, no current-pointer mutation | `DecisionBasisRef(Set)` | domain decision; Step 7 fact reader; Step 9 transaction |

#### 8.10.14.3 `HostIntentId` 与 `HostIntentRef`

##### `HostIntentId`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Identifies one locally owned host-intent record.
pub struct HostIntentId(String);

impl HostIntentId {
    /// Creates an intent identity from a locally generated opaque value.
    pub fn from_generated(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted intent identity without asserting its acceptance state.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Returns the opaque identity for typed local persistence or reference mapping.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `String` | `HostIntent` 的稳定本地 identity | 只来自 application id generator 或 local intent repository rehydrate；非空、opaque；不得从 source ref、ProjectMemberRef、action、correlation、timestamp、route 或 external body 拼接。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_generated(String)` | 封装本地生成 identity | value 为本仓 id generator 输出 | `Option<HostIntentId>` | 空值为 `None`；不 record / accept / reject intent。 |
| `from_persisted(String)` | 重建已有 identity | value 为 local store safe value | `Option<HostIntentId>` | 不读取 source、不判断 replay、不把 historical record 解释为 current intent。 |
| `as_str(&self)` | 提供 typed storage/reference mapping value | 无 | `&str` | 业务代码不得解析字符串语义。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| local identity only | 不得以 L1 Work change id、Identity event id、operator request id、Member request id、Runtime run id 或 backend resource id 代替。 |
| identity is not acceptance | id 存在不表示 source formal、双锚一致、scope permitted、intent accepted 或 decision committed。 |
| no caller authorization | public factory 只形成 opaque carrier；id generator、UoW 与 domain record factory 仍在 application/domain owner。 |

##### `HostIntentRef`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// References one locally owned host-intent record without carrying the intent body or acceptance state.
pub struct HostIntentRef {
    /// Stable identity of the referenced local host intent.
    pub intent_id: HostIntentId,
}

impl HostIntentRef {
    /// Creates a typed reference from a stable local host-intent identity.
    pub fn new(intent_id: HostIntentId) -> Self;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intent_id` | `HostIntentId` | 定位本地 `HostIntent` | 由已生成或已持久化 local id 构造；可进入 decision、history、material 和 future public result，但不携带 requested action、source、scope、status、reason 或 body。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostIntentRef::new(HostIntentId)` | 形成 typed local reference | stable local intent id | `HostIntentRef` | 无 I/O；不证明 ref 指向 accepted intent。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| ref 不是 formal source ref | 不得把 `HostIntentRef` 当成 `HostIntentSourceRef`、L1 object ref、operator request ref 或 source authorization proof。 |
| ref 不是 decision permission | 后续 `HostOrchestrationDecision::propose` 必须读取 loaded `HostIntent` 并检查 `Accepted`；仅有 ref 不允许产生 decision。 |

#### 8.10.14.4 formal source 与 subject-bound control scope

##### `HostIntentSourceKind` 与 `HostIntentSourceRef`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Classifies the formal source category mapped into a host-intent reference.
pub enum HostIntentSourceKind {
    /// A project-member assignment, revocation, or equivalent formal work change is the source.
    ProjectMemberChange,
    /// A global-member lifecycle change is the source.
    IdentityLifecycleChange,
    /// A formally mapped operations control request is the source.
    OperationalControlRequest,
}

/// References a formal host-intent source without embedding source-owner truth or request body.
pub struct HostIntentSourceRef {
    /// Closed category supplied by the formal source mapper.
    pub kind: HostIntentSourceKind,
    opaque_source_ref: String,
}

impl HostIntentSourceRef {
    /// Creates a source reference from a body-free formal-source mapping result.
    pub fn from_formal_mapping(
        kind: HostIntentSourceKind,
        opaque_source_ref: String,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted source reference without resolving the external source.
    pub fn from_persisted(
        kind: HostIntentSourceKind,
        opaque_source_ref: String,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the opaque source reference only for typed persistence or formal mapper correlation.
    pub fn as_opaque_ref(&self) -> &str;

    /// Returns whether two source references have the same category and opaque identity.
    pub fn same_source(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 / 变体 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ProjectMemberChange` | `HostIntentSourceKind` | 标记来源为 L1 Work 的项目成员正式变化 | future source mapper 只在能够按正式 L1 boundary 识别此类别时构造；不复制 ProjectMember body、assignment body 或 event envelope。 |
| `IdentityLifecycleChange` | `HostIntentSourceKind` | 标记来源为 L1 Identity 的成员生命周期变化 | future source mapper 只在正式 source boundary 允许时构造；不复制 identity body、authorization result或 lifecycle event body。 |
| `OperationalControlRequest` | `HostIntentSourceKind` | 标记来源为正式映射后的运维控制请求 | exact operations entry / authorization contract 尚未定义；缺 mapper / owner confirmation 时不得构造 positive source ref，future path must wait or reject. |
| `kind` | `HostIntentSourceKind` | 保留 source category，禁止 opaque ref 跨类别解释 | 只能来自 `from_formal_mapping` 或 persisted rehydrate；不由 route、topic、actor、request id 或 source string prefix猜测。 |
| `opaque_source_ref` | private `String` | 对 source-owner formal record 的 body-free opaque定位锚 | mapper output 或 local safe persistence；trim 后非空；不是 raw source body、URL、credential、external DTO、authorization policy、event payload 或 evidence/report。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_formal_mapping(HostIntentSourceKind, String)` | 形成 mapped source carrier | source category 和 mapper 已产生的 opaque ref | `Result<HostIntentSourceRef, ContractError>` | 空值返回 `EmptyPublicText { field: "host_intent_source_ref" }`；不读取 L1 / operations source、不验证 currentness或 actor authority。 |
| `from_persisted(HostIntentSourceKind, String)` | 重建已有 safe source relation | persisted category/ref | `Result<HostIntentSourceRef, ContractError>` | 空值返回同一 structural error；不以历史 source ref重建或确认当前 authorization。 |
| `same_source(&self, &Self)` | 判断 stable source identity | another typed source ref | `bool` | 比较 kind + opaque ref；不比较 freshness、不进行 L1 lookup。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ProjectMemberChange` | `A project-member assignment, revocation, or equivalent formal work change is the source.` | work-side formal source category | formal source mapper | `HostIntent.source_ref`、history causality；不得直接成为 command body |
| `IdentityLifecycleChange` | `A global-member lifecycle change is the source.` | identity-side formal source category | formal source mapper | 同上；不得成为 Identity truth copy |
| `OperationalControlRequest` | `A formally mapped operations control request is the source.` | operations source category | formal operations mapper after owner contract exists | 同上；exact entry remains pending |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| category is not authority | source kind/ref 不代表 source current、actor authorized、scope permitted、action valid、L1 owner ready 或 control decision committed。`HostControlPolicy` 必须在 loaded context 中给出 local conclusion。 |
| no generic external fallback | 不得退回 `ExternalRef`、`String`、raw URI、topic/offset、request body或 fake map；缺 exact mapper 的 sibling boundary保持 `MSVC-UP-001~008` 的 pending / blocked 语义。 |
| no source-owner truth | 本类型不保存 Work assignment、Identity lifecycle、运维 request、Governance approval、Member/Runtime/Sandbox state 或任何 external body。 |

##### `HostControlScopeRef`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// References the mapped dual-anchor control scope for one project-member host-intent evaluation.
pub struct HostControlScopeRef {
    /// Project-scoped execution subject to which this mapped control scope is bound.
    pub project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Identity anchor that the formal scope mapper proved corresponds to the project-scoped subject.
    pub global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    opaque_scope_ref: String,
}

impl HostControlScopeRef {
    /// Creates a subject-bound scope reference from an already mapped body-free control scope.
    pub fn from_mapped_scope(
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        opaque_scope_ref: String,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted subject-bound scope reference without resolving scope ownership.
    pub fn from_persisted(
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        opaque_scope_ref: String,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether this scope is bound to one supplied project-member subject.
    pub fn matches_subject(&self, project_member_ref: &ProjectMemberRef) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this scope carries exactly the supplied mapped project and identity anchors.
    pub fn matches_anchors(
        &self,
        project_member_ref: &ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: &GlobalMemberRef,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether two references have the same subject-bound opaque scope identity.
    pub fn same_scope(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_member_ref` | `ProjectMemberRef` | 将 control scope 固定到唯一当前执行主语 | 来自 future entry 的 typed project-member input 与 formal scope / anchor mapper 已验证的对应关系；`GlobalMemberRef`、Workspace view、host/backend id 均不得替代。 |
| `global_member_ref` | `GlobalMemberRef` | 固定与该项目执行主语一致的身份锚 | 必须由同一次 formal scope / anchor mapping 与 `project_member_ref` 一起产生，或从已保存的同一双锚 relation rehydrate；不得由 opaque scope text、route、actor、host/backend id、Identity lookup 的临时结果或 fake 猜测。 |
| `opaque_scope_ref` | private `String` | body-free mapped project / host control scope identity | formal scope mapper output 或 local safe persistence；trim 后非空；不得保存 L1 Work body、authorization policy body、project config、resource list、endpoint、credential或 raw request。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_mapped_scope(ProjectMemberRef, GlobalMemberRef, String)` | 形成双锚绑定的 scope carrier | typed execution subject、由同次 formal mapping 产生的 identity anchor、mapped opaque scope ref | `Result<HostControlScopeRef, ContractError>` | 只检验 opaque scope 非空及三者都已给出；不调用 Work / Identity / Governance、不自行证明双锚对应关系或判 control allowed。缺正式 mapper result 时不得构造。 |
| `from_persisted(ProjectMemberRef, GlobalMemberRef, String)` | 重建历史双锚 scope relation | persisted typed subject / identity anchor / scope ref | `Result<HostControlScopeRef, ContractError>` | 不把 historical scope 或 historical anchor relation 自动视为 current、authorized或 usable。 |
| `matches_subject(&self, &ProjectMemberRef)` | 检查 scope 的 typed subject binding | current candidate subject | `bool` | 只比较 typed ref；不查询 Work truth。 |
| `matches_anchors(&self, &ProjectMemberRef, &GlobalMemberRef)` | 检查已携带的双锚是否与候选完全一致 | current candidate subject 与 identity anchor | `bool` | 只比较两个 typed anchor；不从 opaque scope text 推导映射、不调用 Work / Identity、不证明 currentness / authorization。 |
| `same_scope(&self, &Self)` | 比较 subject-bound opaque scope identity | other typed scope ref | `bool` | 只比较 subject + opaque scope；不作 scope containment / inheritance / allow decision。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| dual-anchor-bound and project-only | 任何不能同时携带已映射 `ProjectMemberRef` 和相应 `GlobalMemberRef` 的 control scope 都不能构造；非项目型输入必须由 future entry/domain flow fail closed。 |
| no inferred anchor relation | `matches_anchors` 只检查已映射 carrier 中的值相等；它不证明 L1 当前 relation。scope text、source category、actor、route、host、generation、endpoint、backend resource、cache、default 或 fake 均不得补造 / 推断第二锚。 |
| no authorization shadow | scope ref 不等于 governance approval、permission、allowlist、policy transmission、config selection或 externally effective policy。`MSVC-UP-005` 仍 pending，本类型不得被误写为 policy input path。 |
| no host existence leak | 不能从 scope ref 推断 current host、host existence、generation、registration、Runtime session 或 backend resource。 |

#### 8.10.14.5 requested lifecycle 与 orchestration action carrier

##### `HostLifecycleAction` 与 `HostLifecycleActionSet`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Classifies one lifecycle change explicitly requested for a project-scoped host.
pub enum HostLifecycleAction {
    /// Requests creation of a new logical host lifecycle path.
    Launch,
    /// Requests a new host generation after an explicit restart decision.
    Restart,
    /// Requests explicit replacement of the current host by a new generation.
    Replace,
    /// Requests controlled stopping of the current host lifecycle path.
    Stop,
    /// Requests controlled termination and subsequent local closure handling.
    Terminate,
    /// Requests relocation through an explicit host-control decision.
    Relocate,
}

/// Carries a canonical declared set of lifecycle actions supported by the current control baseline.
pub struct HostLifecycleActionSet(Vec<HostLifecycleAction>);

impl HostLifecycleActionSet {
    /// Returns the immutable lifecycle-action baseline declared for the current project-only scope.
    pub fn current_scope_baseline() -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a previously declared canonical action set without loading configuration.
    pub fn from_persisted(
        actions: Vec<HostLifecycleAction>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether one requested lifecycle action belongs to this declared baseline.
    pub fn contains(&self, action: HostLifecycleAction) -> bool;

    /// Returns canonical actions without permitting mutation of the declared set.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[HostLifecycleAction];
}
```

| 字段 / 变体 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Launch` | `HostLifecycleAction` | 请求建立新的逻辑宿主路径 | 仅由 formal intent mapper 映射；不创建 `MemberExecutionHost`、backend resource 或 Runtime run。 |
| `Restart` | `HostLifecycleAction` | 请求经显式决定重启 | formal intent mapper；若后续被允许，CMP-MS-03 仍必须建立新 generation，不能原地修改旧 host。 |
| `Replace` | `HostLifecycleAction` | 请求替换当前 host | formal intent mapper；不得把 external replacement observation 当作 intent。 |
| `Stop` | `HostLifecycleAction` | 请求受控停止 | formal intent mapper；不代表 local closure、cleanup dispatch 或 external cleanup complete。 |
| `Terminate` | `HostLifecycleAction` | 请求受控终止 | formal intent mapper；不等于 backend destroy、Sandbox release 或 Runtime termination result。 |
| `Relocate` | `HostLifecycleAction` | 请求经显式决定迁移 / relocation | formal intent mapper；具体 carrier、target、backend 和 cross-owner protocol 仍 pending。 |
| `0` | private `Vec<HostLifecycleAction>` | 当前 project-only control baseline 中允许的 requested action 集合 | `current_scope_baseline` 返回 declaration order 的六个 current variants；`from_persisted` 只 rehydrate previously declared set，必须 non-empty、ordered-unique、不可含未定义 variant；不从 04 config、feature flag、adapter capability、fake 或 external source 动态扩张。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `current_scope_baseline()` | 给出当前正式设计声明的 action baseline | 无 | `HostLifecycleActionSet` | 返回 `Launch, Restart, Replace, Stop, Terminate, Relocate` 的 declaration order；不是运行时可调 allowlist。 |
| `from_persisted(Vec<HostLifecycleAction>)` | 重建已保存 baseline | persisted actions | `Result<HostLifecycleActionSet, ContractError>` | 空、duplicate 或 noncanonical order 返回 `InvalidCarrierCombination` / `DuplicateContractSetMember` / `NonCanonicalContractSetOrder`；不自动排序、补齐或删除。 |
| `contains(HostLifecycleAction)` | 判断 requested action 是否属于 declared set | requested action | `bool` | pure membership；不作 scope、source、generation、current-host 或 authorization 判断。 |
| `as_slice()` | 只读取 canonical action set | 无 | `&[HostLifecycleAction]` | 调用方不得将结果用作 mutable config 或 external capability claim。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Launch` | `Requests creation of a new logical host lifecycle path.` | requested launch category | formal intent mapper | `HostIntent.requested_action`、`HostControlPolicy` |
| `Restart` | `Requests a new host generation after an explicit restart decision.` | requested restart category | formal intent mapper | 同上；经 committed decision 后才能进入 generation progression |
| `Replace` | `Requests explicit replacement of the current host by a new generation.` | requested replacement category | formal intent mapper | 同上；不直接成为 backend request |
| `Stop` | `Requests controlled stopping of the current host lifecycle path.` | requested stop category | formal intent mapper | 同上；不等于 cleanup result |
| `Terminate` | `Requests controlled termination and subsequent local closure handling.` | requested terminate category | formal intent mapper | 同上；不等于 external termination |
| `Relocate` | `Requests relocation through an explicit host-control decision.` | requested relocation category | formal intent mapper | 同上；carrier / target contract remains pending |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| requested action is not a decision | `HostLifecycleAction` 只表达 formal input category；没有 accepted intent、scope/source/subject guard、current facts 和 local commit 时，不得生成 `HostOrchestrationDecision`。 |
| no `NoAction` / `Hold` request | `NoAction` 与 `Hold` 只能是本仓 decision conclusion，不能由 caller 请求、从 route 推断或以空 action 代替。 |
| recovery stays separate | `Recover` 不是本 enum variant；健康处置由后续 `HostRecoveryDecision / HostRecoveryAction` 单独拥有，不能借 CMP-MS-01 吞并。 |
| immutable boundary | action baseline 的变更是正式需求 / 架构范围变更，不是 04 配置、adapter discovery、fake 或 operations request 的自由输入。 |

##### `HostOrchestrationAction`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Classifies one explicit local orchestration conclusion without asserting external execution.
pub enum HostOrchestrationAction {
    /// The local decision concludes that a launch path may be progressed.
    Launch,
    /// The local decision concludes that a restart path may be progressed.
    Restart,
    /// The local decision concludes that a replacement path may be progressed.
    Replace,
    /// The local decision concludes that a stop path may be progressed.
    Stop,
    /// The local decision concludes that a termination path may be progressed.
    Terminate,
    /// The local decision concludes that a relocation path may be progressed.
    Relocate,
    /// The local decision preserves a non-progressing hold because a required local guard is not safely passable.
    Hold,
    /// The local decision intentionally selects no lifecycle progression.
    NoAction,
}

impl HostOrchestrationAction {
    /// Maps one requested lifecycle category into the corresponding candidate orchestration category.
    pub fn from_requested(action: HostLifecycleAction) -> Self;

    /// Returns the corresponding requested category when this conclusion represents one.
    pub fn requested_action(&self) -> Option<HostLifecycleAction>;

    /// Returns whether this conclusion intentionally avoids lifecycle progression.
    pub fn avoids_progression(&self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 / 变体 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Launch` / `Restart` / `Replace` / `Stop` / `Terminate` / `Relocate` | `HostOrchestrationAction` | 保存与 requested action 对应的 candidate local control conclusion | 仅由 `HostOrchestrationDecision::propose` 的 domain choice 使用；`from_requested` 只做分类映射，不能绕过 accepted / current-fact / generation / conflict guard。 |
| `Hold` | `HostOrchestrationAction` | 将 unknown、blocked、conflicting 或 otherwise unsafe local control situation 表达为 non-progressing decision conclusion | 只能由 domain decision policy 在已加载 local facts 中选择；不能由 external timeout、adapter availability、fake、query 或 job 自行写入。 |
| `NoAction` | `HostOrchestrationAction` | 明确记录已评估但不推进 lifecycle 的结论 | 只能由 domain decision policy 在 formal accepted intent 与 current facts 上形成；不是 null、missing input、authorization bypass 或 hidden retry。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_requested(HostLifecycleAction)` | 进行 requested-to-candidate category mapping | formal requested category | `HostOrchestrationAction` | pure mapping；不 commit decision、不创建 host/attempt、不发起 external call。 |
| `requested_action()` | 读取 conclusion 对应的 requested category | 无 | `Option<HostLifecycleAction>` | `Hold` / `NoAction` 返回 `None`；不能据此证明 intent accepted或 decision committed。 |
| `avoids_progression()` | 判断 conclusion 是否有意不推进 lifecycle | 无 | `bool` | 仅 `Hold` / `NoAction` 返回 true；不等于 decision terminal、closure completed 或 action cancelled。 |

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Launch` | `The local decision concludes that a launch path may be progressed.` | launch decision conclusion | accepted intent + current-fact domain choice | committed decision then qualification / generation use case |
| `Restart` | `The local decision concludes that a restart path may be progressed.` | restart decision conclusion | 同上 | committed decision then new-generation path; not Runtime recovery |
| `Replace` | `The local decision concludes that a replacement path may be progressed.` | replacement decision conclusion | 同上 | committed decision then replacement / closure-related local work |
| `Stop` | `The local decision concludes that a stop path may be progressed.` | stop decision conclusion | 同上 | committed decision then closure-related local work |
| `Terminate` | `The local decision concludes that a termination path may be progressed.` | termination decision conclusion | 同上 | committed decision then closure-related local work |
| `Relocate` | `The local decision concludes that a relocation path may be progressed.` | relocation decision conclusion | same-domain choice | committed decision then qualification / new-generation path; adapter contract pending |
| `Hold` | `The local decision preserves a non-progressing hold because a required local guard is not safely passable.` | explicit safe hold | domain policy from loaded local blocker / unknown / conflict facts | history / safe view / later explicit reconsideration; no action attempt |
| `NoAction` | `The local decision intentionally selects no lifecycle progression.` | explicit no-action conclusion | domain policy from accepted intent and current facts | history / safe view; no action attempt |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| local conclusion only | action enum 不代表 carrier call、Member launch、Runtime run, Sandbox bind/release、backend operation、dispatch acknowledgement或 external completion。 |
| recovery not merged | `HostOrchestrationAction` 不含 `Recover`；recovery decision remains separate in CMP-MS-05 even though the overall control plane may later consume its committed ref. |
| hold/no-action remain traceable | `Hold` / `NoAction` 必须仍有 local decision record、basis 与 reason；不得用 missing row、empty response或 ignored command表达。 |

#### 8.10.14.6 intent / decision state, reason, and control-baseline carriers

##### `HostIntentAcceptanceStatus`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Classifies the local acceptance conclusion recorded for one host intent.
pub enum HostIntentAcceptanceStatus {
    /// The project-member subject, identity anchor, source, scope, and requested action passed local intake guards.
    Accepted,
    /// The input violated a current local boundary and was not accepted.
    Rejected,
    /// A required formal source or owner fact is not safely determinable yet.
    Waiting,
    /// The input conflicts with an equivalent intent or committed local control fact.
    Conflict,
}

impl HostIntentAcceptanceStatus {
    /// Returns whether this status permits a later orchestration-decision proposal.
    pub fn permits_decision_proposal(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this status is terminal for the same intent record under the current state model.
    pub fn is_terminal(&self) -> bool;
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Accepted` | `The project-member subject, identity anchor, source, scope, and requested action passed local intake guards.` | 已通过 local intake guard 的 intent conclusion | `HostControlPolicy` on fully mapped local input | `HostOrchestrationDecision::propose`、history / material; not an external action |
| `Rejected` | `The input violated a current local boundary and was not accepted.` | 明确拒绝 | local policy outcome | history / safe response; no decision proposal |
| `Waiting` | `A required formal source or owner fact is not safely determinable yet.` | 等待状态 | local policy outcome when formal input remains pending | later explicit re-evaluation only; no decision proposal |
| `Conflict` | `The input conflicts with an equivalent intent or committed local control fact.` | 冲突结论 | local replay / conflict policy outcome | history / safe response; no second effective decision |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `permits_decision_proposal()` | 判断是否可作为 decision proposal 的 input | 无 | `bool` | only `Accepted` returns true；仍需 loaded intent、current facts、idempotency / revision guard。 |
| `is_terminal()` | 判断 record 在 current state model 是否不可原地成功转写 | 无 | `bool` | `Rejected` / `Conflict` return true; `Accepted` remains effective but not mutable into another acceptance result; `Waiting` may receive a new formal evaluation. |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| no implicit accepted | source ref、scope ref、actor、metadata、replay key或 mapper success 均不自动形成 `Accepted`。 |
| no in-place success rewrite | `Rejected` / `Conflict` 不可原地改为 `Accepted`；新的正式输入或 explicit waiting re-evaluation must create the allowed linked local fact under domain rules. |
| not external state | status 不表示 Work assignment active、Identity valid、Member registered、Runtime running、Sandbox bound 或 carrier action succeeded。 |

##### `LocalDecisionStatus`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Classifies the local lifecycle state of one host-control decision record.
pub enum LocalDecisionStatus {
    /// A decision candidate exists but has not become committed local control truth.
    Proposed,
    /// The decision is committed local control truth and may be consumed only with its guards.
    Committed,
    /// A later explicit local decision replaced this decision's current effect.
    Superseded,
    /// The candidate was invalidated before external progression was allowed.
    Voided,
}

impl LocalDecisionStatus {
    /// Returns whether this record is committed local decision truth.
    pub fn is_committed(&self) -> bool;
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Proposed` | `A decision candidate exists but has not become committed local control truth.` | proposal state | `HostOrchestrationDecision::propose` or later recovery decision factory | local commit or void only |
| `Committed` | `The decision is committed local control truth and may be consumed only with its guards.` | committed local control truth | domain commit transition under UoW | later qualification / generation / closure preparation after permits + generation guard |
| `Superseded` | `A later explicit local decision replaced this decision's current effect.` | historic decision whose active effect ended | domain supersede transition with typed replacement ref | history / causal basis only |
| `Voided` | `The candidate was invalidated before external progression was allowed.` | invalid pre-progression proposal | domain void transition with decision reason | history only; no action progression |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `is_committed()` | 判断 local decision truth 是否已提交 | 无 | `bool` | only `Committed` returns true；does not itself evaluate `permits(action)`, target, expected generation, unknown fence or external result. |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| distinct from intent status | `HostIntentAcceptanceStatus` 与 `LocalDecisionStatus` 不能合并；accepted intent is not committed decision. |
| no result collapse | `Committed` 不表示 host established, attempt prepared/dispatched/succeeded, registration accepted, cleanup complete, delivery, observation or acceptance. |
| no entry mutation | Query、Consumer、Projection、Job 或 adapter cannot write a status directly; only domain transition invoked by application UoW may do so. |

##### `HostIntentReasonCode` 与 `DecisionReasonCode`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Carries one redacted local reason code for a host-intent acceptance conclusion.
pub struct HostIntentReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

impl HostIntentReasonCode {
    /// Creates an intent reason from an already redacted local intake classification.
    pub fn from_intake_classification(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted public-safe intent reason code.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the opaque code for domain, history, or explicit result mapping.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}

/// Carries one redacted local reason code for an orchestration-decision transition.
pub struct DecisionReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

impl DecisionReasonCode {
    /// Creates a decision reason from an already redacted local control classification.
    pub fn from_control_classification(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted public-safe decision reason code.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the opaque code for domain, history, or explicit result mapping.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| carrier | 字段来源 | 使用上限 | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HostIntentReasonCode` | application redaction mapper 已裁剪的 intake policy classification，或 only-public-safe persisted rehydrate | `HostIntent` acceptance / waiting / rejection / conflict fact；future safe result/history mapper | raw source body、actor profile、authorization policy body、route、endpoint、credential、error text或 generic `String` |
| `DecisionReasonCode` | application redaction mapper 已裁剪的 local decision / void / hold / no-action classification，或 safe persisted rehydrate | `HostOrchestrationDecision` transition / history causality；future safe result mapper | action receipt、external feedback、Runtime outcome、Sandbox result、backend error、generic `HostSafeSummaryReason` |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostIntentReasonCode::from_intake_classification(HostRedactedCode)` | 包装 intake reason | already-redacted local code | `HostIntentReasonCode` | pure wrapper；不做 source/subject/scope authorization。 |
| `DecisionReasonCode::from_control_classification(HostRedactedCode)` | 包装 decision reason | already-redacted local code | `DecisionReasonCode` | pure wrapper；不 commit/void/supersede、不选择 action。 |
| `from_persisted(HostRedactedCode)` | 重建已保存 safe code | prior `HostRedactedCode::from_persisted_public_code` output | matching wrapper | 不重新解析、redact或访问 external source。 |
| `as_code()` | 提供 opaque code | 无 | `&str` | 不得反解 code 为 authorization proof、retry policy、external result或 source identity。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| position-specific reason | intake 与 decision reason 不可互换；不建立一个能跨 domain / entry / external surface 随意使用的 `HostReason`。 |
| redaction precedes construction | contracts/domain/adapter/entry/fake cannot make either wrapper from raw `String`; invalid or absent safe code must stay owning rejected / waiting / blocked / unknown path. |
| reason is not state | reason code accompanies a selected local status or transition but cannot mutate status or make a pending dependency positive. |

##### `PolicyRevision`, `ExecutionSubjectKind`, and `HostIntentConflictMode`

###### 类型定义

```rust
/// Identifies one declared member-service control-policy baseline revision.
pub struct PolicyRevision(String);

impl PolicyRevision {
    /// Creates a revision identity from a declared immutable control baseline.
    pub fn from_declared_baseline(value: String) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Rehydrates a previously persisted declared baseline revision.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the opaque revision identity for typed local policy correlation.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}

/// Classifies the execution-subject shape supported by the current host-control scope.
pub enum ExecutionSubjectKind {
    /// The only supported subject is a project-member reference with a separate global-member identity anchor.
    ProjectMemberScoped,
}

/// Classifies the fixed replay and conflict behavior used by the current host-control baseline.
pub enum HostIntentConflictMode {
    /// An equivalent normalized intent reuses the stable existing local conclusion.
    ReplayEquivalent,
    /// A non-equivalent or concurrent conflict records an explicit conflict conclusion.
    RecordConflict,
}
```

| carrier / variant | 作用 | 允许来源 | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PolicyRevision` | 关联 `HostControlPolicy` 与 declared local boundary revision | static declared baseline binding or local persisted policy record; never runtime config | Governance policy revision, environment variable, adapter version, source version, host generation, timestamp |
| `ProjectMemberScoped` | 固定当前唯一执行主语 shape | current formal 00/01/02 project-only scope | GlobalMember-only, Workspace, endpoint, runtime session, backend resource or future third subject |
| `ReplayEquivalent` | 确认等价 intent 走稳定既有结论 | `HostControlPolicy::from_baseline` only | duplicate action dispatch, re-running external effect, arbitrary entry behavior |
| `RecordConflict` | 确认非等价 / 并发冲突保留 explicit conflict | `HostControlPolicy::from_baseline` only | overwrite existing intent, a second effective decision, silent retry |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| policy baseline is not Governance truth | `PolicyRevision` only labels this repository's immutable guard baseline; it does not consume or replace governance approval / policy transmission. `MSVC-UP-005` remains pending. |
| project-only is closed for this scope | `ExecutionSubjectKind` cannot be extended by configuration or a new enum variant in an adapter; adding a third subject requires reopening formal scope/architecture. |
| fixed conflict semantics | no runtime feature flag, fake, adapter, source category, metadata field, or availability signal may change equivalent replay / explicit conflict into implicit action. |

#### 8.10.14.7 domain-only basis and guard input owner routing

Not every type used by `HostOrchestrationDecision` belongs in `contracts`. `DecisionBasisRef(Set)`, `ExistingIntentFacts`, and `CurrentHostFacts` must remain local domain/control vocabulary because they contain selected committed Host Truth and are neither public DTO nor cross-boundary carrier. Their unique future owner is planned `crates/domain/src/control.rs`; they must be closed in the immediately following `6.2 / CMP-MS-01` object group before that object card is marked complete.

| carrier / input | unique owner | permissible contents / sources | forbidden contents / current limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `DecisionBasisRef` / `DecisionBasisRefSet` | `domain/src/control.rs` | typed `HostIntentRef`; `HostControlScopeRef` only after the domain guard checked its dual anchors against the loaded intent; selected `HostRef + HostGeneration`; and typed prior local orchestration decision relation when the loaded local fact supplies them | raw Work / Identity / operations body, generic string ref, external source ref, backend state, Runtime run, Member/Sandbox body, repository version or action receipt |
| `ExistingIntentFacts` | `domain/src/control.rs` | application-provided already-loaded local intent identity/key/status relation needed for pure replay classification | database row, idempotency reservation, digest, raw command, external source lookup or a duplicate result surface |
| `CurrentHostFacts` | `domain/src/control.rs` | application-provided committed local current-host / generation / closure-relevant safe facts selected through future reader port | projection view, carrier/backend observation, external association body, raw signal, repository implementation or external completion |

The owner routing is intentional: Step 6 must not turn domain-internal selected facts into public `contracts` DTOs just to avoid a later object card. Conversely, domain may not reintroduce `HostIntentId/Ref`, formal source, scope, action, state, reason, policy revision, subject kind, or conflict-mode aliases. Step 7 will define only the ports that supply these local facts; it will not invent their schema.

### 8.12 `6.1-g`：qualification / assembly / readiness shared carrier corrective closure

#### 8.12.1 发现、范围与唯一 owner

在 `CMP-MS-01` 停审后、进入已获授权的 `CMP-MS-02` 前，反查正式 `02` §6.3、`02_hld_step_06_key_objects.md` §7、Step 7 interface skeleton §5 与 Step 8 flow §5 发现：`HostQualificationContext`、`HostAssembly`、`HostReadinessDecision` 和 `RequiredQualificationPolicy` 同时需要本地 id/ref、closed state、environment requirement、freshness policy、revision、required-kind set 与 body-free readiness gap。此前 contracts 只拥有 external-safe wrapper、safe public projection carrier 与 control carrier；若直接在 domain 写这些共享 vocabulary，future Command / Query / history / safe mapper 会被迫依赖 domain 或私造同义 type。

本 corrective closure 只关闭本仓的 public/shared type shape，不增加第 30 个业务对象、不定义 qualification source entry、assembly item/outcome、freshness numerical comparison、readiness evaluator、image manifest、credential secret、Sandbox binding body、carrier/backend truth 或任何 sibling schema。

| 项 | `6.1-g` 结论 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-contracts` / `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs`。`domain/src/qualification.rs`、`domain/src/assembly.rs`、application、infra、entry、adapter、fake 和 future DTO 只能导入，不得 shadow 或用 alias 重建。 |
| 直接输入 | 正式 `00` 的 `BR-MS-008~017`、`D-MS-008~017`；正式 `01` 的 Host Truth / control-plane 分层；正式 `02` 的 CMP-MS-02 四对象、`IB-MS-004~006`、处理流与三条状态轴；以及 Step 5 的 crate/file owner map。 |
| 本批闭合的 carrier | `HostQualificationContextId/Ref`、`HostAssemblyId/Ref`、`HostReadinessDecisionId/Ref`、`HostEnvironmentRequirementRef`、`FreshnessPolicyRef`、`AssemblyRevision`、三类 closed status、required source/item kind and ordered-unique set、`FreshnessAssessment`、`QualificationGapCode`、`ReadinessGapRef/Set`。 |
| 留给 domain 的东西 | `QualificationSourceEntry(Set)`、source-ref/summary pairing、item/outcome/set、freshness evaluation input、readiness evaluation input、qualification policy behavior、assembly aggregate transition 与 readiness decision causality。 |
| exact-contract 上限 | Images pinned supply、credential owner、Sandbox binding、carrier capability、Member / Runtime / Core / Bus schema 都继续是 `MSVC-UP-001~008` 范围内的 pending / blocked。carrier construction不代表 source resolved、fresh、binding valid、item complete 或 readiness ready。 |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 定位一次 qualification context | application id generation 或 local context-store rehydrate | typed local context id/ref | 无 source resolve、无 Host Truth 写入 | `HostQualificationContextId`、`HostQualificationContextRef` | domain context、Step 7 store、Step 8 `IB-MS-004` |
| 定位一份 generation-bound assembly | application id generation 或 local assembly-store rehydrate | typed local assembly id/ref | 无 required-item freeze、无 progression | `HostAssemblyId`、`HostAssemblyRef` | domain assembly、Step 7 store、Step 8 `IB-MS-005` |
| 定位一条 immutable readiness conclusion | application id generation 或 local decision-store rehydrate | typed local readiness-decision id/ref | 无 readiness evaluation、无 ready assertion | `HostReadinessDecisionId`、`HostReadinessDecisionRef` | domain readiness、Step 7 store、Step 8 `IB-MS-005/006` |
| 保留环境与 freshness 的 opaque binding | formal requirement/policy mapper 或 local safe persistence | typed opaque requirement/policy ref | 无 requirement lookup、无 policy evaluation | `HostEnvironmentRequirementRef`、`FreshnessPolicyRef` | domain policy input、Step 7 resolver/config seam、Step 14/04 binding |

#### 8.12.3 local qualification-context identity

##### `HostQualificationContextId`

```rust
/// Identifies one locally owned host-qualification context record.
pub struct HostQualificationContextId(String);

impl HostQualificationContextId {
    /// Creates a context identity from a locally generated opaque value.
    pub fn from_generated(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted context identity without asserting resolution or freshness.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Returns the opaque context identity for typed local persistence or reference mapping.
    pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `String` | 一次本仓 qualification context 的稳定 identity | 仅来自 application id generator 或 local context store rehydrate；非空、opaque；不得从 `HostOrchestrationDecisionRef`、subject、generation、source ref、environment ref、timestamp、route 或 external body 拼接。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `from_generated(String)` | 包装新 context identity | application id-generator output | `Option<HostQualificationContextId>` | 空值为 `None`；不创建 context、不调用 resolver、不表示 resolved。 |
| `from_persisted(String)` | 重建已有 identity | local safe stored value | `Option<HostQualificationContextId>` | 不评估 source、freshness、generation或ready。 |
| `as_str()` | 提供 typed storage/reference mapping | 无 | `&str` | 业务代码不得解析 opaque text。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| local identity only | 不是 Identity/Work event id、image supply ref、credential ref、Sandbox binding ref、carrier id、Runtime run id、Member request id或 backend resource id。 |
| identity is not qualification | context id 存在不表示全部 source 已解析、fresh、同世代或可进入 assembly。 |

|---|---|

##### `AssemblyRevision`

```rust
/// Identifies one immutable locally owned revision of a host assembly.
pub struct AssemblyRevision(u64);

impl AssemblyRevision {
    /// Creates the first revision for a newly formed local assembly.
    pub fn initial() -> Self;

    /// Creates the next revision after the assembly aggregate accepted one local fact change.
    pub fn next_after(previous: &Self) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted assembly revision without checking aggregate currentness.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: u64) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether this revision is later than another revision of the same local assembly.
    pub fn is_after(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0` | private `u64` | 同一 local `HostAssembly` 的 immutable revision | `initial()` 只由 domain assembly factory 采用；`next_after` 只承接已接受的同一 aggregate local fact change；repository rehydrate可使用 `from_persisted`。不能由 backend version、source version、event offset、timestamp、generation或 page cursor替代。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `initial()` | 形成新 assembly 的首 revision | 无 | `AssemblyRevision` | 不建立 assembly、不 freeze item、不产生 readiness decision。 |
| `next_after(&Self)` | 表示 accepted local assembly change 后的新 revision | 同一 aggregate 的 prior revision | `AssemblyRevision` | 纯值计算；实际 atomic update / CAS 留 Step 11 / 13。 |
| `from_persisted(u64)` | 重建保存 revision | local stored numeric value | `AssemblyRevision` | 不判断 current、不比较 target generation、不写 store。 |
| `is_after(&Self)` | 同一 aggregate 内纯顺序比较 | other local assembly revision | `bool` | 不可跨 assembly / host 推导 currentness。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| revision is not generation | generation 区分 host instance；revision 只区分同一 assembly 的本地事实版本。二者必须共同进入 readiness basis，不能互相替代。 |
| revision is not optimistic-store version | repository expected version / transaction CAS 由 future application/infra port 单独拥有。 |

#### 8.12.6 closed qualification, assembly, and readiness state

```rust
/// Classifies the local resolution conclusion for one host-qualification context.
pub enum QualificationResolutionStatus {
    /// All required source entries are locally evaluable and satisfy the selected freshness classification.
    Resolved,
    /// Some required source entries are locally evaluable while others remain absent or unresolved.
    Partial,
    /// At least one required source entry has no usable formal reference or safe summary.
    Missing,
    /// At least one required source entry is not usable under the selected freshness classification.
    Stale,
    /// Required subject, source, scope, anchor, or generation facts are mutually incompatible.
    Conflict,
    /// A required source, contract, or outcome cannot be safely determined.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies the aggregate-local assembly condition for one host generation.
pub enum HostAssemblyStatus {
    /// Required item selection or qualification input is still being collected.
    Collecting,
    /// Required items are frozen and matching local item facts are being recorded.
    Progressing,
    /// Every frozen required item has a locally acceptable matching outcome.
    Complete,
    /// A required contract, source, or prerequisite prevents positive assembly progression.
    Blocked,
    /// At least one frozen required item has an explicit locally unacceptable outcome.
    Failed,
    /// A required item result or external-effect boundary cannot be safely determined.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies one immutable generation-bound host-readiness conclusion.
pub enum HostReadinessStatus {
    /// Same-generation required qualification and assembly conditions satisfy local readiness semantics.
    Ready,
    /// A required contract, owner boundary, or no-fallback guard blocks readiness.
    Blocked,
    /// A permitted future source or item outcome is still awaited.
    Waiting,
    /// A required condition has an explicit locally unacceptable result.
    Failed,
    /// Freshness, source, item, or effect status cannot be safely determined.
    Unknown,
}
```

| enum / variant | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `QualificationResolutionStatus::Resolved` | `All required source entries are locally evaluable and satisfy the selected freshness classification.` | context local resolution conclusion | domain qualification policy over domain-owned entries / assessment | assembly eligibility only；不等于 ready/registered/healthy。 |
| `Partial` | `Some required source entries are locally evaluable while others remain absent or unresolved.` | explicit incomplete qualification | domain policy conclusion | history / safe summary / blocked-or-waiting readiness evaluation；不得进入 positive assembly. |
| `Missing` | `At least one required source entry has no usable formal reference or safe summary.` | required source absence | domain policy conclusion | gap/history/readiness non-ready surface。 |
| `Stale` | `At least one required source entry is not usable under the selected freshness classification.` | freshness failure | domain assessment/policy conclusion | re-evaluation marker / non-ready surface；不能由 cache / local receipt修复。 |
| `Conflict` | `Required subject, source, scope, anchor, or generation facts are mutually incompatible.` | incompatible local facts | domain policy conclusion | conflict/gap/history；不得覆盖旧 context。 |
| `Unknown` | `A required source, contract, or outcome cannot be safely determined.` | fail-closed unresolved boundary | domain policy conclusion | unknown/gap/history；不得默认 resolved。 |
| `HostAssemblyStatus::Collecting` | `Required item selection or qualification input is still being collected.` | pre-freeze or incomplete assembly aggregate | `HostAssembly::assemble` / domain transition | later progressing / blocked / failed / unknown；不是 ready。 |
| `Progressing` | `Required items are frozen and matching local item facts are being recorded.` | frozen item work in progress | domain transition | complete / blocked / failed / unknown；不表示 dispatch success。 |
| `Complete` | `Every frozen required item has a locally acceptable matching outcome.` | local aggregate completion | domain transition | independent readiness evaluation only；不能自身变成 Ready。 |
| `Blocked` | `A required contract, source, or prerequisite prevents positive assembly progression.` | fail-closed assembly block | domain transition | history/gap/re-evaluation input；不由 config/fake解除。 |
| `Failed` | `At least one frozen required item has an explicit locally unacceptable outcome.` | explicit local item failure | domain transition | non-ready decision / later recovery input；不自动 trigger recovery。 |
| `Unknown` | `A required item result or external-effect boundary cannot be safely determined.` | unknown-effect fence | domain transition | unknown/gap/reconciliation input；不得盲重放。 |
| `HostReadinessStatus::Ready` | `Same-generation required qualification and assembly conditions satisfy local readiness semantics.` | local same-generation readiness decision | domain readiness evaluator only | registration prerequisite / safe summary；不等于 registered、healthy、Runtime ready或 Sandbox/backend ready。 |
| `Blocked` | `A required contract, owner boundary, or no-fallback guard blocks readiness.` | positive path prohibited | domain readiness evaluator | safe summary / history / later re-evaluation；不得 fallback。 |
| `Waiting` | `A permitted future source or item outcome is still awaited.` | non-terminal wait | domain readiness evaluator | safe summary / later new decision；不是 success。 |
| `Failed` | `A required condition has an explicit locally unacceptable result.` | explicit local readiness failure | domain readiness evaluator | history / recovery input；不得被 heartbeat/registration覆盖。 |
| `Unknown` | `Freshness, source, item, or effect status cannot be safely determined.` | fail-closed decision | domain readiness evaluator | safe summary / reconciliation；不得升格 ready。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| three axes remain distinct | qualification、assembly 和 readiness 各有 owner/state；不得引入 `HostStatus`，不得把状态枚举互相转换。 |
| complete is not ready | `HostAssemblyStatus::Complete` 只能成为 readiness evaluator 的输入；不存在 `Complete -> Ready` enum conversion、factory default或mapper shortcut。 |
| ready has a narrow meaning | `Ready` 只表达同 generation 的本地 qualification+assembly 语义；不证明 registration、endpoint、session、health、Runtime、Sandbox、image owner 或 external action truth。 |

#### 8.12.7 required kind sets, freshness assessment, and gap carriers

##### Required source and assembly-item kind sets

```rust
/// Classifies the owner category of one required qualification source.
pub enum RequiredSourceKind {
    /// A project-member assignment or work eligibility source supplied by the formal Work boundary.
    ProjectMemberQualification,
    /// A global-member identity or lifecycle source supplied by the formal Identity boundary.
    GlobalMemberQualification,
    /// A pinned image supply source supplied by the member-images boundary.
    PinnedImageSupply,
    /// An instance-bound launch credential qualification source.
    LaunchCredential,
    /// A host-level Sandbox binding qualification source.
    SandboxBinding,
    /// A host-carrier capability qualification source.
    CarrierCapability,
}

/// Carries a canonical ordered unique set of required qualification-source categories.
pub struct RequiredSourceKindSet(Vec<RequiredSourceKind>);

impl RequiredSourceKindSet {
    /// Creates a set from a declared canonical order without sorting or deduplicating caller input.
    pub fn try_new(values: Vec<RequiredSourceKind>) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the required source categories without permitting mutation.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[RequiredSourceKind];

    /// Returns whether a source category is required by this set.
    pub fn contains(&self, value: RequiredSourceKind) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies one required host-assembly item category.
pub enum AssemblyItemKind {
    /// The environment requirement binding selected for the host generation.
    EnvironmentRequirement,
    /// The pinned image supply needed to instantiate the host.
    PinnedImageSupply,
    /// The launch credential qualification needed for this host instance.
    LaunchCredential,
    /// The host-level Sandbox binding qualification or association prerequisite.
    SandboxBinding,
    /// The carrier or registry capability needed by the host-side assembly path.
    CarrierCapability,
}

/// Carries a canonical ordered unique set of required assembly-item categories.
pub struct RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet(Vec<AssemblyItemKind>);

impl RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet {
    /// Creates a set from a declared canonical order without sorting or deduplicating caller input.
    pub fn try_new(values: Vec<AssemblyItemKind>) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns the required item categories without permitting mutation.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[AssemblyItemKind];

    /// Returns whether an item category is required by this set.
    pub fn contains(&self, value: AssemblyItemKind) -> bool;
}
```

| 类型 / 变体 | 作用与来源 | 允许去向 | 禁止解释 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RequiredSourceKind` | 只分类 required owner source；具体 source ref / summary 仍由 domain `QualificationSourceEntry` 选择 | `RequiredQualificationPolicy`、domain completeness evaluation | 不表示 source 存在、verified、fresh、owner ready或 contract closed。 |
| `RequiredSourceKindSet` | 固定声明的 required source 分类和 canonical order | domain policy factory / Step 7 resolver selection | canonical order **恰为 `RequiredSourceKind` declaration order**：`ProjectMemberQualification -> GlobalMemberQualification -> PinnedImageSupply -> LaunchCredential -> SandboxBinding -> CarrierCapability`；不从 action、config、arrival order或 cache动态增删；不携带 source body。 |
| `AssemblyItemKind` | 只分类本地 readiness 前的装配项类别；不定义 item body / target / outcome | `HostAssembly`、domain readiness evaluation | canonical order **恰为 `AssemblyItemKind` declaration order**：`EnvironmentRequirement -> PinnedImageSupply -> LaunchCredential -> SandboxBinding -> CarrierCapability`；不表示 item 已准备、已 dispatch、已成功或 external resource active。`MemberRegistration` 与 `RuntimeSession` 分别属于 CMP-MS-04 的下游 registration / session truth，永久不得成为本集合或 readiness-required item。 |
| `RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet` | 固定声明的 required item 分类和 canonical order | domain policy / assembly factory | 不由 backend capability、fake、registration或 runtime status临时扩展 / 删除；若新 item 需进入此闭集，必须回退正式 00/01/02，而非在 Step 6 增加 enum variant。 |

| 构造 / 成员函数 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 | 结构不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `try_new(Vec<...>)` | 封装已声明的 ordered-unique set | caller-declared values -> `Result<Set, ContractError>` | 两类 set 均按其 **enum declaration order** 验证；empty 返回 `InvalidCarrierCombination { owner: "required_source_kind_set" }` 或 `"required_assembly_item_kind_set"`，duplicate 返回 `DuplicateContractSetMember`，非该顺序返回 `NonCanonicalContractSetOrder`；不自动排序、去重、补 baseline。 |
| `as_slice()` | 只读暴露 canonical members | 无 -> `&[...]` | 调用方不得转为可变 config / allowlist。 |
| `contains(value)` | 纯 membership check | closed enum value -> `bool` | 不作 source resolution、assembly status或authorization判断。 |

##### `FreshnessAssessment`

```rust
/// Records the local freshness classification of one qualification context without embedding threshold policy.
pub struct FreshnessAssessment {
    /// Classification selected by the domain freshness evaluator.
    pub status: FreshnessAssessmentStatus,
    /// Optional safe reason explaining a non-fresh or indeterminate classification.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    /// Optional source-side captured time supplied by the owner mapper.
    pub captured_at: Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>,
}

/// Classifies freshness for a local qualification assessment.
pub enum FreshnessAssessmentStatus {
    /// All selected required sources satisfy the bound freshness policy.
    Fresh,
    /// At least one required source is outside the bound freshness policy.
    Stale,
    /// Freshness cannot be determined from the available owner-safe evidence.
    Unknown,
}

impl FreshnessAssessment {
    /// Creates an assessment from a domain evaluator result and optional owner-captured time.
    pub fn from_evaluation(
        status: FreshnessAssessmentStatus,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
        captured_at: Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Returns whether the assessment is explicitly fresh.
    pub fn is_fresh(&self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 / 变体 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | 表达 domain evaluator 的 fresh / stale / unknown 结论 | 只能由 domain evaluation 传入；contracts 不比较 timestamp、duration或 policy threshold。 |
| `reason` | 为 stale / unknown 保留 body-free safe reason | 只能使用已验证 `HostSafeSummaryReason`；`Fresh` 必须为 `None`，不得含 raw error。 |
| `captured_at` | 可选保留 owner source 的 captured time | 只能来自 owner mapper；不等于本地 accepted_at、assembly updated_at、source version或 clock fallback。 |
| `Fresh` | selected required source 满足 policy | domain evaluator output；不等于 qualification resolved 或 readiness ready。 |
| `Stale` | 至少一个 required source 超出 policy | domain evaluator output；必须保持非 ready。 |
| `Unknown` | 无法安全判定 freshness | domain evaluator output；必须 fail closed。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 返回 | 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `from_evaluation(...)` | 构造 immutable assessment | `Result<FreshnessAssessment, ContractError>` | `Fresh` + reason 不允许；不调用 policy/source。 |
| `is_fresh()` | 纯分类 helper | `bool` | 仅 `Fresh` 返回 true；不证明 source current 或 ready。 |

##### `QualificationGapCode`

```rust
/// Carries one closed, body-free reason category for a qualification gap.
pub enum QualificationGapCode {
    /// A required formal source reference or safe summary is missing.
    MissingSource,
    /// A required source is present but outside the allowed freshness classification.
    StaleSource,
    /// A source, subject, scope, anchor, or generation relation conflicts locally.
    ConflictingSource,
    /// The upstream source or contract is not yet available for safe evaluation.
    PendingContract,
    /// An owner-safe source result is indeterminate and must remain fail-closed.
    UnknownSource,
    /// A required assembly prerequisite is absent or cannot be safely selected.
    MissingRequirement,
    /// A required generation-bound item does not match the target generation.
    GenerationMismatch,
    /// A required external capability is explicitly unavailable for this path.
    CapabilityUnavailable,
    /// A required local assembly item awaits a matching outcome without asserting an external effect state.
    PendingItemOutcome,
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc / 作用 | 允许来源 | 禁止解释 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MissingSource` | `A required formal source reference or safe summary is missing.` | domain qualification evaluator | 不表示 external object deleted。 |
| `StaleSource` | `A required source is present but outside the allowed freshness classification.` | domain freshness evaluator | 不以 local clock / cache hit改成 fresh。 |
| `ConflictingSource` | `A source, subject, scope, anchor, or generation relation conflicts locally.` | domain consistency guard | 不覆盖旧 context或选择任一 side silently。 |
| `PendingContract` | `The upstream source or contract is not yet available for safe evaluation.` | formal boundary / blocker mapping | 不表示 contract eventually ready。 |
| `UnknownSource` | `An owner-safe source result is indeterminate and must remain fail-closed.` | resolver / outcome mapping | 不等于 missing、failed或success。 |
| `MissingRequirement` | `A required assembly prerequisite is absent or cannot be safely selected.` | domain assembly policy | 不由 default item补齐。 |
| `GenerationMismatch` | `A required generation-bound item does not match the target generation.` | domain generation guard | 不以 source version / backend generation替代。 |
| `CapabilityUnavailable` | `A required external capability is explicitly unavailable for this path.` | adapter-neutral capability mapping | 不等于 external failure已完成或可 fallback。 |
| `PendingItemOutcome` | `A required local assembly item awaits a matching outcome without asserting an external effect state.` | domain assembly aggregate over one frozen required item | 不等于 dispatch 已发生、external effect pending、Runtime / Member / Sandbox 状态或 eventual success。 |

##### `ReadinessGapRef` 与 `ReadinessGapRefSet`

```rust
/// References one body-free local gap considered by a host-readiness decision.
pub struct ReadinessGapRef {
    /// Closed local category of the readiness-relevant qualification or assembly gap.
    pub code: QualificationGapCode,
    /// Optional required source category affected by the gap.
    pub source_kind: Option<RequiredSourceKind>,
    /// Optional required assembly-item category affected by the gap.
    pub item_kind: Option<AssemblyItemKind>,
    /// Optional public-safe reason selected by the domain mapper.
    pub reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

impl ReadinessGapRef {
    /// Creates a source-scoped readiness gap without embedding source body or locator.
    pub fn for_source(
        code: QualificationGapCode,
        source_kind: RequiredSourceKind,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Creates an item-scoped readiness gap without embedding item outcome or external target body.
    pub fn for_item(
        code: QualificationGapCode,
        item_kind: AssemblyItemKind,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Creates an aggregate-scoped readiness gap when no single source or item can be named safely.
    pub fn aggregate(
        code: QualificationGapCode,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;
}

/// Carries a canonical ordered unique set of body-free readiness gaps.
pub struct ReadinessGapRefSet(Vec<ReadinessGapRef>);

impl ReadinessGapRefSet {
    /// Creates a gap set from canonical readiness-gap order without sorting or deduplicating caller input.
    pub fn try_new(values: Vec<ReadinessGapRef>) -> Result<Self, ContractError>;

    /// Creates the only valid empty gap set for a locally ready decision.
    pub fn empty_for_ready() -> Self;

    /// Returns gaps without permitting mutation.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[ReadinessGapRef];

    /// Returns whether the set contains no readiness gaps.
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 / factory | 作用 | 来源 / 结构约束 |
|---|---|---|
| `code` | 关闭缺口的有限分类 | domain evaluator / transition 已选的 `QualificationGapCode`；不得使用 error text、route、external status或 free-text。 |
| `source_kind` | 定位受影响的 required source 分类 | 仅 `for_source` 形成；不得携带 `HostQualificationSourceRef` 或 external locator/body。 |
| `item_kind` | 定位受影响的 required assembly item 分类 | 仅 `for_item` 形成；不得携带 item outcome、attempt ref、carrier/backend target或 Sandbox body。 |
| `reason` | 可选 body-free public-safe reason | 只接受 `HostSafeSummaryReason`；不能承载 credential / image / endpoint / external error body。 |
| `for_source` | 构造 source-scoped gap | source kind `Some`、item kind `None`；只允许 `MissingSource`、`StaleSource`、`ConflictingSource`、`PendingContract`、`UnknownSource` | `MissingRequirement`、`GenerationMismatch`、`CapabilityUnavailable` 不能在本 factory作为 source-only gap；不自动改为 aggregate。 |
| `for_item` | 构造 item-scoped gap | source kind `None`、item kind `Some`；只允许 `PendingContract`、`UnknownSource`、`MissingRequirement`、`GenerationMismatch`、`CapabilityUnavailable`、`PendingItemOutcome` | `MissingSource`、`StaleSource`、`ConflictingSource` 不能在本 factory作为 item-only gap。 |
| `aggregate` | 构造不可安全归属到单项的 gap | source / item均 `None` | 只允许 `PendingContract` 或 `UnknownSource`；不把可定位的 missing / stale / mismatch压平。 |
| `ReadinessGapRefSet::try_new` | 固定多 gap 形成顺序 | ordered values -> `Result<Set, ContractError>` | 去重键是 `(scope_rank, code_rank, source_kind_rank, item_kind_rank)`，其中 `scope_rank=source(0) < item(1) < aggregate(2)`；`code_rank`、`source_kind_rank`、`item_kind_rank`均为对应 enum declaration order，缺失 kind 只可出现在该 scope 合法位置。duplicate 返回 `DuplicateContractSetMember { owner: "readiness_gap_ref_set" }`，非此顺序返回 `NonCanonicalContractSetOrder { owner: "readiness_gap_ref_set" }`；不排序、去重或按事件到达顺序排列。`Ready` 时不得携带非空 set。 |
| `empty_for_ready` | 构造 ready 的唯一 gap set | 无 -> empty set | 不是任何 non-ready status 的默认值。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| body-free local carrier | gap ref 只描述 local decision使用的分类，不能包含 L1 source、image manifest、credential、Sandbox binding、carrier/backend、Member/Runtime、Bus 或 Observability body。 |
| source/item scopes do not collapse | 已知 source 或 item 时必须选对应 factory；aggregate 不是便利 fallback。 |
| public projection remains separate | `ReadinessGapRef` 是 domain/readiness shared carrier；`HostSafeGapRef` 是 application projection 的公开 surface，二者不能相互构造或用作对方状态。 |
| exact gap-to-scope mapping | `for_source`、`for_item`、`aggregate` 的允许 code 映射是封闭规则；factory 对不匹配组合返回 `InvalidCarrierCombination { owner: "readiness_gap_ref" }`，不让调用方猜测或通过默认 scope 绕过。 |

#### 8.12.8 `6.1-g` corrective audit and contracts stop review

本审计只复核 CMP-MS-02 所需 contracts carrier 的 owner、field source、状态边界与 external-safe wrapper 复用。它不提前写 domain entry/outcome/evaluator，不定义 Step 7 port / adapter，不产生 protocol / flow / persistence / config / test 契约，也不关闭上游 blocker。

| 审计维度 | 覆盖范围 | 结果 | 结论 |
|---|---|---|---|
| unique owner | `contracts/src/refs.rs` 的 id/ref、requirement/policy ref、revision、status、kind/set、assessment/gap | pass | domain、application、infra、entry、adapter、fake和future DTO均不得 shadow；domain-only entry/item/outcome/evaluator 仍在后续 `qualification.rs` / `assembly.rs`。 |
| field source / optionality | local id factory、opaque ref、source captured time、reason、required kind set、gap scope | pass_with_upstream_blockers | ids只来自 local generation/rehydrate；refs只来自 mapper/binding/rehydrate；optional captured time不以 local clock补造；reason保持redacted；upstream source缺失只能形成 gap/status。 |
| canonical set semantics | `RequiredSourceKindSet`、`RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet`、`ReadinessGapRefSet` | pass_after_corrective_audit | 两类 required set 一律按其 enum declaration order；gap set 以 `source -> item -> aggregate`、再按 code / kind declaration order为 canonical key。复用 `ContractError::DuplicateContractSetMember` / `NonCanonicalContractSetOrder`；不自动排序、去重、补默认或按 event order 排列。 |
| readiness boundary correction | `AssemblyItemKind` and downstream CMP-MS-04 boundary | pass | 已移除错误进入 readiness-required set 的 `MemberRegistration` 与 `RuntimeSession`。二者分别属于 registration / session owner；不能被组装完成或 readiness 决定消费，也不能证明 `Ready`。 |
| state separation | qualification / assembly / readiness statuses | pass | 三条状态轴独立；`Complete != Ready`；ready的含义限定为同 generation 的本地装配语义。 |
| external-safe wrapper reuse | Identity/Work、Images、credential、Sandbox、carrier source surface | pass_with_upstream_blockers | domain source entries只能选择既有 `HostQualificationSourceRef`、`HostPinnedImageSupplyRef`、`HostLaunchCredentialRef`、`HostSandboxBindingRef`、`HostCarrierCapabilityRef` 与 `HostQualificationSafeSummary`；不创建 generic external ref或对端 body。 |
| public safe projection separation | `ReadinessGapRef` vs `HostSafeGapRef` / `HostSafeReadinessState` | pass | 前者是 readiness decision basis carrier；后者只由 application safe mapper从committed local truth投影，二者不互写、不互推。 |
| cross-project boundary | `MSVC-UP-001~008` | pass_with_upstream_blockers | Images、Sandbox、credential、Member、Runtime、Core/Bus/SDK exact contract仍 pending；任何 pending / unknown / stale / conflict仍非 ready。 |
| Step 7 handoff | local stores、resolver/mappers、safe read mapper | pass_with_upstream_blockers | Step 7必须定义typed port供给/保存本批carrier；不得借port定义外部 schema或放宽 fail-closed。 |

`6.1-g` object-group stop-review conclusion: `completed / pass_with_upstream_blockers`。本次 corrective audit 已收紧 required-item scope、所有 ordered-unique set 的 canonical order、gap scope-to-code map 和 duplicate key；当时 `contracts` 范围包含 `6.1-a~6.1-g`。此结论只补全 CMP-MS-02 所需的 shared carrier，不代表 CMP-MS-02 domain truth、Step 7或正式 `03-详细设计.md` 已完成。CMP-MS-02 完成后反查 CMP-MS-03，发现 attempt / association local id-ref 仍无 schema owner，因此后续已授权的 CMP-MS-03 必须先完成受限 `6.1-h` corrective closure；不得借此定义外部 callback、backend 或 receipt 合同。

### 8.13 `6.1-h`：CMP-MS-03 local progression identity corrective closure

#### 8.13.1 发现、范围与唯一 owner

进入 `domain / CMP-MS-03` 前，按 `02_hld_step_06_key_objects.md` §8、`02_hld_step_07_interface_skeleton.md` §6、`02_hld_step_08_processing_flows.md` §6 与 Step 4/5 文件映射反查，发现 `HostActionAttempt`、`HostExternalAssociation`、CMP-MS-06 cleanup target 与 CMP-MS-05 read basis 都需要跨 domain / application / worker / jobs 传递本地 attempt / association ref。此前 `6.1-a~g` 已闭合 host、decision、qualification / assembly ref，却未给这两个 local record 的 identity / ref 或单调 local host revision 指定唯一 contracts owner。若直接写 `host.rs`、`action_attempt.rs` 或 `association.rs`，后续 store、Consumer、Job 和 cleanup path 将不得不各自自造同义 ref。

本 corrective closure 只补 `contracts/src/refs.rs` 的本地 opaque identity、typed reference 与 local revision arithmetic。它不定义 `HostActionKind`、lifecycle / attempt / association state、action target body、dispatch receipt、callback / event envelope、port、repository、UoW、backend product、carrier / registry / Sandbox truth 或任何 external completion。四个业务对象仍由随后 `domain/src/{host,action_attempt,association}.rs` 唯一拥有。

| 项 | corrective closure 结论 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-contracts` / `contracts::refs` / `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs` 独占 `HostActionAttemptId/Ref`、`HostExternalAssociationId/Ref` 与 `HostRevision`。domain、application、infra、api、worker、jobs、adapter、fake与 future DTO只能导入，不得 shadow / alias。 |
| 本批输入 | 已停审的正式 02 四个 CMP-MS-03 对象、`EstablishHostGenerationCommand`、`PrepareHostActionCommand`、`DispatchPendingHostActionsJob`、`HostActionOutcomeConsumerPlaceholder`；以及 Step 4/5 的七模块 owner 与依赖方向。 |
| 本批闭合 | 两个 local record 的 non-empty opaque id/ref；host aggregate 的本地 semantic revision value；它们的 factory / rehydrate path、来源和不可替代性。 |
| 本批不闭合 | action category / target、attempt status、association category / state、outcome / dispatch receipt、effect uncertainty、association set、current pointer、single-active判断、late classification与 CAS / UoW。 |
| external contract ceiling | `MSVC-UP-001~008` 全部不变。`HostActionAttemptRef` / `HostExternalAssociationRef` 只定位本仓 local record，不表示 carrier dispatch、Sandbox bind、runtime handoff、Member action、backend resource或 callback / receipt ready。 |

|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CAP-MS-09` generation/current host transition的本地 revision锚 | domain host transition已接受的一次 local fact change | `HostRevision` | 无 current-pointer 写入 | `HostRevision` | `HostGenerationFence`、Step 7 store expected-version、Step 11/13 CAS |
| `CAP-MS-10` prepared attempt 的跨层指向 | application generated / persisted attempt id | `HostActionAttemptRef` | 无 attempt 创建、dispatch或effect reservation | `HostActionAttemptId`、`HostActionAttemptRef` | `HostActionAttempt`、dispatch job、history / consumer mapping |
| `CAP-MS-11` outcome matching 的 local record定位 | typed local attempt identity | same typed attempt ref | 无 outcome classification | `HostActionAttemptRef` | consumer/store / health/assembly re-evaluation marker |
| `CAP-MS-12` typed association / release target 的 local record定位 | application generated / persisted association id | `HostExternalAssociationRef` | 无 association active / release judgement | `HostExternalAssociationId`、`HostExternalAssociationRef` | `HostExternalAssociation`、CMP-MS-06 cleanup target、Step 7 store |

|---|---|---|

| `HostExternalAssociationId::from_generated(String)` / `from_persisted(String)` | 构造或重建 opaque local association identity | 空值返回 `None`；不创建 association、不加载 external resource、不判断 binding / release。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|

| ref is not state | ref 的存在不证明 local record已提交、state为正向、current、匹配本 generation或 external outcome已到达。 |

#### 8.13.4 `HostRevision` local semantic revision carrier

```rust
/// Identifies one immutable semantic revision of a locally owned logical host record.
pub struct HostRevision(u64);

impl HostRevision {
    /// Creates the initial semantic revision for a newly established local host.
    pub fn initial() -> Self;

    /// Creates the next semantic revision after one accepted local host transition.
    pub fn next_after(previous: &Self) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted host revision without checking currentness or store version.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: u64) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether this revision is later than another revision of the same logical host.
    pub fn is_after(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 / 函数 | 作用 | 来源 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|
| `HostRevision.0` | 区分同一 local `MemberExecutionHost` 已接受的语义迁移 | `initial()` 只能由 `MemberExecutionHost::establish` 使用；`next_after()` 只由同一 host 已接受 transition衍生；`from_persisted()` 只由 local store rehydrate使用。不是 `HostGeneration`、repository expected version、projection cursor、external source version、message offset、effect key或 timestamp。 |
| `initial()` | 形成新 logical host 的第一 semantic revision | pure value factory；不建立 current pointer、不检查 single-active、不写 store。 |
| `next_after(&HostRevision)` | 表示单个已接受 local host transition后的下一 revision | pure arithmetic；实际 optimistic concurrency / atomic save 由 Step 7 / 11 / 13的 application/UoW/store承担。 |
| `from_persisted(u64)` | 重建保存的 semantic revision | 不验证 host是current、不比较外部资源、不将持久化 value升级为 current。 |
| `is_after(&HostRevision)` | 同一 local host 内纯顺序比较 | 不得跨 host / subject / generation推导 winner、current或 CAS 成功。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| revision vs generation | `HostGeneration` 区分同一执行主语下的新 logical host instance；`HostRevision` 只区分同一 host record 内已接受的语义变更，二者不可替代。 |
| revision vs store version | future repository `expected_version` / persisted version只属于 application port / infra CAS；不得将 `HostRevision` 送入 store as compare-and-swap token。 |
| no authority from arithmetic | `next_after` 不会接受 action、current pointer、association、external outcome或 effect key；它不能自行验证任何 transition。 |

#### 8.13.5 `6.1-h` corrective object-group stop review

#### 8.15.4 `HealthAssessmentRevision` local assessment-series revision carrier

```rust
/// Identifies one immutable assessment-series revision within a local host generation.
pub struct HealthAssessmentRevision(u64);

impl HealthAssessmentRevision {
    /// Creates the initial assessment-series revision for a host generation without a prior assessment.
    pub fn initial() -> Self;

    /// Creates the next assessment-series revision after one selected prior assessment.
    pub fn next_after(previous: &Self) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted assessment-series revision without asserting currentness or store success.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: u64) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether this revision is later than another revision in the same host-generation series.
    pub fn is_after(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 / 函数 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|
| `HealthAssessmentRevision.0` | 区分同一 `HostRef + HostGeneration` 下 successive assessment records 的本地评估顺序 | `initial()` 只由 `HostHealthAssessment::assess` 在没有 selected prior assessment 时使用；`next_after()` 只由新 assessment factory 对同 scope selected prior revision 使用；`from_persisted()` 只由 local assessment store rehydrate 使用。它不是 `HostGeneration`、`HostRevision`、`HostSessionRevision`、`AssemblyRevision`、repository expected version、projection cursor、external source version、message sequence、idempotency/effect key或 timestamp。 |
| `initial()` | 形成新 host-generation assessment series 的首 revision | pure value factory；不选择 current assessment、不写 history、不保存 store、不评估四轴。 |
| `next_after(&Self)` | 为新的 immutable assessment record 形成严格后继 revision | overflow 返回 `None`，domain 必须 fail-closed；不形成新 assessment id、不标记 prior superseded、不选择 current、不执行 CAS / UoW。 |
| `from_persisted(u64)` | 重建已保存 revision | 不判断该 record current、basis valid、health healthy、failure confirmed、decision committed或 store save successful。 |
| `is_after(&Self)` | 比较同一 host-generation assessment series 的两个 local revisions | pure comparison；不得跨 host / generation 推导 current winner、replacement correctness或 CAS success。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| revision versus new assessment | 每次新的 four-axis assessment 必须使用新的 `HostHealthAssessmentId`；新 assessment 在同 host/generation且有 selected prior时必须使用严格后继 revision。revision 不是 prior record status 的原地版本号，也不得把 revision increment 伪装为 store commit / external evaluation。 |
| revision versus generation | generation 区分项目成员的 logical host instance；assessment revision只区分一个已选 assessment record 的 accepted local transition，二者不可替代。 |
| revision versus store version | future repository `expected_version` 与 physical persisted version 属 application port / infra CAS；不得将 `HealthAssessmentRevision` 当 compare-and-swap token。 |
| no authority from arithmetic | `next_after` 不会验证 snapshot basis、current host/session facts、policy、formal control、failure certainty或 recovery prerequisite；它不能自行授权任何 transition。 |
