`6.1-j` object-group stop-review conclusion: **completed / pass_with_upstream_blockers**。本 corrective closure 只补 CMP-MS-05 所需 local shared carrier，允许继续已获授权的 `domain / CMP-MS-05` object group；不代表外部 signal contract、Step 7、实现、测试或正式 `03-详细设计.md` 已完成。

## 8.16 `6.1-k`：CMP-MS-06 closure / reconciliation local carrier corrective closure

### 8.16.1 发现、范围与唯一 owner

进入已获授权的 `domain / CMP-MS-06` 前，按正式 02 §6.4.3、§6.7、02 HLD Step 6 §11、Step 8 的 cleanup / reconcile 流和 Step 9 的四轴状态反查，发现 `HostClosure`、`CleanupAttempt`、`ResidualFinding`、`ReconciliationCase` 已需要在 domain、application、Job、Consumer、history 和 future store 之间传递四类 local record 的 id / typed ref；其中 closure 和 case 还需要与 repository expected version 严格分离的 semantic revision，closure 与 case 又各自需要确定性的同类 ref 集。此前 `contracts::refs` 只闭合了 `HostClosureDecisionRef`，它只是已提交决定的 closure candidate，绝不能被借作 `HostClosureRef`，更不能承载 cleanup、finding 或 case truth。

若直接在 `closure.rs` 或 `reconciliation.rs` 定义这些 shared carrier，未来 cleanup Job、feedback Consumer、case reader、history 和 safe mapper 将各自形成同义 string / vector alias；若复用 `HostActionAttemptRef`，又会把 CMP-MS-03 的 host-side action 与 CMP-MS-06 的 closure cleanup 混成一个 side-effect record。本 corrective closure 因而只补足本仓 local identity / ref / revision / homogeneous set 的唯一 schema owner；它不定义任何 external request、receipt、route、backend resource、Sandbox policy / cleanup truth、Runtime session、Member truth 或 reconciliation external owner schema。

| 项 | corrective closure 结论 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-contracts` / `contracts::refs` / `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs` 独占 `HostClosureId/Ref`、`CleanupAttemptId/Ref`、`ResidualFindingId/Ref`、`ReconciliationCaseId/Ref`、`ClosureRevision`、`ReconciliationCaseRevision`、`CleanupAttemptRefSet` 与 `ResidualFindingRefSet`。domain、application、infra、api、worker、jobs、adapter、fake 和 future DTO 只能导入，不得 shadow、alias 或退回裸 `String` / `Vec`。 |
| 本批输入 | 已停审的正式 02 四个 CMP-MS-06 对象、`HostClosureDecisionRef` candidate 边界、`HostExternalAssociationRef` cleanup target、已有 `ExternalEffectKey` / safe summary carrier、Step 4/5 文件 owner，以及 HLD 的 close / cleanup feedback / residual / reconciliation skeleton。 |
| 本批闭合 | 四类 non-empty opaque local identity 的 generated / persisted factory、typed local ref、closure / case local semantic revision、两类同质 ref set 的 canonical order 与 source ceiling。 |
| 本批不闭合 | closure scope、invalidation / pending / gap / residual basis / reconciliation basis 等 heterogeneous domain-only set，cleanup kind / status / target validation / effect-key lifecycle，finding kind / status，case disposition / actor / resolution，current selection，store、UoW、CAS、Consumer / Job protocol、external cleanup / observation / owner truth。它们仍分别属于随后 `closure.rs`、`reconciliation.rs` 或 Step 7+。 |
| existing candidate boundary | `HostClosureDecisionRef` 继续只包装已经由上游 local decision guard 验证的 closure candidate。它不能构造 `HostClosureRef`、不能创建 closure / cleanup attempt、不能停止 Runtime、不能释放 Sandbox / carrier，也不能证明任何 external cleanup completion。 |
| external-contract ceiling | `MSVC-UP-001~008` 全部不变；尤其 `MSVC-UP-004` 的 Sandbox bind / release / cleanup exact schema 与 owner truth 仍 pending。新 carrier 只定位本仓 local record，不表示 target 存在、request 已送达、外部 owner 已接受、resource 已释放或 backend 已清理。 |

~~~rust
    pub fn next_after(previous: &Self) -> Option<Self>;

}
~~~

| carrier | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|
| `ClosureRevision` | 区分同一个 `HostClosure` 已接受的 closure-local mutation，例如 scope 开启、已验证的 local invalidation / attempt / gap / residual link、或 local completion classification。 | `initial()` 只由 `HostClosure::open` 使用；`next_after()` 只由同一 closure 的 accepted transition 使用；overflow 返回 `None` 并 fail-closed。它不是 `HostGeneration`、`HostRevision`、repository expected version、database version、effect key、feedback sequence、external source version 或 timestamp。 |
| `ReconciliationCaseRevision` | 区分同一个 `ReconciliationCase` 已接受的 local case mutation，例如 finding append、explicit disposition、hold / escalation / resolution link。 | `initial()` 只由 `ReconciliationCase::open` 使用；`next_after()` 只由同一 case 的 accepted transition 使用；overflow 返回 `None` 并 fail-closed。它不是 finding revision、closure revision、host generation、store CAS token、external owner revision 或 action receipt。 |
| `from_persisted` / `is_after` | 分别重建已保存值、在同一 local record 内纯比较。 | 不选择 current record、不验证 selected facts、不检查 port / receipt、不保存 store；future expected-version、atomic save 和 UoW 仍由 Step 7 / 11 / 13 承接。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| semantic revision is not persistence version | 两种 revision 记录已接受的本地语义变更；不能直接用作 SQL row version、repository expected version、lease、lock、cursor 或 retry counter。 |
| no authority from arithmetic | `next_after` 不会验证 decision candidate、closure scope、invalidation、effect key、finding basis、case actor / disposition、external feedback 或 cleanup completion；它不能自行授权任何 transition。 |
| no cross-aggregate comparison | `is_after` 只比较同一 closure 或同一 case 的 revision；不可跨 host / generation / case 推导 current winner、closure complete 或 UoW success。 |

| `ResidualFindingRefSet` | 按 `finding_ref.finding_id.as_str().as_bytes()` 严格升序；重复、乱序、非 appendable input 返回 `DomainError`，不得自动排序、去重、覆盖或按 finding kind / status / detected time 重排。 | 只由 matching `ResidualFinding::to_ref()` 经 future application same-host / generation validation 输入，或由 local closure / case store safe rehydrate。被收录不表示 finding confirmed / resolved、case opened，或 external fact changed。 |
| shared restriction | 两个 set 均只可容纳自己的同质 local ref；不建立 `LocalReferenceSet`、`ExternalReferenceSet` 或 any-object vector。 | closure invalidation / pending / gap、residual basis、reconciliation basis、disposition / hold / reason / resolution 等 heterogeneous support values 继续只由 `closure.rs` 或 `reconciliation.rs` 定义。 |

| 审查项 | 结果 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| unique owner | pass | 四类 local id/ref、两类 semantic revision和两类 homogeneous set均只属于 planned `contracts/src/refs.rs`；domain / application / infra / entry / fake无第二 schema。 |
| candidate / aggregate separation | pass | `HostClosureDecisionRef` 继续只表达 committed / permitted decision candidate；`HostClosureRef` 只定位已存在 aggregate，二者没有 implicit conversion、factory shortcut 或 truth escalation。 |

| revision distinction | pass | closure / case semantic revision与 host / session / assembly / assessment revision、generation、store expected version、cursor、external source version和 timestamp 保持不同类型与语义。 |
| local / external separation | pass_with_upstream_blockers | carrier 只定位 local record；`MSVC-UP-001~008`、尤其 Sandbox cleanup / owner feedback的 exact schema仍 pending，不可由 id / ref 推导 external request、acceptance、release或 completion。 |

`6.1-k` corrective object-group stop-review conclusion: **completed / pass_with_upstream_blockers**。本 corrective closure 只补 CMP-MS-06 所需 local shared carrier，允许继续已经授权的 `domain / CMP-MS-06` object group；不代表 cleanup dispatch、external outcome、Sandbox / carrier cleanup、reconciliation resolution、Step 7、实现、测试或正式 `03-详细设计.md` 已完成。

## 8.17 `6.1-i` 后续 domain 对象契约非规范性工作稿（已由 §9.10 取代）

### 8.17.1 草稿：本对象组写入边界、唯一 owner 与概要归一

本对象组承接 `CAP-MS-13`、`CAP-MS-16`、`IB-MS-007`、`AcceptHostRegistrationCommandPlaceholder` 以及 02 中 registration / replacement / replay 的边界。唯一 domain owner 为 planned `member-service-domain` 的 `crates/domain/src/registration.rs`；`HostEndpoint` 与 `HostSession` 分别在 `endpoint.rs`、`session.rs` 定义。`RegistrationSessionPolicy` 是本地不可变 guard，不是 credential issuer、Member registry、Runtime session policy 或配置中心。

| 规则 | 本批收口结论 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| 业务对象分母 | 只闭合 `HostRegistration` 与 `RegistrationSessionPolicy` 两个冻结业务对象；candidate facts、acceptance basis、witness、permit、current-facts 和 decision enum 均为 domain-only support value。 | 不新增 `MemberRegistration`、`Credential`、`EndpointRegistry`、`RuntimeSession` 或第 30 个业务对象。 |
| shared carrier 使用 | 03 对象字段必须使用 `HostRegistrationId/Ref`、`HostMemberRegistrationRef`、`HostLaunchCredentialRef`、`RegistrationInputFingerprint`、`HostGeneration`、双锚 typed refs；02 的 `*Placeholder` 只保留为 pending 语义。 | 不在 domain 重定义 wrapper、以 `String` / `OpaqueCredentialRef` / generic `ExternalRef` 替代，或把 placeholder 名称当 exact sibling schema。 |
| 接受语义 | `Accepted` 只表示本仓 registration acceptance record 已通过本地 generation、双锚、replay 与 credential-binding guard；不表示 Member 已接受、credential 可用、endpoint active、Host Session active、ready 或 Runtime run。 | 不由 heartbeat、endpoint reachability、projection、fake、timeout、local receipt 或 absence-of-error 直接 accept。 |
| replacement 语义 | 新 registration 使用新 local id；旧记录只转为 `Replaced` 并保留双向 replacement link/history。 | 不原地覆盖旧记录、删除历史、重置 fingerprint 或让旧 generation 接管 current。 |
| unresolved upstream | `MSVC-UP-002` / `MSVC-UP-006` exact mapper 未闭合时，正向 acceptance 只能停在 `Blocked` / `Waiting` / `Rejected` 的 owning result；本对象卡仍定义 closed shape，不伪造 positive input。 | 不填写 Member request/report、credential secret、issuer/revoke record、IPC、route 或 external acceptance。 |

### 8.17.3 草稿：domain-only support values

这些类型只携带已由 application / formal mapper 选中的结构化输入，不拥有 Member、credential 或 current-pointer truth。它们不是 public DTO，也不计入 29 个业务对象分母。

#### `RegistrationCandidateFacts`

```rust
/// Carries the already mapped facts required to evaluate one host-registration input.
pub struct RegistrationCandidateFacts {
    /// Local host to which the candidate is proposed.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation selected by the caller's local current-fact read.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Project member execution subject for the candidate.
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Global member identity anchor paired with the project member.
    global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Member-owned registration input reference without request or report body.
    source_ref: HostMemberRegistrationRef,
    /// Instance-bound launch credential reference without secret material.
    credential_ref: HostLaunchCredentialRef,
    /// Opaque input equivalence fingerprint supplied by a formal mapper.
    input_fingerprint: RegistrationInputFingerprint,
    /// Correlation identity shared with history and later endpoint/session records.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

impl RegistrationCandidateFacts {
    /// Forms one complete candidate only from the formal mapped registration boundary.
    pub fn from_mapped(
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        source_ref: HostMemberRegistrationRef,
        credential_ref: HostLaunchCredentialRef,
        input_fingerprint: RegistrationInputFingerprint,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

impl RegistrationCandidateFacts {
    /// Creates complete mapped facts without parsing a Member body or checking external truth.
    pub fn from_mapped(
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        source_ref: HostMemberRegistrationRef,
        credential_ref: HostLaunchCredentialRef,
        input_fingerprint: RegistrationInputFingerprint,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the selected host and generation pair.
    pub fn target(&self) -> (&HostRef, &HostGeneration);

    /// Returns whether the facts match one exact project-member and global-member anchor pair.
    pub fn matches_anchors(
        &self,
        project_member_ref: &ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: &GlobalMemberRef,
    ) -> bool;
}

impl RegistrationCandidateFacts {
    /// Creates candidate facts from an already validated boundary mapping.
    pub fn from_mapped(
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        source_ref: HostMemberRegistrationRef,
        credential_ref: HostLaunchCredentialRef,
        input_fingerprint: RegistrationInputFingerprint,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the local host/generation pair selected for this candidate.
    pub fn target(&self) -> (&HostRef, &HostGeneration);

    /// Returns the candidate's opaque replay fingerprint.
    pub fn input_fingerprint(&self) -> &RegistrationInputFingerprint;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| `host_ref` / `generation` | `HostRef` / `HostGeneration` | 必须来自同一次 committed local host selection；不得从 endpoint、Member id、Runtime id 或 credential ref 推导。 |
| `project_member_ref` / `global_member_ref` | L1 typed refs | 必须由 formal mapper 成对提供；本对象只做 equality check，不执行 L1 relation lookup 或 authorization。 |
| `source_ref` | `HostMemberRegistrationRef` | 只回链 Member-owned input；不保存 request/report body；`MSVC-UP-002` exact schema 仍 pending。 |
| `credential_ref` | `HostLaunchCredentialRef` | 只保存 instance-bound safe ref；不保存 token、secret、issuer或 revoke body。 |
| `input_fingerprint` | `RegistrationInputFingerprint` | 已由 formal mapper 计算并裁剪；本类型不选择 hash/canonicalization 算法，不等于 `IdempotencyKey`。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 来自已验证 command metadata / local operation context；不作为 registration identity 或 fingerprint。 |

| 不变量 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| dual-anchor equality | 构造时只拒绝结构性缺失或不配对；不能凭两个 opaque refs 声称 L1 关系已授权。 |
| no external body | candidate 永远不携带 Member registration payload、credential secret、endpoint transport、Runtime body或 IPC envelope。 |
| no acceptance shortcut | candidate 只是一组待评估 facts；创建它不产生 `Accepted`、current pointer、endpoint或 session。 |

#### `ExistingRegistrationFacts` 与 `RegistrationReplayDisposition`

```rust
/// Carries the minimal local facts needed to classify a registration replay.
pub struct ExistingRegistrationFacts {
    /// Existing local registration reference, when a matching local record was found.
    registration_ref: Option<HostRegistrationRef>,
    /// Host and generation of the existing local record, when available.
    host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
    /// Existing record generation, when available.
    generation: Option<HostGeneration>,
    /// Existing local registration status, when available.
    status: Option<HostRegistrationStatus>,
    /// Existing opaque input fingerprint, when available.
    input_fingerprint: Option<RegistrationInputFingerprint>,
}

/// Classifies how one candidate relates to an already selected local registration record.
pub enum RegistrationReplayDisposition {
    /// No equivalent local record was found for the selected scope.
    NewInput,
    /// The same fingerprint and generation identify an already recorded local conclusion.
    DuplicateReplay {
        /// Existing local record that must be returned through stored-result/replay handling.
        registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
    },
    /// A different fingerprint conflicts with an existing current registration.
    Conflict,
    /// A new candidate is explicitly eligible to replace an existing accepted registration.
    ReplacementRequired {
        /// Existing accepted record that must be superseded in a later local UoW.
        prior_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
    },
    /// The local lookup did not provide enough facts to classify safely.
    Unknown,
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `NewInput` | `No equivalent local record was found for the selected scope.` | local replay lookup with explicit no-match | policy validation; never direct accept |
| `DuplicateReplay` | `The same fingerprint and generation identify an already recorded local conclusion.` | exact local fingerprint/generation match | application stored-result/replay surface; no second record |
| `Conflict` | `A different fingerprint conflicts with an existing current registration.` | same current scope with non-equivalent fingerprint | rejected/conflict result; never overwrite |
| `ReplacementRequired` | `A new candidate is explicitly eligible to replace an existing accepted registration.` | policy replacement guard after current facts and explicit action | replacement UoW; old record becomes `Replaced` |
| `Unknown` | `The local lookup did not provide enough facts to classify safely.` | unavailable or incomplete local facts | blocked/unknown result; no positive transition |

```rust
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        status: CredentialQualificationStatus,
        reason_code: Option<RegistrationReasonCode>,

}

impl CredentialBindingQualification {

    pub fn from_mapped(
        credential_ref: HostLaunchCredentialRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        status: CredentialQualificationStatus,
        reason_code: Option<RegistrationReasonCode>,

    /// Returns whether this classification exactly matches the supplied candidate scope.

}
```

| 字段 / 变体 | 来源与约束 |
|---|---|
| `credential_ref` / `host_ref` / `generation` | formal credential mapper 必须同时提供并绑定；不从 raw credential、host id或 current pointer补齐。 |
| `status` | 只由 owner-safe mapper 映射；`Qualified` 在 `MSVC-UP-006` exact contract 未闭口时不可由 fake/timeout/default 构造。 |
| `reason_code` | 仅为 invalid/unknown 保留已脱敏本地原因；不得含 issuer、token、secret或 adapter error body。 |
| `Qualified` | 仅表示本地 qualification witness 可被 policy 消费；不表示 credential 已签发、可连接、未撤销或 external authorization 成功。 |
| `Invalid` | 本地明确不接受该绑定；registration 只能 rejected / invalidated。 |
| `Unknown` | 合同或证据不足；registration 只能 blocked / waiting / unknown。 |

#### `RegistrationAcceptanceBasis`、witness 与 permit support

```rust
/// Proves that one registration candidate passed the local acceptance guards.
pub struct RegistrationAcceptanceBasis {
    /// Registration input fingerprint used by the guard.
    input_fingerprint: RegistrationInputFingerprint,
    /// Host and generation checked by the guard.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Credential reference whose owner-safe qualification was checked.
    credential_ref: HostLaunchCredentialRef,
    /// Local policy baseline used for the guard.
    policy_revision: PolicyRevision,
}

/// A narrow witness that a local registration record is in the accepted state.
pub struct AcceptedRegistrationWitness {
    /// Accepted local registration reference.
    registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
    /// Host and generation selected by that registration.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    generation: HostGeneration,
}

/// A one-use permit for changing one exact current registration association.
pub struct RegistrationMutationPermit {
    /// Registration selected by the policy snapshot.
    registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
    /// Host/generation pair selected by the same snapshot.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    generation: HostGeneration,
}
```

| support value | 唯一构造入口 | 约束 / 语义上限 |
|---|---|---|
| `RegistrationAcceptanceBasis` | `RegistrationSessionPolicy::validate_registration` 的 `Accept` 分支 | 不可由 command、receipt、credential ref 单独拼装；不表示 store commit、Member acceptance或 endpoint/session active。 |
| `AcceptedRegistrationWitness` | `HostRegistration::accepted_witness()` | 只有 committed/rehydrated `Accepted` record 可产生；不携带 registration body 或 credential qualification body。 |
| `RegistrationMutationPermit` | `RegistrationSessionPolicy` 对匹配 current facts 的 guard | 按值消费、不可跨 generation / UoW 复用；不是 DB lock、repository version、actor authorization或 external permit。 |

### 8.17.4 草稿：`HostRegistrationStatus`、`RegistrationReasonCode` 与 validation decision

```rust
/// Classifies the local lifecycle of one host-registration acceptance record.
pub enum HostRegistrationStatus {
    /// A mapped registration input has been recorded but not yet accepted or rejected.
    Received,
    /// Local registration rules accepted the input for this host generation.
    Accepted,
    /// Local registration rules explicitly rejected the input.
    Rejected,
    /// A later registration replaced this record as the current registration surface.
    Replaced,
    /// Host replacement, closure, or explicit invalidation ended this record's activity.
    Invalidated,
}

/// Carries a redacted local reason for registration classification without external error body.
pub struct RegistrationReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

impl RegistrationReasonCode {
    /// Creates a reason from an already redacted registration classification.
    pub fn from_classification(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted redacted registration reason.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the redacted code for safe local mapping.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}

/// Carries the policy result before a HostRegistration transition is applied.
pub enum RegistrationValidationDecision {
    /// All local guards passed and an acceptance basis is available.
    Accept(RegistrationAcceptanceBasis),
    /// The input is explicitly rejected by a closed local rule.
    Reject(RegistrationReasonCode),
    /// The input cannot progress because an upstream contract or local prerequisite is unresolved.
    Blocked(RegistrationReasonCode),
    /// The input conflicts with a current local registration and must not overwrite it.
    Conflict(RegistrationReasonCode),
    /// The input is an equivalent replay of an existing local record.
    Duplicate(HostRegistrationRef),
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Accept(RegistrationAcceptanceBasis)` | `All local guards passed and an acceptance basis is available.` | policy over matching candidate/current/credential facts | `HostRegistration::accept`; future local UoW |
| `Reject(RegistrationReasonCode)` | `The input is explicitly rejected by a closed local rule.` | policy scope/generation/fingerprint/credential invalidity | `HostRegistration::reject`; safe result |
| `Blocked(RegistrationReasonCode)` | `The input cannot progress because an upstream contract or local prerequisite is unresolved.` | missing/pending/unknown mapper or current facts | blocked/waiting result; no accepted record |
| `Conflict(RegistrationReasonCode)` | `The input conflicts with a current local registration and must not overwrite it.` | non-equivalent current record or anchor mismatch | conflict result/history; no overwrite |
| `Duplicate(HostRegistrationRef)` | `The input is an equivalent replay of an existing local record.` | exact fingerprint/generation match | stored-result/replay path; no second mutation |

`RegistrationReasonCode` 只包装已脱敏 code；它不与 `ContractError`、`DomainError`、HTTP status、credential error或 Member report 互换。`Accept` 也不代表持久化已提交，必须由 application 在后续 UoW 中保存并追加 history。

## 8.18 `6.1-l`：CMP-MS-07 material / handoff / projection / outbox / history local carrier corrective closure

### 8.18.1 发现、范围与唯一 owner

进入已获授权的 `domain / CMP-MS-07` 前，按正式 02 §6.8、02 HLD Step 6 §12、Step 8 的 materialization / publication / handoff / projection / history 流反查，发现六个冻结对象已经共同引用 `HostFactMaterialId/Ref`、`HostHandoffRecordId/Ref`、`HostProjectionStateId/Ref`、`HostOutboxRecordId/Ref`、`HostHistoryEntryId/Ref`、material stable key、projection local semantic revision 与 committed local source-change anchor；此前没有任何一个已收稳的 crate / module / file 持有这些 carrier 的唯一 schema。若直接在五个 domain file、application materialization、infra store、worker 或 Job 中分别使用 `String`、history id、event id、broker offset 或 repository version 代替，material / handoff / projection / outbox / history 将失去 typed identity，且会把 local submission、external feedback、cursor、CAS 与 source truth 混为一层。

本 corrective closure 只补足可跨 domain / application / future port / store 使用的**本仓 local** identity、reference、key、semantic revision 与 change anchor。它不新增第 30 个业务对象，不定义 Bus/Core envelope、route、receipt、feedback identity、broker offset、storage row version、Runtime / Member / Images / Sandbox / Observability truth，也不解决正式 02 中 `HostChangeCursor` 与 HLD 中 `CommittedChangeCursor` 的命名差异。

| 项 | corrective closure 结论 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-contracts` / `contracts::refs` / `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs` 独占 `CommittedHostChangeRef`、五组 id/ref、`HostMaterialKey` 与 `ProjectionRevision`。`domain`、`application`、`infra`、`api`、`worker`、`jobs`、adapter、fake、DTO 和 store 只能导入，不得 shadow、alias 或退回裸 `String`。 |
| domain object owner 不变 | `HostFactMaterial` 与 `HostHandoffRecord` 仍只属于 planned `domain/src/material.rs`；`HostProjectionState` 只属于 `domain/src/projection.rs`；`HostOutboxRecord` 只属于 `domain/src/outbox.rs`；`HostHistoryEntry` 只属于 `domain/src/history.rs`。`SafeHostView` 已完整属于 `contracts/src/views.rs`，不是本批 domain object。 |
| `CommittedHostChangeRef` 的受限含义 | 它只是本仓 append-only local committed-change marker 的 opaque reference，由 future application commit-plan / UoW seam 或 safe persistence 提供。它不是 Bus event id、broker offset、message id、repository expected version、database row version、external source version、receipt、history-entry id 或 any sibling-owned reference。其存在不证明当前 call 已物理提交；原子提交证明仍属于未来 UoW / persistence seam。 |
| material key | `HostMaterialKey` 只锚定一个已选 source-change / source-revision / redaction-profile context 的 local material identity；它不等于 `PublicationKey`、`HandoffKey`、idempotency key、external digest、route、event id 或 delivery receipt。 |
| projection revision | `ProjectionRevision` 只区分同一 projection-state 的已接受 local semantic mutation；它不是 projection cursor、`HostTruthRevision`、repository CAS / store version、broker offset、retry count 或 external version。 |
| explicitly deferred cursor | 正式 02 的 `HostChangeCursor` 与 HLD 的 `CommittedChangeCursor` 尚未收敛。本文后续只使用文字“domain-owned committed projection cursor”，不定义 Rust type、alias、conversion、third cursor name或 public exposure；涉及该 slot 的 factory / `apply` / rebuild contract 必须保留 type hole 和 `pending`。 |
| 本批不闭合 | material source classification / body-free payload、handoff attempt / feedback matching、projection scope / gap / status、outbox local progression、history owner / change kind等 file-local support value，分别在 §9.13 的 owning domain file 收口；不把它们抬升为 generic contracts container。 |

All five `*Id::from_generated(String)` factories reject blank values and accept only application id-generator output; all `*Id::from_persisted(String)` factories reject blank values and only rehydrate a local persisted value; all `*Id::as_str()` and `*Ref::new(...)` functions are pure. None reads a repository, reserves an idempotency record, changes a domain state, persists a record, derives a target, calls a port, verifies a UoW commit or interprets any external fact.

```rust
/// Identifies one local material identity derived from a selected committed change, source revision, and redaction profile.
pub struct HostMaterialKey(String);

}

/// Identifies one accepted local semantic revision of one projection-state record.
pub struct ProjectionRevision(u64);

impl ProjectionRevision {
    /// Creates the initial local semantic revision for a new projection-state record.
    pub fn initial() -> Self;

    /// Creates the next local semantic revision after one selected prior projection-state revision.
    pub fn next_after(previous: &Self) -> Option<Self>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted local semantic revision without asserting cursor or store state.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: u64) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether this revision is later than another revision in the same projection-state series.
    pub fn is_after(&self, other: &Self) -> bool;
}
```

## 9. `domain / CMP-MS-01 / control.rs` 对象契约



### 9.1 本对象组写入边界、归属与概要占位归一

本批只写 planned `crates/domain/src/control.rs` 的 `CMP-MS-01` domain truth / decision / guard，以及它们必须使用的 domain-only control value。它承接正式 `00` 的 `C-MS-1`、`FR-MS-001/002`、`D-MS-001~003`、`BR-MS-001~007`、正式 `01` 的 control plane / Host Truth 边界，以及正式 `02` Step 6~9 的三对象、两项 P0 Command 和两条状态轴。它不创建 port、DTO、repository、UoW、entry、adapter 或实际源码。

| 规则 | 本批收口结论 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| 唯一 crate / file owner | `member-service-domain` / planned `crates/domain/src/control.rs` 独占 `HostIntent`、`HostOrchestrationDecision`、`HostControlPolicy` 和本节列出的 control-only value object。`contracts/src/refs.rs` 继续独占 id/ref/source/scope/action/status/reason/baseline carrier。 | 不在 application、infra、api、worker、jobs、adapter、fake 或 public DTO 中 shadow 任何 domain value；不把 CMP 当 crate。 |
| 29 个业务对象分母 | 本批只闭合冻结的三个业务对象：`HostIntent`、`HostOrchestrationDecision`、`HostControlPolicy`。`DecisionBasisRef(Set)`、`ExistingIntentFacts`、`CurrentHostFacts`、`FormalControlIntakeState`、`HostControlActionPlan` 仅是 `control.rs` 内部 value / input / plan，不计入业务对象分母。 | 不新增 `HostControlRequest`、`HostCommand`、`HostDecisionContext`、Runtime run、Member 主体或任何第 30 个业务对象。 |
| domain 依赖上限 | 只导入 `contracts` 的 typed carrier，以及已确认 Core shared category `ActorContext` / `Timestamp` 的类型引用；domain 不调用它们的 owner。 | 不导入 API DTO、repository trait、UoW、DB、clock、Bus、container、Member / Runtime / Images / Sandbox client、L1 truth 或 public view。 |
| id / time / actor 来源 | `HostIntentId`、`HostOrchestrationDecisionId` 均由 application id generator 在 factory 前提供；`Timestamp` 来自 application clock output；`ActorContext` 仍是 trusted entry context，并由后续 history / application flow 追溯。 | domain 不生成 id、读取 clock、认证 actor、保存 actor profile / authorization body，或把 metadata / actor presence 当作 acceptance / commit。 |
| formal source / dual anchor | `HostIntentSourceRef`、`HostControlScopeRef` 已是 contracts-owned consumption carrier；`HostControlPolicy` 只检查 candidate 与已映射 carrier 的 typed equality。 | 不做 L1 lookup，不从 scope text、source text、cache、route、host id、fake 或 `GlobalMemberRef` 单独推断 project-member relation。 |
| 结果与外部动作 | `Accepted` 与 `Committed` 都是本仓 local control truth；`Hold` / `NoAction` 是可追溯的本地结论。 | 不调用 carrier / Member / Runtime / Sandbox / backend；不将任何本地状态、receipt、timeout 或 ref 升格为 dispatch、completion、delivery、observation 或 acceptance。 |

为把概要层的轮廓转成 Rust-facing shape，本批作三项最小归一；它们不改变需求、对象分母、状态名或 owner：

| 概要骨架 | 本批 Rust-facing 形态 | 归一原因与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| `OptionalHostRef`、`OptionalHostGeneration`、`OptionalDecisionRef` | 分别使用 `Option<HostRef>`、`Option<HostGeneration>`、`Option<HostOrchestrationDecisionRef>`；不新增 wrapper type。 | 02 只表达 optionality，未给 wrapper owner / schema。Rust `Option` 保留精确 optionality，且避免第二区域再造 ref carrier。 |
| `DependencyGapRef` 作为 `HostIntent::mark_waiting` 参数 | 使用已经 contracts-owned、body-free 的 `HostIntentReasonCode`。 | 02 未给 `DependencyGapRef` schema / owner；CMP-MS-01 waiting 只需保留本地裁剪原因，不得把 later qualification gap、external body 或 generic string塞入 domain。 |
| singular `conflict_mode` 字段 | `HostControlPolicy` 以两个不可配置的私有 baseline slot 固定 `ReplayEquivalent` 与 `RecordConflict`。 | 当前范围同时要求“等价重放返回既有结论”和“不同 / 并发冲突显式记录”；单个 enum slot 无法同时表达两条硬规则。该 pair 不向外暴露新配置或业务状态。 |
