#### 9.3.1 `CurrentHostFacts` 与 `CurrentHostControlState`

```rust
/// Classifies only the selected local current-host control condition for one project member.
pub enum CurrentHostControlState {
    /// No committed current host exists for the project-member subject.
    NoCurrentHost,
    /// One committed current host and its immutable generation are available for control evaluation.
    Current {
        /// Typed reference to the locally owned current host.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Immutable local generation of the current host.
        generation: HostGeneration,
    },
    /// A committed current host is in local closure handling and must not receive ordinary progression.
    ClosureInProgress {
        /// Typed reference to the locally owned host being closed.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Immutable local generation of the host being closed.
        generation: HostGeneration,
    },
    /// Local current-host facts cannot be safely determined for this decision.
    Unknown,
}

/// Carries already selected committed local host facts into one pure control evaluation.
pub struct CurrentHostFacts {
    /// Project-scoped execution subject whose current host facts were selected.
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Narrow control condition; it is not a global host lifecycle state.
    control_state: CurrentHostControlState,
    /// Optional prior local orchestration decision retained only as a causal basis.
    prior_effective_decision_ref: Option<HostOrchestrationDecisionRef>,
}

impl CurrentHostFacts {
    /// Forms facts that prove no committed current host exists for the supplied subject.
    pub fn no_current(project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef) -> Self;

    /// Forms facts for one selected committed current host and generation.
    pub fn current(
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        prior_effective_decision_ref: Option<HostOrchestrationDecisionRef>,
    ) -> Self;

    /// Forms facts for a selected host that is already in local closure handling.
    pub fn closure_in_progress(
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        prior_effective_decision_ref: Option<HostOrchestrationDecisionRef>,
    ) -> Self;

    /// Forms an explicit unknown local current-host condition without inventing a host or generation.
    pub fn unknown(project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef) -> Self;

    /// Returns whether these facts belong to the supplied project-member execution subject.
    pub fn matches_subject(&self, project_member_ref: &ProjectMemberRef) -> bool;

    /// Returns the selected host and generation only when the control state contains both.
    pub fn selected_target(&self) -> Option<(&HostRef, &HostGeneration)>;
}
```

| 字段 / 变体 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| `NoCurrentHost` | 为首次 launch 或明确 no-action 提供已提交的“无 current host”本地事实 | 只能由 current-fact reader 对本地 truth 选择；不是 backend 空列表、query view 或 L1 absence。 |
| `Current { host_ref, generation }` | 保留可被控制的同一逻辑 host 与 generation | 两个字段必须同次来自 committed current pointer；不得单独用 host ref 或 generation 形成。 |
| `ClosureInProgress { host_ref, generation }` | 明确 ordinary progression 被 local closure 压住 | 只来自 later CMP-MS-06 committed closure relation的 safe local selection；本批不定义 closure body或 cleanup truth。 |
| `Unknown` | 保留无法安全判定 currentness 的事实缺口 | 禁止以 `None`、timeout、adapter error、fake或观察信号伪装 `NoCurrentHost`。 |
| `prior_effective_decision_ref` | 仅作为可选 causal basis，不表示此 decision 当前仍可执行 | local current-fact reader 从 committed local relation选择；不得从 action result或 external request填充。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 返回 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|
| `no_current(...)` | 建立无 current host 的 typed input | 不读取 repository，不证明外部后端没有资源。 |
| `current(...)` / `closure_in_progress(...)` | 建立已有 host + generation 的 typed input | host/generation成对出现；不验证 single-active、CAS或 cleanup。 |
| `unknown(...)` | 显式保留不可判定状态 | 后续 policy 只能形成 `Hold`，不得产生 positive action。 |
| `selected_target()` | 取得成对 target | `NoCurrentHost` / `Unknown` 返回 `None`；不得以该 helper证明 action permitted。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 不是全局 `HostStatus` | 四个变体只表达一次 control evaluation 所需的 narrow current condition；不得吸收 readiness、registration、session、health、Runtime、Sandbox或 backend 状态。 |
| local selection only | facts 必须来自 future local read port的 committed truth；query projection、client cache、adapter result和外部观察都不能填充。 |
| `Unknown` fail closed | `Unknown` 不允许被任意 default、空结果或后续 Job改成 `NoCurrentHost`；新正式 local facts才可形成新 evaluation。 |

#### 9.3.2 `DecisionBasisRef(Set)`、`ExistingIntentFacts` 与 action plan

##### `FormalControlIntakeState`

`FormalControlIntakeState` 补足“carrier 可构造”与“可形成 `Accepted`”之间的必要门槛。`HostIntentSourceRef`、`HostControlScopeRef` 和双锚只保存被 formal mapper 映射过的 consumption carrier；它们本身不证明 source currentness、scope permission、actor authorization 或上游合同已经闭合。因此 `HostControlPolicy` 只有在 candidate 同时带有 `LocallyEvaluable` 时，才可走新的 positive local intake 分支。

```rust
/// Classifies the body-free formal-control input state supplied for one complete host-intent candidate.
pub enum FormalControlIntakeState {
    /// A formal mapper supplied a complete input that may be evaluated against this repository's local control baseline.
    LocallyEvaluable,
    /// A required formal mapping or owner fact is pending, unknown, or blocked and cannot safely enter a positive path.
    WaitingForFormalInput,
    /// A formal mapper supplied a fail-closed local denial for this otherwise complete candidate.
    RejectedByFormalInput,
}

impl FormalControlIntakeState {
    /// Returns whether the state allows only a local baseline evaluation, not an authorization or currentness claim.
    pub fn permits_local_evaluation(&self) -> bool;
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `LocallyEvaluable` | `A formal mapper supplied a complete input that may be evaluated against this repository's local control baseline.` | 表示 mapper 已给出同次、body-free 的可评估输入 | future formal source / scope / anchor mapper；与 candidate 在同一 application operation 中形成 | `HostControlPolicy::evaluate_intake` 的新建候选正向分支；不等于 `Accepted`、authorization 或 source-current proof |
| `WaitingForFormalInput` | `A required formal mapping or owner fact is pending, unknown, or blocked and cannot safely enter a positive path.` | 保留 formal input 尚不能安全判定 | mapper 的 pending / unknown / blocked result；已 complete candidate 可带入本地 waiting record | `HostIntentAcceptanceStatus::Waiting`；不得进入 replay-new accepted 或 decision proposal |
| `RejectedByFormalInput` | `A formal mapper supplied a fail-closed local denial for this otherwise complete candidate.` | 保留 mapper 已明确拒绝的 formal-input 结论 | mapper 的 fail-closed local result | `HostIntentAcceptanceStatus::Rejected`；不得被 policy、clock 或 job 改写为 accepted |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `permits_local_evaluation() -> bool` | 判断能否继续本仓 local baseline guard | 仅 `LocallyEvaluable` 返回 true；纯分类，不读取 L1、不认证 actor、不确认 source currentness、scope permission 或 Governance approval。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| domain-only support value, not business truth | 此 enum 不计入 29 个业务对象，不可持久化为第二份 source / scope / authorization record，也不是 public Command DTO、entry disposition 或 external protocol field。 |
| mapper result is scoped, not external truth | `LocallyEvaluable` 只表示 future mapper 已给出可供本仓**本地**规则评估的输入；它不关闭 `MSVC-UP-002/005`，不使 Work / Identity / Governance truth、permission 或 currentness 可被本对象自行推断。 |
| missing state fails closed before construction | 若调用方连 `LocallyEvaluable` / `WaitingForFormalInput` / `RejectedByFormalInput` 三者之一都不能明确提供，则不得构造 candidate；future entry/application 只能暴露其 owning `blocked / rejected / waiting` surface，不能补 default。 |
| no route/cache/fake upgrade | route、actor presence、cache hit、timeout、adapter availability、fake map、typed ref existence或 local receipt 均不能产生 `LocallyEvaluable`。 |

##### `HostIntentCandidate`

`HostIntentCandidate` 是完整 typed control input 的 domain-only value，不是 command DTO、不会被持久化为第二份 intent，也不是第 30 个业务对象。它只能由 application 在 formal mapper、Core metadata mapping 和 local normalized-key preparation 已完成后传入 domain；缺任意必填 typed carrier 时，不得以 default / raw value 构造。

```rust
/// Carries one fully mapped project-member host-intent candidate into pure domain intake evaluation.
pub struct HostIntentCandidate {
    /// Project-scoped execution subject for the candidate.
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Identity anchor supplied with the same formal control mapping.
    global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Body-free formal source reference for the candidate.
    source_ref: HostIntentSourceRef,
    /// Lifecycle category requested by the formal source.
    requested_action: HostLifecycleAction,
    /// Dual-anchor-bound control scope supplied by the formal mapper.
    scope_ref: HostControlScopeRef,
    /// Already normalized local intent-equivalence key.
    intent_key: HostIntentKey,
    /// Validated or inherited local correlation identity.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// Body-free formal-control input state supplied for this same candidate by the future mapper.
    formal_intake_state: FormalControlIntakeState,
}

impl HostIntentCandidate {
    /// Forms a candidate from complete typed inputs without resolving external truth.
    pub fn from_mapped_input(
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        source_ref: HostIntentSourceRef,
        requested_action: HostLifecycleAction,
        scope_ref: HostControlScopeRef,
        intent_key: HostIntentKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        formal_intake_state: FormalControlIntakeState,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether the candidate scope carries exactly this candidate's supplied anchors.
    pub fn has_matching_scope_anchors(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns the formal-control input state without turning it into external authority.
    pub fn formal_intake_state(&self) -> &FormalControlIntakeState;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `project_member_ref` | `ProjectMemberRef` | 当前唯一执行主语 | future entry 从 formal project-member mapping 取得；不是 `GlobalMemberRef`、Workspace、host 或 backend resource。 |
| `global_member_ref` | `GlobalMemberRef` | 与执行主语同次映射的身份锚 | 必须与 scope carrier中的 identity anchor相同；domain 不做 Identity 查询。 |
| `source_ref` | `HostIntentSourceRef` | 保留 formal source 的 body-free local consumption ref | formal mapper或 safe local rehydrate；不含 Work / Identity / operations正文。 |
| `requested_action` | `HostLifecycleAction` | 保留 formal requested category | formal mapper output；`Hold` / `NoAction` / `Recover` 不可作为输入。 |
| `scope_ref` | `HostControlScopeRef` | 将请求锁到双锚项目型 control scope | 同次 mapper 产物；factory 不重新证明 relation 或 authorization。 |
| `intent_key` | `HostIntentKey` | 提供已经规范化的语义等价锚 | application normalizer only；不是 Core entry idempotency key、request id 或 digest。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 与后续本地 history / decision 保持因果关联 | validated / inherited command context；不作为 replay key。 |
| `formal_intake_state` | `FormalControlIntakeState` | 把同次 mapper 的 local-evaluable / waiting / rejected 输入显式交给 policy | 只能来自 future formal source / scope / anchor mapper 的 body-free result；不是 source body、permission body、actor profile、config、cache或 fake。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 副作用 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|
| `from_mapped_input(...)` | 组合完整的 typed candidate | 无 I/O、无 authorization、无 intent write、无 key canonicalization；不接受 optional 或缺失的主语、source、scope、action 或 formal-intake state。若 scope 未携带同一双锚则返回 `DomainError`，不得形成可持久化 candidate。 |
| `has_matching_scope_anchors()` | 调用 `scope_ref.matches_anchors(...)` 做纯 equality check | 成功构造的 candidate 必为 true；该 check 仍不做 L1 lookup，不能被解释为 actor authorized / source current。 |
| `formal_intake_state()` | 读取 mapper 提供的 bounded local input state | 纯读取；不能据此确认 source / scope / actor truth，policy 仍须执行 action baseline 与 replay guard。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| incomplete or cross-anchor input never becomes a candidate | source、双锚、scope、action、key、correlation、formal-intake state 任一缺失，或 scope 不携带同一双锚时，future entry/application 必须在 domain factory 之前走 rejected / waiting / blocked surface；不得构造半空或自相矛盾的 `HostIntent`。 |
| candidate is not authority | typed carrier齐备与 `LocallyEvaluable` 只说明输入可被 domain 检查，不表示 source current、scope permitted、actor authorized、intent accepted 或 decision committed。 |
| no external body / request DTO | 不增加 payload、route、envelope、credential、endpoint、L1 body、Runtime / Member / Sandbox body或 adapter result字段。 |

##### `ExistingIntentSummary`、`ExistingIntentFacts` 与 `HostIntentReplayDisposition`

```rust
/// Carries the local fields needed to compare one previously recorded intent with a new candidate.
pub struct ExistingIntentSummary {
    /// Typed reference to the already recorded local intent.
    pub intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
    /// Project-scoped subject retained by the recorded intent.
    pub project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Identity anchor retained by the recorded intent.
    pub global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Formal source retained by the recorded intent.
    pub source_ref: HostIntentSourceRef,
    /// Subject-bound scope retained by the recorded intent.
    pub scope_ref: HostControlScopeRef,
    /// Requested lifecycle category retained by the recorded intent.
    pub requested_action: HostLifecycleAction,
    /// Normalized equivalence key retained by the recorded intent.
    pub intent_key: HostIntentKey,
    /// Current acceptance conclusion of the recorded intent.
    pub acceptance_status: HostIntentAcceptanceStatus,
}

/// Carries a selected local replay lookup result without exposing a store row or reservation state.
pub enum ExistingIntentFacts {
    /// The local lookup proved no recorded intent for this subject and normalized key.
    NoExistingIntent {
        /// Subject used by the completed local lookup.
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        /// Normalized key used by the completed local lookup.
        intent_key: HostIntentKey,
    },
    /// One recorded intent was selected for comparison.
    Existing(ExistingIntentSummary),
    /// The lookup could not safely establish a local replay relation.
    LocalFactsUnavailable {
        /// Subject requested by the failed or unavailable local lookup.
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        /// Normalized key requested by the failed or unavailable local lookup.
        intent_key: HostIntentKey,
    },
    /// Local facts expose more than one incompatible record for one subject and normalized key.
    Ambiguous {
        /// Subject for which the local relation is internally inconsistent.
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        /// Key for which the local relation is internally inconsistent.
        intent_key: HostIntentKey,
        /// One existing local intent retained as a conflict witness.
        witness_intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
    },
}

/// Classifies the pure domain replay conclusion before application performs any reservation or write.
pub enum HostIntentReplayDisposition {
    /// No prior local intent was found for the same typed subject and normalized key.
    CreateNew,
    /// A semantically equivalent local intent already owns the stable conclusion.
    ReplayExisting {
        /// Reference to the existing local intent that must be returned unchanged.
        intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
        /// Existing acceptance conclusion returned without a new write.
        acceptance_status: HostIntentAcceptanceStatus,
    },
    /// A non-equivalent or ambiguous local record requires a new explicit conflict fact.
    RecordConflict {
        /// Existing local intent retained as the conflict causality anchor.
        conflicting_intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
    },
    /// Local replay facts are unavailable and the positive path must wait.
    WaitForLocalFacts,
}
```

| value / variant | 作用 | 字段来源与不变量 |
|---|---|---|
| `ExistingIntentSummary` | 将仅用于等价比较的已加载 local fields 与 store row隔离 | future local intent repository 返回 typed summary；不含 repository version、digest、reservation、command body、actor profile、history body或 stored result。 |
| `NoExistingIntent` | 表示 completed local lookup 的明确空结果 | `project_member_ref` 与 `intent_key` 必须匹配 candidate；不能由 timeout、projection、cache、adapter error或 fake counter形成。 |
| `Existing(...)` | 表示刚好一条可比较 local record | `HostControlPolicy` 必须同时比较双锚、source、scope、requested action与 key；单靠 key相同不足以安全重放。 |
| `LocalFactsUnavailable` | 保留 local source不可判定，形成 safe waiting | 不可被转写为 no prior intent、rejected、retry 或 external action。 |
| `Ambiguous` | 表达本地重复 / corruption / concurrent relation冲突 | 只保留一个 typed witness，完整排查与 store repair 留 Step 11/12；不覆盖任一旧 record。 |
| `CreateNew` | 允许后续 policy evaluation 形成一个新 local intent record | 不等于 reservation success、id生成、写入完成或 accepted。 |
| `ReplayExisting` | 返回已存在稳定结论 | 只读返回；不得创建新 intent、decision、history、material marker或 external effect。 |
| `RecordConflict` | 要求将新 input 保存为明确 conflict truth | `conflicting_intent_ref` 不得等于待创建的新 intent ref；不改写 witness。 |
| `WaitForLocalFacts` | 阻止 positive path | 必须形成 `Waiting` 的 local intent only if complete typed candidate 已存在；candidate本身无法构造时仍停在 entry/application fail-closed surface。 |

`ExistingIntentSummary` 的 semantic comparison 不比较 `CorrelationId`：重试可以有不同 trace / correlation，而同一 control intent仍必须返回同一既有 local conclusion。它也不把 acceptance status 当作 semantic identity；status 只决定 replay 返回的稳定本地表面。

##### `HostIntentEvaluationReasons`、`HostControlPlanReasons`、`HostIntentAcceptance` 与 `HostIntentIntakeDisposition`

`HostIntentEvaluationReasons` 与 `HostControlPlanReasons` 是 policy 选择已脱敏 reason 的封装，既不含原始输入，也不自行定义状态。它们不计入 29 个业务对象；唯一目的，是避免 application / entry 用裸 `HostIntentReasonCode` 或 `DecisionReasonCode` 与状态、action 任意拼装。

```rust
/// Carries the four already-redacted reason codes from which intake policy may select one conclusion.
pub struct HostIntentEvaluationReasons {
    accepted: HostIntentReasonCode,
    rejected: HostIntentReasonCode,
    waiting: HostIntentReasonCode,
    conflict: HostIntentReasonCode,
}

impl HostIntentEvaluationReasons {
    /// Forms the complete reason family consumed by one pure intake evaluation.
    pub fn from_redacted_codes(
        accepted: HostIntentReasonCode,
        rejected: HostIntentReasonCode,
        waiting: HostIntentReasonCode,
        conflict: HostIntentReasonCode,
    ) -> Self;
}

/// Carries the already-redacted reasons from which decision policy may select an action, hold, or no-action plan.
pub struct HostControlPlanReasons {
    action: DecisionReasonCode,
    hold: DecisionReasonCode,
    no_action: DecisionReasonCode,
}

impl HostControlPlanReasons {
    /// Forms the complete reason family consumed by one pure orchestration-plan evaluation.
    pub fn from_redacted_codes(
        action: DecisionReasonCode,
        hold: DecisionReasonCode,
        no_action: DecisionReasonCode,
    ) -> Self;
}

/// Couples one local intent-acceptance status with its body-free reason and optional conflict anchor.
pub struct HostIntentAcceptance {
    status: HostIntentAcceptanceStatus,
    reason_code: HostIntentReasonCode,
    conflicting_intent_ref: Option<HostIntentRef>,
}

impl HostIntentAcceptance {
    /// Forms an accepted local conclusion selected by the control policy.
    fn accepted(reason_code: HostIntentReasonCode) -> Self;

    /// Forms a rejected local conclusion selected by the control policy.
    fn rejected(reason_code: HostIntentReasonCode) -> Self;

    /// Forms a waiting local conclusion selected by the control policy.
    fn waiting(reason_code: HostIntentReasonCode) -> Self;

    /// Forms a conflict conclusion with one existing local intent as its required witness.
    fn conflict(
        conflicting_intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
        reason_code: HostIntentReasonCode,
    ) -> Self;
}

/// Returns either a new domain acceptance conclusion or an existing stable replay surface.
pub enum HostIntentIntakeDisposition {
    /// A new local intent record must be formed with this domain-owned conclusion.
    RecordNew(HostIntentAcceptance),
    /// An existing local intent owns the stable replay result.
    ReplayExisting {
        /// Existing local intent to return without a second write.
        intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
        /// Existing acceptance conclusion returned without re-evaluation.
        acceptance_status: HostIntentAcceptanceStatus,
    },
}
```

| value | 作用 | 来源 / 构造资格 | 不变量 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HostIntentEvaluationReasons` | 将 accepted / rejected / waiting / conflict 四条已脱敏分类同时交给 intake policy | application redaction mapper 的完整 typed output；不能由 entry、adapter、fake、配置或 raw string构造 | policy 只能从这四条中选择与实际 local conclusion 同名的 code；不改变 source / scope / replay truth。 |
| `HostControlPlanReasons` | 将 action / hold / no-action 的已脱敏分类同时交给 decision policy | application redaction mapper 的完整 typed output；不接受 action outcome、backend error 或 external result | `Hold` / `NoAction` 也必须有 reason；reason family 不可成为 runtime allowlist 或 retry policy。 |
| `HostIntentAcceptance` | 防止 `HostIntent` 的 status、reason、conflict ref由 application 以互不匹配字段任意拼装 | 只由同文件的 `HostControlPolicy::evaluate_intake(...)` 形成；`HostIntent::record(...)` 消费它 | `Conflict` 必须有且仅有 non-self `conflicting_intent_ref`；非 `Conflict` 必须为 `None`；所有 status 必须有已裁剪 `HostIntentReasonCode`。 |
| `RecordNew` | 告知 application 在 UoW 中创建一次 local intent | policy 已完成纯 domain guard；application 后续仍负责 id / time / reservation / store | 不等于 local commit，不能在此处 append history、reserve replay或调用外部 port。 |
| `ReplayExisting` | 给 application 一个无写入的稳定结果 | 仅由 `HostIntentReplayDisposition::ReplayExisting` 映射 | 不重建 / 重评估 existing intent，不将 old result解释为当前 source、scope或 actor authority。 |

##### `DecisionBasisRef` 与 `DecisionBasisRefSet`

```rust
/// References one committed local fact used as minimal causal basis for an orchestration decision.
pub enum DecisionBasisRef {
    /// Retains the accepted local intent that supplied subject, source, and checked-scope causality.
    AcceptedIntent(HostIntentRef),
    /// Retains the selected current logical host and generation when one exists.
    CurrentHost {
        /// Typed reference to the selected locally owned current host.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Immutable generation paired with the selected host.
        generation: HostGeneration,
    },
    /// Retains a prior local decision only as explicit supersession or current-control causality.
    PriorDecision(HostOrchestrationDecisionRef),
}

/// Carries an ordered, unique, body-free set of local decision bases.
pub struct DecisionBasisRefSet(Vec<DecisionBasisRef>);

impl DecisionBasisRefSet {
    /// Forms a canonical basis set from already selected local decision-causality references.
    pub fn compose(
        accepted_intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
        current_host: Option<(HostRef, HostGeneration)>,
        prior_decision_ref: Option<HostOrchestrationDecisionRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the canonical basis sequence without permitting mutation.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[DecisionBasisRef];

    /// Returns whether this set includes the supplied accepted intent reference.
    pub fn contains_intent(&self, intent_ref: &HostIntentRef) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this set includes the supplied host and generation pair as one basis item.
    pub fn contains_target(
        &self,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this set includes the supplied prior orchestration decision reference.
    pub fn contains_prior_decision(
        &self,
        decision_ref: &HostOrchestrationDecisionRef,
    ) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 / 变体 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| `AcceptedIntent` | 决定的最小 formal-control causal anchor | 必须是将被 loaded `HostIntent` 验证为 `Accepted` 的 ref；它间接回链已校验 scope，不复制 source / scope body。 |
| `CurrentHost` | 记录 target/current generation 的 committed local basis | host / generation 必须成对来自 `CurrentHostFacts::selected_target()` 的同一次 local selection；不含 current pointer row、backend resource或 action outcome。 |
| `PriorDecision` | 记录可能被替代的既有正式决定 | 只能是 selected local relation；不是 external command、recovery decision、generic action ref或 receipt。 |
| `0` | canonical basis sequence | 顺序固定为 `AcceptedIntent`、可选 `CurrentHost`、可选 `PriorDecision`；不得为空、重复、自动排序或以 generic string重建。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 返回 / 不变量 |
|---|---|---|
| `contains_intent(...)` | 检查 basis 中是否包含指定 intent ref | 只做 typed ref equality；不证明被引用 intent 当前仍为 `Accepted`。 |
| `contains_target(...)` | 检查 host / generation 是否作为同一 `CurrentHost` basis 出现 | 两个值必须同时匹配；不得以单个 host 或 generation 命中。 |
| `contains_prior_decision(...)` | 检查是否保留指定 prior decision 因果 | 只做 typed ref equality；不证明 prior decision 仍为 `Committed`。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| scope causality does not duplicate scope body | 本版由 `AcceptedIntent` 间接携带已验证的 `HostControlScopeRef` 因果；不在 decision basis复制 source / scope carrier，以免产生 clone / rehydrate shadow owner。该选择符合 6.1-f “scope only after guard”上限，不削弱 `HostIntent` factory 的双锚检查。 |
| basis is not currentness proof | basis ref 不能替代 proposal / commit 时对 loaded intent、`CurrentHostFacts`、expected generation和revision/UoW guard的再核验。 |
| no external outcome | 不得加入 Runtime run、Member request、Sandbox binding、backend state、source version、action receipt、delivery / observation / acceptance摘要。 |

##### `HostControlActionPlan`

```rust
/// Carries the pure local action conclusion and the optional current-host target selected for one decision proposal.
pub struct HostControlActionPlan {
    /// Project-scoped execution subject for the planned conclusion.
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Explicit local conclusion; it does not assert external execution.
    action: HostOrchestrationAction,
    /// Selected local target when the conclusion applies to one current host.
    target_host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
    /// Expected generation paired with the selected target.
    expected_generation: Option<HostGeneration>,
    /// Redacted local reason for the selected conclusion.
    reason_code: DecisionReasonCode,
}

impl HostControlActionPlan {
    /// Returns whether the plan intentionally avoids lifecycle progression.
    pub fn avoids_progression(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether an action-bearing plan targets exactly one supplied host generation.
    pub fn targets(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this plan is bound to the same subject and selected target facts.
    pub fn matches_current_facts(&self, current_facts: &CurrentHostFacts) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 / 函数 | 作用 | 约束 / 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| `project_member_ref` | 让 plan 与 intent / current facts 固定在同一执行主语 | 只能来自 checked candidate / loaded accepted intent；不得由 global identity或 host反推。 |
| `action` | 保存 policy 形成的 `HostOrchestrationAction` | 只由 `HostControlPolicy::plan_action(...)` 选择；`Hold` / `NoAction` 仍必须有 `reason_code`。 |
| `target_host_ref` + `expected_generation` | 保存可操作 target的成对 local selection | 必须同时为 `Some` 或同时为 `None`；ordinary lifecycle action若作用于 current host则必须为 `Some`。`Launch` only在 `NoCurrentHost` 时可为双 `None`。 |
| `reason_code` | 使 hold / no-action / voidable path保持可追溯 | 已 redacted local control classification；不是 adapter error、external outcome或 generic string。 |
| `avoids_progression()` | 判断 plan 是否为 `Hold` / `NoAction` | 纯判断；不表示 decision ��� committed / voided 或 closure complete。 |
| `targets(...)` | 检查 host + generation pair 是否精准匹配 | 只有两个 optional target均存在且都匹配才返回 true；不能证明 decision状态或 external action。 |
| `matches_current_facts(...)` | 检查 plan 与 current facts 是否锁定同一执行主语及合法 target shape | `Hold` / `NoAction` 必须双 `None`，可匹配同 subject 的任一 control state；action-bearing `Launch` 只可匹配 `NoCurrentHost` 的双 `None`；其他 action-bearing plan 只可匹配 `Current` 的同一 host+generation pair。`Unknown` / `ClosureInProgress` 不得匹配 action-bearing plan；仍不代表 action allowed。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| only policy creates a plan | `HostControlActionPlan` 没有 application、entry、adapter或 fake公开 factory；唯一形成入口是后续 §9.6 `HostControlPolicy::plan_action(...)`。 |
| no unintended progression | `Unknown` / `ClosureInProgress` current facts只能产生 `Hold`；`Hold` / `NoAction`不得进入 qualification、generation、attempt、carrier或 cleanup dispatch。 |
| no action-result leak | plan 不含 adapter capability、backend target、Runtime run、Member command、Sandbox state、external effect key或 outcome。 |

### 9.4 `HostIntent` 对象契约

#### 9.4.1 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostIntent`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 1 个，不新增 `HostControlRequest` 或第二份 intake record。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::control` / planned `crates/domain/src/control.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-01`、`CAP-MS-03`、`IB-MS-001`；承接项目成员型 intent intake、stable replay、explicit conflict、waiting fail-closed 与 decision-input pure inspection。 |
| 主要责任 | 保存完整 mapped candidate 的本地受理结论、双锚、source / scope ref、intent key 和 correlation；只有 `Accepted` 能成为后续 orchestration-decision proposal 的输入。 |
| 不拥有 | Work / Identity / operations source body、actor profile / authorization truth、replay reservation、repository row、history、material、outbox、external action、Member / Runtime / Images / Sandbox truth。 |

#### 9.4.2 Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one locally owned, project-member host-intent acceptance conclusion.
pub struct HostIntent {
    /// Stable local identity generated before this record is constructed.
    intent_id: HostIntentId,
    /// The only execution subject supported by the current design scope.
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// The separately mapped global-member identity anchor for the execution subject.
    global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Body-free formal source reference retained for local causality only.
    source_ref: HostIntentSourceRef,
    /// Formal lifecycle category requested by the mapped source.
    requested_action: HostLifecycleAction,
    /// Dual-anchor-bound control scope retained without source-owner truth.
    scope_ref: HostControlScopeRef,
    /// Normalized local intent-equivalence key, distinct from entry idempotency.
    intent_key: HostIntentKey,
    /// Local causal correlation retained across later host-control records.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// Current local acceptance conclusion for this one intent record.
    acceptance_status: HostIntentAcceptanceStatus,
    /// Redacted reason bound to the current acceptance conclusion.
    reason_code: HostIntentReasonCode,
    /// Existing local intent retained only when this record explicitly records conflict.
    conflicting_intent_ref: Option<HostIntentRef>,
    /// Application-supplied local record time; it is not source time or external observation time.
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostIntent {
    /// Records a new local intent from a complete mapped candidate and a policy-owned acceptance conclusion.
    pub fn record(
        intent_id: HostIntentId,
        candidate: HostIntentCandidate,
        acceptance: HostIntentAcceptance,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates one persisted local intent without re-evaluating source truth or authorization.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        intent_id: HostIntentId,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        source_ref: HostIntentSourceRef,
        requested_action: HostLifecycleAction,
        scope_ref: HostControlScopeRef,
        intent_key: HostIntentKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        acceptance_status: HostIntentAcceptanceStatus,
        reason_code: HostIntentReasonCode,
        conflicting_intent_ref: Option<HostIntentRef>,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the stable local reference without exposing mutable acceptance fields.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostIntentRef;

    /// Returns the current local acceptance classification.
    pub fn acceptance_status(&self) -> &HostIntentAcceptanceStatus;

    /// Returns the local reason associated with the current acceptance classification.
    pub fn reason_code(&self) -> &HostIntentReasonCode;

    /// Returns the optional conflict witness without resolving it.
    pub fn conflicting_intent_ref(&self) -> Option<&HostIntentRef>;

    /// Returns whether this record currently permits an orchestration-decision proposal.
    pub fn is_accepted(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this record has the supplied normalized intent-equivalence key only.
    pub fn matches(&self, intent_key: &HostIntentKey) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this record is bound to the supplied project and global anchors.
    pub fn matches_anchors(
        &self,
        project_member_ref: &ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: &GlobalMemberRef,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Checks the exact accepted intent, source, and scope relation needed by another domain module.
    pub(crate) fn matches_accepted_control_context(
        &self,
        intent_ref: &HostIntentRef,
        source_ref: &HostIntentSourceRef,
        scope_ref: &HostControlScopeRef,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Advances a waiting record to accepted after a policy-owned formal re-evaluation.
    pub fn accept(
        &mut self,
        re_evaluated_candidate: &HostIntentCandidate,
        acceptance: HostIntentAcceptance,
        actor: &ActorContext,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Advances a waiting record to rejected after a policy-owned formal re-evaluation.
    pub fn reject(
        &mut self,
        re_evaluated_candidate: &HostIntentCandidate,
        acceptance: HostIntentAcceptance,
        actor: &ActorContext,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Retains a waiting record after a policy-owned formal re-evaluation remains waiting.
    pub fn mark_waiting(
        &mut self,
        re_evaluated_candidate: &HostIntentCandidate,
        acceptance: HostIntentAcceptance,
        actor: &ActorContext,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Advances a waiting record to conflict after a policy-owned formal re-evaluation.
    pub fn mark_conflict(
        &mut self,
        re_evaluated_candidate: &HostIntentCandidate,
        acceptance: HostIntentAcceptance,
        actor: &ActorContext,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;
}
```

#### 9.4.3 字段来源与约束

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `intent_id` | `HostIntentId` | 定位本地 intent truth | application id generator 或 local repository rehydrate；不得由 source、scope、key、route、time 或 external id 拼接。 |
| `project_member_ref` | `ProjectMemberRef` | 固定唯一执行主语 | 只从 `HostIntentCandidate` 的 formal project-member mapping 取得；不可被 `GlobalMemberRef`、workspace、host 或 backend ref 替代。 |
| `global_member_ref` | `GlobalMemberRef` | 固定同次映射的身份锚 | 只从 candidate 取得，且 candidate factory 已要求 `scope_ref.matches_anchors(...)`；domain 不查询 Identity。 |
| `source_ref` | `HostIntentSourceRef` | 保存 body-free formal source causality | candidate / persisted safe record 提供；不含 Work、Identity、operations 正文。 |
| `requested_action` | `HostLifecycleAction` | 保存 formal requested lifecycle category | candidate 提供；不是 `Hold` / `NoAction`，不含 `Recover`，不等于 committed decision。 |
| `scope_ref` | `HostControlScopeRef` | 保留双锚绑定的 control scope | candidate / persisted record 提供；只做 typed equality，不能证明 permission、source currentness 或 L1 relation。 |
| `intent_key` | `HostIntentKey` | 锚定语义等价重放比较 | application normalizer 或 persisted record 提供；不是 Core `IdempotencyKey`、request id、digest 或 effect key。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 连接后续 decision / history 的因果 | validated / inherited command context；不参与 semantic replay equality。 |
| `acceptance_status` | `HostIntentAcceptanceStatus` | 保存本地受理结论 | 只由 `HostControlPolicy::evaluate_intake(...)` 形成的 `HostIntentAcceptance`，或 waiting-only re-evaluation 的同类结果提供。 |
| `reason_code` | `HostIntentReasonCode` | 保存与 status 绑定的已裁剪理由 | policy-selected acceptance 提供；不得保存 raw error、source body、actor body或 adapter text。 |
| `conflicting_intent_ref` | `Option<HostIntentRef>` | 只在冲突时保留 witness | `Conflict` 必须 `Some` 且不能等于 `to_ref()`；其余状态必须 `None`。 |
| `recorded_at` | `Timestamp` | 标记本地 record 初始时点 | application clock output 或 persisted record；不可用 source、backend 或 client time 替代。后续 transition 的时序由 append-only history 在 application UoW 中承接。 |

#### 9.4.4 factory 与成员函数契约

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `record(HostIntentId, HostIntentCandidate, HostIntentAcceptance, Timestamp) -> Result<HostIntent, DomainError>` | 建立一个新 local acceptance fact | candidate 必须已双锚一致；acceptance 必须是 policy-owned，并与 conflict optionality 一致；无 I/O、history、outbox 或 external action。 |
| `rehydrate(..., HostIntentAcceptanceStatus, HostIntentReasonCode, Option<HostIntentRef>, Timestamp) -> Result<HostIntent, DomainError>` | 重建持久化 intent | 只检查结构、scope anchor 与 status/conflict coherence；不重判 source current、L1 relation、permission 或 authorization。 |
| `to_ref() -> HostIntentRef` | 形成 typed local ref | 纯函数；ref 不代表 accepted。 |
| `acceptance_status() -> &HostIntentAcceptanceStatus` / `reason_code() -> &HostIntentReasonCode` | 读取稳定 acceptance surface | 纯读取；不得从 reason 反解外部结果。 |
| `conflicting_intent_ref() -> Option<&HostIntentRef>` | 读取 conflict witness | 纯读取；不加载或解析 witness。 |
| `is_accepted() -> bool` | 判断是否可作为 proposal 输入 | 仅 `Accepted` 为 true；proposal 仍须重读 intent、current facts 与 UoW / revision guard。 |
| `matches(&HostIntentKey) -> bool` | 判断 key equality | 只比较 key；不得单独决定 replay、authorization 或 source currentness。 |
| `matches_anchors(&ProjectMemberRef, &GlobalMemberRef) -> bool` | 判断本 record 的双锚值相等 | 纯 equality；不查询 L1、不证明 authorization。 |
| `matches_accepted_control_context(&HostIntentRef, &HostIntentSourceRef, &HostControlScopeRef) -> bool` | 为同一 domain crate 内的 recovery 对象提供最窄的 accepted-control 匹配 | 仅在本 record 为 `Accepted`、intent ref 相等、source `same_source`、scope `same_scope` 时返回 true；`pub(crate)` 不暴露 source / scope 正文，也不证明 source currentness、actor authorization、Governance approval 或 external action permission。 |
| `accept/reject/mark_waiting/mark_conflict(&HostIntentCandidate, HostIntentAcceptance, &ActorContext) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 对 waiting record 应用一次 formal re-evaluation | 仅允许当前 `Waiting`；candidate 必须与原 record 的 project/global/source/scope/action/key 同一，correlation 不参与 semantic equality；`HostIntentAcceptance` 的 status 必须分别为目标 status。`ActorContext` 是已由 entry/application 校验的 transition witness，本对象既不认证也不持久化它。 |

`HostIntentAcceptance` 的四个构造函数只能为 `domain::control` 私有成员，且仅 `HostControlPolicy` 可以调用；application 只能消费 `HostIntentIntakeDisposition::RecordNew` 返回的 opaque policy conclusion，再传给 `record` 或 waiting re-evaluation。这样不会让 entry 用裸 reason / status 拼装 Host Truth。

#### 9.4.5 acceptance 状态与合法迁移

| status | 允许形成 / 迁入 | 允许去向 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Accepted` | 新 candidate 的 policy accepted conclusion；或显式 `Waiting -> Accepted` | 后续 decision proposal 的只读输入；history / material 由 application 写 | 不原地变 `Rejected` / `Conflict`，不直接产生 Host、generation 或 action。 |
| `Rejected` | 新 candidate 的 policy rejected conclusion；或显式 `Waiting -> Rejected` | history / safe result | 不进入 decision proposal，不自动 retry / upgrade。 |
| `Waiting` | policy waiting conclusion；等待中的显式 formal re-evaluation | `accept` / `reject` / `mark_conflict` / `mark_waiting`，均须新的 complete candidate + policy conclusion | 不由 clock、query、job、fake、adapter availability、timeout 或 empty lookup 升格。 |
| `Conflict` | policy conflict conclusion；或显式 `Waiting -> Conflict` | history / safe result | 不覆盖 witness、不产生第二 effective decision、不原地转 accepted。 |

```text
new complete candidate
  ├─ structural / baseline reject ─────────► Rejected
  ├─ replay facts unavailable ─────────────► Waiting
  ├─ non-equivalent / ambiguous relation ──► Conflict
  └─ complete local acceptance ────────────► Accepted

Waiting -- policy-owned formal re-evaluation --> Accepted | Rejected | Conflict | Waiting
Accepted / Rejected / Conflict -- no in-place success rewrite --> terminal for this record
```

02 概要中“new facts”语义在本对象的细化口径是：新的正式变化形成新的候选 / linked local fact；不得把既有 `Accepted` record 原地改写为 `Rejected` 或 `Conflict`。这保留 append-only history 的可追溯性，也不改变 02 的状态集合、对象分母或上游 owner。

#### 9.4.6 不变量、禁止事项与后续承接

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| sole execution subject | 只允许 `ProjectMemberRef`；GlobalMember-only、workspace-only、host-only 或 external-resource input 不构造 intent。 |
| dual-anchor equality is necessary, not sufficient | `scope_ref.matches_anchors(...)` 和 `matches_anchors(...)` 只作值比较，不证明 Work / Identity relation、scope permission、source currentness 或 governance approval。 |
| full replay comparison | policy 必须同时比较 project/global anchor、source、scope、requested action 与 key；不能只比较 key 或 correlation。 |
| accepted is not execution | 不创建 Host、generation、qualification、attempt、Runtime session、Member registration、Sandbox binding 或 external dispatch。 |
| no non-command mutation | Query、Consumer、Projection、Job、adapter、fake 和 signal 不能直接调用 transition；它们也不能通过 local receipt、availability 或 timeout 伪造 re-evaluation。 |
| Step 7 handoff | 需要 formal source/scope/anchor mapper、intent replay lookup/persistence、history append、UoW / expected-version 与 idempotency reservation seam；不得新增 L1 body、authorization truth 或 Core shadow schema。 |

### 9.5 `HostOrchestrationDecision` 对象契约

#### 9.5.1 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostOrchestrationDecision`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 2 个，独立于 `HostIntent`、`HostRecoveryDecision` 和任何 action attempt。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::control` / planned `crates/domain/src/control.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-02`、`CAP-MS-03`、`CAP-MS-04`、`IB-MS-002`；承接已 accepted intent + 已选择 committed local current facts到正式 local orchestration decision 的形成、提交、替代、作废与纯读取。 |
| 主要责任 | 保存一个已提议或已提交的、项目成员型宿主生命周期结论；建立与 accepted intent、target/generation、basis、prior-decision 的最小因果关系，并且只在 `Committed` 时供后续 qualification / generation / closure use case 再次 guard 后消费。 |
| 不拥有 | intent/source/scope body、L1 relation / authorization、current-pointer truth、generation fence、repository expected version、idempotency reservation、history / material / outbox、host / attempt / registration / session / health / closure truth，或任何 Member / Runtime / Images / Sandbox / carrier/backend result。 |

#### 9.5.2 Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one locally owned orchestration decision without asserting an external lifecycle effect.
pub struct HostOrchestrationDecision {
    /// Stable local identity generated before the proposal is constructed.
    decision_id: HostOrchestrationDecisionId,
    /// Accepted local intent that is the sole formal-control causal input for this decision.
    intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
    /// Project-scoped execution subject shared with the loaded accepted intent and current facts.
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Explicit local lifecycle conclusion, including hold or no-action when progression is unsafe or intentionally absent.
    action: HostOrchestrationAction,
    /// Selected existing host when this conclusion applies to one current local host.
    target_host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
    /// Expected local generation paired with the selected target.
    expected_generation: Option<HostGeneration>,
    /// Ordered body-free local facts used as causal basis for the proposal.
    basis_refs: DecisionBasisRefSet,
    /// Prior local decision this new decision explicitly replaces, when applicable.
    supersedes_ref: Option<HostOrchestrationDecisionRef>,
    /// Local lifecycle of this decision record, not an external action lifecycle.
    decision_status: LocalDecisionStatus,
    /// Redacted reason selected for the action, hold, no-action, or void conclusion.
    reason_code: DecisionReasonCode,
    /// Correlation retained for local history and downstream use-case causality.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// Application-supplied local proposal time; it is not source, backend, or external outcome time.
    decided_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostOrchestrationDecision {
    /// Forms a proposed local decision from a loaded accepted intent and a policy-produced action plan.
    pub fn propose(
        decision_id: HostOrchestrationDecisionId,
        intent: &HostIntent,
        current_facts: &CurrentHostFacts,
        action_plan: HostControlActionPlan,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        decided_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates one persisted local decision without re-evaluating local or external truth.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        decision_id: HostOrchestrationDecisionId,
        intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        action: HostOrchestrationAction,
        target_host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
        expected_generation: Option<HostGeneration>,
        basis_refs: DecisionBasisRefSet,
        supersedes_ref: Option<HostOrchestrationDecisionRef>,
        decision_status: LocalDecisionStatus,
        reason_code: DecisionReasonCode,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        decided_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the stable local reference without exposing mutable decision fields.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostOrchestrationDecisionRef;

    /// Returns the selected local orchestration conclusion.
    pub fn action(&self) -> &HostOrchestrationAction;

    /// Returns the current local decision-record lifecycle status.
    pub fn decision_status(&self) -> &LocalDecisionStatus;

    /// Returns the redacted local reason without exposing an external outcome.
    pub fn reason_code(&self) -> &DecisionReasonCode;

    /// Returns whether the decision is committed local control truth.
    pub fn is_committed(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this committed decision permits the supplied requested lifecycle action.
    pub fn permits(&self, action: HostLifecycleAction) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this decision is bound to exactly one supplied host generation.
    pub fn targets(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Commits a proposed decision after the application has placed it in its local UoW guard.
    pub fn commit(&mut self, actor: &ActorContext) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Marks a committed decision as explicitly replaced by another local orchestration decision.
    pub fn supersede(
        &mut self,
        replacement_ref: HostOrchestrationDecisionRef,
        actor: &ActorContext,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Voids a proposed decision before any downstream progression is permitted.
    pub fn void(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: DecisionReasonCode,
        actor: &ActorContext,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;
}
```

#### 9.5.3 字段来源与约束

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision_id` | `HostOrchestrationDecisionId` | 定位本地 decision truth | application id generator 或 local repository rehydrate；不得由 intent、action、host、generation、source、time或 external id 拼接。 |
| `intent_ref` | `HostIntentRef` | 锁定唯一 formal-control causal input | 只由 loaded `HostIntent::to_ref()` 提供，且 `propose` 必须复核该 intent 是 `Accepted`；ref 本身不证明 accepted。 |
| `project_member_ref` | `ProjectMemberRef` | 固定 decision 的唯一执行主语 | 从 loaded accepted intent 与 `CurrentHostFacts` 的同一 subject 得到；不得由 GlobalMember、target host、backend或 source 反推。 |
| `action` | `HostOrchestrationAction` | 保存 policy 选择的本地生命周期结论 | 只从 `HostControlActionPlan` 取得；可为 requested-action 映射、`Hold` 或 `NoAction`，但不等于 external dispatch / completion。 |
| `target_host_ref` + `expected_generation` | `Option<HostRef>` + `Option<HostGeneration>` | 绑定 existing-current-host 决定的 target 和旧世代防护 | 必须同为 `Some` 或同为 `None`；只从同一次 `HostControlActionPlan` / `CurrentHostFacts` selection 取得。`Launch` 仅在 `NoCurrentHost` 时可双 `None`；`Restart` / `Replace` / `Stop` / `Terminate` / `Relocate` 仅在 `Current` 时必须双 `Some`；`Hold` / `NoAction` 必须双 `None`。 |
| `basis_refs` | `DecisionBasisRefSet` | 保留 accepted intent、可选 current target、可选 prior decision 的 canonical causal basis | `propose` 由 loaded accepted intent / current facts 组装；其 `AcceptedIntent` 必须等于 `intent_ref`，target 与 optional prior relation必须与 proposal inputs 一致；不嵌 source / scope body、repository version或 external outcome。 |
| `supersedes_ref` | `Option<HostOrchestrationDecisionRef>` | 表示这份新 decision 声明替代的 prior local decision | 只能从 selected `CurrentHostFacts.prior_effective_decision_ref` 或 same-UoW replacement relation取得；若 `Some` 则必须被 `basis_refs` 的 `PriorDecision` 同时记录，且不得等于 `to_ref()`。它不使 prior record 自动 transition。 |
| `decision_status` | `LocalDecisionStatus` | 表示 proposed / committed / superseded / voided 的本地记录状态 | `propose` 固定 `Proposed`；`commit/supersede/void` 唯一可变入口；rehydrate只校验结构，不重放状态。 |
| `reason_code` | `DecisionReasonCode` | 给 action / hold / no-action / void 留下已裁剪因果 | `HostControlActionPlan` 提供初始值；`void` 只接受 policy/application 已裁剪的 replacement reason；不得保存 raw source、actor、adapter、Runtime、Member、Sandbox或 backend text。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 连到 later qualification / history / material 的本地因果 | validated / inherited command context或 persisted record；不作为 semantic replay key、generation或 expected version。 |
| `decided_at` | `Timestamp` | 标记本地 proposal 建立时点 | application clock output 或 persisted record；不是 commit time、source time、signal time、external observation time 或 event offset。 |

#### 9.5.4 factory、读取与 transition 契约

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `propose(HostOrchestrationDecisionId, &HostIntent, &CurrentHostFacts, HostControlActionPlan, CorrelationId, Timestamp) -> Result<HostOrchestrationDecision, DomainError>` | 形成一条 `Proposed` local decision | intent 必须 `Accepted`；current facts与 intent/plan 必须同一 `ProjectMemberRef`；plan须通过 `matches_current_facts` 的 action/target shape guard；basis必须canonical地包含 intent与可选 selected target / prior ref；`Hold` / `NoAction` 可以提议但绝不进入下游 progression。无 I/O、UoW、history、material或 external call。 |
| `rehydrate(...) -> Result<HostOrchestrationDecision, DomainError>` | 重建持久化 local decision | 只检查 target-generation pair、basis/intent/subject/supersedes coherence与状态组合；不确认 loaded intent current status、current pointer、external owner truth或 outcome。 |
| `to_ref() -> HostOrchestrationDecisionRef` | 形成 typed local decision ref | 纯函数；ref 不代表 `Committed`、permitted或 action processed。 |
| `action() / decision_status() / reason_code()` | 暴露最小 pure inspection surface | 只读；不得从 action / reason 推导 external operation、qualification、registration、health或 cleanup state。 |
| `is_committed() -> bool` | 判断 local decision是否可被下游读取 | 仅 `Committed` 返回 true；下游仍必须再验证 `permits(...)`、target/generation、current revision与UoW guard。 |
| `permits(HostLifecycleAction) -> bool` | 判断 committed local decision 是否允许某一 requested action类别进入后续 use case | 仅当 `Committed` 且 `action.requested_action() == Some(input)` 时为 true；`Hold` / `NoAction` 永远 false；不表示 effect prepared、dispatched、accepted或 completed。 |
| `targets(&HostRef, &HostGeneration) -> bool` | 判断 target pair 完整相等 | 只有 target与generation均为 `Some` 且均匹配才为 true；`Launch` / `Hold` / `NoAction` 无 target时为 false；不替代 expected-version / fence。 |
| `commit(&mut self, &ActorContext) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 把 `Proposed` transition 为 `Committed` | 仅 `Proposed` 可调用，actor 是 entry/application 已验证的 transition witness；无 repository save、history append、outbox或 external call。`Hold` / `NoAction` 也可 committed为可追溯 local conclusion，但不授权 progression。 |
| `supersede(&mut self, HostOrchestrationDecisionRef, &ActorContext) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 结束一个已 committed decision的当前效力 | 仅 `Committed -> Superseded`；replacement ref不得为 self、不得为 `None`，并须由 application 在同一 local UoW 中保证已存在或被创建且 subject / causal relation正确。此对象不加载 replacement、不提交它、不写 history。 |
| `void(&mut self, DecisionReasonCode, &ActorContext) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 使尚未授权下游 progression 的 candidate无效 | 仅 `Proposed -> Voided`；更新本地 reason；不允许 `Committed` / `Superseded` / `Voided` 进入 void，不代表 external cancellation。 |

#### 9.5.5 decision 状态、target 与关系闭环

| status | 允许形成 / 迁入 | 允许去向 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Proposed` | `propose(...)` 或结构一致的 local rehydrate | `commit` 或 `void` | 不产生 Host、generation、qualification、attempt、carrier call或 closure；不被 Query / signal / Job / adapter提交。 |
| `Committed` | 显式 `Proposed -> Committed` | 仅 `supersede` | 不是 action prepared / dispatched / completed，不表示 Runtime session、Member registration、Sandbox binding、Images supply、health或 cleanup完成。 |
| `Superseded` | 显式 `Committed -> Superseded`，携带 non-self replacement ref | history / causal basis only | 不重新变 committed / voided，不删除 / 覆盖 prior事实，不因 replacement ref存在而推断 replacement 已 committed。 |
| `Voided` | 显式 `Proposed -> Voided` | history / safe result only | 不重开、commit、supersede或解释成 external cancel / rollback。 |

```text
loaded Accepted HostIntent + selected committed CurrentHostFacts
  |
  +-- policy action plan + canonical basis --> Proposed
                                            |\
                                            | \-- void(reason, actor) --> Voided
                                            |
                                            +---- commit(actor) ------> Committed
                                                                          |
                                                                          +-- supersede(replacement, actor) --> Superseded

Committed + permits(action) + matching target/generation + future UoW guard
  -> downstream qualification / generation / closure use case only
  -> never an external action outcome
```

关系闭环：`supersedes_ref` 存在于**新** decision，描述其提议时要取代的 prior causal relation；prior record必须由 application 同一 UoW 显式调用 `prior.supersede(new.to_ref(), actor)`。两边不由 ref 自动同步，避免 domain object在无 repository / UoW 情况下隐式修改另一条 truth。若这一配对写入、expected version或 currentness无法保证，Step 7+ flow必须 fail closed / conflict，而不是让单侧变成 effective truth。

#### 9.5.6 不变量、禁止事项与后续承接

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| accepted intent is required but not sufficient | `propose` 必须读取 loaded `HostIntent` 且为 `Accepted`，但仍需同 subject current facts、canonical basis、policy action plan和后续 transaction guard；单有 `HostIntentRef` 不可形成 decision。 |
| one target is a pair | `target_host_ref` 与 `expected_generation` 永远同存同缺；不得以 host、generation、source version、backend revision或 event offset单独代替。 |
| basis has no external body | `DecisionBasisRefSet` 只能承接 local accepted intent/current target/prior decision；不得加入 source正文、scope正文、L1 relation、repository row、adapter result、Runtime run、Member request、Sandbox binding或 delivery/observation/acceptance summary。 |
| committed is local truth only | `Committed` 只表明本仓控制决定已在local transaction中成立；它不代表 any action was sent, accepted, dispatched, completed, delivered, observed or accepted by any external owner. |
| no hidden writer | Query、Consumer、Projection、Job、fake、adapter、signal或 timeout不能构造、commit、supersede或 void decision；只有显式 command/use case经 application UoW调用 domain transition。 |
| recovery remains separate | `HostRecoveryDecision` 仍在 CMP-MS-05；不得以 `Recover` action、health signal或 Runtime state写入本对象，或让本对象替代 recovery decision。 |
| Step 7 handoff | 需 `IntentDecisionStorePort` 的 accepted-intent/decision/relation read-save surface、`CurrentHostFactsReaderPort`、UoW / expected-version / replacement-pair guard、history/material append seam；port 不能把 external body、source authorization或 backend currentness塞入本对象。 |

### 9.6 `HostControlPolicy` 对象契约

#### 9.6.1 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostControlPolicy`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 3 个，是不可变 domain policy / guard，不拥有独立 lifecycle truth。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::control` / planned `crates/domain/src/control.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-01~04`、`IB-MS-001~003`；承接项目型 subject / dual-anchor / formal-input、action baseline、stable replay / conflict、current-host / expected-generation与 plan-selection guard。 |
| 主要责任 | 在完整、body-free的 local candidate、replay facts、accepted intent和committed current facts上形成受理结论或 action plan；使缺 mapping / local facts / current facts时可追溯地 fail closed。 |
| 不拥有 | Governance approval / policy transmission、actor authentication、L1 Work / Identity source / authorization truth、config / feature flag、repository / UoW / reservation、clock / id、external resolver / adapter、Member / Runtime / Images / Sandbox / carrier/backend state及任何 public DTO / receipt / disposition。 |

#### 9.6.2 Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Holds the immutable local control baseline used to evaluate host intents and orchestration plans.
pub struct HostControlPolicy {
    /// Declared immutable revision of this repository-local control baseline.
    policy_revision: PolicyRevision,
    /// Closed execution-subject shape supported by this baseline.
    supported_subject_kind: ExecutionSubjectKind,
    /// Immutable requested-action set permitted by the current project-only scope.
    allowed_action_set: HostLifecycleActionSet,
    /// Fixed branch that reuses an equivalent existing local conclusion.
    replay_equivalent_mode: HostIntentConflictMode,
    /// Fixed branch that records non-equivalent or concurrent conflict explicitly.
    record_conflict_mode: HostIntentConflictMode,
}

impl HostControlPolicy {
    /// Creates the immutable project-only control baseline from declared design inputs.
    pub fn from_baseline(
        policy_revision: PolicyRevision,
        allowed_action_set: HostLifecycleActionSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Evaluates a complete candidate and selected local replay facts into a new conclusion or stable replay.
    pub fn evaluate_intake(
        &self,
        candidate: &HostIntentCandidate,
        existing_facts: &ExistingIntentFacts,
        reasons: &HostIntentEvaluationReasons,
    ) -> Result<HostIntentIntakeDisposition, DomainError>;

    /// Classifies the local replay relation without performing a reservation, store read, or external lookup.
    pub fn classify_replay(
        &self,
        candidate: &HostIntentCandidate,
        existing_facts: &ExistingIntentFacts,
    ) -> Result<HostIntentReplayDisposition, DomainError>;

    /// Selects a pure orchestration action plan for a loaded accepted intent and selected committed current facts.
    pub fn plan_action(
        &self,
        intent: &HostIntent,
        current_facts: &CurrentHostFacts,
        reasons: &HostControlPlanReasons,
    ) -> Result<HostControlActionPlan, DomainError>;

    /// Checks whether one optional expected generation is coherent with selected committed current facts.
    pub fn guard_expected_generation(
        &self,
        expected_generation: Option<&HostGeneration>,
        current_facts: &CurrentHostFacts,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;
}
```

#### 9.6.3 固定 baseline 与字段来源

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy_revision` | `PolicyRevision` | 标识本仓声明的不可变 local control baseline | 仅 `from_baseline` 的 declared design input 或 local persisted rehydrate context；不是 Governance policy revision、config、environment variable、adapter version、source version或 host generation。 |
| `supported_subject_kind` | `ExecutionSubjectKind` | 固定当前仅 `ProjectMemberScoped` | factory 无调用者自选参数，固定 `ProjectMemberScoped`；新增 subject须回退 00/01/02，不能配置化。 |
| `allowed_action_set` | `HostLifecycleActionSet` | 固定允许被 formal mapper请求的生命周期类别 | `from_baseline` 接收的 declared canonical set，必须等于 `current_scope_baseline()`；不能因 configuration、feature flag、runtime availability、images supply、adapter capability或 fake增减。 |
| `replay_equivalent_mode` | `HostIntentConflictMode` | 固定等价意图返回已有 stable conclusion | factory 私有固定为 `ReplayEquivalent`；不是 command / entry / config 可选择的模式。 |
| `record_conflict_mode` | `HostIntentConflictMode` | 固定非等价或并发关系记录 explicit conflict | factory 私有固定为 `RecordConflict`；不能以 retry、overwrite、second decision或 external action替代。 |

`HostIntentConflictMode` 的两个 enum variant不是互斥的运行时选择；当前基线必须同时保存两条不可配置规则。`HostControlPolicy` 也不读取配置、L1 truth、Governance approval、policy-transmission path或 adapter；`MSVC-UP-005` 因此仍是 pending。

#### 9.6.4 intake、replay、plan 与 expected-generation guard 契约

| 函数签名 | 输入与分支 | 输出 / 禁止副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `from_baseline(PolicyRevision, HostLifecycleActionSet) -> Result<HostControlPolicy, DomainError>` | revision 必须为已声明 non-empty carrier；action set必须为current project-only canonical baseline；factory固定 subject与两条 conflict rule。 | 返回 immutable policy；不读 config / L1 / Governance / adapter，不产生 policy transmission、authorization或 external action。 |
| `classify_replay(&HostIntentCandidate, &ExistingIntentFacts) -> Result<HostIntentReplayDisposition, DomainError>` | 先要求 candidate双锚一致；所有 fact variant的 subject/key必须与 candidate相符。`NoExistingIntent -> CreateNew`；`Existing` 仅在 project/global anchors、source、scope、requested action与intent key全部相等时 `ReplayExisting`；不等价则 `RecordConflict`；`Ambiguous -> RecordConflict`；`LocalFactsUnavailable -> WaitForLocalFacts`。 | 纯分类；不 reserve key、不查询 store、不生成 id、不写 intent、history、material或 external effect。correlation与 acceptance status均不可替代 semantic comparison。 |
| `evaluate_intake(&HostIntentCandidate, &ExistingIntentFacts, &HostIntentEvaluationReasons) -> Result<HostIntentIntakeDisposition, DomainError>` | candidate structural / anchor不一致直接 `DomainError`；`RejectedByFormalInput -> RecordNew(rejected)`；`WaitingForFormalInput -> RecordNew(waiting)`；`LocallyEvaluable` 先检查 requested action在baseline，再调用 `classify_replay`：`ReplayExisting -> ReplayExisting`，`RecordConflict -> RecordNew(conflict)`，`WaitForLocalFacts -> RecordNew(waiting)`，`CreateNew -> RecordNew(accepted)`。 | policy只用 matching reason slot产生 module-private `HostIntentAcceptance`；不写 record、不 reserve、不改 existing intent、不执行 authorization、不把 typed ref/actor/metadata当 accepted。 |
| `guard_expected_generation(Option<&HostGeneration>, &CurrentHostFacts) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | `Current` / `ClosureInProgress` 时必须有 expected generation且与 selected pair相等；`NoCurrentHost` 时 expected generation必须缺失；`Unknown` 无论有无 expected generation均返回 `DomainError`，使 caller形成 `Hold`而非 positive action。 | 纯 guard；不读取 current pointer、不做 CAS、不判断 external resource、不建立 host/generation。 |
| `plan_action(&HostIntent, &CurrentHostFacts, &HostControlPlanReasons) -> Result<HostControlActionPlan, DomainError>` | intent非`Accepted`或subject不匹配返回 `DomainError`。`Unknown` / `ClosureInProgress` 形成 `Hold`，双 target缺失，使用 hold reason；`NoCurrentHost + Launch` 形成 `Launch`，双 target缺失，使用 action reason；`NoCurrentHost + Stop/Terminate` 形成 `NoAction`，双 target缺失，使用 no-action reason；`NoCurrentHost + Restart/Replace/Relocate` 形成 `Hold`；`Current + Launch` 不能伪造无 host，形成 `Hold`；`Current` 下其余 requested action 映射为同名 orchestration action，带 matching target/generation和 action reason；policy随后以 `guard_expected_generation` 复核 target pair。 | 返回唯一由 policy形成的 plan；不创建 decision、不 commit、不 supersede、不 void、不生成 attempt、不调 external port。任何 `Hold` / `NoAction`均不得被后续 stage解释为qualification、generation、attempt或 dispatch 输入。 |

#### 9.6.5 fail-closed 分支与禁止事项

| 条件 | policy 允许的 local outcome | 明确禁止 |
|---|---|---|
| source / scope / dual-anchor mapper缺失、unknown或blocked | candidate无法构造时由 entry/application `blocked / rejected / waiting`；candidate已完整但 `WaitingForFormalInput` 时 `Waiting` | 用 typed ref、route、cache、actor、metadata、fake或 adapter availability伪造 `LocallyEvaluable` / `Accepted`。 |
| formal mapper明确 fail-closed | `Rejected` | 由 local retry、clock、query、Job或 timeout 改写为 accepted。 |
| replay local facts不可判定 | `Waiting` | 将 unavailable当 no-existing、重跑 external action、创建 second effective decision。 |
| replay relation不等价或 ambiguous | `Conflict`，保留 existing witness | 覆盖既有 intent、隐藏竞争、用 correlation或 key单字段宣称等价。 |
| current facts `Unknown` / `ClosureInProgress` | `Hold` plan，后续无 progression | 以 empty / missing target、adapter receipt、backend availability或 new job宣称 `NoCurrentHost`。 |
| current host上的 `Launch` | `Hold` plan，等待显式替代 / restart / relocation控制路径 | 隐去既有 target、把 `Launch` 当作无 current host，或直接创建 new host / external lifecycle。 |
| no current host下 non-launch | `NoAction`（`Stop` / `Terminate`）或 `Hold`（`Restart` / `Replace` / `Relocate`） | 虚造 host/generation、隐式创建 new host或触发 external lifecycle。 |
| current host action有 generation mismatch或 missing expected generation | `DomainError` 交由 future application映射 conflict / stale / hold；不得形成 positive decision | 用 source version、event offset、backend revision、time或 new key绕过 expected-generation guard。 |
| required external contract尚未闭合 | local record / hold / blocked only | 在 policy中定义 Member launch、Runtime entry/run、Images verification、Sandbox bind/release、credential、Bus route或 external success。 |
