## 9.7 `domain / CMP-MS-02 / qualification.rs` 对象契约

### 9.7.1 本对象组写入边界、唯一 owner 与概要归一

| 项 | 本批收口结论 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::qualification` / `crates/domain/src/qualification.rs` 独占 `HostQualificationContext`、`RequiredQualificationPolicy` 及本节 domain-only qualification value。 | 不在 `contracts`、`application`、`infra`、resolver adapter、fake 或 entry 中 shadow domain object；不把 CMP 名称当 crate。 |
| shared carrier 依赖 | 只导入 `contracts/src/refs.rs` 的 typed id/ref、required kind set、freshness assessment、gap code、safe source ref / summary、`HostGeneration`、双锚和 `Timestamp`。 | 不把 Identity、Work、Images、credential、Sandbox、carrier、Member、Runtime 或 Core/Bus 正文带入 domain。 |
| 业务对象分母 | 本批先闭合 `HostQualificationContext` 与 `RequiredQualificationPolicy` 两个冻结业务对象；随后 `assembly.rs` 闭合 `HostAssembly` 与 `HostReadinessDecision`，四者共同构成 CMP-MS-02 的 4 个冻结业务对象。`QualificationSourceRef`、`QualificationSourceEntry(Set)`、freshness input/evaluation、item/outcome set 和 readiness evaluation都是 domain-only support value，不新增第 30 个对象。 | 不新增 `HostQualificationSource`、`ImageManifest`、`Credential`、`SandboxBinding`、`RuntimeSession` 或 generic `HostStatus`。 |
| qualification 语义 | 只记录一次 generation-bound、body-free 的本地资格语境，并对 required source / freshness 作 fail-closed 分类。 | ref / summary 存在不等于 source resolved、verified、fresh、available、authorized 或 host ready。 |
| external seam | resolver、clock、id、repository、UoW 和 adapter 均由 application / Step 7 持有；本文件只规定它们给 domain 的 typed input 与结果形状。 | domain 不发起 I/O，不读取配置，不调用 resolver，不执行 launch、bind、register 或 Runtime action。 |

本批将概要设计中的 `ExternalRef`、`SafeExternalSummary`、`CapturedAt` 归一为已由 `contracts` 闭合的 role-specific wrapper：资格来源只能使用 `HostQualificationSourceRef`、`HostPinnedImageSupplyRef`、`HostLaunchCredentialRef`、`HostSandboxBindingRef` 或 `HostCarrierCapabilityRef`，摘要只能使用 `HostQualificationSafeSummary`。缺少 exact sibling contract 时，entry 只能构造 `Missing` / `Pending` / `Unknown` 分项，不能制造正向资格。

### 9.7.2 capability / 功能到对象映射

| capability / 功能 | 输入 | 输出 | 本地状态 / 副作用 | domain 对象 / value | 后续 Step 承接 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CAP-MS-05`：建立资格语境 | application 生成的 context id、已提交 decision ref、项目 / 全局双锚、target generation、correlation、local time | 空的 generation-bound context | 新对象为 `Missing` + freshness `Unknown`；无 resolver / external effect | `HostQualificationContext`、`QualificationSourceEntrySet` | Step 7 context store / mapper；Step 8 `IB-MS-004` |
| 收集一个 owner-safe source | matching source kind、role-specific opaque ref、qualification safe summary、可选 source version / captured-at | 一个 source entry | 只在本地 context 中记录 typed carrier；不改变 owner truth | `QualificationSourceRef`、`QualificationSourceEntry` | Step 7 resolver result mapper；Step 9 source resolution flow |
| 记录缺失或未决来源 | required source kind、closed gap code、target generation | unresolved source entry | context 保留 `Missing` / `Stale` / `Conflict` / `Unknown` 的非正向事实 | `QualificationSourceEntry`、`QualificationSourceEntrySet` | Step 8 gap mapping；Step 12 error / recovery |
| 评估 freshness | context entries、opaque freshness-policy ref、evaluation time、owner captured-at | `FreshnessEvaluation` / `FreshnessAssessment` | 只更新本地 freshness classification；不比较未定义的数字阈值 | `FreshnessEvaluationInput`、`FreshnessEvaluation` | Step 7 policy binding / resolver seam；Step 14 配置绑定 |
| 评估 required-source completeness | context、fixed required source set、freshness evaluation | `QualificationEvaluation` | 纯 domain 结论；由 application 决定何时在 UoW 中保存 | `RequiredQualificationPolicy`、`QualificationEvaluation` | Step 9 qualification flow；Step 10 状态矩阵 |
| 保护 no-fallback | resolution status、freshness / gap | allow / reject domain guard | `Resolved` 才能作为 assembly 的正向输入；其余保持 blocked / waiting / unknown | `RequiredQualificationPolicy` | Step 8 result mapping；Step 12 fail-closed |

### 9.7.3 domain-only qualification support value

以下类型仅用于 `qualification.rs` 内部组合 typed source 与分类结果。它们没有 public protocol 身份、不会单独持久化为第二份 truth，也不能被 application 当作 external owner object。

#### `QualificationSourceRef`

```rust
/// Selects one role-specific external-safe reference for a qualification source.
pub enum QualificationSourceRef {
    /// References the project-member qualification source without carrying Work body.
    ProjectMember(HostQualificationSourceRef),
    /// References the global-member qualification source without carrying Identity body.
    GlobalMember(HostQualificationSourceRef),
    /// References a pinned image supply without carrying manifest or digest body.
    PinnedImage(HostPinnedImageSupplyRef),
    /// References an instance-bound launch credential without carrying secret material.
    LaunchCredential(HostLaunchCredentialRef),
    /// References a host-level Sandbox binding without carrying policy or backend body.
    SandboxBinding(HostSandboxBindingRef),
    /// References a carrier capability without carrying backend resource state.
    CarrierCapability(HostCarrierCapabilityRef),
}

impl QualificationSourceRef {
    /// Returns the required-source category represented by this typed reference.
    pub fn kind(&self) -> RequiredSourceKind;

    /// Returns whether this reference is compatible with the supplied required-source category.
    pub fn matches_kind(&self, kind: RequiredSourceKind) -> bool;
}
```

| 变体 | 对应 `RequiredSourceKind` | 来源 / 允许去向 | 禁止解释 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ProjectMember` | `ProjectMemberQualification` | L1-work formal mapper 的 opaque ref；进入 source entry | 不表示 ProjectMember 当前有效、已授权或 Work body 已同步。 |
| `GlobalMember` | `GlobalMemberQualification` | L1-identity formal mapper 的 opaque ref；进入 source entry | 不表示 GlobalMember identity / lifecycle truth 已被本仓拥有。 |
| `PinnedImage` | `PinnedImageSupply` | L2-member-images mapper 的 typed supply ref | 不表示 manifest、digest、provenance、verification 或可实例化已完成；`MSVC-UP-003` 仍 pending。 |
| `LaunchCredential` | `LaunchCredential` | credential owner 的 opaque instance-bound ref | 不表示签发、有效、撤销检查或授权完成；不得携带 secret。 |
| `SandboxBinding` | `SandboxBinding` | L4-sandbox formal binding ref | 不表示 bind、isolation、release、cleanup 或 backend 状态。 |
| `CarrierCapability` | `CarrierCapability` | carrier adapter 的 capability ref | 不表示 backend reachable、资源已分配或 host active。 |

`kind()` 与 `matches_kind()` 仅作封闭类别匹配；它们不调用 owner、不验证 freshness、不写 context，也不产生 `Resolved`。

#### `QualificationSourceEntryStatus`

```rust
/// Classifies the local usability of one required qualification-source entry.
pub enum QualificationSourceEntryStatus {
    /// A typed source reference and safe summary are present for local evaluation.
    Usable,
    /// No formally usable source reference or safe summary is present.
    Missing,
    /// Source identity, scope, anchor, or generation relation conflicts locally.
    Conflict,
    /// The source contract or matching result is not yet available for evaluation.
    Pending,
    /// The source result cannot be safely classified.
    Unknown,
}
```

| 变体 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 | 禁止解释 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Usable` | entry 结构上可交给 freshness / completeness evaluator | 同次 formal mapper 提供 ref + safe summary | policy evaluation input | 不等于 verified、fresh、resolved 或 ready。 |
| `Missing` | 明确缺少正式 ref / summary | domain `mark_unresolved` / policy result | `QualificationResolutionStatus::Missing`、gap | 不表示 owner 删除对象。 |
| `Conflict` | typed source / anchor / generation 互相不一致 | domain structural guard | `Conflict`、gap/history | 不选择任一 side silently，不覆盖旧 context。 |
| `Pending` | exact contract 或 matching outcome 尚未到达 | pending placeholder / waiting mapper | `Partial` 或 `Unknown` / waiting readiness | 不表示 external action 已开始。 |
| `Unknown` | 当前证据不足以安全分类 | resolver / adapter-neutral unknown | `Unknown`、gap/reconciliation | 不当作 missing、failed 或 success。 |

`Stale` 不属于本 enum：source 是否结构可评估与 source 在特定 `FreshnessPolicyRef` 下是否新鲜是两条不同事实。一个 `Usable` entry 仍可因其 owner-captured time 的正式评估而使 context 进入 `QualificationResolutionStatus::Stale`；它不被就地改写为另一个 source-status。

#### `QualificationSourceEntry`

```rust
/// Records one body-free qualification-source observation for a target host generation.
pub struct QualificationSourceEntry {
    /// Closed owner category required by the local qualification policy.
    pub source_kind: RequiredSourceKind,
    /// Optional role-specific source reference; absent for an unresolved entry.
    pub source_ref: Option<QualificationSourceRef>,
    /// Optional redacted source summary; absent when the owner contract is pending or unknown.
    pub safe_summary: Option<HostQualificationSafeSummary>,
    /// Optional owner-supplied source version used only for causal comparison.
    pub source_version: Option<HostExternalSourceVersionRef>,
    /// Optional owner-captured time; it is not local acceptance time.
    pub source_captured_at: Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>,
    /// Local classification of whether this entry may participate in evaluation.
    pub status: QualificationSourceEntryStatus,
    /// Optional body-free gap explaining a non-usable entry.
    pub gap_code: Option<QualificationGapCode>,
}

impl QualificationSourceEntry {
    /// Creates a usable entry from a matching typed reference and safe summary.
    pub fn usable(
        source_kind: RequiredSourceKind,
        source_ref: QualificationSourceRef,
        safe_summary: HostQualificationSafeSummary,
        source_version: Option<HostExternalSourceVersionRef>,
        source_captured_at: Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Creates an unresolved entry with an explicitly permitted source-scoped gap.
    pub fn unresolved(
        source_kind: RequiredSourceKind,
        status: QualificationSourceEntryStatus,
        gap_code: QualificationGapCode,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether the entry has the supplied source category.
    pub fn matches_kind(&self, source_kind: RequiredSourceKind) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether the entry can participate in a local freshness evaluation.
    pub fn is_usable(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns the optional source-safe reference without resolving its owner.
    pub fn source_ref(&self) -> Option<&QualificationSourceRef>;

    /// Returns the optional redacted summary without exposing source body.
    pub fn safe_summary(&self) -> Option<&HostQualificationSafeSummary>;

    /// Returns the local gap classification, if one was recorded.
    pub fn gap_code(&self) -> Option<QualificationGapCode>;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / optional 规则 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source_kind` | `RequiredSourceKind` | 固定 entry 的 owner 类别和 canonical key | 由 policy 要求或 mapper 分类提供；必填，不可由 summary kind 推断。 |
| `source_ref` | `Option<QualificationSourceRef>` | 保存 role-specific opaque ref | `Usable` 必须 `Some`；`Missing` / `Pending` / `Unknown` 可为 `None`；不得存 raw string / owner body。 |
| `safe_summary` | `Option<HostQualificationSafeSummary>` | 保存已裁剪 source summary | `Usable` 必须 `Some`；不得由 local receipt、adapter availability 或 timeout 代替。 |
| `source_version` | `Option<HostExternalSourceVersionRef>` | 保留 owner version 以便 matching / re-evaluation | 仅 owner mapper / safe persistence 提供；缺失不以 local revision、cursor、generation 或 timestamp 补造。 |
| `source_captured_at` | `Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>` | 保留 owner 摘要形成时点 | 只来自 owner；不等于 `captured_at`、`updated_at` 或本地 clock。 |
| `status` | `QualificationSourceEntryStatus` | 逐项本地分类 | 只能由 entry factory 或 domain evaluator 选择；`Usable` 不表示 external verification。 |
| `gap_code` | `Option<QualificationGapCode>` | 非正向分类的 body-free 原因 | `Usable` 必须 `None`；非正向状态须使用与 source scope 兼容的 code。 |

`usable(...)` 必须验证 `source_ref.matches_kind(source_kind)`、summary 已是 `Qualification` kind 且 `gap_code == None`；`unresolved(...)` 必须拒绝 `Usable`、拒绝 item-only gap code，并要求 status 与 code 组合一致。任何 invalid combination 返回既有 `DomainError` invariant surface，不创建 entry。

#### `QualificationSourceEntrySet`

```rust
/// Holds the canonical, unique source-entry sequence for one qualification context.
pub struct QualificationSourceEntrySet(Vec<QualificationSourceEntry>);

impl QualificationSourceEntrySet {
    /// Creates the only empty entry set, for a context that has just been opened.
    pub fn empty_for_open_context() -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a non-empty canonical entry sequence without sorting or deduplicating it.
    pub fn try_new(entries: Vec<QualificationSourceEntry>) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Appends the next canonical source entry while rejecting duplicates and out-of-order input.
    pub fn append_canonical(&mut self, entry: QualificationSourceEntry) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns the entry for one source category, if that category has been recorded.
    pub fn find(&self, source_kind: RequiredSourceKind) -> Option<&QualificationSourceEntry>;

    /// Returns entries in their declared canonical order.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[QualificationSourceEntry];

    /// Returns whether every required category has one structurally usable entry.
    pub fn has_usable_entries_for(&self, required: &RequiredSourceKindSet) -> bool;
}
```

| 项 | 契约 |
|---|---|
| 唯一 key | 一条 entry 的唯一 key 是 `RequiredSourceKind`，不是 opaque ref、summary code、source version、captured time、correlation、arrival order 或 `ProjectMemberRef`。同一 context 内不得出现两个相同 kind 的 entry。 |
| canonical order | 必须严格遵循 `ProjectMemberQualification -> GlobalMemberQualification -> PinnedImageSupply -> LaunchCredential -> SandboxBinding -> CarrierCapability` 的 declaration order。`try_new` 和 `append_canonical` 均只验证调用方已经给出的顺序，绝不排序、去重、选择较新项或补默认项。 |
| empty 的唯一语义 | `empty_for_open_context()` 只能由 `HostQualificationContext::open` 采用，表示尚未记录任何 source；它不是“所有 source 已满足”、不是空 required set、也不是可进入 assembly 的快捷表示。`try_new(Vec::new())` 必须失败。 |
| incremental 记录 | `append_canonical` 只接受尚未出现、且 rank 恰在已记录末项之后的 entry。异步 resolver 到达顺序、cache 命中、fake map、timeout 或 adapter 回调不能让 domain 自动重排；future application 必须保留原有 typed result，待能按 canonical order 传入时再调用。 |
| 读取上限 | `find` / `as_slice` 只读返回 local entry；不调用 owner、不刷新 source、不选择 replacement、不比较 source version，也不把 ref / summary 解释为 `Resolved`。 |

`has_usable_entries_for(...)` 只回答每个 required kind 是否已有且为 `Usable` 的结构性 entry；它不读取 `FreshnessAssessment`，因此**不能**形成 `QualificationResolutionStatus::Resolved`。`Resolved` 的唯一来源仍是后述 `RequiredQualificationPolicy::evaluate_context(...)`。

### 9.7.4 freshness evaluation support value

freshness 数值、duration、clock-skew、timeout、cache-age、config key、allowlist 与 policy transmission 都不属于 `qualification.rs`。本模块只接收 application / future binding seam 已以 `FreshnessPolicyRef` 绑定、并已裁剪成有限分类的 source-level input，随后检查其与本 context 的 typed entry 是否一致。因而 local clock 只能作为 evaluation 的记录时点，**不能**在 source evidence 缺失时补造 `Fresh`。

```rust
/// Classifies the freshness of one required source after its bound policy was evaluated outside the domain object.
pub enum QualificationSourceFreshnessStatus {
    /// Owner-supplied captured evidence satisfies the bound freshness policy.
    Fresh,
    /// Owner-supplied captured evidence is outside the bound freshness policy.
    Stale,
    /// Freshness cannot be determined from owner-safe evidence.
    Unknown,
}

/// Carries one canonical source-level freshness classification without threshold values.
pub struct QualificationSourceFreshness {
    /// Required source category to which this classification applies.
    source_kind: RequiredSourceKind,
    /// Bound-policy classification supplied for the matching source evidence.
    status: QualificationSourceFreshnessStatus,
    /// Owner-captured time retained only when the source supplied it.
    source_captured_at: Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>,
    /// Optional body-free reason for stale or unknown evidence.
    reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
}

/// Supplies policy-bound, canonical freshness evidence for one context evaluation.
pub struct FreshnessEvaluationInput {
    /// Opaque binding of the freshness rule used by the upstream evaluator.
    freshness_policy_ref: FreshnessPolicyRef,
    /// Local time at which this already-bound evidence was presented for evaluation.
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    /// Canonical, unique source evidence supplied by the binding seam.
    source_evidence: Vec<QualificationSourceFreshness>,
}

/// Records the structural result of evaluating source-level freshness for one context.
pub struct FreshnessEvaluation {
    /// Opaque binding that was checked against the local qualification policy.
    freshness_policy_ref: FreshnessPolicyRef,
    /// Local evaluation time supplied by application; never a replacement source time.
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    /// Canonical source-level classifications retained for this pure evaluation.
    source_evidence: Vec<QualificationSourceFreshness>,
    /// Aggregate fresh, stale, or unknown classification for the context.
    assessment: FreshnessAssessment,
}

/// Carries the only policy-produced qualification conclusion that a context may apply.
pub struct QualificationEvaluation {
    /// Local context to which this conclusion is bound.
    context_ref: HostQualificationContextRef,
    /// Immutable target generation shared with the evaluated context.
    target_generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Opaque freshness binding that was checked for this conclusion.
    freshness_policy_ref: FreshnessPolicyRef,
    /// Local resolution conclusion selected from required entries and freshness evidence.
    resolution_status: QualificationResolutionStatus,
    /// Aggregate freshness classification used by the conclusion.
    freshness: FreshnessAssessment,
    /// Canonical source-scoped gaps retained for a non-resolved conclusion.
    gap_refs: Option<ReadinessGapRefSet>,
}

impl FreshnessEvaluationInput {
    /// Creates a canonical freshness input without evaluating numeric thresholds in this module.
    pub fn try_new(
        freshness_policy_ref: FreshnessPolicyRef,
        evaluated_at: Timestamp,
        source_evidence: Vec<QualificationSourceFreshness>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the opaque binding identity without exposing policy contents.
    pub fn freshness_policy_ref(&self) -> &FreshnessPolicyRef;
}

impl QualificationSourceFreshness {
    /// Creates one source-level classification from an already bound owner result.
    pub fn from_bound_classification(
        source_kind: RequiredSourceKind,
        status: QualificationSourceFreshnessStatus,
        source_captured_at: Option<HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>,
        reason: Option<HostSafeSummaryReason>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the source category covered by this classification.
    pub fn source_kind(&self) -> RequiredSourceKind;

    /// Returns the closed freshness classification.
    pub fn status(&self) -> &QualificationSourceFreshnessStatus;

    /// Returns the owner-captured time, if supplied.
    pub fn source_captured_at(&self) -> Option<&HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt>;
}

impl FreshnessEvaluation {
    /// Validates source evidence against one context and computes only the aggregate closed classification.
    pub fn assess(
        context: &HostQualificationContext,
        required_sources: &RequiredSourceKindSet,
        input: FreshnessEvaluationInput,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the aggregate assessment without asserting qualification resolution.
    pub fn assessment(&self) -> &FreshnessAssessment;

    /// Returns source-level classifications in canonical order.
    pub fn source_evidence(&self) -> &[QualificationSourceFreshness];
}

impl QualificationEvaluation {
    /// Returns the policy-produced resolution classification.
    pub fn resolution_status(&self) -> &QualificationResolutionStatus;

    /// Returns the aggregate freshness classification used by the policy conclusion.
    pub fn freshness(&self) -> &FreshnessAssessment;

    /// Returns canonical source-scoped gaps when this is a non-resolved conclusion.
    pub fn gap_refs(&self) -> Option<&ReadinessGapRefSet>;
}
```

| 类型 / 变体 | 字段来源与结构规则 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| `QualificationSourceFreshnessStatus::Fresh` | 只可由 future policy-binding / mapper seam 基于 owner-supplied captured evidence给出；对应 `source_captured_at` 必须为 `Some`，且与 matching `QualificationSourceEntry.source_captured_at` 相等。 | 不得由 `evaluated_at`、local clock、cache hit、source version、adapter availability、receipt或 fake 构造。 |
| `Stale` | 同样必须有 matching owner-captured evidence；reason 可选但只能是 `HostSafeSummaryReason`。 | 不得本地修复、自动重试或把 stale 改成 fresh。 |
| `Unknown` | evidence 缺失、captured time 缺失、owner classification 未到、分类与 entry 不匹配或 formal binding 不可判定时的 fail-closed 值。 | 不得降格成 Missing 或 Failed，也不得以 local time补齐。 |
| `FreshnessEvaluationInput` | `freshness_policy_ref` 只能由 caller 从正式 binding 提供；evidence 按 `RequiredSourceKind` declaration order、unique，且只覆盖 matching `Usable` entries。`evaluated_at` 只能来自 future application clock output。 | 不含 threshold、duration、timeout、config、policy body、owner body、secret、route、endpoint或 resolver handle。 |
| `FreshnessEvaluation` | `assess` 要求 input binding 与后续 policy binding相等；required `Usable` entry 缺 evidence、重复 evidence、out-of-order evidence、captured-at mismatch 或 `Fresh/Stale` 无 captured time 均使对应分类为 `Unknown`，不自动修正 input。aggregate 优先级为 `Unknown > Stale > Fresh`。`FreshnessAssessment.captured_at` 只在恰有一个 required source 贡献确定 classified captured time 时保留；多 source 时必须为 `None`，source-level time 留在 evidence 中，不能在 domain 取 min/max。 | 不读取 config / port，不比较数字，不写 context，不推进 readiness。 |
| `QualificationEvaluation` | 只由 `RequiredQualificationPolicy` 构造，并携带 context ref、target generation 和 freshness binding，防止跨 context / 跨 generation / 跨 binding套用。`Resolved` 必须同时具有 `FreshnessAssessmentStatus::Fresh`、required source 都是 `Usable`、且 `gap_refs == None`；其它 status 必须保留 `Some(non_empty canonical gap set)`。 | context、adapter、entry、fake 或 public mapper不得直接构造 `Resolved`、删除 gap 或绕过 policy。 |

`FreshnessEvaluationInput::try_new(...)` 必须拒绝空 evidence、重复 source kind、非 canonical order、`Fresh/Stale` 缺 source-captured time、`Fresh` 携带 reason，以及 raw `Timestamp` 冒充 `HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt`。这是一条结构验证，不是在 domain 中实现 freshness 算法。若 caller 没有 formal binding、owner evidence 或已定义 policy-evaluator 输出，则只能提供 `Unknown` source classification，或在 application 自己的 owning surface停在 `pending / blocked`；不得先造出 `FreshnessEvaluationInput` 的 positive 值。

`QualificationSourceFreshness::from_bound_classification(...)` 是 source-level value 的唯一构造入口；它不接受 raw `String`、数字阈值或裸 `Timestamp`。`Unknown` 可以没有 captured time；`Fresh` / `Stale` 没有 owner-captured time 时必须拒绝 positive construction（调用方应改传 `Unknown`），从而避免在 domain 内隐式制造时点证据。

### 9.7.5 `HostQualificationContext` 对象契约

#### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostQualificationContext`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 4 个，表示一次已提交 control decision 下、单一 target generation 的 body-free qualification context。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::qualification` / `crates/domain/src/qualification.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-05`、`IB-MS-004`、qualification source change consumer 和 `IB-MS-006` 的只读依据。 |
| 主要责任 | 保存 committed-decision causal ref、项目型双锚、target generation、一次性 canonical source entries、policy-produced resolution / freshness 与 correlation；只接受正式 owner 的 typed safe input。 |
| 不拥有 | L1 Identity / Work truth、image manifest / digest、credential secret / issuance、Sandbox backend / policy、carrier truth、Member / Runtime state、resolver / clock / config、repository / UoW、history / outbox、public DTO 或 readiness decision。 |

#### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one generation-bound, body-free qualification context for a committed local decision.
pub struct HostQualificationContext {
    /// Stable local identity for this qualification context.
    context_id: HostQualificationContextId,
    /// Locally committed orchestration decision that causally opened this context.
    decision_ref: HostOrchestrationDecisionRef,
    /// Project-scoped execution subject for the context.
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Identity anchor supplied with the same formal subject mapping.
    global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Immutable host generation to which every source entry applies.
    target_generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Canonical body-free observations keyed by required source category.
    source_entries: QualificationSourceEntrySet,
    /// Policy-produced qualification conclusion; never inferred from entry presence.
    resolution_status: QualificationResolutionStatus,
    /// Policy-produced aggregate freshness classification.
    freshness: FreshnessAssessment,
    /// Canonical source gaps from the latest policy conclusion, absent only for a resolved context.
    qualification_gap_refs: Option<ReadinessGapRefSet>,
    /// Local time at which this context was opened; it is not an owner source time.
    captured_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local causal correlation retained for assembly, decision, and history linkage.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

impl HostQualificationContext {
    /// Opens an empty context only from a loaded committed local orchestration decision.
    pub fn open(
        context_id: HostQualificationContextId,
        committed_decision: &HostOrchestrationDecision,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        target_generation: HostGeneration,
        captured_at: Timestamp,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Records one next-canonical usable qualification source without resolving its owner.
    pub fn record_source(&mut self, entry: QualificationSourceEntry) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records one next-canonical unresolved source classification without inventing a reference or summary.
    pub fn mark_unresolved(
        &mut self,
        source_kind: RequiredSourceKind,
        status: QualificationSourceEntryStatus,
        gap_code: QualificationGapCode,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Assesses supplied policy-bound freshness evidence without reading a clock, configuration, or source owner.
    pub fn assess_freshness(
        &self,
        required_sources: &RequiredSourceKindSet,
        input: FreshnessEvaluationInput,
    ) -> Result<FreshnessEvaluation, DomainError>;

    /// Applies the only policy-produced resolution and aggregate freshness conclusion.
    pub fn apply_evaluation(&mut self, evaluation: QualificationEvaluation) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this context is bound to exactly the supplied target generation.
    pub fn matches_generation(&self, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns structural source completeness without asserting freshness or resolution.
    pub fn is_complete(&self, required_sources: &RequiredSourceKindSet) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local reference without exposing mutable source entries.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostQualificationContextRef;

    /// Returns the policy-produced resolution classification.
    pub fn resolution_status(&self) -> &QualificationResolutionStatus;

    /// Returns the aggregate freshness assessment.
    pub fn freshness(&self) -> &FreshnessAssessment;

    /// Returns source-scoped gaps from the latest policy evaluation when the context is non-resolved.
    pub fn qualification_gap_refs(&self) -> Option<&ReadinessGapRefSet>;

    /// Returns canonical source entries for same-crate policy evaluation only.
    pub fn source_entries(&self) -> &QualificationSourceEntrySet;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `context_id` | `HostQualificationContextId` | 本地 qualification context identity | application id generator 或 local store rehydrate；不能从 decision、subject、generation、source、timestamp或 external id拼接。 |
| `decision_ref` | `HostOrchestrationDecisionRef` | 保留唯一 local control causality | `open` 只能从 loaded `HostOrchestrationDecision` 且 `is_committed()` 为 true 后调用 `to_ref()` 取得。该 check 不替代 future application 对 subject / action / UoW 的 committed-decision selection。 |
| `project_member_ref` + `global_member_ref` | `ProjectMemberRef` + `GlobalMemberRef` | 固定 project-only execution subject 与 identity anchor | 由同次 formal mapping / accepted local control path提供；仅 equality relation，domain 不重新查询 L1 relation。 |
| `target_generation` | `HostGeneration` | 防止 source / freshness 跨 generation 复用 | application 从已选择的 lifecycle path 提供；不得用 source version、backend revision、Runtime run、timestamp或 current pointer替代。 |
| `source_entries` | `QualificationSourceEntrySet` | 保存 per-source body-free local classification | `open` 固定 empty；后续仅以 canonical entry API追加。ref / summary / status均不等于 owner truth。 |
| `resolution_status` | `QualificationResolutionStatus` | 本地 policy conclusion | `open` 固定 `Missing`；之后仅 `apply_evaluation` 可改写，禁止 record method、ref presence、summary presence、cache、adapter或 fake 直接写 `Resolved`。 |
| `freshness` | `FreshnessAssessment` | 保存 policy-produced aggregate classification | `open` 固定 `Unknown`、无 local-clock fallback；之后只由 `apply_evaluation` 接收的 `QualificationEvaluation`更新。 |
| `qualification_gap_refs` | `Option<ReadinessGapRefSet>` | 保留最新 policy conclusion 的 canonical source-scoped gaps | `open` 固定 `None`，只表示尚未评估，绝不表示无 gap；`Resolved` 时必须为 `None`，任何 non-resolved已评估结论必须为 `Some(non-empty)`。不从 entry、receipt、cache或 public projection隐式生成。 |
| `captured_at` | `Timestamp` | 标记本地 context opening time | application clock output；不是 source owner captured time、freshness proof、decision commit time或 external observation time。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 链接本地 qualification / assembly / readiness / history causal path | validated / inherited command or consumer context；不是 idempotency key、source identity或 generation。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `open(...) -> Result<HostQualificationContext, DomainError>` | 建立空的 generation-bound context | 必须由 loaded committed decision 调用；若 decision 非 `Committed` 则失败。创建 `empty_for_open_context()`、`Missing`、`FreshnessAssessment::Unknown`；不 resolver、不写 store、不生成 Host、不发起 assembly / bind / register / Runtime action。 |
| `record_source(QualificationSourceEntry) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 记录一个结构上可评估的 source | 只接受 `Usable` entry，调用 entry set 的 canonical append。重复 kind、out-of-order、non-usable、跨 generation source relation或 raw ref/body均失败；不改变 resolution / freshness。 |
| `mark_unresolved(RequiredSourceKind, QualificationSourceEntryStatus, QualificationGapCode) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 显式保留 missing / conflict / pending / unknown source | 内部只使用 `QualificationSourceEntry::unresolved` 后 canonical append；`Usable`、item scope code、重复 kind或 silent fallback 均失败；不把 pending 解释成 external action。 |
| `assess_freshness(&RequiredSourceKindSet, FreshnessEvaluationInput) -> Result<FreshnessEvaluation, DomainError>` | 验证 evidence 与当前 entries 的对应关系 | pure；要求 context 中所有 matching `Usable` required entry有唯一 canonical evidence；不访问 policy contents、不读 clock、不写 context。 |
| `apply_evaluation(QualificationEvaluation) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 应用 policy 唯一可写的 qualification conclusion | 验证 evaluation 的 context ref、target generation、freshness binding与当前 context精确一致；`Resolved` 必有 fresh assessment、`gap_refs == None` 和 structural completeness；其它状态必须有 non-empty matching gap。只更新 `resolution_status` / `freshness` / `qualification_gap_refs`，不增加 source、不调用 external owner。 |
| `matches_generation` / `is_complete` | 纯 guard / inspection | 前者只比较 target generation；后者只检查 required `Usable` entries。两者均不证明 `Resolved` / `Ready`。 |

| 工厂 / 静态函数 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 使用场景 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostQualificationContext::open(...)` | 形成唯一合法的空 context | local context id、loaded committed decision、双锚、target generation、local timestamp、correlation | `Result<HostQualificationContext, DomainError>` | future `ResolveHostQualificationCommand` 的 domain phase；exact command DTO / store / UoW 留 Step 7~11。 |
| `QualificationSourceEntry::usable(...)` | 形成可参与 freshness 的 source entry | matching typed ref / summary、optional owner version/time | `Result<QualificationSourceEntry, DomainError>` | future resolver mapper 已给出 fully typed, body-free input时。 |
| `QualificationSourceEntry::unresolved(...)` | 形成显式非正向 source entry | source kind、non-usable status、source-scoped gap | `Result<QualificationSourceEntry, DomainError>` | missing / pending / conflict / unknown 的 fail-closed分支。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| committed ref is a causal precondition, not an action result | `decision_ref` 从已 loaded committed decision 得到只表示本仓控制决定可作为 qualification 的 local causal输入；不表示 host / generation / image / credential / Sandbox / Member / Runtime action 已存在或成功。 |
| resolved has one construction path | `Resolved` 只能由 `RequiredQualificationPolicy::evaluate_context` 构造的 `QualificationEvaluation` 经 `apply_evaluation` 写入；不得由 `source_entries` 数量、typed ref、summary、safe receipt、adapter availability、cached projection、timeout或 fake推导。 |
| source snapshots stay body-free | context 永远不保存 L1 body、manifest、digest、credential secret、Sandbox/backend policy、carrier resource、Member/Runtime request / session / signal或 Core / Bus envelope。 |
| generation and re-evaluation remain explicit | context 不可跨 generation 复用；同一 source kind不能在同一 context 中以新版 ref / summary覆盖旧 entry。新的 owner fact需要 future application 创建新 context / re-evaluation path，并在 Step 11 定义 history / UoW。 |
| no local freshness repair | missing `source_captured_at`、missing formal binding或 unknown evidence只能留 `Unknown` / non-ready；`captured_at`、`evaluated_at`、cache age、source version和local receipt都不是替代证据。 |

### 9.7.6 `RequiredQualificationPolicy` 对象契约

#### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `RequiredQualificationPolicy`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 5 个，是不可变 domain policy / guard，不拥有 qualification、assembly 或 readiness 生命周期。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::qualification` / `crates/domain/src/qualification.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-05~08`、`IB-MS-004~006`；承接 required source / item baseline、freshness binding compatibility和 no-fallback local guard。 |
| 主要责任 | 在已加载 `HostQualificationContext`、`FreshnessEvaluation` 与稍后 `HostAssembly` 上形成 body-free、same-generation 的 local classification；明确 required 集合不能由 action、adapter、fake 或配置改写。 |
| 不拥有 | freshness数值 / 配置、L1 / Images / credential / Sandbox / carrier owner truth、resolver、clock、repository / UoW、public protocol、host progression、Member registration、Runtime session、健康、外部 action 或 completion。 |

#### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Holds the immutable required qualification and assembly baseline for one local policy revision.
pub struct RequiredQualificationPolicy {
    /// Declared local policy baseline revision; not Governance policy truth.
    policy_revision: PolicyRevision,
    /// Canonical source categories that every positive qualification context must cover.
    required_source_kinds: RequiredSourceKindSet,
    /// Canonical item categories that every positive assembly must freeze.
    required_item_kinds: RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet,
    /// Opaque binding of the freshness rule consumed by this local guard.
    freshness_policy_ref: FreshnessPolicyRef,
}

impl RequiredQualificationPolicy {
    /// Creates the immutable, fail-closed baseline from already declared local carriers.
    pub fn from_baseline(
        policy_revision: PolicyRevision,
        required_source_kinds: RequiredSourceKindSet,
        required_item_kinds: RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet,
        freshness_policy_ref: FreshnessPolicyRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the immutable required source categories without action-dependent expansion.
    pub fn required_sources(&self) -> &RequiredSourceKindSet;

    /// Returns the immutable required item categories only when the supplied environment binding is typed.
    pub fn required_items(
        &self,
        environment_requirement_ref: &HostEnvironmentRequirementRef,
    ) -> &RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet;

    /// Evaluates one matching-generation context using the supplied bound freshness evidence.
    pub fn evaluate_context(
        &self,
        context: &HostQualificationContext,
        freshness: FreshnessEvaluation,
    ) -> Result<QualificationEvaluation, DomainError>;

    /// Evaluates frozen item outcomes and same-generation qualification facts for readiness construction.
    pub fn evaluate_assembly(
        &self,
        input: &ReadinessEvaluationInput,
    ) -> Result<ReadinessEvaluation, DomainError>;

    /// Rejects every resolution that is not explicitly resolved and fresh under this policy binding.
    pub fn guard_no_fallback(
        &self,
        context: &HostQualificationContext,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns the opaque freshness binding used by this immutable local guard.
    pub fn freshness_policy_ref(&self) -> &FreshnessPolicyRef;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy_revision` | `PolicyRevision` | 标识本仓 immutable qualification baseline revision | declared local baseline 或 safe persisted rehydrate；不是 Governance approval / policy truth、config version、source version、generation或 timestamp。 |
| `required_source_kinds` | `RequiredSourceKindSet` | 固定正向 qualification 必须覆盖的 source 类别 | 只能接受已声明、non-empty、canonical closed set；不得由 requested action、resolver output、cache、adapter / fake或 config减少 / 增加。 |
| `required_item_kinds` | `RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet` | 固定正向 assembly 必须 freeze 的 item 类别 | 只能接受已声明、non-empty、canonical closed set；`MemberRegistration` 和 `RuntimeSession` 永远不在集合内。 |
| `freshness_policy_ref` | `FreshnessPolicyRef` | 关联 policy 与其 opaque freshness binding | declared local binding 或 safe persisted relation；不内嵌 threshold、duration、timeout、allowlist、config key 或 policy owner body。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `from_baseline(PolicyRevision, RequiredSourceKindSet, RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet, FreshnessPolicyRef) -> Result<RequiredQualificationPolicy, DomainError>` | 建立唯一的 immutable local qualification guard | 四个输入都必须是已验证 typed carrier；factory 固定 no-fallback 而不是新增无 owner 的 `QualificationFallbackMode`。不读配置、不解析 manifest、不签发 credential、不建立 Sandbox、不查 carrier、不调用 resolver。 |
| `required_sources() -> &RequiredSourceKindSet` | 返回固定 required source 集合 | pure accessor；没有 action 参数，避免按 action 临时扩展 / 收缩 policy。 |
| `required_items(&HostEnvironmentRequirementRef) -> &RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet` | 返回固定 required item 集合 | environment ref 仅证明 caller 带有 typed requirement correlation，不能改变集合内容；无 ref 时 caller不能形成 positive assembly input。 |
| `evaluate_context(&HostQualificationContext, FreshnessEvaluation) -> Result<QualificationEvaluation, DomainError>` | 从现有 entries + matching freshness result形成唯一 qualification conclusion | context 必须对应本 policy binding、freshness evidence binding必须与 `freshness_policy_ref` 相等，且 evidence / context target generation一致。`Resolved` 仅在所有 required entries是 `Usable`、freshness aggregate是 `Fresh` 时返回；其余结果按 source gap优先级生成 `Partial` / `Missing` / `Stale` / `Conflict` / `Unknown`。pure；不写 context、不调 port。 |
| `evaluate_assembly(&ReadinessEvaluationInput) -> Result<ReadinessEvaluation, DomainError>` | 评估 CMP-MS-02 后半段已冻结 item/outcome 与 qualification facts | 签名只消费后述 domain-only input；禁止加载 assembly / context、查询 external truth 或直接创建 readiness decision。详细 mapping见 `assembly.rs`。 |
| `guard_no_fallback(&HostQualificationContext) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 形成正向 assembly前的 explicit guard | 只在 context resolution 为 `Resolved`、freshness为 `Fresh`、gap refs为 `None` 时成功；`Partial` / `Missing` / `Stale` / `Conflict` / `Unknown` 全部错误返回，由 future application映射 own blocked / waiting / failed / unknown surface。不得以 previous context、cache、default source、receipt、fake、registration或 Runtime state放行。 |

| 工厂 / 静态函数 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 使用场景 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `RequiredQualificationPolicy::from_baseline(...)` | 建立不可变 policy guard | declared local revision、两个 canonical closed set、opaque freshness binding | `Result<RequiredQualificationPolicy, DomainError>` | application composition root / safe policy rehydrate；具体 config binding留 Step 14 / 04。 |

| `evaluate_context` 的 resolution 选择 | 条件 | mandatory gap / 后续上限 |
|---|---|---|
| `Conflict` | 任一 required entry 是 `Conflict`，或 context / evaluation ref、generation、binding不一致（结构不一致直接 error，不能选状态） | 每个 affected source形成 `ConflictingSource` gap；不覆盖 entry。 |
| `Unknown` | 任一 required entry 是 `Unknown`，或 required usable entry缺 owner freshness evidence / evidence为 `Unknown` | `UnknownSource` source gap；不由 missing/failure / local clock降级。 |
| `Stale` | 无 conflict/unknown，且任一 required usable evidence为 `Stale` | `StaleSource` source gap；不得使用 older/newer cache或 source version修复。 |
| `Missing` | 无上列问题，且任一 required entry缺失或为 `Missing` | `MissingSource` source gap；不表示 upstream object被删除。 |
| `Partial` | 已记录 source 中存在 `Pending`、未记录某个 required source、或结构上有部分 usable但未到 `Resolved`；若能明确 pending，则附 `PendingContract`，否则附 `MissingSource` | 只允许被 future readiness映射为 non-ready；不是“半 ready”。 |
| `Resolved` | 每个 required source有唯一 `Usable` entry，freshness为 `Fresh`，无 unresolved entry、gap或 binding mismatch | `qualification_gap_refs == None`；允许进入 assembly guard，仍不等于 assembly complete / ready。 |

同一 status 的多个 gap 必须由 `ReadinessGapRefSet::try_new(...)` 以 source scope 的 canonical code / kind order形成；每个 non-resolved evaluation 都必须得到 `Some(non-empty)` set。由于 `ReadinessGapRefSet` 是跨 readiness 的 shared carrier，`QualificationEvaluation` 只保存 source-scoped实例；item / aggregate scope不能在 `evaluate_context` 出现。

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| no fallback is a fixed invariant | 本对象没有 `fallback_mode` 字段；“no fallback”由 factory、`evaluate_context` 和 `guard_no_fallback` 的不可规避规则固定。不得另造无 owner 的 `QualificationFallbackMode`，也不得由配置削弱。 |
| exact binding required | `FreshnessEvaluation` 的 `FreshnessPolicyRef` 必须与本 policy相等；不同 revision / binding不得将旧 assessment 套用到当前 policy。 |
| policy is not a resolver | policy不解析 Role -> image、manifest / digest、credential、Sandbox binding或 carrier capability；它只评估已 mapped、body-free local values。任何无法获得的 required source / item维持 pending / unknown / blocked。 |
| ready remains outside | policy可允许 context 成为 `Resolved`，并生成 readiness evaluation；它不创建 `HostReadinessDecision`、不写 `Ready`、不创建 Host、注册、endpoint、session、health或 Runtime / Sandbox outcome。 |
| static baseline, dynamic facts | required set / no-fallback不可由运行期 config、adapter、fake或 inbound event改动；entries、freshness与item outcome是同一基线下的动态 local fact，二者不得混同。 |

## 9.8 `domain / CMP-MS-02 / assembly.rs` 对象契约

### 9.8.1 本对象组写入边界、唯一 owner 与功能映射

| 项 | 本批收口结论 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::assembly` / `crates/domain/src/assembly.rs` 独占 `HostAssembly`、`HostReadinessDecision` 以及本节 item / outcome / evaluation support value。 | 不在 `qualification.rs`、application、adapter、fake或 entry 重定义 assembly item、outcome、decision或状态。 |
| 业务对象分母 | 本节只闭合剩余两个冻结业务对象：`HostAssembly` 与 `HostReadinessDecision`。`HostAssemblyItem(Set)`、`HostAssemblyItemOutcome(Set)`、`ReadinessEvaluationInput/Result` 是 domain-only support value，不新增业务对象。 | 不新增 `AssemblyItemRef`、`RuntimeSession`、`MemberRegistration`、container、image、credential或 Sandbox object。 |
| CMP 边界 | CMP-MS-02拥有 required item的local classification、assembly aggregate和 readiness语义；CMP-MS-03只在 future flow接收 typed host-side progression handoff，CMP-MS-04拥有 registration/session truth。 | 不把 host action attempt、registration、endpoint、session、health、Runtime run或 Sandbox execute 结果作为 assembly / ready shortcut。 |
| external seam | item inputs只能为 typed environment ref、role-specific safe ref / summary、closed gap / neutral local outcome；source owner / carrier / Sandbox / Images / credential contract未闭合时保持 pending / blocked / unknown。 | 不解析 external body、调用 port、生成 effect key、dispatch、重试、cleanup或声称 external completion。 |

### 9.8.2 capability / 功能到对象映射

| capability / 功能 | 输入 | 输出 | 本地状态 / 副作用 | domain 对象 / value | 后续 Step 承接 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CAP-MS-06`：冻结 required assembly | host ref、target generation、resolved qualification context ref、typed environment requirement、policy required item baseline | generation-bound assembly with canonical items | initial `Collecting`；无 external action / store write | `HostAssembly`、`HostAssemblyItem(Set)` | Step 7 store / progression handoff；Step 8 `IB-MS-005` |
| `CAP-MS-07`：记录 matching local outcome | frozen item、matching generation、body-free local item classification | revised assembly outcome set | 只更新 same aggregate revision；unknown / blocked preserved | `HostAssemblyItemOutcome(Set)` | Step 7 outcome mapper / store；Step 9 outcome correlation |
| `CAP-MS-08`：独立 readiness evaluation | context resolution、assembly status / revision、policy baseline、canonical gaps | readiness evaluation result / immutable decision | `Complete` remains input only; no external effect | `ReadinessEvaluationInput`、`ReadinessEvaluation`、`HostReadinessDecision` | Step 8 result mapping；Step 10 state matrix |
| 返回 / 重评 | existing immutable decision、new matching basis、application generated replacement id/time | new replacement decision with causal link | old record is never mutated for re-evaluation | `HostReadinessDecision` | Step 7 decision store/UoW; Step 11 history pair |

### 9.8.3 domain-only assembly item and outcome value

```rust
/// Records one frozen required assembly item for one target host generation.
pub struct HostAssemblyItem {
    /// Closed required-item category and unique key within one assembly.
    item_kind: AssemblyItemKind,
    /// Target generation to which this requirement is bound.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Typed environment requirement used only for the environment item correlation.
    environment_requirement_ref: Option<HostEnvironmentRequirementRef>,
}

/// Holds canonical, unique frozen assembly items.
pub struct HostAssemblyItemSet(Vec<HostAssemblyItem>);

/// Classifies one local item outcome without asserting an external lifecycle result.
pub enum HostAssemblyItemOutcomeStatus {
    /// A frozen item awaits a matching local outcome.
    Pending,
    /// A frozen item has a locally acceptable matching body-free outcome.
    Satisfied,
    /// A frozen item has an explicit locally unacceptable outcome.
    Failed,
    /// A required contract or prerequisite blocks positive item progression.
    Blocked,
    /// A matching item result or external-effect boundary cannot be safely determined.
    Unknown,
}

/// Records one body-free local outcome for one frozen assembly item and its exact generation.
pub struct HostAssemblyItemOutcome {
    /// Frozen required-item category to which this local result applies.
    item_kind: AssemblyItemKind,
    /// Exact target generation matched before this outcome was recorded.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Closed local outcome classification; not an external owner status.
    status: HostAssemblyItemOutcomeStatus,
    /// Optional item-scoped gap required for non-satisfied results.
    gap: Option<ReadinessGapRef>,
}

/// Holds canonical, unique local outcomes keyed by frozen assembly-item category.
pub struct HostAssemblyOutcomeSet(Vec<HostAssemblyItemOutcome>);

impl HostAssemblyItem {
    /// Creates one generation-bound required item without resolving its external owner.
    pub fn required(
        item_kind: AssemblyItemKind,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        environment_requirement_ref: Option<HostEnvironmentRequirementRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this frozen item matches the supplied target generation.
    pub fn matches_generation(&self, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;
}

impl HostAssemblyItemSet {
    /// Creates a frozen set from the declared canonical required-item order.
    pub fn try_new(items: Vec<HostAssemblyItem>) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns frozen items in canonical order.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[HostAssemblyItem];

    /// Returns whether this set exactly covers the supplied policy baseline.
    pub fn exactly_covers(&self, required: &RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet) -> bool;
}

impl HostAssemblyItemOutcome {
    /// Records a pending outcome for one frozen item without asserting dispatch.
    pub fn pending(item: &HostAssemblyItem) -> Self;

    /// Records one locally acceptable matching outcome.
    pub fn satisfied(item: &HostAssemblyItem) -> Self;

    /// Records an explicit local failure with an item-scoped gap.
    pub fn failed(item: &HostAssemblyItem, gap: ReadinessGapRef) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Records a blocked item with an item-scoped gap.
    pub fn blocked(item: &HostAssemblyItem, gap: ReadinessGapRef) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Records an unknown item result with an item-scoped gap.
    pub fn unknown(item: &HostAssemblyItem, gap: ReadinessGapRef) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

impl HostAssemblyOutcomeSet {
    /// Creates the canonical pending-outcome set for a frozen item set.
    pub fn pending_for(items: &HostAssemblyItemSet) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates canonical outcomes without sorting, deduplicating, or accepting a foreign item.
    pub fn try_new(
        items: &HostAssemblyItemSet,
        outcomes: Vec<HostAssemblyItemOutcome>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Replaces exactly one matching current item outcome with a same-generation outcome.
    pub fn replace_matching(
        &mut self,
        item: &HostAssemblyItem,
        outcome: HostAssemblyItemOutcome,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns outcomes in the frozen item order.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[HostAssemblyItemOutcome];
}
```

| value | 字段来源 / 结构不变量 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| `HostAssemblyItem` | `item_kind` 是唯一 key，`generation` 必须等于 assembly target generation。只有 `EnvironmentRequirement` 可有 `Some(environment_requirement_ref)`；其余四 kind必须为 `None`，因为 external-safe refs / summaries在 qualification context，而不是 copied into item。 | 不造无 owner 的 `AssemblyItemRef`；不保存 image manifest、credential、Sandbox body、carrier resource、action target、Member registration或 Runtime session。 |
| `HostAssemblyItemSet` | 必须与 policy `RequiredAssemblyItemKindSet` exact cover，顺序为 `EnvironmentRequirement -> PinnedImageSupply -> LaunchCredential -> SandboxBinding -> CarrierCapability`，每 kind恰一次。 | 不排序 / 去重、补 item、按 action / adapter / fake动态增删、把 `MemberRegistration` / `RuntimeSession` 加入。 |
| `HostAssemblyItemOutcomeStatus` | `Pending` / `Satisfied` / `Failed` / `Blocked` / `Unknown` 是本地 item分类。仅 `Satisfied` 能参加 `Complete`；它不表示 external effect dispatched / accepted / completed。 | 不加入 `Stale`（freshness属于 qualification axis）、`Ready`、`Registered`、`Healthy`、`RuntimeReady` 或 `SandboxReady`。 |
| `HostAssemblyItemOutcome` | item kind + generation必须与 frozen item精确匹配。`Pending` / `Satisfied` 必须无 gap；`Failed` / `Blocked` / `Unknown` 必须有 item-scoped `ReadinessGapRef`，其 `item_kind` 与本 item相等。 | 不以 external ref / receipt / timeout / fake / backend state作为 outcome；不以 source-scoped或 aggregate gap冒充 item gap。 |
| `HostAssemblyOutcomeSet` | 永远与 frozen item set等长、同序、每 kind恰一；初始由 `pending_for` 形成。`replace_matching` 只替换同一 kind、同一 generation的当前位置，且不能通过 old generation / unknown input覆盖当前 item。 | 不允许 outcome key缺失、额外 item、跨 item替换、自动重排、自动重试或补 default `Satisfied`。 |

`HostAssemblyOutcomeSet::replace_matching(...)` 对旧 generation、foreign item、noncanonical set或 attempted `Satisfied` with gap返回 `DomainError`，并保持原 outcome 不变。`Unknown` 是有效的当前 outcome，但它是 fail-closed终止分类：只有新同 generation、同 item、正式可匹配的 local result在 future application/UoW path中才能替换它；不得以超时、cache、duplicate receipt、fake或“未看到失败”改成 `Satisfied`。

### 9.8.4 `HostAssembly` 对象契约

#### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostAssembly`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 6 个，表示一个逻辑 host、一个 immutable generation 和一份 qualification context 之下的本地装配 aggregate。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::assembly` / `crates/domain/src/assembly.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-06`、`CAP-MS-07`、`CAP-MS-08`、`IB-MS-005` 以及 CMP-MS-03 的 typed host-side progression handoff。 |
| 主要责任 | 固定 required item 集合、保留每个 item 的同世代本地 outcome、维护 assembly revision 和 aggregate status，并为独立 readiness evaluator 提供不可变 basis。 |
| 不拥有 | image manifest / digest、credential secret、Sandbox backend / policy、carrier resource、Member registration、Runtime session / run、health、external dispatch / delivery / acceptance、repository version、outbox 或 public view。 |

#### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Aggregates generation-bound assembly requirements and local item outcomes without owning external effects.
pub struct HostAssembly {
    /// Stable local identity of this assembly aggregate.
    assembly_id: HostAssemblyId,
    /// Logical host to which the aggregate belongs.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation fenced by this aggregate.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Qualification context whose local facts were used for this assembly.
    qualification_context_ref: HostQualificationContextRef,
    /// Candidate required items supplied by the local policy baseline.
    required_items: HostAssemblyItemSet,
    /// Whether the candidate item set has been explicitly frozen for progression.
    required_items_frozen: bool,
    /// One local outcome for every frozen item, in item canonical order.
    item_outcomes: HostAssemblyOutcomeSet,
    /// Aggregate local assembly status, independent of readiness and health.
    assembly_status: HostAssemblyStatus,
    /// Monotonic local revision of accepted item facts.
    revision: AssemblyRevision,
    /// Local time of the latest accepted aggregate fact.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostAssembly {
    /// Creates an assembly candidate for one host generation and qualification context.
    pub fn assemble(
        assembly_id: HostAssemblyId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        qualification_context: &HostQualificationContext,
        required_items: HostAssemblyItemSet,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Confirms and freezes the policy-selected required item set exactly once.
    pub fn freeze_required_items(
        &mut self,
        required_items: &HostAssemblyItemSet,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records one matching local item outcome and advances the aggregate revision.
    pub fn record_item_outcome(
        &mut self,
        item_kind: AssemblyItemKind,
        outcome: HostAssemblyItemOutcome,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records an explicit item-scoped block without creating an external effect claim.
    pub fn mark_blocked(
        &mut self,
        item_kind: AssemblyItemKind,
        gap: ReadinessGapRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records an unknown item result and preserves the unknown fence.
    pub fn mark_unknown(
        &mut self,
        item_kind: AssemblyItemKind,
        gap: ReadinessGapRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether every frozen item has a locally satisfied outcome.
    pub fn all_required_items_satisfied(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this aggregate is bound to the supplied host and generation.
    pub fn matches(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local assembly reference without exposing mutable aggregate state.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostAssemblyRef;

    /// Returns the current aggregate status.
    pub fn assembly_status(&self) -> &HostAssemblyStatus;

    /// Returns the current local basis revision.
    pub fn revision(&self) -> &AssemblyRevision;

    /// Returns frozen items in canonical order.
    pub fn required_items(&self) -> &HostAssemblyItemSet;

    /// Returns item outcomes in the same canonical order as the frozen items.
    pub fn item_outcomes(&self) -> &HostAssemblyOutcomeSet;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assembly_id` | `HostAssemblyId` | 定位本地 assembly aggregate | application id generator / local rehydrate；不从 host、generation、context、item、outcome或外部 resource id拼接。 |
| `host_ref` | `HostRef` | 绑定逻辑 host | 由 application 从 committed local host fact 提供；不是 container / pod / carrier / Sandbox resource。 |
| `generation` | `HostGeneration` | 防止旧实例 outcome 覆盖新实例 | 与 host-side current selection 同次提供；immutable，不由 source version / backend version替代。 |
| `qualification_context_ref` | `HostQualificationContextRef` | 回链用于装配的资格语境 | 由 matching context 的 `to_ref()` 提供；ref 不表示 resolved，factory 会检查 context host-generation relation。 |
| `required_items` | `HostAssemblyItemSet` | 保存 policy 选出的候选 required item | 由 `RequiredQualificationPolicy::required_items(...)` 映射后构造；必须 exact cover，不能由 adapter / fake / registration / Runtime临时扩展。 |
| `required_items_frozen` | `bool` | 区分 collecting 与已允许 progression 的 item set | 只由 `assemble`（false）和 `freeze_required_items`（true）改变；不是 public readiness、authorization或 external state。 |
| `item_outcomes` | `HostAssemblyOutcomeSet` | 保存每个 item 的本地 pending / satisfied / failed / blocked / unknown | 初始 `pending_for(required_items)`；只能由同 generation、same item key 的 outcome API替换；不保存 external receipt / body。 |
| `assembly_status` | `HostAssemblyStatus` | 表达 aggregate 装配事实 | 由 assembly transition 根据 freeze 与 outcome 组合选择；不映射 registration、health或 Runtime。 |
| `revision` | `AssemblyRevision` | 为 readiness basis 和 local concurrency 提供单调本地 revision | `AssemblyRevision::initial()` / `next_after`；不是 repository expected version或外部 source version。 |
| `updated_at` | `Timestamp` | 记录本地 aggregate 接受事实的时点 | application clock output；不替代 owner captured time、source freshness或 external observation。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `assemble(...) -> Result<HostAssembly, DomainError>` | 建立 candidate aggregate | 要求 required item set非空、每项 generation matching、context ref与 context generation matching；context 未 `Resolved + Fresh` 时 aggregate 只能以 `Blocked` 初始状态保留，不得被标成 `Collecting` 的正向 progression。无 I/O、无 external action。 |
| `freeze_required_items(&HostAssemblyItemSet, &HostGeneration) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 一次性确认 policy item set并打开受限 progression | generation 必须匹配；输入必须与 candidate set exact equal；重复 freeze 只能在完全相同 set 上返回幂等成功，任何替换 / 扩展 / 顺序变化均 error。context 已 `Resolved + Fresh` 时状态由 `Collecting -> Progressing`，否则保持 `Blocked`。不写 store / outbox。 |
| `record_item_outcome(AssemblyItemKind, HostAssemblyItemOutcome, &HostGeneration, Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 接受一个 current item 的 local outcome | 必须已 frozen、item 和 outcome generation / kind完全匹配；旧 generation、foreign kind、noncanonical outcome或 `Unknown -> Satisfied` 的无正式匹配证据均拒绝。成功后 revision 只递增一次并按 outcome recompute aggregate status。 |
| `mark_blocked(...) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 形成 item-scoped blocked事实 | gap 必须由 `ReadinessGapRef::for_item` 构造且 kind相同；不调用 external owner、不重试、不把 pending contract写成 failure。成功后 status为 `Blocked`，revision递增。 |
| `mark_unknown(...) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 保留不可判定 item结果 | gap 必须 item-scoped且 kind相同；成功后 status为 `Unknown`，revision递增并禁止盲重放。只允许新正式 matching outcome在 future application path显式替换。 |
| `all_required_items_satisfied() -> bool` | 提供 readiness evaluator 的结构性输入 | 仅在 `required_items_frozen == true` 且每个 outcome为 `Satisfied` 时 true；不读取 qualification、freshness、registration、health或 external status。 |
| `matches(...) -> bool` | 检查 host + generation pair | 只比较 typed local values；不证明 current pointer、single-active或 backend existence。 |

| 工厂 / 静态函数 | 作用 | 参数说明 | 返回 | 使用场景 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostAssembly::assemble(...)` | 建立 candidate aggregate | local id、host、generation、loaded qualification context、candidate item set、local time | `Result<HostAssembly, DomainError>` | `CoordinateHostAssemblyCommand` 的 domain phase；policy exact-set guard 与 UoW 留 Step 7 / 9 / 11。 |
| `HostAssemblyOutcomeSet::pending_for(...)` | 为每个 required item 建立显式 pending outcome | frozen candidate item set | `HostAssemblyOutcomeSet` | aggregate factory；不是 satisfied/default readiness。 |

| 状态 / transition | 触发与前置条件 | 结果 / 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| `Collecting` | `assemble` 形成候选项集但尚未 `freeze_required_items`；或本地仍在确认 qualification / item selection | 只能转 `Progressing`、`Blocked`、`Failed`、`Unknown`；不得进入 readiness `Ready`。 |
| `Progressing` | frozen set + matching generation；至少一个 outcome仍 `Pending` | 可转 `Complete`、`Blocked`、`Failed`、`Unknown`；不表示 external dispatch已成功。 |
| `Complete` | frozen set中每项均 `Satisfied` | 只可作为独立 readiness evaluation 输入；不能自身创建 `Ready`。 |
| `Blocked` | qualification未 resolved/fresh、或 item有 `Blocked` outcome | 只能等待新正式输入 / 新 decision；不得由 registration、heartbeat、cache或 fake解除。 |
| `Failed` | item有显式 `Failed` outcome | 只能作为 non-ready / later recovery input；不自动触发 CMP-MS-05。 |
| `Unknown` | item有 `Unknown` outcome或匹配结果无法安全判定 | 保持 unknown fence；仅新同世代正式 matching outcome可替换，不能用 timeout / no-error推断 satisfied。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| generation fence | 所有 item 与 outcome 必须匹配一个 immutable generation；旧 generation 的 late result 既不能写当前 assembly，也不能创建新 assembly。 |
| one item one outcome | `AssemblyItemKind` 是唯一 key；禁止 `AssemblyItemRef`、raw string、外部 effect key或 arrival sequence作为第二 key。 |
| revision monotonicity | 每次接受本地 item fact只产生新 `AssemblyRevision`；旧 revision 的 readiness evaluation不能覆盖新 revision。实际 CAS / UoW由 Step 7 / 11闭合。 |
| no external truth absorption | item status 只描述本地 mapped outcome；不等于 image supplied、credential valid、Sandbox bound、carrier allocated、Member registered或 Runtime ready。 |
| no hidden progression | Query、Consumer、Job、adapter、fake或 timeout不得直接调用 transition；只有 application command / approved consumer path经 generation guard调用。 |

### 9.8.5 readiness-evaluation support value

`HostReadinessDecision` 只能消费一次由 `RequiredQualificationPolicy` 形成的 `ReadinessEvaluation`。这样可以把“读取 context / assembly”与“写入 immutable readiness conclusion”分开，避免 entry 以一个布尔值或 assembly `Complete` 直接制造 `Ready`。

```rust
/// Carries the same-generation local facts required for one readiness evaluation.
pub struct ReadinessEvaluationInput {
    /// Logical host selected for this evaluation.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable generation shared by qualification and assembly facts.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Qualification context reference used as the source basis.
    qualification_context_ref: HostQualificationContextRef,
    /// Local qualification resolution conclusion already produced by policy.
    qualification_status: QualificationResolutionStatus,
    /// Aggregate qualification freshness classification.
    qualification_freshness: FreshnessAssessment,
    /// Source-scoped qualification gaps, absent only when qualification is resolved.
    qualification_gap_refs: Option<ReadinessGapRefSet>,
    /// Assembly reference selected for this evaluation.
    assembly_ref: HostAssemblyRef,
    /// Assembly revision used as the immutable readiness basis.
    assembly_revision: AssemblyRevision,
    /// Aggregate assembly status at the selected revision.
    assembly_status: HostAssemblyStatus,
    /// Item outcomes copied as body-free local classifications for this evaluation.
    item_outcomes: HostAssemblyOutcomeSet,
    /// Local time at which the evaluation input was assembled.
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
}

/// Carries the policy-produced readiness conclusion before it is persisted as a decision object.
pub struct ReadinessEvaluation {
    /// Host and generation to which this conclusion applies.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Qualification context and assembly references used as causal basis.
    qualification_context_ref: HostQualificationContextRef,
    assembly_ref: HostAssemblyRef,
    /// Assembly revision that must remain current when the decision is committed.
    basis_revision: AssemblyRevision,
    /// Policy-selected local readiness status.
    readiness_status: HostReadinessStatus,
    /// Canonical source/item/aggregate gaps for a non-ready conclusion.
    gap_refs: ReadinessGapRefSet,
    /// Local time at which the policy produced the conclusion.
    evaluated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl ReadinessEvaluationInput {
    /// Builds an evaluation input from matching context and assembly snapshots.
    pub fn from_matching_facts(
        context: &HostQualificationContext,
        assembly: &HostAssembly,
        evaluated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the host/generation pair selected for evaluation.
    pub fn target(&self) -> (&HostRef, &HostGeneration);

    /// Returns the assembly revision used as readiness basis.
    pub fn assembly_revision(&self) -> &AssemblyRevision;
}

impl ReadinessEvaluation {
    /// Creates the only policy-owned evaluation result from a fully checked input.
    pub(crate) fn from_policy(
        input: ReadinessEvaluationInput,
        readiness_status: HostReadinessStatus,
        gap_refs: ReadinessGapRefSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the host/generation pair of the conclusion.
    pub fn target(&self) -> (&HostRef, &HostGeneration);

    /// Returns the local readiness status without creating a decision.
    pub fn readiness_status(&self) -> &HostReadinessStatus;

    /// Returns canonical gaps; a ready evaluation must expose an empty set.
    pub fn gap_refs(&self) -> &ReadinessGapRefSet;

    /// Returns the assembly revision on which the conclusion is based.
    pub fn basis_revision(&self) -> &AssemblyRevision;

    /// Returns the qualification context reference used by the conclusion.
    pub fn qualification_context_ref(&self) -> &HostQualificationContextRef;

    /// Returns the assembly reference used by the conclusion.
    pub fn assembly_ref(&self) -> &HostAssemblyRef;
}
```

| 输入字段 | 来源 / 约束 | 结构失败时的处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `host_ref` / `generation` | 必须分别与 `HostAssembly`、`HostQualificationContext` 的同一 local selection 相等；不能从 item outcome、backend resource或 external ref推导。 | `DomainError`；不得选择另一 host 或生成新 generation。 |
| `qualification_context_ref` | 只能来自当前 context 的 `to_ref()`；ref 的存在不证明 context resolved。 | context/ref 不匹配时拒绝 input。 |
| `qualification_status` / `qualification_freshness` | 只能来自 context 最新的 `apply_evaluation` 结果；不得由 source-entry count、cache或 public projection填充。 | 缺失或未评估保持 `Missing` / `Unknown`，由 policy形成 non-ready evaluation。 |
| `qualification_gap_refs` | `Some` 时必须为 source-scoped、non-empty、canonical；`None` 仅表示 policy 已产生 `Resolved` 结论，不表示 context 从未评估。 | scope、order或 status mismatch 返回 `DomainError`。 |
| `assembly_ref` / `assembly_revision` / `assembly_status` / `item_outcomes` | 由同一次 local assembly rehydrate / snapshot 提供；outcomes 必须 exact cover frozen items、同序且同 generation。 | 旧 revision、foreign item、unknown outcome遗漏或 generation mismatch 均 fail closed。 |
| `evaluated_at` | 只来自 application clock output，记录 evaluation 时点；不是 source captured time、commit time或 external observation time。 | domain 不读取或修正 clock。 |

| `ReadinessEvaluation` 约束 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| ready witness | `Ready` 只能由 policy 在 qualification `Resolved` + freshness `Fresh`、assembly `Complete`、所有 required outcomes `Satisfied`、same host/generation/revision和空 gap set同时成立时构造。 |
| non-ready witness | `Blocked` / `Waiting` / `Failed` / `Unknown` 必须保留至少一个 canonical gap；不得以空 set掩盖未闭合条件。 |
| no external assertion | evaluation 只表达本仓装配语义，不证明 Member registration、Host Session、health、Runtime、Sandbox、image verification、credential validity或 carrier allocation。 |
| immutable basis | 结果一旦形成，`basis_revision`、context ref、assembly ref、generation与gap set不可变；新事实必须形成新 evaluation。 |

#### `RequiredQualificationPolicy::evaluate_assembly` 的封闭判定矩阵

| qualification 输入 | assembly 输入 | 结果 status | gap 形成规则 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Resolved` + `Fresh` + no source gaps | `Complete` + all outcomes `Satisfied` | `Ready` | `ReadinessGapRefSet::empty_for_ready()`；不包含 `MemberRegistration` / `RuntimeSession`。 |
| `Resolved` + `Fresh` | `Collecting` / `Progressing` | `Waiting` | 每个 `Pending` item 形成 `PendingItemOutcome`；保持 item canonical order。 |
| `Resolved` + `Fresh` | `Blocked` | `Blocked` | 复用 item-scoped `PendingContract` / `MissingRequirement` / `CapabilityUnavailable` 等 gap；不升格为 `Failed`。 |
| `Resolved` + `Fresh` | `Failed` | `Failed` | 复用 explicit item failure gaps；不自动调用 recovery。 |
| `Resolved` + `Fresh` | `Unknown` | `Unknown` | 复用 item-scoped `UnknownSource` / `PendingItemOutcome`；不以“没有失败证据”改为 satisfied。 |
| `Partial` / `Missing` / `Stale` | 任一 assembly status | `Waiting` 或 `Blocked`，取决于 source gap 是否明确为 pending contract；绝不 `Ready`。 | 先放 source-scoped gaps，再追加 item / aggregate gaps；不删除 assembly gap。 |
| `Conflict` | 任一 assembly status | `Unknown` | 保留 `ConflictingSource` source gaps；不选择任一 anchor / generation side。 |
| `Unknown` | 任一 assembly status | `Unknown` | 保留 `UnknownSource` 或 aggregate `UnknownSource`；不 fallback。 |

`RequiredQualificationPolicy::evaluate_assembly(...)` 只能消费 `ReadinessEvaluationInput`，并且必须先验证 policy required sets、context / assembly refs、generation 和 outcome exact cover；任何结构不一致是 `DomainError`，不是一个可公开的 `HostReadinessStatus`。status 只在结构完整后按上表选择。`Ready` 的 positive branch 在 `MSVC-UP-001~008` 仍有未闭合 required source / item 时不可构造；调用方只能提供相应 `PendingContract` / `UnknownSource` gap。

### 9.8.6 `HostReadinessDecision` 对象契约

#### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostReadinessDecision`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 7 个、也是 CMP-MS-02 最后一个对象，表示一条 immutable、generation-bound 的本地装配 readiness 结论。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::assembly` / `crates/domain/src/assembly.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-08`、`IB-MS-005/006`、assembly revision guard、registration 前置读取和 readiness re-evaluation。 |
| 主要责任 | 绑定 qualification context、assembly ref、basis revision、host/generation、status 与 canonical gaps；确保旧 revision、旧 generation 和 external / entry signal不能覆盖当前结论。 |
| 不拥有 | Host lifecycle、Member registration、endpoint、Host Session、health、Runtime run、Sandbox backend、image / credential / carrier truth、external completion、repository CAS、history / outbox或 public DTO。 |

#### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one immutable generation-bound host-readiness conclusion.
pub struct HostReadinessDecision {
    /// Stable local identity generated for this conclusion.
    decision_id: HostReadinessDecisionId,
    /// Logical host to which this conclusion applies.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation fenced by this conclusion.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Qualification context used as one causal basis.
    qualification_context_ref: HostQualificationContextRef,
    /// Assembly aggregate used as the second causal basis.
    assembly_ref: HostAssemblyRef,
    /// Assembly revision observed when the conclusion was evaluated.
    basis_revision: AssemblyRevision,
    /// Local readiness status; never an external lifecycle status.
    readiness_status: HostReadinessStatus,
    /// Canonical body-free gaps; empty only for Ready.
    gap_refs: ReadinessGapRefSet,
    /// Previous immutable decision explicitly superseded by this conclusion, if any.
    supersedes_ref: Option<HostReadinessDecisionRef>,
    /// Local time at which this conclusion was formed.
    decided_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostReadinessDecision {
    /// Creates an immutable decision from a policy-produced same-generation evaluation.
    pub fn decide(
        decision_id: HostReadinessDecisionId,
        evaluation: ReadinessEvaluation,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates one persisted immutable decision without re-evaluating its facts.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        decision_id: HostReadinessDecisionId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        qualification_context_ref: HostQualificationContextRef,
        assembly_ref: HostAssemblyRef,
        basis_revision: AssemblyRevision,
        readiness_status: HostReadinessStatus,
        gap_refs: ReadinessGapRefSet,
        supersedes_ref: Option<HostReadinessDecisionRef>,
        decided_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Creates a replacement decision without mutating this immutable record.
    pub fn supersede(
        &self,
        replacement_decision_id: HostReadinessDecisionId,
        replacement_evaluation: ReadinessEvaluation,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this decision applies to the supplied host, generation, and assembly revision.
    pub fn matches(
        &self,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
        basis_revision: &AssemblyRevision,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this decision is locally ready for the supplied generation.
    pub fn is_ready_for(&self, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local decision reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostReadinessDecisionRef;

    /// Returns the canonical decision gaps without exposing external body.
    pub fn gap_refs(&self) -> &ReadinessGapRefSet;

    /// Returns the local readiness status.
    pub fn readiness_status(&self) -> &HostReadinessStatus;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decision_id` | `HostReadinessDecisionId` | 定位 immutable local readiness record | application id generator / local decision-store rehydrate；不得由 assembly revision、status、registration、heartbeat、Runtime run、backend state或 fake result拼接。 |
| `host_ref` + `generation` | `HostRef` + `HostGeneration` | 固定结论适用的逻辑 host 世代 | 来自 `ReadinessEvaluation` 的同一 target pair；二者不可分离或跨世代重用。 |
| `qualification_context_ref` | `HostQualificationContextRef` | 回指资格 basis | 只能来自 evaluation；ref 不表示 resolved / fresh。 |
| `assembly_ref` | `HostAssemblyRef` | 回指冻结 item / outcome aggregate | 只能来自 evaluation；ref 不表示 complete。 |
| `basis_revision` | `AssemblyRevision` | 防止旧 assembly facts覆盖新结论 | evaluation 读取的 local assembly revision；不是 repository expected version、source version、cursor或 generation。 |
| `readiness_status` | `HostReadinessStatus` | 保存 policy-produced local conclusion | 只能来自 `ReadinessEvaluation`；`Ready` 需完整 same-generation witness。不能由 registration、health、projection、receipt或 fake写入。 |
| `gap_refs` | `ReadinessGapRefSet` | 保留 source / item / aggregate non-ready原因 | `Ready` 必须为空；non-ready 必须 non-empty；顺序和 scope由 shared set factory验证。不能在 decision 提交后任意追加。 |
| `supersedes_ref` | `Option<HostReadinessDecisionRef>` | 链接新结论替代的旧 immutable decision | 只由 `supersede` / application replacement UoW设置；self-ref、跨 host/generation或把 ref 存在解释为旧记录已失效均禁止。 |
| `decided_at` | `Timestamp` | 本地结论形成时间 | application clock output / persisted record；不是 source captured time、assembly updated time、commit time或 external observation。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `decide(HostReadinessDecisionId, ReadinessEvaluation) -> Result<HostReadinessDecision, DomainError>` | 将 policy evaluation 固化为 immutable decision | 只接受 evaluation 的完整 same-generation basis；`Ready` 必须 gap empty，non-ready必须 non-empty。无 I/O、无 registration、无 external call。 |
| `rehydrate(...) -> Result<HostReadinessDecision, DomainError>` | 重建已保存结论 | 只验证 status/gap、host/generation、basis/reference coherence；不重新判断 source、assembly currentness或 external truth。 |
| `supersede(&self, HostReadinessDecisionId, ReadinessEvaluation) -> Result<HostReadinessDecision, DomainError>` | 从新 evaluation 创建 replacement | 当前对象保持 immutable；replacement evaluation必须匹配同 host/generation且 basis revision **严格晚于**当前（除非明确记录同 revision 的 correction contract，当前不允许）。新对象 `supersedes_ref = Some(self.to_ref())`；不自动修改旧对象。 |
| `matches(&HostRef, &HostGeneration, &AssemblyRevision) -> bool` | 检查结论是否仍适用于 selected local facts | 只比较 typed host/generation/revision；不替代 repository CAS、current pointer或 single-active guard。 |
| `is_ready_for(&HostGeneration) -> bool` | 提供 registration 前置读取的窄语义 | 仅 `readiness_status == Ready` 且 generation matching 返回 true；不表示 registered、healthy、Runtime ready、Sandbox ready或 action completed。 |
| `to_ref() -> HostReadinessDecisionRef` | 形成 immutable local ref | pure；ref 不表示 status、basis current或 public permission。 |
| `gap_refs()` / `readiness_status()` | 最小只读 surface | pure accessor；不能修改 decision、追加 gap或触发 re-evaluation。 |

| 状态 / 结论 | 允许形成 | 允许去向 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Ready` | 仅 `RequiredQualificationPolicy::evaluate_assembly` 在完整 witness下形成 | CMP-MS-04 registration prerequisite、safe projection、history | 不向 `Registered`、`Healthy`、`RuntimeReady`、`SandboxReady` 或 external success 转换。 |
| `Blocked` | required contract / owner / no-fallback gap明确阻止 | waiting / re-evaluation、safe gap、history | 不由 config、fake、registration或 heartbeat解除。 |
| `Waiting` | 允许的 source / item outcome 尚未到达 | 新 evaluation / safe result | 不等于 retry scheduled、external action pending或 success。 |
| `Failed` | required condition有 explicit local failure | recovery input / history | 不自动创建 recovery decision或重放 external action。 |
| `Unknown` | freshness / source / item / effect无法安全判定 | reconciliation / new evaluation | 不以 timeout、无错误 receipt、cache或“未观察到失败”改为 ready。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| immutable conclusion | decision 一经形成不得原地 `record_gap` 或改写 status；重评必须创建 replacement，并在 application / UoW 中显式成对保存新旧链。 |
| basis freshness | `matches` 必须同时匹配 host、generation、assembly revision；旧 revision 的结论不可覆盖更新 revision。实际 current/CAS 由 Step 7 / 11负责。 |
| gap completeness | non-ready decision 不能携带 empty gap set；`Ready` 不能携带任何 gap。`ReadinessGapRefSet` 的 source -> item -> aggregate 顺序必须保留。 |
| no cross-axis shortcut | readiness 只消费 qualification / assembly；registration、endpoint、session、heartbeat、health、Runtime、Sandbox、image / credential / carrier status不得反向制造 `Ready`。 |
| upstream blockers remain visible | `MSVC-UP-001~008` 任一影响 required source / item 时，decision只能 `Blocked` / `Waiting` / `Unknown`，不得伪造正向 witness。 |
