## 9.9 `domain / CMP-MS-03 / host.rs, action_attempt.rs, association.rs` 对象契约

### 9.9.1 本对象组写入边界、唯一 owner 与概要归一

本批仅闭合冻结业务对象 `MemberExecutionHost`、`HostGenerationFence`、`HostActionAttempt`、`HostExternalAssociation`，以及让这四个对象可逐项落码的 domain-only status、reason、set、guard verdict 与 outcome value。它不新建第 30 个业务对象，不创建 Step 7 trait / port，不定义 callback/envelope/receipt、DB lock、container runtime、Runtime run、Member 主体、镜像正文、Sandbox backend / policy / cleanup truth。

| 项 | 本批收口结论 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| `host.rs` 唯一 owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::host` / `crates/domain/src/host.rs` 独占 `MemberExecutionHost`、`HostGenerationFence`、`HostLifecycleStatus`、`HostHoldReasonCode`、`HostExternalAssociationRefSet`、fence current/effect/feedback/establishment support value。 | 不在 `contracts`、application、infra、entry、adapter、fake或 sibling 中 shadow host lifecycle、current pointer、generation fence或 host-association index。 |
| `action_attempt.rs` 唯一 owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::action_attempt` / `crates/domain/src/action_attempt.rs` 独占 `HostActionAttempt`、`HostActionKind`、`HostActionAttemptStatus`、`HostActionOutcomeRecord`、`HostActionAttemptReasonCode`、`HostLifecycleActivationWitness` 与 dispatch eligibility value。 | 不把 action attempt 变成 tool invocation、Runtime run、Sandbox execution、adapter receipt或外部 action truth。 |
| `association.rs` 唯一 owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::association` / `crates/domain/src/association.rs` 独占 `HostExternalAssociation`、`HostExternalAssociationKind`、`HostExternalAssociationStatus`、`HostExternalAssociationTarget` 与 `HostAssociationReasonCode`。 | 不建立 generic `ExternalOwnerRef` / `ExternalResourceRef`，不吸收 carrier、registry、asset、Sandbox 或 backend lifecycle。 |
| shared carrier import ceiling | 只导入 contracts-owned local id/ref/generation/revision/key、typed external-safe ref/summary、redacted code与 Core `Timestamp`。 | 不重定义 `HostId`、`HostGeneration`、`HostRevision`、`ExternalEffectKey`、`HostActionAttemptRef`、`HostExternalAssociationRef`、`HostActionDecisionRef`、`HostClosureDecisionRef` 或对端 DTO。 |
| local-first ceiling | `HostActionAttempt::prepare` 是 external port 之前唯一可建立的 local attempt；`mark_dispatched` 只形成待持久化的本地跨 port 事实，实际 port call 仍留 application / Job / Step 7~9。 | 不以 prepared/dispatched、local receipt、timeout、adapter availability或 safe summary断言对端已接受、完成、持久化或可重试。 |
| state-axis ceiling | host lifecycle、attempt state、association state、qualification/readiness、registration/session、health、closure 分别由各自对象持有。 | 不创建全局 `HostStatus`，不让 `active`、`succeeded`、`released`、typed ref或 safe summary跨轴自动推导正向状态。 |

本批对概要骨架作以下最小 Rust-facing 归一；均为防止未闭合 carrier 进入实现，不改变 29 个对象分母、CMP 所有权或上游 blocker。

| 概要轮廓 | 本批收口形态 | 原因与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| `current_association_refs` | `HostExternalAssociationRefSet`，只保存本地 association ref 的 canonical index。 | association 的 `pending/active/...` 仍只在 `HostExternalAssociation`；index 中有 ref 不表示任一关联 active、外部资源存在或 host ready。 |
| `HostHoldReasonCode` / `AssociationInvalidationReason` | 各文件位置限定的 `HostHoldReasonCode`、`HostActionAttemptReasonCode`、`HostAssociationReasonCode`，均只包装 contracts `HostRedactedCode`。 | 不让 domain 重新接收 raw string、adapter error、receipt、endpoint、secret或 owner body，也不制造全仓泛化 `HostReason`。 |
| `HostClosureRef` | host lifecycle 只保留已闭合的 `HostClosureDecisionRef`。 | `HostClosure` 业务对象与其 future local ref 属 CMP-MS-06；在其尚未写卡前，不能为 `terminate` 私造 ref / repository。terminated 只表示本地 host lifecycle 终止，不等于 closure/cleanup complete。 |
| `mark_active(..., HostReadinessDecisionRef)` | `mark_active(HostLifecycleActivationWitness, ...)`，witness 仅来自 matching local `StartCarrier` attempt 的成功记录。 | host `Active` 是窄的本地 lifecycle 语义，不能由 readiness、registration、session、health或 Runtime/Sandbox truth构造；同样不反向表示其中任何一项。 |
| `ExternalEffectRefSet` / `ExternalEffectStatus` | `UnknownEffectFenceSet` 保存本地 attempt ref + original `ExternalEffectKey` 的未知效果 fence；attempt status 仍在 `HostActionAttempt`。 | fence 不复制外部 effect / backend state，只阻止相同 key 的盲重放；exact outcome envelope仍受 `MSVC-UP-003/004/007` 阻塞。 |

### 9.9.3 `host.rs` support value、closed lifecycle state 与 `MemberExecutionHost`

#### `HostHoldReasonCode`

```rust
/// Carries a redacted local reason for holding one logical host lifecycle without carrying an external body.
pub struct HostHoldReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

impl HostHoldReasonCode {
    /// Creates a host-hold reason from an already redacted local classification.
    pub fn from_progression_classification(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a previously persisted redacted host-hold reason.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the redacted local code without interpreting external truth.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| 字段 / 函数 | 作用 | 来源、可选性与禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|
| `0` | held / conflict / unknown-effect 的 local-safe 原因 | 只来自 application 已完成 redaction 的 `HostRedactedCode` 或 safe rehydrate；不得从 raw callback、adapter error、backend resource、route、credential、image manifest、timeout文本或 public receipt构造。 |
| `from_progression_classification` | 形成 fresh domain reason | pure wrapper；不判断 current pointer、不把 reason 升级为 external effect、也不改变 host。 |
| `from_persisted` / `as_code` | 重建或读取 safe reason | 不重新 redaction、不反推原始原因、不暴露 policy/body；只供 host state、history mapper与未来安全投影消费。 |

#### `HostLifecycleStatus`

```rust
/// Classifies the local lifecycle of one logical host without flattening readiness, session, health, closure, or external-owner state.
pub enum HostLifecycleStatus {
    /// The local host identity and immutable generation have been established.
    Established,
    /// One prepared local lifecycle attempt is being progressed for this host generation.
    Progressing {
        /// Locally owned attempt that caused this host lifecycle progression.
        attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
    },
    /// A matching local start-attempt witness permits the narrow host lifecycle to be active.
    Active {
        /// Locally owned attempt retained only as lifecycle causality.
        activation_attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
    },
    /// Further local progression is held by a redacted reason and optional local blocking attempt.
    Held {
        /// Redacted local reason for the hold.
        reason_code: HostHoldReasonCode,
        /// Local attempt whose unresolved effect blocks progression when one exists.
        blocking_attempt_ref: Option<HostActionAttemptRef>,
    },
    /// A closure-qualified local decision is bringing this host lifecycle toward termination.
    Quiescing {
        /// Closure-qualified decision retained as local causality.
        closure_decision_ref: HostClosureDecisionRef,
    },
    /// This local host lifecycle has terminated while external cleanup may remain pending.
    Terminated {
        /// Closure-qualified decision that authorized the local termination.
        closure_decision_ref: HostClosureDecisionRef,
    },
    /// A newer logical host generation has replaced this host as current.
    Superseded {
        /// Locally owned successor host that became current through a separate atomic save.
        successor_host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Immutable generation of the successor host.
        successor_generation: HostGeneration,
    },
}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 注释 | 作用 | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Established` | `The local host identity and immutable generation have been established.` | 新 logical host 的初始本地生命周期 | `MemberExecutionHost::establish` / valid rehydrate | `Progressing`、`Held`、`Quiescing`、`Superseded`；不等于 backend resource、ready或 session |
| `Progressing { attempt_ref }` | `One prepared local lifecycle attempt is being progressed for this host generation.` | 绑定一个已提交 prepared local attempt | `begin_progression` or `continue_progression` after current/fence guard | `Progressing`（严格 successor attempt）、`Active`、`Held`、`Quiescing`、`Superseded`；不表示 port 已调用或 result 已到达 |
| `Active { activation_attempt_ref }` | `A matching local start-attempt witness permits the narrow host lifecycle to be active.` | 仅表示 host lifecycle 可作为 current association语境继续存在 | `mark_active` consuming a matching local witness | `Held`、`Quiescing`、`Superseded`；不等于 local readiness、registration、Host Session、health、Runtime readiness/run、Sandbox completion或 backend active |
| `Held { .. }` | `Further local progression is held by a redacted reason and optional local blocking attempt.` | 明确冻结 unsafe progression | `hold` after conflict/gap/unknown local classification | history / future explicit recovery or replacement handling；本 CMP 不允许隐式恢复为 progressing/active |
| `Quiescing { .. }` | `A closure-qualified local decision is bringing this host lifecycle toward termination.` | 本地收束进行中 | `begin_quiescing` with `HostClosureDecisionRef` | `Terminated` 或 `Superseded`；不表示 cleanup dispatched/completed |
| `Terminated { .. }` | `This local host lifecycle has terminated while external cleanup may remain pending.` | 本地生命周期终止 | `terminate` from matching quiescing decision | history / closure input only；不得回到 active/progressing |
| `Superseded { .. }` | `A newer logical host generation has replaced this host as current.` | 旧 host 留为历史且不再是 current | `supersede` after future UoW commits successor/pointer relationship | history / safe projection；不得重新 current、active或修改 generation |

`HostLifecycleStatus` 是 host 轴的 closed enum。它不含 `Ready`、`Registered`、`SessionActive`、`Healthy`、`RuntimeReady`、`SandboxReady`、`BackendRunning` 或 `CleanupComplete`；任何实现试图增加此类 variant，必须先回退 00/01/02 重开对象与 owner 边界。

#### `HostExternalAssociationRefSet`

```rust
/// Stores a canonical local index of association records linked to one host generation without carrying association state or external bodies.
pub struct HostExternalAssociationRefSet(Vec<HostExternalAssociationRef>);

impl HostExternalAssociationRefSet {
    /// Creates an empty local association index for a newly established host.
    pub fn empty() -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a canonical local association index without loading association records.
    pub fn try_rehydrate(values: Vec<HostExternalAssociationRef>) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Adds one new local association reference in canonical order.
    pub fn insert_canonical(&mut self, value: HostExternalAssociationRef) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns the immutable local association-reference sequence.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[HostExternalAssociationRef];
}
```

| 约束 | 结论 |
|---|---|
| canonical key | 按 `association_ref.association_id.as_str()` 严格升序；重复或乱序输入返回 `DomainError`，不得自动排序、去重或覆盖。 |
| 字段来源 | 只由 local association store rehydrate，或 application 已验证同 host / same-generation 的 `HostExternalAssociation::to_ref()` 输入；host object 不加载 association、不读取 target或状态。 |
| 语义上限 | ref 被索引不表示 association 为 `Active`、外部资源存在/健康、Sandbox 已绑定、carrier已启动、host ready或 cleanup complete。 |

#### `HostCurrentMutationPermit`、mutation scope 与 `FenceCurrentState`

`HostGenerationFence` 不把 current pointer 实现泄漏为 database lock、row version 或 repository handle；但 host aggregate 也不能仅凭调用者传入的 `HostRef` 自行声称自己是 current。因此本文件在 `host.rs` 内闭合一个只能由 fence 形成的 domain-only permit。它不是第 30 个业务对象、不是授权 token、不是 CAS token，也不可以跨 UoW、跨 host 或跨 generation 缓存。

```rust
/// Classifies the only local lifecycle-mutation scope granted by one fence snapshot.
pub enum HostCurrentMutationScope {
    /// The selected host is current and may receive an ordinary current-host mutation.
    Current,
    /// The selected host is closing and may receive only the matching local termination mutation.
    ClosureInProgress,
}

/// Proves that a local fence observed one exact current host revision for one immediate domain mutation.
pub struct HostCurrentMutationPermit {
    host_ref: HostRef,
    generation: HostGeneration,
    expected_revision: HostRevision,
    scope: HostCurrentMutationScope,
}

impl HostCurrentMutationPermit {
    /// Returns the host reference selected by the fence.
    pub fn host_ref(&self) -> &HostRef;

    /// Returns the immutable generation selected by the fence.
    pub fn generation(&self) -> &HostGeneration;

    /// Returns the semantic host revision observed by the fence.
    pub fn expected_revision(&self) -> &HostRevision;

    /// Returns the narrow lifecycle-mutation scope granted by the fence snapshot.
    pub fn scope(&self) -> &HostCurrentMutationScope;

    /// Returns whether this permit may be consumed by an ordinary current-host mutation.
    pub fn permits_ordinary_current_mutation(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this permit may be consumed only by the matching local termination mutation.
    pub fn permits_closure_termination(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this permit selects the supplied exact host semantic revision.
    pub fn matches_exact(
        &self,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
        revision: &HostRevision,
    ) -> bool;
}

/// Classifies the committed local current-host facts available to one generation fence.
pub enum FenceCurrentState {
    /// No local current-host pointer is committed for this project member.
    NoCurrentHost,
    /// One exact local host and semantic revision are committed as current.
    Current {
        /// Locally owned logical host selected as current.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Immutable generation of the selected logical host.
        generation: HostGeneration,
        /// Semantic revision observed on the selected host record.
        revision: HostRevision,
    },
    /// A committed current host is in local closure handling and cannot accept ordinary progression.
    ClosureInProgress {
        /// Locally owned logical host selected as the closing current host.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Immutable generation of the closing host.
        generation: HostGeneration,
        /// Semantic revision observed on the closing host record.
        revision: HostRevision,
    },
    /// Local current-host facts cannot be safely selected for a positive progression decision.
    Unavailable {
        /// Redacted local reason for the unavailable current-fact surface.
        reason_code: HostHoldReasonCode,
    },
}
```

| value / variant | 字段来源与作用 | 不变量 / 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| `HostCurrentMutationPermit` | 仅由 `HostGenerationFence::permit_current_mutation(...)` 产生；承接一次已加载的 local `host_ref + generation + HostRevision` selection，以及不可伪造的 `Current` 或 `ClosureInProgress` mutation scope。 | 无 public constructor、`Clone`、`Copy`、`Default`、`From` 或可反序列化入口；每个 consumer transition 必须先以 `matches_exact(&host.to_ref(), host.generation(), host.revision())` 验证三元组，再按 scope 验证操作类别。`Current` 只可消费于 ordinary current-host mutation；`ClosureInProgress` 只可消费于 matching `terminate(...)`。permit 按值消费，失败后也不得缓存或复用，必须重新从 fresh committed selection 取得。它不是 repository expected version、DB lock、actor authorization、action permission、effect key、external receipt或 current pointer 写入能力。实际 CAS 与 UoW 仍留 Step 7 / 11 / 13。 |
| `NoCurrentHost` | future current-fact reader 已明确返回“没有 committed logical host”的本地事实。 | 不能由 backend observation、空 projection、timeout、缺少 callback、cache miss 或 sibling unavailable 推断；不等于不存在历史 host、cleanup 完成或可无条件 launch。 |
| `Current { .. }` | 同一次 local reader / UoW selection 返回的 host ref、immutable generation 与该 host semantic revision。 | 三字段必须成对属于同一 `MemberExecutionHost`；`revision` 不是 repository expected version，不能单独证明 single-active 或 future CAS 成功。 |
| `ClosureInProgress { .. }` | local current-fact reader 已确认 host 正处于 closure 语境，保留同一 host/generation/revision 以拒绝 ordinary progression，并且 fence 只能签发 `ClosureInProgress` scope 的 permit。 | 不能被解释为 `NoCurrentHost`、可 launch、可重启或 cleanup complete；本批 permit 只允许 matching `terminate(...)` 消费，不能用于 begin/continue/active/hold/associate/supersede。其它 closure / replacement flow 须在其所属 CMP 与 future UoW 契约中重新取得明确 selection。 |
| `Unavailable { .. }` | local store / selector 无法安全给出 `NoCurrentHost` 或唯一 `Current` / `ClosureInProgress` 时，由 application redaction path 给出已裁剪原因。 | 一切正向 establish / prepare / current mutation 均 fail-closed；reason 不携带 row、backend、Runtime、Member、Sandbox、route 或 raw error body。 |

`HostCurrentMutationScope` 不是又一个 host status、closure status 或 action permission；它只是 frozen current-fact snapshot 在一次 aggregate mutation 上的窄消费条件。`Current` permit 可以为 `begin_quiescing(...)` 消费，但该 mutation 成功提交后，下一次 `terminate(...)` 必须从 fresh current-fact reader 得到 `ClosureInProgress` permit；application 不得把 `Current` permit 转换、缓存或复用于 termination。

#### `MemberExecutionHost` 对象契约

##### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `MemberExecutionHost`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 8 个，表示一个项目成员的一条 logical execution-host instance。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::host` / `crates/domain/src/host.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-09` 的 immutable generation / predecessor / local lifecycle，`CAP-MS-10~12` 的 host-side action causal link 与 local association index。 |
| 主要责任 | 固定 project-member 双锚、immutable generation、predecessor relation、窄的 local lifecycle、local association-ref canonical index 与 semantic revision。 |
| 不拥有 | current pointer、single-active physical lock、repository version、action attempt truth、association state/target、readiness、registration、endpoint/session、health、Runtime run、Member主体、container/backend/Sandbox lifecycle、external completion、history/outbox/public view。 |

##### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one immutable-generation logical execution host and its local lifecycle facts.
pub struct MemberExecutionHost {
    /// Stable locally owned identity of this logical host instance.
    host_id: HostId,
    /// Sole project-scoped execution subject for this logical host.
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Identity anchor carried with the formal project-member control scope.
    global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Immutable local generation for this logical host instance.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Prior logical host replaced or restarted by this instance, when one exists.
    predecessor_host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
    /// Committed local action decision that caused this logical host to be established.
    creation_decision_ref: HostActionDecisionRef,
    /// Narrow local lifecycle; it is not a cross-axis readiness or external-owner status.
    lifecycle_status: HostLifecycleStatus,
    /// Canonical local references to association records linked to this host generation.
    association_refs: HostExternalAssociationRefSet,
    /// Monotonic semantic revision of accepted local host mutations.
    revision: HostRevision,
    /// Local time at which this logical host was established.
    created_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time of the latest accepted host-local mutation.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl MemberExecutionHost {
    /// Establishes a logical host from one fence-approved generation-establishment plan.
    pub fn establish(
        establishment: HostGenerationEstablishment,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates one persisted logical host without selecting it as current or loading associations.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        host_id: HostId,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        predecessor_host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
        creation_decision_ref: HostActionDecisionRef,
        lifecycle_status: HostLifecycleStatus,
        association_refs: HostExternalAssociationRefSet,
        revision: HostRevision,
        created_at: Timestamp,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Begins a host-lifecycle progression from one matching prepared local action attempt.
    pub fn begin_progression(
        &mut self,
        attempt: &HostActionAttempt,
        permit: HostCurrentMutationPermit,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Replaces one successfully completed establishment attempt with its next prepared establishment attempt.
    pub fn continue_progression(
        &mut self,
        completed_attempt: &HostActionAttempt,
        next_attempt: &HostActionAttempt,
        permit: HostCurrentMutationPermit,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Marks the narrow host lifecycle active from one matching successful start-attempt witness.
    pub fn mark_active(
        &mut self,
        activation: HostLifecycleActivationWitness,
        permit: HostCurrentMutationPermit,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Holds further local lifecycle progression without rewriting the causal attempt or effect key.
    pub fn hold(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: HostHoldReasonCode,
        blocking_attempt_ref: Option<HostActionAttemptRef>,
        permit: HostCurrentMutationPermit,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Starts local quiescing from a closure-qualified local decision.
    pub fn begin_quiescing(
        &mut self,
        closure_decision_ref: HostClosureDecisionRef,
        permit: HostCurrentMutationPermit,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Terminates the local lifecycle after the same closure-qualified decision is quiescing it.
    pub fn terminate(
        &mut self,
        closure_decision_ref: HostClosureDecisionRef,
        permit: HostCurrentMutationPermit,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Marks this host historical when a separately established successor is atomically made current.
    pub fn supersede(
        &mut self,
        establishment: &HostGenerationEstablishment,
        permit: HostCurrentMutationPermit,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Adds one matching local association reference without loading association state or target body.
    pub fn associate(
        &mut self,
        association: &HostExternalAssociation,
        permit: HostCurrentMutationPermit,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns the typed local reference for this logical host.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostRef;

    /// Returns whether this host is bound to the supplied local host and generation pair.
    pub fn matches(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns the immutable local generation of this host record.
    pub fn generation(&self) -> &HostGeneration;

    /// Returns the current local lifecycle classification.
    pub fn lifecycle_status(&self) -> &HostLifecycleStatus;

    /// Returns the current local semantic revision.
    pub fn revision(&self) -> &HostRevision;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `host_id` | `HostId` | 本仓 logical host immutable identity | 仅来自 application local id generator 或 safe local rehydrate；不从 container/pod/backend id、Runtime session/run、Member id、association ref、effect key或 timestamp 派生。 |
| `project_member_ref` + `global_member_ref` | typed L1 refs | 固定唯一执行主语与 identity anchor | 必须来自同一 formal control scope / committed creation decision selection；domain 不推导 L1 relation。`GlobalMemberRef` 不能替代 project subject，缺少 formal dual-anchor mapper 时 establish fail-closed。 |
| `generation` | `HostGeneration` | 固定这个 logical instance 所属的 local generation | 只能从 `HostGenerationEstablishment` 接收；immutable，不从 source version、repository version、projection cursor、backend generation或 clock 得到。 |
| `predecessor_host_ref` | `Option<HostRef>` | 形成 restart / replace predecessor chain | 首 generation 必须为 `None`；后继 generation 必须与 establishment plan 中的 selected predecessor 精确相等；不得用 backend resource / Runtime run / closure ref 替代。 |
| `creation_decision_ref` | `HostActionDecisionRef` | 回链建立此 logical host 的 committed local action decision | only fence-approved establish plan 可提供；编排建立路径使用 `HostActionDecisionRef::Orchestration`，恢复重启路径使用 `HostActionDecisionRef::Recovery`；ref 本身不证明 current、host active、backend created 或 lifecycle action succeeded。 |
| `lifecycle_status` | `HostLifecycleStatus` | 保留 host-local progression | 初始只能 `Established`；只能由本对象成员函数转换；不由 readiness, registration, session, health, association state, safe summary或 external owner observation 直接写入。 |
| `association_refs` | `HostExternalAssociationRefSet` | 对本 generation 的 local association record 建 canonical index | 初始 `empty()`；仅 `associate(...)` 或 safe rehydrate 改变；不嵌 target、summary、association status、external resource 或 backend body。 |
| `revision` | `HostRevision` | 区分同一 host record 已接受的 semantic mutation | `establish` 使用 `HostRevision::initial()`；每次有效 transition / association-index append 恰递增一次；不作为 repository expected-version/CAS token。 |
| `created_at` / `updated_at` | `Timestamp` | 分别记录 logical establish 与最后 host-local accepted fact 的 local time | application clock output 或 local rehydrate；不是 source captured time、external observation、port invocation time、commit receipt或 event time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `establish(HostGenerationEstablishment)` | 形成唯一合法的初始 host aggregate | plan 必须由同文件 `HostGenerationFence` 产生，含 selected dual anchor、candidate id、first/next generation、predecessor relation、creation decision 与 local time。返回时固定 `Established`、empty association index、`HostRevision::initial()`；无 I/O、无 pointer write、无 backend/resource/action call。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 只重建已保存 host truth | 验证 status payload、自身 ref/predecessor 非 self、successor generation strictly later、association set canonical、`created_at <= updated_at`。不重新选择 current、不查 decision、不加载 association、不重算 external state。 |
| `begin_progression(...)` | 把初始 host 关联到一个 prepared establishment attempt | permit 必须按值消费、精确匹配 host/generation/revision，且 scope 必须为 `Current`；attempt 必须匹配 host/generation、为 `Prepared` 且 action 是 `CreateHost` 或 `StartCarrier`。仅允许 `Established -> Progressing { attempt_ref }`，成功后 revision 加一。不会 dispatch port，也不会声明 result。 |
| `continue_progression(...)` | 以严格可证明的下一步替换当前 establishment attempt | permit 必须按值消费、精确匹配且 scope 为 `Current`；当前必须是 `Progressing { attempt_ref }` 且该 attempt与`completed_attempt`同一、已本地 `Succeeded`；`next_attempt`必须同 host/generation、`Prepared`、为 `CreateHost` / `StartCarrier`，且与 completed attempt 不是同一 ref。仅 `Progressing -> Progressing`，revision 加一；不生成 effect key、不调 port、不把上一 attempt success 写成 host active。 |
| `mark_active(...)` | 用窄的本地 activation witness 完成 lifecycle activation | permit 必须按值消费、精确匹配且 scope 为 `Current`；status 必须是同一 attempt 的 `Progressing`，witness 必须由该 attempt 的 `StartCarrier + Succeeded` local record产生。仅转为 `Active` 并递增 revision；不读取 readiness、registration、session、health或 Runtime/Sandbox truth。 |
| `hold(...)` | 显式冻结不安全 progression | permit 必须按值消费、精确匹配且 scope 为 `Current`；允许从 `Established`、`Progressing` 或 `Active` 转为 `Held`，并保留 optional blocking local attempt ref。`Quiescing`、`Terminated`、`Superseded` 不得丢失 closure / successor causality 而转为 `Held`。不会取消 attempt、改变 effect key、重试外部 action或隐式恢复。 |
| `begin_quiescing(...)` | 开始 local closure path | permit 必须按值消费、精确匹配且 scope 为 `Current`；只接受已构造的 `HostClosureDecisionRef`，并允许从未终态 local lifecycle 转为 `Quiescing`。不创建 `HostClosure`、`CleanupAttempt`、cleanup receipt 或 Sandbox release。 |
| `terminate(...)` | 记录本地 lifecycle termination | permit 必须按值消费、精确匹配且 scope 为 `ClosureInProgress`；当前必须为 `Quiescing` 且 closure ref 同一；转为 `Terminated` 并递增 revision。它不表示 external carrier stopped、resource deleted、binding released、cleanup complete或 case resolved。 |
| `supersede(...)` | 留存旧 host 并建立 successor chain | permit 必须按值消费、精确匹配且 scope 为 `Current`；establishment 的 predecessor 必须是 `self.to_ref()` 且 successor generation严格晚于当前 generation。此方法只改旧 host 为 `Superseded`；future application 必须在同一 local UoW 建立 successor、保存 predecessor、切 current pointer、append history，任一步失败则不允许单独提交。 |
| `associate(...)` | 为 matching association 建本地 ref index | permit 必须按值消费、精确匹配且 scope 为 `Current`，association 的 host/generation 必须精确相等，host 不能 `Terminated` / `Superseded`。只 canonical append `association.to_ref()` 并递增 revision；不读取 association state、target或 outcome。 |
| `to_ref` / `matches` / accessors | 最小 typed read surface | pure；不得据此推断 current、ready、registered、session active、healthy、external resource existence 或 action completion。 |

| lifecycle transition | 合法来源与结果 | 禁止 shortcut |
|---|---|---|
| `Established -> Progressing` | matching prepared `CreateHost` / `StartCarrier` attempt + exact `Current`-scope permit | 不用 action ref、job selection、target ref、assembly complete、safe summary或 external callback直接推进。 |
| `Progressing -> Progressing` | matching succeeded current establishment attempt + a different matching prepared next establishment attempt + exact `Current`-scope permit | 不允许用同一 attempt重复推进，也不让 action ref、receipt或 callback跳过此前 local succeeded state。 |
| `Progressing -> Active` | matching `HostLifecycleActivationWitness` + exact `Current`-scope permit only | readiness `Ready`、registration accepted、association active、backend existence、Runtime session、heartbeat或 Sandbox binding 均不能替代 witness。 |
| `Established/Progressing/Active -> Held` | explicit redacted local hold classification + exact `Current`-scope permit | `Held` 不等于 failed / terminated / recovered；`Quiescing` 必须继续保留 closure causality；本 CMP 不允许按 timeout、cache、fake或“未观察到错误”恢复为 progressing/active。 |
| non-terminal -> `Quiescing -> Terminated` | same closure-qualified decision; entering quiescing consumes a `Current` permit, termination consumes a freshly loaded exact `ClosureInProgress` permit | 不以 stop/terminate target、external cleanup summary或 resource disappearance跳过 closure causality，也不得复用进入 quiescing 前的 permit。 |
| non-superseded -> `Superseded` | separate fence-approved establishment plan + exact `Current`-scope permit + future atomic successor/current save | 不原地改 generation、不删除旧 host、不把 external replacement observation当 successor。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| immutable generation and identity | restart / replace 永远创建新的 `HostId` 和 `HostGeneration`；任何 `set_generation`、`replace_host_id` 或 in-place generation increment 都是禁止实现。 |
| currentness stays outside aggregate | aggregate 只接受 fence permit；它不保存 `is_current` boolean，不管理 project-level pointer，也不实现 DB lock / lease / CAS。 |
| scope and permit are one-shot | `HostCurrentMutationPermit` 同时绑定 exact triple 与 mutation scope，按值消费；`ClosureInProgress` 不得借三元匹配被当作 ordinary `Current`。任何失败、重试或下一 mutation 都必须重新加载 committed facts并取得新 permit。 |
| dual-anchor is consumed, not owned | host 只保留 formal scope 已交付的 typed anchors；不读取 Identity / Work body，不校验 actor permission、Governance approval或 project-member mapping。 |
| no cross-axis lifecycle | `Active` 不推出 readiness、registration、endpoint/session、health、Runtime, Sandbox or external backend state；任何这些状态也不反向写 host lifecycle。 |
| no external-body capture | host 不保存 action request/receipt/callback、container/pod、image manifest、credential、endpoint、Sandbox policy、Runtime run、Member report或 observability body。 |

### 9.9.4 `action_attempt.rs`：动作类别、结果支持值与 `HostActionAttempt`

#### `HostActionKind`

`HostActionKind` 是本仓 host-side progression effect 的有限分类，不是 Runtime、Tools 或 Sandbox 的执行命令枚举。`CreateHost` / `StartCarrier` / `StopHost` / `TerminateHost` 描述 host-side lifecycle progression；`AcquirePinnedAsset` 与 `BindSandbox` 描述 CMP-MS-03 所需的跨 owner handoff 类别。closure cleanup / association release 是 CMP-MS-06 `CleanupAttempt` 的独立责任，不能再作为 `HostActionAttempt` action-kind 或 effect record。具体 target、request、route、credential、manifest、policy 和执行协议必须由后续 port / protocol 契约承接。

```rust
/// Classifies one local host-side action attempt without carrying an external command body.
pub enum HostActionKind {
    /// Establishes or provisions the logical host-side carrier path.
    CreateHost,
    /// Starts the host-side carrier path whose success may provide a lifecycle witness.
    StartCarrier,
    /// Requests a controlled local stop of the host-side lifecycle path.
    StopHost,
    /// Requests a controlled local termination path before closure handling.
    TerminateHost,
    /// Acquires or attaches one already pinned asset reference.
    AcquirePinnedAsset,
    /// Requests a host-level Sandbox binding handoff.
    BindSandbox,
}

impl HostActionKind {
    /// Returns whether this action is allowed to participate in host lifecycle progression.
    pub fn is_host_lifecycle_action(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this action belongs to the host establishment progression path.
    pub fn is_establishment_action(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this action is the narrow start witness source for host activation.
    pub fn can_provide_activation_witness(&self) -> bool;

}
```

| 变体 | Rustdoc 语义 | 可由谁产生 | 不得解释为 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CreateHost` | `Establishes or provisions the logical host-side carrier path.` | `HostActionDecisionRef` 经 domain/application committed + permitted guard 后 | container / pod 已创建、Runtime run 已启动或 Member 已注册 |
| `StartCarrier` | `Starts the host-side carrier path whose success may provide a lifecycle witness.` | matching host-side action plan | carrier 已接受、Host Session active、Runtime ready 或 health healthy |
| `StopHost` | `Requests a controlled local stop of the host-side lifecycle path.` | explicit stop decision | external stop completed、Sandbox released 或 closure complete |
| `TerminateHost` | `Requests a controlled local termination path before closure handling.` | explicit terminate decision | backend destroy、resource deletion 或 cleanup completion |
| `AcquirePinnedAsset` | `Acquires or attaches one already pinned asset reference.` | assembly/progression handoff after pinned supply is mapped | image manifest verification、asset content、container image ready |
| `BindSandbox` | `Requests a host-level Sandbox binding handoff.` | typed Sandbox boundary mapper | Sandbox policy accepted、execute permission、tool execution或 backend bind complete |

| 函数 | 约束 |
|---|---|
| `is_host_lifecycle_action()` | 仅 `CreateHost`、`StartCarrier`、`StopHost`、`TerminateHost` 返回 `true`；它不授予 action permission，也不创建 attempt。 |
| `is_establishment_action()` | 仅 `CreateHost`、`StartCarrier` 返回 `true`；`MemberExecutionHost::begin_progression/continue_progression` 必须使用本 helper，而 stop / terminate 只能先进入显式 local closure path。 |
| `can_provide_activation_witness()` | 仅 `StartCarrier` 返回 `true`；即使为 `true`，仍必须由 matching succeeded outcome 形成 `HostLifecycleActivationWitness`。 |

release / cleanup 不属于 `HostActionKind`：只能先由 CMP-MS-06 的 local closure 形成独立 `CleanupAttempt`，再由 future cleanup port / feedback mapper 处理。这个调整不改变 CMP-MS-03 source association 的 `HostActionAttemptRef` 因果，也不声明 release request、receipt、resource deletion 或 external cleanup completed。

#### `HostActionAttemptStatus`、reason 与结果记录

```rust
/// Classifies the local persistence stage of one irreversible host-side action attempt.
pub enum HostActionAttemptStatus {
    /// The attempt exists locally and has not crossed an external port.
    Prepared,
    /// The local record states that an external port call was initiated.
    Dispatched,
    /// A matching safe outcome was recorded as a local success classification.
    Succeeded,
    /// A matching safe outcome was recorded as a local failure classification.
    Failed,
    /// The effect boundary cannot be safely classified and is fenced against blind replay.
    Unknown,
    /// The attempt was explicitly cancelled before an indeterminate effect could be recorded.
    Cancelled,
}

/// Carries a redacted local reason for one action-attempt classification.
pub struct HostActionAttemptReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

impl HostActionAttemptReasonCode {
    /// Creates an attempt reason from an already redacted local classification.
    pub fn from_attempt_classification(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted redacted attempt reason.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the redacted code without exposing its source body.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}

/// Records one generation- and effect-matched safe outcome for a local action attempt.
pub struct HostActionOutcomeRecord {
    /// Local attempt to which this outcome is attached.
    attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
    /// Logical host selected when the outcome was matched.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation selected when the outcome was matched.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Stable effect key retained across unknown or reconciliation paths.
    effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
    /// Correlation identity used for local matching; it is not a replay key.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// Local success, failure, or unknown classification.
    status: HostActionOutcomeStatus,
    /// Optional body-free summary supplied by a compatible formal mapper.
    summary: Option<HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary>,
    /// Redacted local reason required for a failed or indeterminate local classification.
    reason_code: Option<HostActionAttemptReasonCode>,
    /// Local time at which the outcome was accepted into the record.
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
}

/// Classifies a local action outcome without asserting external completion.
pub enum HostActionOutcomeStatus {
    /// The compatible safe outcome is locally classified as successful.
    Succeeded,
    /// The compatible safe outcome is locally classified as failed.
    Failed,
    /// The effect boundary remains indeterminate and requires the original-key fence.
    Unknown,
}

impl HostActionOutcomeRecord {
    /// Creates a matching local success record from a role-compatible safe summary.
    pub fn succeeded_from_safe_summary(
        attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        summary: HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Creates a matching local failure record from a role-compatible safe summary and redacted reason.
    pub fn failed_from_safe_summary(
        attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        summary: HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary,
        reason_code: HostActionAttemptReasonCode,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates one locally persisted outcome record without reclassifying an external effect.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        status: HostActionOutcomeStatus,
        summary: Option<HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary>,
        reason_code: Option<HostActionAttemptReasonCode>,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Creates an unknown-effect record while retaining the original effect key.
    pub fn unknown(
        attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        reason_code: HostActionAttemptReasonCode,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this record matches one local attempt, host, generation and effect key.
    pub fn matches(
        &self,
        attempt_ref: &HostActionAttemptRef,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
        effect_key: &ExternalEffectKey,
        correlation_id: &CorrelationId,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns the local outcome classification without mapping it to external truth.
    pub fn status(&self) -> &HostActionOutcomeStatus;
}
```

| value / 状态 | 字段来源与闭合规则 | 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|
| `HostActionAttemptStatus` | 只由 `HostActionAttempt` 的 transition 改变；`Prepared -> Dispatched -> Succeeded/Failed/Unknown`，`Prepared -> Cancelled` 是唯一取消路径。`record_outcome(...)` 必须把 outcome status 与 attempt status 一次性配对，禁止只写一侧。 | 不由 receipt、timeout、adapter availability、backend observation、Member report 或 Runtime signal 直接写入。 |
| `HostActionAttemptReasonCode` | 只包装 contracts `HostRedactedCode`；新鲜值来自 application redaction classification，持久化值来自 safe rehydrate。 | raw callback、route、secret、error text、manifest、resource id 或 public body。 |
| `HostActionOutcomeRecord` | 所有 identity 必须与 attempt 的 host/generation/effect/correlation 精确匹配。构造 / rehydrate 的闭合组合是：`Succeeded = Some(ActionOutcome) + None`，`Failed = Some(ActionOutcome) + Some(redacted reason)`，`Unknown = None + Some(redacted reason)`；其它 `status/summary/reason_code` 组合均为 `DomainError`。`Succeeded` / `Failed` 分别只能由对应 named factory 构造，`Unknown` 只能由 `unknown(...)` 构造，rehydrate 必须重做同一组合检查；未知状态必须保留原 `ExternalEffectKey`。 | 不把 summary 存成 callback body、dispatch receipt、external resource state或 completion proof。 |

| `HostActionOutcomeRecord` factory / rehydrate path | 允许输入 | 固定输出 / 拒绝条件 |
|---|---|---|
| `succeeded_from_safe_summary(...)` | matching local identity + compatible `HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary` + local accepted time | 只能输出 `Succeeded / Some(summary) / None`；不得接收状态、reason、receipt或 raw external body。 |
| `failed_from_safe_summary(...)` | matching local identity + compatible `HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary` + `HostActionAttemptReasonCode` + local accepted time | 只能输出 `Failed / Some(summary) / Some(reason)`；不得把缺 reason、unknown summary或 adapter error text降级为 failure record。 |
| `unknown(...)` | matching local identity + original effect key + redacted reason + local accepted time | 只能输出 `Unknown / None / Some(reason)`；不得接收 action summary、替换 effect key或把 timeout / availability直接解释为 external result。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | only persisted typed fields | 必须重做 identity non-empty、`status/summary/reason` 三元组和 time-validity检查；不 refresh、重新 redaction、查询 owner 或解除 unknown fence。 |

上述 factory 与 `rehydrate(...)` 还必须共同拒绝：空 local identity、空 `ExternalEffectKey`、空 `CorrelationId`、summary 的 `ActionOutcome` kind / source-role compatibility 不成立、以及任何以另一 attempt/ref、另一 host/generation、另一 effect key或另一 correlation 拼接的 record。这里不能比较 summary 与 attempt `target_ref` 的 exact external-safe ref 或 role：二者属于不同的 contracts wrapper，且 exact target-to-feedback mapping 仍由 `MSVC-UP-001/002/003/004/007` 阻塞。factory 只能验证已携带的 typed shape；它不加载 attempt、读 port、推断 external completion或把 mapper input升级为 accepted local outcome。`HostActionAttempt::record_outcome(...)` 才以已加载的完整 attempt 再验证五元 identity；所有 rehydrate 的 attempt matching 同样必须在 aggregate rehydrate 内完成。

### `HostLifecycleActivationWitness`

```rust
/// Proves only that one local StartCarrier attempt has a matching succeeded outcome for host activation.
pub struct HostLifecycleActivationWitness {
    /// The local attempt that supplied the witness.
    attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
    /// The host to which the witness is bound.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// The immutable generation to which the witness is bound.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// The effect key retained for causal matching.
    effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
    /// The local outcome time used for causal ordering only.
    witnessed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostLifecycleActivationWitness {
    /// Creates a witness only from a matching locally succeeded StartCarrier outcome.
    pub fn from_succeeded_start(
        attempt: &HostActionAttempt,
        outcome: &HostActionOutcomeRecord,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether the witness applies to the supplied host and generation.
    pub fn matches(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns the causal attempt reference retained by this witness.
    pub fn attempt_ref(&self) -> &HostActionAttemptRef;
}
```

`from_succeeded_start` 必须同时验证：attempt status 为 `Succeeded`、`action_kind == StartCarrier`、outcome status 为 `Succeeded`、attempt / outcome 的 host、generation、effect key、correlation 全部相等。该 witness 只允许 `MemberExecutionHost::mark_active` 使用；它不读取 `HostReadinessDecision`，不证明 registration、session、health、Runtime、Sandbox 或 backend active。

#### `HostEffectDispatchEligibility`

```rust
/// Classifies whether one prepared local attempt may be selected for a future dispatch call.
pub enum HostEffectDispatchEligibility {
    /// The prepared local attempt is eligible for one future dispatch selection.
    Eligible,
    /// A local guard blocks dispatch and retains a redacted reason.
    Blocked {
        /// Redacted local reason that blocks selection.
        reason_code: HostActionAttemptReasonCode,
    },
    /// The original effect key is fenced after an indeterminate effect boundary.
    FencedUnknown {
        /// Locally owned unknown attempt retaining the original effect key.
        attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
    },
    /// The attempt is terminal or otherwise not dispatchable.
    NotEligible,
}
```

该分类由 `HostGenerationFence::classify_dispatch(...)` 与已加载的 `HostActionAttempt` 共同使用。它不调用 external port、不排队 Job、不决定 retry schedule，也不因 `Eligible` 而表示 adapter 可用、对端接收、外部成功或实施 readiness。

#### `HostActionAttempt` 对象契约

##### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostActionAttempt`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 9 个，表示一次 generation-bound、local-first 的 host-side irreversible-effect record。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::action_attempt` / `crates/domain/src/action_attempt.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-10` 的 local preparation / dispatch selection，`CAP-MS-11` 的 safe matching outcome 与 unknown-effect retention。 |
| 主要责任 | 固定 action causality、target safe ref、effect key、correlation、local attempt stage、optional safe outcome record与 local timestamps。 |
| 不拥有 | action decision truth、host lifecycle/current pointer、repository dispatch receipt、outbox/Job scheduling、adapter availability、external request/response、Runtime/tool execution、Sandbox backend/policy、association lifecycle、external completion。 |

##### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one locally prepared host-side action attempt before and after conservative effect matching.
pub struct HostActionAttempt {
    /// Stable locally owned identity of this attempt.
    attempt_id: HostActionAttemptId,
    /// Logical host selected for this attempt.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation selected for this attempt.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Committed local decision causality already checked before preparation.
    decision_ref: HostActionDecisionRef,
    /// Closed host-side action category.
    action_kind: HostActionKind,
    /// Role-specific safe target for a future external action mapper.
    target_ref: HostActionTargetRef,
    /// Stable identity retained for this irreversible effect across unknown paths.
    effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
    /// Local persistence stage of this attempt.
    attempt_status: HostActionAttemptStatus,
    /// Matching safe local outcome when a terminal or unknown classification is recorded.
    outcome: Option<HostActionOutcomeRecord>,
    /// Redacted local reason for a failed, unknown, cancelled, or blocked dispatch surface.
    reason_code: Option<HostActionAttemptReasonCode>,
    /// Causal correlation identity supplied by a validated command, consumer, or job context.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// Local time at which the prepared attempt was formed.
    prepared_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time of the latest accepted attempt-local mutation.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostActionAttempt {
    /// Creates a prepared local attempt before any external port call.
    pub fn prepare(
        attempt_id: HostActionAttemptId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        decision_ref: HostActionDecisionRef,
        action_kind: HostActionKind,
        target_ref: HostActionTargetRef,
        effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        prepared_at: Timestamp,
        eligibility: HostEffectDispatchEligibility,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted local attempt without replaying an effect or querying an external owner.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        attempt_id: HostActionAttemptId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        decision_ref: HostActionDecisionRef,
        action_kind: HostActionKind,
        target_ref: HostActionTargetRef,
        effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
        attempt_status: HostActionAttemptStatus,
        outcome: Option<HostActionOutcomeRecord>,
        reason_code: Option<HostActionAttemptReasonCode>,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        prepared_at: Timestamp,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Records only the local fact that a future application path initiated an external port call.
    pub fn mark_dispatched(
        &mut self,
        eligibility: HostEffectDispatchEligibility,
        dispatched_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records a matching conservative local outcome classification.
    pub fn record_outcome(
        &mut self,
        outcome: HostActionOutcomeRecord,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records that the irreversible effect boundary cannot be safely classified.
    pub fn mark_unknown(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: HostActionAttemptReasonCode,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Cancels a prepared attempt before a dispatch or unknown-effect record exists.
    pub fn cancel(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: HostActionAttemptReasonCode,
        cancelled_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this attempt exactly matches one local host and generation.
    pub fn matches(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this attempt can act as a host-lifecycle progression source.
    pub fn is_host_lifecycle_action(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local reference for this attempt.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostActionAttemptRef;

    /// Returns the retained external-effect identity without changing retry eligibility.
    pub fn effect_key(&self) -> &ExternalEffectKey;

    /// Returns the local attempt stage.
    pub fn attempt_status(&self) -> &HostActionAttemptStatus;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `attempt_id` | `HostActionAttemptId` | 定位一次 local attempt record | application id generator / local store rehydrate；不从 host、generation、effect key、target、receipt、backend id或 timestamp 派生。 |
| `host_ref` + `generation` | `HostRef` + `HostGeneration` | 把 attempt 固定到唯一 logical host instance | `prepare` caller 必须从 loaded host/current selection获得 paired values；不得用 action target、external source version或 association ref 替代。 |
| `decision_ref` | `HostActionDecisionRef` | 保留已验证的 local causal authority | application 在 prepare 前必须再检查 loaded decision committed、permits(action) 与 generation matching；carrier factory 本身不做此验证。 |
| `action_kind` | `HostActionKind` | 界定本仓要记录的 host-side effect 类别 | 只能是 closed enum；不带外部 command/body，不能用 Runtime action、Tool invocation、MCP/A2A/API method 或 Sandbox execute action充当 variant。 |
| `target_ref` | `HostActionTargetRef` | 指向 future external mapper 的 body-free target | 只能来自 compatible formal target mapper / safe persistence；target ref 存在不表示 dispatch、acceptance、resource existence或 success。 |
| `effect_key` | `ExternalEffectKey` | 锚定不可逆 effect identity | application 从 committed local effect context 形成后提供；unknown 及 reconciliation 必须保留同一 key，任何 fresh key retry 都是 fail-closed violation。 |
| `attempt_status` | `HostActionAttemptStatus` | 记录 local stage | 初始只能 `Prepared`；仅本对象方法改变；不由 port response / message raw body直接赋值。 |
| `outcome` | `Option<HostActionOutcomeRecord>` | 保留 terminal/unknown outcome matching | `Prepared` / `Dispatched` / `Cancelled` 必须为 `None`；`Succeeded` / `Failed` / `Unknown` 必须为 `Some` matching record，且 record status 必须分别相同。outcome 不复制 external truth。 |
| `reason_code` | `Option<HostActionAttemptReasonCode>` | 保留 local-safe non-positive explanation | `Succeeded` 必须 `None`；`Failed`、`Unknown`、`Cancelled` 必须 `Some`。`Prepared` / `Dispatched` 默认 `None`，若 need block，应由 eligibility 返回而不在已建立 attempt里伪造 terminal reason。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 保持 command / consumer / history causal matching | validated/inherited local context；不是 idempotency key、effect key、attempt id、currentness proof或 external message identity。 |
| `prepared_at` / `updated_at` | `Timestamp` | 分别记录本地 prepare 与最后 accepted mutation | application clock output / safe rehydrate；不等于 external dispatch time、source captured time、backend completion time或 broker event time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `prepare(...)` | 创建 local-first `Prepared` record | `eligibility` 必须是 `Eligible`；`Blocked`、`FencedUnknown`、`NotEligible` 均返回 `DomainError`，不得创建 attempt。caller还必须已验证 decision / current/generation guard。无 I/O、port call、outbox enqueue、dispatch receipt或 external truth。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 重建已保存 attempt | 验证 status/outcome/reason组合、outcome exact matching、`prepared_at <= updated_at`；不重发、不清 unknown fence、不查询 decision、target或 owner。 |
| `mark_dispatched(...)` | 记录 local dispatch initiation | 只允许 `Prepared -> Dispatched` 且 eligibility 仍为 `Eligible`；它表示 application/Job 已越过 port invocation boundary的本地待持久化事实，不保存 receipt、route或 remote acceptance。 |
| `record_outcome(...)` | 关联 matching local result | 只允许 `Prepared` 或 `Dispatched` 接收 host/generation/effect/correlation/attempt ref精确匹配的 `Succeeded` / `Failed` / `Unknown` record；`Succeeded` / `Failed` 必须带 summary，`Failed` 还必须带 reason，`Unknown` 必须无 summary且带 reason。`Unknown` 转换必须同时被 fence 记录；本方法不激活 host或 association。 |
| `mark_unknown(...)` | 无安全 outcome 时形成 unknown fence input | 只允许 `Prepared` / `Dispatched -> Unknown`；内部以同一 attempt identity、host/generation/effect/correlation生成无 summary outcome record，保留 original effect key。实际向 `UnknownEffectFenceSet` 写入由 application 同 UoW + fence plan保证。 |
| `cancel(...)` | 在 effect 未变得 indeterminate 前显式取消 | 仅 `Prepared -> Cancelled`；dispatched、unknown、succeeded、failed 均拒绝取消，不能把取消当作 remote cancellation。 |
| `matches` / `is_host_lifecycle_action` / accessors | 给 host/fence/association 提供窄的 typed read surface | pure；不决定 current、dispatch eligible、retry、external acceptance或 lifecycle transition。 |

| attempt state | 合法来源 | 后续可去向 | 明确不表示 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Prepared` | `prepare` only，且 local eligibility passed | `Dispatched`、`Succeeded`、`Failed`、`Unknown`、`Cancelled` | port already called、external owner accepted、host progressing/active |
| `Dispatched` | `mark_dispatched` after local selection | `Succeeded`、`Failed`、`Unknown` | receipt / remote acceptance / completion / safe retry |
| `Succeeded` | matching `HostActionOutcomeRecord::Succeeded` | activation witness / association mapper / history input | host active、association active、readiness、registration、session、health或 external lifecycle complete |
| `Failed` | matching `HostActionOutcomeRecord::Failed` | hold / future explicit recovery or closure input | effect definitely absent、automatic retry或 external cleanup state |
| `Unknown` | matching unknown record / `mark_unknown` | fence / reconciliation / hold only | fresh retry key、safe re-dispatch、external failed/succeeded |
| `Cancelled` | `cancel` before any dispatch/unknown effect | history / explicit new decision path | remote cancellation、resource untouched或 new action permission |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| local-first | local attempt must be committed before application / Job calls a port; failed local save means no port call. The object itself does not sequence a UoW or invoke a port. |
| unknown-key retention | `Unknown` 必须保持 original `ExternalEffectKey`，且同 key 的 blind redispatch 被 fence 拒绝；不得新建 attempt/key 绕过未知效果。 |
| no action-truth substitution | attempt / status / summary 都不替代 host lifecycle、decision、association、cleanup、Runtime/Tools/Sandbox execution、member state或 external owner truth。 |
| no hidden retry | `can_retry` 不在本对象提供；retry eligibility、reconciliation、backoff、lease、batch和dispatch Job选择留 Step 7 / 9 / 11 / 13 / 14。 |

### 9.9.5 `association.rs`：typed target、关联状态与 `HostExternalAssociation`

#### `HostExternalAssociationKind` 与 `HostExternalAssociationTarget`

```rust
/// Classifies the local role of one host-to-external association without defining an external owner schema.
pub enum HostExternalAssociationKind {
    /// Associates a host generation with a body-free carrier or backend resource reference.
    CarrierOrBackendResource,
    /// Associates a host generation with a body-free Sandbox binding reference.
    SandboxBinding,
    /// Associates a host generation with a body-free pinned asset reference.
    PinnedAsset,
}

/// Holds one role-compatible external-safe target retained by a local association record.
pub enum HostExternalAssociationTarget {
    /// A carrier, registry, asset, or backend-resource reference.
    CarrierOrBackendResource(HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef),
    /// A host-level Sandbox binding reference.
    SandboxBinding(HostSandboxBindingRef),
    /// A carrier, registry, or asset resource reference after a separate resource mapper has produced it.
    PinnedAsset(HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef),
}

impl HostExternalAssociationTarget {
    /// Returns the closed local association kind compatible with this target.
    pub fn kind(&self) -> HostExternalAssociationKind;

    /// Returns whether this target is structurally compatible with the supplied association kind.
    pub fn matches_kind(&self, kind: &HostExternalAssociationKind) -> bool;
}
```

`HostExternalAssociationTarget::matches_kind(...)` 的唯一合法矩阵是 `CarrierOrBackendResource <-> CarrierOrBackendResource(...)`、`SandboxBinding <-> SandboxBinding(...)`、`PinnedAsset <-> PinnedAsset(...)`；不得因两个 variant 都包裹 `HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef` 而交叉接受。`HostPinnedImageSupplyRef` 只属于 qualification source，永远不能转换、alias 或 `into` 成 `PinnedAsset` target。`HostActionAttempt` 的 action-kind 与 association-kind则只允许以下窄兼容：`CreateHost` / `StartCarrier -> CarrierOrBackendResource`，`AcquirePinnedAsset -> PinnedAsset`，`BindSandbox -> SandboxBinding`；`StopHost` 与 `TerminateHost` 不能作为 fresh association source。association release 不读取任何 `HostActionKind`，只能由 CMP-MS-06 的 matching `CleanupAttempt` 关联。上述判断均只做 local typed-category compatibility，不证明 resource 存在、供给可用、bind accepted、action dispatched或 external owner lifecycle。

| kind / target | 可允许的 source | 语义上限 |
|---|---|---|
| `CarrierOrBackendResource` + matching target | formal carrier/registry/backend mapper或 safe persistence，且仅为 `HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef` | 不保存 owner identity、container body、resource lifecycle、endpoint、route、credential或 backend state。 |
| `SandboxBinding` + matching target | formal L4-sandbox host-binding mapper或 safe persistence | 不表示 bind accepted、policy applied、Sandbox execute、cleanup completed或 backend truth；`MSVC-UP-004` 继续 pending。 |
| `PinnedAsset` + matching target | formal Images-to-resource mapper 或 safe persistence 的 `HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef` | 不表示 digest verified、manifest content、image pulled/attached、runtime image ready；`MSVC-UP-003` 继续 pending。原始 `HostPinnedImageSupplyRef` 仅属于 qualification source，不直接成为 association target。 |

`HostExternalAssociationKind` 不是 generic external owner enum。所有 variant 的 owner identity、schema 和 lifecycle 仍在对端；本仓只用 closed kind + typed target 限制自身可以保存的 reference shape。

#### `HostExternalAssociationStatus` 与 `HostAssociationReasonCode`

```rust
/// Classifies the local association status of one typed external-safe reference.
pub enum HostExternalAssociationStatus {
    /// The local association record exists but no active local association conclusion is recorded.
    Pending,
    /// The local record may be used as a current association for its host generation.
    Active,
    /// The local record is no longer current for its intended association role.
    Stale {
        /// Redacted local reason for staleness.
        reason_code: HostAssociationReasonCode,
    },
    /// A local CMP-MS-06 cleanup attempt is pending a matching safe release outcome.
    ReleasePending {
        /// Locally owned cleanup attempt that carries the original release effect key.
        cleanup_attempt_ref: CleanupAttemptRef,
    },
    /// A matching safe release outcome was linked to this local association record.
    Released {
        /// Locally owned cleanup attempt that caused the local released classification.
        cleanup_attempt_ref: CleanupAttemptRef,
    },
    /// A local structural, scope, generation, or target mismatch invalidated this association.
    Invalid {
        /// Redacted local invalidation reason.
        reason_code: HostAssociationReasonCode,
    },
    /// External association or release effect cannot be safely determined.
    Unknown {
        /// Typed local causality whose original effect key remains fenced when one exists.
        blocking_causality: HostAssociationUnknownCausality,
        /// Redacted local unknown reason.
        reason_code: HostAssociationReasonCode,
    },
}

/// Carries a redacted local reason for association staleness, invalidation, or unknown state.
pub struct HostAssociationReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

impl HostAssociationReasonCode {
    /// Creates an association reason from an already redacted local classification.
    pub fn from_association_classification(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted redacted association reason.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the redacted code without revealing an external body.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}

/// Identifies the local record that fences an indeterminate association or cleanup effect.
pub enum HostAssociationUnknownCausality {
    /// No local side-effect record is available; the redacted reason must explain the structural gap.
    NoAttempt,
    /// An indeterminate source-association action retains its original host-action effect key.
    SourceActionAttempt(HostActionAttemptRef),
    /// An indeterminate release retains its original cleanup-attempt effect key.
    CleanupAttempt(CleanupAttemptRef),
}
```

| association state | 合法来源 | 明确不表示 |
|---|---|---|
| `Pending` | `HostExternalAssociation::link` / valid rehydrate | external resource created, bound, healthy, reachable or active |
| `Active` | exact matching source attempt + compatible safe action outcome, via `activate` | host active, assembly satisfied, readiness, registration/session, health or external owner lifecycle completion |
| `Stale` | explicit local freshness/currentness classification | external object deleted、release complete或 safety issue resolved |
| `ReleasePending` | matching prepared / dispatched local `CleanupAttempt` whose target is this association | release sent/accepted/completed或 closure complete |
| `Released` | matching local cleanup attempt + compatible safe release classification | external cleanup truth、resource deleted、Sandbox cleanup complete或 reconciliation closed |
| `Invalid` | local structural/scope/generation/target mismatch | external owner rejected、resource absent或 action failed |
| `Unknown` | unknown action/release boundary, preserving local attempt when one exists | active/released failure、safe retry、external unavailable or completion |

| `HostExternalAssociationStatus` | required `action_outcome` | required `cleanup_outcome` | additional payload / rejection rule |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Pending` | `None` | `None` | no status payload; `link(...)` is the only fresh constructor. |
| `Active` | `Some(ActionOutcome)` | `None` | no status payload; only `activate(...)` may enter it from `Pending`. |
| `Stale { reason_code }` | `None` | `None` | redacted stale reason required; any retained historic action summary must be projected through history, not kept in the current association state. |
| `ReleasePending { cleanup_attempt_ref }` | `Some(ActionOutcome)` | `None` | matching cleanup attempt ref required; release can begin only from `Active`, and the retained source-action summary remains local causality rather than external lifecycle proof. |
| `Released { cleanup_attempt_ref }` | `Some(ActionOutcome)` | `Some(CleanupOutcome)` | matching cleanup attempt ref and cleanup summary required; a source-action summary is retained as local causality rather than external lifecycle proof. |
| `Invalid { reason_code }` | `None` | `None` | redacted invalidation reason required; only structural local mismatch may enter it. |
| `Unknown { blocking_causality, reason_code }` | `None` | `None` | redacted reason required; source-action or cleanup-attempt causality must match host/generation, and each present unknown record retains its own original effect key in its own fence. `NoAttempt` only represents a structural local gap. Any prior action summary is moved to history before this record enters `Unknown`. |

上述矩阵是 `link`、`activate`、`request_release`、`record_release_outcome`、`mark_stale`、`invalidate`、`mark_unknown` 与 `rehydrate` 的共同约束。任何表外组合、由 status payload 与 stored summary 不匹配形成的记录，或从 history 回填当前 summary，均返回 `DomainError`；不得由 adapter、fake、receipt、timeout 或 external observation补正。

#### `HostExternalAssociation` 对象契约

##### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostExternalAssociation`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 10 个，表示 host generation 与一条 role-specific external-safe target 的本地 association record。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::association` / `crates/domain/src/association.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-12` 的 typed association、safe action/release result link和本地 release surface；为 CMP-MS-06 cleanup handoff保存 typed association ref。 |
| 主要责任 | 固定 host/generation/kind/target/source attempt；保存窄的 local association status、optional safe action/release summary、local time和 typed local ref。 |
| 不拥有 | external owner identity/schema/lifecycle、backend resource body、container/Sandbox policy、release/cleanup truth、host current pointer、host lifecycle、action attempt state、readiness、registration/session、health、Runtime run、cleanup attempt or external receipt。 |

##### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records a local association between one host generation and one role-compatible external-safe target.
pub struct HostExternalAssociation {
    /// Stable locally owned identity of this association record.
    association_id: HostExternalAssociationId,
    /// Logical host to which this association belongs.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation to which this association belongs.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Closed local association role.
    association_kind: HostExternalAssociationKind,
    /// Role-compatible body-free target retained by this record.
    target: HostExternalAssociationTarget,
    /// Local action attempt that first established this association record.
    source_attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
    /// Local association state; not an external owner lifecycle state.
    association_status: HostExternalAssociationStatus,
    /// Latest compatible body-free action outcome linked to this record.
    action_outcome: Option<HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary>,
    /// Latest compatible body-free cleanup/release outcome linked to this record.
    cleanup_outcome: Option<HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary>,
    /// Local time of the latest accepted association-local mutation.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostExternalAssociation {
    /// Creates a pending association from a matching local source attempt and role-compatible target.
    pub fn link(
        association_id: HostExternalAssociationId,
        source_attempt: &HostActionAttempt,
        association_kind: HostExternalAssociationKind,
        target: HostExternalAssociationTarget,
        linked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted association record without loading the external target owner.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        association_id: HostExternalAssociationId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        association_kind: HostExternalAssociationKind,
        target: HostExternalAssociationTarget,
        source_attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
        association_status: HostExternalAssociationStatus,
        action_outcome: Option<HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary>,
        cleanup_outcome: Option<HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary>,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Activates the local association from an exact matching succeeded action attempt and safe outcome.
    pub fn activate(
        &mut self,
        source_attempt: &HostActionAttempt,
        outcome: HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Marks the association stale without deleting its typed target or history.
    pub fn mark_stale(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: HostAssociationReasonCode,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Links a matching CMP-MS-06 cleanup attempt without claiming that release is complete.
    pub fn request_release(
        &mut self,
        cleanup_attempt: &CleanupAttempt,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Links a matching conservative release outcome from a pending cleanup attempt.
    pub fn record_release_outcome(
        &mut self,
        cleanup_attempt: &CleanupAttempt,
        outcome: HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Marks this local association invalid without mutating the external owner.
    pub fn invalidate(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: HostAssociationReasonCode,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Retains an indeterminate association or release boundary without changing the effect key.
    pub fn mark_unknown(
        &mut self,
        blocking_causality: HostAssociationUnknownCausality,
        reason_code: HostAssociationReasonCode,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this association belongs to the supplied local host and generation.
    pub fn matches(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local association reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostExternalAssociationRef;

    /// Returns the local association state.
    pub fn association_status(&self) -> &HostExternalAssociationStatus;

    /// Returns the accepted local action summary, when one exists.
    pub fn action_outcome(&self) -> Option<&HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary>;

    /// Returns the accepted local cleanup/release summary, when one exists.
    pub fn cleanup_outcome(&self) -> Option<&HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary>;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `association_id` | `HostExternalAssociationId` | 定位本地 association record | application id generator / local safe rehydrate；不等于 external resource id、Sandbox binding id、carrier id或 release receipt。 |
| `host_ref` + `generation` | `HostRef` + `HostGeneration` | 锁定关联适用的 logical host instance | `link` 只从 matching source attempt复制；不得由 target/ref text、callback、backend observation或 current pointer推断。 |
| `association_kind` + `target` | closed kind + role-compatible target | 约束本仓可保存的外部 safe locator | `target.matches_kind(kind)` 必须为 true；不建立 `ExternalOwnerRef` 或 generic `ExternalResourceRef`。 |
| `source_attempt_ref` | `HostActionAttemptRef` | 保留创建此 association 的 local causality | 由 `source_attempt.to_ref()` 提供；ref 出现不表示 source attempt succeeded、association active或 external target exists。 |
| `association_status` | `HostExternalAssociationStatus` | 保存 local relation lifecycle | 初始 `Pending`；仅本对象成员函数改变；不按 Host lifecycle / readiness / health / external resource state自动迁移。 |
| `action_outcome` / `cleanup_outcome` | `Option<HostActionOutcomeSafeSummary>` / `Option<HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary>` | 分别保存 action activation 与 release matching 的 body-free summary | 两个字段不可互换；`Pending` / `Stale` / `Invalid` / `Unknown` 必须二者皆 `None`，`Active` 只允许 action summary，`ReleasePending` 保留 prior action summary且 cleanup summary为 `None`，`Released` 必须保留 action summary且必须有 cleanup summary；所有组合由 `rehydrate` 与 transition method 拒绝。进入 `Stale` / `Invalid` / `Unknown` 前的 summary 必须作为 future history material handed off，而非保留在当前 association record。不得保存 raw body、receipt、external lifecycle snapshot或 callback envelope。 |
| `updated_at` | `Timestamp` | 标记 local association decision time | application clock output / safe rehydrate；不是 external source captured time、release completion time或 DB commit version。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `link(...)` | 建立 `Pending` local association | source attempt必须是同一 host/generation、action kind 与 association kind满足本节固定 compatibility matrix、且为 `Prepared` / `Dispatched` / `Succeeded` 而不能是 `Failed` / `Unknown` / `Cancelled`；target-kind必须精确匹配。它不要求 source attempt succeeded，不插入 host index、不执行 port、不宣称 target存在。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 重建已保存 association | 验证 kind/target、status/payload、source-action / cleanup-attempt causality、summary kind及 action/cleanup summary 组合的一致性；不 refresh external ref、不判定 external state、不删除 stale/invalid history。 |
| `activate(...)` | 形成 local `Active` relation | 只允许 `Pending`，source attempt ref/host/generation必须匹配，attempt 必须 `Succeeded`，outcome 必须 compatible `ActionOutcome`。它只写 local state+summary；不让 host 自动 `Active`，不写 readiness或 external lifecycle。 |
| `mark_stale(...)` | 显式撤销 local current usability | 允许 `Pending` 或 `Active` 进入 `Stale`，保留 target和source attempt；根据 payload matrix 清除当前 action / cleanup summary并把其历史保留交给 future history mapper；`ReleasePending`、`Released`、`Invalid`、`Unknown` 不得被 stale 覆盖；不调用 release，不删除 record，不以 stale 断言 external object无效。 |
| `request_release(...)` | 进入 local `ReleasePending` | 只允许从 `Active` 进入；`CleanupAttempt` 必须指向本 association、host/generation精确匹配、为 `Prepared` 或 `Dispatched`，并持有其自身已保存的 `ExternalEffectKey`。它保留 existing source-action summary、清空 cleanup summary，不需要/不产生 cleanup receipt；不能创建 / 换用 `HostActionAttempt` 或 effect key。效果 unknown则 future flow必须以同一 `CleanupAttemptRef` 进入 `Unknown`。 |
| `record_release_outcome(...)` | 形成 local `Released` classification | 只允许 matching `ReleasePending` + same `CleanupAttemptRef` + cleanup attempt `Succeeded` + compatible `CleanupOutcome` summary；不等于 external resource lifecycle or cleanup truth。 |
| `invalidate(...)` | 保留 structural invalidation | 仅允许 `Pending` 或 `Active` 进入 `Invalid`，并清除/禁止 action 与 cleanup summary；`ReleasePending`、`Released`、既有 `Invalid`、`Unknown` 不得被覆盖；不可从 external observation重写。 |
| `mark_unknown(...)` | 保留关联/释放不确定性 | 仅允许 `Pending`、`Active` 或 `ReleasePending` 进入 `Unknown`；它必须清除 action/cleanup summary，并将被清除的安全摘要交给 future history-material handoff，而不能以当前 record 或 raw body留存。`SourceActionAttempt` 或 `CleanupAttempt` causality 必须匹配 host/generation；后者还必须匹配当前 release-pending ref。两类 unknown 都由各自 record / fence 保留原 `ExternalEffectKey`，不得 mint 新 key；`NoAttempt` 只允许 structural gap，不代表 side effect。此方法不新建 attempt、cleanup work或 external request。 |
| `matches` / `to_ref` / accessor | 提供 typed local relation surface | pure；不代表 association active、target live、host current、ready或 external owner success。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| typed target only | 无 generic `ExternalOwnerRef`、raw URL、resource body、manifest、credential、policy、receipt或 callback body字段；future new association role必须回到本 Step 改 closed enum / wrapper。 |
| active/released are local | `Active` 只表示本仓当前可把该 reference 当 association 使用；`Released` 只表示匹配安全摘要被本仓记录；二者不宣称任何 external lifecycle / cleanup事实。 |
| history, not deletion | stale、invalid、released、unknown record保留 local ref和因果；不可通过删除 association 避免 cleanup / reconciliation。 |
| no readiness bridge | association status不能直接写 `HostAssembly` item outcome、`HostReadinessDecision`、host lifecycle、registration/session或 health；后续 mapper必须显式、同 generation并保留 blocker。 |

### 9.9.6 `host.rs`：current/generation/late-effect guard 与 `HostGenerationFence`

#### unknown-effect fence、generation establishment 与 feedback disposition support value

```rust
/// Records one unknown irreversible effect that blocks blind redispatch of its original key.
pub struct UnknownEffectFenceEntry {
    /// Locally owned attempt whose effect boundary is unknown.
    attempt_ref: HostActionAttemptRef,
    /// Original key that must not be replaced for blind retry.
    effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
    /// Host to which the unknown effect belongs.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable generation to which the unknown effect belongs.
    generation: HostGeneration,
}

/// Holds canonical unknown-effect fences for one project-member generation guard.
pub struct UnknownEffectFenceSet(Vec<UnknownEffectFenceEntry>);

impl UnknownEffectFenceSet {
    /// Creates an empty unknown-effect fence set for a local current-fact selection.
    pub fn empty() -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates canonical unknown-effect entries without removing or replacing any effect key.
    pub fn try_rehydrate(entries: Vec<UnknownEffectFenceEntry>) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Adds one unknown effect when its key is not already fenced by another local attempt.
    pub fn insert_unknown(&mut self, entry: UnknownEffectFenceEntry) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Removes one fence only after a later same-key local reconciliation result is explicitly accepted.
    pub fn resolve_matching(
        &mut self,
        attempt_ref: &HostActionAttemptRef,
        effect_key: &ExternalEffectKey,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether the original effect key remains fenced.
    pub fn contains_key(&self, effect_key: &ExternalEffectKey) -> bool;

    /// Returns canonical local entries without exposing external effect body.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[UnknownEffectFenceEntry];
}

/// Carries a fence-approved plan to establish one new logical host generation.
pub struct HostGenerationEstablishment {
    /// Application-generated identity for the new local host.
    host_id: HostId,
    /// Sole project-scoped execution subject selected by the formal control path.
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Identity anchor paired with the selected project member.
    global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// First or strictly next immutable local generation.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Current host being replaced or restarted, if one was selected.
    predecessor_host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
    /// Committed local action decision that permits this establishment category.
    creation_decision_ref: HostActionDecisionRef,
    /// Local time supplied for the new host record.
    established_at: Timestamp,
}

/// Classifies a prospective generation-establishment request without performing a store mutation.
pub enum HostGenerationEstablishmentVerdict {
    /// One exact establishment plan is locally permitted pending application UoW/CAS commit.
    Establish(HostGenerationEstablishment),
    /// Existing local current facts make the request a stable replay surface.
    ReplayExisting {
        /// Existing local host selected by the current-fact reader.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Existing immutable local generation.
        generation: HostGeneration,
    },
    /// Local current facts or an unknown effect require an explicit hold.
    Hold {
        /// Redacted local reason for the non-positive verdict.
        reason_code: HostHoldReasonCode,
    },
    /// Current facts are unavailable and no positive progression may be planned.
    Unavailable {
        /// Redacted local reason for the unavailable verdict.
        reason_code: HostHoldReasonCode,
    },
}

/// Classifies how an incoming local feedback candidate relates to the selected fence facts.
pub enum HostFeedbackDisposition {
    /// The feedback may be passed to the matching attempt/association domain record.
    CurrentMatch,
    /// The feedback belongs to a retained historical host or generation and must not mutate current records.
    LateHistorical,
    /// The feedback is a duplicate of an already accepted local effect outcome.
    Duplicate,
    /// Local attempt, generation, effect key, or correlation facts conflict structurally.
    Conflict {
```
