```rust
    pub(crate) fn matches_scope(
        &self,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
        registration_ref: &HostRegistrationRef,
        endpoint_ref: &HostEndpointRef,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns the selected active shell reference when the fact is active.
    pub(crate) fn selected_active_session_ref(&self) -> Option<&HostSessionRef>;

    /// Returns whether this fact explicitly selected no active shell.
    pub(crate) fn is_none(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this fact is fail-closed unavailable.
    pub(crate) fn is_unavailable(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Proves that the domain mapper accepted one formal Runtime-mapping result for one exact local shell.
///
/// It has no public or crate-visible constructor. Persisted active-shell fields are rehydrated by
/// `HostSession::rehydrate`, not by reconstructing this transition witness.
pub struct HostRuntimeAssociationWitness {
    /// Runtime association reference without Runtime session or run body.
    runtime_association_ref: HostRuntimeAssociationRef,
    /// Host for which the association was mapped.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Generation for which the association was mapped.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Host Session shell for which the association was mapped.
    session_ref: HostSessionRef,
    /// Correlation used only for local matching.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

impl HostRuntimeAssociationWitness {
    /// Returns whether this witness exactly applies to one loaded pending shell.
    fn matches_pending_shell(&self, session: &HostSession) -> bool;

    /// Forms a witness only inside this module after the domain mapper completed exact matching.
    fn from_formal_runtime_mapping(
        runtime_association_ref: HostRuntimeAssociationRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        session_ref: HostSessionRef,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

/// Reserves the domain-owned location for a future Runtime association mapper.
///
/// The exact Step 7 Runtime-port `Associated` result remains blocked by `MSVC-UP-001`.
/// No mapped-facts DTO, `Associated` DTO, or callable cross-crate mapper exists in Step 6.
/// After the contract closes, Step 7 must add exactly one body-free application-to-domain seam
/// that validates same-shell typed references before invoking this module's private witness factory.
/// Until then this marker has no callable method and cannot be used by entry, application, adapter,
/// fake, or sibling client to manufacture a positive witness.
pub(crate) struct RuntimeAssociationWitnessMapper;

/// Carries an explicit non-positive Host Session classification without fabricating Runtime or Member truth.
pub enum SessionNonPositiveBasis {
    /// A local prerequisite or unresolved formal contract blocks positive progression.
    Blocked {
        /// Already-redacted reason for the blocked classification.
        reason_code: HostSessionReasonCode,
    },
    /// A matching association result or current-fact read cannot safely be classified.
    Unknown {
        /// Already-redacted reason for the unknown classification.
        reason_code: HostSessionReasonCode,
    },
    /// A matching registration, endpoint, Member association, or Runtime association basis is explicitly stale.
    Stale {
        /// Already-redacted reason for the stale classification.
        reason_code: HostSessionReasonCode,
    },
    /// Explicit local invalidation or already-closed decision causality closes the shell.
    Close {
        /// Already-redacted reason for the closure classification.
        reason_code: HostSessionReasonCode,
        /// Optional already-closed local closure-decision causality.
        closure_decision_ref: Option<HostClosureDecisionRef>,
    },
}

```

| state / support value | 允许来源、合法去向与上限 |
|---|---|
| `Pending` | only `HostSession::open` with accepted registration + active endpoint + typed Member association。它不是 Runtime request sent、association accepted、Runtime session/run或 readiness。 |
| `Active` | `Pending -> Active` only through a matching `HostRuntimeAssociationWitness` and `SessionMutationPermit`。`MSVC-UP-001`未闭合时该 witness不可由本仓构造，所以实际正向路径保持 `Pending` / `Blocked` / `Unknown`。 |
| `Blocked` | explicit local prerequisite/contract gap；可以由 `Pending`或`Unknown`重分类，必须有 redacted reason。不会自行重试或变成 active。 |
| `Unknown` | formal Runtime/Member association、current facts或 matching result不可安全确定；保留 fail-closed。只有新的正式 matching mapper result可进入后续 explicit classification，不能以 timeout/fake/default降格。 |
| `Stale` | matching registration/endpoint/association basis明确 stale；terminal for this record。 |
| `Replaced` | old active shell + replacement plan + future same-UoW/CAS pair；terminal。 |
| `Closed` | explicit closure-decision causality或 local invalidation；不表示 Runtime run stopped、Sandbox released或 cleanup complete。 |
| `HostRuntimeAssociationWitness` | 当前没有 application/domain cross-crate construct path。private `from_formal_runtime_mapping(...)` 只保留给 future same-module mapper；`HostSession::rehydrate(...)` 是唯一重新装配 persisted active-shell fields 的入口，不重建 transition witness。application、entry、adapter、fake、sibling client都不能直接构造；typed ref存在本身永不形成 witness。它不携带 Runtime request/run/checkpoint/outcome。 |
| `RuntimeAssociationWitnessMapper` | `domain::session` 的 reserved marker，不是当前可调用 cross-crate seam。`MSVC-UP-001`未闭合，故本 Step 不声明 `RuntimeAssociationMappedFacts`、`map_formal_associated(...)` 或任何 `Associated` DTO；这些必须先由 Step 7 的正式 Runtime port闭合，再以一条 body-free、same-shell application-to-domain mapper seam引入。到那之前不得 call、emulate、fake、deserialize或以 timeout / receipt / absence-of-error提升 association。 |
| `HostSessionReasonCode` | `from_session_classification(HostRedactedCode)` 或 `from_persisted(...)`；只在 `Blocked` / `Stale` / `Closed` / `Unknown` 使用，`as_code()` 仅供 safe local mapper读取。不得包含 Runtime / Member body、endpoint、credential、route、receipt或 adapter error text。 |
| `CurrentSessionFacts` / `SessionMutationPermit` / `SessionReplacementPlan` | future local reader / `RegistrationSessionPolicy` only；`CurrentSessionFacts` 只允许 `none(host,generation,registration,endpoint)`、`active(...,session_ref)` 或 `unavailable(...)` 的同 scope factory；its `matches_scope` / selected-ref / `is_none` / `is_unavailable` helpers are `pub(crate)` and read-only for policy. `SessionMutationPermit` 与 `SessionReplacementPlan` 都由 `registration.rs` policy file 唯一 owner：file-private `issue_from_policy(...)` 仅由 policy guard调用，`session.rs` 仅以 crate-visible verifier消费 opaque permit，不能构造、clone、修改或 re-export。unavailable一律 fail closed，permit按值一次性消费；`ClassifyExisting`匹配 non-current `Pending` / `Blocked` / `Unknown` shell且可保留任意同 scope selected active shell，`ClassifyCurrent`只匹配 selected `Active` shell，plan要求 future old/new/current/history同一 UoW/CAS。 |
| `SessionNonPositiveBasis` | `Blocked` / `Unknown` / `Stale` / `Close` 只由 future matching local prerequisite, Member / Runtime mapper, current-fact reader 或 already-closed causality mapper给出；必须为 already-redacted、same-scope input。`Close` 的 optional causal ref must be retained by `HostSession.closure_causality_ref` for later same-UoW history, not discarded after the transition. It cannot be constructed from Runtime ref、timeout、fake、endpoint presence、heartbeat、receipt或 absence-of-error。 |

#### `HostSession` 对象契约

##### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostSession`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 14 个，表示本仓 host-side association shell，而非 Runtime session/run。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::session` / `crates/domain/src/session.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-15~16`、`IB-MS-008/009` 的 pending shell / explicit association / blocked / stale / replacement / closure portion。 |
| 主要责任 | 固定 host/generation、accepted registration、active endpoint、Member association、optional Runtime association ref、本地 session status/reason、revision、replacement link、correlation和local times。 |
| 不拥有 | Runtime entry/session/run/turn/checkpoint/memory/goal/plan/tool execution/outcome、Member body/heartbeat truth、endpoint transport、health/readiness、current pointer、external protocol、store/UoW或 public view。 |

##### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one host-side association shell without owning a Runtime session, run, or execution outcome.
pub struct HostSession {
    /// Stable locally owned Host Session shell identity.
    session_id: HostSessionId,
    /// Host to which this shell applies.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation to which this shell applies.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Accepted registration that owns this shell scope.
    registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
    /// Active endpoint that owns this shell scope.
    endpoint_ref: HostEndpointRef,
    /// Member-side association reference without Member lifecycle or signal body.
    member_association_ref: HostMemberAssociationRef,
    /// Optional Runtime association reference after a separately mapped witness is accepted.
    runtime_association_ref: Option<HostRuntimeAssociationRef>,
    /// Local Host Session shell lifecycle classification.
    session_status: HostSessionStatus,
    /// Optional redacted reason required for non-positive classifications.
    reason_code: Option<HostSessionReasonCode>,
    /// Optional closed local decision retained only when close supplied causal provenance.
    closure_causality_ref: Option<HostClosureDecisionRef>,
    /// Successor shell when this active shell was atomically replaced.
    replaced_by_ref: Option<HostSessionRef>,
    /// Local semantic revision of this shell, not a store version or Runtime revision.
    revision: HostSessionRevision,
    /// Local time at which the pending shell was opened.
    opened_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time at which a matching Runtime association witness was accepted, if any.
    activated_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// Local time of the latest accepted shell mutation.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
    /// Correlation retained only for matching later association feedback.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

impl HostSession {
    /// Opens a pending host-side session shell from accepted registration, active endpoint, and Member association facts.
    pub fn open(
        session_id: HostSessionId,
        registration: AcceptedRegistrationWitness,
        endpoint: &HostEndpoint,
        member_association_ref: HostMemberAssociationRef,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        opened_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a locally persisted Host Session shell without contacting Member or Runtime.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        session_id: HostSessionId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
        endpoint_ref: HostEndpointRef,
        member_association_ref: HostMemberAssociationRef,
        runtime_association_ref: Option<HostRuntimeAssociationRef>,
        session_status: HostSessionStatus,
        reason_code: Option<HostSessionReasonCode>,
        closure_causality_ref: Option<HostClosureDecisionRef>,
        replaced_by_ref: Option<HostSessionRef>,
        revision: HostSessionRevision,
        opened_at: Timestamp,
        activated_at: Option<Timestamp>,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Accepts a matching Runtime association witness and activates only this local Host Session shell.
    pub fn activate(
        &mut self,
        witness: HostRuntimeAssociationWitness,
        permit: SessionMutationPermit,
        activated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records an explicit blocked local session classification.
    pub fn mark_blocked(
        &mut self,
        basis: SessionNonPositiveBasis,
        permit: SessionMutationPermit,
        blocked_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records that a matching session association cannot safely be classified.
    pub fn mark_unknown(
        &mut self,
        basis: SessionNonPositiveBasis,
        permit: SessionMutationPermit,
        unknown_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Marks this shell stale from an explicit matching prerequisite classification.
    pub fn mark_stale(
        &mut self,
        basis: SessionNonPositiveBasis,
        permit: SessionMutationPermit,
        stale_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Marks this active shell as replaced by a separately created successor shell.
    pub fn replace(
        &mut self,
        plan: SessionReplacementPlan,
        replacement_ref: HostSessionRef,
        permit: SessionMutationPermit,
        replaced_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Closes this shell with explicit local closure or invalidation causality.
    pub fn close(
        &mut self,
        basis: SessionNonPositiveBasis,
        permit: SessionMutationPermit,
        closed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this shell exactly matches the supplied local association scope.
    pub fn matches_scope(
        &self,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
        registration_ref: &HostRegistrationRef,
        endpoint_ref: &HostEndpointRef,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local Host Session reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostSessionRef;

    /// Returns the local Host Session classification.
    pub fn session_status(&self) -> &HostSessionStatus;

    /// Returns the local semantic revision without exposing a repository expected version.
    pub fn revision(&self) -> &HostSessionRevision;

    /// Returns the exact shell scope and status for a pure domain guard, including a by-value local reference.
    pub(crate) fn guard_scope_and_status(
        &self,
    ) -> (
        &HostRef,
        &HostGeneration,
        &HostRegistrationRef,
        &HostEndpointRef,
        HostSessionRef,
        &HostSessionStatus,
    );

    /// Returns whether this shell is pending for the future same-module Runtime witness mapper.
    fn is_pending_for_runtime_mapping(&self) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `session_id` | `HostSessionId` | local Host Session shell identity | application generator / local rehydrate；不得从 Runtime session/run、Member association、endpoint、host/generation、time或 route派生。 |
| scope quartet | `HostRef` + `HostGeneration` + `HostRegistrationRef` + `HostEndpointRef` | 固定 shell 的 local association scope | `open` 必须接收 matching accepted witness + active endpoint；rehydrate验证配对，不从 runtime ref/heartbeat补齐。 |
| `member_association_ref` | `HostMemberAssociationRef` | Member-side host association shell | formal Member mapper / rehydrate；不表示 Member active/healthy/registered。 |
| `runtime_association_ref` | `Option<HostRuntimeAssociationRef>` | 被接受过的 Runtime association carrier | `Pending` / `Blocked` / `Unknown` 必须为 `None`；`Active`必须为 `Some` matching ref。`Stale` / `Replaced` / `Closed` 若从此前 `Active` 迁入则保留相同 ref 作为只读历史因果，若从非 active 状态迁入则必须为 `None`；这些终态均不把 ref 解释为当前 association、Runtime session/run 或 execution truth。 |
| `session_status` | `HostSessionStatus` | object-local shell lifecycle | `open`仅 `Pending`；成员函数按 closed transition改变。 |
| `reason_code` | `Option<HostSessionReasonCode>` | non-positive local reason | `Blocked` / `Stale` / `Closed` / `Unknown`必须 `Some`；`Pending` / `Active` / `Replaced`必须 `None`。 |
| `closure_causality_ref` | `Option<HostClosureDecisionRef>` | 保留 close transition 所消费的已闭合 local decision 因果 | 仅 `Closed`时可为 `Some`，并且只能等于 `SessionNonPositiveBasis::Close` 给出的 ref；其它状态必须 `None`。它不是 `HostClosure` object/ref，不证明 cleanup、release、Sandbox 或 Runtime stop 已完成。 |
| `replaced_by_ref` | `Option<HostSessionRef>` | old-to-new shell replacement link | only `Replaced`为 `Some(non-self)`。 |
| `revision` | `HostSessionRevision` | same-shell semantic mutation sequence | open为 `initial()`；每一次 accepted state change恰 `next_after()` 一次；不与 `HostRevision`、generation、repository expected version、projection cursor、source version或 Runtime revision互换。 |
| `opened_at` / `activated_at` / `updated_at` | `Timestamp` / `Option<Timestamp>` | local open / accepted witness / transition time | application clock output / rehydrate；`Pending` / `Blocked` / `Unknown`必须 `activated_at=None`；`Active`必须 `Some`且 `opened_at <= activated_at <= updated_at`；`Stale` / `Replaced` / `Closed` 保留此前 active 的 `Some` 值作为历史，或保持从非 active 状态进入时的 `None`。所有值均不表示 Runtime event / execution time。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | later mapper matching | validated local context；不代替 session id、replay key、runtime association ref或 currentness proof。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `open(...)` | 形成唯一合法 `Pending` shell | registration必须 accepted，endpoint必须 active且same scope；Member ref只作 typed shell。固定 `closure_causality_ref=None`。无 Runtime call、current pointer write、health/readiness change或 external session creation。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 重建 local shell | 验证状态 / reason / closure-causality / runtime-ref / replacement-ref / revision / 时间组合；不关联 Runtime、Member或 endpoint。 |
| `activate(...)` | `Pending -> Active` | witness+self+permit scope精确匹配，permit只能 `ActivateWithoutCurrent` / `ActivateReplacementSuccessor`；写 accepted runtime ref / `activated_at`并递增 semantic revision。只激活本地 shell，不宣称 Runtime run / execution active。 |
| `mark_blocked(...)` | `Pending|Unknown -> Blocked` | 只接受 `SessionNonPositiveBasis::Blocked` + matching `ClassifyExisting` permit；不抹掉 pending contract原因，不重试对端。 |
| `mark_unknown(...)` | `Pending|Blocked -> Unknown` | 只接受 `SessionNonPositiveBasis::Unknown` + matching `ClassifyExisting` permit；不新生成 Runtime ref或 session。 |
| `mark_stale(...)` | `Pending|Active|Blocked|Unknown -> Stale` | 只接受 `SessionNonPositiveBasis::Stale`；`Pending` / `Blocked` / `Unknown` 必须消费 matching `ClassifyExisting` permit，`Active` 必须消费 matching `ClassifyCurrent` permit。若 self 为 `Active`，保留已接受的 Runtime ref / `activated_at` 作历史因果；否则二者保持 `None`。不关 Runtime run、不改变 host lifecycle。 |
| `replace(...)` | `Active -> Replaced` | plan / successor / `ReplaceCurrent` permit精确匹配；保留已接受的 Runtime ref / `activated_at` 作历史因果，future same-UoW/CAS保存 old/new/current/history。 |
| `close(...)` | `Pending|Active|Blocked|Unknown -> Closed` | 只接受 `SessionNonPositiveBasis::Close`；`Pending` / `Blocked` / `Unknown` 必须消费 matching `ClassifyExisting` permit，`Active` 必须消费 matching `ClassifyCurrent` permit。把 optional closure decision原样写入 `closure_causality_ref`。若 self 为 `Active`，保留 Runtime ref / `activated_at` 作历史因果，否则二者保持 `None`。该 ref不表示 CMP-MS-06 cleanup/closure complete。 |
| accessors | narrow pure inspection | `guard_scope_and_status(...)` returns borrowed scope/status plus `to_ref()`-equivalent **by-value** `HostSessionRef`; it cannot return `&HostSessionRef` because the shell stores `HostSessionId`, not a ref field. `is_pending_for_runtime_mapping()` is private to `session.rs` for a future same-module mapper; both helpers are not re-exported by the workspace-facing facade and confer no mutation capability. They do not call Runtime / Member、不确认 active network、execution、health、ready或 current pointer commit。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| Host Session is a shell | 永远不是 Runtime session/run、LLM loop、goal/plan、memory/checkpoint、tool execution或 execution outcome truth。 |
| Runtime positive path is formally fenced | `Active`需要 formal Runtime mapper的 matching witness；`MSVC-UP-001`未闭合时不可由 local ref、timeout、receipt、fake、endpoint active或 heartbeat伪造。 |
| orthogonal state remains orthogonal | endpoint active不自动激活 session；session active不反推 endpoint reachability、registration current、health、readiness或 Runtime run。 |
| terminal records do not revive | `Stale` / `Replaced` / `Closed`不可回 `Pending` / `Active`；replacement必须新 shell、new local id和history pairing。 |
| accepted Runtime association is historical after terminal transition | 从 `Active` 进入 `Stale` / `Replaced` / `Closed` 时，accepted Runtime ref 与 `activated_at` 仅保留为不可变历史因果；它们不得被清空后丢失，也不得作为 current / reachable / healthy / executing 证据。 |
| close preserves supplied causality | 任何 `Some(HostClosureDecisionRef)` 必须随 `Closed` shell 持久化；application / history 不得在对象 transition 后从 command、receipt、Runtime、Sandbox 或 external status回填、替换或推断该 ref。 |

### 9.10.7 `registration.rs`：`RegistrationSessionPolicy` 对象契约

#### policy baseline 与 policy-only guard outputs

```rust
/// Holds the immutable local guard baseline for registration, endpoint, and Host Session records.
pub struct RegistrationSessionPolicy {
    /// Declared local policy baseline revision, not Governance policy truth.
    policy_revision: PolicyRevision,
    /// Fixed project-member generation scope for all active-association guards.
    uniqueness_scope: RegistrationSessionUniquenessScope,
    /// Fixed local replay behavior for exact and non-equivalent mapped inputs.
    replay_mode: RegistrationReplayMode,
    /// Fixed credential-binding rule for local acceptance evaluation.
    credential_binding_mode: CredentialBindingMode,
    /// Fixed history-preserving replacement rule for all three currentness axes.
    replacement_mode: RegistrationSessionReplacementMode,
}

/// Classifies the fixed scope of one active registration, endpoint, or Host Session association.
pub enum RegistrationSessionUniquenessScope {
    /// Exactly one active association may exist for each project-member, host, and immutable generation axis.
    ProjectMemberHostGeneration,
}

/// Classifies the complete fixed replay behavior for one registration input relation.
pub enum RegistrationReplayMode {
    /// Exact matches reuse the existing conclusion; non-equivalent current input stays conflict or uses an explicit replacement plan.
    ReuseExactOtherwiseConflictOrReplacement,
}

/// Classifies the fixed local credential-binding requirement.
pub enum CredentialBindingMode {
    /// Credential qualification must be instance-bound to the exact host, generation, and dual-anchor scope.
    InstanceBoundExactScope,
}

/// Classifies the fixed replacement requirement shared by the three currentness axes.
pub enum RegistrationSessionReplacementMode {
    /// A successor record, predecessor transition, current selection, and history append must be paired atomically later.
    AtomicNewRecordWithHistory,
}

/// Authorizes exactly one endpoint activation, replacement, or invalidation mutation.
///
/// This opaque permit is issued only by `RegistrationSessionPolicy` in `registration.rs`.
/// `endpoint.rs` can verify and consume it but has no constructor or field access.
pub struct EndpointMutationPermit {
    /// Host bound by the evaluated endpoint scope.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Generation bound by the evaluated endpoint scope.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Registration bound by the evaluated endpoint scope.
    registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
    /// Existing endpoint expected by the mutation, when any.
    selected_current_endpoint_ref: Option<HostEndpointRef>,
    /// Exact endpoint record allowed to consume this one-use permit.
    target_endpoint_ref: HostEndpointRef,
    /// Narrow mutation role; it is not a database lock or expected-version token.
    scope: EndpointMutationScope,
}

/// Classifies the single permitted use of an endpoint mutation permit.
pub enum EndpointMutationScope {
    /// Activates a candidate only when no active endpoint is selected.
    ActivateWithoutCurrent,
    /// Activates a candidate only as the successor of the selected active endpoint.
    ActivateReplacementSuccessor,
    /// Marks the selected active endpoint as replaced.
    ReplaceCurrent,
    /// Marks the selected active endpoint stale or invalid.
    InvalidateCurrent,
    /// Marks one candidate endpoint stale or invalid before it ever became current.
    ClassifyCandidate,
}

/// Describes the old/new endpoint relation that a later local UoW must persist atomically.
pub struct EndpointReplacementPlan {
    /// Existing active endpoint that must become replaced.
    prior_ref: HostEndpointRef,
    /// Host shared by the old and new endpoint records.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Generation shared by the old and new endpoint records.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Accepted registration shared by the old and new endpoint records.
    registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
}

/// Authorizes exactly one local Host Session mutation.
///
/// This opaque permit is issued only by `RegistrationSessionPolicy` in `registration.rs`.
/// `session.rs` can verify and consume it but has no constructor or field access.
pub struct SessionMutationPermit {
    /// Host bound by the evaluated session scope.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Generation bound by the evaluated session scope.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Registration bound by the evaluated session scope.
    registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
    /// Endpoint bound by the evaluated session scope.
    endpoint_ref: HostEndpointRef,
    /// Existing active session selected by the guard, when any.
    selected_current_session_ref: Option<HostSessionRef>,
    /// Exact session shell allowed to consume this one-use permit.
    target_session_ref: HostSessionRef,
    /// Narrow mutation role; it is not a storage lock or expected-version token.
    scope: SessionMutationScope,
}

/// Classifies the single permitted use of a session mutation permit.
pub enum SessionMutationScope {
    /// Activates a pending shell only when no active session is selected.
    ActivateWithoutCurrent,
    /// Activates a pending successor shell while one exact active predecessor is selected.
    ActivateReplacementSuccessor,
    /// Marks the selected active shell as replaced.
    ReplaceCurrent,
    /// Classifies one non-current pending, blocked, or unknown shell.
    ClassifyExisting,
    /// Classifies the exact selected active shell as stale or closed.
    ClassifyCurrent,
}

/// Describes the old/new Host Session relation that a later local UoW must persist atomically.
pub struct SessionReplacementPlan {
    /// Existing active Host Session shell that must become replaced.
    prior_ref: HostSessionRef,
    /// Shared host.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Shared generation.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Shared accepted registration.
    registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
    /// Shared active endpoint.
    endpoint_ref: HostEndpointRef,
}

impl EndpointMutationPermit {
    /// Issues one endpoint permit only inside this file from a matching policy guard.
    fn issue_from_policy(
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
        selected_current_endpoint_ref: Option<HostEndpointRef>,
        target_endpoint_ref: HostEndpointRef,
        scope: EndpointMutationScope,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Verifies whether this policy-issued permit may mutate the supplied endpoint in the supplied narrow scope.
    pub(crate) fn verifies_endpoint_transition(
        &self,
        endpoint: &HostEndpoint,
        allowed_scope: &EndpointMutationScope,
    ) -> bool;
}

impl SessionMutationPermit {
    /// Issues one session permit only inside this file from a matching policy guard.
    fn issue_from_policy(
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        registration_ref: HostRegistrationRef,
        endpoint_ref: HostEndpointRef,
        selected_current_session_ref: Option<HostSessionRef>,
        target_session_ref: HostSessionRef,
        scope: SessionMutationScope,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Verifies whether this policy-issued permit may mutate the supplied shell in the supplied narrow scope.
    pub(crate) fn verifies_session_transition(
        &self,
        session: &HostSession,
        allowed_scope: &SessionMutationScope,
    ) -> bool;
}

/// Carries the result of a pure endpoint currentness guard before an endpoint mutation.
pub enum EndpointGuardDecision {
    /// A candidate may activate without replacing an active endpoint.
    Activate(EndpointMutationPermit),
    /// A candidate may activate only with the supplied replacement plan and paired permits.
    Replace {
        /// Old/new relation for the future atomic save.
        plan: EndpointReplacementPlan,
        /// Permit for the new successor candidate.
        successor_permit: EndpointMutationPermit,
        /// Permit for the selected old active endpoint.
        prior_permit: EndpointMutationPermit,
    },
    /// Endpoint progression is blocked because facts are unavailable or a prerequisite is non-positive.
    Blocked(HostEndpointReasonCode),
    /// Candidate scope conflicts with the selected active endpoint.
    Conflict(HostEndpointReasonCode),
}

/// Carries the only policy decision that may issue a permit for an endpoint non-positive transition.
pub enum EndpointNonPositiveGuardDecision {
    /// A matching candidate may consume a candidate-classification permit.
    ClassifyCandidate(EndpointMutationPermit),
    /// A matching selected active endpoint may consume a current-invalidation permit.
    ClassifyCurrent(EndpointMutationPermit),
    /// Facts or prerequisite mapping are unavailable; no permit is issued.
    Blocked(HostEndpointReasonCode),
    /// Candidate or target does not belong to the loaded exact scope; no permit is issued.
    Conflict(HostEndpointReasonCode),
}

/// Carries the result of a pure Host Session currentness guard before a session mutation.
pub enum SessionGuardDecision {
    /// A pending shell may activate without replacing an active shell.
    Activate(SessionMutationPermit),
    /// A pending successor shell may activate only with the supplied replacement plan and paired permits.
    Replace {
        /// Old/new relation for the future atomic save.
        plan: SessionReplacementPlan,
        /// Permit for the new successor shell.
        successor_permit: SessionMutationPermit,
        /// Permit for the selected old active shell.
        prior_permit: SessionMutationPermit,
    },
    /// Session progression is blocked by missing, pending, or unavailable local facts / external mapper contract.
    Blocked(HostSessionReasonCode),
    /// Candidate scope conflicts with the selected active local shell.
    Conflict(HostSessionReasonCode),
}

/// Carries the only policy decision that may issue a permit for a Host Session non-positive transition.
pub enum SessionNonPositiveGuardDecision {
    /// A non-current pending, blocked, or unknown shell may be classified with a non-positive basis.
    ClassifyExisting(SessionMutationPermit),
    /// The exact selected active shell may be marked stale or closed with a non-positive basis.
    ClassifyCurrent(SessionMutationPermit),
    /// Facts or prerequisite mapping are unavailable; no permit is issued.
    Blocked(HostSessionReasonCode),
    /// Candidate or target does not belong to the loaded exact scope; no permit is issued.
    Conflict(HostSessionReasonCode),
}
```

| carrier / variant | 来源与固定约束 |
|---|---|
| `RegistrationSessionUniquenessScope::ProjectMemberHostGeneration` | baseline唯一合法 scope；不因 configuration、feature flag、adapter availability、Runtime state、endpoint ref或 fake扩大/缩小。host lifecycle currentness不替代本 scope。 |
| `RegistrationReplayMode::ReuseExactOtherwiseConflictOrReplacement` | factory 固定的单一组合规则：exact mapped input 重用既有 local conclusion；non-equivalent current input只能显式 conflict 或进入 replacement plan。它不是运行时二选一，不能由 retry、correlation、metadata或 reservation结果改变。 |
| `CredentialBindingMode::InstanceBoundExactScope` | candidate与qualification的 credential ref、host/generation、ProjectMember/GlobalMember双锚必须精确相同；不以 ref存在、cached credential、actor、timeout或 endpoint状态替代。 |
| `RegistrationSessionReplacementMode::AtomicNewRecordWithHistory` | 三轴replacement均要求 new local record + old terminal transition + current selection + append-only history在 future same-UoW/CAS中配对；policy不持有 repository / transaction / lock。 |
| `EndpointGuardDecision` / `SessionGuardDecision` | only policy产生；只是 positive activation/replacement guard result。`Blocked` / `Conflict`均不是 endpoint/session lifecycle state，public mapping与persisted result留 application / Step 7~8。 |
| `EndpointNonPositiveGuardDecision` / `SessionNonPositiveGuardDecision` | only policy产生；这是 candidate/current 或 existing-shell 的 non-positive permit 唯一签发路径。`Blocked` / `Conflict`不产生 permit，且不等于 lifecycle state；它们不得由 adapter、entry、fake、timeout或 receipt替代。 |

#### `RegistrationSessionPolicy` 对象契约

##### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `RegistrationSessionPolicy`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 15 个，是 immutable domain policy / guard，无自身业务生命周期。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::registration` / `crates/domain/src/registration.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-13~16`、`IB-MS-007~009` 的 registration validation、credential binding、replay、三轴 single-active、late input、replacement / invalidation guard。 |
| 主要责任 | 只在已加载的 body-free local facts上分类，形成 registration decision、one-use permits、replacement plans、endpoint/session guard decision；固定 fail-closed 和 atomic-history replacement baseline。 |
| 不拥有 | Member request / registration truth、credential authority、L1 lookup / authorization、Runtime protocol/session/run、endpoint transport、current pointer、repository version/UoW/lock、configuration、external retry、history/outbox或 entry disposition。 |

##### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Evaluates immutable local registration and session guard rules without I/O or external-owner truth.
pub struct RegistrationSessionPolicy {
    /// Declared local policy baseline revision.
    policy_revision: PolicyRevision,
    /// Fixed active-association uniqueness scope.
    uniqueness_scope: RegistrationSessionUniquenessScope,
    /// Fixed complete replay behavior for exact and non-equivalent mapped inputs.
    replay_mode: RegistrationReplayMode,
    /// Fixed instance-bound credential qualification requirement.
    credential_binding_mode: CredentialBindingMode,
    /// Fixed history-preserving replacement requirement.
    replacement_mode: RegistrationSessionReplacementMode,
}

impl RegistrationSessionPolicy {
    /// Creates the immutable fail-closed baseline from declared local carriers only.
    pub fn from_baseline(policy_revision: PolicyRevision) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Classifies a candidate against already selected local replay facts without a store read or reservation.
    pub fn classify_replay(
        &self,
        candidate: &RegistrationCandidateFacts,
        current: &CurrentRegistrationFacts,
    ) -> Result<RegistrationReplayDisposition, DomainError>;

    /// Validates one mapped registration candidate using matching local facts and credential qualification.
    pub fn validate_registration(
        &self,
        candidate: &RegistrationCandidateFacts,
        current: &CurrentRegistrationFacts,
        qualification: &CredentialBindingQualification,
        replay: RegistrationReplayDisposition,
    ) -> Result<RegistrationValidationDecision, DomainError>;

    /// Creates a one-use permit for one exact registration transition after matching current facts.
    pub fn guard_registration_mutation(
        &self,
        current: &CurrentRegistrationFacts,
        target_registration: &HostRegistration,
        scope: RegistrationMutationScope,
    ) -> Result<RegistrationMutationPermit, DomainError>;

    /// Guards activation or replacement of one candidate endpoint against selected local endpoint facts.
    pub fn guard_endpoint_mutation(
        &self,
        registration: &AcceptedRegistrationWitness,
        candidate: &HostEndpoint,
        current: &CurrentEndpointFacts,
    ) -> Result<EndpointGuardDecision, DomainError>;

    /// Guards a non-positive endpoint classification without treating unavailable facts as no current endpoint.
    pub fn guard_endpoint_non_positive_mutation(
        &self,
        registration: &AcceptedRegistrationWitness,
        target: &HostEndpoint,
        current: &CurrentEndpointFacts,
    ) -> Result<EndpointNonPositiveGuardDecision, DomainError>;

    /// Guards activation or replacement of one pending Host Session shell against selected local session facts.
    pub fn guard_session_mutation(
        &self,
        registration: &AcceptedRegistrationWitness,
        endpoint: &HostEndpoint,
        candidate: &HostSession,
        current: &CurrentSessionFacts,
    ) -> Result<SessionGuardDecision, DomainError>;

    /// Guards a non-positive Host Session classification without creating a Runtime association witness.
    pub fn guard_session_non_positive_mutation(
        &self,
        registration: &AcceptedRegistrationWitness,
        endpoint: &HostEndpoint,
        target: &HostSession,
        current: &CurrentSessionFacts,
    ) -> Result<SessionNonPositiveGuardDecision, DomainError>;

    /// Classifies whether an incoming generation may mutate the selected local generation scope.
    pub fn guard_generation(
        &self,
        incoming: &HostGeneration,
        selected: &HostGeneration,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns the declared local policy baseline revision.
    pub fn policy_revision(&self) -> &PolicyRevision;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `policy_revision` | `PolicyRevision` | 标识 immutable local guard baseline | declared local baseline / safe rehydrate；不是 Governance approval/policy truth、config version、source version、generation或 Runtime revision。 |
| `uniqueness_scope` | `RegistrationSessionUniquenessScope` | 固定三轴 active uniqueness scope | factory固定 `ProjectMemberHostGeneration`；不可配置化。 |
| `replay_mode` | `RegistrationReplayMode` | 固定 exact replay与non-equivalent处理 | factory固定单一组合 variant；不允许 caller选择 / 转换。 |
| `credential_binding_mode` | `CredentialBindingMode` | 固定 exact instance-bound qualification | factory固定 `InstanceBoundExactScope`；不读取 credential owner / secret。 |
| `replacement_mode` | `RegistrationSessionReplacementMode` | 固定 history-preserving atomic pair requirement | factory固定 `AtomicNewRecordWithHistory`；不持有 UoW/CAS实现。 |

| 函数签名 | 输入与分支 | 输出 / 禁止副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `from_baseline(...)` | `PolicyRevision`必须是已声明 typed carrier；四条 baseline均由 factory固定，`replay_mode` 为单一组合 variant。 | immutable policy；不读 config / L1 / Governance / Member / Runtime / adapter，不产生 policy transmission、authorization、current pointer或 external action。 |
| `classify_replay(...)` | candidate与current的 dual-anchor、host/generation必须结构一致，否则 `DomainError`；`None -> NewInput`；`Accepted`且全部语义字段一致 -> `DuplicateReplay`；same scope但fingerprint/source/credential不同 -> `ReplacementRequired` only when candidate可进入 explicit replacement path，否则 `Conflict`；`Unavailable -> Unavailable`。 | pure；不读取 store、不reserve fingerprint、不生成 id、不写 record/history、不中断或重试外部协作。 |
| `validate_registration(...)` | 先要求 candidate/current/qualification scope和双锚精确相同；qualification `Unknown -> Blocked`、`Invalid -> Reject`；replay `Unavailable -> Blocked`、`Duplicate -> Duplicate`、`Conflict -> Conflict`；`NewInput + Qualified -> AcceptNew`；`ReplacementRequired + Qualified -> AcceptReplacement(plan)`。 | pure decision；不建立 record、不保存/替换 current、不调用 Member / credential / Runtime。`Accept*`仍不代表 commit。 |
| `guard_registration_mutation(...)` | `target_registration`必须与 current 同 host/generation/双锚；`Unavailable`拒绝。`CreateWithoutCurrent`只允许 `Received target + None current`；`CreateReplacementSuccessor`只允许 `Received target + selected Accepted current`；`ReplaceCurrent`只允许 target恰为 selected `Accepted`；`InvalidateCurrent`同样只允许 target恰为 selected `Accepted`；`InvalidateReceivedRecord`允许任何同 scope `Received target`，无论 current 为 `None` 还是另一 selected `Accepted`，因为该 target 从未成为 current。不得由历史 terminal record或外部 closure ref伪造 target。 | one-use permit；permit同时携带 target + selected-current（如有），不实行 CAS / lock / transaction。 |
| `guard_endpoint_mutation(...)` | registration必须与candidate/current同 host/generation/ref，candidate必须 `Candidate + Fresh`；current `None -> Activate`，`Active`同scope -> `Replace` only，`Unavailable -> Blocked`；foreign / stale / invalid candidate -> `Conflict` or `Blocked`。 | policy-only positive decision；不 probe endpoint、不写 endpoint/current/history、不激活 session。 |
| `guard_endpoint_non_positive_mutation(...)` | registration、target和current必须同 host/generation/registration；`Unavailable -> Blocked`，不发 permit。target为同 scope `Candidate` 时发 `ClassifyCandidate(ClassifyCandidate)`，不因另一 selected active endpoint存在而阻塞；target为 selected `Active` 时只发 `ClassifyCurrent(InvalidateCurrent)`；terminal / foreign / mismatched target一律 `Conflict`。 | policy-only non-positive decision；不 probe、不重评 freshness、不写 endpoint/current/history。basis仍须由 bound evaluator / explicit mapper另行给出。 |
| `guard_session_mutation(...)` | registration必须 accepted、endpoint必须 `Active`、candidate必须 `Pending`且三者 scope相同；current `None -> Activate`，`Active`same scope -> `Replace` only，`Unavailable -> Blocked`。 | policy-only positive decision；不 call Runtime / Member、不创造 witness、不写 shell/current/history。 |
| `guard_session_non_positive_mutation(...)` | registration必须 accepted、endpoint必须 `Active`、target与current必须同 scope；`Unavailable -> Blocked`，不发 permit。target为同 scope `Pending` / `Blocked` / `Unknown`时发 `ClassifyExisting`，不因另一 selected active shell存在而阻塞；target恰为 selected `Active`时仅发 `ClassifyCurrent`；terminal / foreign / mismatched target均 `Conflict`。 | policy-only non-positive decision；不 call Runtime / Member、不创造 witness、不写 shell/current/history；basis仍须来自同 scope的 formal mapper / current-fact / causality mapping。 |
| `guard_generation(...)` | only exact equality succeeds；old/new/missing/foreign generation均 `DomainError`供 caller映射 stale/conflict/blocked。 | 不从 source version、timestamp、endpoint或 Runtime ref推导 generation。 |

| fail-closed / 禁止事项 | policy允许的 local outcome | 明确禁止 |
|---|---|---|
| formal Member mapper未闭合 / source或双锚不足 | owning `blocked` / `waiting`；不构造 positive candidate或basis。 | 用 typed ref存在、actor、metadata、cache、route、fake或 receipt伪造可接受输入。 |
| credential contract/witness未闭合 | `CredentialQualificationStatus::Unknown -> Blocked`。 | 默认 qualified、以 credential ref代替 qualification、签发/撤销 credential或读取 secret。 |
| registration/endpoint/session local current facts unavailable | `Blocked`；不得产生 permit / replacement plan。 | 把 unavailable当 `None`、用 query projection/heartbeat/adapter state补 current。 |
| Runtime association exact contract未闭合 | pending shell、blocked / unknown classification；不产生 active witness。 | local Runtime ref、endpoint active、timeout、fake、receipt或 absence-of-error直接 `HostSession::activate`。 |
| non-equivalent/replacement relation | explicit conflict或 future atomic replacement plan。 | overwrite old record、原地改 generation、删除 history、先单侧标 replaced或创建第二 active。 |
| stale/late generation | stale/conflict/blocked path。 | 用 source version、event offset、新 correlation、new fingerprint或 retry跨 generation接管 current。 |
| configuration / external availability change | no positive domain outcome；当前 baseline不可变。 | 放宽 uniqueness、credential binding、replacement atomicity或 `MSVC-UP-*` blocker。 |

### 9.10.8 CMP-MS-04 对象组停审、字段来源、状态闭环与 Step 7 承接

#### 对象组停审

| 审查项 | 结论 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| frozen object denominator | pass | 四个冻结对象 `HostRegistration`、`HostEndpoint`、`HostSession`、`RegistrationSessionPolicy`均有独立对象卡；candidate、facts、reason、witness、decision为各自 domain file 的 support value，三轴 permit / replacement plan 由 `registration.rs` policy file 唯一持有并供 endpoint/session 消费，未新增第 30 个业务对象。 |
| capability -> object coverage | pass | `CAP-MS-13`由 registration + policy承担；`CAP-MS-14`由 endpoint + policy guard承担；`CAP-MS-15`由 Host Session + Runtime witness/guard承担；`CAP-MS-16`由 replay/permit/replacement/invalidation规则跨四对象承接。 |
| unique module/file owner | pass | registration/policy仅 `domain::registration`；endpoint及其 currentness仅 `domain::endpoint`；session及其 Runtime witness/currentness仅 `domain::session`；id/ref/fingerprint/revision和safe external wrapper仍只由 contracts拥有。 |
| local/current/atomicity separation | pass_with_upstream_blockers | 三轴 permit均已显式绑定 target record和selected-current（如有）；non-positive candidate/current 和 shell/current路径均只能由 named policy guard签发。registration、endpoint、session仍要求 future local store/UoW/CAS 才能证明 current pointer与single-active的原子性，未伪造 DB lock/transaction。 |
| state-axis isolation | pass | registration accepted、endpoint active、session active严格分轴；任何一轴都不自动改变另一轴、host lifecycle、readiness、health、Sandbox、Member或 Runtime run truth。 |
| registration semantics | pass | `Accepted`严格限定为 local acceptance；`Blocked` / `Conflict` / `Duplicate`只作 policy/application/entry disposition，不污染 registration lifecycle enum。 |
| endpoint redaction / freshness | pass_with_upstream_blockers | endpoint只保存 `HostSafeEndpointRef` + already-evaluated `FreshnessAssessment`；无 raw transport、probe或 health truth。未定义的 endpoint mapper/freshness evidence保持 non-positive。 |

## 9.11 `domain / CMP-MS-05 / health_signal.rs, health.rs, recovery.rs` 对象契约

### 9.11.1 本对象组写入边界、唯一 owner 与概要归一

本批只闭合冻结业务对象 `HealthSignalSnapshot`、`HostHealthAssessment`、`HostFailureClassification`、`HostRecoveryDecision`，以及令四者可逐项落码的 domain-only source metadata、ordered basis、four-axis evaluation、failure taxonomy、formal recovery context、prerequisite、plan 与 one-way eligibility value。它不新建 health manager、heartbeat record、observability record、Runtime recovery record、backend health record、recovery policy aggregate、sandbox result、event envelope、repository、UoW、entry、adapter 或实现源码。

| 项 | 本批收口结论 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| `health_signal.rs` 唯一 owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::health_signal` / `crates/domain/src/health_signal.rs` 独占 `HealthSignalSnapshot`、signal source metadata、opaque order marker、capture candidate、intake status / reason 与仅供本文件使用的 comparison support value。 | 不在 worker、application、adapter、fake、Member、Runtime、Sandbox 或 observability 层另存 health snapshot、source order、dedup / late judgement 或 raw heartbeat。 |
| `health.rs` 唯一 owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::health` / `crates/domain/src/health.rs` 独占 `HostHealthAssessment`、assessment basis set、four-axis value、assessment record status、failure basis、failure taxonomy / certainty / reason 及 `HostFailureClassification`。 | 不把 four axes 迁入 `HostSession`、projection、backend adapter 或 public view；不以 external monitoring result 成为第二健康写源。 |
| `recovery.rs` 唯一 owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::recovery` / `crates/domain/src/recovery.rs` 独占 `HostRecoveryDecision`、`HostRecoveryAction`、recovery decision status / reason、formal recovery context、prerequisite set、plan 与 Runtime-recovery eligibility fence。 | 不在 CMP-MS-01 control、CMP-MS-03 attempt、CMP-MS-06 closure、entry、Job 或 Query 中 shadow recovery decision / action / commit guard。 |
| frozen object denominator | 本对象组恰有四个冻结业务对象；source metadata、order marker、basis set、axis value、classification input、control context、prerequisite、plan、reason 与 eligibility witness 都是 domain support value，不新增第 30 个业务对象。 | 不以“health policy”“recovery manager”“signal receipt”“backend incident”增加主语，或把 support value 当作可独立持久化 truth。 |
| contracts import ceiling | 只导入 contracts-owned `HealthSignalSnapshotId/Ref`、`HostHealthAssessmentId/Ref`、`HostFailureClassificationId/Ref`、`HostRecoveryDecisionId/Ref`、`HostRef`、`HostGeneration`、`HostSessionRef`、`HostIntentRef`、`HostIntentSourceRef`、双锚 `HostControlScopeRef`、`HostHealthSignalSourceRef`、`HostHealthSignalSafeSummary`、`HostExternalSourceVersionRef`、`HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt`、`FreshnessAssessment`、`HostRedactedCode`、`CorrelationId`、Core `Timestamp`，以及已闭合的 local attempt / association / readiness / decision refs。 | 不重新定义 local id/ref、以裸 `String` 替代 typed ref、把 repository version / cursor / source version / sequence 误作 `HealthAssessmentRevision`，或把 public `HostSafe*` enum 当 domain truth。 |
| control-plane 与 health 分离 | signal / assessment / failure 都是 facts；只有 `DecideHostRecoveryCommand` 所映射的正式 control context 才可形成 recovery proposal，且只有 committed decision 才是下游 local action / closure 的候选因果。 | Consumer / health Job、Query、signal、backend alert、timeout、receipt、adapter error 或 fake 不能创建、commit、supersede 或 void recovery decision。 |
| external truth ceiling | Member、Runtime、Sandbox、carrier、Core / Bus signal envelope的 exact schema仍由 `MSVC-UP-001/002/004/007` 挂起；source ref / safe summary / local classification 只允许 body-free consumption。 | 不保存 heartbeat、status report、log、dump、checkpoint、Runtime run、tool outcome、Sandbox policy / backend state、observability event body或 route。 |

概要层 placeholder 只按本批已有 carrier / domain support value归一；归一不关闭任一 sibling exact contract：

| 概要 placeholder / 旧名 | 本批唯一可用表达 | 当前语义上限 |
|---|---|---|
| `HealthSignalSourceKind` / `SignalSourceRefPlaceholder` | `HostHealthSignalSourceRef` + `HealthSignalSourceMetadata` | typed safe source ref与已映射 inbound metadata；不定义 producer、envelope、route、body或 source owner truth。 |
| `ExternalMessageId` / `ExternalIdempotencyKey` | contracts `HostInboundConsumerMetadataPlaceholder` 内的 opaque message / replay input | 仅 local matching input；不代表 source accepted、broker receipt、event order或 local snapshot committed。 |
| `OptionalSignalSequence` | domain-only `Option<HealthSignalOrderMarker>` | 仅保留 formal mapper 已给出的 opaque ordering marker；缺 marker时不能伪造 accepted order。具体 source sequence schema继续 pending。 |
| `ExternalObservedAt` / source captured time | `HostInboundTimeAnchor` 与 `HostHealthSignalSafeSummary` 内的 optional `HostExternalSummaryCapturedAt` | source time与本地 record time分离；不将任一时间当 currentness、store commit或 observability truth。 |
| `HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet` / `HostFactRefSet` | domain-only `HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet` | ordered local refs only；不含 raw snapshot、repository row、adapter result或 external body。 |
| `OptionalFailureClassificationRef` | `Option<HostFailureClassificationRef>` | optional local causal link；ref 不证明 confirmed、current、permitted或 action executed。 |
| `FormalControlSourceRef` / `RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet` | domain-only `FormalRecoveryContext` + `RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet` | only mapped local control / prerequisite witnesses; no governance approval、authorization body、Runtime eligibility或 current-pointer schema。 |

### 9.11.2 CMP-MS-05 capability / 功能到对象映射

| capability / 功能 | 输入 | 输出 / 本地副作用 | domain 对象或 support value | 后续 Step 承接 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CAP-MS-17`：body-free health signal capture / classification | formal mapper 已给出的 typed source、inbound identity / time、host / generation / optional Host Session、safe summary、opaque order marker、freshness classification和selected comparison facts | 一个 immutable snapshot，分类为 `Accepted` / `Duplicate` / `Late` / `Stale` / `Conflict` / `Rejected`；非 accepted 可留 history，但不写 current assessment | `HealthSignalSnapshot`、`HealthSignalCaptureCandidate`、`HealthSignalSourceMetadata`、`HealthSignalOrderMarker`、`HealthSignalIntakeStatus` | Step 7 signal mapper / snapshot store；Step 8 `IB-MS-010` consumer schema；Step 9 intake flow；Step 13 dedup / late fence。 |
| `CAP-MS-18`：four-axis host-health assessment | accepted matching snapshots、same-generation committed local host / session / attempt / association facts、selected prior assessment、application time | new immutable assessment id and strictly successor revision; four independent axes; prior current record may be marked superseded / invalidated in a future paired UoW | `HostHealthAssessment`、`HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet`、four axis value、`HealthAssessmentEvaluation`、`HealthAssessmentRecordStatus` | Step 7 current-fact / assessment store / UoW；Step 8 `IB-MS-011` safe read；Step 9 health Job；Step 10 matrix；Step 11/13 CAS / replacement pairing。 |
| `CAP-MS-19`：host-side failure classification | selected matching assessment、allowed local attempt / association / snapshot refs、taxonomy evaluation、new confirmation / uncertainty / withdrawal basis | candidate / confirmed / unknown local classification or a history-preserving supersede / withdraw transition; no external failure truth | `HostFailureClassification`、`FailureBasisRefSet`、layer / category / impact / certainty / status support value | Step 7 failure basis reader / store；Step 8 safe health result；Step 9 health evaluation flow；Step 12 error / uncertainty mapping。 |
| `CAP-MS-20`：explicit recovery decision | `DecideHostRecoveryCommand`-only formal context、current matching health / optional failure fact、current generation / prerequisite selection、redacted local plan | proposed / committed / superseded / voided local decision; committed ref may later be wrapped for a narrowly permitted host action or closure path | `HostRecoveryDecision`、`FormalRecoveryContext`、`RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet`、`RecoveryDecisionPlan`、`RuntimeRecoveryEligibility` | Step 7 formal context / recovery store / UoW；Step 8 `IB-MS-012`; Step 9 command flow; Step 11/13 replacement / idempotency。 |
| safe read basis | selected committed local assessment / failure / recovery records and visibility / freshness result independently selected by application | only the four public-safe classifications already owned by contracts `HostSafeHealthSummary`; no read-side mutation | narrow object accessors and contracts `HostSafe*` mappers | Step 7 read port; Step 8 query schema; Step 9 no-write query flow。 |

`IB-MS-010` 是 inbound Consumer，`EvaluateDueHostHealthJob` 只形成 assessment / failure facts，`IB-MS-012` 才是 formal recovery Command，`IB-MS-011` 是 no-write Query。因而 snapshot `Accepted`、assessment `Current`、failure `Confirmed` 和 recovery `Committed` 不构成同一状态轴，也不能相互跳转。

### 9.11.3 CMP-MS-05 对象能力到字段 / factory / 函数 / state 映射

| 对象 | 对象能力 | 必需字段 | factory / 构造入口 | 成员函数 | state / classification | 字段来源 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HealthSignalSnapshot` | 固定一次已映射 signal 的 local scope、safe source / summary、order / freshness judgement与 intake disposition | local id；host / generation；optional session；typed source；inbound metadata / optional marker；safe summary；freshness；intake status；correlation；local record time | `capture(...)`；`rehydrate(...)` | `matches_host_generation`、`is_eligible_for_assessment`、`to_ref`、accessors | immutable `Accepted/Duplicate/Late/Stale/Conflict/Rejected` classification | id由application generator / rehydrate；all external-safe input only from formal mapper / safe persistence；freshness from bound evaluator；status from same-scope comparison; time from application clock。 |
| `HostHealthAssessment` | 以一个 new id / successor revision 固定 same-generation four-axis assessment，并保留 supersede / invalidation chain而不覆写 factual axes | local id；host / generation；basis refs；four axes；semantic revision；optional prior ref；record status；local time | `assess(...)`；`rehydrate(...)` | `supersede`、`invalidate`、`is_current_for`、`has_uncertainty`、`to_ref` | `Current/Superseded/Invalidated` plus four independent axis enums | id / time from application; basis and axis values from named current-fact reader + domain evaluator; revision only from `HealthAssessmentRevision`; status transition only with matched local replacement / invalidation basis。 |
| `HostFailureClassification` | 把 host-side anomaly限定为 layer / category / impact / certainty，并按 local evidence推进 candidate / confirmed / unknown / terminal history | local id；host / generation；assessment ref；taxonomy; canonical basis; record status; prior / replacement relation；local times | `classify(...)`；`rehydrate(...)` | `confirm`、`mark_unknown`、`withdraw`、`supersede`、`applies_to`、`to_ref` | `Candidate/Confirmed/Superseded/Withdrawn/Unknown`; certainty is distinct from record status | id / time from application; assessment / local basis from committed reader; category / impact / certainty only from domain classifier; reason only redaction mapper / rehydrate。 |
| `HostRecoveryDecision` | 在 explicit formal control context中基于 current health / optional failure / prerequisites提出、提交、替代或作废本仓处置 | local id；双锚 host / generation；assessment / optional failure refs；control source / scope; action; prerequisite refs; status; supersedes relation; optional void reason; correlation; local times | `propose(...)`；`rehydrate(...)` | `commit`、`supersede`、`void`、`permits`、`targets`、`requires_new_generation`、accessors、`to_ref` | `Proposed/Committed/Superseded/Voided`; action `Recover/Restart/Stop/Terminate/Hold` is independent | id / time from application; formal context only command mapper / port + loaded accepted intent; health / failure / prior decision / current facts from committed readers; plan / reason from recovery domain guard; no signal / job / query source。 |

所有 factory 只建立本地 domain object / support value，不能证明 snapshot 已存储、assessment 已成为 current、failure 已确认、decision 已进入 UoW、action 已准备 / 发出 / 完成。任一 mapper、current-fact、redaction、time、basis 或 future CAS witness缺失时，调用方必须停在 owning `rejected` / `blocked` / `waiting` / `unknown` / `gap` surface，不能补默认值。

### 9.11.4 `health_signal.rs`：source metadata、intake classification 与 `HealthSignalSnapshot`

#### `HealthSignalSourceMetadata`、`HealthSignalOrderMarker` 与 `HealthSignalCaptureCandidate`

```rust
/// Carries body-free inbound metadata for one mapped health signal without becoming an external envelope.
pub struct HealthSignalSourceMetadata {
    /// Validated inbound identity and source/local time anchors.
    inbound_metadata: HostInboundConsumerMetadataPlaceholder,
    /// Optional opaque ordering marker supplied only by the formal source mapper.
    order_marker: Option<HealthSignalOrderMarker>,
}

/// Preserves one opaque source-order marker without defining the producer sequence schema.
pub struct HealthSignalOrderMarker(String);

/// Carries one completely mapped, body-free candidate for local signal capture.
pub struct HealthSignalCaptureCandidate {
    /// Locally selected host for the signal.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation selected with the host.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Optional local host-session shell correlated by the mapped signal.
    host_session_ref: Option<HostSessionRef>,
    /// Typed safe source reference without envelope or heartbeat body.
    source_ref: HostHealthSignalSourceRef,
    /// Inbound identity, time, and optional mapped order metadata.
    source_metadata: HealthSignalSourceMetadata,
    /// Typed safe signal summary; it is the sole retained carrier for optional source version and captured time.
    safe_summary: HostHealthSignalSafeSummary,
    /// Already evaluated freshness classification; this object does not calculate thresholds.
    freshness: FreshnessAssessment,
    /// Local causal correlation carried from validated consumer metadata.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

impl HealthSignalOrderMarker {
    /// Creates an opaque marker only from a formal mapped ordering value.
    pub(crate) fn from_formal_mapping(value: String) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a stored opaque marker without reordering or contacting the source owner.
    pub(crate) fn from_persisted(value: String) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the opaque marker only for same-source local comparison.
    pub(crate) fn as_str(&self) -> &str;
}

impl HealthSignalSourceMetadata {
    /// Combines validated inbound metadata with an optional formal ordering marker.
    pub(crate) fn from_mapped_input(
        inbound_metadata: HostInboundConsumerMetadataPlaceholder,
        order_marker: Option<HealthSignalOrderMarker>,
    ) -> Self;
}

impl HealthSignalCaptureCandidate {
    /// Creates a candidate after the source mapper has supplied every body-free required field.
    pub(crate) fn from_mapped_input(
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        host_session_ref: Option<HostSessionRef>,
        source_ref: HostHealthSignalSourceRef,
        source_metadata: HealthSignalSourceMetadata,
        safe_summary: HostHealthSignalSafeSummary,
        freshness: FreshnessAssessment,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}
```

| support value / 字段 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|
| `HealthSignalSourceMetadata.inbound_metadata` | 保留已验证 message identity、replay anchor以及 source/local time分层 | only contracts `HostInboundConsumerMetadataPlaceholder` from future formal Consumer mapper or safe rehydrate；它不是 envelope、broker offset、receipt或 acceptance proof。 |
| `HealthSignalSourceMetadata.order_marker` | 让同一 formal source 可在 local comparison中保留其 opaque order anchor | only formal mapper or safe rehydrate；无 marker不以 source version、timestamp、correlation、message id、offset、local id或 clock补造。marker不定义 source sequence numeric semantics。 |
| `HealthSignalOrderMarker` | source-order 的 opaque identity carrier | private string must be non-empty; only equality comparison is allowed. It is not `HostExternalSourceVersionRef`、message id、repository expected version、cursor或 a sortable sequence number. |
| `source_ref` + `safe_summary` | 形成类型化 source / summary pair | source ref only `HostHealthSignalSourceRef`; safe summary only `HostHealthSignalSafeSummary`. Its nested optional source version / captured time remain owner-supplied and must not be duplicated or rebuilt from local data. |
| `freshness` | 记录已绑定 evaluator给出的 fresh / stale / unknown classification | only `FreshnessAssessment`; no threshold, duration, local-clock or observer implementation belongs here. `Fresh` does not itself prove order, acceptance or health. |
| `host_ref` + `generation` + optional `host_session_ref` | 固定本仓 consumption scope | formal mapper must bind them in one input; an optional Host Session ref is correlation only, not proof of active session / Runtime association / currentness. |
| `correlation_id` | 保留 local causal linkage | must equal the validated inbound replay correlation carried by metadata; it is not message identity, order marker, source version or idempotency reservation. |

`HealthSignalCaptureCandidate` 的 fresh construction only accepts a formal mapper result. 若 `MSVC-UP-001/002/004/007` 未给出 exact envelope、message / source mapping或明确 order semantics，future entry must remain `rejected` / `blocked` / `gap` and cannot construct an `Accepted` intake path. This restriction does not forbid preserving a structurally valid non-positive local record when the owner-safe mapper already supplied its bounded fields.

#### `HealthSignalIntakeStatus` 与 `HealthSignalReasonCode`

```rust
/// Carries a redacted local reason for one non-positive health-signal intake classification.
pub struct HealthSignalReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

/// Classifies one immutable local health-signal intake result without asserting health or execution truth.
pub enum HealthSignalIntakeStatus {
    /// The mapped signal is same-generation, fresh, and formally comparable for assessment input.
    Accepted,
    /// A same-source equivalent signal already has one retained local snapshot.
    Duplicate {
        /// Existing local snapshot used only as an equivalence anchor.
        matching_snapshot_ref: HealthSignalSnapshotRef,
    },
    /// A valid historic signal cannot affect the selected current assessment.
    Late {
        /// Historic local snapshot that anchors the late classification.
        history_snapshot_ref: HealthSignalSnapshotRef,
    },
    /// The mapped signal is outside the bound freshness classification.
    Stale {
        /// Redacted local reason for the stale classification.
        reason_code: HealthSignalReasonCode,
    },
    /// Source, generation, order marker, or safe-summary facts conflict locally.
    Conflict {
        /// Redacted local reason for the conflict classification.
        reason_code: HealthSignalReasonCode,
    },
    /// The mapped input cannot enter the local signal boundary.
    Rejected {
        /// Redacted local reason for the rejection classification.
        reason_code: HealthSignalReasonCode,
    },
}

impl HealthSignalReasonCode {
    /// Creates a signal reason from an already redacted local intake classification.
    pub(crate) fn from_intake_classification(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted redacted signal reason without reclassifying the source.
    pub(crate) fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the redacted code for local safe mapping only.
    pub(crate) fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| status / reason | Rustdoc semantic | 允许来源 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Accepted` | `The mapped signal is same-generation, fresh, and formally comparable for assessment input.` | only same-scope formal mapper + named local comparison / freshness evaluation; under unresolved source contract it has no callable positive mapper. | `HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet` only after same-generation current-fact selection; history / safe mapper. It never means healthy. |
| `Duplicate { matching_snapshot_ref }` | `A same-source equivalent signal already has one retained local snapshot.` | comparison against one committed local snapshot with exact source / host / generation / opaque marker equivalence. | history / duplicate disposition; never new assessment, current overwrite, recovery or external receipt. |
| `Late { history_snapshot_ref }` | `A valid historic signal cannot affect the selected current assessment.` | known historical generation or local evaluation-window comparison with a retained matching historic snapshot. | history / reconciliation diagnostic only; never current assessment / failure confirmation / recovery. |
| `Stale { reason_code }` | `The mapped signal is outside the bound freshness classification.` | bound freshness evaluator output with `Stale`; no local time fallback. | history / uncertainty basis only; never accepted assessment basis. |
| `Conflict { reason_code }` | `Source, generation, order marker, or safe-summary facts conflict locally.` | typed comparison detects incompatible same-source facts. | history / gap / reconciliation; never automatic winner selection. |
| `Rejected { reason_code }` | `The mapped input cannot enter the local signal boundary.` | forbidden body, missing formal mapping, invalid scope, unavailable order proof, or explicit source-boundary rejection. | body-free local disposition / history only; never assessment, health state or decision. |
| `HealthSignalReasonCode` | redacted local classification reason | redaction mapper or safe persisted rehydrate only. | matching non-positive status and later safe mapper; never raw heartbeat, log, dump, report, checkpoint, adapter error or transport status. |

#### `HealthSignalSnapshot` 对象契约

##### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HealthSignalSnapshot`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 16 个，表示一次 body-free、generation-bound 的本地 signal intake record。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::health_signal` / `crates/domain/src/health_signal.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-17`、`IB-MS-010`、`EX-MS-011/014/025/026`；承接 signal scope / source / summary / order / freshness classification，而不是 health conclusion。 |
| 主要责任 | 固定 mapped source、host / generation / optional session、inbound metadata、opaque order marker、safe summary、freshness和不可变 intake classification，使 duplicate / late / stale / conflict / rejected可保留为本地历史却不能逆写 current health assessment。 |
| 不拥有 | Member heartbeat/status、Runtime session/run/progress、Sandbox binding/backend/policy、carrier truth、observability event、raw message/envelope、consumer receipt、store dedup reservation、assessment / failure / recovery decision、history/outbox/public DTO。 |

##### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one immutable body-free health-signal intake classification for one host generation.
pub struct HealthSignalSnapshot {
    /// Stable locally owned snapshot identity.
    snapshot_id: HealthSignalSnapshotId,
    /// Logical host selected by the formal mapper.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation selected with the host.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Optional local host-session shell correlated by the signal.
    host_session_ref: Option<HostSessionRef>,
    /// Typed safe source reference without external source body.
    source_ref: HostHealthSignalSourceRef,
    /// Validated inbound identity, time anchors, and optional opaque order marker.
    source_metadata: HealthSignalSourceMetadata,
    /// Body-free summary retaining only allowed owner-supplied source version and captured time.
    safe_summary: HostHealthSignalSafeSummary,
    /// Bound freshness classification retained without threshold policy.
    freshness: FreshnessAssessment,
    /// Immutable local intake classification.
    intake_status: HealthSignalIntakeStatus,
    /// Local causal correlation for assessment and history matching.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// Local time at which this immutable snapshot record was formed.
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HealthSignalSnapshot {
    /// Captures one classified body-free signal without accepting an external envelope.
    pub fn capture(
        snapshot_id: HealthSignalSnapshotId,
        candidate: HealthSignalCaptureCandidate,
        intake_status: HealthSignalIntakeStatus,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates one persisted snapshot without replaying, ordering, or contacting the source owner.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        snapshot_id: HealthSignalSnapshotId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        host_session_ref: Option<HostSessionRef>,
        source_ref: HostHealthSignalSourceRef,
        source_metadata: HealthSignalSourceMetadata,
        safe_summary: HostHealthSignalSafeSummary,
        freshness: FreshnessAssessment,
        intake_status: HealthSignalIntakeStatus,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this snapshot can be selected as one assessment basis for the exact host generation.
    pub fn is_eligible_for_assessment(
        &self,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this snapshot belongs to one exact local host generation.
    pub fn matches_host_generation(
        &self,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local snapshot reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HealthSignalSnapshotRef;

    /// Returns the immutable local intake classification.
    pub fn intake_status(&self) -> &HealthSignalIntakeStatus;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `snapshot_id` | `HealthSignalSnapshotId` | 定位一个本地 immutable snapshot record | application id generator / local snapshot-store rehydrate；不得由 message id、source ref、order marker、version、host/generation、time或 correlation拼接。 |
| `host_ref` + `generation` | `HostRef` + `HostGeneration` | 锁定 signal 可被消费的 local host instance | same formal mapper input；generation不从 source version、order marker、source timestamp、session ref或 broker offset推断。 |
| `host_session_ref` | `Option<HostSessionRef>` | 只关联可能相关的 local Host Session shell | formal mapper / safe rehydrate；`Some` 必须由 future same-scope reader验证，且不证明 shell active、Runtime associated / running或 signal current。 |
| `source_ref` | `HostHealthSignalSourceRef` | 回链 allowed external source | formal mapper / safe persistence；没有 envelope / source body、heartbeat、status report、log、checkpoint或 observability event。 |
| `source_metadata` | `HealthSignalSourceMetadata` | 保留 local matching所需的 inbound identity / time / opaque order marker | formal Consumer mapper / safe rehydrate；order marker缺失不能以任何 local value补齐，也不使 inbound metadata变成 exact envelope。 |
| `safe_summary` | `HostHealthSignalSafeSummary` | 只保存 health judgment允许的 summary，并作为 optional source version / captured time唯一 carrier | formal redaction / source mapper or safe rehydrate；summary / version / time存在不表示 owner truth、freshness、order、message acceptance或 health。 |
| `freshness` | `FreshnessAssessment` | 记录已求值的 freshness classification | bound evaluator output / safe rehydrate；`Accepted` 必须 `Fresh`，`Stale` status必须 `Stale`；`Unknown` 不能被 local clock变为 Fresh。 |
| `intake_status` | `HealthSignalIntakeStatus` | 固化 acceptance / non-positive classification | `capture` only accepts a same-candidate classification; no later mutator. `Duplicate/Late` link必须 non-self，`Accepted`不带 linked ref/reason，non-positive variant遵守其载荷结构。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 与 assessment / history本地因果关联 | must match validated inbound metadata correlation; not a message id、sequence、source version、idempotency reservation或 effect key。 |
| `recorded_at` | `Timestamp` | record形成的本地时间 | application clock output / safe rehydrate；不是 source captured / observed time、assessment time、store commit time或 external completion time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `capture(...) -> Result<HealthSignalSnapshot, DomainError>` | 建立一个 immutable local snapshot | candidate必须完整且 source / summary / metadata correlation coherent；status必须符合 freshness、scope和linked-ref shape。无 I/O、envelope parse、dedup reservation、store write、assessment / failure / recovery creation。 |
| `rehydrate(...) -> Result<HealthSignalSnapshot, DomainError>` | 重建已保存 snapshot | 验证 status载荷、non-self link、freshness/status组合和correlation一致性；不重新比较 order、不刷新 source、不将历史 record升为 Accepted。 |
| `is_eligible_for_assessment(...) -> bool` | 给 health evaluator提供窄判断 | only `Accepted && freshness.is_fresh() && exact host/generation` returns true；不选择 current assessment、不评价 four axes、不代表 healthy。 |
| `matches_host_generation(...) -> bool` | 检查 scope | pure typed equality；不读取 session、source、store或 current pointer。 |
| `to_ref()` / `intake_status()` | 最小 local read surface | pure；ref/status均不证明 record已提交、source current、assessment current、failure confirmed或 recovery committed。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| immutable intake fact | snapshot没有 `accept`、`reclassify`、`refresh` 或 `overwrite_summary` mutator。新信号、new mapper result或重复判断必须新建 record；existing record不改 source、summary、order marker、freshness、status或 time。 |
| accepted is deliberately narrow | `Accepted` 只说明本仓 local evaluator允许该 snapshot作为 future same-generation assessment input；不表示 host / session / backend healthy、Runtime progress、business success、action outcome或 recovery authorization。 |
| old / duplicate / late never reverse current | old-generation signal只在有 retained historic anchor时成为 `Late`，否则 `Rejected` / `Conflict`；`Duplicate`、`Late`、`Stale`、`Conflict`、`Rejected`可进入历史但绝不形成或覆盖 current assessment、confirmed failure或 recovery decision。 |
| no source-body capture | raw heartbeat、status report、logs、dump、checkpoint、request / callback body、route、broker offset、credential、Runtime / Sandbox / carrier / observability body均不得进入字段、reason或 linked ref。 |
| no inferred order | message time、source version、correlation、local id、receipt、cache、timeout、adapter availability、fake counter与absence-of-error都不替代 formal order marker / comparison facts。 |
| current external blockers remain effective | `MSVC-UP-001/002/004/007` 未关闭时，future actual positive mapper remains blocked; this object card only defines local shape and fail-closed non-positive preservation, not an interoperable signal contract. |

### 9.11.5 `health.rs`：assessment basis、四轴、记录状态与 `HostHealthAssessment`

#### `HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet`、current-fact selection 与四轴 evaluation

`HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet` 只保留已经由本仓 local reader 选中的、body-free 的本地因果锚。它不是 snapshot body、repository row、adapter result、event envelope、projection、Runtime run、backend health report 或 Observability record。集合内出现一个 ref 也不证明该 ref 当前、已提交、健康、失败或允许 recovery；这些判断仍分别由对象状态、future current-fact reader 和 application UoW 给出。

```rust
/// References one committed local fact retained as causal basis for a four-axis health assessment.
pub enum HealthAssessmentBasisRef {
    /// Anchors the exact logical host and generation selected for this assessment.
    HostScope {
        /// Locally owned logical host selected by the committed reader.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Immutable host generation paired with the selected host.
        generation: HostGeneration,
    },
    /// Retains one accepted local signal snapshot without carrying its source body.
    AcceptedSnapshot(HealthSignalSnapshotRef),
    /// Retains one matching local Host Session shell reference.
    HostSession(HostSessionRef),
    /// Retains one matching local host-side action attempt reference.
    ActionAttempt(HostActionAttemptRef),
    /// Retains one matching local host-to-external association reference.
    Association(HostExternalAssociationRef),
}

/// Stores a canonical ordered unique body-free basis set for one health assessment.
pub struct HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet(Vec<HealthAssessmentBasisRef>);

/// Describes the selected current-assessment relation without exposing a store row or CAS token.
pub enum CurrentHealthAssessmentFacts {
    /// No current assessment is committed for the selected host generation.
    NoCurrent {
        /// Host selected by the completed local current-fact read.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Generation selected with the host.
        generation: HostGeneration,
    },
    /// One current assessment is committed for the selected host generation.
    Current {
        /// Host selected by the completed local current-fact read.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Generation selected with the host.
        generation: HostGeneration,
        /// Existing current assessment that the new immutable record may replace.
        assessment_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
        /// Semantic revision retained by the selected current assessment.
        assessment_revision: HealthAssessmentRevision,
    },
    /// The local reader cannot safely select the current-assessment relation.
    Unavailable {
        /// Host requested from the failed or unavailable local read.
        host_ref: HostRef,
        /// Generation requested from the failed or unavailable local read.
        generation: HostGeneration,
    },
}

/// Carries the four independent local classifications selected for one health assessment.
pub struct HealthAssessmentAxes {
    /// Local logical-host health classification.
    host_axis: HostHealthAxisValue,
    /// Local Host Session shell health classification.
    session_axis: SessionHealthAxisValue,
    /// Local association usability classification without backend truth.
    backend_axis: BackendHealthAxisValue,
    /// Evidence completeness, freshness, conflict, or uncertainty classification.
    uncertainty_axis: HealthUncertaintyValue,
}

/// Carries one fully selected, same-generation assessment evaluation before it becomes local truth.
pub struct HealthAssessmentEvaluation {
    /// Logical host selected for the evaluation.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable generation selected with the host.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Canonical local causal basis for the evaluation.
    basis_refs: HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet,
    /// Four independent classifications selected from local facts only.
    axes: HealthAssessmentAxes,
    /// New immutable assessment-series revision.
    assessment_revision: HealthAssessmentRevision,
    /// Selected current assessment that this new record will supersede, when one exists.
    prior_assessment_ref: Option<HostHealthAssessmentRef>,
    /// Local time at which the evaluation was formed.
    assessed_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet {
    /// Creates a canonical basis set without sorting, deduplicating, or selecting a winning fact.
    pub fn try_new(values: Vec<HealthAssessmentBasisRef>) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the canonical local basis without permitting mutation.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[HealthAssessmentBasisRef];
}

impl HealthAssessmentAxes {
    /// Groups four independently selected local classifications without evaluating an external owner.
    pub fn from_local_classifications(
        host_axis: HostHealthAxisValue,
        session_axis: SessionHealthAxisValue,
        backend_axis: BackendHealthAxisValue,
        uncertainty_axis: HealthUncertaintyValue,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

impl HealthAssessmentEvaluation {
    /// Creates an assessment evaluation from selected committed local facts and typed axis classifications.
    pub fn from_selected_local_facts(
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
```
