```rust
        basis_refs: HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet,
        axes: HealthAssessmentAxes,
        current_facts: CurrentHealthAssessmentFacts,
        assessed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the exact host-generation pair selected by the evaluation.
    pub fn target(&self) -> (&HostRef, &HostGeneration);

    /// Returns the revision selected from the local assessment series.
    pub fn assessment_revision(&self) -> &HealthAssessmentRevision;
}
```

| support value / variant | 作用 | 来源、排序与不变量 |
|---|---|---|
| `HostScope { host_ref, generation }` | 将 assessment basis 锁到一个已选 local host instance | 每个 set 必须**恰有一个**，且必须与 `HealthAssessmentEvaluation` / `HostHealthAssessment` 的 pair 精确相等；不能由 source version、message、session、association、projection 或 backend resource 补造。 |
| `AcceptedSnapshot` | 保留实际被允许进入评估的一条 snapshot 因果 | 只可来自 loaded `HealthSignalSnapshot` 且其 `is_eligible_for_assessment(...)` 已对同一 pair 返回 true；`Duplicate`、`Late`、`Stale`、`Conflict`、`Rejected` snapshot ref 不得写入。 |
| `HostSession` / `ActionAttempt` / `Association` | 记录 health evaluator 实际消费的本地 shell / attempt / association 因果 | future reader 必须先证明 ref 与 selected host/generation 相符；ref 不携带或证明 Runtime run、external action、backend resource / policy、cleanup 或 owner outcome。 |
| canonical order | 防止不同 arrival / query order 产生不同 assessment basis | order 固定为 `HostScope -> AcceptedSnapshot -> HostSession -> ActionAttempt -> Association`，同 variant 按该 local ref 的 opaque persisted identity 升序。空、重复、非 canonical、缺 HostScope 或多 HostScope 均为 `DomainError`；不得自动排序、去重、补 default 或按 broker/time order 选择。 |
| `NoCurrent` | 允许该 host-generation 的首个 assessment 形成 `HealthAssessmentRevision::initial()` | 完成的 local reader 只能明确返回同一 pair 的 no-current；不能由 cache miss、projection、timeout、adapter error、fake map 或 absence-of-error 构造。 |
| `Current` | 提供 replacement chain 的 selected current host/generation、ref / revision | `host_ref + generation` 必须与 evaluation target 精确相等；new evaluation 必须使用 `HealthAssessmentRevision::next_after(...)` 的严格后继，并令 `prior_assessment_ref=Some(assessment_ref)`；它不是 repository expected version 或 commit witness。 |
| `Unavailable` | 保留当前 relation 无法安全读取 | `from_selected_local_facts(...)` 必须拒绝形成 evaluation；application 只能停在 blocked / unknown / gap，不得将 unavailable 当 no-current。 |
| `HealthAssessmentAxes` | 使 application 不能以一个 boolean / public view 随意拼装四轴 | 仅接受同一 selected local facts 的 typed classification；`NoKnownUncertainty` 时三个 health axis 都不得为 `Unknown`。这一结构检查不读取 Runtime、Member、Sandbox、carrier、backend 或 Observability truth。 |
| `HealthAssessmentEvaluation` | 将 selection 与 immutable object factory 分离 | 仅在 same host/generation、canonical basis、current facts与轴组合完整时形成；它不是 persistent record、current pointer、UoW permit、protocol DTO或 job result。 |

```rust
/// Classifies the local health of the logical host axis without representing an external runtime or business result.
pub enum HostHealthAxisValue {
    /// Local host facts support a healthy classification for this axis.
    Healthy,
    /// Local host facts show a non-terminal degradation for this axis.
    Degraded,
    /// Local host facts show an unhealthy condition for this axis.
    Unhealthy,
    /// Local host facts cannot classify this axis reliably.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies the local health of the Host Session shell without representing a Runtime session or run.
pub enum SessionHealthAxisValue {
    /// The selected local Host Session shell is usable for this assessment axis.
    Available,
    /// The selected local Host Session shell is degraded.
    Degraded,
    /// The selected local Host Session shell is known to be unavailable.
    Unavailable,
    /// The selected local Host Session shell cannot be classified reliably.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies local usability of a selected association without claiming backend state or policy truth.
pub enum BackendHealthAxisValue {
    /// Local association facts support a healthy usability classification.
    Healthy,
    /// Local association facts show degraded usability.
    Degraded,
    /// Local association facts show that the association is unavailable for this host-side assessment.
    Unavailable,
    /// Local association facts cannot be classified reliably.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies uncertainty in one assessment basis independently of the three health axes.
pub enum HealthUncertaintyValue {
    /// The selected local basis has no known uncertainty within this assessment boundary.
    NoKnownUncertainty,
    /// Required local evidence is incomplete.
    Incomplete,
    /// One or more selected local facts are stale for the bound evaluator.
    Stale,
    /// Selected local facts conflict and cannot be collapsed safely.
    Conflicting,
    /// The local evaluator cannot determine evidence certainty.
    Unknown,
}

/// Carries a redacted local reason for invalidating an otherwise immutable assessment record.
pub struct AssessmentInvalidationReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

/// Classifies the local record lifecycle of one immutable four-axis assessment.
pub enum HealthAssessmentRecordStatus {
    /// This is the selected current local assessment for its host generation.
    Current,
    /// A later immutable assessment replaced this record's current effect.
    Superseded {
        /// Replacement assessment retained as local causal history.
        replacement_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
        /// Strictly later assessment-series revision of the replacement record.
        replacement_revision: HealthAssessmentRevision,
    },
    /// A generation or basis conflict made this record unusable for further disposition.
    Invalidated {
        /// Redacted local reason for the invalidation.
        reason_code: AssessmentInvalidationReasonCode,
    },
}

impl AssessmentInvalidationReasonCode {
    /// Creates an invalidation reason from an already redacted local classification.
    pub fn from_assessment_invalidation(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted redacted assessment invalidation reason.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the redacted code for safe local mapping only.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}
```

| enum / variant | Rustdoc semantic | 允许来源 | 明确不是 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HostHealthAxisValue::{Healthy,Degraded,Unhealthy,Unknown}` | `Classifies the local health of the logical host axis without representing an external runtime or business result.` | same-generation committed local host / accepted snapshot basis 经 domain evaluation | container/process/Runtime run、LLM loop、业务成功或 external owner health。 |
| `SessionHealthAxisValue::{Available,Degraded,Unavailable,Unknown}` | `Classifies the local health of the Host Session shell without representing a Runtime session or run.` | matching local Host Session shell与allowed local facts | Runtime association/run truth、Member heartbeat truth或 endpoint raw reachability。 |
| `BackendHealthAxisValue::{Healthy,Degraded,Unavailable,Unknown}` | `Classifies local usability of a selected association without claiming backend state or policy truth.` | matching CMP-MS-03 local association / safe outcome classification | Sandbox/backend/carrier lifecycle、policy、resource existence或 tool execution outcome。 |
| `HealthUncertaintyValue::NoKnownUncertainty` | `The selected local basis has no known uncertainty within this assessment boundary.` | complete local evaluator input | 全局完整、所有 sibling ready、Runtime positive or no external risk。 |
| `Incomplete` / `Stale` / `Conflicting` / `Unknown` | `Required local evidence is incomplete.` / `One or more selected local facts are stale for the bound evaluator.` / `Selected local facts conflict and cannot be collapsed safely.` / `The local evaluator cannot determine evidence certainty.` | named local evaluator / mapper / current-fact reader的 typed non-positive classification | failure confirmed、recovery permitted、默认 healthy或可被 clock / fake 清除。 |
| `Current` | `This is the selected current local assessment for its host generation.` | new `assess(...)` 或 structurally valid rehydrate | health overall success、failure confirmed或 recovery committed。 |
| `Superseded { .. }` | `A later immutable assessment replaced this record's current effect.` | `Current -> Superseded` with non-self higher revision replacement | replacement已经持久化、new current pointer已切换或任何 external result。 |
| `Invalidated { .. }` | `A generation or basis conflict made this record unusable for further disposition.` | explicit local invalidation with redacted reason | host recovered、failure withdrawn、action cancelled or external source false。 |

#### `HostHealthAssessment` 对象契约

##### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostHealthAssessment`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 17 个，表示一份 generation-bound、four-axis、immutable factual assessment record。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::health` / `crates/domain/src/health.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-18`、`IB-MS-010/011`、`EvaluateDueHostHealthJob`、`EX-MS-015/016/028`；承接 local health assessment、revision、uncertainty和history-preserving replacement，而非外部 monitoring truth。 |
| 主要责任 | 基于同 generation 的 committed local fact selection 和 eligible snapshot basis 固定四个正交轴；以新 id / strict successor revision 表达新结论，并使 old assessment 只能 supersede / invalidate，不能原地改写 axes 或 basis。 |
| 不拥有 | health signal body、Member / Runtime / Sandbox / carrier/backend truth、failure classification、recovery decision、current pointer、repository CAS、UoW、history / outbox、Query view、threshold / schedule / configuration。 |

##### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one immutable, generation-bound, four-axis local host-health assessment.
pub struct HostHealthAssessment {
    /// Stable locally owned assessment identity.
    assessment_id: HostHealthAssessmentId,
    /// Logical host selected for the assessment.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation selected with the host.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Canonical body-free local basis used by this assessment.
    basis_refs: HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet,
    /// Local logical-host health classification.
    host_axis: HostHealthAxisValue,
    /// Local Host Session shell health classification.
    session_axis: SessionHealthAxisValue,
    /// Local association usability classification.
    backend_axis: BackendHealthAxisValue,
    /// Evidence uncertainty classification retained independently of health axes.
    uncertainty_axis: HealthUncertaintyValue,
    /// Immutable assessment-series revision for this host generation.
    assessment_revision: HealthAssessmentRevision,
    /// Selected prior assessment that this record will replace, when applicable.
    prior_assessment_ref: Option<HostHealthAssessmentRef>,
    /// Local lifecycle of this assessment record, not a health-axis value.
    record_status: HealthAssessmentRecordStatus,
    /// Local time at which the four-axis evaluation was formed.
    assessed_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time of the latest allowed record-lifecycle transition.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostHealthAssessment {
    /// Creates one current immutable assessment from a complete same-generation local evaluation.
    pub fn assess(
        assessment_id: HostHealthAssessmentId,
        evaluation: HealthAssessmentEvaluation,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates one persisted assessment without re-evaluating current facts or external owners.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        assessment_id: HostHealthAssessmentId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        basis_refs: HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet,
        host_axis: HostHealthAxisValue,
        session_axis: SessionHealthAxisValue,
        backend_axis: BackendHealthAxisValue,
        uncertainty_axis: HealthUncertaintyValue,
        assessment_revision: HealthAssessmentRevision,
        prior_assessment_ref: Option<HostHealthAssessmentRef>,
        record_status: HealthAssessmentRecordStatus,
        assessed_at: Timestamp,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Marks this current assessment as superseded by one strictly later immutable assessment.
    pub fn supersede(
        &mut self,
        replacement_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
        replacement_revision: HealthAssessmentRevision,
        superseded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Invalidates this current assessment when a matching local basis or generation conflict is explicit.
    pub fn invalidate(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: AssessmentInvalidationReasonCode,
        invalidated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this record is the current local assessment for one exact host generation.
    pub fn is_current_for(
        &self,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this assessment records an evidence uncertainty classification.
    pub fn has_uncertainty(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this assessment has exactly the supplied local host-generation scope.
    pub fn matches_host_generation(
        &self,
        host_ref: &HostRef,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local assessment reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostHealthAssessmentRef;

    /// Returns the immutable assessment-series revision.
    pub fn assessment_revision(&self) -> &HealthAssessmentRevision;

    /// Returns the current record lifecycle without exposing mutable fields.
    pub fn record_status(&self) -> &HealthAssessmentRecordStatus;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `assessment_id` | `HostHealthAssessmentId` | 定位一次 immutable local assessment | application id generator / local assessment-store rehydrate；每个 new assessment 必须新 id，不能由 host、generation、revision、snapshot、time或 query拼接。 |
| `host_ref` + `generation` | `HostRef` + `HostGeneration` | 固定 assessment scope | only `HealthAssessmentEvaluation` 的 exact pair；不可从 snapshot source/session/association/ref text、source version或 cursor推导。 |
| `basis_refs` | `HealthAssessmentBasisRefSet` | 保存实际评估所消费的 local causal anchors | only canonical evaluation set；不含 raw snapshot、source summary body、store row、adapter result、projection或 public DTO。 |
| four axes | four closed domain enums | 分别保留 host / Host Session / association usability / uncertainty judgement | only typed `HealthAssessmentAxes`；任何 axis 都不自动修改 lifecycle、registration、session、failure或 recovery。 |
| `assessment_revision` | `HealthAssessmentRevision` | 区分同一 host-generation 下 successive assessment facts | no prior -> `initial()`；selected prior -> strict `next_after()`；不是 CAS token、HostGeneration、HostRevision、source version、message order、cursor或 timestamp。 |
| `prior_assessment_ref` | `Option<HostHealthAssessmentRef>` | 标记新 record选择替代的 previous current assessment | `None` only first assessment; `Some` must equal selected `Current` fact and be non-self. It does not transition the prior object or prove same-UoW save. |
| `record_status` | `HealthAssessmentRecordStatus` | 保存 current / superseded / invalidated record lifecycle | `assess` only produces `Current`; only `supersede` / `invalidate` mutate it. Four axes remain immutable across these transitions. |
| `assessed_at` / `updated_at` | `Timestamp` | 区分 evaluation time 与 latest local lifecycle transition time | application clock / safe rehydrate；`assessed_at <= updated_at`；均不是 source captured time、external observation、store version、commit receipt或 recovery time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `assess(HostHealthAssessmentId, HealthAssessmentEvaluation)` | 形成新 `Current` record | evaluation 必须已选择 same-generation basis/current relation；没有 prior 时 revision必须 initial，有 prior 时必须 strict successor。无 I/O、current-pointer update、old-record transition、failure/recovery creation或 external call。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 重建历史 record | 验证 basis scope、axis / uncertainty combination、prior / revision、status payload、non-self ref、time monotonicity；不重新读 snapshot/session/attempt/association，不确认 current，也不拉取 external truth。 |
| `supersede(...)` | `Current -> Superseded` | replacement ref不得 self，replacement revision必须 strict after self revision，time不得倒退。future application 必须在同一 UoW 保存 new record、old status、selected current relation与history；本方法不创建 replacement、不切 pointer。 |
| `invalidate(...)` | `Current -> Invalidated` | only an already-redacted explicit local basis/generation conflict may call it；不允许从 stale query、timeout、adapter error、fake或 absence-of-error构造 reason。invalidated record不得支持 failure/recovery。 |
| `is_current_for(...)` | 给 failure/recovery guard 提供窄的 current check | only `record_status == Current` plus exact pair returns true；不表示 axes healthy、basis fresh、store CAS success或 action permitted。 |
| `has_uncertainty()` | 暴露 uncertainty presence | only `NoKnownUncertainty` returns false；不自动 hold、clear failure、withdraw classification或重新评估。 |
| `matches_host_generation(...)` / accessors | 提供 typed read surface | pure；ref/revision/status不证明 selected current pointer已保存、failure confirmed或 recovery committed。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| new fact, new id, new revision | 新 health conclusion 永远创建新 `HostHealthAssessmentId`；同一 selected host-generation 的 replacement 必须 revision严格后继。不得原地替换 old record 的 basis、axis、scope、revision或 `assessed_at`。 |
| four axes remain orthogonal | host、session、backend association与uncertainty不压成 boolean，也不互相改写。`HostSession` / association事实可作为 basis，却不能直接成为某一 axis 或把 Runtime / backend truth写进轴。 |
| currentness is local and transactional | 本对象只表示 record lifecycle；selected current relation、expected store version、single winner和old/new/history atomicity由 future Step 7 / 11 / 13 reader、store与UoW承担。无该 witness时不得 commit a new current assessment。 |
| uncertainty is not a positive bridge | `Incomplete` / `Stale` / `Conflicting` / `Unknown` 不得被压成 healthy、confirmed failure、recovery permit或 Runtime-positive evidence。`Unknown` / `Suspected` 只能由新正式 local basis重新分类，不能由时间、cache、receipt或 fake升级。 |
| no projection or observability writeback | Query / projection / observability backend只能读取 safe mapping；不得以 view freshness、alert、metric、log或 dashboard receipt重建 / 覆写 assessment。 |

### 9.11.6 `health.rs`：failure basis、分类 taxonomy、certainty 与 `HostFailureClassification`

#### 写入边界与分类语义

`HostFailureClassification` 只表达本仓对一个**宿主侧、generation-bound、可追溯的异常分类**。它不是 Member failure report、Runtime failure、Sandbox/backend incident、observability alert、日志摘要或重试授权。分类必须回指一份已选中的本地 `HostHealthAssessment`，并可选地回指同一世代的 signal、Host Session、action attempt 或 association ref；所有 basis 都是 typed local ref，不能携带正文。

| 项 | 本批收口结论 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| 唯一 owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::health` / `crates/domain/src/health.rs` 独占 `HostFailureClassification`、`FailureBasisRef(Set)`、failure layer/category/impact、certainty、classification status、reason 与 confirmation/withdrawal support value。 | 不在 signal consumer、health Job、recovery.rs、Host Session、attempt、association、projection、adapter、fake 或 observability 中建立第二份 failure truth。 |
| 业务对象分母 | `HostFailureClassification` 是冻结 29 个业务对象之一；basis set、taxonomy、support value 和 reason 是该对象的 domain-only value，不新增 `FailureReport`、`Incident`、`HealthManager` 或第 30 个对象。 | 不把 support value 单独持久化成 failure 主语，不复制 Runtime/Sandbox/backend failure object。 |
| 适用范围 | 以 `HostRef + HostGeneration` 和 selected assessment 锁定本地宿主世代；category 只描述本仓可观察的 host/session/association/progression 影响。 | 不把 scope 扩展为项目、成员、业务目标、Runtime run、工具调用、Sandbox policy 或外部资源 truth。 |
| certainty 与 status | `FailureCertainty` 表示证据定性；`FailureClassificationStatus` 表示该分类记录的本地生命周期。两者必须独立存储和校验。 | 不用 `Confirmed` status 推断外部故障已确认；不以 `Suspected` / `Unknown` status 当作 confirmed failure。 |
| positive confirmation | 只有 named domain evaluator 以新的正式 basis 形成 `FailureConfirmationSupport` 后，`Candidate -> Confirmed` 才可发生。 | 不从 timeout、cache miss、absence-of-error、adapter error、fake、alert、receipt、Query 或旧 basis 重放升级。 |
| recovery separation | 分类最多作为 `HostRecoveryDecision` 的输入；它不产生、提交、替代或作废 recovery decision，也不调用 action / closure。 | 不在 `confirm`、`withdraw` 或 `mark_unknown` 中发起 Restart、Recover、Stop、Terminate、Sandbox cleanup 或 Runtime continuation。 |

#### `FailureBasisRef` 与 canonical `FailureBasisRefSet`

`FailureBasisRefSet` 只保留分类实际消费的 local causal anchors。集合至少包含一条 `Assessment`，且在 `HostFailureClassification::classify` 中必须由 loaded assessment reader 验证与对象的 host/generation 精确相符。ref 的存在不代表对应记录 current、healthy、confirmed、committed 或可执行；这些结论只能由各自对象状态和后续 UoW 给出。

```rust
/// References one body-free local fact used to classify a host-side failure.
pub enum FailureBasisRef {
    /// The four-axis assessment selected as the primary classification basis.
    Assessment(HostHealthAssessmentRef),
    /// An accepted signal snapshot retained as supporting local evidence.
    AcceptedSnapshot(HealthSignalSnapshotRef),
    /// A matching local Host Session shell reference.
    HostSession(HostSessionRef),
    /// A matching local host-side action attempt reference.
    ActionAttempt(HostActionAttemptRef),
    /// A matching local host-to-external association reference.
    Association(HostExternalAssociationRef),
}

/// Stores a canonical ordered, unique, body-free basis set for one failure classification.
pub struct FailureBasisRefSet(Vec<FailureBasisRef>);

impl FailureBasisRefSet {
    /// Creates a canonical basis set without selecting or inventing evidence.
    pub fn try_new(values: Vec<FailureBasisRef>) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns the immutable canonical basis sequence.
    pub fn as_slice(&self) -> &[FailureBasisRef];
}
```

| 规则 | 收口契约 |
|---|---|
| required anchor | 每个 set 必须恰有一个 `Assessment`；缺失、重复或多个 assessment 都是 `DomainError`。assessment 必须是 selected local record，不能由 classification 自己生成。 |
| allowed supporting refs | `AcceptedSnapshot`、`HostSession`、`ActionAttempt`、`Association` 只能引用本仓已存在的 typed local record；不能把 raw report、Runtime run、Sandbox binding body、backend event、log 或 metric 放入 set。 |
| canonical order | 规范顺序为 `Assessment -> AcceptedSnapshot -> HostSession -> ActionAttempt -> Association`；同一 variant 按其 opaque persisted local id 升序。`try_new` 拒绝乱序、重复、空集合和未识别 variant，不自动排序、去重或补默认。 |
| scope check | `classify`、`confirm`、`mark_unknown`、`withdraw` 使用的 set 必须与 target `HostRef + HostGeneration` 相符；仅凭 ref 文本无法证明 scope，必须由 named reader 提供 matching local fact。 |
| new-basis check | confirmation / withdrawal support 必须包含至少一项相对当前 classification 的新 formal local ref；旧 set 原样重放、只改变 reason 或只改变时间不得视为新依据。 |

#### failure layer、category、impact 与 certainty taxonomy

```rust
/// Identifies the local layer to which a host-side anomaly is attributed.
pub enum HostFailureLayer {
    /// The logical host lifecycle or host-local fact layer.
    Host,
    /// The local Host Session shell layer, not a Runtime session or run.
    Session,
    /// The local host-to-external association usability layer without backend truth.
    Backend,
    /// The layer cannot be determined safely from retained local facts.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies a host-side anomaly without naming an external owner failure.
pub enum HostFailureCategory {
    /// Local host facts show that the logical host cannot be used for the selected purpose.
    HostUnavailable,
    /// Local host progression is stalled without asserting a remote failure.
    HostLifecycleStalled,
    /// The selected host-generation relation conflicts with local current facts.
    HostGenerationConflict,
    /// The local Host Session shell is not usable for the selected host generation.
    SessionUnavailable,
    /// The local Host Session shell is stale or cannot be matched to current facts.
    SessionStale,
    /// The local association cannot be used for a host-side handoff.
    AssociationUnavailable,
    /// Local association facts conflict and cannot be safely selected.
    AssociationConflict,
    /// A required local progression precondition is not satisfied.
    ProgressionBlocked,
    /// The retained evidence is insufficient for a more specific category.
    InsufficientEvidence,
    /// No safe local category can be selected.
    Unclassifiable,
}

/// Describes the local impact of a classified anomaly.
pub enum HostFailureImpactScope {
    /// The logical host cannot be treated as available for this local flow.
    HostAvailability,
    /// The local Host Session shell cannot be used for this local flow.
    SessionAvailability,
    /// The selected host association cannot be used for the local handoff.
    AssociationUsability,
    /// Local progression must stop until a new fact or decision is available.
    ProgressionBlocked,
    /// The impact cannot be safely determined.
    Unknown,
}

/// Classifies how strongly the retained local basis supports the failure claim.
pub enum FailureCertainty {
    /// A new formal local basis satisfies the domain confirmation guard.
    Confirmed,
    /// A local anomaly is plausible but does not satisfy the confirmation guard.
    Suspected,
    /// The local basis cannot determine whether a failure exists.
    Unknown,
}
```

| layer | allowed category family | disallowed interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| `Host` | `HostUnavailable`、`HostLifecycleStalled`、`HostGenerationConflict`、`ProgressionBlocked`、`InsufficientEvidence`、`Unclassifiable` | process/container health、Member 主体状态、业务失败或 Runtime run failure。 |
| `Session` | `SessionUnavailable`、`SessionStale`、`ProgressionBlocked`、`InsufficientEvidence`、`Unclassifiable` | Runtime session/run、callback success、Member heartbeat truth或 transport reachability。 |
| `Backend` | `AssociationUnavailable`、`AssociationConflict`、`ProgressionBlocked`、`InsufficientEvidence`、`Unclassifiable` | Sandbox/carrier/backend lifecycle、资源存在、policy decision或 tool execution result。 |
| `Unknown` | 仅 `InsufficientEvidence` 或 `Unclassifiable` | 以 unknown layer 拼出一个具体 external failure，或把 `Unknown` 当 confirmed。 |

| certainty | 含义 | 允许去向 |
|---|---|---|
| `Confirmed` | named evaluator 已以新的 formal basis 满足本地确认规则 | 可作为 recovery command 的受限输入；仍不等于外部 failure。 |
| `Suspected` | 有异常线索但 basis 不足以确认 | 仅保留 candidate / history；不能授权 action。 |
| `Unknown` | evidence 不足、冲突或层级不可判定 | 仅支持 `Unknown` / `Hold` / investigation surface；不能直接确认。 |

#### classification status、reason 与 support values

```rust
/// Classifies the lifecycle of one local failure-classification record.
pub enum FailureClassificationStatus {
    /// A local anomaly is recorded but is not a confirmed failure.
    Candidate,
    /// The domain confirmation guard has been satisfied for this record.
    Confirmed,
    /// A later classification replaced this record's current effect.
    Superseded {
        /// The newer local classification retained as replacement history.
        replacement_ref: HostFailureClassificationRef,
    },
    /// A newer formal assessment withdrew the applicability of this record.
    Withdrawn {
        /// Redacted local reason for withdrawal.
        reason_code: FailureReasonCode,
    },
    /// The layer or category remains indeterminate.
    Unknown,
}

/// Carries a redacted local reason for a failure classification.
pub struct FailureReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

impl FailureReasonCode {
    /// Creates a reason from an already redacted domain classification.
    pub fn from_classification(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted redacted reason without adding evidence.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the redacted code for local history or safe mapping.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}

/// Supports confirmation with a new formal local basis.
pub struct FailureConfirmationSupport {
    /// Canonical basis containing at least one new local ref.
    basis_refs: FailureBasisRefSet,
    /// Redacted reason selected by the domain evaluator.
    reason_code: FailureReasonCode,
}

impl FailureConfirmationSupport {
    /// Creates confirmation support only from the named domain evaluator.
    pub(crate) fn from_formal_evaluation(
        basis_refs: FailureBasisRefSet,
        reason_code: FailureReasonCode,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

/// Supports withdrawing a classification with a newer formal local basis.
pub struct FailureWithdrawalSupport {
    /// New canonical basis explaining why the prior classification no longer applies.
    basis_refs: FailureBasisRefSet,
    /// New assessment selected for the withdrawal relation.
    replacement_assessment_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
    /// Redacted local reason for withdrawal.
    reason_code: FailureReasonCode,
}

impl FailureWithdrawalSupport {
    /// Creates withdrawal support only from a newer formal assessment evaluation.
    pub(crate) fn from_formal_reassessment(
        basis_refs: FailureBasisRefSet,
        replacement_assessment_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
        reason_code: FailureReasonCode,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}
```

`FailureClassificationStatus::Confirmed` 与 `FailureCertainty::Confirmed` 是两个不同维度：前者是 record lifecycle，后者是当前 evidence 定性。`Candidate` 可以带 `Suspected` 或 `Unknown`；`Unknown` status 必须带 `Unknown` certainty；只有 `confirm(...)` 同时满足 new-basis、layer/category/impact compatibility、same-generation 和 redacted-reason guard 时，才可把 certainty 与 status 一起推进到 `Confirmed`。`Unknown` 或 `Suspected` 不得通过重复 basis、时间流逝、缓存刷新、receipt、fake 或 absence-of-error 直接升级。

#### `HostFailureClassification` 对象卡

##### 基本信息与 Rust-facing shape

| 项 | 契约 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostFailureClassification`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 18 个，表示一份 host-side failure fact / classification record。 |
| owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::health` / `crates/domain/src/health.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-19`、`EvaluateDueHostHealthJob`、`IB-MS-010/011`、health assessment flow；分类结果只供本地 health/recovery 输入和 safe mapping。 |
| 不拥有 | Member / Runtime / Images / Sandbox / carrier / backend / observability truth、recovery action、repository、UoW、entry、protocol DTO、cleanup 或 external effect。 |

```rust
/// Records one generation-bound host-side failure classification.
pub struct HostFailureClassification {
    /// Stable locally owned classification identity.
    classification_id: HostFailureClassificationId,
    /// Logical host selected for the classification.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation selected with the classification.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Primary four-axis assessment used as classification input.
    assessment_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
    /// Local layer attributed to the anomaly.
    failure_layer: HostFailureLayer,
    /// Closed local category for the anomaly.
    failure_category: HostFailureCategory,
    /// Local impact classification.
    impact_scope: HostFailureImpactScope,
    /// Evidence certainty, independent of record lifecycle.
    certainty: FailureCertainty,
    /// Canonical body-free local basis.
    basis_refs: FailureBasisRefSet,
    /// Local lifecycle of this classification record.
    classification_status: FailureClassificationStatus,
    /// Prior classification replaced by this record, when applicable.
    prior_classification_ref: Option<HostFailureClassificationRef>,
    /// Redacted local reason for the classification.
    reason_code: FailureReasonCode,
    /// Local time when this classification record was formed.
    classified_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time of the latest allowed lifecycle transition.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostFailureClassification {
    /// Forms a candidate or unknown classification from a complete local evaluation.
    pub fn classify(
        classification_id: HostFailureClassificationId,
        evaluation: FailureClassificationEvaluation,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted classification without re-reading external evidence.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        classification_id: HostFailureClassificationId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        assessment_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
        failure_layer: HostFailureLayer,
        failure_category: HostFailureCategory,
        impact_scope: HostFailureImpactScope,
        certainty: FailureCertainty,
        basis_refs: FailureBasisRefSet,
        classification_status: FailureClassificationStatus,
        prior_classification_ref: Option<HostFailureClassificationRef>,
        reason_code: FailureReasonCode,
        classified_at: Timestamp,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Confirms a candidate only with a new formal local basis.
    pub fn confirm(
        &mut self,
        support: FailureConfirmationSupport,
        confirmed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records that the classification remains indeterminate under a new local basis.
    pub fn mark_unknown(
        &mut self,
        basis_refs: FailureBasisRefSet,
        reason_code: FailureReasonCode,
        unknown_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Withdraws a current classification after a newer formal reassessment.
    pub fn withdraw(
        &mut self,
        support: FailureWithdrawalSupport,
        withdrawn_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Marks this record superseded by a distinct newer classification.
    pub fn supersede(
        &mut self,
        replacement_ref: HostFailureClassificationRef,
        superseded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this classification applies to an exact host-generation pair.
    pub fn applies_to(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local classification reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostFailureClassificationRef;

    /// Returns the independent evidence certainty.
    pub fn certainty(&self) -> &FailureCertainty;

    /// Returns the local classification record lifecycle.
    pub fn classification_status(&self) -> &FailureClassificationStatus;
}
```

`FailureClassificationEvaluation` 是 `health.rs` 内部的 domain support value，至少包含 `host_ref`、`generation`、`assessment_ref`、layer、category、impact、certainty、canonical basis、初始 status、reason 与 `classified_at`。它只能由 loaded assessment / named local evaluator 形成；当 initial status 为 `Confirmed` 时必须携带 `FailureConfirmationSupport`，否则 `classify` 拒绝。为保持“没有新正式 basis 就不能确认”的门禁，`classify` 的默认 positive 入口只产生 `Candidate` 或 `Unknown`；confirmed record 必须显式走带 support 的 path。

##### 字段来源与校验

| 字段 | 来源与约束 |
|---|---|
| `classification_id` | application id generator 或 local failure-store rehydrate；新 record 必须新 id，不得由 assessment、generation、category、time、source 或 message 拼接。 |
| `host_ref` / `generation` | 同一次 selected assessment / current-fact read 的精确 pair；不得从 ref 文本、source version、cursor、Runtime run 或 backend id 推导。 |
| `assessment_ref` | 已加载且允许作为 classification basis 的 local `HostHealthAssessmentRef`；ref 本身不证明 current、healthy 或 `Current` status。 |
| `failure_layer` / `failure_category` / `impact_scope` | named domain classifier 的 closed taxonomy；factory 必须检查 layer-category-impact compatibility，不能由 adapter / alert / config 扩展。 |
| `certainty` | domain evaluator 对 basis 的定性；不是概率、分数、监控 severity 或 external confirmation。 |
| `basis_refs` | `FailureBasisRefSet` canonical sequence；必须包含 `assessment_ref` 对应的 `Assessment`，所有 supporting ref 与 target scope 匹配。 |
| `classification_status` | `classify` 仅允许 `Candidate` / `Unknown`（confirmed 需 support）；`confirm`、`mark_unknown`、`withdraw`、`supersede` 是唯一 transition。 |
| `prior_classification_ref` | 新 immutable record 选择替代 prior 时由 evaluation 提供；不得自引用，不能单凭 ref 自动转移 prior 状态。 |
| `reason_code` | 只接受已裁剪 `FailureReasonCode`；不得保存 source body、log、stack、route、credential、Runtime/Sandbox/backend/error text。 |
| `classified_at` / `updated_at` | application local clock 或 safe rehydrate；`classified_at <= updated_at`，不表示 source observed time、commit receipt、external action 或 recovery time。 |

##### factory、transition 与不变量

| 函数 | 契约 |
|---|---|
| `classify(id, evaluation)` | 检查 assessment / basis / target exact match、taxonomy compatibility、certainty/status组合、prior relation和时间；无 I/O、history、UoW、action或 recovery side effect。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 只验证 persisted shape、canonical basis、scope、status/certainty组合、replacement relation与时间；不重读 external owner，不将历史 record 变成 current。 |
| `confirm(support, time)` | 仅 `Candidate -> Confirmed`；support 必须来自新 formal basis、同一 host/generation、包含 assessment，且 certainty 变为 `Confirmed`。`Unknown` status、`Suspected` certainty、`Superseded`、`Withdrawn` 或 `Confirmed` 不可通过此方法重写。 |
| `mark_unknown(basis, reason, time)` | 仅 `Candidate -> Unknown`，或在 domain 明确允许的 candidate reclassification 中保留新 basis；basis 必须是新的 canonical set，certainty 固定 `Unknown`。不把 unknown 当 confirmed。 |
| `withdraw(support, time)` | 仅 `Candidate` 或 `Confirmed` 的当前记录可转 `Withdrawn`；必须有 newer formal assessment / basis，reason 已裁剪；不代表 host 已恢复，也不创建 recovery decision。 |
| `supersede(replacement_ref, time)` | 当前 record -> `Superseded`；replacement ref 不得 self，且必须由 application 在同一 UoW 建立 successor、更新 prior、current relation 与 history。此方法不加载或提交 successor。 |
| `applies_to(...)` | 仅 exact host/generation match 且 status 为 `Candidate` 或 `Confirmed` 时返回 true；`Unknown`、`Withdrawn`、`Superseded` 不作为 active failure input。 |

状态闭环如下：

```text
formal local assessment + canonical basis
             │
             ├── insufficient / indeterminate ──► Unknown
             │
             └── anomaly candidate ─────────────► Candidate
                                                    │
                          new formal basis + guard ├──► Confirmed
                                                    │
                          new formal reassessment ├──► Withdrawn
                                                    │
                          newer classification ───┴──► Superseded
```

| 状态 | certainty 约束 | 允许去向 | 明确不是 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Candidate` | `Suspected` 或 `Unknown` | `Confirmed`（仅新 support）、`Unknown`、`Withdrawn`、`Superseded` | action authorization、external failure。 |
| `Confirmed` | 必须 `Confirmed` | `Withdrawn` 或 `Superseded` | Runtime / business failure confirmed、automatic restart。 |
| `Unknown` | 必须 `Unknown` | 只能由新 immutable record 重新分类或由显式 supersede/withdraw history 处理 | confirmed failure、ready、retry permission。 |
| `Withdrawn` | 保留历史 certainty | history / safe mapping | host recovered、cleanup complete或 external cancellation。 |
| `Superseded` | 保留历史 certainty | history / causal basis | successor 已 committed、action 已 executed。 |

##### forbidden boundaries 与 Step 7 handoff

- `FailureBasisRef(Set)` 只允许 typed local refs；不得嵌入 heartbeat、status report、logs、dump、Runtime checkpoint/run、Sandbox policy/backend body、Member report、observability event、route 或 receipt。
- `HostFailureClassification` 不拥有 `HostRecoveryAction`、`FormalRecoveryContext` 或任何 dispatch/closure method；`confirm`、`withdraw`、`mark_unknown` 与 `supersede` 都是纯 domain transition。
- `QueryHostHealthFailure`、signal Consumer、health Job、projection、adapter、fake、timeout 与 absence-of-error 均不得直接调用 `confirm`、写 status 或创建 replacement。
- `MSVC-UP-001/002/004/007` 未闭合时，任何依赖 Runtime / Member / Sandbox / Core signal 的 positive classification 只能停在 `Candidate` / `Unknown` / `Blocked` / `Waiting`；本对象卡不把 local summary 升级为外部 failure。
- Step 7 必须提供 named assessment/failure basis reader、same-generation validator、failure store / UoW、new-basis confirmation mapper、withdrawal/replacement pair 与 safe health mapper；port 不得向对象注入外部 body或 recovery authorization。

### 9.11.7 `recovery.rs`：formal context、prerequisite、action plan 与 `HostRecoveryDecision`

#### 正式恢复上下文与 prerequisite 边界

`FormalRecoveryContext` 是恢复决定唯一允许的 control-plane 输入。它只能由 future `DecideHostRecoveryCommand` 的 application mapper / formal port 在已得到 body-free mapped result 后构造；它不是 `HostIntent` 的可随意复制视图，也不是 health Consumer、health Job、Query、alert、timeout、receipt、adapter error、fake 或配置的替代输入。该限制使“health fact”与“是否提出处置”保持不同主语。

```rust
/// Carries the only formal control context from which a recovery proposal may be formed.
pub struct FormalRecoveryContext {
    /// Formal source retained as a body-free causal anchor.
    source_ref: HostIntentSourceRef,
    /// Accepted local intent selected by the formal recovery-command mapper.
    intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
    /// Mapped project-member control scope carrying both required typed anchors.
    scope_ref: HostControlScopeRef,
}

impl FormalRecoveryContext {
    /// Creates context only from one mapped command result and its loaded accepted intent.
    pub fn from_mapped_decide_host_recovery_command(
        intent: &HostIntent,
        source_ref: HostIntentSourceRef,
        scope_ref: HostControlScopeRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates already persisted local control causality without re-reading an external owner.
    pub fn from_persisted(
        source_ref: HostIntentSourceRef,
        intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
        scope_ref: HostControlScopeRef,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether the retained scope carries the supplied exact project and identity anchors.
    pub fn matches_anchors(
        &self,
        project_member_ref: &ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: &GlobalMemberRef,
    ) -> bool;
}
```

| 字段 / factory | 来源与不可替代约束 |
|---|---|
| `source_ref` | 只能来自 future formal `DecideHostRecoveryCommand` mapper / port；`HostRecoveryDecision::propose` 必须用 loaded accepted `HostIntent` 检查其 source 一致。它不等于 command body、Work / Identity / Governance truth、actor authorization 或 external action permission。 |
| `intent_ref` | 只能定位 loaded local `HostIntent`；proposal 前必须复核 `Accepted`，且 ref 不能单独证明 accepted、current、committed 或可恢复。 |
| `scope_ref` | 必须同时携带 `ProjectMemberRef + GlobalMemberRef`；proposal 复核它与 intent、host target 的双锚精确一致。`matches_anchors` 只作 typed equality，不能查询或推导 L1 relation。 |
| `from_mapped_decide_host_recovery_command(...)` | 必须同时接收 loaded `HostIntent`，并通过其 `matches_accepted_control_context(...)` 核对 `Accepted` status、intent ref、source 与 scope；`intent_ref` 只能由 `intent.to_ref()` 导出。无 `new` / `Default` / raw-string fallback。future Step 7 必须将调用点限制在 named formal mapper / port；缺 command mapper、任一锚、accepted intent 或 scope match 时只产生 owning `rejected` / `waiting` / `blocked` / `unknown` surface。 |
| `from_persisted(...)` | 只保留历史 local causality；不把旧 source/scope 复活为 current command、Governance approval 或 Runtime eligibility。 |

`RecoveryPrerequisiteRef` 只保存本仓已经拥有的 typed local ref；它不携带 health signal body、Member report、Runtime session/run/checkpoint、Sandbox binding/policy/backend state、image manifest、credential、event envelope、receipt 或 observability data。所有 ref 都必须由 future named local reader 逐项验证属于同一 `host_ref + generation`；只靠 ref 文本相等、endpoint/session 可见、heartbeat、receipt、timeout、fake 或 absence-of-error 均不得通过 scope validation。

```rust
/// References one body-free local prerequisite selected for a recovery decision.
pub enum RecoveryPrerequisiteRef {
    /// The required primary local health assessment.
    Assessment(HostHealthAssessmentRef),
    /// An optional selected local failure classification.
    FailureClassification(HostFailureClassificationRef),
    /// A local registration record relevant to the selected host generation.
    Registration(HostRegistrationRef),
    /// A local endpoint association relevant to the selected host generation.
    Endpoint(HostEndpointRef),
    /// A local host-session shell relevant to the selected host generation.
    Session(HostSessionRef),
    /// A local host-side action attempt relevant to the selected host generation.
    ActionAttempt(HostActionAttemptRef),
    /// A local external-association record relevant to the selected host generation.
    Association(HostExternalAssociationRef),
}

/// Stores a fixed-order, duplicate-free set of local recovery prerequisites.
pub struct RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet(Vec<RecoveryPrerequisiteRef>);

/// Carries a prerequisite set after a future named reader validated its exact host-generation scope.
pub struct ValidatedRecoveryPrerequisites {
    host_ref: HostRef,
    generation: HostGeneration,
    prerequisite_refs: RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet,
}

impl RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet {
    /// Validates canonical order, uniqueness, and the mandatory assessment member.
    pub fn from_canonical(
        prerequisite_refs: Vec<RecoveryPrerequisiteRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this set contains the exact primary assessment reference.
    pub fn contains_assessment(&self, assessment_ref: &HostHealthAssessmentRef) -> bool;
}

impl ValidatedRecoveryPrerequisites {
    /// Forms a scope-bound prerequisite selection from one application-supplied named-reader validation result.
    pub fn from_reader_validation(
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        prerequisite_refs: RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}
```

| canonical rank | `RecoveryPrerequisiteRef` | 集合与 scope 规则 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Assessment` | 恰有一个，且必须等于 recovery decision 的 `assessment_ref`。 |
| 2 | `FailureClassification` | 至多一个；若 decision 有 `failure_classification_ref`，两者必须精确相等；反之不得以 basis 中的 failure ref 补造字段。 |
| 3 | `Registration` | 至多一个；只表示 local record，不能证明 Member register / credential owner truth。 |
| 4 | `Endpoint` | 至多一个；不能证明 transport reachable 或 Runtime association。 |
| 5 | `Session` | 至多一个；只表示 local Host Session shell，不能证明 Runtime session/run。 |
| 6 | `ActionAttempt` | 至多一个；`Prepared` / `Dispatched` / receipt 不等于 effect completion 或 unknown-effect clearance。 |
| 7 | `Association` | 至多一个；不能证明 Sandbox / carrier / backend binding、release 或 cleanup。 |

`from_canonical` 拒绝空集、非上述顺序、同 kind 重复、同一 typed ref 重复和缺 `Assessment`，且不得悄悄排序、去重或插入缺项。`ValidatedRecoveryPrerequisites::from_reader_validation(...)` 是窄 `pub` factory，因为 future Step 7 `RecoveryPrerequisiteReader` 位于独立 application crate；它只复核 canonical set 与 supplied `host_ref + generation` 的结构完整性，不自行读取、推断或证明各 ref 的 scope。只有 named reader 在已读取 selected local records、逐项验证其 exact `host_ref + generation` 与 target 完全相等后才可调用它；该限制是架构调用约束，不得伪称 Rust visibility 或 typed ref existence 已完成验证。reader / rehydrate 不可用时，proposal 必须停在 `blocked` / `waiting` / `unknown`，不能构造未验证 set。

#### 独立 action、eligibility 与决策计划

`HostRecoveryAction` 是 `recovery.rs` 独占的 local recovery-disposition enum。它不得复用 public-read `HostSafeRecoveryAction`，也不得复用 host-side effect 分类 `HostActionKind`；前者仅是 safe projection，后者是 attempt / handoff 分类，二者均不能成为 recovery decision truth。

```rust
/// Selects one local recovery disposition without describing a Runtime, Sandbox, or tool command.
pub enum HostRecoveryAction {
    /// Requests a bounded Runtime-recovery handoff for the exact selected generation.
    Recover,
    /// Requests only a guarded new logical-host generation path.
    Restart,
    /// Requests a local stop closure candidate.
    Stop,
    /// Requests a local terminate closure candidate.
    Terminate,
    /// Explicitly forbids further recovery progression until a new formal decision exists.
    Hold,
}

/// Carries one already-redacted local rationale for a recovery decision plan.
pub struct RecoveryDecisionReasonCode(HostRedactedCode);

impl RecoveryDecisionReasonCode {
    /// Creates a reason only from an already redacted recovery classification.
    pub fn from_recovery_classification(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted redacted reason without adding external detail.
    pub fn from_persisted(value: HostRedactedCode) -> Self;

    /// Returns the redacted code for local history or safe mapping.
    pub fn as_code(&self) -> &str;
}

/// States what is known about the Runtime-specific portion of one recovery plan.
pub enum RuntimeRecoveryEligibility {
    /// The selected action has no Runtime-recovery handoff in this object group.
    NotRequired,
    /// A required Runtime handoff is unavailable under a named fail-closed blocker.
    Blocked { reason_code: RecoveryDecisionReasonCode },
    /// Local policy intentionally holds instead of claiming a Runtime handoff is eligible.
    Hold { reason_code: RecoveryDecisionReasonCode },
    /// Available local facts cannot determine Runtime handoff eligibility.
    Unknown { reason_code: RecoveryDecisionReasonCode },
    /// Restart may be offered only to the later exact-generation guard; it is not eligibility itself.
    RestartRequiresCommittedGenerationGuard,
}

/// States the unknown-effect requirement that a later action-specific guard must freshly check.
pub enum RecoveryUnknownEffectClearance {
    /// No generation-creation clearance is represented by this recovery decision.
    NotRequired,
    /// A later recovery restart guard must observe an empty same-scope unknown-effect fence.
    MustBeEmptyAtGenerationGuard,
    /// The local unknown-effect selection is unavailable and must fail closed.
    UnknownEffectStateUnavailable,
}

/// Selects the only permitted downstream guard family for one recovery action.
pub enum RecoveryActionGuard {
    /// A future formal Runtime handoff must be closed before any Recover progression.
    RecoverRequiresFormalRuntimeHandoff,
    /// A future HostGenerationFence recovery-restart guard owns new-generation selection.
    RestartRequiresGenerationFence,
    /// Only CMP-MS-06 may consume the decision as a stop closure candidate.
    StopRequiresClosureCandidate,
    /// Only CMP-MS-06 may consume the decision as a terminate closure candidate.
    TerminateRequiresClosureCandidate,
    /// Hold permits no action, closure, Runtime handoff, or generation progression.
    HoldForbidsProgression,
}

/// Holds the closed local plan selected for one recovery-decision proposal.
pub struct RecoveryDecisionPlan {
    action: HostRecoveryAction,
    prerequisite_refs: RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet,
    reason_code: RecoveryDecisionReasonCode,
    runtime_eligibility: RuntimeRecoveryEligibility,
    unknown_effect_clearance: RecoveryUnknownEffectClearance,
    action_guard: RecoveryActionGuard,
}

/// Carries the exact local facts selected before one recovery proposal is formed.
pub struct RecoveryDecisionCurrentFacts {
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    host_ref: HostRef,
    generation: HostGeneration,
    assessment_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
    failure_classification_ref: Option<HostFailureClassificationRef>,
    prerequisites: ValidatedRecoveryPrerequisites,
    selected_prior_decision_ref: Option<HostRecoveryDecisionRef>,
}

/// Binds a proposed decision to one already-checked local commit preflight without carrying a transaction or port.
pub struct RecoveryCommitGuard {
    decision_ref: HostRecoveryDecisionRef,
    project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
    global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
    host_ref: HostRef,
    generation: HostGeneration,
    action: HostRecoveryAction,
    prerequisite_refs: RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet,
    supersedes_ref: Option<HostRecoveryDecisionRef>,
}

impl RecoveryDecisionPlan {
    /// Creates a plan only from a named domain evaluation over validated local facts.
    pub fn from_domain_evaluation(
        action: HostRecoveryAction,
        prerequisite_refs: RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet,
        reason_code: RecoveryDecisionReasonCode,
        runtime_eligibility: RuntimeRecoveryEligibility,
        unknown_effect_clearance: RecoveryUnknownEffectClearance,
        action_guard: RecoveryActionGuard,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

impl RecoveryDecisionCurrentFacts {
    /// Creates proposal facts from one application-supplied named-reader validation result.
    pub fn from_validated_local_facts(
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        assessment_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
        failure_classification_ref: Option<HostFailureClassificationRef>,
        prerequisites: ValidatedRecoveryPrerequisites,
        selected_prior_decision_ref: Option<HostRecoveryDecisionRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

impl RecoveryCommitGuard {
    /// Creates a one-shot guard from one application-supplied recovery-store/UoW preflight for an exact proposal.
    pub fn from_preflight(
        decision_ref: HostRecoveryDecisionRef,
        project_member_ref: ProjectMemberRef,
        global_member_ref: GlobalMemberRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        action: HostRecoveryAction,
        prerequisite_refs: RecoveryPrerequisiteRefSet,
        supersedes_ref: Option<HostRecoveryDecisionRef>,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}
```

| action | `RuntimeRecoveryEligibility` / unknown-effect rule | 唯一下游 guard 与禁止结论 |
|---|---|---|
| `Recover` | 在 `MSVC-UP-001` 未闭合期间只能为 `Blocked`、`Hold` 或 `Unknown`，unknown-effect 固定 `NotRequired`，不得出现 positive eligibility。 | 只允许 `RecoverRequiresFormalRuntimeHandoff`，且 blocker 未闭合时不得 commit；不得创建 Runtime run、session、checkpoint、tool execution或 local positive action attempt。 |
| `Restart` | 固定 `RestartRequiresCommittedGenerationGuard` + `MustBeEmptyAtGenerationGuard`；这只是未来 guard 需求而不是已通过资格。 | 只允许 `RestartRequiresGenerationFence`；仅由已 `Committed` decision、exact host-generation、freshly empty unknown-effect fence与 future Step 7 mapper / port / UoW 一起进入 `HostGenerationFence::guard_recovery_restart(...)`；不得降级为 `Launch`。 |
| `Stop` | `NotRequired + NotRequired`；只表示本对象不做 Runtime-recovery handoff / generation clearance，不代表 stop 已执行。 | 只允许 `StopRequiresClosureCandidate`；已 committed decision 仅可在 future application 通过 `HostClosureDecisionRef::from_recovery_ref(...)` 形成 CMP-MS-06 closure candidate；不创建 closure / cleanup。 |
| `Terminate` | 同 `Stop`，固定 `NotRequired + NotRequired`；不读取 Runtime state、Sandbox state 或 receipt。 | 只允许 `TerminateRequiresClosureCandidate`；已 committed decision 仅可形成 CMP-MS-06 closure candidate；不代表 Runtime stop、Sandbox release、carrier release、cleanup 或 external termination completed。 |
| `Hold` | `RuntimeRecoveryEligibility::Hold` + `NotRequired`；若本地 unknown-effect selection 不可用，可以以同一 redacted reason 改用 `UnknownEffectStateUnavailable`。两种组合都不允许把 missing prerequisite解释为 ready。 | 只允许 `HoldForbidsProgression`；不得形成 `HostActionDecisionRef`、`HostClosureDecisionRef`、Runtime handoff或新 generation。 |

`RecoveryDecisionReasonCode::from_recovery_classification(...)` 只接受已脱敏的 recovery classification，不接收 raw source、error、receipt或 external body。`RecoveryDecisionPlan::from_domain_evaluation(...)` 必须同时检查 action、canonical prerequisite set、already-redacted reason、eligibility、unknown-effect requirement和 guard 的唯一合法组合；`Blocked` / `Hold` / `Unknown` 中的 nested reason 必须与 plan reason 一致。`RecoveryDecisionCurrentFacts::from_validated_local_facts(...)` 必须复核双锚、host-generation、assessment / optional failure / set 的双向一致，并要求 optional prior decision 已由 named reader 验证为同 scope 的 current committed decision。`RecoveryCommitGuard::from_preflight(...)` 必须绑定具体 `decision_ref`、双锚、host-generation、action、canonical set 和 supersedes relation。上述 cross-crate factory 必须是 `pub`，因为 planned `member-service-application` 是独立 crate；但它们的字段仍私有，不是 contracts / protocol DTO，且 future Step 7 必须把调用点收束为唯一 named application reader、mapper、recovery store / UoW preflight。该调用约束是架构边界，不得伪称 Rust 的 crate visibility 已验证了 reader、preflight或外部 truth。它们都不读取 runtime、fence、receipt、endpoint/session、heartbeat、adapter或 fake；缺少 prerequisite scope validation、redaction input或 future mapper result时只返回 domain error / non-positive classification。`MustBeEmptyAtGenerationGuard` 从不缓存“已清空”结论，实际 empty check 只能在随后同一次 selected fence evaluation 重新进行。

#### `HostRecoveryDecision` 对象卡

| 项 | 契约 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostRecoveryDecision`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 19 个，表示一次 formal-control-bound、generation-bound 的本地 recovery disposition。 |
| owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::recovery` / planned `crates/domain/src/recovery.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-20` 与 future `IB-MS-012 DecideHostRecoveryCommand`；health / failure 仅为本地 factual input，不是 control source。 |
| 不拥有 | Runtime run/session/checkpoint、Member truth、Sandbox / backend / policy truth、image truth、governance approval、action attempt、closure、cleanup、repository、UoW、entry、port、event envelope或 external completion。 |

```rust
/// Records one formal, generation-bound local recovery decision.
pub struct HostRecoveryDecision {
    /// Stable locally owned decision identity.
    decision_id: HostRecoveryDecisionId,
    /// Exact logical host selected for the decision.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation selected with the host.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Selected local health assessment required by the canonical prerequisite set.
    assessment_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
    /// Optional local failure classification selected as supporting evidence.
    failure_classification_ref: Option<HostFailureClassificationRef>,
    /// The only accepted formal control-plane causal context.
    formal_context: FormalRecoveryContext,
    /// Closed action, prerequisite, reason, eligibility, clearance, and guard plan.
    plan: RecoveryDecisionPlan,
    /// Local decision lifecycle, shared with orchestration decisions but not with health state.
    decision_status: LocalDecisionStatus,
    /// Prior committed recovery decision replaced by this record, when applicable.
    supersedes_ref: Option<HostRecoveryDecisionRef>,
    /// Redacted invalidation reason retained only when this proposal is voided.
    void_reason_code: Option<RecoveryDecisionReasonCode>,
    /// Local causal correlation carried by the formal command mapping.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// Local time when this proposal was formed.
    proposed_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time of the latest allowed decision transition.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostRecoveryDecision {
    /// Proposes a recovery decision from validated local facts and one formal recovery context.
    pub fn propose(
        decision_id: HostRecoveryDecisionId,
        intent: &HostIntent,
        current_facts: RecoveryDecisionCurrentFacts,
        formal_context: FormalRecoveryContext,
        plan: RecoveryDecisionPlan,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        proposed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted local recovery decision without re-reading health or external owners.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        decision_id: HostRecoveryDecisionId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        assessment_ref: HostHealthAssessmentRef,
        failure_classification_ref: Option<HostFailureClassificationRef>,
        formal_context: FormalRecoveryContext,
        plan: RecoveryDecisionPlan,
        decision_status: LocalDecisionStatus,
        supersedes_ref: Option<HostRecoveryDecisionRef>,
        void_reason_code: Option<RecoveryDecisionReasonCode>,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        proposed_at: Timestamp,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Commits only a proposed decision after the action-specific local commit guard was supplied.
    pub fn commit(
        &mut self,
        commit_guard: RecoveryCommitGuard,
        committed_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Ends one committed decision's current local effect with an explicit replacement reference.
    pub fn supersede(
        &mut self,
        replacement_ref: HostRecoveryDecisionRef,
        superseded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Invalidates only a proposed decision before it can enter downstream progression.
    pub fn void(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: RecoveryDecisionReasonCode,
        voided_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this committed decision permits exactly the supplied local recovery action.
    pub fn permits(&self, action: HostRecoveryAction) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this decision is bound to the supplied exact host-generation pair.
    pub fn targets(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this is a committed Restart decision that still requires the generation guard.
    pub fn requires_new_generation(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this decision may only be wrapped as a CMP-MS-06 closure candidate.
    pub fn permits_closure_candidate(&self) -> bool;

    /// Returns the selected local recovery disposition without asserting downstream eligibility.
    pub fn action(&self) -> &HostRecoveryAction;

    /// Returns the local lifecycle of this decision record.
    pub fn decision_status(&self) -> &LocalDecisionStatus;

    /// Returns the redacted plan reason without exposing source or external error text.
    pub fn reason_code(&self) -> &RecoveryDecisionReasonCode;

    /// Returns the optional redacted void reason only for a voided proposal.
    pub fn void_reason_code(&self) -> Option<&RecoveryDecisionReasonCode>;

    /// Returns the typed local decision reference without asserting commitment or execution.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostRecoveryDecisionRef;
}
```

`RecoveryDecisionCurrentFacts` 与 `RecoveryCommitGuard` 都是 `recovery.rs` domain-only support value，不计入第 30 个业务对象。前者只能由 future named health/failure/prerequisite/current-fact reader形成，至少提供 exact 双锚、`host_ref + generation`、selected assessment、optional matching failure、`ValidatedRecoveryPrerequisites` 和 optional current committed prior decision；后者只能由 future Step 7 application mapper / recovery store / UoW preflight 以同一 decision ref、双锚、host-generation、plan action、canonical prerequisite set 和 supersedes relation形成。二者不带 Runtime/Sandbox/Member body、repository handle、DB lock、receipt、endpoint/session inference或 external effect result。

| 字段 / transition | 来源、校验与 fail-closed 规则 |
|---|---|
| `decision_id` / `proposed_at` / `updated_at` | 分别只来自 application id generator / local safe rehydrate 与 application clock / rehydrate；id 不从 health、failure、intent、action、generation、source或 timestamp 拼接。`propose(...)` 固定 `updated_at = proposed_at`；rehydrate 与每次 allowed transition 必须保持 `proposed_at <= updated_at`。 |
| target / assessment / failure / prior decision | `RecoveryDecisionCurrentFacts` 必须证明双锚、target、assessment、optional failure与已验证 prerequisite set 同一 host-generation；optional prior decision 必须是 same-scope current committed recovery decision，并成为新 record 的 `supersedes_ref`。assessment ref 存在不等于 `Current`，failure ref 存在不等于 `Confirmed`，prior ref 存在不使 prior 自动 superseded。 |
| `formal_context` | `propose(...)` 必须接收 loaded `HostIntent`，并以 `matches_accepted_control_context(...)` 复核 `Accepted` status、intent ref、source 和 scope；context 双锚还必须与 current facts 精确相等。不能从 assessment、failure、receipt、timeout、Query、Consumer、Job、fake或 endpoint/session构造。 |
| `plan` | action 与 guard/eligibility/unknown-effect combination必须匹配上表；reason 必须已裁剪；`Recover`在 `MSVC-UP-001` open 时不能通过 commit guard。 |
| `supersedes_ref` / `void_reason_code` | `supersedes_ref` 只从 validated current facts 的 optional prior-decision selection 取得；`void_reason_code` 在 `Proposed` 时固定 `None`，只有 `void(...)` 可以设为 `Some`，其余 status 必须为 `None`。rehydrate 必须检查 status / optionality 与 non-self relation。 |
| `commit(...)` | 仅 `Proposed -> Committed`。guard 必须精确匹配 `self.to_ref()`、双锚、host-generation、action、canonical prerequisites 和 supersedes relation，且 `committed_at >= updated_at`；成功时设 `updated_at = committed_at`。future same-UoW 必须先验证 current formal control / health facts与 action-specific guard；该方法不保存 record、不发 port、不建 Runtime run、不建 host、不清 unknown fence。 |
| `supersede(...)` | 仅 `Committed -> Superseded`；replacement 不得 self，`superseded_at >= updated_at`，成功时设 `updated_at = superseded_at`，且 future application 必须同一 UoW 创建/确认 matching replacement relation。它不执行 replacement、不调用 closure或 action。 |
| `void(...)` | 仅 `Proposed -> Voided`；`voided_at >= updated_at`，保存 independently redacted `void_reason_code`并设 `updated_at = voided_at`，不覆盖 plan 初始 reason。用于 formal input、prerequisite或 action guard不能继续满足的情况。已 committed record不可用 void 回写。 |
| `permits(...)` / `targets(...)` / `requires_new_generation()` | 纯检查 `Committed + exact action + plan guard`或 exact host-generation；`HostGenerationFence::guard_recovery_restart(...)` 必须同时使用 `targets(...)`。这些方法仍不代替 generation fence、unknown-effect check、UoW、port mapper或 external result。 |
| accessors / `to_ref()` | action、status、plan reason、optional void reason 和 typed ref 只供 local store / history / safe mapper 窄读取 | 不暴露 prerequisite body、formal source body或 external result；ref 不证明 committed 或已执行。 |

状态闭环固定如下，`LocalDecisionStatus` 与 health assessment record status、failure classification status / certainty、attempt status、closure status均不互相转换：

```text
Formal DecideHostRecoveryCommand + validated local facts
                         │
                         ▼
                     Proposed
                      ├─ invalidated before commit ─► Voided
                      └─ action-specific commit guard ─► Committed
                                                            │
                                                            └─ explicit replacement ─► Superseded
```

`Stop` / `Terminate` 的 `Committed` decision 仅能通过已加载 decision 的 `permits_closure_candidate()` 之后，交由 future application 包装为 `HostClosureDecisionRef::from_recovery_ref(...)` 的 **CMP-MS-06 candidate**。该 ref 不等于 `HostClosure`、cleanup attempt、Runtime stop、Sandbox release、carrier release或外部终止完成。`Recover` 不创建 Runtime run；`Restart` 只允许 future guard 创建新 logical host generation，绝不承诺 checkpoint、run、session或 tool execution 恢复。任何 receipt、timeout、fake、endpoint/session/heartbeat、backend availability、absence-of-error或 safe summary 都不能推导 `RuntimeRecoveryEligibility`、`RecoveryCommitGuard`、`HostActionDecisionRef` 或 generation-guard eligibility。

## 9.12 `domain / CMP-MS-06 / closure.rs, reconciliation.rs` 对象契约

### 9.12.1 本对象组写入边界、唯一 owner 与概要归一

本批只闭合冻结业务对象 `HostClosure`、`CleanupAttempt`、`ResidualFinding`、`ReconciliationCase`，以及令四者可逐项落码的 closure scope / invalidation / pending / gap、cleanup kind / local outcome classification、residual basis / affected target 与 reconciliation disposition / hold / escalation / resolution support value。它不新建 closure manager、cleanup worker record、Sandbox cleanup record、backend resource record、operator case、external observation record、Runtime stop record、Member status record、port、repository、UoW、entry、adapter、Job 或实现源码。

| 项 | 本批收口结论 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| `closure.rs` 唯一 owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::closure` / `crates/domain/src/closure.rs` 独占 `HostClosure`、`CleanupAttempt`、`HostClosureScope`、local invalidation / pending / gap / block / unknown support value、cleanup kind / status / reason / local outcome classification。 | 不在 application、worker、jobs、association、Sandbox adapter、fake 或 sibling 仓另存 closure、cleanup attempt、cleanup status、unknown key fence 或 local-completion judgment。 |
| `reconciliation.rs` 唯一 owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::reconciliation` / `crates/domain/src/reconciliation.rs` 独占 `ResidualFinding`、`ReconciliationCase`、residual basis / affected target / finding status、case disposition / hold / escalation / resolution support value。 | 不在 health、projection、Job、external owner、observability 或 query 中 shadow finding、case、resolution basis 或 disposition truth。 |
| frozen object denominator | `HostClosure`、`CleanupAttempt`、`ResidualFinding`、`ReconciliationCase` 分别是冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 20、21、22、23 个；scope、invalidation、pending item、gap、reason、status、basis、affected target、disposition、actor context、resolution 和 revision guard 都是 file-local support value。 | 不以“cleanup queue”“reconciliation worker”“external resource”“operator approval”“evidence report”补第 30 个业务对象，也不把 support value 当独立 repository truth。 |
| contracts import ceiling | 只导入 contracts-owned `HostClosureId/Ref`、`CleanupAttemptId/Ref`、`ResidualFindingId/Ref`、`ReconciliationCaseId/Ref`、`ClosureRevision`、`ReconciliationCaseRevision`、`CleanupAttemptRefSet`、`ResidualFindingRefSet`、`HostRef`、`HostGeneration`、`HostClosureDecisionRef`、`HostExternalAssociationRef`、typed external-safe ref / summary、`ExternalEffectKey`、`CorrelationId`、`HostRedactedCode` 与 Core `Timestamp`。 | 不在 domain 重定义 opaque id/ref/revision、用裸 `String` / JSON / generic external ref 替代 typed carrier，或把 repository expected-version、source version、cursor、receipt、backend id 当 semantic revision。 |
| closure candidate ceiling | `HostClosureDecisionRef` 只表示 application 已选中的 committed-decision **candidate**；`HostClosure::open` 仍只形成 local closure record，且 future application 必须重验 decision、host、generation、scope 与 current local facts。 | candidate 不得转换成 `HostClosureRef`，不得自行创建 cleanup / invalidation，不表示 Runtime stop、carrier/Sandbox release、external cleanup 或 host termination complete。 |
| cleanup causality separation | `CleanupAttempt` 是 CMP-MS-06 专属 side-effect record，独立于 CMP-MS-03 `HostActionAttempt`；它只在 closure scope 下处理 association release / cleanup，并保存自己的 immutable `ExternalEffectKey`。 | 不以 `HostActionAttempt` dispatch / outcome / unknown 状态承载 cleanup；unknown cleanup 不得 mint 新 key、换 target 或以 timeout/absence 盲重放。 |
| local versus external completion | `locally_closed`、cleanup `Succeeded`、finding `Resolved`、case `Resolved` 是四条不同的本地语义；本批只保存 local scope / matching / safe-summary / disposition conclusion。 | 不把它们相加、投影或命名为 `external_cleanup_completed`，不宣称 resource deleted、binding released、Sandbox reaper complete、backend state reconciled 或 owner accepted。 |
| external truth ceiling | L4-sandbox 继续拥有 sandbox backend、policy、isolation、bind / release / cleanup guard、reaper 和 cleanup truth；carrier / registry / Runtime / Member / Images / Core / Bus / SDK exact schema仍由各 owner 和 `MSVC-UP-001~008` 约束。 | 不保存 backend body、policy、container runtime、Runtime session/run、tool execution、credential、image content / digest / manifest、event envelope、route、receipt或 observability evidence。 |

概要层 placeholder 只按本批已有 carrier / domain support value归一；归一不关闭任何 sibling exact contract：

| `CAP-MS-21`：freeze closure scope / local invalidation / local-close boundary | formal `CloseHostCommand` 的 future mapped candidate、matching host / generation local facts、fixed scope、local clock | new closure id / revision；immutable scope；recorded local invalidation、pending / gap / residual classifications；only a local completion conclusion | `HostClosure`、`HostClosureScope`、`ClosureInvalidationSet`、`ClosurePendingItemSet`、`ClosureGapSet`、`HostClosureStatus` | Step 7 close-command / current-fact mapper、closure store/UoW、cross-record invalidation writer、safe history mapper；Step 8 `IB-MS-013`；Step 9 closure flow；Step 10/11/13 matrix/CAS。 |
| `CAP-MS-22`：local-first cleanup / release attempt | loaded matching closure + association、closure-scoped cleanup category、application-built original effect key / correlation、clock；future port result only as body-free safe mapped outcome | one independently persisted cleanup attempt before port boundary; dispatched / outcome / failed / unknown / gap / cancelled local classification; same effect key remains on the record | `CleanupAttempt`、`HostCleanupKind`、`CleanupAttemptStatus`、`CleanupOutcomeDisposition`、`CleanupGap` | Step 7 cleanup attempt store / selection / release-port / feedback mapper / unknown-key reader; Step 9 cleanup Job flow; Step 11 UoW; Step 13 idempotency / retry fence。 |
| `CAP-MS-23`：residual / orphan / drift / disputed finding | same-generation committed local facts, optionally matching closure, typed affected target, formal body-free residual observation, local clock | new finding and explicit open / confirmed / disputed / unknown / resolved / superseded local finding state; no repair or owner mutation | `ResidualFinding`、`ResidualBasis`、`ResidualAffectedTarget`、`ResidualFindingKind`、`ResidualFindingStatus` | Step 7 residual-basis reader / observation mapper / finding store; Step 9 reconcile Job flow; Step 10 matrix; Step 12 uncertainty mapping。 |
| `CAP-MS-24`：explicit reconciliation disposition | one or more same-host/generation findings, formal actor-context / local decision basis, optional matching cleanup attempt / resolution basis, local clock | a case with open / requested / holding / escalated / resolved / unknown state and append-only causal links; no implicit repair / restart / terminate | `ReconciliationCase`、`ReconciliationDisposition`、`ReconciliationCaseStatus`、`ReconciliationBasisSet`、hold / escalation / resolution support value | Step 7 case / finding reader-store-UoW, formal disposition mapper, cleanup authorization handoff, safe history mapper; Step 9 reconciliation Job flow; Step 11/13 CAS / duplicate guard。 |
| safe read / history basis | selected committed local closure / attempt / finding / case records plus independently resolved visibility / redaction result | only contracts-owned future safe slice / history material; no domain write and no external-result upgrade | narrow accessors; contracts safe mapper later | Step 7 read / history port; Step 8 query / publication protocol; Step 9 no-write query / append-only history flow。 |

`IB-MS-013` is the only formal close-command entry. `ProgressPendingHostCleanupJob` may select and progress an already committed `CleanupAttempt`; `ReconcileHostResidualsJob` may detect or classify from mapped facts, but it may not manufacture a closure candidate, implicit operator disposition, restart, terminate, or external cleanup result. Therefore `HostClosureStatus::LocallyClosed`、`CleanupAttemptStatus::Succeeded`、`ResidualFindingStatus::Resolved` 与 `ReconciliationCaseStatus::Resolved` cannot transition one another automatically.

### 9.12.3 CMP-MS-06 对象能力到字段 / factory / 函数 / state 映射

| 对象 | 对象能力 | 必需字段 | factory / 构造入口 | 成员函数 | state / classification | 字段来源 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostClosure` | 冻结一个 host generation 的 local closure scope、记录本地失效 / cleanup / pending / gap / residual，并在严格本地条件下给出 local-close judgment | local id；host / generation；closure decision candidate；immutable scope；invalidation / cleanup / pending / gap / residual sets；status；semantic revision；local times | `open(...)`；`rehydrate(...)` | `begin_invalidating`、`record_invalidation`、`record_cleanup_attempt`、`record_gap`、`record_residual`、`mark_blocked`、`hold_unknown`、`mark_locally_closed`、accessors / `to_ref` | `Open / Invalidating / CleanupPending / LocallyClosed / Residual / Blocked / Unknown` | id/time from application generator/clock or rehydrate; candidate/scope/current facts only formal mapper + named local reader; all children only matching typed local records。 |
| `CleanupAttempt` | 先于 external port 固化 closure-scoped cleanup side effect、original effect key、target association和safe outcome / uncertainty | local id；closure / host / generation；immutable target association ref；kind；effect key；correlation；status；optional safe outcome/reason/gap；local times | `prepare(...)`；`rehydrate(...)` | `mark_dispatched`、`record_outcome`、`mark_failed`、`mark_unknown`、`record_gap`、`cancel`、matching accessors / `to_ref` | `Prepared / Dispatched / Succeeded / Failed / Unknown / Gap / Cancelled` | id/key/correlation/time from application committed context; closure/association only loaded matching local records; outcome only formal cleanup-feedback mapper; no `HostActionAttempt` source。 |
| `ResidualFinding` | 用 canonical local basis 与 one safe observation固定一个 residual / orphan / drift / disputed comparison，并保留其 evolution chain | local id；host / generation；optional closure ref；kind；affected target；basis；status；optional case / replacement / resolution causal ref；reason；local times | `detect(...)`；`rehydrate(...)` | `confirm`、`dispute`、`mark_unknown`、`resolve`、`supersede`、`matches`、accessors / `to_ref` | `Open / Confirmed / Disputed / Resolved / Superseded / Unknown` | id/time from application; local refs from committed named reader; observation only formal mapper; kind/reason/status from closed domain comparison, never backend dump / Job guess。 |
| `ReconciliationCase` | 聚合 same-host/generation findings，表达被授权的本地 disposition / hold / escalation / resolution，并记录 case-local revision | local id；host / generation；canonical finding refs；disposition; status; basis; optional cleanup refs; actor context; optional resolution basis; semantic revision; local times | `open(...)`；`rehydrate(...)` | `add_finding`、`decide`、`link_cleanup_attempt`、`hold`、`escalate`、`resolve`、`mark_unknown`、accessors / `to_ref` | `Open / ActionRequested / Holding / Escalated / Resolved / Unknown` | id/time from application; findings / cleanup only matching committed local records; actor / resolution only formal mapper or local reader; disposition is local, not external owner state。 |

所有 factory 只构造本地 domain object或 support value，不能证明对象已被 store、同一 UoW 已提交、port 已调用、safe summary 为 external completion、Sandbox backend已执行 cleanup、carrier / registry resource 已删除或 external owner已接受处置。缺 formal mapper、same-scope reader、redaction、time、basis、original key或 future expected-version/CAS witness时，application必须停在 owning `rejected` / `blocked` / `waiting` / `unknown` / `gap` surface，不得补默认正向值。

### 9.12.4 `closure.rs`：closure scope、local invalidation、pending / gap 与 cleanup support value

`HostClosureScope` 是随 `HostClosure` 一次性冻结的 local selection，不是 live current pointer、repository query、runtime state、cleanup plan、Sandbox policy或 external scope。它必须在 future application 的同一次 local fact selection中取得，并覆盖 registration、endpoint、Host Session与 association 四类本地关联：已存在项以对应 typed local ref 入 scope；已由 reader 明确确认“该世代此轴没有可失效记录”的项以 private `NoMatchingRecordAtOpen` marker 入 scope。不能以空 vector、absence of callback、backend query或 adapter error推断任何一轴已经没有义务。

| support value | 唯一 owner / 作用 | 输入 / invariant | 明确不表示 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HostClosureScope` | `closure.rs`；immutable four-axis closure selection | 四轴皆必须显式；association members use canonical `HostExternalAssociationRef` order; each present ref is later revalidated by named reader as same host/generation；`NoMatchingRecordAtOpen` 只能来自 named local reader。 | current pointer、host terminated、association released、external resource absence、future automatic scope refresh。 |
| `ClosureInvalidationSet` / `ClosureInvalidation` | `closure.rs`；记录已接受的 local registration / endpoint / session / association invalidation classification | one item per scope member; exact ref/kind must belong to frozen scope; canonical order follows scope order; duplicate、out-of-scope、different-generation或 automatic sorting/replacement rejected。 | deletion、external revoke / release、Member/Runtime/Sandbox acknowledgement or cleanup complete。 |
| `ClosurePendingItemSet` / `ClosurePendingItem` | `closure.rs`；以 explicit local kind / ref / redacted reason保留尚未结清的 local invalidation、cleanup、feedback、gap或 residual work | key is closed `(kind, typed-local-ref-or-scope-member)`; canonical order fixed; item can only be removed by an explicit matching local transition, never by time elapsed or missing response。 | queue lease、retry schedule、external action acceptance or work completion。 |
| `ClosureGapSet` / `ClosureGap` | `closure.rs`；保留 named contract / mapper / owner / feedback gap与 redacted reason | every gap has a closed local category, optional matching cleanup ref only when already created, and local recorded time; no raw error / route / receipt body。 | L4-sandbox policy/backend truth、Core/Bus route defect、operator action或 external rejection fact。 |
| `HostClosureStatus` / `ClosureBlockReasonCode` | `closure.rs`；closure-local lifecycle and redacted non-positive classification | status/payload combination is validated by `open` / transition / `rehydrate`; `Blocked` always carries redacted local reason; no status infers another object axis。 | host lifecycle state、cleanup attempt state、finding/case result or external completion。 |
| `HostCleanupKind` / `CleanupAttemptStatus` / `CleanupAttemptReasonCode` / `CleanupGap` | `closure.rs`；close-only cleanup category、local attempt lifecycle、redacted reason和gap | closed cleanup kinds are `CarrierOrBackendAssociationRelease`、`SandboxBindingRelease`、`PinnedAssetAssociationCleanup`; no `RuntimeStop`、tool invocation、generic backend operation or policy variant; status/reason/outcome/gap combinations are sealed below。 | target owner schema、Sandbox policy decision、runtime action、tool execution、resource deletion or external cleanup truth。 |
