`HostClosureScope`、`ClosureInvalidationSet`、`ClosurePendingItemSet` 与 `ClosureGapSet` 均为 heterogeneous domain-only set，故不得塞入 `contracts::refs` 的 homogeneous ref set，也不得退回 `Vec<String>`。它们的 constructors / rehydrate 必须拒绝空 key、scope 外 item、duplicate、乱序、跨 host / generation input和未映射 raw body；不得自动排序、去重或以 optional 缺失消除义务。

### 9.12.5 `closure.rs`：`HostClosureStatus` 与 `CleanupAttemptStatus` 状态 / payload matrix

```rust
/// Expresses only the locally recorded progression of a frozen host-closure scope.
pub enum HostClosureStatus {
    /// Scope exists but no local invalidation has been recorded yet.
    Open,
    /// Matching scope members are being explicitly invalidated.
    Invalidating,
    /// Local invalidation has advanced and named cleanup / feedback work remains.
    CleanupPending,
    /// All required local bookkeeping for this frozen scope is settled locally.
    LocallyClosed,
    /// A matching residual finding remains for this closure scope.
    Residual,
    /// A required local mapper, owner, or contract gap blocks safe progression.
    Blocked { reason_code: ClosureBlockReasonCode },
    /// A local cleanup effect or required local result cannot be safely determined.
    Unknown { causality: ClosureUnknownCausality, reason_code: ClosureBlockReasonCode },
}

/// Classifies the local lifecycle of one closure-scoped cleanup attempt.
pub enum CleanupAttemptStatus {
    Prepared,
    Dispatched,
    Succeeded,
    Failed,
    Unknown,
    Gap,
    Cancelled,
}

/// Identifies the already-existing local causality retained when a closure cannot safely progress.
pub enum ClosureUnknownCausality {
    /// A matching cleanup attempt retains its own original effect key.
    CleanupAttempt(CleanupAttemptRef),
    /// No external side effect is claimed; a required local scope fact is structurally unavailable.
    ScopeFactUnavailable,
}
```

| closure status | required set / payload condition | allowed source | explicitly not equivalent to |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Open` | frozen scope exists; no invalidation accepted; no cleanup attempt ref / gap / residual may be hidden | `HostClosure::open` / valid rehydrate | command accepted、host quiescing / terminated、cleanup request or external action。 |
| `Invalidating` | at least one matching invalidation transition is in progress or accepted; unresolved scope items remain explicit pending items | `begin_invalidating` / `record_invalidation` | registration / endpoint / session / association externally revoked or removed。 |
| `CleanupPending` | all required local invalidations are recorded; outstanding cleanup attempt, feedback, gap or explicit pending item remains | `record_invalidation` / `record_cleanup_attempt` / valid rehydrate | cleanup dispatched、accepted、succeeded、resource released or external cleanup completed。 |
| `LocallyClosed` | all frozen-scope local invalidations and local pending ledger are explicitly settled; no unresolved gap, unknown cleanup, unresolved residual or pending cleanup remains | `mark_locally_closed` only | any external cleanup, deletion, release, reaper outcome, owner acceptance or reconciled backend state。 |
| `Residual` | canonical matching residual finding ref is retained and local case handling is required | `record_residual` | residual confirmed by external owner、case resolved or external repair complete。 |
| `Blocked { reason }` | redacted reason plus at least one matching pending/gap item is retained | `mark_blocked` / valid rehydrate | permanent failure, external rejection or policy decision。 |
| `Unknown { causality, reason }` | redacted reason required; `CleanupAttempt` must be in the closure set, same host/generation and itself retain original effect key; `ScopeFactUnavailable` must not be used to hide a side effect | `hold_unknown` / valid rehydrate | safe retry, fresh effect key, external unavailability or completion。 |

| cleanup status | required summary / reason / gap combination | effect-key rule | explicitly not equivalent to |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Prepared` | no outcome, no reason, no gap, `dispatched_at=None` | immutable original key is already retained before any port boundary | request created externally。 |
| `Dispatched` | no outcome, no gap; local `dispatched_at=Some`; any local call witness is body-free and non-authoritative | same original key continues | owner accepted or completed cleanup。 |
| `Succeeded` | matching `HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary=Some`; no gap; optional redacted local classification only if it agrees with success | same original key remains historic | resource released / deleted, Sandbox cleanup complete or closure locally closed。 |
| `Failed` | matching body-free cleanup summary and redacted local failure reason required; no hidden gap | key remains historic; retry requires a new explicit future disposition, not blind redispatch | final external failure or a resolved residual。 |
| `Unknown` | no outcome; redacted reason required; no gap; original key stays immutable and fenced | no new key / target / attempt may bypass this unknown effect | timeout equals failure, safe retry or external state known。 |
| `Gap` | no outcome; redacted reason and named `CleanupGap` required | original key retained; no cross-key retry | no work needed or owner refused cleanup。 |
| `Cancelled` | no outcome; explicit redacted pre-dispatch cancellation reason; `dispatched_at=None` | key remains historical; cannot be repurposed for another target | rollback of a dispatched / unknown effect or external cancellation。 |

`CleanupAttemptStatus` is not a generic retry policy. A future Step 7 selector may examine it only after loading the same attempt, closure, association, original effect key and expected store version. It must never move `Unknown` / `Gap` by minting a new key or accept `Succeeded` as Sandbox/backend cleanup truth.

### 9.12.6 `closure.rs`：`HostClosure` 对象契约

#### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `HostClosure`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 20 个，表示一个已冻结 host generation 的本地收束范围、local invalidation / cleanup / residual 账本和严格的 local-completion judgment。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::closure` / `crates/domain/src/closure.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-21` 的 explicit close / local invalidation / local-close boundary；它消费 `HostClosureDecisionRef` candidate而不拥有 decision truth。 |
| 主要责任 | 固定 host、generation、candidate和scope；只追加 matching local invalidation、cleanup attempt、pending、gap、residual和non-positive classification；以 semantic revision保护 local mutation sequence。 |
| 不拥有 | host lifecycle、current pointer、registration / endpoint / Host Session record、association target / release truth、cleanup side effect、Sandbox policy/backend/reaper、carrier/registry owner、Runtime stop/run、Member state、external observation、case disposition、repository/UoW/CAS、history/outbox。 |

#### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records the locally owned closure ledger for one frozen host generation.
pub struct HostClosure {
    /// Stable locally owned identity of this closure record.
    closure_id: HostClosureId,
    /// Logical host whose local scope is being closed.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable generation selected when this closure was opened.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Restricted local decision causality; not a closure or cleanup completion proof.
    decision_ref: HostClosureDecisionRef,
    /// Immutable four-axis local selection frozen at open time.
    closure_scope: HostClosureScope,
    /// Canonical local invalidation facts for members of the frozen scope.
    invalidations: ClosureInvalidationSet,
    /// Canonical local cleanup attempts created under this closure.
    cleanup_attempt_refs: CleanupAttemptRefSet,
    /// Explicit named local work that remains unresolved.
    pending_items: ClosurePendingItemSet,
    /// Explicit contract / mapper / owner / feedback gaps.
    gaps: ClosureGapSet,
    /// Canonical local residual findings that still concern this closure.
    residual_finding_refs: ResidualFindingRefSet,
    /// Closure-local state, never an external cleanup lifecycle.
    closure_status: HostClosureStatus,
    /// Monotonic semantic revision of accepted closure-local mutations.
    revision: ClosureRevision,
    /// Local time at which this immutable scope was opened.
    opened_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time of the latest accepted closure-local mutation.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl HostClosure {
    /// Opens a local closure ledger from a typed candidate and a fully selected immutable scope.
    pub fn open(
        closure_id: HostClosureId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        decision_ref: HostClosureDecisionRef,
        closure_scope: HostClosureScope,
        opened_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted local closure without refreshing current facts or any external owner.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        closure_id: HostClosureId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        decision_ref: HostClosureDecisionRef,
        closure_scope: HostClosureScope,
        invalidations: ClosureInvalidationSet,
        cleanup_attempt_refs: CleanupAttemptRefSet,
        pending_items: ClosurePendingItemSet,
        gaps: ClosureGapSet,
        residual_finding_refs: ResidualFindingRefSet,
        closure_status: HostClosureStatus,
        revision: ClosureRevision,
        opened_at: Timestamp,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Begins explicit local invalidation of the frozen scope.
    pub fn begin_invalidating(&mut self, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Appends one matching local invalidation without deleting the affected record.
    pub fn record_invalidation(
        &mut self,
        invalidation: ClosureInvalidation,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Links one prepared matching cleanup attempt and makes its local work explicit.
    pub fn record_cleanup_attempt(
        &mut self,
        cleanup_attempt: &CleanupAttempt,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records one named local gap without treating it as external failure.
    pub fn record_gap(&mut self, gap: ClosureGap, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Links one matching residual finding without resolving the finding or a case.
    pub fn record_residual(
        &mut self,
        finding: &ResidualFinding,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Holds safe progression for an explicit local blocker while retaining pending work.
    pub fn mark_blocked(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: ClosureBlockReasonCode,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Retains an indeterminate matching cleanup causality without changing its effect key.
    pub fn hold_unknown(
        &mut self,
        causality: ClosureUnknownCausality,
        reason_code: ClosureBlockReasonCode,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records only the strict local completion of this frozen scope.
    pub fn mark_locally_closed(
        &mut self,
        expected_revision: ClosureRevision,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether a local child belongs to this exact host-generation closure.
    pub fn matches_host_generation(&self, host_ref: &HostRef, generation: &HostGeneration) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local closure reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostClosureRef;

    /// Returns only the closure-local state.
    pub fn closure_status(&self) -> &HostClosureStatus;

    /// Returns the current local semantic revision, never a store expected-version.
    pub fn revision(&self) -> ClosureRevision;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `closure_id` | `HostClosureId` | 定位本地 closure record | application id generator 或 local safe rehydrate；不由 decision、host、generation、cleanup key、backend / binding id、timestamp或 external body派生。 |
| `host_ref` + `generation` | `HostRef` + `HostGeneration` | 锁定本 closure 的 local subject | `open`只接受同次 formal close mapping + named local current-fact selection；所有 child / scope ref的 same-host/generation 实体存在性由 future reader再验证；不从 callback、summary或 target text推断。 |
| `decision_ref` | `HostClosureDecisionRef` | 保留已选择 closure candidate 的来源类别 | 只能由 application 在 loaded committed / permitted decision 与 host / generation guard 后提供；该 ref 本身不证明 guard仍新鲜、scope已失效或 closure已创建。 |
| `closure_scope` | `HostClosureScope` | 冻结四轴 local record selection及 explicit no-record-at-open marker | `open`写一次后不可替换；scope只由 same-selection current-fact reader输出；不能按后到 event、backend query、new registration / session或 association自动扩容。 |
| `invalidations` | `ClosureInvalidationSet` | 留存已接受 local invalidation classification | only `record_invalidation`或 valid rehydrate；每项必须严格匹配 frozen scope；不删被失效的 sibling record。 |
| `cleanup_attempt_refs` | `CleanupAttemptRefSet` | 回链 closure 下的 local cleanup effects | `record_cleanup_attempt`只加入 prepared matching attempt，canonical order且不重复；ref不表示 port call或 external release。 |
| `pending_items` / `gaps` | domain-only canonical set | 显式防止 missing work / contract gap 被隐去 | only matching transition改变；任何 `Unknown`、unresolved cleanup、scope incomplete、feedback gap或 residual都必须有对应 pending / gap material；不当 worker queue / retry timer。 |
| `residual_finding_refs` | `ResidualFindingRefSet` | 保留需 reconciliation 的 local finding | only `record_residual`或 rehydrate；same host/generation/optional closure match由 loaded finding验证；finding ref不表示 confirmed、case opened或 resolved。 |
| `closure_status` | `HostClosureStatus` | 保存 closure-local progression | initial only `Open`；status与 set/payload matrix必须相符；不按 host lifecycle、cleanup outcome、case outcome或 external observation自动变化。 |
| `revision` | `ClosureRevision` | 保证同一 closure record accepted semantic mutation序列可检测 | `open=initial()`；每个有效本对象 transition / set mutation恰 `next_after()` 一次；不等于 repository expected-version/CAS、generation、case revision、source version或 cursor。 |
| `opened_at` / `updated_at` | `Timestamp` | local open 与 latest accepted local mutation time | application clock output / safe rehydrate；`opened_at <= updated_at`；不是 command source time、external observation、port call、receipt、resource release或 DB commit time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `open(...)` | 建立 `Open` local closure | scope必须四轴明确、canonical且无 raw body；candidate只为 typed causality。它不验证 decision store、current pointer、actor authorization、host lifecycle或 external state，不写 invalidation/cleanup，不发 port。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 重建本地 closure | 必须重验 scope、set canonical order、child ref uniqueness、status/payload matrix、revision/time order和closure-local causal relation；不读对端、不刷新 scope、不补缺 gap或 effect key。 |
| `begin_invalidating(...)` | `Open -> Invalidating` | 仅 `Open`允许；创建 / 保留 required pending entries，不变更 registration/endpoint/session/association对象本身。future application UoW才协调那些 object mutations。 |
| `record_invalidation(...)` | 追加 matching local invalidation | 仅 `Invalidating`；invalidation subject必须属于 scope且尚未记录；通过后递增 revision。它不执行 revoke、close、release或 delete。所有 scope item齐备后，仅能进入 `CleanupPending`或 `Blocked` / `Unknown`，不会直接 `LocallyClosed`。 |
| `record_cleanup_attempt(...)` | 把 local-first cleanup attempt纳入 closure | 只允许 `Invalidating` / `CleanupPending`；attempt必须 `Prepared`、closure/host/generation精确匹配、target association存在于 frozen scope、effect key非空且 ref未收录。它只记录 local relation和pending item，不能 dispatch cleanup。 |
| `record_gap(...)` / `mark_blocked(...)` | 保留非正向缺口 | gap必须是 closed category；`mark_blocked`必须保留至少一个 matching pending/gap。它们不代表 owner拒绝、port调用或 permanent failure。 |
| `record_residual(...)` | 进入 / 保持 local residual branch | finding必须与 host/generation及 optional closure ref精确匹配，并保留 canonical ref和pending item。`LocallyClosed`接到新 matching finding时只可转为 `Residual`，绝不回到 `Open`；不自动开 case或修复 resource。 |
| `hold_unknown(...)` | 进入 `Unknown` fail-closed branch | `CleanupAttempt` causality必须已在 cleanup set、same host/generation，且 attempt已是 `Unknown`并保留原 key；`ScopeFactUnavailable`只可表示无 side effect的 structural gap。它不创建 retry / attempt / key。 |
| `mark_locally_closed(...)` | 给出 strict local completion | only `CleanupPending`；`expected_revision`只比较 local semantic revision、不是 repository CAS token；必须所有 scope invalidation都已记录，pending / gap / residual为空，且每个 recorded cleanup attempt都处在 locally settled `Succeeded`或允许的 pre-dispatch `Cancelled`（无未知 effect）状态。它不检查或宣称 external target state、release receipt、Sandbox cleanup或 resource deletion。 |
| accessors / `matches_host_generation` / `to_ref` | 暴露窄 local surface | pure；不会读取 current pointer、判定 closure current、做 store lookup或表达 external completion。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| immutable scope / append-only causal ledger | scope、host、generation和decision ref不可被 replacement / recovery / later observation原地改写；invalidation、attempt、gap、residual只能以 typed canonical link追加，历史由 future history mapper另行 materialize。 |
| locally closed is deliberately narrow | `LocallyClosed`只说明本对象冻结的 local bookkeeping已满足；它既不替代 `MemberExecutionHost::Terminated`，也不蕴含 `CleanupAttempt::Succeeded` 的 external effect、`HostExternalAssociation::Released`、finding/case resolved或 Sandbox cleanup truth。 |
| no cross-axis mutation | closure不直接修改 registration / endpoint / session / association / health / recovery / Runtime / Sandbox object；future application必须以 named local reader + UoW协调每个对象自己的 member function。 |
| non-positive facts survive | `Blocked`、`Unknown`、gap、residual、attempt ref和reason不因 Job tick、timeout、query、fake或 resource absence被删除；任何后续正式事实也只能显式形成新的 local transition / history，而不覆盖源记录。 |

### 9.12.7 `closure.rs`：`CleanupAttempt` 对象契约

#### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `CleanupAttempt`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 21 个，表示一个 closure 下、指向一条 immutable local association 的 local-first release / cleanup side-effect record。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::closure` / `crates/domain/src/closure.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-22`；为 `ProgressPendingHostCleanupJob` 的 future selection和 `HostExternalAssociation` release matching提供唯一 local causality。 |
| 主要责任 | 在任何 release port 前固定 closure / association / host / generation / kind / original key / correlation；只保存 local dispatch、body-free mapped outcome、failure / unknown / gap / cancellation分类。 |
| 不拥有 | cleanup request body、port、receipt、retry schedule、Sandbox/carrier/registry resource、binding policy、backend cleanup/reaper truth、host action decision、Runtime stop、tool execution、association lifecycle、closure status、case disposition、store/UoW。 |

#### Rust-facing shape

```rust
/// Records one closure-scoped cleanup effect before any external release boundary is crossed.
pub struct CleanupAttempt {
    /// Stable locally owned identity of this cleanup attempt.
    cleanup_attempt_id: CleanupAttemptId,
    /// Closure under which this attempt was prepared.
    closure_ref: HostClosureRef,
    /// Logical host copied from the matching closure and association.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable generation copied from the matching closure and association.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Immutable local association whose target is the sole cleanup target.
    target_association_ref: HostExternalAssociationRef,
    /// Closed local cleanup category compatible with that association.
    cleanup_kind: HostCleanupKind,
    /// Immutable original external-effect key; unknown never replaces it.
    effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
    /// Local causal correlation for this one attempt.
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// Local attempt state, not a Sandbox/backend lifecycle.
    attempt_status: CleanupAttemptStatus,
    /// Compatible body-free cleanup outcome when locally recorded.
    cleanup_outcome: Option<HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary>,
    /// Redacted local non-positive reason when required by the status matrix.
    reason_code: Option<CleanupAttemptReasonCode>,
    /// Named local contract / mapper / feedback gap when required by the status matrix.
    gap: Option<CleanupGap>,
    /// Local time at which the attempt was prepared before external work.
    prepared_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time at which the release port boundary was crossed, when that happened.
    dispatched_at: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// Local time of the latest accepted attempt-local mutation.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

/// Classifies an already mapped cleanup result without upgrading it to external cleanup truth.
pub enum CleanupOutcomeDisposition {
    Succeeded { summary: HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary },
    Failed {
        summary: HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary,
        reason_code: CleanupAttemptReasonCode,
    },
}

impl CleanupAttempt {
    /// Prepares an independent local cleanup attempt from one matching closure and active association.
    pub fn prepare(
        cleanup_attempt_id: CleanupAttemptId,
        closure: &HostClosure,
        association: &HostExternalAssociation,
        cleanup_kind: HostCleanupKind,
        effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        prepared_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted cleanup attempt without calling a port or checking an external owner.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        cleanup_attempt_id: CleanupAttemptId,
        closure_ref: HostClosureRef,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        target_association_ref: HostExternalAssociationRef,
        cleanup_kind: HostCleanupKind,
        effect_key: ExternalEffectKey,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        attempt_status: CleanupAttemptStatus,
        cleanup_outcome: Option<HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary>,
        reason_code: Option<CleanupAttemptReasonCode>,
        gap: Option<CleanupGap>,
        prepared_at: Timestamp,
        dispatched_at: Option<Timestamp>,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Records only the local crossing of the future cleanup-release port.
    pub fn mark_dispatched(&mut self, dispatched_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records a matching body-free local cleanup outcome classification.
    pub fn record_outcome(
        &mut self,
        outcome: CleanupOutcomeDisposition,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Retains an indeterminate post-dispatch effect without changing key or target.
    pub fn mark_unknown(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: CleanupAttemptReasonCode,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Retains a named non-positive port / mapper / feedback gap.
    pub fn record_gap(&mut self, gap: CleanupGap, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Cancels only an attempt that has never crossed the external port boundary.
    pub fn cancel(
        &mut self,
        reason_code: CleanupAttemptReasonCode,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether this attempt exactly targets the supplied local association.
    pub fn matches_association(&self, association: &HostExternalAssociation) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this attempt belongs to the supplied local closure.
    pub fn matches_closure(&self, closure: &HostClosure) -> bool;

    /// Returns the immutable original effect key for same-key matching only.
    pub fn effect_key(&self) -> &ExternalEffectKey;

    /// Returns the typed local cleanup-attempt reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> CleanupAttemptRef;
}
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cleanup_attempt_id` | `CleanupAttemptId` | 定位本地 cleanup effect record | application generator / safe rehydrate；不是 external request、receipt、binding、resource或 action attempt identity。 |
| `closure_ref` + `host_ref` + `generation` | typed local closure ref + subject | 锚定 close scope与同一实例世代 | `prepare`只从 loaded matching closure / association复制；不得从 effect key、target ref text、source summary、callback、host current pointer或 Sandbox observation推断。 |
| `target_association_ref` + `cleanup_kind` | `HostExternalAssociationRef` + closed kind | 令 association record成为唯一 immutable cleanup target | `prepare`只接受 matching `Active` association且 kind-compatible；association target immutable，故 exact same association ref是“same association target”的必要条件。它不保存 generic resource body。 |
| `effect_key` + `correlation_id` | `ExternalEffectKey` + `CorrelationId` | 稳定关联 cleanup side effect与local causality | application在 local-first persistence context形成；empty / replacement / cross-attempt reuse拒绝。`Unknown` / `Gap`保留原 key，future retries必须经新 formal disposition和same-key reader，不可 bypass。 |
| `attempt_status` / `cleanup_outcome` / `reason_code` / `gap` | closed status + optional safe / redacted payload | 保存 narrow local attempt classification | only matrix-legal combinations；outcome只来自 compatible formal cleanup-feedback mapper；summary不包含 request/receipt/body / external completion。 |
| `prepared_at` / `dispatched_at` / `updated_at` | local timestamps | 区分 local preparation、port boundary与latest local decision | `prepared_at <= dispatched_at <= updated_at` when dispatched; application clock / rehydrate only；none is external time、owner accepted-at或 cleanup finished-at。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `prepare(...)` | 建立 `Prepared` local cleanup attempt | closure与association必须 host / generation精确相同；association必须属于 frozen scope、状态为 `Active`且 cleanup kind-compatible；new attempt保留 own original key和correlation。它不把 association改为 `ReleasePending`、不写 closure set、不插 port。future application在同一 UoW中才可调用 `closure.record_cleanup_attempt(...)` 与 `association.request_release(...)`。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 重建 attempt | 重验非空 identity/key/correlation、status/payload matrix、time order和kind结构；future aggregate rehydrate / reader必须再验证 closure / association / host / generation / key relation。它不联系 external owner，不以 missing outcome替为 unknown。 |
| `mark_dispatched(...)` | `Prepared -> Dispatched` | 只记录 local port-crossing time；必须晚于 `prepared_at`，不能写 receipt、accepted或 completed。无 local saved attempt / UoW witness时 future application不得跨 port。 |
| `record_outcome(...)` | `Dispatched -> Succeeded | Failed` | outcome summary必须为 `CleanupOutcome` typed wrapper，且 future mapper / application必须已匹配 same cleanup ref、same closure / association / host / generation / original key / correlation。`Succeeded`仅 local matching classification；`Failed`必须有 redacted reason。 |
| `mark_unknown(...)` | `Dispatched -> Unknown` | 保留同一 target / key / correlation与redacted reason；不得由 timeout、fake或 no feedback自动调用；future association只能以这个 same ref进入 `Unknown`。 |
| `record_gap(...)` | `Prepared | Dispatched -> Gap` | gap必须说明 local contract / mapper / owner / feedback absence；若已 `Dispatched`，不能把 gap解释为无 effect，key仍fenced。它不进行 retry。 |
| `cancel(...)` | `Prepared -> Cancelled` | only pre-dispatch；reason required；绝不取消 / 覆盖 `Dispatched` / `Unknown` effect。 |
| `matches_association(...)` | 供 release matching做 strict local equality | true only when immutable `target_association_ref`、host、generation与 supplied association都精确一致，且 association is the same typed target relation; it does not compare or claim external resource state。 |
| `matches_closure(...)` / accessors | 暴露 narrow local matching surface | pure；不加载 closure、port、receipt、current pointer或 external owner。 |

`HostExternalAssociation::request_release(&CleanupAttempt, ...)` 与 `record_release_outcome(&CleanupAttempt, ...)` 的跨对象闭合规则固定如下：两者都必须先验证 `cleanup_attempt.matches_association(self)`；这同时要求 **same immutable association target、same host、same generation**。`request_release` 只接受 `Prepared` / `Dispatched` cleanup attempt；`record_release_outcome`还要求 `self` 已保存同一 `CleanupAttemptRef`、attempt为 `Succeeded`，并使用该 attempt的**original, unchanged** `ExternalEffectKey`进行 future feedback match。一个 `HostActionAttemptRef`、另一 cleanup attempt、fresh key、仅同 host/generation、target text相似、receipt、timeout、fake或 backend observation都不足以成立 release match。

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| separate effect lane | cleanup attempt从不借用 `HostActionAttempt` id / status / effect key / dispatch method；source association causality仍在 `HostActionAttemptRef`，release causality只在 `CleanupAttemptRef`。 |
| local first, no port proof | `Prepared`在 external port前持久化，`Dispatched`只说明本地越过 port；二者均不代表 Sandbox / carrier / registry owner接收、执行或完成。 |
| same-key unknown fence | unknown / post-dispatch gap永远保留 original key、target和correlation；不得 new-key retry、换 association、clone attempt、删记录或用 absence-of-error解除。future store / UoW / selector必须实现同键查找和拒绝盲重放。 |
| no external completion shortcut | `Succeeded`只是 matching safe summary被本地记录；它不改变 `HostClosure` 到 `LocallyClosed`，不删除 association，不表示 resource release / Sandbox cleanup / reaper / external reconciliation complete。 |

### 9.12.8 `reconciliation.rs`：residual / reconciliation support value、来源与权限栅栏

#### 受影响目标与 residual 对照基线

`ResidualAffectedTarget` 是 finding 进行本地比较时的 closed target category，不是 generic external-resource model，也不能由它读取、创建、更新或删除任何外部资源。每个 `ResidualFinding` 恰有一个 immutable affected target；同一 host / generation 的多个 target 或多条 observation 必须形成不同 finding，不能折叠为一个“backend residual”。

~~~rust
/// Classifies the one typed target against which a local residual finding is compared.
pub enum ResidualAffectedTarget {
    /// A locally owned association record, not the external resource behind it.
    Association(HostExternalAssociationRef),
    /// A body-free carrier, registry, asset, or backend resource reference.
    CarrierOrBackendResource(HostCarrierOrBackendResourceRef),
    /// A body-free host-level Sandbox binding reference.
    SandboxBinding(HostSandboxBindingRef),
    /// A body-free cleanup-target reference supplied by a formal mapper.
    CleanupTarget(HostCleanupTargetRef),
}

/// Retains one body-free local input to a residual comparison.
pub enum ResidualBasis {
    /// Required local comparison scope; exactly one is present and is ordered first.
    HostScope { host_ref: HostRef, generation: HostGeneration },
    /// Optional locally owned closure causal relation.
    Closure(HostClosureRef),
    /// A committed local registration record.
    Registration(HostRegistrationRef),
    /// A committed local endpoint record.
    Endpoint(HostEndpointRef),
    /// A committed local Host Session shell.
    Session(HostSessionRef),
    /// A committed local host-external association record.
    Association(HostExternalAssociationRef),
    /// A committed local closure-cleanup attempt.
    CleanupAttempt(CleanupAttemptRef),
    /// A committed local health assessment.
    HealthAssessment(HostHealthAssessmentRef),
    /// A committed local failure classification.
    FailureClassification(HostFailureClassificationRef),
    /// The one allowed body-free external observation for this comparison.
    Observation(HostResidualObservationSafeSummary),
}

/// Stores a canonical, duplicate-free residual comparison basis.
pub struct ResidualBasisSet(Vec<ResidualBasis>);
~~~

| value / field | 唯一 owner、输入与不变量 | 明确不表示 |
|---|---|---|
| `ResidualAffectedTarget::Association` | 只接受已保存 `HostExternalAssociationRef`；future named reader仍须验证 association 属于同一 host / generation。它比较的是 local association identity，而非 target text或 backend object。 | association `Active` / `Released`、resource存在、carrier lifecycle、release / cleanup completed。 |
| `CarrierOrBackendResource` / `SandboxBinding` / `CleanupTarget` | 只接受 contracts 已封口的 role-specific body-free safe ref；formal mapper或 safe rehydrate 才能提供。不同 variant 即使 opaque text 相同也不相等、不可转换。 | container / backend body、Sandbox policy / isolation、binding state、cleanup request / receipt、owner acceptance或 external state。 |
| `ResidualBasis::HostScope` | 每个 set 恰一条，必须是第一项，且与 finding 的 `host_ref + generation` 精确相等。它只作为 local comparison anchor。 | L1 membership / Governance authority、host currentness、repository selection、external owner scope。 |
| local-record variants | 注册、endpoint、session、association、cleanup、assessment、failure只能从 committed typed local reader输入；future mapper必须逐项验证 same host / generation，并在 optional closure relation存在时验证 closure relation。 | 这些对象的 current / healthy / accepted / released / recovered state，或它们的 external counterpart truth。 |
| `Observation` | 每个 set 恰一条 `HostResidualObservationSafeSummary`；只能由正式 observation mapper 或 safe persistence 提供。它保留 source ref/version/captured-at 的既有 safe ceiling。 | raw backend dump、evidence、report、trace、request / response body、owner mutation、external repair completed。 |

`ResidualBasisSet::from_canonical(...)` / `try_rehydrate(...)` 必须拒绝：缺少或重复 `HostScope`、缺少或重复 `Observation`、host/generation 不一致、空 ref、cross-role safe ref、duplicate local ref、乱序、raw body、未映射 summary、以及从 absence / timeout / fake 推导的假 observation。固定顺序为 `HostScope`、`Closure`、`Registration`、`Endpoint`、`Session`、`Association`、`CleanupAttempt`、`HealthAssessment`、`FailureClassification`、`Observation`；相同 variant 内按 typed local id 的 opaque byte order。constructor / rehydrate 均不得自动排序、去重、替换较旧 observation 或在 optional input 缺失时删除义务。

~~~rust
/// Closed local classification of the discrepancy being retained.
pub enum ResidualFindingKind {
    Residual,
    Orphan,
    Drift,
    Disputed,
}

/// Closed local lifecycle of one residual finding.
pub enum ResidualFindingStatus {
    Open,
    Confirmed,
    Disputed,
    Resolved,
    Superseded,
    Unknown,
}

/// Carries a redacted local reason without retaining raw observation content.
pub struct ResidualFindingReason {
    code: HostRedactedCode,
}

/// Classifies why a finding was locally opened, confirmed, disputed, or held unknown.
pub enum ResidualEvaluation {
    Detected(ResidualFindingReason),
    Confirmed(ResidualFindingReason),
    Disputed(ResidualFindingReason),
    Unknown(ResidualFindingReason),
}
~~~

`ResidualFindingReason` 的 private `HostRedactedCode` 只可由 contracts redaction boundary、formal mapper或 safe rehydrate 给出；没有 `Default`、raw-text constructor、external-error conversion或 log / evidence extractor。`ResidualEvaluation` 是 finding-local classification：它不能由 metric、alert、Job tick、timeout、adapter error、fake或 absence-of-error 自动写入，也不表示 source owner已经确认任何差异。

#### formal actor 与 reconciliation disposition 的权限分层

对账“发现差异”与“决定处置”必须分属不同 authority。Job 可以带着受限的 observation-only context 开 case 或使 case 进入 unknown surface，但不得取得 actor、disposition、repair、restart、terminate、Sandbox cleanup 或 external owner mutation 权限。只有 future formal mapper 已构造的 context 才能形成 `FormalReconciliationDisposition`；这个 local formal mapping 也不是 Governance approval、L1 truth 或对端接受证明。

~~~rust
/// Retains the body-free formal control context required for a reconciliation disposition.
pub struct FormalReconciliationContext {
    source_ref: HostIntentSourceRef,
    intent_ref: HostIntentRef,
    scope_ref: HostControlScopeRef,
}

/// Records whether a case was opened by a formal mapping or by observation-only Job work.
pub enum ReconciliationActorContext {
    /// A formal mapper and a loaded accepted local intent supplied the control context.
    FormalMapped(FormalReconciliationContext),
    /// A Job only records the correlation of its observation; it has no disposition authority.
    JobObservationOnly { correlation_id: CorrelationId },
}

/// Describes a local reconciliation conclusion without executing it.
pub enum ReconciliationDisposition {
    Hold,
    RequestCleanup,
    NoAction,
    Escalate,
    Resolve,
}

/// Couples a disposition to the only actor context permitted to make it.
pub struct FormalReconciliationDisposition {
    context: FormalReconciliationContext,
    disposition: ReconciliationDisposition,
}

/// Retains a redacted reason for keeping a case fail-closed.
pub struct ReconciliationHold { reason_code: HostRedactedCode }
/// Retains a body-free target and redacted reason for a local escalation record.
pub struct ReconciliationEscalation {
    target_ref: HostHandoffTargetRef,
    reason_code: HostRedactedCode,
}
/// Retains the local, redacted basis for closing a case.
pub struct ReconciliationResolution { reason_code: HostRedactedCode }
/// Retains a redacted reason when the local case outcome cannot safely be classified.
pub struct ReconciliationUnknownReason { reason_code: HostRedactedCode }
~~~

| value / factory | 来源、权限与精确约束 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| `FormalReconciliationContext::from_mapped_reconciliation_command(...)` | 只能同时消费 loaded `HostIntent`、formal mapped `HostIntentSourceRef` 和 dual-anchor `HostControlScopeRef`；必须复用 `HostIntent::matches_accepted_control_context(...)`，且 future application再验证 scope 与 selected host / generation 的 relation。 | 不能由 finding、health signal、Consumer、Job、Query、alert、timeout、receipt、fake、configuration或 `OperationalControlRequest` text直接构造；不复制 Governance approval / L1 body。 |
| `ReconciliationActorContext::JobObservationOnly` | 只可由 future Job entry 的 typed correlation或 safe persisted equivalent构造；可用于 `ReconciliationCase::open` 和 non-positive observation record。 | 不可转换为 `FormalMapped`，不允许 `decide` / `hold` / `escalate` / `resolve` 或创建 cleanup attempt。 |
| `FormalReconciliationDisposition::from_formal_context(...)` | 只接受 `FormalReconciliationContext`；closed disposition不得为 hidden string / generic action。它记录本地 formal causality，之后仍由 case验证 revision、finding scope与basis。 | 不表示 formal command已提交、actor获 L1 / Governance approval、Sandbox / carrier / Runtime owner已经接受或执行。 |
| `Hold` / `NoAction` | 分别保留 explicit hold 和“当前不请求 action”的本地 disposition；均需 formal context及 canonical case basis。 | 不可由 no feedback 或 silence隐式形成；`NoAction` 不删除 finding，不自动 resolve case。 |
| `RequestCleanup` | 只表示已经保存的 local disposition允许 future application选择合格 association 并建立独立 `CleanupAttempt`。 | 不能创建 attempt、effect key、port call、association release、repair、restart、terminate、Runtime stop或 Sandbox cleanup。 |
| `Escalate` / `ReconciliationEscalation` | formal disposition后才可保存 body-free `HostHandoffTargetRef` 与 redacted reason。 | 不定义 Bus route、operator body、owner queue、acceptance、ack、delivery或 response。 |
| `Resolve` / `ReconciliationResolution` | 必须有 explicit local resolution support、formal disposition、matching case semantic revision及 canonical basis。 | 不推导 external cleanup complete、resource deleted、finding truth repaired或 sibling truth changed。 |

`ReconciliationBasis` 与 `ReconciliationBasisSet` 是 `reconciliation.rs` 私有 heterogeneous support value，不得误放入 `contracts::refs`。它们只允许以下成员：

~~~rust
/// Retains one body-free input to a case-level reconciliation conclusion.
pub enum ReconciliationBasis {
    /// Required same-subject local comparison scope; exactly one and ordered first.
    HostScope { host_ref: HostRef, generation: HostGeneration },
    /// Optional local closure causal relation.
    Closure(HostClosureRef),
    /// Every finding currently indexed by the case appears exactly once.
    Finding(ResidualFindingRef),
    /// Every cleanup attempt currently indexed by the case appears exactly once.
    CleanupAttempt(CleanupAttemptRef),
    /// An allowed safe observation used in the local conclusion.
    Observation(HostResidualObservationSafeSummary),
}

/// Stores canonical, body-free bases supporting one local reconciliation case.
pub struct ReconciliationBasisSet(Vec<ReconciliationBasis>);
~~~

对任何已保存 `ReconciliationCase`，basis 的 `HostScope` 必须与 case host / generation 精确相同；其 `Finding` members 必须与 `finding_refs` 集合完全相等，其 `CleanupAttempt` members 必须与 `cleanup_attempt_refs` 集合完全相等。在 `add_finding` 或 `link_cleanup_attempt` 后，调用方必须一次性提供新的 complete canonical basis；缺一个、留过期 ref、以 target text替代 ref、只给 subset、自动增加 sibling ref或仅用同 host / generation 都返回 `DomainError`。固定顺序是 `HostScope`、`Closure`、`Finding`、`CleanupAttempt`、`Observation`，每一 local-ref variant按 opaque id byte order。集合不保存 raw body、backend dump、trace、report、receipt、route、credential或 owner policy。

### 9.12.9 `reconciliation.rs`：`ResidualFinding` 对象契约

#### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `ResidualFinding`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 22 个。它固定一次 same-host / same-generation local comparison及其差异演变，不拥有任何 repair 或 external resource。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::reconciliation` / `crates/domain/src/reconciliation.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-23`；使 closure residual index、case finding index、safe history 与 future reconcile Job 都回指同一 local finding。 |
| 主要责任 | 用 immutable target、canonical local basis和恰一条 safe observation记录 residual / orphan / drift / disputed 分类；显式保留 confirm、dispute、unknown、resolve和supersede evolution。 |
| 不拥有 | observation port、backend / Sandbox / carrier state、repair request、cleanup dispatch、case disposition、operator record、Runtime / Member / Images truth、repository / UoW、history writer、evidence / report / observability body。 |

#### Rust-facing shape

~~~rust
/// Records one body-free local discrepancy comparison for one host generation.
pub struct ResidualFinding {
    /// Stable locally owned identity of this finding.
    finding_id: ResidualFindingId,
    /// Logical host whose committed local facts are compared.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation to which this finding applies.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Optional closure relation; absence does not imply that no closure exists.
    closure_ref: Option<HostClosureRef>,
    /// Immutable typed target category under comparison.
    affected_target: ResidualAffectedTarget,
    /// Canonical local comparison basis containing exactly one safe observation.
    basis: ResidualBasisSet,
    /// Closed local discrepancy category.
    finding_kind: ResidualFindingKind,
    /// Local finding lifecycle only.
    finding_status: ResidualFindingStatus,
    /// Latest redacted local evaluation or reason.
    evaluation: ResidualEvaluation,
    /// Case that explicitly resolved this finding, when locally recorded.
    resolved_by_case_ref: Option<ReconciliationCaseRef>,
    /// Local case semantic revision used for the matching resolution relation.
    resolved_by_case_revision: Option<ReconciliationCaseRevision>,
    /// More accurate successor finding, when this record was superseded.
    replacement_finding_ref: Option<ResidualFindingRef>,
    /// Local time at which the finding was first retained.
    detected_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time of the latest accepted finding-local transition.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl ResidualFinding {
    /// Detects a new local finding in the `Open` state from a canonical body-free basis.
    pub fn detect(
        finding_id: ResidualFindingId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        closure_ref: Option<HostClosureRef>,
        affected_target: ResidualAffectedTarget,
        basis: ResidualBasisSet,
        finding_kind: ResidualFindingKind,
        reason: ResidualFindingReason,
        detected_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted finding without refreshing an observation or resolving an external owner.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        finding_id: ResidualFindingId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        closure_ref: Option<HostClosureRef>,
        affected_target: ResidualAffectedTarget,
        basis: ResidualBasisSet,
        finding_kind: ResidualFindingKind,
        finding_status: ResidualFindingStatus,
        evaluation: ResidualEvaluation,
        resolved_by_case_ref: Option<ReconciliationCaseRef>,
        resolved_by_case_revision: Option<ReconciliationCaseRevision>,
        replacement_finding_ref: Option<ResidualFindingRef>,
        detected_at: Timestamp,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Records a locally validated confirmation without changing target or causal identity.
    pub fn confirm(
        &mut self,
        basis: ResidualBasisSet,
        reason: ResidualFindingReason,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records a conflict in the local comparison and blocks automatic repair.
    pub fn dispute(
        &mut self,
        reason: ResidualFindingReason,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Retains an indeterminate local comparison without discarding its basis.
    pub fn mark_unknown(
        &mut self,
        reason: ResidualFindingReason,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Links a finding to one matching locally resolved reconciliation case.
    pub fn resolve(
        &mut self,
        case: &ReconciliationCase,
        resolution: &ReconciliationResolution,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Replaces this description only with a more accurate same-target finding.
    pub fn supersede(
        &mut self,
        replacement: &ResidualFinding,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether a typed local target is the same category and identity for this generation.
    pub fn matches(
        &self,
        affected_target: &ResidualAffectedTarget,
        generation: &HostGeneration,
    ) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local finding reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> ResidualFindingRef;
}
~~~

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `finding_id` | `ResidualFindingId` | 定位本地 discrepancy record | application generator / safe rehydrate；不是 observation、case、target、external resource或 evidence identity。 |
| `host_ref` + `generation` | typed local subject | 锚定 immutable comparison scope | `detect`只接受 future named local reader已选中的 same-subject facts；basis 的 required scope必须精确相同。不能从 observation source、target text、host current pointer或 Job payload推断。 |
| `closure_ref` | optional `HostClosureRef` | 保留与 closure 的 local causal关系 | only loaded matching closure / safe rehydrate；absence只表示本 finding未被关联到 closure，不表示 host没有closure或 cleanup已结清。 |
| `affected_target` | closed `ResidualAffectedTarget` | 固定一次 comparison target | formal mapper / matching local association reader / safe rehydrate；创建后不可变，不能由 later observation换 variant、换 opaque ref或降为 string。 |
| `basis` | canonical `ResidualBasisSet` | 保留 local comparison input与one safe observation | `detect` / `confirm`只接受 complete canonical set；future reader验证每个 local ref scope。它不存 raw body、owner result或 target state。 |
| `finding_kind` / `finding_status` / `evaluation` | closed enum + redacted support | 区分差异类别、local lifecycle及非正向理由 | domain closed classification；`evaluation`与状态必须矩阵合法，不能从 timeout / fake / silence自动升级为 confirmed / resolved。 |
| `resolved_by_case_ref` + `resolved_by_case_revision` | optional typed local causal pair | 固定本 finding被哪个 local case revision显式闭合 | only `resolve` / valid rehydrate；必须同在或同无，且不是 case external completion、store expected version或 generic resolution text。 |
| `replacement_finding_ref` | optional `ResidualFindingRef` | 保留更准确 description 的演变链 | only `supersede` / rehydrate；不得自指、不得指向不同 host / generation / affected target 或作为 delete alias。 |
| `detected_at` / `updated_at` | local timestamps | 区分本地 retain与后续 local transition | application clock / safe rehydrate；`detected_at <= updated_at`；不使用 observation captured-at、external owner time、receipt或 DB commit time替代。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `detect(...)` | 建立 `Open` finding | basis必须有 exact host/generation scope、one observation和合法 target；initial evaluation是 `Detected`。它不写 closure residual index、不自动开 case、不调用 observation port、不改变任何 external or sibling truth。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 重建 finding | 重验 target kind、basis canonicality、one observation、status/evaluation/causal-link matrix、time order和非自指 replacement。它不 refresh observation、不把历史 summary当 current、不补 case或 raw evidence。 |
| `confirm(...)` | `Open -> Confirmed` | 新 basis仍须 target / host / generation / optional closure relation精确不变；只可由 future formal observation mapper + named local reader调用。它不代表 owner confirmed、repair authorized或 cleanup succeeded。 |
| `dispute(...)` | `Open | Confirmed -> Disputed` | reason必须 redacted；保留 immutable basis与target，不允许删掉冲突 observation或用新的 target覆盖旧 finding。它不创建 hold / escalation，case仍需显式处理。 |
| `mark_unknown(...)` | `Open | Confirmed | Disputed -> Unknown` | 保留 original basis、target和all causality；只能记录 named local indeterminacy，不能用未知作重新观察、new target或无 key repair的借口。 |
| `resolve(...)` | active finding -> `Resolved` | 只接受 loaded matching `ReconciliationCase`：same host/generation、case status为 `Resolved`、case finding index含 own ref、case有 matching local resolution relation，且 resolution对象与case所保存的 resolution equality match。写入 exact case ref + semantic revision。它不改变 case、closure、attempt或 association。 |
| `supersede(...)` | active finding -> `Superseded` | replacement必须不同 id、same host/generation、same `ResidualAffectedTarget`，且已是 later local finding；旧 finding保留完整 basis。它不 remove case link、不 merge history、不表示 external difference消失。 |
| `matches(...)` / `to_ref` | 暴露 narrow local equality与ref | `matches`只比较 typed target category/identity和 generation；不查询 resource、owner或 current state。 |

| finding status | required payload / permitted transitions | 不得推导 |
|---|---|---|
| `Open` | exact one basis observation；`Detected` evaluation；无 resolution / replacement causal link。可到 `Confirmed`、`Disputed`、`Unknown`、`Superseded`。 | target真实存在、case已开、repair allowed。 |
| `Confirmed` | `Confirmed` evaluation；basis已由 formal mapped observation重新比较。可到 `Disputed`、`Unknown`、`Resolved`、`Superseded`。 | external owner accepted difference、cleanup / repair done。 |
| `Disputed` | `Disputed` evaluation；no resolution/replacement pair。可到 `Unknown`、`Resolved`、`Superseded`。 | operator已接受、source owner错误、automatic repair authority。 |
| `Unknown` | `Unknown` evaluation；original basis完整保留。只可到 `Resolved` 或 `Superseded`，不能退回 `Open`。 | absence等于 clean、可安全重试 / delete。 |
| `Resolved` | exact case ref + case semantic revision paired、case local resolution relation匹配；terminal。 | external cleanup / release / owner reconciliation completed。 |
| `Superseded` | exact replacement finding ref；terminal。 | 旧 finding被删除、旧 observation无效或目标已修复。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| immutable comparison identity | host、generation、closure relation、affected target、finding id和detected time不可在 confirm / dispute / unknown / resolve中替换；变化必须通过 distinct successor finding表达。 |
| no automatic repair | finding不能直接 request cleanup、release association、start Runtime、restart / terminate host、delete local records或改写 Member / Sandbox / carrier truth；它只能成为 closure / case 的 typed local input。 |
| observation ceiling | exactly one safe observation在 basis中；不保存 / 不回放 raw source body、backend dump、report、evidence、telemetry、credential、route或 receipt。sibling schema缺失时停在 `Open` / `Disputed` / `Unknown`。 |
| resolution is local and exact | `Resolved`只来自 same finding ref 被 same-host/generation locally resolved case以exact resolution relation引用；case status、timeout、receipt、association release、resource absence或 Job tick本身均不足。 |

### 9.12.10 `reconciliation.rs`：`ReconciliationCase` 对象契约

#### 同一 subject 输入与 case status

`ReconciliationCase` 是本仓唯一的 local disposition record，不是 operator case、cleanup queue、external-owner ticket 或 repair executor。为避免把 ref text 相等误作对象范围验证，`reconciliation.rs` 保留一个 file-local input value；它不进入 29 个业务对象分母，也不取代 Step 7 的 reader / store / UoW。

~~~rust
/// Carries finding references only after loaded finding objects were checked for one host generation.
pub struct ValidatedReconciliationFindings {
    host_ref: HostRef,
    generation: HostGeneration,
    finding_refs: ResidualFindingRefSet,
}

/// Classifies the local lifecycle of one reconciliation case.
pub enum ReconciliationCaseStatus {
    Open,
    ActionRequested,
    Holding,
    Escalated,
    Resolved,
    Unknown,
}
~~~

`ValidatedReconciliationFindings::from_loaded_findings(...)` 只能消费一个或多个 loaded non-terminal `ResidualFinding`，逐项检查 same `host_ref + generation`、non-empty canonical refs与它们各自 required `ResidualBasis::HostScope`。它既不确认 finding、也不选择 current host、调用 observation port、创建 case或判断 external owner。future application的 named finding reader仍负责验证 store selection与expected-version；没有这个 input 时，case factory不得用 `ResidualFindingRefSet` 的文本、Job payload、query list、history、timeout或 fake 自行断言 same-subject。

#### 基本信息与唯一 owner

| 项 | 收口结论 |
|---|---|
| 业务对象 | `ReconciliationCase`；冻结 29 个业务对象中的第 23 个。它聚合同一 host generation 的 finding并保存 local disposition / hold / escalation / resolution history。 |
| 唯一 crate / module / file owner | planned `member-service-domain` / `domain::reconciliation` / `crates/domain/src/reconciliation.rs`。 |
| 功能来源 | `CAP-MS-24`；为 future formal disposition mapper、reconcile Job、cleanup authorization handoff、finding resolution、history / safe mapper提供唯一 case-local truth。 |
| 主要责任 | 用 canonical finding / cleanup indexes、basis、opening actor context、optional formal disposition和case semantic revision表达 explicit local decision；任何作用到外部的动作都留给后续 application / port。 |
| 不拥有 | lifecycle decision、host / generation mutation、cleanup attempt creation / dispatch、port、receipt、operator authorization truth、Governance approval、L4-sandbox / carrier cleanup truth、Runtime stop / restart / terminate、store / CAS / UoW、outbox、external ticket / report。 |

#### Rust-facing shape

~~~rust
/// Records the local reconciliation disposition for findings of one host generation.
pub struct ReconciliationCase {
    /// Stable locally owned identity of this case.
    case_id: ReconciliationCaseId,
    /// Logical host shared by every indexed finding and cleanup attempt.
    host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Immutable host generation shared by every indexed finding and cleanup attempt.
    generation: HostGeneration,
    /// Canonical non-empty local finding index.
    finding_refs: ResidualFindingRefSet,
    /// Canonical local cleanup-attempt index; empty until an independently prepared attempt is linked.
    cleanup_attempt_refs: CleanupAttemptRefSet,
    /// Canonical basis whose finding and cleanup members exactly match both indexes.
    basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
    /// Formal or observation-only context that opened the local case.
    opening_actor_context: ReconciliationActorContext,
    /// Explicit formal disposition, if one has been made.
    formal_disposition: Option<FormalReconciliationDisposition>,
    /// Redacted hold reason when the local case is holding.
    hold: Option<ReconciliationHold>,
    /// Body-free escalation relation when locally recorded.
    escalation: Option<ReconciliationEscalation>,
    /// Explicit local resolution basis when locally recorded.
    resolution: Option<ReconciliationResolution>,
    /// Redacted local uncertainty reason when the case cannot progress safely.
    unknown_reason: Option<ReconciliationUnknownReason>,
    /// Local case lifecycle only.
    case_status: ReconciliationCaseStatus,
    /// Accepted case-local semantic mutation sequence.
    revision: ReconciliationCaseRevision,
    /// Local time at which this case first existed.
    opened_at: Timestamp,
    /// Local time of the latest accepted case-local mutation.
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

impl ReconciliationCase {
    /// Opens a local case from validated same-subject findings without making a disposition.
    pub fn open(
        case_id: ReconciliationCaseId,
        findings: ValidatedReconciliationFindings,
        basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
        opening_actor_context: ReconciliationActorContext,
        opened_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Rehydrates a persisted local case without querying an owner or replaying a disposition.
    pub fn rehydrate(
        case_id: ReconciliationCaseId,
        host_ref: HostRef,
        generation: HostGeneration,
        finding_refs: ResidualFindingRefSet,
        cleanup_attempt_refs: CleanupAttemptRefSet,
        basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
        opening_actor_context: ReconciliationActorContext,
        formal_disposition: Option<FormalReconciliationDisposition>,
        hold: Option<ReconciliationHold>,
        escalation: Option<ReconciliationEscalation>,
        resolution: Option<ReconciliationResolution>,
        unknown_reason: Option<ReconciliationUnknownReason>,
        case_status: ReconciliationCaseStatus,
        revision: ReconciliationCaseRevision,
        opened_at: Timestamp,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;

    /// Adds one matching finding while replacing the complete canonical case basis.
    pub fn add_finding(
        &mut self,
        finding: &ResidualFinding,
        basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records only a formal `RequestCleanup` or `NoAction` local disposition.
    pub fn decide(
        &mut self,
        disposition: FormalReconciliationDisposition,
        basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Links an independently prepared same-subject cleanup attempt without dispatching it.
    pub fn link_cleanup_attempt(
        &mut self,
        cleanup_attempt: &CleanupAttempt,
        basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records an explicit formal hold with its redacted fail-closed reason.
    pub fn hold(
        &mut self,
        disposition: FormalReconciliationDisposition,
        hold: ReconciliationHold,
        basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Records an explicit formal escalation without claiming downstream acceptance.
    pub fn escalate(
        &mut self,
        disposition: FormalReconciliationDisposition,
        escalation: ReconciliationEscalation,
        basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Resolves only a case whose formal local disposition and semantic revision exactly match.
    pub fn resolve(
        &mut self,
        disposition: FormalReconciliationDisposition,
        resolution: ReconciliationResolution,
        basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
        expected_revision: ReconciliationCaseRevision,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Retains a named local uncertainty without inventing a disposition or action.
    pub fn mark_unknown(
        &mut self,
        reason: ReconciliationUnknownReason,
        basis: ReconciliationBasisSet,
        updated_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<(), DomainError>;

    /// Returns whether a finding reference is currently indexed by this local case.
    pub fn contains_finding(&self, finding_ref: &ResidualFindingRef) -> bool;

    /// Returns whether this case has the supplied exact local resolution relation.
    pub fn matches_resolution(&self, resolution: &ReconciliationResolution) -> bool;

    /// Returns the typed local case reference.
    pub fn to_ref(&self) -> ReconciliationCaseRef;
}
~~~

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源 / 约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `case_id` | `ReconciliationCaseId` | 定位本地 disposition record | application generator / safe rehydrate；不是 operator ticket、external request、cleanup effect或 finding identity。 |
| `host_ref` + `generation` | typed local subject | 冻结 case 的共同范围 | `open`只从 `ValidatedReconciliationFindings` 复制；later finding / attempt link都必须 exact match。不得由 host pointer、case key、target text或 observation source推断。 |
| `finding_refs` | non-empty `ResidualFindingRefSet` | 聚合 case 正在处理的 finding | `open`从 validated findings取得；`add_finding`只加 loaded matching active finding；canonical order、no duplicate由 contracts set强制。ref存在不代表 finding已confirmed / resolved。 |
| `cleanup_attempt_refs` | `CleanupAttemptRefSet` | 回链 disposition后由 application独立创建的 cleanup record | initial empty；`link_cleanup_attempt`只接 matching locally prepared attempt，且 complete basis同步更新。它不表示 attempt dispatched、outcome received、target released或 cleanup complete。 |
| `basis` | canonical `ReconciliationBasisSet` | 固定 case conclusion 的 local input | 每次 mutation后 finding / cleanup members必须与 indexes集合完全相等；only formal mapper / named local reader / safe persistence提供。不得保存 raw external content。 |
| `opening_actor_context` | `ReconciliationActorContext` | 留存 case如何开始 | `FormalMapped` 要 formal context；`JobObservationOnly` 仅为 observation correlation。两者均不等于 external actor identity、approval、owner acceptance或 current authorization。 |
| `formal_disposition` | optional `FormalReconciliationDisposition` | 保留 explicit local disposition | only `decide` / `hold` / `escalate` / `resolve` or rehydrate；Job-only context绝不可出现。`RequestCleanup`只授权以后独立选择 attempt。 |
| `hold` / `escalation` / `resolution` / `unknown_reason` | optional closed support values | 保存状态所需的 redacted local relation | payload/status matrix sealed below；no raw reason、route、ticket body、receipt、policy或 owner response。 |
| `case_status` | `ReconciliationCaseStatus` | 保存 case-local lifecycle | initial only `Open`；它不由 finding status、cleanup result、closure status、Job tick、external callback或 query自动推进。 |
| `revision` | `ReconciliationCaseRevision` | 检测本 case accepted semantic mutation sequence | `open = initial()`；每个 accepted mutation exactly `next_after()`；不是 repository expected-version / CAS、HostGeneration、closure revision、source version、cursor或 retry count。 |
| `opened_at` / `updated_at` | local timestamps | 区分 local creation与latest local mutation | application clock / safe rehydrate；`opened_at <= updated_at`；不是 command source time、observation captured-at、port time、receipt、owner acceptance或 DB commit time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 参数 / 返回 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `open(...)` | 建立 `Open` local case | findings必须 non-empty、same host/generation且 basis index exact match。可由 `JobObservationOnly` 创建，以便保留 observation，但绝不形成 disposition。它不改变 finding、closure、attempt或 external truth。 |
| `rehydrate(...)` | 重建 case | 重验 two indexes canonicality、basis exact correspondence、status/payload matrix、revision/time order；不读取 owner、不刷新 finding / observation、不重放 action或把 Job context升为 formal。 |
| `add_finding(...)` | 追加 active same-subject finding | only non-terminal case；finding id不得重复，finding不能已由不同 local case resolved；new complete basis必须反映 full new indexes。它不自动 resolve / reopen finding、不开 cleanup attempt。 |
| `decide(...)` | 记录 formal `RequestCleanup` 或 `NoAction` | 只接受 `FormalMapped` context；`RequestCleanup`使 case到 `ActionRequested`，`NoAction`保留 `Open` 并保留 formal local decision。两者不创建 effect key、attempt、port call、repair、restart、terminate或 external outcome。 |
| `link_cleanup_attempt(...)` | 关联独立 cleanup attempt | only `ActionRequested`；attempt必须 `Prepared`、same host/generation、未重复，且由 future application在另一个明确的 local-first sequence中已建立。链接不 dispatch、cancel、retry或把 finding resolve。 |
| `hold(...)` | 进入 `Holding` | only formal `Hold` disposition和non-empty redacted hold；不得由 Job-only / timeout / no feedback自动调用。它不取消 existing attempt、不改 association、也不成为 external owner hold。 |
| `escalate(...)` | 进入 `Escalated` | only formal `Escalate` disposition与 body-free target；不发送 handoff、不写 route/receipt、不表示 target owner accepted。 |
| `resolve(...)` | 进入 `Resolved` | only formal `Resolve` disposition、matching resolution、complete basis和current semantic `expected_revision`；expected revision仅做 case-local equality，future repository CAS仍另行验证。它不直接写任何 finding；future application必须在 same UoW中逐一调用 loaded finding 的 `resolve`。 |
| `mark_unknown(...)` | active case -> `Unknown` | 可在 formal or Job-opened case上记录 named local uncertainty；保留 original indexes、basis和any prior formal disposition，不补 action、不换 key、不删除 attempt或 finding。 |
| `contains_finding(...)` / `matches_resolution(...)` / `to_ref` | 暴露 narrow local matching | pure；不查询 store、current pointer、actor permission、external owner或 effect state。 |

| case status | required payload / allowed transitions | 不得推导 |
|---|---|---|
| `Open` | non-empty finding index、exact basis、no hold / escalation / resolution / unknown reason；formal disposition may be absent or explicit `NoAction`. 可到 `ActionRequested`、`Holding`、`Escalated`、`Resolved`、`Unknown`。 | finding已经confirmed、external action已请求 / accepted。 |
| `ActionRequested` | exact `RequestCleanup` formal disposition；cleanup index可仍为空，直到 independent prepared attempt被链接。可到 `Holding`、`Escalated`、`Resolved`、`Unknown`。 | cleanup attempt存在、port crossed、resource release、repair completed。 |
| `Holding` | exact `Hold` formal disposition + `ReconciliationHold`；可到 `ActionRequested`、`Escalated`、`Resolved`、`Unknown`。 | Job / owner已接受hold、previous uncertain effect已消失。 |
| `Escalated` | exact `Escalate` formal disposition + `ReconciliationEscalation`；可到 `Holding`、`Resolved`、`Unknown`。 | handoff delivered、operator read、downstream accepted / acted。 |
| `Resolved` | exact `Resolve` formal disposition + `ReconciliationResolution`；terminal。 | all linked findings/cleanup externally complete、resource absent、closure locally closed。 |
| `Unknown` | non-empty `ReconciliationUnknownReason`；prior basis and any formal disposition remain immutable; can move only by a new explicit formal disposition to `Holding`、`ActionRequested`、`Escalated`或 `Resolved`。 | safe retry、implicit cleanup / repair authority。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| disposition authority is explicit | Job-observation context can retain local case / uncertainty only. Every `Hold`、`RequestCleanup`、`NoAction`、`Escalate`、`Resolve` requires `FormalReconciliationDisposition` and its loaded accepted-intent / dual-anchor checks. |
| request is not execution | `RequestCleanup` only records local authorization relation. It never creates `CleanupAttempt`, effect key, release request, port call, retry, repair, restart, terminate, Runtime stop or Sandbox operation. |
| exact index / basis correspondence | finding and cleanup indexes have no hidden subset: every indexed ref appears exactly once in basis and every basis ref appears in its matching index. New finding / attempt links must atomically replace the entire validated basis at domain level; persistence atomicity remains Step 7 / 11 / 13 work. |
| no external completion shortcut | case `Resolved`, escalation, hold, no-action, cleanup safe summary, association release or resource absence cannot claim Sandbox / carrier cleanup, external reconciliation, owner acceptance or sibling truth mutation. |

### 9.12.11 CMP-MS-06 停审、字段 / 状态审计与 Step 7 handoff

#### 冻结对象、能力与唯一 owner 审计

| 审查项 | 结果 | 证据 / 收口结论 |
|---|---|---|
| 29 对象分母 | pass | `HostClosure`、`CleanupAttempt`、`ResidualFinding`、`ReconciliationCase` 分别固定为第 20、21、22、23 个对象；scope、invalidation、pending / gap、kind / reason、basis、actor context、hold / escalation / resolution、validated finding input和semantic revision均是 file-local support value，不新增 cleanup worker、external resource、operator case或第 30 个业务对象。 |
| `CAP-MS-21` coverage | pass_with_upstream_blockers | `HostClosure` 收口 frozen scope、local invalidation、pending / gap / residual link与strict `LocallyClosed`；candidate仍只来自 `HostClosureDecisionRef`，不把 Runtime stop或 external cleanup吸收为本仓 truth。 |
| `CAP-MS-22` coverage | pass_with_upstream_blockers | `CleanupAttempt` 独占 closure-scoped local-first effect、immutable association target、original effect key、correlation、dispatch / safe outcome / failed / unknown / gap / cancelled classification；release remains L4-sandbox / carrier owner boundary。 |
| `CAP-MS-23` coverage | pass_with_upstream_blockers | `ResidualFinding` 独占 typed target、canonical local basis、exactly one safe observation、finding evolution和case-local resolution link；observation mapper与external owner schema仍 pending。 |
| `CAP-MS-24` coverage | pass_with_upstream_blockers | `ReconciliationCase` 独占 same-subject finding / cleanup indexes、formal disposition / hold / escalation / resolution和case semantic revision；Job observation-only context不会取得 disposition / repair authority。 |
| module / file owner | pass | `domain::closure` 只拥有 closure / cleanup及其 support values；`domain::reconciliation` 只拥有 finding / case及其 support values；shared id/ref/revision/homogeneous set仍只属于 `contracts::refs`。application、Job、Consumer、adapter、fake、query、history、Sandbox与siblings均没有第二 schema。 |
| local / external boundary | pass_with_upstream_blockers | `LocallyClosed`、cleanup `Succeeded`、finding `Resolved`、case `Resolved` 四轴保持独立且都只表示 local record conclusion。L4-sandbox 继续拥有 policy、backend、isolation、bind/release/cleanup guard、reaper和cleanup truth；carrier / registry / Runtime / Member / Images / Core / Bus / SDK exact body未被定义。 |

#### CMP-MS-06 字段来源审计

| 对象 / 字段组 | 允许来源 | 交叉校验 / fail-closed 规则 | 不得由何物推导 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HostClosure` id / subject / decision / scope / revision / time | application generator / clock、safe rehydrate、loaded permitted closure candidate与same-selection local reader | four-axis scope explicit；candidate、host、generation、scope和all child relation必须分别复核；semantic revision不替代 repository expected-version。 | Runtime stop、host pointer、receipt、backend state、query / Job / fake。 |
| `HostClosure` invalidation / attempt / pending / gap / residual sets | matching committed local registration / endpoint / session / association / attempt / finding和closed support value | scope membership、same host/generation、canonical order、non-positive material保留；no auto-removal / sort / de-dup。 | absence、timeout、resource not found、external cleanup result。 |
| `CleanupAttempt` target / kind / key / correlation / outcome | loaded matching closure + active association、application-built original key/correlation、formal cleanup feedback mapper或 safe rehydrate | same immutable association + host + generation + original key + correlation；post-dispatch uncertainty保留原 key / target。 | `HostActionAttempt`、fresh key、target text、receipt、timeout、backend observation。 |
| `ResidualFinding` target / basis / kind / evaluation | formal body-free observation mapper、named committed local reader、application generator / clock或 safe rehydrate | one immutable target；basis has exactly one same-subject `HostScope` and one safe observation; all local refs require same host/generation; reason is redacted. | raw dump / evidence / report、source text、job guess、target lookup、external owner state。 |
| `ResidualFinding` resolution / successor links | loaded matching local case / successor finding、case semantic revision、explicit redacted resolution | resolved case must be same host/generation, include own finding ref and match exact resolution relation; successor must be same target and different finding id. | case id text、case status alone、resource absence、cleanup success、late callback。 |
| `ReconciliationCase` finding / cleanup indexes / basis | validated loaded findings、matching loaded prepared cleanup attempt、formal mapper / named local reader / safe rehydrate | non-empty finding index; every finding / cleanup index member appears exactly once in complete canonical basis; all members same host/generation. | raw list, query cursor, Job payload, association target text, event envelope or auto-merged history。 |
| `ReconciliationCase` actor / disposition / hold / escalation / resolution | formal mapped accepted intent + source + dual-anchor scope; Job only provides observation correlation; redacted support values and safe handoff target | formal disposition rejects Job-only context; status/payload matrix and current case semantic revision must match; request cleanup does not create attempt. | governance approval body, operator / owner response, timeout, fake, config, external receipt or generic action string。 |

#### CMP-MS-06 四轴状态闭环审计

| state axis | 允许的 local progression | 关键闭合 / 不可跨轴传播 |
|---|---|---|
| `HostClosure` | `Open -> Invalidating -> CleanupPending -> LocallyClosed`；named residual / gap / uncertainty可到 `Residual` / `Blocked` / `Unknown`。 | only strict local bookkeeping allows `LocallyClosed`；finding / case / association / external result不会自动打开、关闭或重置 closure。 |
| `CleanupAttempt` | `Prepared -> Dispatched -> Succeeded / Failed / Unknown / Gap`；only pre-dispatch `Prepared -> Cancelled`。 | `Unknown` / post-dispatch `Gap` retain same key, correlation and immutable association; no new-key retry, clone, delete or key substitution. |
| `ResidualFinding` | `Open -> Confirmed / Disputed / Unknown`；matching locally resolved case only may yield `Resolved`；more accurate same-target successor may yield `Superseded`。 | cleanup safe summary、case creation、timeout、absence、observation alone或 closure state不自动 resolve finding. |
| `ReconciliationCase` | `Open -> ActionRequested / Holding / Escalated / Resolved / Unknown`；new formal disposition is required to leave unknown. | Job can open / record unknown only; `RequestCleanup` does not create / dispatch attempt; resolved case does not directly mutate findings, closure, association or external owner. |

#### 关键因果、同键与 authority fence 审计

| fence | 结论 |
|---|---|
| source / cleanup causality separation | `HostActionAttemptRef` only retains original association-source causality. CMP-MS-06 release causality is only `CleanupAttemptRef`; association release matching requires the same immutable association ref, host, generation, original cleanup effect key and correlation. |
| unknown-effect fence | A dispatched cleanup `Unknown` or `Gap` keeps its original key / target / correlation forever. A future disposition may authorize a separately defined next action only after named same-key reader, store / UoW and exact target guard exist; Step 6 does not claim that seam is ready. |
| case / finding resolution fence | finding resolution requires a loaded matching locally resolved case, exact finding membership and matching resolution relation; case resolution requires formal `Resolve`, complete basis and expected local semantic revision. No status word, case id, receipt or observation is enough. |
| Job authority fence | `JobObservationOnly` can detect, retain a finding, open a local case and record local uncertainty only. It cannot synthesize formal actor context, disposition, cleanup attempt, effect key, port call, repair, restart, terminate, Runtime stop, Sandbox release or owner result. |
| external truth fence | safe summary / ref may be retained only at the typed consumption layer. It cannot become backend state, policy truth, resource lifecycle, delivery / acceptance, observability evidence, L1 domain truth or an implementation-ready protocol body. |

#### Step 7 handoff（仅命名 future seam；不创建 Step 7 文件）

| future seam | 必须消费的 CMP-MS-06 typed input / output | 当前禁止补写 |
|---|---|---|
| closure current-fact / scope reader and closure store | `HostClosureDecisionRef`、four-axis local scope selection、`HostClosureRef`、`ClosureRevision`、invalidation / pending / gap / residual links | repository schema、SQL / database choice、CAS token、transaction implementation或 current-pointer truth。 |
| cleanup selection / attempt store / release port / feedback mapper | `CleanupAttemptRef`、immutable association ref、original `ExternalEffectKey`、correlation、`HostCleanupOutcomeSafeSummary` | request / response body、route、receipt, retry scheduler、Sandbox / carrier policy or cleanup truth。 |
| residual fact reader / observation mapper / finding store | `ResidualAffectedTarget`、`ResidualBasisSet`、`HostResidualObservationSafeSummary`、`ResidualFindingRef` | backend query, owner DTO, evidence / observability body, source freshness guess or automatic repair. |
| formal reconciliation disposition mapper / case store / UoW | `FormalReconciliationContext`、`FormalReconciliationDisposition`、dual-anchor scope、`ReconciliationBasisSet`、`ReconciliationCaseRevision` | Governance approval contract, L1 body, operator protocol, repository expected-version / commit result or hidden authority. |
| reconcile Job and safe history / projection mapper | Job observation-only context, local finding / case refs, redacted local status and safe summary layer | Job-created control decision, direct object mutation bypass, external completion claim, public DTO / event envelope / route. |
