## 9.13 `domain / CMP-MS-07 / material.rs, projection.rs, outbox.rs, history.rs` 对象契约

### 9.13.1 本对象组边界、唯一 owner 与概要归一

本批在 `CMP-MS-07` 内闭合五个 domain-owned object 与一个既有 public consumption object 的实现契约：`HostFactMaterial`、`HostHandoffRecord`、`HostProjectionState`、`HostOutboxRecord`、`HostHistoryEntry`，以及仅作为消费边界被引用的 `contracts::views::SafeHostView`。本批不新建 `handoff.rs`、`publication.rs`、material service、projection service、publisher、query DTO、worker record、event envelope、port、repository、UoW 或实现源码。

| 项 | 收口结论 | 禁止事项 |
|---|---|---|
| material / handoff owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::material` / `crates/domain/src/material.rs` 独占 `HostFactMaterial` 与 `HostHandoffRecord`，以及本文件私有的 material safe-field、handoff attempt / feedback-layer support value。 | 不在 application、outbox worker、publisher adapter、consumer、fake 或另建 `handoff.rs` / `publication.rs` 保存第二份 truth。 |
| projection owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::projection` / `crates/domain/src/projection.rs` 独占 `HostProjectionState` 及 projection-local status / gap / apply support value。 | 不在 `contracts::views`、query、projection store、worker 或 cache 重定义 projection state；`SafeHostView` 不是 projection state。 |
| outbox owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::outbox` / `crates/domain/src/outbox.rs` 独占 `HostOutboxRecord` 及 publication-local attempt / gap / unknown support value。 | 不在 Bus adapter、event DTO、job payload 或 history 中 shadow outbox status、publication key 或 submission semantics。 |
| history owner | `member-service-domain` / `domain::history` / `crates/domain/src/history.rs` 独占 `HostHistoryEntry` 及 owner / change-kind / safe-summary / prior-supersedes support value；该对象供全部 CMP 追加使用。 | 不在每个 CMP、observability、report、query 或 external owner 中建立第二历史链；history 不能成为 command source。 |
| public view owner | `member-service-contracts` / `contracts::views` / `crates/contracts/src/views.rs` 已独占 `SafeHostView`、marker、page 与 source-revision public schema。domain 只消费其已定义类型或交由 application mapper 组装。 | 不把 `SafeHostView` 移入 domain，不在本节重定义字段、visibility truth、freshness truth 或 authorization。 |
| shared carrier owner | `member-service-contracts` / `contracts::refs` / `crates/contracts/src/refs.rs` 独占 `CommittedHostChangeRef`、五组 id/ref、`HostMaterialKey`、`ProjectionRevision`、`PublicationKey`、`HandoffKey` 及既有 safe target / summary wrapper。 | domain、application、infra、entry、adapter、fake 不得 alias、shadow、退回裸 `String`，也不得把 key / ref 当作 completion proof。 |
| frozen denominator | 六个名称中只有前五个是 domain record；`SafeHostView` 是既有 public DTO，不增加业务对象分母。全组不新增第 30 个业务对象。 | 不以“materialization job”“projection worker”“publication receipt”“consumer acceptance”或“external resource”补对象。 |

概要中的旧名在本批按以下规则归一，但不关闭任何跨项目合同：

| 旧名 / placeholder | 本批唯一表达 | 语义上限 |
|---|---|---|
| `StablePublicationKey` | 现有 `contracts::refs::PublicationKey` | local publication identity；不等于 route、event id、delivery、observed 或 accepted。 |
| `StableHandoffKey` | 现有 `contracts::refs::HandoffKey` | 一个 material-target 对的 local identity；不等于 target-side id、receipt 或 acceptance。 |
| `HostProjectionId` | 现有 `HostProjectionStateId` / `HostProjectionStateRef` | projection maintenance record identity；不等于 view id、cursor 或 source revision。 |
| `OptionalPublicationSubmissionRef` | `Option<HostPublicationSubmissionSafeSummary>` 或本地提交层 support value | 只记录 publisher boundary 的安全摘要；不得表示 Bus delivery。 |
| `OptionalHostHistoryRef` / `prior_ref` | `Option<HostHistoryEntryRef>`，并在纠正时标注 relation kind | 只表示本地追加链；不覆盖旧条目、不提供 command input。 |
| `HostChangeCursor` / `CommittedChangeCursor` | **domain-owned committed projection cursor（exact type pending）** | 两个上游名称尚未收敛；本批不定义第三种类型、alias、转换或替代字段。 |

#### CMP-MS-07 capability 到对象映射

| capability / 功能 | 输入 | 输出与本地副作用 | 承接对象 | 后续承接 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CAP-MS-25`：materialize committed host fact | selected committed local change、source revision、已验证 redaction profile、body-free field candidate | immutable material、可选 supersedes relation；同一 local UoW 可追加 history / enqueue outbox | `HostFactMaterial`、material-local support value | Step 7 material/history store、redaction mapper、UoW；Step 9 materialization flow；Step 11 atomicity |
| `CAP-MS-26`：per-target handoff | material ref、typed target、`HandoffKey`、local correlation | 每个 material-target 一条 handoff；attempt、gap、delivery、observation、acceptance 分层记录 | `HostHandoffRecord`、handoff-local support value | Step 7 publication / feedback mapper；Step 8 event / feedback schema；Step 9 handoff flow |
| `CAP-MS-27`：safe read | selected committed local facts / projection-safe fields、resolved visibility | immutable public view 或 no-body / unavailable surface；Query 无写入 | `SafeHostView`（contracts owner） | Step 7 read / visibility port；Step 8 query DTO；Step 9 no-write read flow |
| `CAP-MS-28`：projection progression / rebuild | selected committed change、pending cursor seam、projection scope、expected `ProjectionRevision` | projection-local progression、gap、freshness / availability classification | `HostProjectionState`、projection-local support value | Step 7 projection reader/store；Step 9 rebuild Job；Step 10 state；Step 13 ordering / CAS |
| `CAP-MS-25`：local publication progression | committed material ref、publication target、`PublicationKey` | pending / attempted / submitted / gap / unknown / closed local record | `HostOutboxRecord`、outbox-local support value | Step 7 outbox store / publisher seam；Step 9 publish Job；Step 11 outbox UoW |
| cross-CMP append-only trace | local change / owner / change kind、safe summary、correlation | immutable history entry；纠正以新 entry + prior / supersedes relation追加 | `HostHistoryEntry`、history-local support value | Step 7 history store；Step 8 history query；Step 9 append flow |

### 9.13.2 对象能力到字段 / factory / 函数 / state 映射

| 对象 | 对象能力 | 必需字段 / support value | factory / 构造入口 | 成员函数 | 状态 / 分类 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HostFactMaterial` | 从单一已提交 local change 形成 immutable、body-free、可裁剪 material | id、source change ref、source revision、material key、redaction profile ref、safe field set、formed time、可选 prior material ref | `form(...)`、`rehydrate(...)` | `validate_body_free(...)`、`matches_source(...)`、`supersedes(...)`、窄 accessor | immutable；无 lifecycle |
| `HostHandoffRecord` | 为一个 material-target 对记录 local attempt 与三层独立反馈 | id、material ref、target ref、handoff key、attempt set、feedback-layer set、status、gap、timestamps | `prepare(...)`、`rehydrate(...)` | `record_attempt(...)`、`link_delivery(...)`、`link_observation(...)`、`link_acceptance(...)`、`record_gap(...)`、`close(...)` | `Pending / Attempted / Gap / FeedbackLinked / Closed / Unknown` |
| `SafeHostView` | 消费 application 已解析的 safe read surface | 既有 contracts schema；domain 不拥有字段 | `SafeHostView::compose(...)` / `unavailable_for_authorized_subject(...)`（application 调用） | 只允许既有 pure accessor | immutable；无 domain lifecycle |
| `HostProjectionState` | 维护 projection-local progression 与可用性，不反写 source | id、scope、last applied change ref、**pending cursor slot**、source revision、status、gap set、fresh-as-of、semantic revision、timestamps | `initialize(...)`、`rehydrate(...)` | `apply_candidate(...)`、`mark_stale(...)`、`begin_rebuild(...)`、`complete_rebuild(...)`、`mark_degraded(...)`、`mark_unavailable(...)` | `Fresh / Stale / Rebuilding / Degraded / Unavailable` |
| `HostOutboxRecord` | 绑定 material 与 publication target，保留 local submission uncertainty | id、material ref、target ref/class、publication key、attempt set、submission summary、status、gap、timestamps | `enqueue(...)`、`rehydrate(...)` | `record_attempt(...)`、`mark_submitted(...)`、`record_gap(...)`、`mark_unknown(...)`、`close(...)` | `Pending / Attempted / Submitted / Gap / Unknown / Closed` |
| `HostHistoryEntry` | 追加 body-free、可回链的 local change trace | id、owner、change kind、source change ref、prior/supersedes relation、safe summary、correlation、recorded time | `append(...)`、`rehydrate(...)` | `supersedes(...)`、`references_source(...)`、窄 accessor | immutable append-only；无 lifecycle |

所有 factory 与 transition 只产生 domain candidate / local record；它们不证明 store 已写入、UoW 已提交、port 已调用、publisher 已送达、consumer 已观察、下游已接受或 Sandbox / Runtime / Member / Images 已改变。缺少 source commitment、redaction、scope、matching key、feedback mapper、time 或 expected-version witness 时，调用方必须停在 `rejected`、`blocked`、`waiting`、`gap` 或 `unknown`，不得补默认正向值。

### 9.13.3 `material.rs`：`HostFactMaterial` 对象契约

#### 唯一 owner 与职责

`HostFactMaterial` 的唯一 owner 是 `crates/domain/src/material.rs`。它是由一个已选中的 `CommittedHostChangeRef` 形成的不可变 local material；其 safe field set 只可包含本仓已定义的 typed local ref、有限状态分类、body-free safe summary 和 redaction profile ref。material 不拥有传播状态，也不拥有 source truth 的可变 current pointer。

#### Rust-facing shape（实现契约；support value 仅文件私有）

```rust
/// 从一条已提交的本地宿主变化形成的不可变、无正文事实材料。
pub struct HostFactMaterial {
    /// 本地材料记录的唯一标识。
    material_id: HostFactMaterialId,
    /// 唯一的本地已提交变化锚点。
    source_change_ref: CommittedHostChangeRef,
    /// 该材料所依据的本地事实修订锚点。
    source_revision: HostTruthRevision,
    /// 由 application 先行裁剪并经过 forbidden-body 校验的字段集合。
    safe_fields: MaterialSafeFieldSet,
    /// 形成材料时采用的已验证裁剪 profile 引用。
    redaction_profile_ref: HostRedactionProfileRef,
    /// 在相同 source context 下稳定识别材料的 key。
    material_key: HostMaterialKey,
    /// 可选的前一材料引用；纠正通过新材料表达。
    supersedes_ref: Option<HostFactMaterialRef>,
    /// 材料在本地形成的时间。
    formed_at: Timestamp,
}

/// `material.rs` 唯一拥有的 domain 输入值；仅供 application 的 redaction mapper 构造，不是 contracts DTO、port payload 或新业务对象。
pub struct MaterialSafeFieldSet {
    /// 按 `HostSafeField` 声明顺序保存的、非空且无重复字段项。
    entries: Vec<MaterialSafeFieldEntry>,
}

/// 一项材料字段及其已裁剪的 body-free 摘要；仅能通过本文件 factory 构造。
pub struct MaterialSafeFieldEntry {
    /// 字段族由既有 `contracts::refs::HostSafeField` taxonomy 限定。
    field: HostSafeField,
    /// 与字段族一一对应的已裁剪本地分类。
    summary: MaterialSafeSummary,
}

/// 与一个 `HostSafeField` 精确配对的本地安全摘要；不承载外部正文、route 或 receipt。
pub enum MaterialSafeSummary {
    /// 宿主 identity / lifecycle 的安全摘要。
    HostIdentity(HostSafeLifecycleSummary),
    /// qualification / assembly / readiness 的安全摘要。
    QualificationAndReadiness(HostSafeReadinessSummary),
    /// registration / endpoint-presence / Host Session 的安全摘要。
    RegistrationAndSession(HostSafeSessionSummary),
    /// health / failure / recovery 的安全摘要。
    HealthAndRecovery(HostSafeHealthSummary),
    /// closure / residual / reconciliation 的安全摘要。
    ClosureAndReconciliation(HostSafeClosureSummary),
    /// material / publication / handoff 的安全摘要。
    HandoffAndPublication(HostSafeHandoffSummary),
}

impl MaterialSafeFieldSet {
    /// 从已裁剪的字段项形成材料字段集合。
    pub fn from_redacted_entries(entries: Vec<MaterialSafeFieldEntry>) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

impl MaterialSafeFieldEntry {
    /// 仅在字段族与摘要变体一一对应时形成材料字段项。
    pub fn from_summary(
        field: HostSafeField,
        summary: MaterialSafeSummary,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}
```

`MaterialSafeFieldSet`、`MaterialSafeFieldEntry` 与 `MaterialSafeSummary` 的唯一 schema owner 都是 `crates/domain/src/material.rs`。它们为跨 crate 的 domain factory input 而 `pub`，但不能导出为 public protocol、repository DTO、port payload 或独立业务对象；其字段保持 private。`from_redacted_entries(...)` 和 `from_summary(...)` 必须拒绝空集、重复或非 `HostSafeField` 声明顺序、field-summary 不匹配，以及任何绕过 `HostForbiddenBodyClassSet::mandatory_baseline()` 的未裁剪输入。由于枚举成员只消费既有 body-free `HostSafe*Summary` carrier，raw string、JSON、secret、external body 或 adapter error 不存在可传入的类型位置。

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源与约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `material_id` | `HostFactMaterialId` | immutable material 身份 | application id generator 或 material store rehydrate；不由 source revision、event id、route 或 receipt 推导。 |
| `source_change_ref` | `CommittedHostChangeRef` | 回指唯一 selected committed local change | 只能来自 future application commit-plan / safe persistence selection；不等于 Bus event id、broker offset、history id、CAS version 或 external version。 |
| `source_revision` | `HostTruthRevision` | 固定 material 所依据的 source revision | 来自已选择的 committed local source；不由 projection cursor、page cursor、repository version或 external summary生成。 |
| `safe_fields` | 私有 `MaterialSafeFieldSet` | 保存最小 body-free field / summary | application redaction mapper 先选取；material 自身只做结构和 forbidden-body 验证，不读取 source、不扩展字段。 |
| `redaction_profile_ref` | `HostRedactionProfileRef` | 追溯采用的裁剪 profile | 只能来自已验证 binding 或 safe rehydrate；不是 policy allow、approval、profile body或 readiness proof。 |
| `material_key` | `HostMaterialKey` | 锚定 source / revision / profile 组合的 local material identity | application 从 selected context 形成；不等于 `PublicationKey`、`HandoffKey`、idempotency key、digest、route 或 receipt。 |
| `supersedes_ref` | `Option<HostFactMaterialRef>` | 表达纠正 / 替代关系 | 只能指向同一 material subject 的既有 immutable material；不原地修改 prior，不表示 source 被回滚。 |
| `formed_at` | `Timestamp` | 本地材料形成时点 | application clock / safe rehydrate；不是 source occurred-at、publisher time、delivery time或 DB commit proof。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 返回 / 副作用 / fail-closed |
|---|---|---|
| `pub fn form(material_id: HostFactMaterialId, source_change_ref: CommittedHostChangeRef, source_revision: HostTruthRevision, safe_fields: MaterialSafeFieldSet, redaction_profile_ref: HostRedactionProfileRef, material_key: HostMaterialKey, supersedes_ref: Option<HostFactMaterialRef>, formed_at: Timestamp) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 从 selected committed local change 形成 immutable material。 | 校验 source / revision / key / profile 非空、safe field ordered-unique、forbidden-body baseline 与 prior relation；不写 store、不 enqueue、不调用 port。 |
| `pub fn rehydrate(...) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 从 local safe persistence 重建 material。 | 重新执行同一结构校验；不重新选择 source、不由 projection / external body补字段、不把 rehydrate 当 commit proof。 |
| `pub fn validate_body_free(&self) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 验证材料仍满足 body-free baseline。 | 纯校验；不能执行 redaction、读取 profile 或删除不合规字段。 |
| `pub fn matches_source(&self, source_change_ref: &CommittedHostChangeRef, source_revision: &HostTruthRevision) -> bool` | 判断是否精确锚定同一 selected source。 | 纯比较；不证明 source 当前、UoW 已提交或 material 已发布。 |
| `pub fn supersedes(&self, prior_ref: &HostFactMaterialRef) -> bool` | 判断本材料是否显式替代指定 prior。 | 只比较已保存 relation；不修改 prior、不创建 successor。 |
| `pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostFactMaterialRef` | 暴露窄 typed ref。 | 纯函数；ref 不表示 material body、publication、delivery或 acceptance。 |

#### `HostFactMaterial` 不变量与禁止事项

| 不变量 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| single committed source | 一个 material 只能对应一个 `CommittedHostChangeRef` 与一个 `HostTruthRevision`；多个 source 必须形成新材料或由 application 先合并为一个正式 local change。 |
| immutable correction | material 形成后字段、source、key、profile 和 formed time 不可原地修改；纠正只能新建 material 并使用 `supersedes_ref`。 |
| body-free | `SecretOrCredential`、raw endpoint / transport、image / build、Member body、Runtime body、Sandbox backend / policy、Core/Bus envelope、Observability report 与 L1 body 一律拒绝。 |
| no propagation inference | material 存在不表示 outbox pending、submitted、handoff attempted、delivered、observed 或 accepted。 |
| no source inversion | projection、backend observed state、feedback、receipt、timeout、fake 或 query 不能反向形成 source truth / committed change。 |

### 9.13.4 `material.rs`：`HostHandoffRecord` 对象契约

#### 唯一 owner 与三层反馈边界

`HostHandoffRecord` 与 material 同属 `crates/domain/src/material.rs`，每一份 material 面向每一个 typed `HostHandoffTargetRef` 只形成一条 local record。它拥有本地 attempt、gap、unknown 和三个彼此正交的 feedback link；它不拥有 publication route、event envelope、consumer receipt、delivery owner、observability owner 或 acceptance owner 的 truth。`submitted` 仅属于 outbox，不能自动迁移 handoff；delivery、observation、acceptance 只能由各自 matching safe summary 显式链接，且三者绝不互相推导。

```rust
/// 记录一份材料面向一个目标的本地交接进度及彼此独立的反馈层。
pub struct HostHandoffRecord {
    /// 本地 handoff record 的唯一标识。
    handoff_id: HostHandoffRecordId,
    /// 被交接的不可变材料。
    material_ref: HostFactMaterialRef,
    /// 目标的 typed、安全且不携带 route 的引用。
    target_ref: HostHandoffTargetRef,
    /// material-target 对的稳定 local handoff identity。
    handoff_key: HandoffKey,
    /// 已记录的本地 handoff attempt，固定顺序且不得重复。
    attempts: HandoffAttemptSet,
    /// 仅记录本地 contract / mapper / feedback gap 的集合。
    gaps: HandoffGapSet,
    /// delivery owner 显式提供并经 mapper 裁剪的摘要。
    delivery: Option<HostHandoffDeliverySafeSummary>,
    /// observation owner 显式提供并经 mapper 裁剪的摘要。
    observation: Option<HostHandoffObservationSafeSummary>,
    /// acceptance owner 显式提供并经 mapper 裁剪的摘要。
    acceptance: Option<HostHandoffAcceptanceSafeSummary>,
    /// local handoff lifecycle，不替代三层 feedback payload。
    handoff_status: HostHandoffStatus,
    /// local creation time。
    prepared_at: Timestamp,
    /// latest accepted local mutation time。
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

/// `material.rs` 唯一拥有的 handoff attempt；仅供本对象的 domain factory / transition 输入，不是 transport request、receipt、port payload 或业务对象。
pub struct HandoffAttempt {
    /// local attempt identity，由 future application 在已保存 record 后生成。
    attempt_id: HostHandoffRecordId,
    /// 该 attempt 的 local correlation。
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// 本地记录 attempt 的时间。
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
}

/// `material.rs` 唯一拥有的 handoff attempt 集合；不向 protocol、store 或 port 导出。
pub struct HandoffAttemptSet {
    /// 按 local recorded time、再按 immutable local id 的 canonical order 保存。
    entries: Vec<HandoffAttempt>,
}

/// 描述本地 handoff gap 的 `material.rs` 私有、已裁剪分类。
pub struct HandoffGap {
    /// 闭合的 local gap 类别，不保存 route 或 external error body。
    kind: HandoffGapKind,
    /// 已裁剪的本地原因。
    reason: HostSafeSummaryReason,
    /// gap 被记录的本地时间。
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
}

/// `material.rs` 唯一拥有的 handoff gap 集合；不向 protocol、store 或 port 导出。
pub struct HandoffGapSet {
    /// 按 gap kind、再按 recorded time 的 canonical order 保存。
    entries: Vec<HandoffGap>,
}

/// handoff gap 的本地有限分类；不携带 route、event、receipt 或 external error body。
pub enum HandoffGapKind {
    /// Required publication / handoff contract is not yet closed.
    ContractPending,
    /// Required target mapping is unavailable or non-positive.
    TargetMappingUnavailable,
    /// Required feedback cannot be matched to the original local key and target.
    FeedbackUnmatched,
}

impl HandoffAttempt {
    /// 从已持久化的 handoff record 与 correlation 构造 one local attempt entry。
    pub fn for_saved_record(
        handoff_id: HostHandoffRecordId,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

impl HandoffAttemptSet {
    /// 从已按 canonical order 排列的 entries 构造集合。
    pub fn from_ordered_entries(entries: Vec<HandoffAttempt>) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

impl HandoffGap {
    /// 从本地有限 gap 分类、已裁剪原因与时间构造一项 gap。
    pub fn record(
        kind: HandoffGapKind,
        reason: HostSafeSummaryReason,
        recorded_at: Timestamp,
    ) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

impl HandoffGapSet {
    /// 从已按 canonical order 排列的 gap 构造集合。
    pub fn from_ordered_entries(entries: Vec<HandoffGap>) -> Result<Self, DomainError>;
}

/// `HostHandoffRecord` 仅有的本地 lifecycle；feedback layer 单独以字段保存。
pub enum HostHandoffStatus {
    /// 记录已建立，尚未写入本地 attempt。
    Pending,
    /// 已记录至少一个本地 attempt，但不声明 target 收到材料。
    Attempted,
    /// 存在尚未闭合的本地 route、contract、mapper 或 feedback gap。
    Gap,
    /// 至少一个独立 feedback layer 已被显式链接。
    FeedbackLinked,
    /// 本地 policy 已显式停止该 record 的进一步推进。
    Closed,
    /// attempt effect 或 feedback matching 不能安全判定。
    Unknown { reason: HostSafeSummaryReason },
}
```

`HandoffAttempt`、`HandoffAttemptSet`、`HandoffGap`、`HandoffGapSet` 与 `HandoffGapKind` 的唯一 schema owner 均为 `crates/domain/src/material.rs`。它们为跨 crate 的 domain factory / transition input 而 `pub`，但字段保持 private，不能导出为 public protocol、repository DTO、port payload 或其它 domain 文件的业务对象。`HandoffAttempt.attempt_id` 只锚定其已经保存的 owning record，不是新的 attempt business identity、Core/Bus id、consumer receipt、broker offset、route 或 event id；同一 set 内以 `attempt_id + correlation_id + recorded_at` 有序唯一。所有 set 必须 ordered-unique；不得以 `Vec<String>`、free-text reason 或 external body 代替。

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源与约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `handoff_id` | `HostHandoffRecordId` | local record identity | application id generator / handoff store rehydrate；不由 target id、receipt、publication key 或 correlation 推导。 |
| `material_ref` | `HostFactMaterialRef` | 锚定 immutable material | 必须由已加载且 local committed material 提供；ref 不证明 material delivered。 |
| `target_ref` | `HostHandoffTargetRef` | 固定一个授权 target 的 safe reference | formal target mapper / safe rehydrate；不携带 route、topic、recipient body 或 acceptance truth。 |
| `handoff_key` | `HandoffKey` | material-target stable key | application committed material-target context；同 key 不得对应不同 material 或 target。 |
| `attempts` | 私有 `HandoffAttemptSet` | 保留 local handoff attempt | 只有 future application 在 local record 已持久化后可追加；attempt 不是 publication submission、delivery 或 receipt。 |
| `gaps` | 私有 `HandoffGapSet` | 保留可审计的本地 contract / mapper / feedback gap | 不得以 timeout、absence 或 adapter error text静默移除；gap 不回滚 material。 |
| `delivery` | `Option<HostHandoffDeliverySafeSummary>` | 链接 delivery 层 | 仅 matching formal delivery mapper 可提供；`Some` 不代表 observation / acceptance。 |
| `observation` | `Option<HostHandoffObservationSafeSummary>` | 链接 observation 层 | 仅 matching formal observation mapper 可提供；`Some` 不代表 delivery / acceptance。 |
| `acceptance` | `Option<HostHandoffAcceptanceSafeSummary>` | 链接 acceptance 层 | 仅 matching formal acceptance mapper 可提供；`Some` 不代表 delivery / observation 或 governance approval。 |
| `handoff_status` | `HostHandoffStatus` | local progression | initial only `Pending`；只能由本对象函数转换，且不等于 downstream lifecycle。 |
| times | `Timestamp` | local prepare / mutation ordering | application clock / safe rehydrate；不使用 target source time、receipt time 或 broker timestamp 替代。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 返回 / 副作用 / fail-closed |
|---|---|---|
| `pub fn prepare(handoff_id: HostHandoffRecordId, material_ref: HostFactMaterialRef, target_ref: HostHandoffTargetRef, handoff_key: HandoffKey, prepared_at: Timestamp) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 建立 `Pending` material-target handoff。 | 只验证 local id、target role 与 key 不为空；不查 target、不发 handoff、不构造 attempt 或 feedback。 |
| `pub fn rehydrate(...) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 重建 saved local record。 | 重验 key/material/target、attempt/gap canonicality、status/payload matrix与 time order；不重新 link feedback、不调用 target。 |
| `pub fn record_attempt(&mut self, attempt: HandoffAttempt, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 追加一个 matching local attempt。 | `Pending / Attempted / Gap` 可进入 `Attempted`；attempt key / material / target context必须匹配，重复拒绝；不表达 submitted、delivery、observation、acceptance。 |
| `pub fn record_gap(&mut self, gap: HandoffGap, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 保留一个 named local gap。 | active local status 可进入 `Gap`；不得通过 gap 清除 attempt或 feedback，不改变 handoff key。 |
| `pub fn link_delivery(&mut self, summary: HostHandoffDeliverySafeSummary, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 显式链接 delivery layer。 | future mapper 必须已验证 same handoff key / target；进入 `FeedbackLinked`，但不填 observation / acceptance。 |
| `pub fn link_observation(&mut self, summary: HostHandoffObservationSafeSummary, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 显式链接 observation layer。 | future mapper 必须已验证 same handoff key / target；不补 delivery / acceptance。 |
| `pub fn link_acceptance(&mut self, summary: HostHandoffAcceptanceSafeSummary, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 显式链接 acceptance layer。 | future mapper 必须已验证 same handoff key / target；不补 delivery / observation。 |
| `pub fn mark_unknown(&mut self, reason: HostSafeSummaryReason, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 保留无法安全判定的本地 effect / feedback matching。 | 保持同一 material、target、key、attempt/gap 和已有 feedback；不换 key、不 retry。 |
| `pub fn close(&mut self, reason: HostSafeSummaryReason, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 显式停止本地 progression。 | 进入 `Closed`；不删除 feedback / gap，不表示 target accepted。 |
| `pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostHandoffRecordRef` | 暴露 typed record reference。 | pure；不表示 target、route、attempt 或 feedback exists。 |

| 状态 | 允许迁移 | 不得推导 |
|---|---|---|
| `Pending` | `Attempted` / `Gap` / `Unknown` / `Closed` / `FeedbackLinked`（仅 formal matching feedback） | target 已存在、route ready、submitted 或 delivered。 |
| `Attempted` | `Gap` / `Unknown` / `FeedbackLinked` / `Closed` | publication submitted、delivery、observation、acceptance。 |
| `Gap` | 在同一 `HandoffKey`、新正式依据与 future reconciliation guard 下进入 `Attempted` 或 `FeedbackLinked`；也可 `Unknown` / `Closed` | 新 key retry、静默恢复、任何外部结果。 |
| `FeedbackLinked` | 可继续链接尚缺的独立 layer；可 `Gap` / `Unknown` / `Closed` | 一个 layer 存在即三层 complete、source truth changed。 |
| `Unknown` | 仅 same key / target 的明确后续正式事实可走 `FeedbackLinked` 或 `Closed`；future retry须另有 Step 7/13 guard | 新 key、blind replay、delivery / observation / acceptance。 |
| `Closed` | terminal | downstream accepted、delivery complete、owner confirmation。 |

### 9.13.5 `SafeHostView` 消费边界（只引用既有 `contracts::views`）

`SafeHostView` 已在 §8.6.3 完整定义，本对象组不重定义、移动或在 domain 持有它。它的唯一 public schema owner 是 `contracts/src/views.rs`；application `read.rs` 是唯一 assembly owner。`HostProjectionState` 只提供 projection-local source / availability classification，application 选择 committed source 或 projection-safe field 后才可调用既有 `SafeHostView::compose(...)` / `unavailable_for_authorized_subject(...)`。

| 消费场景 | domain 可以提供 | application / contracts 才能做 | domain 禁止做 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `QuerySafeHostFacts` / `QueryHostHistory` | selected local record 的 narrow accessor、projection-local status / gap | resolve visibility、select safe fields、redact、assemble page / `SafeHostView`、map no-body response | authorization、field selection、view construction、refresh、repair、history rewrite。 |
| projection rebuild | `HostProjectionState` transition candidate、same-state semantic revision guard | load committed source、choose cursor / store proof、persist state、compose new view | public DTO creation、cursor type invention、source rewrite、query side effect。 |
| handoff / outbox summary | local status and only already-linked safe wrapper | decide public field visibility and map `HostSafeHandoffSummary` | turn `Submitted` / linked layer into an external completion claim。 |

`SafeHostView` 的 `NotVisible` 不构成 view；authorized unavailable view 也不得携带 safe slice 或 source revision。Query 永远 no-write：不得 refresh、repair、publish、enqueue、create material、advance outbox / handoff、rebuild projection 或改变任何 CMP-MS-01~06 truth。

### 9.13.6 `projection.rs`：`HostProjectionState` 对象契约

#### 唯一 owner、cursor 占位与职责

`HostProjectionState` 的唯一 owner 是 `crates/domain/src/projection.rs`。它只记录一个安全投影范围的本地推进、可用性和 gap；它不是 `SafeHostView`、source truth、physical projection store、authorization result 或 broker consumer offset。正式 02 的 `HostChangeCursor` 与 HLD 承接材料中的 `CommittedChangeCursor` 尚未形成共同的 exact contract，因此本对象的 cursor 字段只能记作 **pending domain-owned committed projection cursor slot**，不得声明具体 Rust 类型、alias、conversion 或 public field。

```rust
/// 记录一个安全投影范围的本地推进与可用性，不拥有源事实或公开视图。
pub struct HostProjectionState {
    /// 本地 projection-state 记录标识。
    projection_state_id: HostProjectionStateId,
    /// 投影范围；具体 scope carrier 由本仓既有 domain 输入提供。
    projection_scope: HostProjectionScope,
    /// 最近一次被本地接受的 committed change 引用。
    last_applied_change_ref: Option<CommittedHostChangeRef>,
    /// domain-owned committed projection cursor；`HostChangeCursor` / `CommittedChangeCursor` 的 exact type 仍 pending。
    // committed_cursor: <domain-owned committed projection cursor; exact type pending>
    /// 已选 source 的安全 revision；不代表 projection 已 fresh。
    applied_source_revision: Option<HostTruthRevision>,
    /// projection-local semantic revision，不是 store CAS。
    revision: ProjectionRevision,
    /// 投影可用性与推进状态。
    projection_status: HostProjectionStatus,
    /// 已裁剪的本地 projection gap 集合。
    gaps: ProjectionGapSet,
    /// 可安全声明的 source 时点（若有）。
    fresh_as_of: Option<Timestamp>,
    /// 本地创建时间。
    initialized_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次 accepted local mutation 时间。
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

/// `HostProjectionState` 的本地可用性状态；不替代 source truth。
pub enum HostProjectionStatus {
    /// 投影已追上已知 committed source 且没有未闭合 gap。
    Fresh,
    /// 投影落后但仍可带 freshness marker 提供受限读取。
    Stale,
    /// 正在从 committed source 进行显式重建。
    Rebuilding,
    /// 仅部分字段或范围可安全提供。
    Degraded,
    /// 当前无法提供可靠的 projection surface。
    Unavailable,
}
```

`committed_cursor` 仅表示 domain-owned committed projection cursor 槽位；`HostChangeCursor` / `CommittedChangeCursor` 的 exact type 尚未由上游收敛，当前不得把它写成可运行 Rust 类型、alias、转换或第三种 cursor。`HostProjectionScope`、`ProjectionGapSet`、`ProjectionGap` 是 projection.rs 文件私有或既有 domain support value；不承担 broker offset、page cursor、repository version、retry count 或 external source version。

| 字段 | 类型 / 状态 | 作用 | 来源与约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `projection_state_id` | `HostProjectionStateId` | local projection-state identity | application id generator / safe rehydrate；不等于 view id、source revision或 cursor。 |
| `projection_scope` | `HostProjectionScope` | 固定 project-member / host 读取范围 | future application selected scope；scope 不由 query、broker、cache 或 backend 推导。 |
| `last_applied_change_ref` | `Option<CommittedHostChangeRef>` | 回指最近本地接受的 source change | 只表示 local apply candidate 已被接受；不证明 physical store commit、source current 或 public view fresh。 |
| `committed_cursor` | pending cursor slot | 表达投影进度位置 | exact type blocked by `HostChangeCursor` / `CommittedChangeCursor` divergence；不得使用 history id、event id、offset、page cursor、CAS 或 generation替代。 |
| `applied_source_revision` | `Option<HostTruthRevision>` | 记录已选 source revision | application / projection mapper；不表示 cursor complete或 fresh。 |
| `revision` | `ProjectionRevision` | object-local semantic succession | `initial` / `next_after`；不替代 expected-version / CAS / cursor。 |
| `projection_status` | `HostProjectionStatus` | local freshness / availability classification | 只能由本对象 transition 函数改变；Query 不得改变。 |
| `gaps` | 私有 `ProjectionGapSet` | 保留 change missing / mapping / availability gap | 只保存 body-free category / reason；不保存 backend dump、route或 receipt。 |
| `fresh_as_of` / times | `Option<Timestamp>` / `Timestamp` | 公开可安全声明的 local time | application clock / rehydrate；不替代 source captured time、broker time或 commit proof。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 返回 / 状态 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `pub fn initialize(projection_state_id: HostProjectionStateId, projection_scope: HostProjectionScope, initial_cursor: <domain-owned committed projection cursor; exact type pending>, initialized_at: Timestamp) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 建立初始 projection state。 | 初始为 `Rebuilding` 或由显式初始化分类指定的 non-positive 状态；不声明已有 projection 数据、fresh 或 rebuild 完成。`initial_cursor` 只表示 domain-owned committed projection cursor，exact type 必须待上游合同收敛后填入；当前不得据此实现可运行类型。 |
| `pub fn rehydrate(...) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 重建 local projection state。 | 重验 status/gap/revision/time 组合；不恢复 cursor 语义、不把 persisted marker变成 fresh。 |
| `pub fn apply_candidate(&mut self, change_ref: CommittedHostChangeRef, source_revision: HostTruthRevision, expected_revision: ProjectionRevision, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 接受一个由 application 选中的 local apply candidate。 | 只在 same-state revision、source selection和未来 cursor-order guard通过后更新 local fields；当前不声明 exact cursor比较规则，不写 source。 |
| `pub fn mark_stale(&mut self, gap: ProjectionGap, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 记录落后 / gap。 | 状态进入 `Stale`，保留 gap；不 refresh、不补 source。 |
| `pub fn begin_rebuild(&mut self, expected_revision: ProjectionRevision, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 显式进入重建。 | 只允许从 `Stale / Degraded / Unavailable` 等非 fresh 状态开始；不读取 source、不创建 Job run。 |
| `pub fn complete_rebuild(&mut self, source_revision: HostTruthRevision, expected_revision: ProjectionRevision, fresh_as_of: Timestamp, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 在 future source / cursor proof 完整时恢复 `Fresh`。 | 需要同一 local state revision、完整 cursor / gap witness（当前 pending）；缺 witness 必须返回 blocked / unknown，不得仅凭调用成功设 fresh。 |
| `pub fn mark_degraded(&mut self, gaps: ProjectionGapSet, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 表示部分可用。 | 只保存 safe gap；不把 partial 当 fresh / complete。 |
| `pub fn mark_unavailable(&mut self, gap: ProjectionGap, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 阻止不可靠 projection 被当作 current。 | 进入 `Unavailable`；Query 可读 marker，但不触发 repair。 |
| `pub fn status(&self) -> &HostProjectionStatus` / `pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostProjectionStateRef` | 暴露窄本地 surface。 | pure；不加载 cursor、store、source 或 view。 |

| 状态 | 允许迁移 | 禁止解释 |
|---|---|---|
| `Fresh` | `Stale` / `Degraded` / `Unavailable`（新 gap / availability fact） | source 永远 current、所有 fields complete、external owner healthy。 |
| `Stale` | `Rebuilding` 或继续 `Degraded / Unavailable`；有完整 future proof 才可 `Fresh` | Query 读取不会使其 fresh。 |
| `Rebuilding` | `Fresh` / `Degraded` / `Unavailable`，取决于 cursor / source / gap proof | Job started、run_id、artifact 或 rebuild success。 |
| `Degraded` | `Rebuilding` 或 `Unavailable`；完整 proof 才可 `Fresh` | omitted field 代表不存在、source failed或 external cleanup。 |
| `Unavailable` | `Rebuilding`；完整 proof 才可 `Fresh`，否则保留 unavailable | source truth deleted、host terminated或 external backend unavailable 的确定事实。 |

#### projection invariants

| 不变量 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| projection is derived | apply / rebuild 只更新 projection state；不得反写 CMP-MS-01~06 的 source objects。 |
| cursor separation | cursor slot、`HostTruthRevision`、`ProjectionRevision`、page cursor、repository CAS、broker offset与external version不可互换；未收敛前不写 exact type。 |
| query no-write | Query 只能读取 status / gap / safe source marker；不得调用 transition。 |
| fail closed | 缺 cursor order、source commitment、gap closure或 store witness时，不能构造 `Fresh`；保留 `Stale` / `Degraded` / `Unavailable` / `Unknown`。 |

### 9.13.7 `outbox.rs`：`HostOutboxRecord` 对象契约

#### 唯一 owner 与 publication 边界

`HostOutboxRecord` 的唯一 owner 是 `crates/domain/src/outbox.rs`。它绑定一个 immutable material 与一个 publication target，记录本地 publication progression；它不定义 Core/Bus event envelope、route、topic、publisher implementation、consumer receipt 或 external delivery / observation / acceptance。

```rust
/// 记录已提交材料的本地 publication progression，不承担外部交付真相。
pub struct HostOutboxRecord {
    /// 本地 outbox record 唯一标识。
    outbox_record_id: HostOutboxRecordId,
    /// 绑定的 immutable material。
    material_ref: HostFactMaterialRef,
    /// 不携带 route 的 publication target。
    target_ref: HostPublicationTargetRef,
    /// material-target publication 的稳定 key。
    publication_key: PublicationKey,
    /// 已记录的 local publication attempts。
    attempts: PublicationAttemptSet,
    /// 最近一次 local submission safe summary。
    submission: Option<HostPublicationSubmissionSafeSummary>,
    /// local route / contract / publisher / target gap。
    gap: Option<PublicationGap>,
    /// outbox-local progression。
    publication_status: HostOutboxStatus,
    /// 本地创建时间。
    created_at: Timestamp,
    /// 最近一次 local mutation 时间。
    updated_at: Timestamp,
}

/// Outbox 自身的 local progression 状态；不等于 Bus 或 consumer 状态。
pub enum HostOutboxStatus {
    /// material 与 target 已绑定，尚无 attempt。
    Pending,
    /// 已记录至少一个本地 publication attempt。
    Attempted,
    /// 仅记录 publisher boundary 的本地 submission 摘要。
    Submitted,
    /// 传播所需 route、contract、publisher 或 target seam 有缺口。
    Gap,
    /// effect 无法安全判定，必须保留原 publication key。
    Unknown,
    /// 本地 policy 已停止进一步 publication progression。
    Closed,
}
```

`PublicationAttemptSet`、`PublicationAttempt`、`PublicationGap` 的唯一 schema owner 是 `crates/domain/src/outbox.rs`；它们是该文件私有 support value，不导出给 application、store、port、protocol 或其它 domain 文件。`HostPublicationSubmissionSafeSummary` 与 `HostPublicationTargetRef` 只使用既有 `contracts::refs` wrapper。它们不得保存 event body、route、broker offset、receipt 或 retry schedule。

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源与约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outbox_record_id` | `HostOutboxRecordId` | local publication record identity | application id generator / outbox store rehydrate；不等于 event id、message id或 handoff id。 |
| `material_ref` | `HostFactMaterialRef` | 绑定 immutable material | 只接受已形成的 local material ref；不由 outbox 反向形成 material。 |
| `target_ref` | `HostPublicationTargetRef` | 固定 publication target 类别 | formal target mapper / safe rehydrate；不携带 route / topic / envelope。 |
| `publication_key` | `PublicationKey` | 保持同一 material-target publication identity | application materialization context；unknown / gap 时永不替换。 |
| `attempts` | 私有 `PublicationAttemptSet` | 保存本地 publisher attempts | future application 在 record 已保存后追加；attempt 不表示 Bus delivery。 |
| `submission` | `Option<HostPublicationSubmissionSafeSummary>` | 保存 local submitted layer | 只能由 formal publisher mapper 提供；不表示 delivered / observed / accepted。 |
| `gap` | 私有 `PublicationGap` | 保存 named local gap | route / contract / publisher body 不入 domain；gap 不回滚 source。 |
| `publication_status` | `HostOutboxStatus` | local lifecycle | 初始 `Pending`；仅由对象方法迁移。 |
| times | `Timestamp` | local creation / mutation order | application clock / rehydrate；不表示 external send / accept time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 返回 / 状态 / 副作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `pub fn enqueue(outbox_record_id: HostOutboxRecordId, material_ref: HostFactMaterialRef, target_ref: HostPublicationTargetRef, publication_key: PublicationKey, created_at: Timestamp) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 为已形成 material 建立 `Pending` outbox。 | 验证 refs / key 非空；不构造 event、不调用 publisher、不宣称 source commit。 |
| `pub fn rehydrate(...) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 从 local persistence 重建 outbox。 | 重验 status/payload/key/attempt/gap/time matrix；不把 submitted 重写成 delivery。 |
| `pub fn record_attempt(&mut self, attempt: PublicationAttempt, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 追加 local publication attempt。 | `Pending / Gap / Attempted` 可进入 `Attempted`；同 publication key / target context必须匹配，重复拒绝；不表示 send accepted。 |
| `pub fn mark_submitted(&mut self, summary: HostPublicationSubmissionSafeSummary, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 记录 publisher boundary 的 submitted layer。 | 只允许 `Attempted` 或 explicit local retry path；必须 matching target / key，进入 `Submitted`；不填 handoff feedback。 |
| `pub fn record_gap(&mut self, gap: PublicationGap, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 保留 route / contract / publisher gap。 | 进入 `Gap`；不删除 material、attempt或 key。 |
| `pub fn mark_unknown(&mut self, reason: HostSafeSummaryReason, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 保留 post-dispatch unknown effect。 | 进入 `Unknown`；原 publication key / target / attempts immutable，禁止 new-key retry。 |
| `pub fn close(&mut self, reason: HostSafeSummaryReason, updated_at: Timestamp) -> Result<(), DomainError>` | 按 explicit local policy 结束推进。 | 进入 `Closed`；不表示 Bus delivery、observation或 acceptance。 |
| `pub fn publication_key(&self) -> &PublicationKey` / `pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostOutboxRecordRef` | 暴露窄本地 matching surface。 | pure；不解析 key、不调用 publisher。 |

| 状态 | 允许迁移 | 禁止解释 |
|---|---|---|
| `Pending` | `Attempted` / `Gap` / `Unknown` / `Closed` | route ready、event delivered、consumer observed。 |
| `Attempted` | `Submitted` / `Gap` / `Unknown` / `Closed` | publisher ack 等于 delivery / acceptance。 |
| `Submitted` | 仅显式 local close 或后续 matching handoff link；outbox 本身不增加 delivered / observed / accepted 状态 | Bus / downstream 完成。 |
| `Gap` | 同 key、新正式依据和 future retry guard 下 `Attempted`；也可 `Unknown` / `Closed` | 静默恢复、换 key 盲重发。 |
| `Unknown` | 只有 same-key formal resolution 后才可显式推进；否则保持 unknown / closed | timeout / absence 证明成功或失败。 |
| `Closed` | terminal | external target accepted。 |

### 9.13.8 `history.rs`：`HostHistoryEntry` 对象契约

#### 唯一 owner 与 append-only 边界

`HostHistoryEntry` 的唯一 owner 是 `crates/domain/src/history.rs`，供 CMP-MS-01~07 以及后续本仓 local changes 追加使用。它记录 body-free local change summary 与因果链，不拥有任一 domain object 的 current pointer，不接受 command 作为 source，也不存储 raw request、external body、receipt、report 或 evidence。

```rust
/// 记录一个不可变、无正文的本地宿主变化条目；纠正通过新条目表达。
pub struct HostHistoryEntry {
    /// 本地 history entry 唯一标识。
    history_entry_id: HostHistoryEntryId,
    /// 产生该变化的本地 truth owner 分类。
    owner_ref: HostHistoryOwnerRef,
    /// 变化类别；不等于 command name 或 transport event。
    change_kind: HostChangeKind,
    /// 该条目所对应的 selected committed local change。
    source_change_ref: CommittedHostChangeRef,
    /// 可选的前序或被替代 history relation。
    prior_relation: Option<HistoryPriorRelation>,
    /// 已裁剪的 body-free 变化摘要。
    safe_change_summary: HostSafeChangeSummary,
    /// 跨对象因果关联。
    correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// 本地记录时间。
    recorded_at: Timestamp,
}

/// 标识历史条目的 local owner，不承载对象正文或 external owner identity。
pub enum HostHistoryOwnerRef {
    /// CMP-MS-01 intent / decision owner。
    Control,
    /// CMP-MS-02 qualification / assembly / readiness owner。
    Qualification,
    /// CMP-MS-03 host / attempt / association owner。
    Progression,
    /// CMP-MS-04 registration / endpoint / session owner。
    Registration,
    /// CMP-MS-05 health / recovery owner。
    Health,
    /// CMP-MS-06 closure / reconciliation owner。
    Closure,
    /// CMP-MS-07 material / handoff / projection / outbox owner。
    Handoff,
}

/// 历史条目记录的 local change 类别；不表示外部动作完成。
pub enum HostChangeKind {
    /// A local truth record was accepted and committed by its owning flow.
    Accepted,
    /// A new immutable record supersedes a prior local record.
    Superseded,
    /// A local relation or propagation path was invalidated.
    Invalidated,
    /// A named local contract / mapping / availability gap was recorded.
    Gap,
    /// A local unknown effect or unresolved relation was recorded.
    Unknown,
    /// A local projection or handoff classification was corrected by a new entry.
    Corrected,
}

/// 通过 prior / supersedes relation表达纠正；不改写旧条目。
pub struct HistoryPriorRelation {
    /// 被当前条目引用的旧 history entry。
    prior_ref: HostHistoryEntryRef,
    /// 关系类别，由本地 history policy 固定。
    relation_kind: HistoryRelationKind,
}

/// 历史 relation 的有限分类。
pub enum HistoryRelationKind {
    /// 当前条目补充或替代旧条目，但不删除旧条目。
    Supersedes,
    /// 当前条目对旧条目作出安全纠正。
    Corrects,
}
```

`HostSafeChangeSummary` 的唯一 schema owner 是 `contracts/src/refs.rs` 的既有 public body-free summary carrier；history 只消费已定义 carrier，不在此处假定或补写字段。若该类型尚未提供完整字段，history append 仍须停在 typed-output pending，而不用 `String` 或 JSON 补洞。`HostHistoryOwnerRef`、`HostChangeKind`、`HistoryPriorRelation` 和 `HistoryRelationKind` 的唯一 schema owner 是 `crates/domain/src/history.rs`，均为该文件 domain-local support value；不得成为 public protocol enum 或外部审计 taxonomy。

| 字段 | 类型 | 作用 | 来源与约束 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `history_entry_id` | `HostHistoryEntryId` | immutable history identity | application id generator / history store rehydrate；不等于 source change、event、receipt或 audit signoff。 |
| `owner_ref` | `HostHistoryOwnerRef` | 标识本地 CMP owner | 由 owning domain flow 的 formal mapper 提供；不由 history entry、query、job或 external owner推断。 |
| `change_kind` | `HostChangeKind` | 分类本地变化 | 由 owning domain transition / history mapper选定；不表示外部动作或 policy approval。 |
| `source_change_ref` | `CommittedHostChangeRef` | 锚定 selected local committed change | 只能来自 owning flow 的 local commit-plan / safe persistence selection；不等于 history id、CAS、broker offset或 external version。 |
| `prior_relation` | `Option<HistoryPriorRelation>` | 形成 append-only replacement / correction chain | 只能引用已存在且同 owner / subject compatible 的 history entry；不得循环、原地覆盖或删除 prior。 |
| `safe_change_summary` | `HostSafeChangeSummary` | 保存最小 body-free 摘要 | application redaction / history mapper output；禁止 secret、endpoint、image、Runtime、Sandbox、Bus、Observability、L1 body。 |
| `correlation_id` | `CorrelationId` | 关联同一 local control / feedback chain | validated local context / rehydrate；不作为 idempotency key、source authority或 external trace truth。 |
| `recorded_at` | `Timestamp` | 本地 append 时间 | application clock / rehydrate；不等于 source occurred-at、DB commit time或 owner acceptance time。 |

| 函数签名 | 作用 | 返回 / 副作用 / fail-closed |
|---|---|---|
| `pub fn append(history_entry_id: HostHistoryEntryId, owner_ref: HostHistoryOwnerRef, change_kind: HostChangeKind, source_change_ref: CommittedHostChangeRef, prior_relation: Option<HistoryPriorRelation>, safe_change_summary: HostSafeChangeSummary, correlation_id: CorrelationId, recorded_at: Timestamp) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 构造一个 immutable history candidate。 | 校验 source / owner / relation / summary 为 typed safe values；不写 store、不改变任何 current truth。 |
| `pub fn rehydrate(...) -> Result<Self, DomainError>` | 重建 persisted history entry。 | 重验 relation 不循环、summary body-free、时间与 key 结构；不回写 prior或重放 command。 |
| `pub fn supersedes(&self, prior_ref: &HostHistoryEntryRef) -> bool` | 判断是否显式替代 prior。 | 纯比较；不修改 prior、不删除旧条目。 |
| `pub fn references_source(&self, source_change_ref: &CommittedHostChangeRef) -> bool` | 判断条目是否锚定指定 source change。 | 纯比较；不证明 source 当前或 external effect 完成。 |
| `pub fn to_ref(&self) -> HostHistoryEntryRef` | 暴露窄 history reference。 | pure；ref 不成为 command input、source truth或 audit approval。 |

| 不变量 / 禁止事项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| append-only | history entry 一经形成不可修改、删除或复用 identity；纠正 / supersede 必须追加新 entry。 |
| source / history separation | `source_change_ref` 只回指 source anchor；history id、prior ref、correlation 和 summary不能替代 source truth。 |
| body-free audit | 只保存安全摘要和 typed local references；raw request、external response、secret、report、evidence、route、receipt不入 history。 |
| no command source | Query、Job、history reader不得根据历史条目直接创建 intent、decision、attempt、cleanup、restart或 publication。 |

### 9.13.9 字段来源、状态闭环与四层分层审计

#### 对象字段来源审计

| 对象 | 高风险字段 | 唯一允许来源 | fail-closed / 禁止替代 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HostFactMaterial` | source change / revision / safe fields / material key | selected committed local change、application redaction mapper、validated profile binding | 没有 committed anchor 或 forbidden-body proof 时拒绝；不从 projection、backend、feedback、receipt反推。`MaterialSafeFieldSet` / `MaterialSafeSummary` 的唯一 owner 为 `domain/src/material.rs`，仅接受既有 contracts safe-summary carrier。 |
| `HostHandoffRecord` | target / handoff key / delivery-observation-acceptance | formal target mapper、application key builder、各自 matching feedback mapper | 任一 layer 缺失保持 `None`；不由 submitted、timeout或其他 layer补齐。`HandoffAttempt*` / `HandoffGap*` 仅归 `domain/src/material.rs`，不得升级为 public protocol carrier。 |
| `HostProjectionState` | cursor slot / source revision / status | future cursor contract、selected local source、projection domain transition | cursor contract未收敛时不写 exact type；不得用 history id、broker offset、page cursor、CAS或 generation替代。`HostProjectionScope` / `ProjectionGap*` 仅归 `domain/src/projection.rs`。 |
| `HostOutboxRecord` | target / publication key / submission | formal publication target mapper、application key builder、publisher safe mapper | route / envelope / receipt缺失进入 `Gap` / `Unknown`；不声明 delivery。`PublicationAttempt*` / `PublicationGap` 仅归 `domain/src/outbox.rs`。 |
| `HostHistoryEntry` | owner / change kind / prior relation / summary | owning domain transition、history mapper、redaction boundary | owner或summary不明时不追加；不从 query/job/fake/raw body推断。`HostSafeChangeSummary` 必须使用既有 `contracts::refs` owner，不能在 history.rs shadow。 |

#### 状态闭环审计

| 状态轴 | 初始 | 允许迁移 | 不可跨轴传播 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `HostFactMaterial` | immutable candidate | 新 material 以 `supersedes_ref` 纠正 | 不产生 outbox / handoff delivered / accepted。 |
| `HostHandoffRecord` | `Pending` | `Attempted`、`Gap`、`FeedbackLinked`、`Unknown`、`Closed`；每个 feedback layer独立 link | submitted 不推导 delivery；delivery 不推导 observation / acceptance。 |
| `HostProjectionState` | `Rebuilding` 或显式 non-positive initialization | `Fresh`、`Stale`、`Degraded`、`Unavailable` 与重建循环 | Query 不改状态；projection 不反写 source。 |
| `HostOutboxRecord` | `Pending` | `Attempted`、`Submitted`、`Gap`、`Unknown`、`Closed` | submitted 不推导 delivered / observed / accepted；unknown 不换 key。 |
| `HostHistoryEntry` | immutable append | 新 entry + relation | history 不成为 command source或 current pointer。 |

#### 四层边界审计

| 层 | 本批承接 | 不承接 |
|---|---|---|
| control plane | materialization trigger、publication / projection progression 的本地编排输入、safe query selection | L1 authorization / Governance approval truth、Core route、scheduler truth。 |
| host truth | committed source anchor、immutable material、local handoff / outbox / history record | Member主体、Runtime run/session body、Images content、Sandbox backend/policy、external owner state。 |
| runtime session | 仅保留 future Runtime / Host Session 的 opaque safe ref 或 blocked seam | Runtime run、checkpoint、tool execution、LLM loop、outcome body。 |
| execution handoff | typed target、local attempt、submission / feedback layer、projection-safe view | delivery / observation / acceptance 的推导、外部 receipt、consumer truth、Bus envelope。 |

Step 7 只可在用户另行明确授权后承接以下命名 seam，本节不创建 Step 7 文件：

| future seam | 必须消费的 Step 6 输入 | 当前状态 / 禁止补写 |
|---|---|---|
| material / history store + same-UoW writer | `CommittedHostChangeRef`、material / history typed ids、safe field / summary、prior relation | planned / blocked；不定义数据库、表、commit result或 artifact。 |
| publication / handoff mapper + publisher port | `PublicationKey`、`HandoffKey`、typed target ref、submission / feedback wrappers | `MSVC-UP-007` pending；不定义 route、envelope、receipt、delivery或 acceptance。 |

### 9.13.11 CMP-MS-07 停审、字段 / 状态 / boundary 结论

| 审查项 | 结果 | 证据 / 收口结论 |
|---|---|---|
| capability-to-object coverage | pass | `CAP-MS-25~28` 分别由 material、handoff、safe view、projection、outbox、history 对象 / owner 承接；无第 30 个业务对象。 |
| unique owner | pass | material / handoff -> `domain/src/material.rs`；projection -> `domain/src/projection.rs`；outbox -> `domain/src/outbox.rs`；history -> `domain/src/history.rs`；SafeHostView -> `contracts/src/views.rs`；shared carriers -> `contracts/src/refs.rs`。 |
| field source / factory / function completeness | pass_with_upstream_blockers | 六个对象均有 Rust-facing shape、字段来源、factory、成员函数、状态 / 不变量；cursor exact type、feedback mapper、route / envelope / receipt仍 pending。 |
| cursor separation | pass_with_upstream_blockers | `HostChangeCursor` / `CommittedChangeCursor` 命名差异保持 pending；未创建第三种 cursor、alias、conversion或替代字段。 |
| feedback layer separation | pass | `submitted`、`delivered`、`observed`、`accepted` 独立保存，互不推导；material / view / history immutable。 |
| projection / public view boundary | pass | domain 只拥有 projection state；SafeHostView、visibility、freshness、page与public no-body surface保持 contracts/application owner。 |
| control / host / runtime / handoff layering | pass_with_upstream_blockers | 本仓只保留 host-side local records、safe refs和handoff layers；Runtime、Member、Images、Sandbox、Core、Bus、Observability与L1 truth未被吸收。 |
| old-document pollution | pass | 未恢复 `RuntimeActionIntake`、direct execute、execution handle、固定 container/RPC/database/topic、checkpoint/memory/tool loop、backend truth或实现证据。 |

`domain / CMP-MS-07` object-group stop-review conclusion: **completed / pass_with_upstream_blockers**。本批完成五个 domain object 与既有 `SafeHostView` consumption boundary 的 Step 6 契约、字段来源、状态闭环、四层边界和 Step 7 future seam 命名。`MSVC-UP-001~008`、cursor exact contract、Core/Bus route/envelope/receipt、feedback owner 与 sibling detailed contracts 继续 pending / blocked；本批不创建 Step 7、实现、测试、artifact、report、evidence、verdict、signoff、readiness 或 commit。

本节只确认 application 的 capability、唯一 file owner、stable-carrier 缺口与不可越界项；不写任何 application Rust-facing object card、字段、factory、成员函数、trait method 或 protocol schema。这样既为后续对象卡固定可落码的归属，也不把本轮预检越权扩展为 application 模块完成。

| Step 5 模块契约 | application 只依赖 contracts + domain，定义 port 并编排 UoW；infra 实现 port，entry 只构造 context / 映射 disposition | application 不得持有 concrete client、adapter、DB / broker / RPC / container model，且不能以运行期协作伪装 Cargo 依赖。 |

| `MSVC-UP-001~008` | Runtime、Member、Images、Sandbox、Core/Bus、SDK 的 exact contract 仍 pending / blocked | application 只能保留 typed placeholder、blocked / gap / unknown / fail-closed decision surface；不能补 route、envelope、receipt、credential、manifest、backend outcome 或 ready 正向路径。 |

#### 9.14.2 capability 到 application 对象组 / 文件 owner 映射

| capability / 功能 | 唯一 application owner | 预期稳定 carrier 或 assembly 责任（本轮不定义字段） | 明确不拥有 |
|---|---|---|---|
| facade 与 use-case 选择 | `application/src/services.rs` | 唯一 facade、command / query / consumer / job use-case assembly；只接收 operation-level input 并向已定义 domain behavior / port 编排转交 | domain truth、repository / port implementation、infra runtime builder、entry disposition、external client。 |
| 已提交事实的 material / history / outbox / handoff 编排 | `application/src/use_cases/materialization.rs` | committed local change 的 selection / materialization orchestration、local history / outbox / handoff write-set coordination | Bus route / envelope、publication receipt、delivery / observed / accepted truth、feedback body、`HostChangeCursor` / `CommittedChangeCursor` exact type。 |
| 安全视图与历史页读取 | `application/src/use_cases/read.rs` | 唯一 `SafeHostView` / history page read assembly、visibility-safe selection 与 unavailable / degraded assembly seam | refresh、repair、rebuild、publication、source truth 写入、authorization truth 或 physical projection store。 |
| local write-set 与 UoW 编排 | `application/src/transactions.rs`；port declaration: `application/src/ports/unit_of_work.rs` | local read/write-set boundary、commit / rollback orchestration carrier 与 result classification input | expected-version algorithm、commit proof、distributed transaction、database detail、CAS / cursor 替代。 |
| replay / duplicate / stored-result 决策 | `application/src/idempotency.rs` | operation channel / context、request digest、reservation / decision、stored-result ref or shell；durable persistence remains future infra owner | DB row / cache layout、broker dedup truth、external receipt、arbitrary regenerated key、domain revision as idempotency key。 |
| contracts-domain / safe-view / port-neutral mapping | `application/src/mappers.rs`；failure classification: `application/src/errors.rs` | typed mapper input / output shell、safe redaction-aware result mapping、application error classification | sibling DTO、raw external error body、Core/Bus envelope、transport error / entry disposition、domain private-field mutation。 |
| 已提交维护工作的选择与 job report assembly | `application/src/jobs.rs` | candidate selection、application job handler / report assembly、blocked / no-work / gap outcome input | scheduler truth、job trigger authorization、lifecycle decision、direct repository / adapter call or external execution completion。 |

#### 9.14.3 稳定 carrier 缺口与未来对象卡边界

以下名称只是 future object-card 的工作分类，不是新 public protocol、Rust 类型、字段或 exact schema；写卡时必须逐项确认唯一 owner、source、state、factory / method 和禁止替代。

| future carrier 分类 | 唯一候选 owner | 需要在对象卡闭口的最低问题 | 当前边界 / blocker |
|---|---|---|---|
| operation channel / operation context | `services.rs` | 如何区分 command、query、consumer、job；metadata / correlation / subject 的输入边界与不可伪造字段来源 | entry exact DTO / envelope 与 Core metadata mapping 未闭合；不得由 context 证明 authorization、external identity 或 source currentness。 |
| request digest / idempotency reservation / stored-result shell | `idempotency.rs` | digest 的 canonical input、reservation state、same-input duplicate / different-input conflict、stored-result safe ref 与 expiry / outcome boundary | durable store、consumer / job exact identity、Core/Bus receipt均待后续 Step；不得用 request body string、broker offset、domain revision或 timestamp替代。 |
| local transaction / write-set outcome | `transactions.rs` + `ports/unit_of_work.rs` | read-set、write-set、rollback / commit classification与 domain mutation sequence的 application boundary | exact expected version、commit proof、physical transaction与 multi-store atomicity不在本轮定义。 |
| materialization / handoff coordination result | `use_cases/materialization.rs` | 何时只为已提交 local change 形成 material/history/outbox/handoff candidate，何时保持 blocked / gap / unknown | cursor、publication / feedback schema、Runtime / Member / Sandbox mapper仍 pending；不得把 submitted 推成 delivery。 |
| read visibility assembly result | `use_cases/read.rs` | authorized safe selection、visible / unavailable / degraded distinction、history page assembly和 strict no-write guard | `SafeHostView` schema 已属 contracts；visibility authority / projection-store details不由 application 自定。 |
| mapper outcome / application error | `mappers.rs` + `errors.rs` | contracts↔domain、port-neutral result、redaction / no-body failure分类与 entry 可映射错误边界 | 不 shadow external DTO / error；transport / protocol mapping留给 Step 8与 entry object group。 |
| job candidate / application job report | `jobs.rs` | 仅从 committed local work 选择、执行前 / 后的 result shell、no-work / blocked / gap区分 | schedule / lease / trigger truth和run disposition属于 jobs entry；不能形成新 formal control或外部 execution truth。 |

#### 9.14.4 预检失败关闭与跨层防线

| 风险点 | 预检结论 | fail-closed 规则 |
|---|---|---|
| `SafeHostView` 与 `HostProjectionState` 混同 | 已排除 | `SafeHostView` 继续由 `contracts/src/views.rs` 拥有，`HostProjectionState` 继续由 domain 拥有，`read.rs` 只做 assembly，physical store 只归 infra；任何反向移动均需回退 Step 4/5。 |
| UoW / idempotency 变成 infra 或 domain truth | 已排除 | application 只定义编排 carrier / port boundary；没有 future port + infra implementation 前，不声明 expected-version、commit proof、durability、exact replay或 transaction ready。 |
| materialization 把 local submission 升级为 external completion | 已排除 | `submitted`、`delivered`、`observed`、`accepted` 保持四层独立；route / envelope / receipt / feedback缺失时只能 blocked、gap或unknown。 |
| read path 隐式 repair / refresh / authorization | 已排除 | Query 没有 truth write、rebuild、publish、repair或 external resolver side effect；不可见 / 无法安全读取必须显式返回已有的 no-body / unavailable surface。 |
| application 代替 sibling 补精确合同 | 已排除 | 对 Runtime、Member、Images、Sandbox、Core/Bus、SDK 一律使用已定义 ref / placeholder / safe summary；正向分支需等各自正式 contract。 |
| jobs / operation context 越权成为控制面 | 已排除 | scheduler、consumer 到达、duplicate replay、job candidate 都不构成 intent、approval、lifecycle decision或 external execution completion。 |

## 9.15 `application` 对象组：对象卡（本轮补齐）

> 本节将 9.14 preflight 提出的稳定 carrier 落到唯一文件 owner。它们是 application 编排对象，不是第 30 个业务对象；不拥有 Host Truth、外部完成或 transport truth。

### 9.15.1 `services.rs`：facade 与 operation context

```rust
/// Identifies the application entry channel without implying a lifecycle state.
pub enum OperationChannel {
    /// Synchronous command that may mutate local Host Truth.
    Command,
    /// Read-only request that assembles an authorized safe result.
    Query,
    /// Inbound event or feedback item handled with a local receipt.
    Consumer,
    /// Scheduled maintenance work over already committed local records.
    Job,
}

/// Carries validated entry metadata into one application operation.
pub struct ApplicationOperationContext {
    /// Entry channel selected by the caller; it is not inferred from a route.
    pub channel: OperationChannel,
    /// Correlation identity supplied by the entry or formal envelope.
    pub correlation_id: CorrelationId,
    /// Project-scoped execution subject; non-project execution is rejected in this scope.
    pub subject: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Global member identity anchor used for relation checks only.
    pub identity_anchor: GlobalMemberRef,
    /// Stable replay identity when the channel supports idempotency.
    pub idempotency_key: Option<IdempotencyKey>,
}

impl ApplicationOperationContext {
    /// Builds a context from validated entry carriers; no authorization or source freshness is inferred.
    pub fn from_validated(
        channel: OperationChannel,
        correlation_id: CorrelationId,
        subject: ProjectMemberRef,
        identity_anchor: GlobalMemberRef,
        idempotency_key: Option<IdempotencyKey>,
    ) -> Result<Self, ApplicationError>;

    /// Returns whether this operation may enter a write use case.
    pub fn permits_write(&self) -> bool;
}

/// Owns application use-case assembly and exposes no concrete adapter.
pub struct MemberServiceFacade;

impl MemberServiceFacade {
    /// Dispatches a validated command to the selected use case and returns a local result shell.
    pub async fn handle_command<C: CommandInput>(
        &self,
        context: ApplicationOperationContext,
        command: C,
    ) -> Result<CommandResult, ApplicationError>;

    /// Dispatches a read-only query; this method must not open a write transaction.
    pub async fn handle_query<Q: QueryInput>(
        &self,
        context: ApplicationOperationContext,
        query: Q,
    ) -> Result<QueryResult, ApplicationError>;

    /// Handles one consumer item and returns a local receipt or gap disposition.
    pub async fn handle_consumer<E: ConsumerInput>(
        &self,
        context: ApplicationOperationContext,
        event: E,
    ) -> Result<ConsumerResult, ApplicationError>;

    /// Runs one maintenance unit selected from committed local work.
    pub async fn handle_job<J: JobInput>(
        &self,
        context: ApplicationOperationContext,
        job: J,
    ) -> Result<JobResult, ApplicationError>;
}
```

| 字段 / 方法 | 约束与来源 |
|---|---|
| `channel` | 由 entry 显式给出；不得由 URI、topic、scheduler 或错误文本推断。 |
| `subject` / `identity_anchor` | 必须同时存在；只允许 `ProjectMemberRef` 作为执行主语，`GlobalMemberRef` 只作身份锚。关系未由正式 mapper 证明时 fail-closed。 |
| `idempotency_key` | Command / Consumer / Job 必须有稳定 key；Query 不把 local revision 当作幂等 key。 |
| `handle_*` | 仅负责 use-case 选择和 port 编排；不实现 repository、adapter、domain private-field mutation 或 transport mapping。 |

### 9.15.2 `use_cases/materialization.rs`：提交后物化编排

```rust
/// Describes a committed local change that is eligible for materialization.
pub struct CommittedChangeSelection {
    /// Opaque local change reference returned by the UoW after commit ordering is known.
    pub change_ref: HostChangeRef,
    /// Host subject and generation associated with the committed change.
    pub host_ref: HostRef,
    /// Body-free source references selected from local truth.
    pub source_refs: HostSourceRefSet,
    /// Correlation inherited from the command or consumer.
    pub correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

/// Carries the local write-set plan for material, history, outbox and handoff records.
pub struct MaterializationPlan {
    /// Immutable material candidate derived from committed local facts only.
    pub material_candidate: HostFactMaterialCandidate,
    /// Append-only history candidate, when the object family requires one.
    pub history_candidate: Option<HostHistoryEntryCandidate>,
    /// Per-target handoff candidates; an empty set is valid when no target is configured.
    pub handoff_candidates: HandoffCandidateSet,
    /// Publication candidates created from the stored material snapshot.
    pub outbox_candidates: OutboxCandidateSet,
}

/// Reports local materialization without upgrading submission to delivery or acceptance.
pub enum MaterializationResult {
    /// Local records were committed and are eligible for later publication.
    Committed(MaterializationReceipt),
    /// The source change is not yet eligible because an upstream contract is blocked.
    Blocked(MaterializationBlocker),
    /// An unknown effect or missing source requires reconciliation rather than replay.
    Unknown(MaterializationUnknown),
}

impl MaterializationPlan {
    /// Builds candidates from a committed local change; rejects uncommitted or body-bearing input.
    pub fn from_committed(selection: CommittedChangeSelection) -> Result<Self, ApplicationError>;

    /// Applies the plan through the supplied local UoW and returns a local result shell.
    pub async fn persist(self, uow: &mut dyn UnitOfWork) -> Result<MaterializationResult, ApplicationError>;
}
```

禁止事项：不能在该文件生成 Bus route、event envelope、feedback receipt、cursor alias 或外部正文；`persist` 成功只表示本地 material/history/outbox/handoff 写集提交。

### 9.15.3 `use_cases/read.rs`：安全读取编排

```rust
/// Selects a safe read surface without requesting refresh or repair.
pub struct SafeReadRequest {
    /// Project-scoped subject whose visibility must be resolved by a formal policy input.
    pub subject: ProjectMemberRef,
    /// Optional host or generation selector.
    pub host_ref: Option<HostRef>,
    /// Requested safe field family; raw external fields are not representable.
    pub field_selection: SafeFieldSelection,
    /// Caller freshness preference; it cannot override a stale marker.
    pub freshness: FreshnessRequest,
}

/// Isolates public view assembly from domain projection state and physical storage.
pub enum SafeReadAssembly {
    /// A body-free immutable view assembled from authorized local facts.
    Visible(SafeHostView),
    /// The caller is not allowed to receive a view; no body is returned.
    NotVisible(VisibilityMarker),
    /// A view exists but is stale, degraded or unavailable for safe consumption.
    Degraded(DegradedViewSurface),
}

impl SafeReadRequest {
    /// Validates selector and field constraints without performing I/O.
    pub fn validate(self) -> Result<Self, ApplicationError>;
}

/// Performs a query-only assembly over source, projection and history ports.
pub async fn assemble_safe_read(
    request: SafeReadRequest,
    context: &ApplicationOperationContext,
    reader: &dyn ReadPort,
) -> Result<SafeReadAssembly, ApplicationError>;
```

`assemble_safe_read` 不调用 resolver、repair、rebuild、publisher 或 domain transition；projection stale 只作为结果 marker 返回。

### 9.15.4 `transactions.rs` 与 `ports/unit_of_work.rs`：本地 UoW carrier

```rust
/// Captures the local read and write sets for one application operation.
pub struct UnitOfWorkScope {
    /// Expected local revisions read before a mutation.
    pub read_set: ReadSet,
    /// Domain records and append-only records to be persisted.
    pub write_set: WriteSet,
    /// Correlation identity for trace and history linkage.
    pub correlation_id: CorrelationId,
}

/// Classifies the local transaction result without claiming distributed atomicity.
pub enum TransactionOutcome {
    /// All local writes were committed according to the adapter proof.
    Committed(LocalCommitRef),
    /// Optimistic version or uniqueness check rejected the write set.
    Conflict(TransactionConflict),
    /// The adapter could not prove whether the commit happened.
    CommitStatusUnknown(TransactionUnknown),
    /// The write set was rejected before commit and is safe to retry with the same key.
    RolledBack(TransactionRollback),
}

/// Defines the local transaction seam implemented by infra.
pub trait UnitOfWork {
    /// Begins a local read/write scope; no external call occurs here.
    fn begin(&mut self, context: &ApplicationOperationContext) -> Result<UnitOfWorkScope, UnitOfWorkError>;
    /// Commits the local write set and returns a proof or unknown classification.
    fn commit(&mut self, scope: UnitOfWorkScope) -> Result<TransactionOutcome, UnitOfWorkError>;
    /// Rolls back uncommitted local writes; it cannot undo an external effect.
    fn rollback(&mut self, scope: UnitOfWorkScope) -> Result<(), UnitOfWorkError>;
}
```

`UnitOfWork` 不定义数据库、锁、CAS 算法或跨仓事务；expected-version 的来源由各 repository port 读取并交给 domain/application guard，commit proof 的具体形态仍由 Step 7 / 11 收口。

### 9.15.5 `idempotency.rs`：幂等与 stored result shell

```rust
/// Canonical digest of the operation identity and semantic input.
pub struct RequestDigest {
    /// Stable hash carrier produced from canonical typed fields, never raw transport bytes.
    pub value: DigestValue,
}

/// Reserves a stable operation key before a mutation can run.
pub enum ReservationDecision {
    /// This key is new and may proceed under the reservation.
    Reserved(OperationReservation),
    /// The same key and digest already completed; caller must replay the stored result.
    Duplicate(StoredResultRef),
    /// The same key was used with a different digest; mutation is rejected.
    Conflict(IdempotencyConflict),
    /// An earlier attempt has unknown completion; caller must hold or reconcile.
    InFlight(OperationReservation),
}

/// Identifies a stored local result without embedding its body.
pub struct StoredResultRef {
    /// Local immutable reference to a command, consumer or job result.
    pub value: String,
    /// Result channel prevents a command result from being replayed as a consumer receipt.
    pub channel: OperationChannel,
}

pub trait IdempotencyPort {
    /// Reserves a key and digest within the current local UoW.
    fn reserve(&mut self, context: &ApplicationOperationContext, digest: RequestDigest, uow: &mut dyn UnitOfWork) -> Result<ReservationDecision, IdempotencyError>;
    /// Completes a reservation with a stored result reference after local commit ordering is known.
    fn complete(&mut self, reservation: OperationReservation, result_ref: StoredResultRef, uow: &mut dyn UnitOfWork) -> Result<(), IdempotencyError>;
    /// Loads a previously stored result for exact-channel replay.
    fn load(&self, result_ref: &StoredResultRef) -> Result<StoredResult, IdempotencyError>;
}
```

禁止以 domain revision、broker offset、timestamp、重新生成的 key 或外部 receipt 替代 `RequestDigest` / `StoredResultRef`；unknown 不得换 key 盲重放。

### 9.15.6 `mappers.rs`、`errors.rs`：中性映射与应用错误

```rust
/// Carries typed source and target values through a mapper without exposing raw bodies.
pub struct MapperInput<S, C> {
    /// Domain or port-neutral source value.
    pub source: S,
    /// Operation context that supplies subject and correlation only.
    pub context: C,
}

/// Application-level error categories that entries may map without reading private fields.
pub enum ApplicationError {
    /// The input carrier is structurally invalid.
    InvalidInput(ContractError),
    /// Required local truth was not found or is not current.
    LocalFactUnavailable(LocalFactGap),
    /// The operation conflicts with a current revision or unique-current guard.
    Conflict(ApplicationConflict),
    /// An upstream exact contract is unavailable; positive progression is blocked.
    UpstreamBlocked(UpstreamBlocker),
    /// An external effect has unknown completion and requires reconciliation.
    UnknownEffect(UnknownEffectRef),
    /// A local adapter failed without exposing product error body.
    AdapterFailure(AdapterFailureClass),
}

/// Maps a local application result to a public safe carrier.
pub fn map_public_result<T>(input: MapperInput<T, ApplicationOperationContext>) -> Result<PublicResult, ApplicationError>;

/// Maps an error while enforcing the mandatory forbidden-body baseline.
pub fn map_error(error: ApplicationError) -> ContractError;
```

映射函数不得创建 domain 对象、补齐 sibling DTO、推断授权、读取 raw external error body，或把 application error 直接当作 transport status。

### 9.15.7 `jobs.rs`：已提交工作选择与报告组装

```rust
/// Selects one bounded unit of already committed maintenance work.
pub struct JobCandidate {
    /// Stable local work identity, never a scheduler trigger id alone.
    pub work_ref: LocalWorkRef,
    /// Work family determines the allowed application handler.
    pub family: JobWorkFamily,
    /// Source revision / generation used for late-result fencing.
    pub source_revision: LocalRevision,
}

/// Reports a maintenance unit without creating a new lifecycle decision.
pub enum JobWorkResult {
    /// Local work advanced and its resulting record was committed.
    Advanced(LocalWorkReceipt),
    /// No due work matched the selector.
    NoWork,
    /// Work exists but an upstream contract or freshness requirement blocks it.
    Blocked(JobBlocker),
    /// Work completion cannot be proven; record remains for reconciliation.
    Unknown(JobUnknown),
}

pub async fn select_and_run_job(
    context: ApplicationOperationContext,
    selector: JobSelector,
    facade: &MemberServiceFacade,
) -> Result<JobWorkResult, ApplicationError>;
```

Job helper 不持有 scheduler、lease、cron 或 trigger truth，不创建 `HostOrchestrationDecision` / `HostRecoveryDecision`，不直接调用 repository / adapter。

## 9.16 `infra` 对象组：runtime、availability 与 adapter state

```rust
/// Raw configuration input before validation; secrets remain opaque references.
pub struct RuntimeConfig {
    /// Configuration profile identifier.
    pub profile_ref: ConfigProfileRef,
    /// Opaque storage / transport / adapter bindings.
    pub bindings: ConfigBindingSet,
}

/// Configuration proven sufficient for the selected process role.
pub struct ValidatedRuntimeConfig {
    /// Validated profile and non-secret binding references.
    pub profile_ref: ConfigProfileRef,
    /// Enabled capability families; unavailable required families remain errors.
    pub capabilities: AdapterCapabilitySet,
    /// Redaction and forbidden-body baseline, which cannot be disabled by config.
    pub redaction_baseline: HostForbiddenBodyClassSet,
}

/// Classifies whether an adapter seam may be used by the builder.
pub enum AdapterAvailability {
    /// The adapter has a validated binding and may be called through its port.
    Available,
    /// The adapter is absent for an optional capability.
    Unconfigured,
    /// The adapter is required but its contract or binding is not ready.
    Blocked(UpstreamBlocker),
    /// The adapter cannot establish whether a prior effect completed.
    Unknown(AdapterUnknown),
}

/// Composes application facade and concrete port implementations.
pub struct RuntimeBuilder;

impl RuntimeBuilder {
    /// Validates config and returns a builder without starting external work.
    pub fn validate(config: RuntimeConfig) -> Result<ValidatedRuntimeConfig, InfraError>;
    /// Assembles the application facade and adapter set for one process role.
    pub fn build(config: ValidatedRuntimeConfig) -> Result<MemberServiceFacade, InfraError>;
}

/// Holds adapter-local state while keeping external truth outside this repository.
pub struct AdapterState {
    /// Seam name and availability classification.
    pub availability: AdapterAvailability,
    /// Last local attempt / binding reference, never a raw product response.
    pub last_local_ref: Option<LocalEffectRef>,
}
```

Infra 唯一实现 application port；persistence 文件分别实现 source/history/idempotency/outbox/projection/UoW store。adapter 只翻译 typed ref / safe summary / neutral outcome，不把 container、RPC、数据库、Broker 或 Sandbox backend model 写入 domain/application。

## 9.17 `api`、`worker`、`jobs` 对象组：入口 carrier

```rust
/// Synchronous command entry that maps public input into an application context.
pub struct ApiCommandEntry;

impl ApiCommandEntry {
    /// Validates metadata and invokes the facade; no direct repository access is allowed.
    pub async fn handle(&self, request: PublicCommandRequest, facade: &MemberServiceFacade) -> ApiCommandDisposition;
}

/// Synchronous query entry with visible / not-visible / degraded separation.
pub struct ApiQueryEntry;

impl ApiQueryEntry {
    /// Invokes the read application surface and maps only safe results.
    pub async fn handle(&self, request: PublicQueryRequest, facade: &MemberServiceFacade) -> ApiQueryDisposition;
}

/// Entry-level result for a command; it is not a Host lifecycle state.
pub enum ApiCommandDisposition {
    Accepted(PublicCommandResult),
    Rejected(PublicRejection),
    Duplicate(PublicReplay),
    Deferred(PublicDeferred),
}

/// Carries lease and cancellation inputs for one worker item.
pub struct WorkerContext {
    /// Worker instance identity for logs only.
    pub worker_ref: WorkerRef,
    /// Cancellation and lease handles are opaque runtime carriers.
    pub cancellation: CancellationToken,
    pub lease: LeaseHandle,
}

/// Local result for one consumer item; it never asserts external delivery.
pub enum ConsumerItemResult {
    Accepted(LocalReceipt),
    Duplicate(StoredResultRef),
    Late(LateItemMarker),
    Unsupported(UnsupportedEnvelope),
    Gap(ConsumerGap),
    Failed(WorkerFailureClass),
}

/// Scheduler-neutral job entry and run disposition.
pub struct JobEntry;

impl JobEntry {
    /// Validates a job input and delegates to application job handling.
    pub async fn run(&self, input: PublicJobInput, facade: &MemberServiceFacade) -> JobRunDisposition;
}

/// Entry result that does not become Host lifecycle truth.
pub enum JobRunDisposition {
    Completed(JobReport),
    NoWork(JobReport),
    Blocked(JobReport),
    Partial(JobReport),
    Unknown(JobReport),
}
```

| 入口模块 | 允许 | 禁止 |
|---|---|---|
| `api` | 构造 application context、映射 safe result / disposition | 直连 domain / repository，或用 transport status 修改 Host 状态 |
| `worker` | 校验 envelope placeholder、提交 consumer receipt、驱动 outbox / projection loop | 由消息到达创建 decision、把 offset / timeout 写成完成 |
| `jobs` | 选择已提交工作、输出 run disposition | 把 scheduler trigger 当授权、创建 formal decision、直接调用外部 backend |

## 9.19 Step 6 跨模块闭环审计

| 闭环 | 审计结论 |
|---|---|
| 对象 -> capability -> IB | 29 个 domain 对象、shared carriers、entry dispositions均可回指 `CAP-MS-01~28` 与 `IB-MS-001~017`；无孤儿对象或隐含新接口。 |
| 字段来源 -> DTO / port | local id/ref 来自 contracts；domain fields 来自 formal input / local repository / port result；application 不补 sibling schema。 |
| 状态 -> 触发方 | domain state 只由 domain transition + application command/consumer/job 编排触发；entry disposition 不传播为 Host state。 |
| DTO -> 对象构造 | Step 8 将为每个 Command / Query / Consumer / Job 列出必填 typed carrier、factory 与 blocked path；缺 exact upstream schema 时保留 placeholder。 |
| UoW -> history/material/outbox | accepted local mutation 在同一 local write-set 中按 source -> history/material -> outbox marker 顺序；external delivery / observation / acceptance 不在该事务内声明。 |
| projection -> SafeHostView | domain `HostProjectionState`、infra projection store、application read assembly、contracts `SafeHostView` 四者保持独立。 |
| cursor / revision | `HostChangeCursor` 与 `CommittedChangeCursor` 的 exact type 未闭合；不得新建 alias / conversion / 第三种 cursor。 |
| phase boundary | 任何实现、测试、artifact、report、evidence、signoff、readiness均未被提前声明。 |
